article.articleHeadline: IRW-PRESS: Redwood AI Corp.: Redwood AI unterzeichnet Absichtserklärung zur Erforschung der Nachverfolgung von Krankheitserregern mittels KI-Genomik an der Grenze zwischen Ruanda und der Demokratischen Republik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IRW-PRESS: Redwood AI Corp.: Redwood AI signs a memorandum of understanding to study pathogen tracking using AI genomics at the border between Rwanda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On June 12, 2026, Redwood AI Corp. announced an unsigned Letter of Intent with Dr. Placide Sesonga of the University of Global Health Equity (UGHE) to study pathogen tracking using AI genomics at the Rwanda–Democratic Republic of Congo border. The collaboration seeks to develop a regional One-Health surveillance initiative to enhance early detection and preparedness for emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases in Central and East Africa, initially focusing on high-priority surveillance regions and mobility corridors in Rwanda and DR Congo. The proposed system would integrate pathogen monitoring, metagenomic sequencing, geospatial and epidemiological analyses, and Redwood AI’s Predictive Intelligence platform to identify abnormal pathogen activity and early outbreak signals at the population level. The project cites the recent Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo and neighboring areas, underscoring the need for faster, coordinated regional outbreak notification. The LOI contemplates a formal project protocol and implementation framework, and notes a board change with Graydon Bensler resigning.

triage.headline_ja: IRW-PRESS: Redwood AI Corp.: Redwood AIがルワンダと民主共和国コンゴ国境でのAIゲノミクスを使用した病原体追跡研究に関する覚書に署名
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はAIテクノロジー企業による監視システムの開発発表であり、実際のエボラウイルス病の新規発生事例ではない。疾患は言及されているが、主題は研究パイロットプログラムの計画段階であり、公衆衛生への直接的な影響や異常な感染症クラスターの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去のエボラ発生を文脈として言及しているが、新規の感染症イベント報告ではなく、AI監視技術の開発・研究契約の発表である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo arrive in the US for the World Cup after Ebola quarantine
article.articleSummary: Three weeks of isolation in Belgium due to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo forced the DR Congo World Cup squad to quarantine before entering the United States; they arrived on a Paris-origin flight, after US authorities required Belgium-based quarantine. Pre-tournament plans were scrapped: a home camp canceled and a warm-up vs Chile canceled amid fears of spread. Head coach Sebastien Desabre said they adapted and focused. The team, qualifying for their first World Cup since 1974 as Zaire, will base in Houston for Group K games: June 17 vs Portugal; June 23 vs Colombia in Guadalajara; June 28 vs Uzbekistan in Atlanta. The outbreak continues in DRC, prompting ongoing travel restrictions and logistical changes for the squad.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ隔離後にワールドカップ参加のため米国に到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行により、国際的な渡航制限・隔離措置が発生しており、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「異常/予想外」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当し、複数基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が国際的なスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）に与える影響である。Bluedot APIが複数の国（米国、フランス、ベルギー、チリ、ポルトガル、コロンビア、ウズベキスタン、メキシコ）を抽出しているが、実際のイベント発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみであり、他地域は代表団の渡航先または競技開催地である。サマリーには「The outbreak continues in DRC」と明記されており、継続する流行がRRA進行の根拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: Η αποστολή του Κονγκό έλαβε άδεια εισόδου στις ΗΠΑ παρά τις ανησυχίες για τον Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo mission was granted entry into the United States despite concerns about Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo’s national football team, the Leopards, was granted entry to the United States for the 2026 World Cup despite Ebola-related concerns that affected their preparations. U.S. authorities anticipated a 21-day isolation period prior to entry due to the viral health risk. The Leopards landed in Houston on Thursday, June 11, around 14:30 local time (20:30 Greek time) on a Paris-originating flight, and exited the international airport about an hour later without any formalities. Right-back Aaron Won-Mbisaka told AFP at the airport that the squad had finally received clearance to participate in the 2026 World Cup. The report notes that Ebola influenced training and preparation, but provides no details of any confirmed cases linked to the team or the entry process.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの代表団はエボラウイルスに関する懸念にもかかわらず、米国への入国許可を取得した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認症例がなく、記事はコンゴ国家フットボールチームの入国許可について報じているのみ。実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、懸念ベースの報道であるため、シグナル基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は確認されたエボラウイルス症例を報じたものではなく、コンゴ国家フットボールチームの2026年ワールドカップ参加に向けた入国許可に関する報道である。エボラウイルスは懸念事項として言及されているのみで、実際のアウトブレイク証拠は記事内に存在しない。このため、感染症シグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: આરોગ્ય સમિતિની બેઠક: રોગચાળાના આંકડા, સ્ટોક, ટીબી, બાળ મૃત્યુદર સહિતના મુદ્દે કલેકટરે સમીક્ષા કરી
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Committee Meeting: The Collector reviewed issues including epidemic statistics, stock, tuberculosis, and child mortality rate.
article.articleSummary: Rajkot district health committee meeting, chaired by Collector Dr. Om Prakash, reviewed epidemic statistics, stock levels, tuberculosis control, and child mortality rate. The Rajkot Municipal Corporation publishes weekly OPD attendance and epidemic data at health centers, with input from the district health officer on CHCs and PHCs. Discussions covered fever cases, cholera, and other communicable diseases, available facilities at health centers, and OPD/medication stock. Public health measures emphasized drinking-water chlorination, chlorine testing, bacteriological analysis, pipeline leak registration and repair, and water treatment. The meeting directed geographic analysis of the TB eradication campaign and AIDS patterns. Per taluka, high-risk pregnancies, maternal and child mortality, child screening, gender ratio, and cancer cases were reviewed; emphasis on PM-JAY uptake, National Adolescent Health Programme, District Quality Assurance, and District AYUSH Society activities. Attendees included District Development Officer Anandu Suresh Govind, Chief Health Officer R. R. Fulmali, and PHC/CHC physicians.

triage.headline_ja: 保健委員会会議：流行統計、在庫、結核、小児死亡率を含む問題についてコレクターが審査を実施
triage.triage_reason: 結核とコレラが言及されているが、記事は定例会議の議題報告であり、具体的な感染症の急性発生や異常事象ではない。情報が不足しており、実際のアウトブレイク徴候の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はラジコット地区の定例保健委員会会議の議事要旨であり、結核とコレラが議題に含まれているものの、現在の感染症イベント（患者数増加、アウトブレイク、予期しない病態など）の具体的な報告ではない。政府機関による定期的な監視・評価活動の記録と解釈される。シグナル判定にはより詳細な患者データ、疾患の異常性、または公開情報の続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Burundi BVD Ebola preparedness - DREF Operation (MDRBI026) - Burundi
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola Virus Disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain have been declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) and Uganda, with Ituri as the epicenter. As of 28 May 2026, more than 1,000 suspected cases and 220 deaths have been reported across the affected DRC provinces, with links to Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, contaminated materials, or animals, and can trigger large, deadly outbreaks if not rapidly contained. The World Health Organization has labeled the event a major public health concern due to cross-border transmission risks. Burundi is high risk because of its proximity and trade routes (Bujumbura-Goma, Bujumbura-Kivu, Bujumbura-Entebbe). Burundi finalized a National Ebola Preparedness and Response Plan on 22 May 2026; preparedness activities continue with Burundi Red Cross and IFRC.

triage.headline_ja: ブルンジ BVD エボラ対策準備 - DREF オペレーション（MDRBI026）- ブルンジ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ多発生により、ワクチン未承認、高い致死率、クロスボーダー感染リスク、WHO公式通告の重大懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo株エボラの多発生を報告しており、DRCの3州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）と呼ばれ、ウガンダとの関連が記載されている。Bujumbura-Goma-Kivuルートでのクロスボーダー感染リスクが明示されている。UgandaはBluedotデータに含まれるが、対象国リストに該当せず、Burundiは対象国に該当しないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHO公式の公衆衛生上の重大懸念として指定され、高リスク評価が確定している。

article.articleHeadline: പനി ചൂടിൽ കോട്ടയം ; പനി ബാധിതരുടെ എണ്ണത്തിൽ വർധന ;സർക്കാർ ആശുപത്രികളിൽ പനി ബാധിതർക്ക് പ്രത്യേക വാർഡ് തുറന്നു ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever in the heat in Kottayam; number of fever patients increasing; a dedicated ward for fever patients opened in government hospitals ⋆ Third Eye News Live.
article.articleSummary: Fever cases in Kottayam, Kerala rise as monsoon begins; government hospitals have opened a dedicated fever ward in outpatient departments to manage the surge. Prolonged OPD queues push many patients to private facilities, where treatment costs—covering antibiotics, vaccines, and blood tests—can be up to four times higher, straining households as schools reopen and attendance falls. Besides viral fever, dengue fever and leptospirosis have been reported in the district, with leptospirosis more common in the western parts. Following the opening of the Thanneermukkom Bund, brackish water from backwaters is flowing into local water bodies, affecting wells and contributing to diarrhea. Leptospirosis remains a concern in the western area. Ongoing outbreaks and public health burden are evident during the monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: コッタヤムの熱病；熱病患者数が増加；政府病院で熱病患者のための専用病棟を開設
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーララ州コッタヤムでデング熱とレプトスピラ症が同時発生し、患者数増加傾向が明らかで、政府医療施設に専用病棟開設される事態となっており、IHR基準（異常性・深刻な影響）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ケーララ州コッタヤムにおいて、モンスーンシーズンの到来に伴いデング熱とレプトスピラ症の患者数が増加している。政府病院が専用病棟を開設するなど公衆衛生上の対応が活発化。水系感染症（レプトスピラ症）と媒介蚊感染症（デング熱）の同時流行の兆候。記事言語がマラヤラム語であり、地元メディアによる報道から地域内での社会的関心の高さが窺える。

article.articleHeadline: Registran nuevos focos de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreaks recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks extend beyond Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with new cases detected in North Kivu and South Kivu. As of June 10, 2026, authorities report 676 confirmed cases: 629 in Ituri, 44 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu, along with 41 new cases and three new zones affected. The Public Health Emergency Operations Center notes geographic expansion and says response teams are adapting, with surveillance being intensified. Health Minister Roger Kamba emphasized a zone-by-zone, signal-driven response, underscoring ongoing efforts to strengthen surveillance and control measures. The update is issued by national health authorities and public briefings dated June 12, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの新たな発生が記録される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な地理的拡大、国際的拡大リスク）。既知の流行地での地理的拡大と複数州への波及は、フルRRAを要するシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Ebola）の既知流行地（イトゥリ州）からの地理的拡大。2026年6月10日時点で676確定症例、複数州への波及。保健当局による対応強化とサーベイランス集約化が報告されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、サマリーは主題がDRC内の流行拡大であることを明確に述べている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo: confirman 676 casos y 136 muertes en actual brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: 676 cases and 136 deaths confirmed in the current outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of the current cut-off. The epidemic remains active and has crossed borders into Uganda, which has 19 cases, including 14 imported from the DRC, with 2 deaths among imported cases. Transmission is via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals. Laboratory confirmation is required to distinguish Ebola from other diseases with similar symptoms. The region faces containment challenges due to insecurity in parts of the DRC, limited access to remote populations, medical supplies, and healthcare worker training. International organizations have intensified support for information campaigns and surveillance. Early contact tracing and a 21-day monitoring period are emphasized to prevent further spread. Cross-border risk communication and joint health worker training on biosecurity are ongoing between Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：現在の流行で676例の確認患者と136例の死亡が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認例と死亡例があり、すでに国境を越えてウガンダに拡大している。公開衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限リスクがすべて認識される。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていません。DRCでの流行が確認されており、対象国であるため PICKUP 判定としています。エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大、高い致死率（約20%）、限定的な治療オプション、および地域の紛争による公衆衛生上の課題が全基準に該当する理由です。

article.articleHeadline: Noch mehr Zonen betroffen: Ebola-Ausbruch weitet sich aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even more areas affected: Ebola outbreak is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to widen. As of Wednesday, June 10, 2026, confirmed cases rose to 676 with 136 deaths. A government briefing published Thursday evening via X confirmed new affected areas in North Kivu and Ituri, bringing the three active provinces to Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola; it was first announced on May 15 but remained undetected for weeks. Response is hampered by mistrust of health workers and attacks on burial teams and treatment centers. The country relies on more than 500 health zones, each serving roughly 100,000–150,000 people, to coordinate care. Congo has battled multiple Ebola outbreaks, including the second-worst globally from 2018–2020 with more than 2,200 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: さらに多くの地域が影響：エボラ感染の拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多地域・多州への拡大、死亡を伴う重症事例の増加、国際的拡大のリスク、および対応の課題が明示されている。
triage.notes: 記事では確認された676症例、136死亡、3州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）への拡大を報告。Bundibugyo株のエボラウイルス。保健労働者への不信感と埋葬チーム・治療施設への攻撃により対応が阻害されている。COVIDやマールブルグを考慮する際とは異なり、エボラはWHO PHEIC候補の疾患である。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaudbrud i DR Congo spreder sig til nye områder af landet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo spreads to new areas of the country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 676 laboratory-confirmed cases with 136 deaths, according to the government and AFP. As of Thursday, cases rose from 635 with 127 deaths a day earlier. Three new health zones have reported Ebola infections, in Nord-Kivu and Ituri, signaling extension beyond the initial epicenter in Ituri. Ituri accounts for 629 cases; Nord-Kivu 44; Sud-Kivu 3. The outbreak began on May 15 and involves the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Authorities have noted that the outbreak went undetected for weeks before being identified, complicating control efforts. Mistrust and opposition from communities have hampered response, with attacks on treatment centers and health workers involved in funerals of the deceased.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が国内の新しい地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。実験室確認676例、死亡136例、新規地域への拡大、コミュニティ対立による対応困難が確認される。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀有株）は承認済みワクチンなし。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀有株で承認済みワクチンがない。流行は5月15日開始。初期検出遅延（数週間未検出）およびコミュニティの不信、処置センターへの攻撃が対応を複雑化させている。新規3健康区域での報告は北キブ州およびイトゥリ州での拡大を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm Kesehatan Menyala di Cirebon, Puluhan Ribu Orang Terduga TBC Jadi Target Skrining Massal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert sounded in Cirebon as tens of thousands of people suspected of TB become targets of mass screening.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, health alert in Cirebon Regency, West Java, Indonesia, as tens of thousands of residents suspected of tuberculosis (TB) become targets of mass screening. The local government emphasizes strengthening early detection to prevent outbreaks or escalation into a public health emergency (KLB). Efforts focus on optimizing primary health centers (puskesmas) and community health cadres to conduct mass TB screening and expand prevention education. Cross-sector collaboration with the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI), the police (Polri), and hospitals will help map high-risk areas and secure medical logistics. Authorities urge rapid follow-up of any reports of potential outbreaks or case surges to curb spread. The initiatives were discussed at a Kabupaten Cirebon Coordination Meeting on Prevention and Control of Diseases, reflecting heightened readiness to address TB alongside rising non-communicable diseases in the region.

triage.headline_ja: シレボンで保健警報が発令、数万人のTBC疑い患者が一括検診の対象に
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西ジャワ州での結核の大規模検診プログラムは異常・予想外な事象であり、スクリーニング基準を複数満たす。ただし死亡数や重症度の詳細、感染の急速な拡大の具体的証拠が記述されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシア西ジャワ州シレボン地区での結核に関する大規模検診開始を述べており、インドネシアが実際の発生地である。発生地域フィールドのJawa Barat（西ジャワ州）はインドネシア内の地方行政区画であり、国レベルの verified_locations に統一。社会的・政治的関心は高く（地方政府による調整会議開催、複数セクターの連携）、スクリーニング基準を複数満たす。しかし具体的な死亡数、入院数、感染の急速な拡大の明確な証拠が記載されていないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Health Department Conducts Mass Dengue Survey in Kharar
article.articleSummary: Mass dengue survey conducted in Kharar city, Punjab, as part of an anti-dengue campaign directed by the Punjab Government and Health & Family Welfare Minister Dr. Balbir Singh. Civil Surgeon Dr. Sangeeta Jain led the effort, with teams visiting households to inspect for dengue mosquito larvae and to educate residents on preventive measures. Senior Medical Officer Dr. Preet Mohan Singh Khurana stressed public participation, noting dengue mosquitoes breed in clean, stagnant water and urging citizens to prevent water accumulation in homes, shops, and surroundings. Residents were urged to observe a weekly 'Dry Day,' regularly clean coolers and water containers, and promptly contact a government health facility if fever develops. Teams inspected houses, commercial establishments, and public places to identify potential breeding sites and disseminate precautions. Public cooperation is sought to keep Kharar dengue-free.

triage.headline_ja: Health Department Conducts Mass Dengue Survey in Kharar
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の集団調査は公衆衛生上の関心を示していますが、現在の活動は予防キャンペーンであり、流行や深刻な公衆衛生影響の報告がないため。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はカラール市（パンジャブ州、インド）での予防的なデング熱調査キャンペーンについて述べており、アクティブな流行や深刻な事例報告は含まれていない。スクリーニング基準では『prolonged_exposure』と『epidemic_prone』が該当するが、現在のシグナルは行政的な予防活動であり、詳細な流行データが不足しているため、WATCH判定として経過観察の継続を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam records over 50,000 dengue cases as experts warn of unpredictable outbreak
article.articleSummary: Việt Nam recorded more than 50,000 dengue fever cases in the first five months of 2026, a 2.5-fold rise from the same period in 2025, with DENV-2 currently dominant and linked to a higher risk of severe illness. Outbreaks have remained high through late 2025 and into 2026, defying traditional seasonal decline. Prolonged hot, humid weather with heavy rainfall is creating favorable mosquito breeding conditions and expanding spread beyond traditional hotspots to northern provinces, per WHO. Globally, dengue infections rose tenfold from 2010–2019, with WHO warning dengue is a major public health threat. The age profile now shows adults and children affected roughly equally, placing more households at risk. Severe dengue typically peaks on days 3–5 and can cause shock, major bleeding or organ failure, sometimes requiring intensive care and costing hundreds of millions of đồng. Authorities are piloting vaccination programmes, deploying AI-based early warning, enhanced surveillance, and vector-control measures toward WHO's 2030 death-elimination target.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムが5万件以上のデング熱患者を記録、専門家が予測不可能な流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の急速な増加（前年比2.5倍）、DENV-2優位株による重症化リスク上昇、季節外の異常な流行パターン、北部地域への地理的拡大、成人・小児に同等の影響により、IHR基準3項目以上該当かつWPRO基準全5項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムでの5万件超のデング熱急増を主題とし、DENV-2による重症化リスク、従来の季節パターンからの逸脱（prolonged hot/humid weather with heavy rainfall）、地理的拡大（northern provinces）、成人・小児に同等の影響、および政府による予防接種・AI早期警戒・ベクター対策の実施を報告している。WHO 2030目標との関連も記述されており、国際的な公衆衛生の懸念事項として適切。

article.articleHeadline: Kozhikode man tests positive for Nipah, 77 contacts identified
article.articleSummary: Kozhikode, Kerala: A 43-year-old Ramanattukara resident tested positive for Nipah virus, confirmed by NIV Pune after an initial VRDL positive result. The patient is in critical condition and on ventilator support at a Nipah isolation facility in Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital. This case is the 11th Nipah episode in Kerala since the 2018 outbreak. Authorities have intensified surveillance and contact tracing, identifying 77 possible contacts categorized by risk: 15 priority (2 highest-risk, 13 high-risk) and 58 healthcare workers. None of the identified contacts currently show symptoms, and there is no immediate containment zone. Immediate family members—wife, two children, father, mother—and a maternal relative are under quarantine or surveillance as the district develops a detailed exposure route map and strengthens containment preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: コジコード男性ニパウイルス陽性、77人の接触者特定
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス確定患者の発生（インド・ケララ州での11番目のエピソード）。重症度が高く（人工呼吸器装着、重篤状態）、接触者追跡が進行中。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高い死亡率（40-75%）を持つ新興病原体。ケララ州では2018年以来の周期的な発生が報告されている。本症例は確定患者であり、接触者管理（77人）が継続中。隔離施設での治療体制が確立されており、現時点で顕症接触者なし。今後の動向監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah In Kerala: केरल के कोझिकोड में निपाह वायरस का नया मामला आने से हड़कंप, प्रशासन अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah in Kerala: A new Nipah virus case in Kozhikode, Kerala triggers panic; authorities on alert.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus case in Kozhikode, Kerala: a 43-year-old man from Ramanattukara tested positive and is hospitalized in the ICU at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital. District authorities confirm the case and have traced the patient’s recent contacts. A total of 77 individuals have been identified (14 family members, 5 friends/colleagues, 58 healthcare workers); 15 high-risk contacts have been isolated or quarantined. The suspected source is exposure to bat droppings while cleaning an old warehouse he had rented. Rapid Response Team meetings are under way, and a 24-hour control room has been set up at the district medical office, with helplines publicized (0495-2373901, 9072007767). Public urged not to panic; health facilities report adequate medicines and PPE. Door-to-door screening in Ramanattukara and surrounding areas is planned as Nipah, a deadly zoonotic virus transmitted by fruit bats and causing encephalitis, is monitored.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州ニパール：コージコード地区での新規ニパール・ウイルス感染が確認され、住民にパニック；当局が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: ニパール・ウイルス（高い致死率の人獣共通感染症）の確認症例に基づく重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、および対応体制の確立が示唆される。IHR基準で3項目該当。
triage.notes: ニパール・ウイルスは高い致死率（40～75%）の人獣共通感染症であり、フルーツバットが自然宿主。本症例はコージコード（ケララ州）での確認で、77名の接触者が特定され、15名が隔離・検疫中。当局が24時間体制の統制室を設置し、接触者追跡・スクリーニングを開始。バットの糞便への曝露が疑われる暴露源であり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク存在。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda perketat langkah pencegahan Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda tightens Ebola prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: Uganda tightens Ebola prevention measures amid the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. On June 10, the Ugandan Ministry of Health, after President Museveni’s national address, distributed new guidelines to districts bordering eastern DR Congo, the outbreak epicenter. Mass gatherings, including weddings and market openings, are suspended; schools are urged to strictly follow preventive measures. Uganda reports no new Ebola cases in five days, with a cumulative 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Secretary Diana Atwine notes that once symptoms appear, the virus is more concentrated in the digestive tract and can be detected in saliva, vomit, and feces, informing transmission dynamics. She urges the public not to share cups or drinking vessels and warns that contaminated items can spread Ebola; cautions against opening fruits during fruit season due to potential animal consumption.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の予防措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、またWPRO基準で複数該当。東部DRコンゴでの流行がウガンダに波及する直接的リスクがあり、すでに19確定症例と死亡例があり、政府レベルでの対応強化が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのエボラ対応強化だが、根本的な流行源は東部DRコンゴ。ウガンダは国境を接する地域で確定症例（19例、死亡2例）があり、越境感染リスクが高い。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めず、DRCのみ対象。Ugandaは Bluedot の発生地域には含まれるが、対象国リスト外のため本来は除外すべき。ただし、DRCでの流行直接イベントと同時発生の国境越境リスクイベントであるため、DRCを主体として PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例升至676例_中国经济网 -- -- 国家经济门户
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases rise to 676 in the Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 676 cumulative confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of June 10, 2026. There are 262 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 32 recoveries. Ongoing community transmission remains, with warnings that without rapid public health action the geographic spread could widen. Africa CDC Director Kasseya described the outbreak as one of Africa’s largest on record, though armed conflict in eastern DRC hampers surveillance and contact tracing. Uganda’s Ebola situation is reportedly under control with no evidence of community transmission. Beyond Ebola, Africa faces cholera, measles, and monkeypox challenges, underscoring the need to strengthen health-system resilience to prevent further public health crises.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認症例が676例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。大規模エボラ流行（676例、136死亡）で深刻な公衆衛生影響、地理的拡大リスク、国際的対応の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCにおけるエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。武装紛争による監視体制の脆弱性が拡大リスク要因として特筆。Africa CDC所長による「アフリカ最大規模」との評価は国際的関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: kerala-nipah-virus-case-kozhikode-businessman-contacts-traced
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus confirmed in Kerala's Kozhikode district: a 43-year-old Feroke businessman is on ventilator at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital after PCR at the local hospital turned positive and NIV Pune confirmed Nipah infection. This is the first Nipah case in Kerala for 2026. Health officials have traced 72 contacts (58 medical staff, 14 family), with two high-risk and 13 moderate-risk; the remainder are low-risk. Containment includes rapid PPE/medical supplies, quarantine for high-risk contacts, fever-surveillance, and an environmental investigation of a rented godown where bat secretions are suspected to be the infection source. Nipah's natural host is fruit bats; transmission occurs via contact with secretions from infected individuals. Case fatality has ranged from 40% to 75%. Since 2018, Kerala has had 32 Nipah infections and 23 deaths; outbreaks occurred in 2018 (19 cases, 17 deaths) and in 2023–2025 with smaller totals. Public health guidance emphasizes hygiene and avoiding bat-bitten fruits.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州コージコード地区でニパウイルス確認：ビジネスマンの濃厚接触者72人を追跡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性），WPRO基準で全5つ該当，インド国内での流行史と高い致命率（40-75%）により，フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは致命率40-75%で極めて高リスク。ケーラ州では2018年以降32件の感染と23件の死亡が記録。2023-2025年にも小規模な再発生あり。環境源（コウモリ由来）が特定されており，継続的な感染リスクがある。濃厚接触者72名の追跡により感染拡大の監視が可能。国際的なバイオセキュリティ関心の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Explained: Why Nipah and Shigella are raising fresh public health concern in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis is a highly contagious bacterial diarrhoeal disease caused by Shigella, transmitted via the faecal-oral route and spread by five 'F's (food, faeces, fingers, flies, fomites). In Kerala, past outbreaks include about 40 cases in Kozhikode in 2020; Shigella is present in Kerala, Maharashtra and Assam, mainly affecting children under five and the elderly. Nipah is a zoonotic virus that causes respiratory illness and acute encephalitis; transmission from fruit bats and via contaminated raw date palm sap or contact with infected animals. Nipah emerged in Kozhikode in 2018, with 17 of 18 infected dying; Kerala has since seen about two-dozen Nipah deaths. Mortality for Nipah ranges 40-75%. Prevention includes hygiene, clean water, latrine use, avoiding bats, and PPE; treatment: Shigella hydration and supportive care; Nipah lacks specific therapy, but early diagnosis with high-quality supportive care improves outcomes. Seasonal outbreaks accompany Kerala’s early monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスとシゲラ菌がケーラ州で新たな公衆衛生上の懸念を引き起こしている理由
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率（40-75%）を持つ新興感染症であり、シゲラ菌との複合感染事象はIHR基準2項目以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当する。インド国内の複数州での発生と季節的な再出現パターンがあり、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは致死率が極めて高く（40-75%）、過去にケーラ州で複数の死亡例を記録（2018年に17/18死亡）。シゲラ菌との複合感染が報告されており、季節的な再出現パターンがある。両感染症とも5歳未満児と高齢者に特に影響を及ぼす。記事では予防措置と治療の対策も記載されており、公衆衛生対策の重要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo aumenta a 676 los casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 676 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths from a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri and spreading to North and South Kivu (Ituri borders South Sudan and Uganda). In the DRC, 629 cases are in Ituri, 44 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu. Three new health zones are affected: Masereka and Vuhovi, North Kivu, and Kambala, Ituri, bringing the total affected zones to 29. Two more recoveries raise the cured to 32; 260 people remain hospitalized or in isolation. The outbreak carries a case fatality rate around 30–50% and has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17; Uganda reports 19 cases, 14 imported from DRC, including 2 deaths. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルス確定症例を676例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な出来事、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を5月17日に宣言済みであり、複数国で確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak、6月12日時点で676確定症例、136死亡（CFR 30-50%）。5月15日にイトゥリで宣言、北キブ、南キブに拡大。ウガンダで19症例（DRC由来14例、死亡2例）報告。WHOは5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。該当対象国はDRCのみ。ウガンダ、スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli bacteria found in drinking water sources near Kent Mahal complex in Kochi
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, laboratory tests detected bacterial contamination in wastewater and drinking water near Kent Mahal Apartments in Brahmapuram, Kochi. The long-running sewage and solid waste dispute, raised about nine years ago by Vadavucode-Puthencruz residents, involves wastewater discharge from the Kent Mahal complex affecting nearby water bodies, fields and homes. The Community Health Centre, Vadavucode, sent two channel-discharge water samples to the Regional Public Health Laboratory, which found coliform bacteria. Drinking water samples from nearby wells were analyzed at the Regional Analytical Laboratory, Kakkanad, showing both coliform bacteria and E. coli, signaling groundwater quality concerns in the area. The results renew attention on the unresolved controversy, which has included official interventions and court proceedings without resolution.

triage.headline_ja: コーチンのケント・マハール複合施設近くの飲料水源でE. coli菌が検出
triage.triage_reason: 飲料水汚染イベント（E. coli検出）で公衆衛生への潜在的影響あり。ただし現時点では局地的・環境的な水質汚染報告であり、ヒト感染患者数や重症度についての情報がなく、評価に不足がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケーララ州コーチ地域の飲料水汚染（E. coli検出）を報告している。長年の下水処理紛争に関連する局地的な水質汚濁であるが、実際のヒト感染患者、健康被害、入院例などについての記述がない。継続的な水への曝露リスクは存在する。追加情報（患者報告、発症状況）を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Recurring Nipah outbreaks in Kerala linked to ecological changes, says recent study
article.articleSummary: Recurring Nipah outbreaks in Kerala are linked to ecological changes, habitat disruption, and increasing human–wildlife interaction, according to a May 13 study 'Two geographies, one virus: What recurrent Nipah spillover in India reveals' by Deepak Y Patil, Rima R Sahay, Sreelekshmy Mohandas and Pragya D Yadav. The researchers note deforestation and loss of natural habitats in biodiversity-rich regions may raise opportunities for viruses to cross from animals to humans. In Kerala, Nipah outbreaks have historically occurred between April and September, when hot, humid conditions and seasonal fruits attract fruit bats (Pteropus spp.) closer to settlements, creating direct or indirect contact with humans and domestic animals. Nipah virus (NiV) is primarily maintained in fruit bats and is a highly infectious pathogen capable of causing severe illness in humans. Kerala's strong disease surveillance and rapid public health response have helped prevent larger outbreaks, underscoring ecology as a driver of recurrent spillovers.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州における反復的ニパーウイルス流行は生態系の変化に関連している、最近の研究が示唆
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスは高リスク病原体だが、本記事は既知の流行パターンに関する研究報告であり、新規の急性アウトブレイク報告ではない。情報の性質上、現在の流行規模や人命喪失の具体的データが不明である。
triage.notes: 記事はニパーウイルスの反復的流行メカニズムに関する学術研究の発表であり、現在進行中の緊急アウトブレイク報告ではない。ケララ州は過去の季節的流行で知られており、現在の活動状況については明確な情報がない。生態系変化と人獣接触増加による継続的曝露リスクは存在するが、公衆衛生対応が有効に機能していると記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: Reportan nuevas zonas afectadas por ébola en la RD del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New areas affected by Ebola reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On June 12, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Public Health Emergency Operations Center said the Ebola outbreak has expanded to additional health zones. Most infections remain in Ituri province, but new cases were detected in North Kivu and South Kivu as well as Ituri. The minister of health, Roger Kamba, reported the total confirmed cases rose to 676, up by 41. They breakdown: 629 in Ituri, 44 in North Kivu, 3 in South Kivu. The three newly affected health zones are Masereka, Vuhovi, and Kambala. Health teams are adapting and surveillance is being intensified; the response is based on signals and in each zone. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was declared in the DRC on May 15. Two days later, the WHO declared it a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱の新たな影響地域が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。WHO公式宣言済みのPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）であり、複数州での感染拡大、確定患者数増加（41人増加）、新たな健康地域への拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日に既にPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）による2026年5月15日宣言のアウトブレイクであり、Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu複数州で確認されている。記事は既知のPHEIC状況に関する最新情報報告であり、国際的監視の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A outbreak hits Patiala's Dogra Mohalla, 16 found infected
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, a Hepatitis A outbreak in Patiala's Dogra Mohalla has 16 confirmed cases. Lab confirmation attributes infection to Hepatitis A, a viral liver disease typically spread via contaminated food and water, with officials suspecting drinking-water contamination. Water samples collected near Sirhindi Gate were sent to the government laboratory at Kharar for analysis. Of the 16 cases, five are hospitalized and the rest are managed on an OPD basis; patients aged 4–48. The 243-household locality houses about 1,119 residents. Civil surgeon Dr Kushaldeep Gill stated active surveillance is underway with house-to-house surveys by ASHAs and ANMs. A medical camp has been established; chlorine tablets and ORS are distributed. Authorities urge safe drinking water, hygiene, and prompt reporting of fever, jaundice, diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Local leaders allege sewage contamination; officials have arranged tanker water and promised repairs to the water supply.

triage.headline_ja: 肝炎A集団発生がパティアラのドグラ・モハッラを襲う、16人が感染確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準で4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。対象国インドでの確認済みイベント。
triage.notes: パティアラのドグラ・モハッラで16人の確認患者（うち5人入院）。汚染された飲料水が疑われるメカニズム。1,119人の住民を抱える243世帯の限定地域だが、継続した曝露リスク（水道水汚染）と地域内での流行性あり。当局が積極的な監視活動と対応措置を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: New areas affected by Ebola reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has spread beyond Ituri to North Kivu and South Kivu, with new cases in Ituri’s Masereka, Vuhovi, and Kambala health zones. Total confirmed cases reach 676: 629 in Ituri, 44 in North Kivu, and 3 in South Kivu. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, was declared on May 15 and designated a WHO public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Health authorities report intensified surveillance and that the response is being adapted to signals and areas as cases continue to be investigated and managed by healthcare teams. The updates reflect ongoing containment efforts across affected provinces amid geographic expansion of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの新たな流行地域が報告される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例676件、複数州への地理的拡大、WHO国際的懸念公衆衛生上の緊急事態指定、ヒト-ヒト感染による流行性の高さから、IHR基準4つすべて該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認例676件（イトゥーリ州629件、北キヴ州44件、南キヴ州3件）、Bundibugyo株の流行。2026年5月15日の宣言、5月17日のWHOによる国際的懸念公衆衛生上の緊急事態指定。複数州間での地理的拡大が進行中。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah virus confirmed in Kozhikode; patient critical, 77 contacts traced, 15 high-risk people quarantined
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus confirmed in Kozhikode, Kerala, India, with a 43-year-old Ramanattukara patient now on ventilator in the ICU at Kozhikode Medical College (condition critical); NIV Pune confirmed infection. 77 contacts identified: 58 healthcare workers, 14 family members, 5 friends/colleagues. Highest-risk: 2; high-risk: 13; low-risk: 62; all highest/high-risk individuals placed under quarantine. Field containment underway; no containment zones declared. Infection source under investigation; two sites examined—the godown where the patient stored goods and a fruit tree near his home; potential link to bats roosting at Karad near Feroke. A control room has been opened; helplines: 0495-2373901 and 9072007767. Fever onset May 30; treated June 1; readmitted June 7; MRI and CSF investigations triggered Nipah suspicion. Relatives reported visit to the godown near Feroke; forest department to check for bat deaths at roosting sites.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスがコジコードで確認; 患者は重体、77人の接触者が特定され、15人の高リスク者が隔離中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ニパウイルスは高致死率で国際的に懸念される病原体。インドでの確認例は重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはWHO指定の高優先度病原体（致死率40-75%）。インドのケーララ州で人への感染確認。患者は重症（ICU、人工呼吸器装着中）。77名の接触者追跡中、15名が高リスク隔離中。感染源調査中（コウモリとの関連が疑われている）。Classical Swine Fever も併記されているが、サマリー上の主要イベントはニパウイルス。古い記事データ（2026年6月時点）であり、現在のリアルタイム情報確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Experts call for better public vigil to prevent disease outbreaks in Kerala
article.articleSummary: June in Kerala records 38 Shigella cases and a single death, alongside a Nipah case and rising influenza, signaling a resurgence of zoonotic and enteric infections as monsoon and climate shifts heighten outbreak risk. Shigella is transmitted via contaminated water; West Nile and dengue are mosquito-borne, underscoring the need for clean surroundings and safe drinking water. The state saw deaths from communicable diseases, dengue, leptospirosis, influenza, and Nipah rise to 468 in 2024 from 224 the year before. Experts urge improved water, sanitation and waste management to curb transmission, emphasizing better sanitation and drinking-water safety. Dr. Rajeev Jayadevan points to abundant water bodies and stagnant water as drivers, while Dr. Althaf Ali calls for investment in root-cause studies to prevent infectious and zoonotic outbreaks, referencing Thiruvananthapuram’s Government Medical College Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州での病気の流行を防ぐための公衆衛生監視の強化を専門家が呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州インド中でシゲラ菌（38例、1死亡）、ニパウイルス、インフルエンザなど複数の感染症が同時発生。2024年の感染症死亡数が2023年の2倍以上（224→468）に増加しており、異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスク（ニパウイルスはヒト-ヒト感染可能）が認められ、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 複数の媒介感染症（西ナイルウイルス、デング熱、レプトスピラ症、ニパウイルス）と腸管感染症（シゲラ菌）が同時に検出されており、季節的リスク（モンスーン期）と気候変動による環境変化が背景にある。2024年の死亡数が前年比2倍超である点が特に懸念される。ニパウイルスは人獣共通感染症でヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高く、国際的波及の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: بعد مخاوف بسبب إيبولا...منتخب الكونغو الديمقراطية يسمح له دخول الولايات المتحدة للمشاركة في المونديال
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After concerns about Ebola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo national team is allowed to enter the United States to participate in the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s national team entered the United States amid Ebola fears. On 12 June 2026, the squad arrived at Houston’s airport from Paris around 14:30 local time and left about an hour later, with officials stating no entry issues. The team had previously lost 1-2 to Chile in Orléans, France, in a closed-door warm-up. A planned match in La Granja de la Concepción, Spain, was canceled due to Ebola-related concerns. The World Health Organization had declared an international health emergency, reporting over 500 confirmed cases and dozens of deaths in the DRC outbreak. Officials said none of the players currently reside in DRC; Kinshasa training camp was canceled per health guidance. The squad underwent a 21-day quarantine before entering the U.S. Their World Cup 2026 opener is against Portugal in Houston on 17 June, followed by Colombia and Uzbekistan. Their last World Cup appearance was in 1974, as Zaire.

triage.headline_ja: エボラへの懸念を受けて、コンゴ民主共和国代表チームが米国へのワールドカップ参加入国を許可される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響：500+確定例と死亡例、異常性：国際的なスポーツイベント渡航制限、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実現）。対象国DRC（203312）で進行中のエボラ流行に関する明確な情報。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行の進行状況（確定例500+、複数死亡例）およびWHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言を明記。Bluedot APIが抽出した複数地域（オルレアン、パリ、ヒューストン、テキサス等）は試合開催地やチームの移動経路を示すが、感染症の実際の発生地はDRCのみ。スポーツイベント関連の渡航制限と検疫実施が記載されており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: โคราชยืนยันพบสุนัขติดพิษสุนัขบ้า เร่งฉีดวัคซีนวงกว้างคุมโรคหนองปลิงใหม่ หลังชาวบ้านถูกกัดเจ็บ 4 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nakhon Ratchasima confirms a rabid dog; ramps up broad vaccination to contain the new Nong Pling disease after four residents were bitten and injured.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak confirmed in Nong Pling Mai, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand. On 12 June 2026, four residents were bitten or injured by a suspected rabid dog in Moo 9, Ban Nong Pling Mai. A broad vaccination drive for pets and at-risk animals was launched on site to interrupt transmission; one blind temple dog named Ta Wan, previously bitten by an infected dog, received vaccination. Lab tests by the Nakhon Ratchasima Provincial Health Office confirmed rabies in the dog; no high-risk human contacts identified yet. Public health officials urge residents to monitor pets and stray animals for abnormal behavior, wash and disinfect wounds, seek medical evaluation promptly, and obtain post-exposure prophylaxis as appropriate. Rabies has near 100% fatality once symptoms appear; emphasis on immediate wound care, vaccination, and quarantine of dogs.

triage.headline_ja: ナコーンラーチャシマ県が狂犬病犬を確認、4名が咬傷被害 - 広域ワクチン接種で新規感染症の蔓延を防止
triage.triage_reason: タイで確認された狂犬病アウトブレイク。IHR基準は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（致死率ほぼ100%）と異常性から2項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で複数該当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率がほぼ100%であり、複数の住民が咬傷被害を受けている深刻なアウトブレイク。地方保健当局による速やかな対応（広域ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が実施されており、管理可能性については当初は肯定的だが、ヒト-ヒト感染以外のリスク（動物媒介）が存在し、曝露継続の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is back. So are the double standards
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began May 15, with 617 confirmed cases and 117 deaths by June 9. It has spread to Uganda; officials fear it could eclipse the West Africa death toll. Bundibugyo, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, relies on supportive care. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, not airborne; control hinges on contact tracing and infection control, challenged by distrust and burial practices. The first confirmed case was a Bunia healthcare worker on April 25; origin likely animal spillover before human transmission. Globally, the US plans an Ebola quarantine facility in Kenya for Americans working in or traveling through outbreak areas, while Kenya's Laikipia Air Base quarantine centre was ordered closed; travel bans by US/Canada hinder response, drawing critique from WHO and health leaders. Past Bundibugyo outbreaks were smaller: Uganda 2007 (131 cases) and DRC 2012 (38).

triage.headline_ja: エボラが戻ってきた。同様に二重基準も戻ってきた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebola（ウイルス性出血熱）の大規模アウトブレイク（617確定例、117死亡）が複数国に拡大し、国際的な関心が高まり、渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのBundibugyo Ebola（Ebola bundibugyo virus）アウトブレイクを主題としている。ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、記事中では主要な発生地はDRCである。ケニアについては、米国による隔離施設計画および既存隔離センターの閉鎖命令が記載されているが、実際のエボラ症例発生は述べられていないため verified_locations には含めない。米国およびカナダは渡航制限を実施している国として記載されているが、発生地ではないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: RS investiga caso suspeito de ebola; paciente testou positivo para malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RS investigates a suspected Ebola case; the patient tested positive for malaria.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, investigates a suspected Ebola case in a 64-year-old man who recently returned from Uganda and was treated in Novo Hamburgo. A rapid malaria test detected Plasmodium falciparum, and malaria treatment began, but the Ebola suspicion remains under investigation per Brazilian Ministry of Health protocols. Definitive ruling awaits Fiocruz laboratory results. The patient will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre for specialized care, with samples sent for analysis; if Ebola is confirmed, transfer to a national reference hospital. Contact mapping and 30-day monitoring of contacts have begun, with health services receiving infection-prevention guidance. The alert follows an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with about 900 suspected cases and 220 deaths; Uganda reports five confirmed cases and one death. Ebola diagnosis relies on PCR; there is no licensed vaccine; current monoclonals target other strains. Incubation is 2–21 days; fever is an early hallmark.

triage.headline_ja: RS がエボラ疑い例を調査中、患者はマラリア陽性と判定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス疑い例の国際的な医学的懸念、ウガンダからの輸入リスク、複数国での同時流行状況が該当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（リオグランデドスル州）におけるエボラ疑い例を主要な主題としており、ウガンダからの輸入リスク及びコンゴ民主共和国での進行中の流行の文脈において重要。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。患者はマラリア陽性と確定したが、エボラ検査結果はFiocruz研究所の結果待機中で、接触者の30日間監視が開始されている。公衆衛生的な懸念とリスク管理体制の整備から PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Cirebon Pasang Alarm Kesehatan! Puluhan Ribu Warga Masuk Kelompok Risiko, Pemkab Siaga Cegah KLB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cirebon Issues Health Alert! Tens of Thousands of Residents Fall into High-Risk Groups, Regency Government on Alert to Prevent an Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, Cirebon Regency, Indonesia, issued a health alert as tens of thousands of residents fall into high-risk groups for various diseases, including infectious and non-communicable conditions. Officials say health challenges are increasingly complex and stress the need for early detection to prevent outbreaks or spikes from becoming a Kejadian Luar Biasa (KLB). The response focuses on strengthening screening and education through primary health facilities (puskesmas) and community health cadres, expanding community outreach, and fostering cross-sector collaboration to map vulnerable areas and secure medical logistics. Emphasis is placed on environmental hygiene education and rapid follow-up on reports of potential outbreaks or case surges to avert escalation into extraordinary events.

triage.headline_ja: チレボン、保健警報を発令！数万人の住民が高リスク層に該当、県政府がアウトブレイク防止に警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・チレボン地域で数万人が高リスク層に該当し、当局が予防的警戒態勢を取っているが、具体的な疾患の特定や確認患者数が不明であり、情報不足のため経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事では「Unknown Illness」との分類であり、具体的な疾患名が特定されていない。当局が予防的警戒態勢を取っているが、確認患者数や重症度、死亡例についての記述がなく、これが潜在的なリスク評価であることが明確。スクリーニング基準では長期曝露リスク（数万人が高リスク層）と流行しやすさ（複数疾患に対する警戒）で該当するが、実際の発症者数やIHR基準への該当が不明なため、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch breitet sich in DR Kongo aus - 136 Tote bestätigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in DR Congo - 136 deaths confirmed.
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of June 12, 2026. The outbreak is expanding across three health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with new transmission areas in North Kivu and Ituri. The virus involved is Bundibugyo virus, a relative of Ebola, for which there is no vaccine or specific therapy available. Response efforts are hindered by lack of vaccination and treatment options, ongoing activity by armed groups and militias, and an already weakened health system. The outbreak began about a month ago and has faced substantial containment challenges. The DRC has previously endured major Ebola crises, including the 2018–2020 epidemic that caused more than 2,200 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大 - 136人の死亡が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。確認症例676件、死亡136件の深刻な影響、ブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ関連）という予想外の病原体、多地域への拡大、国際的懸念。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルスはエボラウイルス属の亜種で、ワクチンと特異的治療法がない。武装勢力の活動と脆弱なヘルスシステムが対応を著しく妨げている。1カ月前からの発生で急速に拡大中。過去の2018-2020年エボラ流行（2,200人以上死亡）との比較で国際的な警戒が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Thiruvananthapuram in grip of communicable diseases, vigil upped
article.articleSummary: Thiruvananthapuram reports rising communicable diseases as the monsoon intensifies. As of 12 June 2026, nearly 8,000 fever cases and 274 dengue cases have been recorded in the past 10 days, with three Shigella cases reported on Thursday—two within corporation limits—prompting intensified surveillance. Dengue and chikungunya remain largely controlled, but intermittent rainfall and water stagnation continue to favour mosquito breeding. A joint meeting of the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation and the health department reviewed source-reduction efforts across all 100 wards. Officials deem the Shigella cases isolated with no outbreak signs. The Pettah case involves a four-year-old child with no recent travel history; preliminary investigations point to infection via contaminated objects handled by the child. In response, the Urban Primary Health Centre intensified preventive measures, including well chlorination and household inspections nearby to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ティルヴァナンタプラム、感染症の脅威に見舞われ、警戒態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とチクングニア熱の同時流行が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、現時点では流行が「概ね統制下」とされており、詳細な情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケーラ州ティルヴァナンタプラム市でのデング熱とチクングニア熱の同時発生を報告。過去10日間で8,000件の発熱症例と274件のデング症例が記録されている。雨季による蚊の繁殖増加により曝露期間が延長される懸念がある。ただし、公式発表では流行は「概ね統制下」とされており、死亡や重症化の明示的な報告がないため、現段階ではWATCH判定とした。シゲラ菌感染症の散発例も報告されているが、アウトブレイク兆候はないとのこと。

article.articleHeadline: നി​പ: നി​രീ​ക്ഷ​ണം ശ​ക്ത​മാ​ക്കി ആ​രോ​ഗ്യ വ​കു​പ്പ് | Nipah: Health department strengthens surveillance
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah: Health department strengthens surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus confirmed in a 43-year-old man admitted to a private hospital in Kozhikode, with laboratory confirmation at Government Medical College Hospital. The patient, a resident near Farook College in Ramannattukara’s Fifth Division, prompted enhanced surveillance and potential containment measures if transmission escalates. Eight people in his home (father, mother, wife, two children, and two of the mother’s relatives) plus 14 other relatives and five friends are under special monitoring; a Rapid Response Team (RRT) has been constituted, and PPE kits, masks, and gloves are reportedly available. A soap- manufacturing unit in the Karad area where he worked has long been shut; bats observed in the vicinity raise concerns about possible exposure via dust or bat activity. Restrictions include bans on marriages, social gatherings, and public events in the division; online district-level meeting decided to enforce mask use (N95) for contacts and full quarantine as needed. Kozhikode District Collector says no containment zone is required for now, and the infection source has not yet been identified.

triage.headline_ja: ニパ：保健部門が監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（Nipah）の確認症例により、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。インドでのニパウイルスは重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスの症例がインドのケーララ州コジコデで確認。患者は43歳男性で、接触者27名が監視下にあり、迅速対応チーム（RRT）が編成。感染源は未特定だが、勤務地の石鹸工場近くのコウモリが懸念材料。結婚式や社会集会の禁止令が発出。ニパウイルスの人間への感染と高い致死率から、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Estado investiga suspeita de ebola em paciente de Novo Hamburgo | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State investigates suspected Ebola in a patient from Novo Hamburgo | abc+
article.articleSummary: 64-year-old male in Novo Hamburgo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, under investigation for suspected Ebola after returning from Uganda in recent weeks. The patient has tested positive for malaria, but Ebola remains suspected. He was treated for malaria and will be transferred on Friday to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre; if confirmed, he will be moved to a national reference hospital. Laboratory confirmation is being conducted at Fiocruz. Health authorities have notified the Ministry of Health and begun contact tracing, with 30 days of follow-up for people who had close contact. Brazil has never confirmed an Ebola case; 2014–2015 suspected cases were negative. Brazil maintains a national contingency plan for viral hemorrhagic fevers, including early case identification, immediate reporting, safe isolation, and contact monitoring. Ebola symptoms include fever, malaise, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and potential liver or kidney involvement; there is no vaccine or specific antiviral.

triage.headline_ja: ノーボ・ハンブルゴの患者におけるエボラウイルス病疑い例を州が調査 | abc+
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い例がブラジルで報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性（ブラジルでの確認例なし）」「国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダからの渡航者）」に該当。スクリーニング基準でも「異常性」「重症度の可能性」「流行しやすさ」が認められ、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダからの帰国者であり国際的な移動に関連。マラリア陽性が確認されているが、エボラウイルス病疑い例としてFiocruzで確認検査中。ブラジルではこれまでエボラウイルス病の確認例がなく、2014-2015年の疑い例は陰性だった。ウガンダはEBOLA.CFR基準の対象国ではないため verified_locations に含めず、ブラジルのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果共和國伊波拉確診升至676例、死亡136人，疫情擴至新衛生區
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Republic of the Congo rise to 676, with 136 deaths, as the outbreak spreads to new health zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Republic of the Congo has risen to 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of June 11, with spread into three new health zones in North Kivu and Ituri provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, indicating ongoing community transmission. WHO had reported 515 cases and 91 deaths as of June 6. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment; candidate vaccines are still in development and testing. The response faces major challenges, including weak health infrastructure, security instability, high population movement, and community distrust. Investigators are probing a funeral as a potential early superspreader event, while attacks on vaccination teams and burning of isolation facilities hinder contact tracing and isolation. Without stronger public health measures, geographic spread may accelerate.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認患者数が676例に増加し、死亡者は136人に達した。疫情は新しい保健区域に拡大している。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病による深刻な健康被害（676例、死亡136人）、予想外の地理的拡大（新規保健区域への波及）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは「コンゴ共和国」と「コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の北キブ州・イトゥリ州」の両者が言及されているが、詳細な感染数（676例、136人死亡）および主要な地理的拡大はDRCのIturi州およびNorth Kivu州で報告されている。対象国リストではDRC (203312)のみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未承認）による継続的な社会感染、弱い保健インフラ、セキュリティ不安定、住民移動の多さ、コミュニティの不信感が重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: RDC, camp de Tsere : lutte quotidienne et précaire contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC, Camp Tsere: Daily and Precarious Fight Against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Ituri region, Rwampara health zone near Bunia; Tsere camp housing over 8,000 displaced people. The response is hampered by fragile sanitation and limited water: only one water point serving thousands, hindering handwashing and surface disinfection. Despite prevention efforts, risk remains high for residents and healthcare workers amid ongoing violence that keeps people displaced. NGOs are intervening: Solidarités Internationales has installed a handwashing station at the camp entrance and is piloting an impluvium to harvest rainwater for decontamination and hygiene. However, NGO-supported health areas are scarce—only 4 of 19 in Rwampara, underscoring gaps in coverage. The article emphasizes that effective Ebola control requires integrated care, prevention, risk communication, and basic services like water and sanitation, alongside medical care, in a context of insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ツェレキャンプ：エボラに対する日々の危機的な闘い
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生であり、IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また、8,000人以上の避難者が居住するキャンプでの発生で、水・衛生施設の不十分さと継続する紛争により管理が困難であり、フルのRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwandaが記載されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（イトゥリ地域、ルワンパラ保健地区）でのエボラ発生であり、ルワンダでの発生は記述されていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。キャンプでの発生、水・衛生の不備、NGOの限定的な対応、継続する紛争という複合的リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: BMC eyes to create herd immunity in Bhubaneswar's stray dogs against rabies by 2028
article.articleSummary: Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation (BMC) aims to create herd immunity against rabies in the city’s stray dog population by 2028. A March vaccination drive across 67 wards, in partnership with Mission Rabies, the College of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry under OUAT, and ASRA, vaccinated about 35,395 of an estimated 47,126 stray dogs (75% by census; ~72% in post-vaccination surveys via the World Veterinary Service app). Humane techniques, including hand- and net-catching, were used; vaccinated dogs received injectable inactivated cell-culture anti-rabies vaccine, marked with non-toxic biomarkers, and released at the same location. Real-time monitoring and data collection occurred through the WVS mobile app, with ward-wise coverage assessed against census figures and independently verified by post-vaccination surveys. Next phase: sero-surveillance by collecting blood samples to evaluate antibody titers, to be tested at the Rabies Diagnostic Laboratory, Veterinary College Bengaluru.

triage.headline_ja: ブバネスワルの野犬集団に対する狂犬病の群れ免疫構築を目指すBMC、2028年までの実現を計画
triage.triage_reason: インドの都市部における動物狂犬病の組織的ワクチン接種プログラムについての記事。公衆衛生への影響は限定的であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露リスク）に部分的に該当する可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の狂犬病ワクチン接種プログラムの進捗報告であり、新たな感染症危機を示す内容ではない。野犬への組織的なワクチン接種は公衆衛生上の予防対策として好ましいものであるが、ヒト感染症の流行警告とはならない。長期曝露リスク（継続的なワクチン接種必要性）が存在するため、WPROスクリーニング基準1項目に該当。ただしIHR基準には該当しないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Impf-Panik im Nachbarland: Warum Paraguays Dengue-Schutz stabil und ohne Nebenwirkungen bleibt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination panic in the neighboring country: Why Paraguay's dengue protection remains stable and free of side effects.
article.articleSummary: Dengue vaccination in Paraguay remains stable and side effects-free, according to the Extended Immunization Program (PAI). The Paraguayan dengue vaccine is not the same as the one withdrawn in Brazil, which involved a serum from the Butantan Institute in São Paulo administered as a single dose. In Brazil, two deaths (a 48-year-old woman and a 58-year-old man) and several serious adverse events led to suspending its use. Paraguay uses a vaccine sourced from Takeda of Japan, approved by national authorities and the WHO, with more than 70,000 doses imported and deployed since November last year. The program targets ages 6 to 39; over 4,500 doses have been given with no adverse events. The two-dose schedule is given within three months to achieve efficacy.

triage.headline_ja: 隣国でのワクチンパニック：パラグアイのデング熱ワクチン接種が安定し副作用がない理由
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチン接種プログラムの安全性に関する報道であり、新規感染症の発生イベントではない。パラグアイのワクチン接種は安定して進行し、副作用は報告されていない。ブラジルでの過去の有害事象は既に対応済みである。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン接種プログラムの安全性に関する肯定的な報道であり、新規の感染症イベント（発生、流行拡大）を報告するものではない。ブラジルでの過去のワクチン有害事象は歴史的な背景情報として言及されているが、現在の活動的な感染症危機ではない。対象国のリストにはブラジル（3469034）のみが含まれるが、記事の主題はパラグアイのワクチン接種プログラムの安全性であり、実際の感染症イベントではないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: പകര്‍ച്ചവ്യാധി ഭീഷണിയില്‍ കേരളം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala under threat from epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Kerala faces simultaneous outbreaks of dengue, shigellosis, malaria, and eleppani, with authorities monitoring ongoing transmission across districts. Yesterday, one dengue death and one eleppani death were reported. Dengue patients treated in hospitals total 13,025, while yesterday's dengue cases were 134 and this month 38 Shigella cases were confirmed. District-level Shigella counts show Malappuram 2, Kozhikode 1, and Wayanad 1, with two Shigella deaths reported in the last six months. Eleppani infections yesterday numbered 11, and three malaria cases were confirmed. In Malappuram, dengue hospitalizations reached 2,495. On Wednesday, dengue 72 cases, eleppani 13, malaria 4, and Shigella 7 were confirmed; on Tuesday, 10 more Shigella cases were confirmed. The article highlights the state's vulnerability to vector-borne and enteric diseases during the current period.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州が疫病の脅威に直面
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーラ州でデング熱、シゲラ症、マラリア、エレッパニの同時多発流行が発生しており、複数の死亡例と継続的な感染報告があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケーラ州は複数のベクター媒介疾患および腸内感染症の同時流行に直面。デング熱の入院患者数13,025名、複数死亡例、シゲラ症の過去6ヶ月間での2死亡例が報告されており、重症度が高い。当局が継続的に監視中であり、地区レベルでの感染報告が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Hantavirus und das wachsende Risiko: Warum Ausbrüche global schlimmer werden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Hantavirus, and the Growing Risk: Why Outbreaks Are Getting Worse Worldwide.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Ebola and Hantavirus outbreaks are increasing in frequency and destructiveness, outpacing investments in preparedness. A Global Preparedness Monitoring Board report warns that pandemic risk grows faster than preventive capacity, with PPE shortages and fragile logistics in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo straining responses. In Kinshasa, stockouts of protective equipment and reliance on air shipments delay case confirmation and containment. The analysis traces outbreak management from field surveillance to laboratory confirmation and vaccine/therapy deployment, noting a gap between rapid scientific advances (including mRNA platforms) and equitable rollout, logistics, and delivery. Trust, geopolitics, misdiagnoses, and test designs misaligned with circulating variants undermine timely detection and response, underscoring the need for early warning, reliable surveillance, and universal access to vaccines and tests.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ハンタウイルス、そして高まるリスク：世界的にアウトブレイクがより深刻になっている理由
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスとハンタウイルスの複合アウトブレイク報告、DRC東部での感染症対応能力の崩壊（PPE不足、検査遅延）、グローバルな準備体制の不備が指摘されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当。国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラとハンタウイルスの複合発生を報告しており、DRC東部（Kinshasa含む）での具体的な物流・検査の遅延とPPE不足が述べられている。グローバル・プレパレドネス・モニタリング・ボードの警告を引用し、国際的な感染症準備体制の不備を強調。ハンタウイルスはDRCでの確定情報ではなく、より定着しているエボラが主要な懸念。2026年6月という将来日付のため、シナリオまたはシミュレーション記事の可能性があるが、公式警告内容は取得すべき信号と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Le risque de propagation de la fièvre Ebola en Europe reste faible
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of Ebola virus disease spreading in Europe remains low.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the risk of Ebola virus disease spreading in Europe remains low. No Ebola cases have been reported in the World Cup host countries Canada, Mexico, or the United States, nor in the wider European region. Mr. Kluge states there is no reason for fans to alter travel plans and that the global risk is still low. The main Ebola foci remain in remote areas of the Democratic Republic of Congo, where travelers undergo strict health screening before departure. The World Health Organization urges supporters to travel normally with basic precautions and emphasizes that it does not recommend international travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパへのエボラ熱の拡大リスクは依然として低い
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは既知の高リスク病原体であり、DRCでの継続的な発生が確認されているが、当該記事は「ヨーロッパおよび主要国でのリスク評価は低い」という予防的情報であり、現在の新規患者報告や国際的拡大の急迫した兆候は含まれていない。情報が限定的であり経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUSA、Canada、Mexicoが含まれているが、記事サマリー上これらの国ではエボラケースの報告がなく、主題はDRCでの継続的発生と欧州・北米地域での予防的リスク評価である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。現在のところ急迫した国際的拡大は報告されていないが、エボラの固有の重症度と感染力により、経過観察の対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: W杯コンゴ代表が米国入り、エボラ影響で21日間の隔離措置
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup Congo national team arrives in the United States, under a 21-day Ebola-related quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's national football team arrived in the United States on June 11 to participate in the World Cup in North and Central America, after completing a 21‑day quarantine required by U.S. authorities before entering U.S. soil. The squad, whose domestic training camp was canceled due to an Ebola outbreak in the DRC, had based preparations in Belgium prior to travel. French coach Sebastien Desabre said the team adapted and trained, aiming to deliver strong performances to lift national spirits. The Congo team will base in Houston during the tournament, with Group K opening against Portugal on June 17 in Houston, followed by a June 23 match against Colombia in Guadalajara, Mexico, and a June 28 clash with Uzbekistan in Atlanta.

triage.headline_ja: W杯コンゴ代表が米国入り、エボラ影響で21日間の隔離措置
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はコンゴのサッカーナショナルチームのW杯参加であり、エボラ発生そのものに関する情報ではない。DRCでのエボラ発生は背景情報に過ぎず、実際の感染症クライシス情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで報告されているエボラ発生を背景として言及しているが、この記事の主題はスポーツイベント（サッカーW杯）であり、感染症の流行状況、症例数、対応状況などの感染症クライシス情報は含まれていない。DRCのエボラ発生については別途の情報源で詳細を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Ένα ραγισμένο φέρετρο, μια κηδεία και το κυνήγι του ασθενούς μηδέν
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: A Cracked Coffin, a Funeral, and the Hunt for Patient Zero.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Central Africa) is traced to the funeral of a 44-year-old Congolese pastor who died in February. His coffin collapsed under mourners’ weight during burial, after which the body was moved to a second coffin. Within weeks, dozens of attendees fell severely ill and died. The pastor, described as patient zero, represents the earliest known infection driving the current outbreak in the DRC. Complicating investigations, his body was never tested for the Ebola virus and the initial coffin was burned amid fears it was cursed. Researchers are racing to determine the source of the strain, which can kill up to about 50% of those infected and currently has no approved treatment. The article underscores funerary practices as a transmission driver in central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：割れた棺、葬儀、そして患者ゼロの追跡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の新規発生は高リスク。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的な感染拡大リスク、および渡航制限のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は世界的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、致死率約50%、承認済み治療法がないことが明記されている。葬儀慣行による感染拡大メカニズムが指摘されており、初期患者の遺体が未検査かつ焼却されたため、起源特定が困難な状況。国際的な関心と支援が高い可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Centre calls for strict Nipah containment measures after case reported in Keralam
article.articleSummary: 12 June 2026, India's Central government ordered strict Nipah containment measures after a Nipah case was confirmed in Keralam. Centre monitors the situation and has contact with the state government; the patient's sample was sent to the National Institute of Virology (NIV), Pune, for confirmation. Earlier, the patient admitted to Crescent Hospital in Calicut with high fever and on a ventilator had preliminary results positive, awaiting confirmation. The patient came into contact with 77 people (58 health workers, 14 family members, 5 friends); no symptoms reported yet. Authorities warn May-September as a high-risk period for Nipah transmission and urge not to touch or provoke bats, reporting sightings to authorities. Nipah is a zoonotic disease spread mainly via fruit bats or infected fluids and can pass person-to-person. Keralam has had multiple Nipah outbreaks in recent years. A nurse infected in West Bengal died in February.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラム州でニパウイルス症例報告後、中央政府が厳格なニパウイルス封じ込め対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つzoonotic diseaseで、ヒト-ヒト感染が確認されている。確定例が報告され、複数州での流行歴があり、国際的な保健懸念を持つ。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高い死亡率（40-75%）を持つ新興感染症。ケーラム州での複数発生歴、西ベンガル州での死亡例（2月）があり、地域的な反復流行パターンを示唆。77人への接触履歴があり、二次感染リスクが存在。5月-9月が高リスク期間とされている。国家レベルでの封じ込め対策が発動されており、政府の重大な関心が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: ยืนยันพบสุนัขติดเชื้อพิษสุนัขบ้า ไล่กัดชาวบ้าน เจ็บ 4 ราย พบหมาวัดตาบอดถูกกัดด้วย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed a rabies-infected dog bit residents, injuring four; a blind temple dog was bitten as well.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in Nongpling Mai, Nongbuasala, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand, after a suspected rabid dog attacked four residents; one bite caused a wrist tendon rupture requiring urgent hospital care. The dog was captured, killed, and its head sent to a laboratory for confirmation, which returned positive for rabies on 12 June 2026. Local authorities launched an intensified vaccination campaign, administering booster rabies vaccines to pets and at‑risk animals within Moo 9. A blind temple dog named Ta Wan was found and vaccinated during the operation; it had prior exposure to a rabid dog and had not received a booster. No additional high‑risk contacts have been identified. Public health guidance urges immediate wound cleaning, disinfection, vaccination, and prompt medical assessment after any mammal bite, lick, or scratch, given rabies’ nearly 100% fatality once symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病に感染した犬が住民を咬傷、4人が負傷；盲目の寺院犬も咬傷被害を受けた
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内での狂犬病確定症例（犬）であり、人への咬傷被害（4人、1人は腱断裂で入院治療）が発生している。公衆衛生上の懸念がある一方、地域的な対応（捕獲・殺処分、検査確認、ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が既に実施されており、追加の高リスク接触者は未確認とのことから、現時点では国際的拡大リスクは限定的と判断される。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は既知の疾患であり、タイでは定期的に発生する。本事例は確定診断済みで、地方当局による対応が迅速に実施されている。人への曝露は限定的（4人の咬傷被害、うち1人は重症）であり、現時点では国内対応が十分に機能している。国際的拡大リスクは低いと評価されるが、狂犬病の死亡率の高さと地域的な防疫能力強化の必要性から、経過観察対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲疾控中心称埃博拉病例和死亡人数持续上升，青年群体感染率最高_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC says Ebola cases and deaths continue to rise, with the highest infection rate among young people.
article.articleSummary: As of June 11, 2026, Africa CDC director Jean-Kaseya reported 635 Bundibugyo ebolavirus cases and 127 deaths in the Congo and Uganda, marking the most severe recorded outbreak of this strain. The outbreak’s mortality is highest among children under 4 (about 44%), while 15–44-year-olds account for roughly 62% of known infections, linked to high mobility, cross-regional movement, and mining work. The response faces substantial resource gaps; regional leaders are urged to unite and contribute. No African country has deployed experimental therapies for Bundibugyo Ebola yet, but candidate vaccines and treatments exist, and authorities have agreed to launch clinical trials. The outbreak remains ongoing, with young adults the most affected by exposure risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ疾病対策センターがエボラ病例と死亡者数の継続的増加を報告、若年層の感染率が最も高い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。重篤な感染症（ブンディブギヨエボラウイルス）の進行中の大規模発生で、複数国での死亡者を伴う。国際的な臨床試験実施と地域リーダーの支援要請により、国際的対応が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギヨエボラウイルスはエボラの中でも比較的稀な株だが、この記事では記録上最も重篤な発生と報告されている。635症例、127死亡（致命率20%）で、4歳以下で44%という高い小児死亡率を記録。若年成人層（15-44歳）が62%の感染を占め、採掘業や人口移動が感染源。未承認療法や候補ワクチンの臨床試験開始が予定されている。記事では「Congo and Uganda」と述べられているが、ウガンダについて記事サマリー内に具体的な発生数が明記されていないため、検証位置はコンゴ民主共和国のみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Past experience positions Uganda to contain Ebola
article.articleSummary: Two additional cases linked to the index patient were confirmed. As of 10 June 2026, Uganda has 19 confirmed Ebola cases, with 14 imported from the DRC. The index case was a Congolese male who fell ill in DRC and sought care in Uganda; diagnosis was made posthumously after DRC flagged suspected Ebola virus disease. Two secondary cases emerged from high-risk exposure in a care setting. Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV) typically yields fewer fatalities than Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV) and may progress slowly, but outcomes hinge on health system capacity. Ebolaviruses are not airborne; transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids of a symptomatic patient or contaminated materials, but is interruptible by contact tracing, IPC, safe burials, and community engagement. Uganda’s advantage includes rapid lab confirmation, aggressive contact tracing, and proven response infrastructure. A planned Ebola treatment unit in DRC will intercept cases at the source; Kampala remains open, visitors welcome.

triage.headline_ja: 過去の経験がウガンダにエボラ封じ込めの態勢を整えている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当し、既に19例の確認例と死亡事例がある重度の感染症イベントである。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の国際的アウトブレイク。DRC発の輸入例14例を含む計19確認例。ウガンダの対応体制は良好だが、DRCでの継続的な感染と越境リスクが存在する。Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV)亜型で致死性は比較的低いとされるが、公衆衛生上の重大性は高い。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: എട്ടുവർഷത്തിനിടെ നാലുതവണ കോഴിക്കോട്ട് നിപ രോഗബാധ; പ്രതിരോധം തീർക്കാനാകാതെ വിദഗ്ധർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Nipah virus infections in Kozhikode over eight years; experts say containment is not possible.
article.articleSummary: Since 2018, Kozhikode, Kerala, has faced Nipah virus outbreaks, with a fourth confirmed in eight years. The Nipah virus is confirmed as the cause and is primarily carried by bats; while exact transmission routes remain unclear, environmental factors in Kozhikode are linked to higher viral density. Despite extensive study and surveillance by central teams, there is no proven way to prevent recurrence. The current case is under treatment at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital, and a precise infection source has not been established. The first outbreak occurred in May 2018 in Changaroth, Kozhikode; that year 17 people from Kozhikode and Malappuram died. The first confirmed patient was Mohammed Sabith; a nurse, Lini, who cared for him, died. In 2021 one death; in 2023 two deaths; 2024-2025 saw hospital admissions with Nipah symptoms in Kozhikode. Overall, 22 Nipah deaths have occurred in Kerala among Kozhikode and Malappuram residents.

triage.headline_ja: コージコード地区で8年間に4度のニパウイルス感染；専門家は封じ込めが不可能と指摘
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つVHFであり、8年間に複数回の再発生、累計22名の死亡、環境要因による継続的なリスク、および封じ込め不可能との専門家評価がIHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の複数に該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは危機管理対象の重要病原体。8年間の反復発生パターン、環境的リスク因子の存在、高い致死率（22死亡/複数年）、および専門家による「封じ込め不可能」との見解は、継続的な公衆衛生脅威を示唆。フルRRAでは媒介生物制御の可能性、地域内外への拡大リスク、国際的な疫学情報共有の必要性を評価すべき。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Centre Calls for Strict Nipah Containment Measures After Case Reported in Keralam
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus case confirmed in Keralam, Kerala, prompting the Centre to demand strict enforcement of standard protocols and SOPs for containment. The patient, admitted to Crescent Hospital in Calicut with a high fever and later moved, is on ventilator support; samples have been sent to NIV Pune for confirmatory testing, with preliminary results positive and confirmation awaited. The government says it is closely monitoring the situation and remains in contact with the state authorities. The patient has come into contact with 77 people—58 health workers, 14 family members, and 5 friends—with none showing symptoms so far. May–September is flagged as a high-risk period for Nipah transmission; authorities urge caution regarding fruit bats and prompt reporting of sightings. Nipah is a zoonotic disease spread via fruit bats or infected bodily fluids and can pass from person to person. In February, a nurse infected with Nipah died in West Bengal.

triage.headline_ja: インド：ケーラ州でニパウイルス症例報告後、中央政府が厳格な封じ込め措置を要求
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（高い致死率を持つ人獣共通感染症）の確定例がインドで報告され、複数州にわたる地理的拡大と人-人感染の可能性があるため、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当する。また、公衆衛生当局による厳格な封じ込め対応の要求という社会的・政治的関心があり、WPRO基準複数に合致する。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは致死率が高い（40-75%）人獣共通感染症であり、ケーラ州での確定例は重症（人工呼吸器使用）。2月にはベンガル州で看護師の死亡例あり。77人の接触者監視中で人-人感染チェーンのリスクが存在。5月～9月は高リスク期間と指摘されており、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah Virus Case Confirmed in Kozhikode, Kerala; 43-Year-Old Man Tests Positive
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus case confirmed in Kozhikode, Kerala: a 43-year-old businessman from Ramanattukara is on ventilator in ICU after NIV Pune confirmed the diagnosis, marking Kerala’s first Nipah case in 2026. District authorities traced 77 contacts (58 healthcare workers, 14 family members, 5 friends/colleagues); two are at highest risk and 13 are high-risk, all under strict quarantine. The infection is linked to an environmental source: the patient rented and cleaned a godown, with exposure to secretions from fruit bats, Nipah’s natural reservoir. Field surveillance and public awareness campaigns are underway; a district control room monitors the situation, and no formal containment zones have been declared yet. Public advisory emphasizes vigilance during the May–September high-risk season, avoiding contact with bats, reporting unusual bat activity, maintaining hygiene, and avoiding partially eaten fruits. This is the first confirmed Nipah infection in Kerala in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス感染症がコーチン県で確認、43歳男性が陽性
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い病原性と致死率を有する新興感染症であり、複数州での患者確認、医療労働者を含む77名の接触者追跡、環境源（コウモリ）の特定により、IHR基準4項目およびWPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはFilovirus科に属し、致死率40～75%の高リスク病原体。2026年ケララ州での初の確認症例。環境源（コウモリ）の存在により継続的なヒト感染リスクあり。医療労働者58名が接触者として追跡されていることから、院内感染防止対策の強化が重要。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത മഴ കനത്തതോടെ പകർച്ചവ്യാധികളും കൂടുന്നു: പകർച്ചപ്പനി ബാധിച്ച് ഇന്നലെ ചികിത്സ തേടിയത് 13,025 പേർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With heavy rains across the state, communicable diseases rise: 13,025 people sought treatment yesterday for contagious fever.
article.articleSummary: Heavy rains across Kerala coincide with rising contagious diseases: 13,025 people sought hospital care yesterday for contagious fever. Shigella infections surged with 4 new cases yesterday (Malappuram 2, Kozhikode 1, Wayanad 1); this month 38 cases confirmed, and over six months, 2 Shigella deaths reported. Dengue remains a major driver, with 134 new dengue cases yesterday and one dengue death. Eleppani and malaria also appear, with 11 Eleppani and 3 malaria confirmed yesterday. In Malappuram, 2,495 people sought treatment for contagious fever. Wednesday’s counts included dengue 72, Eleppani 13, malaria 4, Shigella 7; Tuesday saw 10 Shigella confirmed. Separately, a 43-year-old Nipah-positive patient in Kozhikode remains critically ill on a ventilator in isolation, with the health department releasing a travel-path map covering May 30–June 10.

triage.headline_ja: 州全体の大雨により感染症が増加：昨日、伝染病熱で治療を求めた人は13,025人
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス患者1名の重症例（人工呼吸器装着中）が確認されており、IHR基準の異常性・重症度を満たす。同時にケーララ州内で複数の感染症（デング熱、シゲラ、マラリア等）が集中発生し、管理可能性の観点からも懸念がある。
triage.notes: ニパウイルス患者1名が人工呼吸器装着で重症化しており、5月30日～6月10日の接触追跡マップが保健部門により公表されている。同時期に同州内でデング熱134例、シゲラ感染4例（月間38例、6か月で死亡2例）、マラリア3例、エレッパニ11例が報告されており、多重感染症同時発生の様相を呈している。大雨による環境変化が媒介動物由来感染症の増加と関連している可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിലെ നിപ വൈറസ് ബാധ: സാഹചര്യം സൂക്ഷ്‌മമായി നിരീക്ഷിച്ച് കേന്ദ്രം; എല്ലാ പിന്തുണയും വാഗ്‌ദാനം ചെയ്‌തു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus infection in Kerala: Centre monitoring the situation closely; all support pledged.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus infection has been reported again in Kerala. The Centre is monitoring the situation closely and has pledged full support to the state. Suspected cases and their contacts have been sent to the National Institute of Virology in Pune for detailed laboratory testing; official results will determine the outbreak's severity and the exact source. Until results are available, authorities will implement strict standard prevention and control protocols. The Ministry of Health is in constant touch with the state health department and stands ready to provide technical assistance and expert guidance. The public is urged not to panic and to follow the health department's instructions. These measures aim to contain transmission and enable rapid clarification once laboratory findings are reported.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州のニパウイルス感染：中央政府が状況を厳密に監視；全面的支援を誓約
