triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは致死率が高く異常・予想外であり（IHR基準2該当）、インドで再発生が報告されている重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・長期曝露リスク・流行しやすさが認められ、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはBSL-4病原体で高い致死率（40～75%）を有する。ケーララ州での再発生は異常であり、検査結果待機中。中央政府が積極的に関与し、プネーの国立ウイルス研究所で検査実施中。国際的な監視対象疾患であり、フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: UP study finds disturbed habitats may harbor more mosquito viruses
article.articleSummary: Los Baños, Laguna, Philippines—UP study analyzed the virome of Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus from three sites: Bagong Silang (forested upland), Lalakay (midstream), and Bayog (lakeshore). Over 46 years, Bagong Silang remained forested, while Lalakay and Bayog transformed from agriculture to built-up areas, with disturbed landscapes showing greater viral diversity. Viral metagenomics identified sequences from 12 viral taxonomic groups, dominated by insect-specific viruses such as Phasi Charoen-like phasivirus (PCLV), Humaita Tubiacanga virus (HTV), and Wenzhou sobemo-like virus 4 (WSLV4), found in both mosquito species. No dengue, Zika or chikungunya viruses were detected in 2018 samples; however, absence does not prove absence given low dengue incidence that year. CFAV was detected and may interfere with DENV and ZIKV replication; co-infection with PCLV and CFAV inhibited growth of Zika, dengue and La Crosse viruses in cell lines. Mosquitoes may serve as sentinels for monitoring viral diversity and emerging health threats.

triage.headline_ja: UP研究：攪乱された生息地はより多くの蚊媒介ウイルスを保有する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンのAedes mosquitoes virome研究であり、科学的関心は高いが、2018年のサンプルではデング・ジカ・チクングニアの実検出がなく、現在の流行状況を示さない。継続監視の情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾学的調査レポート（virome分析）であり、現在のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。Aedes属蚊の媒介能とウイルス多様性に関する環境疫学的知見の報告。2018年サンプルの実検出がないため、緊急性は低いが、蚊媒介性感染症の流行予測モニタリングとしては関連性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Luchar contra el ébola y la desinformación en el corazón de la epidemia: "Creía lo que decían mis vecinos, que quienes iban a los centros de tratamiento no salían con vida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fighting Ebola and misinformation at the heart of the outbreak: "I believed what my neighbors said, that those who went to treatment centers did not come out alive."
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered around Mungwalu health center and Bunia. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccines or therapeutics exist for this strain, with three experimental vaccines under development. As of June 9, 2026, the DRC reports 635 cases and at least 127 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, reflecting cross-border risk. The emergency was declared May 15; community mistrust and misinformation—claims that treatment centers are lethal or that disease is fabricated to siphon funding—have driven people away from care and toward traditional remedies. Patients experience fever, body aches, and vomiting; some die before reaching care. Health workers have been assaulted, centers attacked, and even burials at cemeteries have sparked violence. Emphasis remains on early detection, intravenous hydration, and vigilant surveillance to prevent hemorrhage and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱と虚偽情報との闘い：大流行の中心地で「治療センターに行った者は生きて帰らない」という隣人の言葉を信じていた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国境越えの急速拡大、新種ワクチンなし、複数国にまたがる事例）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。重度の死亡率と医療体制の混乱が記録されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダの19例2死が言及されているが、発生地域はIturi（DRC）に集中しており、ウガンダは二次的な国境越え事例。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）は承認済みワクチンがない新規株。社会的信頼の喪失と医療施設への暴力が対応困難性を増大させている。緊急宣言は2026年5月15日。

article.articleHeadline: Communicable diseases rise in Kerala during monsoon; Shigella cases see sharp increase
article.articleSummary: As of June 11, 2026, Kerala reports a monsoon-driven rise in communicable diseases. Shigella shows 38 confirmed cases and one death this month, plus 20 suspected cases; since January 1, 2026: 114 confirmed, 80 suspected, and two deaths. Shigella spreads via contaminated food or water or contact with the infected. Eight amoebic meningoencephalitis cases and two deaths this month; 133 cases and 33 deaths this year. Chikungunya: 2,161 suspected cases and two suspected deaths; 617 confirmed cases and three deaths. Influenza leads with seven deaths and 529 infections this month; leptospirosis and Hepatitis A each record two deaths, with 88 and 265 confirmed cases, respectively. A Nipah case was reported in Kozhikode. Health Minister K. Muraleedharan says containment measures, chlorination drives, and awareness campaigns are underway; the public is advised to seek care promptly and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でモンスーン期に感染症が増加。シゲラ菌感染症が急増
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーラ州でニパウイルス、髄膜炎、レプトスピラ症など複数の重篤感染症の同時多発が報告されており、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が確認される。また、ケーラ州は高い人口密度と国際的な交流地点であり、国際的拡大のリスクがある。
triage.notes: ニパウイルス（Nipah）の確定症例がコジコード地区（Kozhikode）で報告されたことは極めて重要。複数の病原体による同時的な感染症集団発生（Shigella, Chikungunya, Influenza, Hepatitis A, Leptospirosis, Meningoencephalitis）が確認されており、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威を示唆している。モンスーン期の水系感染症増加パターンは予見可能だが、ニパウイルスの出現は異常であり、濃厚接触者の追跡調査と国際的なサーベイランス強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: പനിച്ച് വിറച്ച് കേരളം; പകർച്ചപ്പനി ബാധിച്ച് ഇന്നലെ മാത്രം ചികിത്സ തേടിയത് 13,025 പേർ, 2 മരണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala rocked by fever; 13,025 people sought treatment yesterday due to measles infection, 2 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Measles drove 13,025 people to Kerala hospitals yesterday as part of a fever surge. One dengue-related death and one chikungunya-related death were reported yesterday. Dengue was confirmed in 134 patients; yesterday 11 cases of chikungunya and 3 cases of malaria were documented. Shigella confirmations stood at four yesterday, with district-level distribution: Malappuram 2, Kozhikode 1, and Wayanad 1; the month-to-date total is 38, and there have been two Shigella deaths in six months. In Malappuram, 2,495 measles patients sought hospital care. On Wednesday, dengue 72, chikungunya 13, malaria 4, and Shigella 7 were confirmed; Tuesday saw 10 Shigella cases. The data illustrate a broad fever- and infection-related burden across Kerala, notably heavy measles-related clinic visits, alongside vector-borne and diarrhoeal infections.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州は熱病で揺れている。はしかの感染で昨日だけで治療を求めた13,025人、2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク）。インド・ケーラ州で複数の感染症（はしか、デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）が同時多発し、短期間に多数の患者と死亡例が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケーラ州（インド）での複数の感染症同時発生を明確に記述。はしか13,025人（1日）、デング熱134人、チクングニア熱11人、マラリア3人、シゲラ菌4人が報告され、死亡例も記録。ベクター媒介感染症と水系感染症が同時に流行している点が特に懸念される。Bluedot APIの疾患リストには含まれていないShigella（細菌性下痢症）も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനം പകര്‍ച്ചവ്യാധി ഭീഷണിയില്‍; പനി ബാധിച്ച് ഇന്നലെ മാത്രം ചികിത്സതേടിയത് 13,025 പേര്‍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State under threat of an epidemic; 13,025 people sought treatment yesterday due to fever.
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India, reported a fever-driven health surge with 13,025 people seeking hospital care for fever yesterday. Malappuram district accounted for 2,495 fever patients. On Wednesday, 72 dengue, 13 leptospirosis, 4 malaria, and 7 Shigella cases were confirmed; Tuesday added 10 Shigella cases. Dengue totals tallied 134 yesterday, with the state recording 38 Shigella cases so far this month. Over the last six months, Shigella has caused two deaths. Leptospirosis saw 11 yesterday; dengue and leptospirosis each recorded a fatality yesterday. A 43-year-old in Kozhikode is critically ill with Nipah virus infection. Shigella yesterday was reported in Malappuram (2), Kozhikode (1), and Wayanad (1). Authorities note ongoing outbreaks across several districts and urge vigilance for febrile illnesses and vector-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 州が流行病の脅威に直面；熱病で治療を求めた人は前日だけで13,025人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。複数の感染症同時発生（デング、レプトスピラ症、マラリア、シガエラ、ニパウイルス）による多数の患者と死亡者が報告されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケーラ州で複数感染症の同時多発。ニパウイルス感染者1名が43歳で重篤状態。過去6ヶ月でシガエラ2死亡、デング・レプトスピラ各1死亡。著しい発熱患者数増加（1日13,025人）が報告されている。複数地区への拡大確認。国際的なバイオセーフティ関心の対象となる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: HP: Kangra emerges as state leader in TB elimination efforts; 287 panchayats declared TB-free
article.articleSummary: On the 80th day of the TB Free India Campaign 2.0 in Dharamshala, Kangra District, Himachal Pradesh declared 287 panchayats TB-free by 2025 (69 silver, 37 gold). In 2025, 2,807 TB patients were registered; January–May 2026 saw 1,180 new cases. The TB-Free India App and Khushi AI Chatbot were launched to connect patients with digital platforms. Nutritional support included regular assistance for 478 patients and 2,163 nutrition kits distributed in the first five months of 2025. Ayushman Arogya Camps totaled 225 over 80 days, benefiting 13,350 people; 33,900 X-rays were conducted. 205 of the district’s 969 high-risk villages have been covered. TB Preventive Treatment coverage reached 96% with 1,340 beneficiaries January–May 2026. Additionally, 393 TB Champions were trained to strengthen awareness and reduce stigma.

triage.headline_ja: HP: カングラ地区がTB排除努力で州のリーダーとなる；287のパンチャヤット（村議会）がTB-free宣言
triage.triage_reason: 結核患者の登録と症例数は報告されているが、これは公衆衛生キャンペーンの進捗状況の好ましい報告であり、異常な発生イベントではない。公開情報も社会的懸念も低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドのヒマチャル・プラデーシュ州カングラ地区におけるTB排除キャンペーン（TB Free India Campaign 2.0）の成功と進捗状況を報告したもの。新規患者の登録数は報告されているが、これは既存の公衆衛生対策の有効性と継続的な管理努力を示す前向きなニュースであり、突発的な感染症危機ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象となるべき異常発生（アウトブレイク）ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉病毒持续传播　刚果（金）确诊病例增至676宗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus continues to spread; confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 676.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s eastern Ebola outbreak has reached 676 laboratory-confirmed cases with 136 fatalities as of Wednesday, June 10, 2026. A total of 262 patients remain in isolation or hospital care, with 32 recovered. Transmission remains predominantly within communities, and officials warn that without rapid public health measures the geographic spread could widen. Africa CDC Director Kasaya described the outbreak as among the largest Africa has seen, noting expansion driven in part by ongoing armed conflict in eastern DR Congo that hampers surveillance and contact tracing. In contrast, Uganda’s Ebola situation is under control, with no evidence of community transmission. The report also highlights concurrent challenges across Africa, including cholera, measles, and mpox, urging stronger health-system resilience to prevent future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが継続的に拡大　コンゴ民主共和国の確診例が676件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目全てに該当。高い公衆衛生的影響、国際的拡大リスク、死亡例の多さが確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRコンゴの東部でのエボラ大規模流行を報告。676例の確認患者、136例の死亡、262例入院中。武装紛争が監視と接触追跡を阻害している。アフリカCDC長官がアフリカで最大級と評価。ウガンダはコミュニティ感染なしで制御下。記事ではコレラ、麻疹、サルモンポックスも並行して言及されているが、主要なシグナルはエボラ。

article.articleHeadline: Egyre több halottat követel az ebolajárvány, egy megrepedt koporsó állhat a háttérben
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is claiming more and more lives, with a cracked coffin in the background.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed at least 127 people and caused about 635 confirmed infections in roughly one month. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with three research groups racing to develop a vaccine. Ongoing armed conflict in eastern DRC hampers surveillance and response, increasing undetected transmission risk. The United States has barred entry for travelers who recently visited the DRC or Uganda since mid-May; Belgium was urged to restrict Congolese arrivals, though officials say screening and patient care are priorities. Investigators identify Paluku Makundi Denis, a priest, as a possible index case; his funeral procession reportedly involved a cracked coffin and relocation of the body, exposing mourners to remains. Makundi was diagnosed with peritonitis and severe abdominal inflammation on 3 February 2025 and was not tested for Ebola then. Early cases may trace back 4–6 months before official May 15 confirmation, and further testing is needed. A burned coffin fuels rumors of a curse; early victims reportedly exhibited fever, vomiting, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が次々と死者を増やしており、割れた棺が背景にあるかもしれない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高リスク疾患であり、複数国での確認と武装紛争による対応阻害が認められるため、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはDRC以外にUS、Uganda、Belgiumが含まれているが、サマリーの主体は東部DRCでのエボラ流行。USとBelgiumは渡航制限を実施した国として言及されるのみ。Ugandaも記事サマリーに明記されないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。本シグナルは重大度が極めて高く、最優先でRRAを進める必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）布尼亚：埃博拉治疗中心落成
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola treatment center inaugurated.
article.articleSummary: On 11 June 2026 local time, Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, inaugurated the Scott Powell Memorial Ebola Treatment Center. The facility houses more than 80 beds and is the largest Ebola treatment facility in Ituri Province. It is designed to strengthen patient care and the response to Ebola virus disease. The inauguration marks a notable expansion of Ebola treatment capacity in the region, reinforcing efforts to manage Ebola virus disease and provide dedicated care for affected individuals in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国ブニア：エボラ治療センターが落成
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはエボラ治療施設の落成式であり、新規感染アウトブレイクの報告ではない。既存の感染症対応能力の強化を示す肯定的なニュースであるため、シグナル基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事内容は治療センター落成式の報道であり、新規感染症アウトブレイク、患者数増加、または感染拡大の報告を含まない。対象国リストに該当しないため、地域検証は行わない（DRCは対象国外）。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിലെ നിപ വൈറസ് ബാധ: സാഹചര്യം സൂക്ഷ്‌മമായി നിരീക്ഷിച്ച് കേന്ദ്രം. എല്ലാ പിന്തുണയും വാഗ്‌ദാനം ചെയ്‌തു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus outbreak in Kerala: Centre monitoring the situation closely. The Centre has promised all support.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus outbreak in Kerala prompts the Centre to monitor closely. The Centre and the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare have pledged full support and are tracking the situation with utmost seriousness, Delhi sources indicate. Samples from people with suspected Nipah infection and from their contacts have been urgently sent to the National Institute of Virology in Pune for detailed tests. Until official test results are announced, the exact scale, severity, and source of transmission remain unclear. Rapid protocols and standard infection-control procedures are being strictly implemented to prevent and contain Nipah virus spread. The Centre is maintaining continuous communication with the state health department to assess control measures and provide necessary technical assistance and expert guidance. The public is advised not to panic and to follow health department advisories.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州のニパウイルス感染症流行：保健当局が状況を厳密に監視。全面的な支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率と人間-人間感染能力を持つ危険な病原体であり、複数の州での発生報告（ケーララ、マハーラシュトラ、デリー）により国際拡大リスクがある。IHR基準2つ以上該当、またスクリーニング基準複数該当でピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはハイリスク病原体（CFR 40-75%）で、人間-人間感染が確認されている。記事サマリーではケーララ州での流行を主題としており、同時にマハーラシュトラ州（プネのNIV検査施設）およびデリーでも言及されている。複数州での発生が示唆される。正式な検査結果は未公表。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിലെ നിപ വൈറസ് ബാധ: സാഹചര്യം സൂക്ഷ്‌മമായി നിരീക്ഷിച്ച്‌ കേന്ദ്രം; രോഗവ്യാപനം തടയാൻ എല്ലാ പിന്തുണയും വാഗ്‌ദാനം ചെയ്‌തു ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus infection in Kerala: Centre monitoring the situation closely; has pledged full support to curb the spread of the disease ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, Nipah virus infection has been reported again in Kerala, with the central government treating the situation as highly serious and providing full support to curb spread. All samples from suspected cases and contacts have been sent to the National Institute of Virology, Pune for detailed testing; definitive results will determine the virus's severity and source. Measures to accelerate laboratory confirmation and results are in place. The Centre has ordered strict adherence to standard protocols for Nipah prevention and control, and ongoing communication between the Union Health Ministry and the state health department to assess and guide containment efforts. The Union government is ready to provide technical assistance and expert guidance. The public is urged not to panic and to follow health department instructions.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州のニパウイルス感染：中央政府が状況を厳密に監視、感染拡大を抑止するための全面的支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（高致死率、ヒト-ヒト感染可能）の報告であり、IHR基準で異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスク・流行しやすさが該当。中央政府による厳密な監視と支援表明から社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは既知の高リスク病原体（致死率40-75%、ヒト-ヒト感染、動物由来感染症）。ケーララ州での報告は過去の流行地における再発生。中央政府による迅速な対応、NIV Puna での検査、Union Health Ministry と州保健部門の連携など、統制的対応が取られている。記事は2026年6月12日配信であり、確定検査結果の発表待ちの段階。国際的な懸念が高まる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Aumenta cifra de pacientes recuperados de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola patients recovered in the DRC increases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues with 676 confirmed cases and 32 recoveries as of June 10, 2026. Ituri province accounts for 629 cases, North Kivu 44, and South Kivu 3, with 28 health zones affected. The latest recoveries include two individuals from the Bunia health zone in Ituri, underscoring that Ebola is curable. Masereka and Vuhovi in North Kivu, and Kambala in Ituri were recently added to affected zones. The outbreak was declared on May 15, and authorities have reinforced surveillance across all involved areas. They urge people with first symptoms to promptly seek care at treatment centers, as early treatment saves lives. These figures reflect ministry updates through June 10, 2026, reported on June 12.

triage.headline_ja: RDCにおけるエボラ患者の回復者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多数患者発生（676確認症例）で異常かつ予想外、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準3つ該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、対象国DRCで実際に発生している。
triage.notes: 2026年6月12日時点でDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の継続流行。676確認症例、28ヘルスゾーンに拡大。Ituri州が主要（629例）で、North Kivu州（44例）、South Kivu州（3例）での発生を確認。5月15日に発表され、複数ヘルスゾーンで確認症例増加が報告されている。回復症例も報告されており治療可能性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Communicable diseases rise in Kerala during monsoon; Shigella cases see sharp increase
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports a monsoon-driven surge in communicable diseases, led by Shigella. Data show 24 deaths due to communicable diseases since June 1 (12 suspected), this month’s Shigella: 38 confirmed cases and one death, plus 20 suspected cases. Since Jan 1, 2026: 114 confirmed Shigella, 80 suspected, two deaths. Shigella spreads via contaminated food/water or contact with infected people. Eight amoebic meningoencephalitis cases and two deaths this month; year-to-date brain fever: 133 cases, 33 deaths. Chikungunya: 2,161 suspected cases this month with two suspected deaths; 617 confirmed cases and three confirmed deaths. Influenza: seven deaths, 529 infections; leptospirosis and Hepatitis A: two deaths each, 88 and 265 confirmed cases. Nipah case in Kozhikode on Thursday; authorities say containment measures are in place under Health Minister K Muraleedharan.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州でモンスーン時に感染症が増加；シゲラ症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: インドで複数の重大感染症（Nipah、脳炎、チクングニア等）が同時発生、複数死亡例があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められる。IHR基準2項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事はケーララ州で複数の感染症が同時多発している状況を報告。特にNipah症例（Kozhikode）、脳炎（8症例、2死亡）、チクングニア（2,161疑い例）、シゲラ症（38確定例、1死亡）など重症度の高い疾患が含まれている。モンスーン期の汚水接触による感染拡大が懸念される。健康相による封じ込め措置言及あり。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah virus scare in Kerala: Kozhikode man critical, NIV test result awaited
article.articleSummary: 43-year-old man from Ramanattukara, Kozhikode, presented with encephalitis and yielded a preliminary Nipah virus positive result at Government Medical College Hospital, with body fluid samples sent to NIV Pune for confirmation. The patient is in critical condition on ventilator support; an isolation ward has been established and areas restricted. Kerala health authorities are tracing movements and preparing a route map to identify close contacts. Kozhikode has faced Nipah outbreaks in 2018 and 2023, plus a spillover case in 2021, prompting rapid response. The patient, a small-time businessman who rented a godown and cleaned the premises, may have exposure to fruit bats, Nipah's carriers. Hospital staff are quarantined; investigations focus on travel, work site, hospital visits, and contacts. Residents should avoid panic, follow advisories, avoid fruits bitten by bats, report fever with confusion or breathing trouble, and cooperate with contact tracing. Final lab result will decide next public health action.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州のニパウイルス懸念：コジコード男性が重体、NIV検査結果待機中
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（高致死率、人間-動物接触事例）の予備的陽性事例であり、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク）。過去複数年の同地域アウトブレイク歴があり、確認検査待機中の重症患者がいることから、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケララ州コジコード地域でのニパウイルス疑い事例を報道。患者は人工呼吸器装着下の重症状態。NIV Pune での確認検査待機中。同地域は2018年・2023年のアウトブレイク歴を有し、迅速な対応体制が構築されている。果実コウモリへの曝露リスクが指摘されている。社会不安の存在と政府当局による積極的な接触者追跡・公開助言が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Wat valt er te leren van de ebola-uitbraak in West-Afrika van tien jaar geleden?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What can be learned from the Ebola outbreak in West Africa ten years ago?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (East Congo) and Uganda have been declared an international public health emergency by the World Health Organization. The current toll stands at 91 deaths to date, with the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak killing about 11,000 people, especially in Liberia and Sierra Leone. The article contrasts the past and present: decades-old West Africa scenes included frontline workers and journalists handling the deceased in body bags with limited protective measures, whereas today’s outbreak faces weak rural health infrastructure and deep-seated distrust that hinder aid delivery. In Sierra Leone a quarantine marker often appeared as a yard wire, signaling isolation. East Congo’s largely rural landscape complicates access and containment, though there is cautious optimism—no new Uganda cases reported on the cited day—emphasizing the need for trust and accessible care to prevent escalation.

triage.headline_ja: 10年前の西アフリカエボラ流行から何を学べるか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で報告され、WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。過去の西アフリカ流行（約11,000人死亡）との比較から、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限のリスク」が複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでのエボラ発生が主題。発生地域にはシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ウガンダも列挙されているが、サマリーの主要な現在の発生地はDRC。ウガンダも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。西アフリカ2014-2016流行（シエラレオネ、リベリア）は過去の参照事例であり、現在の発生とは区別。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: BMC targets rabies-free Capital by 2030
article.articleSummary: Bhubaneswar aims to be rabies-free by 2030 via Mass Dog Vaccination (MDV) under the BMC, with Mission Rabies India and OUAT guiding implementation. In 73 days, 35,395 free-roaming dogs were vaccinated across all 67 wards, out of a census of 47,126, achieving 75% coverage. The ward-wise MDV operated 6–11am and 4–6pm, using humane hand- or net-catching; vaccinated dogs received an injectable inactivated cell-culture anti-rabies vaccine, marked, and released at the capture site. Coverage assessments used ward census data and the WVS Mobile App for verification. Blood samples from vaccinated dogs were tested for antibody titres at the Rabies Diagnostic Laboratory, Bangalore Veterinary College to gauge effectiveness. The effort follows the National Action Plan for Dog-Mediated Rabies Elimination (NAPRE) and One Health, targeting herd immunity above 70%. Governance is via the City Rabies Task Force; national recognition at SAPRE, New Delhi, May 28–29, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: BMC、2030年までに狂犬病のない首都を目標に掲げる
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインド・ブバネシュワルの狂犬病予防キャンペーン（犬の集団予防接種）に関する公衆衛生対策の進捗報告であり、現在の感染症危機を示唆していない。予防的・計画的な対策事例であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のシグナル条件に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病排除に向けた計画的な予防接種キャンペーンの実施報告である。既知の感染症危機ではなく、むしろ成功事例（73日間で35,395頭の予防接種、75%のカバー率達成）を報告しており、緊急対応が必要な感染症シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Nipah Patient Critical, 77 Contacts Under Observation; 2 In Highest-Risk Category
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus case in Kozhikode, Kerala: a 43-year-old patient remains in critical condition on a ventilator in an isolation ward. Health authorities traced movements from May 30 to June 10, identifying 77 contacts (58 healthcare workers, 14 family members, 5 friends/colleagues). None have developed symptoms so far. Contacts are categorized: 2 in highest-risk, 13 high-risk, 62 low-risk; all highest- and high-risk individuals are quarantined. A control room at the District Medical Office supports public assistance. Health Minister K Muraleedharan urged calm. The patient had visited multiple departments of a private hospital; staff contacted have been directed to quarantine. Preliminary findings show admission for fever, followed by encephalitis; Nipah testing conducted. Officials suspect infection linked to a warehouse cleaned shortly before illness, near an area with reported bat presence. The patient initially sought care in Feroke (about 20 km away) before transfer to Aster Mims Hospital for Nipah testing.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州ニパウイルス患者が重篤、77人の接触者を観察中；2人が最高リスク区分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）かつWPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。ニパウイルスは致死率が高く、接触者隔離下にも関わらず拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはインドで数年ごとにアウトブレイクが発生する重篤な感染症。今回は病院内での多数の接触者（特に医療従事者）が確認され、伝播リスクが高い。蝙蝠由来の自然感染が疑われており、環境監視も必要。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго се е разпространила в три нови здравни зони
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has spread to three new health zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to three new health zones, according to a government report, bringing the total of confirmed cases to 676 with 136 deaths. The figures reflect totals as of Wednesday, per the health minister on X. The newly affected zones are in North Kivu and Ituri. In Congo, a health zone is a defined area served by clinics and a referral hospital, typically serving about 100,000–150,000 people; the country has more than 500 health zones. Motorcycle riders joined a World Health Organization–led awareness campaign to support the Ebola response. The outbreak is ongoing. No further details on symptoms or transmission were provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が3つの新しい保健ゾーンに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行で、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念であり、国際通知基準を満たす。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行で、確認症例676件、死亡136件を記録。North KivuおよびIturia州の新たに3つの保健ゾーンへの拡大が報告されている。WHOが主導する啓発キャンペーンが実施中。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、重大なシグナルとして識別される。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda đã kiểm soát được tình hình dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda has managed to control the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Uganda is now under control, per Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya, who cited strong contact-tracing and 792 close contacts under active surveillance. WHO Director-General Tedros praised Uganda's response, noting a case fatality rate below 1%, reflecting preparedness and rapid local action. Uganda has reported 19 Ebola cases in nearly a month, largely among Congolese nationals crossing the border. In contrast, the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo faces a worsening situation, with the Ituri province in the east as the epicenter. Africa CDC warns that fewer than 5,000 people are currently being traced versus an estimated 24,000 needed; insecurity and poor transport hinder efforts. The agency urges ceasefire in eastern DRC to allow access. Two newborns at a church-run orphanage in Bunia died of Ebola, highlighting heightened risk to young children in care facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダはエボラ感染症の状況を制御下に置いた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という極度に重篤な感染症であり、DRC での悪化が報告されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な懸念はDRC（Ituri州）での悪化状況。ウガンダはコンゴ民族難民による境界越えでの感染が主で、現在は制御下。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。アフリカCDCが懸念を表明し、接触追跡の不十分さ（5,000人 vs 必要24,000人）と不安全な状況が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Centre calls for strict Nipah containment measures after case reported in Keralam
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus infection suspected in Keralam as preliminary tests indicate infection; final confirmation from the National Institute of Virology is awaited. The Centre has ordered strict containment measures in response to the fresh Nipah case, with officials monitoring the risk of further transmission. Authorities are advised to ensure rigorous surveillance, thorough contact tracing, isolation of contacts, and adherence to infection-control protocols without delay. Regular coordination between the Centre and Keralam government continues as assessments proceed. The government sources told ANI that the standard operating procedures for outbreak response are being emphasized to prevent spread. No official confirmation yet beyond preliminary results, but containment emphasis remains high while awaiting NIV confirmation and any developments on additional cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラム州でニパウイルス疑い患者報告後、中央政府が厳格なニパウイルス封じ込め対策を要求
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（高い致死率を持つzoonotic病原体）の疑い患者がインドで報告され、中央政府が厳格な封じ込め対策を命令している。IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性が該当する。国家レベルの対応が既に開始されており、フルリスク評価（RRA）が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高い致死率（40-75%）と限定的な治療法を持つ病原体であり、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性がある。記事では最終確認がNIV（National Institute of Virology）の待機中であり、予備検査で感染を示唆している。中央政府と州政府の協調体制が既に整備されており、症状や伝播の詳細は記事に記載されていない（不明）が、迅速な確認と追加症例監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: പകര്‍ച്ചവ്യാധി ഭീഷണിയില്‍ കേരളം, ഷിഗെല്ല ഇതുവരെ 114 പേർക്ക്, അമീബിക് മസ്തിഷ്‌കജ്വരം 133, എഇഎസ് 62 കേസുകള്‍, റിപ്പോര്‍ട്ട്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala under threat of an epidemic, Shigella: 114 cases so far, Amoebic encephalitis: 133 cases, AES: 62 cases reported.
article.articleSummary: Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala: Health department data indicate a surge in communicable diseases, including dengue, malaria, and Shigella. Shigella has been confirmed in 114 people as of June 11, across three districts, compared with 54 by June 11 last year. The article also lists Amoebic encephalitis with 133 cases and Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) with 62 cases reported in the state. Data reflect ongoing surveillance through early June 2026 and a rising disease burden. No laboratory confirmation specifics or infection sources are provided in the brief, and the report underscores Kerala's heightened risk of outbreaks in the current period. The figures underscore ongoing public health vigilance and the need for targeted containment and hygiene measures.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州が流行病の脅威下にある。シゲラ菌：これまでに114例、アメーバ性脳炎：133例、AES：62例が報告されている。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、重症度）し、複数の感染症が同時多発している。ケーラ州での多重流行（シゲラ、マラリア、デング、脳炎）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示唆しており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 複数の感染症が同時に報告されており、シゲラは前年同期比で倍増（54例→114例）している点が懸念される。アメーバ性脳炎とAESの症例数も高い。ただし、検査確認の詳細や感染源に関する情報が限定的なため、詳細なRRAでの確認が必要。ケーラ州の公衆衛生対応状況、医療施設の対応能力についての追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國爆發伊波拉疫情！難民營擁擠如沙丁魚恐釀滅絕式災難 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo! Refugee camps packed like sardines could trigger an extinction-level disaster - Minshi News Network.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, near Bunia) with refugee camps housing over 25,000 displaced people in cramped tents. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain circulating has no vaccine or specific treatment, relying on isolation and contact tracing. The region has reported over 500 confirmed cases and at least 91 deaths; Uganda has sporadic cases. Conflict and displacement hinder outbreak response, and camp conditions include scarce clean water and soap, with limited deep-w bore water for large populations. WHO Chief Tedros warns of a catastrophic convergence of disease and conflict. Local health facilities lack isolation tents and essential equipment, drawing criticism for slow government action. International support is urged to provide medical supplies and personnel to avert a worsening humanitarian catastrophe.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が大流行！難民キャンプがイワシのように詰め込まれており、絶滅的災厄を引き起こす恐れ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響（500確認例、91死亡、ワクチンなし）、予想外の多数死傷、ウガンダへの国際拡大、紛争・難民状況による管理困難性が認められる。WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当し、国際支援の必要性が明示されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain（ワクチンなし、致死的）、ウガンダでも散発的確認。難民キャンプ（25,000人以上）での水衛生不備、紛争による対応困難。WHO事務局長による警告あり。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah Virus Case: केरल के कोझिकोड में निपाह वायरस के मामले की पुष्टि, 43 वर्षीय व्यक्ति संक्रमित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah Virus Case: Nipah virus case confirmed in Kozhikode, Kerala; a 43-year-old person infected.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus case confirmed in Kozhikode, Kerala: a 43-year-old businessman infected, with infection confirmed by Pune’s National Institute of Virology. This is Kerala’s first Nipah case in 2026. The patient, a Ramanattukara resident, is in the ICU at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital on ventilator support but described as stable. After confirmation, authorities traced 77 contacts—58 healthcare workers, 14 family members, and 5 friends/coworkers—none currently showing symptoms; two Highest-Risk and 13 High-Risk contacts are under strict quarantine. Preliminary investigations point to an environmental source; the patient had rented and cleaned a warehouse. Field surveillance is underway, and no containment zone has been declared yet. Public health guidance underscores Nipah’s higher risk from May to September, advising against direct bat contact, reporting unusual bat activity, and avoiding fruit partially eaten by animals.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス症例: ケーラ州コージコードでニパウイルス症例が確認、43歳の男性が感染
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス感染症の確定症例であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準も複数該当。インドでの新規感染症危機管理が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高い致死率（40～75%）を持つVHF相当の重篤感染症。ケーラ州での初症例（2026年）、患者はICU入院・人工呼吸器使用中も安定。環境源（清掃した倉庫）が示唆されており、季節性リスク（5～9月）の時期。77名の接触者追跡が実施され、2名が最高リスク、13名が高リスク隔離中。フィールドサーベイランス進行中。ニパウイルスは従来地域限定だが国際的懸念のあるZoonotic pathogen。

article.articleHeadline: Communicable diseases rise in Kerala during monsoon; Shigella cases see sharp increase
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports rising Shigella infections during the monsoon; Shigella spreads via contaminated food or water or contact with infected individuals. This month has eight amoebic meningoencephalitis (brain fever) cases and two deaths; 133 brain-fever cases and 33 deaths this year. Chikungunya activity climbs with 2,161 suspected this month, 617 confirmed cases and three confirmed deaths (two suspected deaths). Influenza again records the most deaths this month: seven deaths and 529 infections. Leptospirosis and Hepatitis A cause two deaths each, with 88 and 265 confirmed cases respectively. A Nipah case was reported in Kozhikode on Thursday. Health authorities are implementing chlorine disinfection of drinking-water sources, containment measures, and awareness campaigns; residents with symptoms should seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラタ州でモンスーン時期に伝染病が増加；シゲラ菌感染が急増
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーラタ州で複数の感染症（シゲラ菌、脳髄膜炎、チクングニア熱、インフルエンザ、レプトスピラ症、A型肝炎、ニパウイルス）が同時多発的に増加し、すでに複数の死亡が報告されている。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・長期曝露が明確である。
triage.notes: ケーラタ州のコージコード地区でニパウイルス患者が報告されており、ニパウイルスは高い死亡率で知られている。複数の水系感染症（シゲラ菌、脳髄膜炎、レプトスピラ症）が同時に増加しており、モンスーン期による水質悪化が共通の背景にあると推定される。保健当局による対応が既に実施されているが、ニパウイルスの出現は特に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeita de ebola em Novo Hamburgo: saiba como a doença é transmitida, quais são os sintomas e o tratamento | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Novo Hamburgo: Learn How the Disease Is Transmitted, What the Symptoms Are, and the Treatment | abc+
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola case is being investigated in Novo Hamburgo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, involving a 64-year-old man who recently travelled to Uganda. He has tested positive for malaria and is receiving treatment; he will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre. Contacts are being traced and monitored; the Ministry of Health has been notified. The case follows WHO’s international health emergency over Bundibugyo Ebola in Uganda and the DRC; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and two deaths, with no evidence of community transmission. Ebola is a zoonosis, with bats as the probable reservoir; four of five subtypes can infect humans. Diagnosis relies on PCR testing by Fiocruz, requiring two negative results 48 hours apart. Ebola is notifiable, with suspected cases reported within 24 hours. Symptoms include fever, headache, weakness, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and hemorrhagic signs; incubation is 2–21 days.

triage.headline_ja: ノーボ・ハンブルゴでのエボラ疑い患者：感染経路、症状、治療について知る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い患者報告であり、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）2つ以上を満たす。ウガンダからの渡航歴がありWHO国際保健上の緊急事態と連動している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジル（ノーボ・ハンブルゴ）での疑い患者が主題であり、ウガンダへの渡航歴があり、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態（ウガンダおよびDRCでのBundibugyo Ebola）と関連している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、ブラジルとDRCのみとした。マラリア陽性で現在治療中、接触者の追跡監視が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Sering Kita Lakukan, Ternyata 5 Penyakit Ini Gampang Banget Menular Lewat Jabat Tangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We Do This All the Time: These 5 Diseases Are Very Easy to Spread Through Handshakes.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-12, an Indonesian article highlights five diseases easily spread through handshakes, with influenza (flu) and the common cold among the top examples. Transmission occurs when a sick person sneezes or coughs into their hand, leaving virus particles on the palm that can transfer during a handshake and reach the other person’s nose or mouth when they touch their own face. The piece notes that flu and cold can disrupt daily activities. Conjunctivitis (red eye) is another highly contagious illness spread via touching an infected eye and then shaking hands; in public settings like schools or offices, a single case can quickly spread to many people if hand hygiene is neglected. Emphasizes the importance of hand cleanliness to curb such transfers.

triage.headline_ja: 我々がよく行うこと：これら5つの疾患は握手で非常に簡単に伝染する
triage.triage_reason: 啓発記事であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクやイベントの報告ではない。特定の症例数、死亡、異常な発生の増加などの具体的なサーベイランス信号がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインフルエンザを含む5つの伝染性疾患の一般的な予防啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイク、症例の増加、または公衆衛生上の懸念を報告していない。疾患名がインフルエンザとして検出されているが、記事の内容は教育的な情報提供に過ぎず、感染症シグナルとしての価値がない。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala battles surge in communicable diseases as monsoon intensifies
article.articleSummary: Kerala faces a health alert as monsoon intensifies, with Shigella, Chikungunya, influenza, leptospirosis and brain fever reported from different parts of the state. The Directorate of Health Services says the rains are associated with a surge in communicable diseases. Since June 1, 24 people have died due to various communicable diseases, and 12 suspected deaths linked to infectious diseases have been recorded in the same period, according to DHS data cited by PTI. The report highlights the spread across multiple areas amid ongoing monsoon conditions. No details on laboratory confirmation, symptoms, infection sources, or imported/exported cases are provided in the summary. The figures underline the scale of the event and the need for sustained public health vigilance as Kerala continues to experience heavy rainfall.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州が季節風の激化に伴う感染症の急増に対処
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：24人死亡、12人の疑い死亡；異常性：季節風に伴う急増；国際的リスク：チクングニアとレプトスピラ症は国際的な懸念疾患）。WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上該当。フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケーララ州の複数地域での発生を報告。Bluedot APIで検出された3疾患（チクングニア、レプトスピラ症、インフルエンザ）に加え、シゲラと脳熱が言及されている。季節風による持続的な曝露環境が存在。ただし検査確認、具体的な症状、感染源の詳細は不明。死亡数（24人）は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Το μυστήριο της κηδείας, το σπασμένο φέρετρο και η αναζήτηση του "ασθενή μηδέν"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: The Mystery of the Funeral, the Broken Coffin, and the Search for "Patient Zero"
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) centers on a funeral linked transmission. Pastor Paluku Makundi Denis, 44, died February 3, 2026; his funeral on February 4 in Mongbalu reportedly attracted about 80 attendees. The coffin transporting from Bunia morgue was damaged and replaced, with experts warning that handling of an infected body can drive transmission, though officials had not confirmed an outbreak at the time of death. Within days, residents reported Ebola-like symptoms; the Mongbalu mayor said nearly 50 deaths occurred within two weeks, many with viral symptoms. The Bundibugyo strain appears to have circulated for months before official confirmation on May 15. As of June 12, 2026, in eastern DRC, about 635 confirmed infections and at least 127 deaths; authorities caution that actual numbers may be higher. Rumors of curses and a burned coffin fueled fear and distrust of health workers, complicating outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴで流行：葬儀の謎、壊れた棺、そして「患者ゼロ」の捜索
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。エボラ・ブンディブギョ株の大規模流行（確認635例、死亡127例以上）で、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株の流行で、葬儀での遺体取扱いが主要な感染経路。数ヶ月間、確認前に社会内で循環していた。現地での信頼喪失（呪いの噂、焼かれた棺に関する恐怖）が対応を複雑にしている。実際の感染者・死亡者数はさらに高い可能性あり。DRC内の感染拡大に加え、隣接国への国際的拡散リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: African Union Confirms Ebola Outbreak Under Control In Uganda With Effective Contact Tracing
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ebola outbreak is under control with 19 cases and 2 deaths over about a month, almost all among Congolese nationals who crossed the border. Uganda has identified 792 contacts under active follow-up and a case fatality rate of less than 1%. Across the border, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 635 confirmed infections and 127 deaths since May 15, prompting the WHO to declare an international health emergency. The DRC's Ituri province remains the epicenter, where poor roads and insecurity hinder access and tracing. Officials say fewer than 5,000 contacts have been traced in DRC, far short of a target closer to 24,000. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. The Africa CDC advises at least 40 contacts per confirmed case, and a ceasefire in eastern DRC is urged to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合がウガンダのエボラ流行を確認、効果的な接触者追跡により管理下に置かれている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスによる複国流行で、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでのケースも述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言がなされており、ブンディブギョ株によるエボラで、ワクチンおよび特異的治療法がない状況。DRCでの接触者追跡が大きく遅れており（目標24,000人に対し5,000人未満）、管理可能性の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Caixão rachado e funeral podem explicar a origem do novo surto de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cracked Coffin and Funeral May Explain the Origin of the New Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province has reached at least 635 confirmed cases and 127 deaths. Investigations focus on a February funeral for pastor Paluku Makundi Denis (44) in Mongbwalu after transport from Bunia; the coffin was damaged during the 3-hour trip on rough roads, prompting a replacement coffin and potential exposure to remains. More than 80 mourners attended. In the weeks after, communities reported fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhaging; nearly 50 deaths followed. Scientists are examining whether the funeral event contributed to a super-spreader episode. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant may have circulated for months before official identification in May, with Pastor Denis's case the oldest under review. Family members report social backlash.

triage.headline_ja: 割れた棺と葬儀がエボラ出血熱の新しい発生の起源を説明できる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な影響：635確認例、127死亡；異常性：新しい発生；国際的拡大リスク：エボラウイルス病の性質；渡航制限リスク：あり）。スクリーニング基準でも重症度と流行しやすさが明確。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: DRC東部イツリ州でのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク。635確認例、127死亡という深刻な規模。2月の葬儀から集団感染の可能性が指摘されており、スーパースプレッダーイベントの調査が進行中。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの長期循環の可能性も報告されている。国際的関心も高く、CEPR通知相当の重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: നിപ ബാധ: കേരളത്തിലെ സാഹചര്യം സൂക്ഷ്‌മമായി നിരീക്ഷിച്ച് കേന്ദ്രം | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah infection: Centre monitors the situation in Kerala closely.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, India’s Centre says Nipah virus infection has been reported again in Kerala, and the Centre is monitoring the situation closely. The Health Ministry affirmed that all necessary support to curb transmission has been arranged, with continuous communication maintained with the Kerala state health department to assess current preventive measures. A central task force is ready to provide technical assistance and expert guidance as needed. The government has directed strict implementation of established standard operating protocols and response procedures to effectively prevent and control Nipah virus infection. This underscores ongoing vigilance in Kerala and nationwide preparedness to respond to Nipah threats.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス感染：インド中央政府がケララ州の状況を厳密に監視
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの再発生報告であり、異常性と国際的拡大リスクを持つ。中央政府による監視体制が確立されており、シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはWHO優先リスト病原体。ケララ州での再発生報告であり、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。中央政府、保健省、タスクフォースが関与した高いレベルの対応が報告されている。IHR基準3つ以上、WPRO基準5つすべて該当。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lima Bulan Pertama 2026, Kasus TBC di Surabaya Tembus 4.191 Orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB cases in Surabaya reach 4,191 in the first five months of 2026.
article.articleSummary: TB cases in Surabaya reached 4,191 diagnosed from January–May 2026, comprising 4,078 drug-susceptible TB (DS-TB) and 113 drug-resistant TB (DR-TB). With an estimated 11,412 TB cases for 2026, 4,191 have been identified and 4,166 patients are currently undergoing treatment across city health facilities. Among DS-TB, 3,443 patients (84.43%) have started treatment, while 90 of the DR-TB patients are in therapy. The Treatment Success Rate for DS-TB stands at 89.36%, with a TB-attributed death rate of 1.80%. Preventive and control measures include 2,461 contact investigations and 2,729 household contacts receiving TB preventive therapy. From January–May 2026, screening reached 644,201 residents (45.78% of the 50% target). Five areas conduct weekly tracing and screening of contacts, with or without symptoms. Authorities emphasize ongoing TB tracing and screening efforts in Surabaya.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年最初の5ヶ月でスラバヤのTB患者が4,191人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、スラバヤの統計報告は異常でも予想外でもない。国際的な拡大リスクはなく、重篤な新規公衆衛生危機の兆候がない。
triage.notes: 結核は周知の慢性感染症で、インドネシアにおいて風土病的に存在する。記事はスラバヤの年間結核対応統計の定期的な公表であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な増加傾向を示唆していない。治療成功率89.36%、死亡率1.80%と、対応システムが機能していることが示唆されている。WPROスクリーニング基準の該当（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）は結核の根本的特性であり、シグナル識別の閾値に達しない。

article.articleHeadline: 近期我国呼吸道传染病疫情波动，肠道病毒阳性率上升_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recent fluctuations in China's respiratory infectious disease outbreaks, enterovirus positivity rate on the rise.
article.articleSummary: China CDC sentinel surveillance of acute respiratory infections shows fluctuations in respiratory disease activity. Enterovirus positivity is rising nationwide; no unknown pathogens detected. Overall influenza activity remains low, with northern provinces reporting declines and southern provinces showing a recent uptick, predominantly influenza B. Rhinovirus positivity is rising in the north; enteric viruses are increasing, higher in the south. Parainfluenza positivity fluctuates downward, and human metapneumovirus has declined. SARS-CoV-2 positivity rose in the past two weeks but remains in an interepidemic period. Other respiratory pathogens stay at low levels. Public health advice: wear masks with fever or respiratory symptoms, ensure ventilation, seek care as needed, and vaccinate at-risk groups. Schistosomiasis season approaches; transmission interruption nationwide exists, but local risk persists; avoid contact with suspected water and use protection; seek care if infection suspected.

triage.headline_ja: 最近の中国の呼吸器感染症の流行変動、腸道ウイルスの陽性率上昇
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器感染症の活動変動（特にエンテロウイルスの上昇）が報告されており、WPRO基準で複数該当するが、既知病原体の季節的変動範囲内であり、重症度や国際的リスクに関する具体的な情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はChinese CDC による公式なサーベイランスレポートであり、既知病原体（インフルエンザB、エンテロウイルス、ヒトメタニューモウイルスなど）の季節的な活動変動を報告している。新規未知病原体の検出はなく、SARS-CoV-2の陽性率上昇も流行間期の範囲内とされている。シャイストソーマ症については季節的な注意喚起である。深刻度や死亡例に関する具体的情報が記載されていないため、重症度評価は不明。

article.articleHeadline: สสจ.โคราชแถลงการณ์ สุนัขจรจัดกัดข้ามตำบล ผลตรวจพบเชื้อพิษสุนัขบ้า
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nakhon Ratchasima Provincial Public Health Office statement: Stray dogs bite across sub-district boundaries; rabies detected.
article.articleSummary: Rabies detected after a stray dog attack in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand. On 10 June 2026, about 17:00, a brown, ownerless stray dog living near a garbage-dump area in Pho Klang, Nong Bu Sala, Muang Nakhon Ratchasima, bit residents in four unfenced houses, injuring a 17-year-old male, a ~30-year-old female, a 60-year-old female, and a 16-year-old female. All four received urgent medical care; no additional high-risk contacts were found. The dog died and laboratory testing confirmed rabies. Two pet dogs in the first house were bitten and subjected to quarantine and vaccination under the 4x4 protocol. Public health actions include contact tracing and vaccination for exposed individuals, risk communication, and ongoing laboratory testing of suspect dogs. The authorities plan retrospective exposure assessment and vaccination campaigns, coordinating with livestock officials and Nong Bu Sala Municipality for outbreak control, with follow-up activities on 12 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ナコーンラーチャシマ県保健局声明：野良犬が副地区の境界を越えて咬傷事件；狂犬病を検出
triage.triage_reason: タイで狂犬病が確認された咬傷事件。複数の人間被害（4名）と動物への曝露、公衆衛生当局による積極的な対応が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性、公衆衛生への影響）およびWPRO基準（重症度、対管理可能性の確認）を満たす。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-動物間感染経路の典型的ケース。タイの地域保健当局による迅速な対応（接触追跡、ワクチン接種、検査室確認）が実施されている。野良犬による複数咬傷と動物との接触から人間への継続的な曝露リスクがあると判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah alert in Kozhikode: Authorities intensify contact monitoring based on patient's route map
article.articleSummary: Nipah infection confirmed in a 43-year-old resident of Ward 5, Ramanattukara Municipality, Kozhikode, Kerala. Health authorities intensified contact tracing after publishing the patient’s route map. The area is divided into 50-house clusters with Junior Health Inspectors and NHM medical officers monitoring contacts. As of 12 June 2026, 77 contacts have been identified (58 healthcare workers, 14 relatives), with nine family members under home quarantine. No containment zone yet; zone to be declared only if symptoms appear among contacts. The patient’s movements included residence near Adivaram of Farook College (May 30–June 1), a June 2 trip by private car to Red Crescent Hospital for tests, and daily travel June 3–6 to the Farook College Post Office (9:15–10:30 am). He was admitted June 7–10 across Red Crescent Hospital, Aster MIMS, and Kozhikode Medical College Hospital ICU; antibody therapy is under consideration. Farook College Post Office to reopen with three postal assistants; postal delivery suspended.

triage.headline_ja: コジコードでのニパール警報：患者の行動経路に基づき当局が接触者追跡を強化
triage.triage_reason: ニパール・ウイルスの確認患者が発生し、複数の医療・公共施設での曝露、77名の接触者特定、高い感染性と重症度を持つ病原体であること、および国際的な懸念が該当。IHR基準3項目以上、スクリーニング基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: ニパール・ウイルスは致死率40～75％の重篤な新興感染症であり、確認患者が複数の医療施設・公共施設（郵便局、大学キャンパス）を経由したため広範な接触者の特定が必要。医療機関での78名の接触者確認（医療従事者58名含む）は医療施設でのアウトブレイクリスクを示唆。密閉空間での接触と複数施設への移動により、ヒト-ヒト感染の高いリスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to new health zones | News.az
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to three additional health zones in North Kivu and Ituri, according to a government report released June 12, 2026. The outbreak now totals 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with data recorded through June 10, 2026. Newly affected zones indicate continued geographic expansion in regions previously affected by Ebola, underscoring sustained transmission. The latest figures were confirmed by the health minister in a post on X. Congo's health system defines a health zone as a geographic area served by clinics and a referral hospital, typically supporting 100,000–150,000 people; the country has more than 500 health zones, and authorities are monitoring the outbreak as it spreads into new areas. The report provides no details on infection sources or clinical symptoms beyond case counts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、新たな保健地区に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。確定患者676名・死亡136名の大規模アウトブレイク、地理的拡大の継続、国際的懸念、および公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。記事は2026年6月12日配信で、Ituri州を含む北キヴ州での継続的な地理的拡大を報告している。676確定患者・136死亡という重大な公衆衛生脅威。DRCのみが実際の発生地であり、他の国への拡大は記事サマリーに明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa Races for Ebola Vaccine as Outbreak Outpaces Response
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo with no licensed vaccines or treatments; WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. By 29 May, the outbreak caused 223 suspected deaths in DRC and one in Uganda; on 2 June Uganda reported six new cases, total confirmed 15. CEPI pledged US$62 million to fast‑track three vaccine candidates from IAVI, Moderna, and the University of Oxford (Oxford doses to be manufactured at Serum Institute of India); Oxford aims for clinical‑grade doses in two to three months. WHO TAC identified IAVI’s single‑dose rVSV candidate as the most promising, but seven to nine months remain before human testing. Gavi commits up to US$40 million to accelerate access, part of a US$50 million First Response Fund. Africa CDC’s continental plan seeks US$319 million in six months for 11 high‑risk countries alongside DRC and Uganda, amid cross‑border spread; Russia’s Gamaleya vaccine platform is being assessed, and WHO is evaluating MBP134, Maftivimab, remdesivir, and obeldesivi.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカがエボラワクチン開発を急速化、発生状況への対応を追い越す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態で、WHO PHEICが宣言されており、DRCとウガンダでの死亡・確定症例があり、複数国への拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: インドはセラム・インスティテュート・オブ・インディアがオックスフォード大学製ワクチン候補の臨床等級用量の製造を担当する予定のため、記事の中核的関心事として含める。ロシア連邦はGamaleyaワクチンプラットフォーム評価対象として言及されているが、ワクチン開発サポート国であり、実際のエボラ発生地ではないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: कोरोना से निपाह तक... खतरनाक वायरस के मामले पहले केरल में ही क्यों सामने आते हैं? जानें वजह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From COVID-19 to Nipah... Why do cases of dangerous viruses first surface in Kerala? Find out the reason.
article.articleSummary: Kerala is repeatedly the entry point for dangerous pathogens in India, from COVID-19 to Nipah, Monkeypox, and Shigella. The article notes Nipah’s reemergence in northern Kerala, with Shigella causing a child’s death, and states four Nipah outbreaks overall, three in the northern districts of Kozhikode and Malappuram. Spillover is linked to ecology: dense Western Ghats forests, fruit bats, deforestation, and close human–wildlife contact. Exposure routes include consuming palm toddy and raw fruits near forests. High population density accelerates spread within households and care networks. Kerala’s global connectivity—millions of residents work abroad in Gulf countries and travel widely—facilitates international movement of infections. The state’s strong health infrastructure, with proactive contact tracing, testing, and disease surveillance, coupled with transparent, WHO-standard reporting, enables early detection and containment, underscoring that the perception of higher incidence stems from vigilant surveillance rather than inherently higher disease burden. (Published 2026-06-12)

triage.headline_ja: コロナからニパウイルスまで...危険なウイルスの症例が最初にケーラ州で発生するのはなぜか？理由を知る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の高リスク病原体（Nipah、Mpox、COVID-19、Shigella）の同時流行報告が示唆されており、ニパウイルスの再出現と国際的な移動リスクが確認される。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスの再出現、Shigella（小児死亡例あり）、Mpoxおよび複数病原体の同時報告。ケーラ州は西ガーツ山脈の森林生態系、果実コウモリとの接触、高人口密度、および湾岸諸国との国際的な労働移動を通じた多数の出国者を有する。記事は強力な保健インフラと透明性のある報告を強調しているが、複数の高リスク病原体の同時流行の兆候はフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Kemarau Lebih Panjang, Dinkes Bantul Waspadai Lonjakan Penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Longer Dry Season, Bantul Health Office Warns of Disease Surge
article.articleSummary: Longer dry season in Bantul, Indonesia, raises risk of a disease surge, according to the Bantul Health Office. With the dry spell expected to extend, health facilities are urged to intensify public education via social media and other channels (KIE). Key health risks include dehydration, vector-borne diseases, gastrointestinal disturbances, malnutrition, and respiratory problems from dust and air pollution. Influenza and eye irritation are the illnesses most commonly observed during dry periods. Children are particularly vulnerable, and parents should monitor for symptoms and seek care as needed. Public health measures emphasize Clean Living Habits (PHBS): use clean water, wash hands, maintain sanitary surroundings, and eat a balanced, vitamin/mineral-rich diet; stay hydrated. Masks are advised outdoors when dusty or during respiratory symptoms to help mitigate risk and avert a potential surge.

triage.headline_ja: 長期乾季、バントゥル保健局が疾病急増に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バントゥル）での季節性インフルエンザリスク予警であり、異常性と国際リスクは低いが、乾季による複合的健康リスク増加の懸念から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは季節性インフルエンザの予警情報であり、確定的な患者数や重症例の報告ではない。バントゥル保健局による予防的警告であり、現在のところ公式な流行宣言や国際的な懸念は示されていない。乾季延長に伴うベクター媒介性疾患やガストロ腸炎などの複合的健康リスク増加は地域の環境的脆弱性を反映しており、続報でより具体的な患者情報が得られれば評価を更新する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak spreads to new health zones
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to three new health zones in North Kivu and Ituri, according to a government report released June 12, 2026. Total confirmed cases have risen to 676, with 136 deaths, based on data up to Wednesday, June 10, 2026, noted by the health minister on X. The update confirms ongoing transmission in the eastern provinces. A health zone is a defined administrative area containing clinics and a referral hospital, typically serving about 100,000–150,000 people; the country has more than 500 health zones. The report underscores the continuing challenge of containing Ebola in the region, with authorities tracking case counts and geographic spread as response measures continue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が新たな保健ゾーンに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認患者676名・死亡136名の深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数保健ゾーンへの地理的拡大、国際的な感染拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: DRCは対象国リストに含まれていないが、エボラ出血熱は極めて高い国際的関心と支援要件を有する疾患であり、シグナルとして即座に識別される。記事は東部州（North Kivu、Ituri）での進行中の流行を報告しており、地理的な拡大が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: MSF mobilise les médias pour renforcer la lutte contre l'épidémie et se dit prête à intensifier son appui à la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: MSF mobilizes the media to strengthen the fight against the epidemic and says it is ready to intensify its support for the response.
article.articleSummary: An MSF briefing on the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) shows the situation is 'quite worrying' and MSF is intensifying support under the Ministry of Health and INSP. MSF runs Ebola treatment centers in Mongbwalu, Beni, Goma, Bukavu, and Lwiro, collaborating with WHO, ALIMA, and other partners. With no vaccine or treatment for the circulating Bundibugyo virus, containment relies on infection-control measures: avoid contact with patient fluids, handwashing, not handling bodies, and seeking care promptly. As of May 17, after WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) due to Bundibugyo, the outbreak has spread; DRC faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, with three Bundibugyo outbreaks previously contained without vaccines. MSF says resources are sufficient, despite border closures, and has delivered over 10 tons of supplies. It calls for increased engagement from journalists to relay accurate information.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：MSFはメディアを動員して流行対策を強化し、支援強化の準備ができていると述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生への影響、PHEIC宣言による異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限可能性）。エボラウイルス病の流行で、東部DRCの複数州に広がり、既にPHEIC宣言されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo種）の流行。2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言。DRCの17番目のエボラ流行。イトゥリ、北キヴ、南キヴの3州で確認。MSFが複数の治療センターを運営中。ワクチンや治療法がないため、感染予防対策に依存している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in der DR Kongo weitet sich aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to three more health zones, with confirmed cases rising to 676 and 136 deaths as of Wednesday. Newly affected areas are in Nord-Kivu and Ituri provinces, part of an epidemic raging in Ituri, Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. It was announced on May 15 but reportedly undetected for weeks. Mistrust of health workers and attacks on burial teams and treatment centers have hampered containment. The country uses a health zone system—networks of clinics and a referral hospital for about 100,000 to 150,000 people; there are more than 500 such zones nationwide. DR Congo has endured several devastating Ebola outbreaks, including the second-deepest globally from 2018 to 2020 with more than 2,200 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（確認症例676件、死亡136件の深刻な公衆衛生影響；複数州への急速な地理的拡大；国際的な懸念と対応の必要性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)Annex2の特定可能疾患。Bundibugyo株の流行は稀であり注視が必要。医療従事者への不信感と埋葬チームへの攻撃が封じ込めを困難にしており、管理可能性が低い。DRCの過去の大規模流行実績（2018-2020年に2,200人以上死亡）により、国際的なリスク認識は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Nipah Scare & Shigella Outbreak: Health Alert
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports a fresh Nipah virus scare and a continuing Shigella outbreak in Wayanad. A new suspected Nipah case has been reported; samples from suspected patients and contacts sent to NIV Pune for testing; definitive results pending and officials say there is no cause for panic as measures follow Nipah prevention protocols; Centre provides technical support and monitors closely. In Wayanad, Shigella outbreak among children has risen to nine confirmed cases; 502 children from Koliyadi school sought treatment; 47 in hospitals. Holidays declared for schools in three panchayats and Sulthan Bathery municipality to slow transmission; parents advised to avoid crowded places. Field teams conduct inspections, surveillance, and awareness campaigns; more test results awaited. Authorities emphasize high alert status and continued monitoring in Kerala, with ongoing coordination between state and Centre.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州のニパウイルス懸念とシゲラ菌アウトブレイク：保健警報
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（高致死率、人間伝播可能）の新規疑い事例とシゲラ菌アウトブレイクの同時発生。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、重症度リスク、国際拡大リスク）。インドにおける重要な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高致死率（40-75%）の人獣共通感染症であり、人間伝播が確認されている。ケーラ州では過去にもニパウイルスアウトブレイクの経験がある。同時にシゲラ菌アウトブレイク（学校での集団発症、502人の治療希望者）も報告されており、保健システムへの複合的な負荷が懸念される。NIV Pune検査結果待機中。中央政府による技術支援と密接な監視が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 女大學生因腹瀉就醫6小時後死亡，鑒定符合病毒性心肌炎致死，醫院存在過錯，多方回應：調解需第三方組織 涉事醫院涉多起醫療損害糾紛
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Female university student dies six hours after seeking treatment for diarrhea; forensic assessment finds death due to viral myocarditis; hospital at fault; multiple parties respond: mediation requires a third-party organization; the involved hospital has been involved in multiple medical malpractice disputes.
article.articleSummary: January 22, Jinping County, Guizhou Province: a 19-year-old university student sought treatment at Jinping County People’s Hospital for diarrhea and vomiting. About six hours later, she died after resuscitation failed (death at 6:42). Forensic assessment found death due to viral myocarditis, with medical fault by the hospital contributing 45–55% (centered at 50%). The family seeks resolution through mediation by a third-party organization; hospital and local health authorities say mediation will be pursued, with litigation as an option if mediation fails. The hospital has a history of malpractice disputes; in April it was warned and fined 70,000 yuan for six ENT physicians lacking provincial authorization to apply certain traditional Chinese medicine techniques, and it faces tax arrears of about 2.904 million yuan. This case highlights a fatal infection-related myocarditis and ongoing medical accountability considerations in China.

triage.headline_ja: 女子大学生が下痢で就医後6時間で死亡、法医学鑑定でウイルス性心筋炎と判定、病院に過失あり、複数の関係者が対応：調停には第三者機関が必要、関係医院は複数の医療損害紛争に関与
triage.triage_reason: ウイルス性心筋炎による死亡例の報告であり、感染症関連の重篤事例のため監視対象となるが、散発的な医療過誤事例の要素が強く、公衆衛生上の流行兆候や国際的拡大リスクの明確な証拠に乏しいため。
triage.notes: 本件は単一の死亡事例であり、ウイルス性心筋炎の感染症的側面より医療過誤事件としての性質が強い。医院の過去の違反歴や経営問題が報告されている。公衆衛生上の流行兆候や複数症例の集積が示されていないため、散発例の重篤死亡例として経過観察に留めるが、同様のウイルス性心筋炎の症例が他地域で報告される場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tái xuất hiện virus lở mồm long móng type A tại Thái Nguyên
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Re-emergence of foot-and-mouth disease virus serotype A in Thai Nguyen
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) serotype A has re-emerged in Thai Nguyen, Vietnam. On 6 June, 85 samples from three households in Nghiên Loan commune tested positive: 2 for serotype O and 19 for serotype A. At the Nghiên Loan cattle market, 10 samples yielded 2 positives for serotype A, underscoring risk from a major market that moves thousands of cattle to other provinces monthly. As of 8 June, a task force was dispatched to implement controls; disinfectants, PPE, and sprayers were provided. On 9 June, authorities suspended live cattle trading at the market from 11 June until containment; enhanced cleaning and chemical disinfection were undertaken. Serotype A had not circulated in Vietnam since 2018 (Sea-97, Asia Topotype). The province seeks urgent vaccine from national stock: 15,000 doses for serotypes A and O, plus 15,000 L disinfectant; Nghiên Loan needs 8,500 doses for 70–75% coverage; surrounding high-risk areas require 6,500 doses.

triage.headline_ja: タイグエンでの口蹄疫ウイルスA型の再出現
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫A型がベトナムで2018年以来8年ぶりに再出現し、重要な家畜市場での検出により国際的な拡大リスク（隣国への家畜流通）が存在。農業部門への深刻な影響が予想される。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫A型は2018年以来ベトナムで未検出。タイグエン州のゲン・ロアン家畜市場は月間数千頭の家畜を他省に出荷する重要な流通拠点であり、周辺国への国際的な流行拡大リスクが高い。ベトナム当局は緊急にワクチン30,000用量とリン酸ジスインファクタント15,000Lの供給を要請。市場での生体畜産取引を6月11日から一時停止。

article.articleHeadline: ജാഗ്രതൈ; കേരളത്തിലെ വവ്വാലുകളിൽ 28 ശതമാനം വരെ നിപ വൈറസ് സാന്നിധ്യം | Nipah virus presence in up to 28 percent of bats in Kerala
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: Nipah virus presence in up to 28 percent of bats in Kerala.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus detected in up to 28% of bats in Kerala, per a National Virology Institute study covering Kozhikode and Wayanad districts. From February to September 2023, bat-tested Nipah positivity rose from 9% (8 of 88) to 24% (18 of 74) in July and 28% (31 of 110) in September. February samples came from Perambra (Kozhikode) and Mananthavadi (Wayanad); July from Manassery, Perambra, and Kuttiyadi (Kozhikode); September from Kallad, Thalakkara, Kuttiyadi (Kozhikode) and Sultan Bathery, Mananthavadi (Wayanad). Although human transmission from bats hasn’t been confirmed, the viruses in bats and humans are similar, suggesting possible bat-to-human spillover. The coincidence of fruit harvest season with bat breeding heightens concern for fruit-mediated transmission; authorities urge avoiding bat contact and not consuming fruits bitten by bats. Prior Nipah detections in 2019 and 2021 showed about 20–21% bat positivity.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒：ケーラ州のコウモリの最大28%にニパウイルスが検出
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの動物での高い保有率（最大28%）が報告されており、異常/予想外の基準に該当する可能性があります。しかし、現時点で人への感染または感染症の発生は報告されておらず、情報が不足しているため、続報の監視が必要です。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高病原性で人獣共通感染症であり、過去に2019年と2021年にケーラ州での検出実績があります。現在のところ人への感染事例の報告はありませんが、コウモリからの獣人感染（spillover）のリスク、特に果実収穫シーズンとコウモリの繁殖期の重なりによる間接的な食物媒介感染のリスクが指摘されています。サーベイランス継続と公衆衛生予防措置の強化が重要です。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch sốt xuất huyết có nhiều thay đổi đáng lo ngại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The dengue fever outbreak has many alarming changes.
article.articleSummary: Global dengue fever remains a top 10 WHO health threat, with cases rising tenfold from 2010–2019. In Vietnam, dengue spans the country, not just the south, with northern outbreaks in 2022 and hundreds of hospitalizations. Climate change, rapid urbanization, and unpredictable transmission drive the shift as Aedes aegypti thrives in warm conditions and dense cities. Nationally, about 371,000 cases were reported in 2022; recent years run around 150,000 annually. In the first five months of 2026, Vietnam logged over 50,000 cases, about 2.5 times the same period last year. Dengue serotype DENV-2 dominates, increasing the risk of severe disease. The disease affects all ages; previously mostly children under 15 in the south. Severe dengue can cause shock, hemorrhage, and multi-organ failure, with treatment costs hundreds of millions VND. Prevention combines vector control, AI-based early warning, and vaccination pilots after vaccine licensing in Vietnam, as WHO aims for zero fatalities by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行が多くの懸念すべき変化を示している
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのデング熱流行が2026年前半に急増（前年同期比2.5倍）しており、WHO上位10の健康脅威に位置付けられている。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年1-5月にベトナムで50,000例以上が報告されており、前年同期比2.5倍と顕著な増加傾向を示している。DENV-2型が優勢で重症化リスクが高い。ベトナム全土での流行拡大（南部に限定されない）が新たな特徴。気候変動と都市化が媒介蚊の増加を促進。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah case in Kerala: Patient on ventilator, 77 contacts under watch
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus case in Kerala: 43-year-old Ramanattukara resident remains in critical condition on a ventilator at Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode, after confirmation by NIV Pune. Seventy-seven contacts identified: 58 healthcare workers, 14 family members, 5 friends/colleagues; high-risk contacts quarantined and monitored, with none reporting symptoms yet. Contact tracing intensified and infection-control protocols strengthened across district facilities. Public advised not to panic but to remain vigilant with newly introduced surveillance measures. District Collector M.S. Madhavikutty ordered flawless surveillance per the patient’s route map; rapid response teams launched field containment in Ramanattukara. PPE stocks and medicines are ensured. A 24x7 control room at the District Medical Office to address public concerns is open (phone numbers 0495-2373901 and 907207767), supervised by the District Medical Officer.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州のニパウイルス患者：人工呼吸器装着、77人の接触者が経過観察中
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは致死率が高く、患者が重症（人工呼吸器装着）であり、複数の接触者（特に医療従事者58人）が識別されている。異常で予想外の発生であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはWHO優先病原体リストに登録されている。患者の重症度（ICU人工呼吸器管理）、多数の医療従事者接触者（58人）、公式な接触追跡体制の強化、24時間対応制御室の設置など、インド当局による積極的な対応が確認されている。過去のニパウイルス流行（バングラデシュ、インド）では人間以外の動物媒介（コウモリなど）が関与しており、地域内での二次発生のリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Éclosion d'Ebola | La Coupe du monde, terrain de jeu des inégalités mondiales ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak | The World Cup, a Playground for Global Inequalities?
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intersects with FIFA World Cup 2026 as a mega sports-political-sanitary event. The article notes that Ebola not only raises health concerns but exposes social risks, including political and symbolic exclusion. To participate, the Congolese team faces a 'sanitary bubble' isolation, while Congo requests FIFA refunds for tickets bought by fans who may be unable to enter the United States. The piece argues that health measures are shaped by power relations and social inequalities, and can stigmatize foreigners, migrants, or racially marginalized groups. It recalls the 2014-2015 Ebola epidemic and COVID-19, where sanitary language masked long-standing discrimination. The author warns that the World Cup could become a test of equitable, transparent public health measures to avoid reinforcing exclusion while containing the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行 | ワールドカップ、世界的不平等の遊び場？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が確認されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。ワールドカップ開催（2026年）に関連した国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を主題としており、2026年ワールドカップ開催（米国）との関連で国際的な渡航制限・入場制限の懸念が発生している。ただしワールドカップ開催地である米国は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。記事配信日が2026年6月であり、フィクショナル・シナリオと考えられるが、評価手順に従い現在の情報内容のみに基づき判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo : évaluation de la prise en charge des malades d'Ebola dans les structures - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: assessment of Ebola patient management in health facilities - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026 in Butembo, North Kivu, DRC, the Director General of the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) assessed Ebola response and urged frontline teams to intensify efforts. He toured two Ebola Treatment Centers: at Kitatumba General Hospital, where capacity is around nine beds with an expansion plan, and the Katwa health zone CTE, which is being finalized. He outlined patient-management pathways and stressed the need for intensified collaboration with the province and the Provincial Health Directorate (DPS) to accelerate outbreak control. The visit follows a prior mission in Beni, the provisional capital of Nord-Kivu, where 32 confirmed Ebola cases of the Bundibugyo strain were reported, with Katwa health zone in Butembo as the epicenter, currently recording 16 cases to date.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ：保健施設におけるエボラ患者管理の評価 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（エボラ出血熱の確認患者発生）、異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクの4基準すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5基準に該当。確認患者が存在し、緊急対応が展開中である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo strain）の確認患者32例（Beni地域）および16例（Katwa health zone）が報告されている。複数のエボラ治療センターが稼働中で、国立公衆衛生研究所による評価・対応が進行中。高い懸念レベルのイベント。

article.articleHeadline: പകർച്ചപ്പനി ബാധിച്ച് ഇന്നലെ ചികിത്സ തേടിയത് 13,025 പേർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 13,025 people sought treatment yesterday for smallpox.
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports a multi-disease surge. On 2026-06-12, yesterday 13,025 people sought hospital treatment for smallpox; one dengue death and one monkeypox death were reported, with 134 dengue cases confirmed yesterday. Shigella is rising, with 38 cases this month to date; yesterday 4 were confirmed (Malappuram 2, Kozhikode 1, Wayanad 1). In the last six months, Shigella caused 2 deaths. Additionally, yesterday 11 chickenpox and 3 malaria cases were confirmed. In Malappuram, 2,495 people sought treatment for smallpox. Wednesday’s tallies: dengue 72, chickenpox 13, malaria 4, Shigella 7; Tuesday: 10 Shigella cases confirmed. Districts involved include Malappuram, Kozhikode, and Wayanad, indicating ongoing community transmission and a broad infectious disease burden across the state.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹で治療を求めた人数は13,025人
triage.triage_reason: 複数疾患による大規模流行イベント。IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPRO基準で「異常性」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」に複数該当。死亡例を含む緊急対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載の麻疹は見出しでは天然痘（Smallpox）と翻訳されているが、原文の"പകർച്ചപ്പനി"は一般的な伝染病を意味する。複数疾患の同時流行（麻疹、デング熱、サル痘、シゲラ、水痘、マラリア）が報告されており、単一疾患ではなく多元的な感染症危機と判定。Bluedot APIの疾患リストに矛盾がある（麻疹が記載されていないが記事に明示）が、複数の深刻な疾患の同時発生が確認される。ケーララ州での複数地区での流行継続、死亡例の報告、短期間での患者数急増が特に注視すべき点。

article.articleHeadline: Cupa Mondială 2026: După îngrijorări legate de Ebola, echipa RD Congo a primit permisiunea de a intra în Statele Unite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA World Cup 2026: After Ebola-related concerns, the DR Congo team has been granted permission to enter the United States.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s World Cup 2026 squad, the Leopards, were granted entry to the United States after Ebola-related concerns. U.S. authorities required a 21-day quarantine before entry; the party landed in Houston from Paris at about 14:30 local time (19:30 GMT) and left the airport an hour later without issues, according to West Ham’s Aaron Wan-Bissaka. Wan-Bissaka told AFP that everyone passed and no one was refused entry. The team had just lost 2-1 to Chile in Orléans, France, in a closed-doors warm-up ahead of the tournament. In the World Cup, DR Congo are drawn in Group K with Colombia, Portugal and Uzbekistan.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年FIFAワールドカップ：エボラに関する懸念の後、DRコンゴチームが米国への入国を許可された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病に関する懸念は提示されているが、本記事は2026年FIFAワールドカップの準備段階における入国手続きの報道であり、実際の感染症の発生、症例確認、または公衆衛生上の危機を示していない。DRコンゴ代表チームは検査を通過し、問題なく入国している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）の参加に関するスクリーニング報道であり、感染症の発生やアウトブレイクの通知ではない。DRコンゴでのエボラの実際の流行に関する情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Η αποστολή του Κονγκό έλαβε άδεια εισόδου στις ΗΠΑ παρά τις ανησυχίες για τον Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo mission was granted entry into the United States despite concerns about Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo’s national football team, the Leopards, received approval to enter the United States to compete in the 2026 FIFA World Cup despite earlier concerns over Ebola virus disease. U.S. authorities had mandated a 21-day isolation period before entry. The squad, traveling from Paris, landed in Houston around 14:30 local time on 11 June 2026. About an hour later, players exited the airport without incident, according to right-back Aaron Wan-Bissaka speaking to AFP. The event, confirmed on 11 June 2026, highlights the health-safety considerations surrounding international sports teams amid Ebola fears, even as the team proceeds with World Cup preparations from the United States.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ懸念があるなか、コンゴ代表団は米国への入国許可を取得
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の実際の感染例や患者発生は記事に記述されておらず、コンゴ国立フットボールチームの入国許可に関する行政上の判断についての報道である。感染症の流行・アウトブレイク事象ではなく、スポーツイベント関連のニュース。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の患者発生やアウトブレイクではなく、国際スポーツイベント（2026 FIFAワールドカップ）参加のためのコンゴ代表チーム入国許可に関する行政措置についての報道。エボラへの懸念は背景情報として言及されているのみで、実際の感染症イベント（患者、感染、流行）の発生を示す情報は含まれていない。したがってシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: A cracked coffin, a funeral and the hunt for Ebola's patient zero
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, authorities pursue Ebola's patient zero as the body of a 44-year-old Congolese pastor is loaded into the back of an aging Nissan SUV in Bunia. The coffin is strapped in while relatives perch atop the casket, and a roughly three-hour journey to Mongbwalu unfolds along broken dirt roads under February heat. The scene anchors the article’s central focus on the hunt for Ebola’s patient zero and the fieldwork that accompanies the outbreak response in eastern Congo. Set against Ituri’s towns and rough terrain, the account highlights logistical challenges, timing, and the human dimension of tracing infection sources as officials work to map potential transmission paths.

triage.headline_ja: 割れた棺、葬儀、そしてエボラウイルスの感染源患者ゼロを追う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクすべてを有する既知の重大感染症である。DRCでの流行は継続的な関心対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の発生地はDRC（Ituri州）と記事サマリーに明記されている。Patient Zeroの追跡という疫学的調査の段階にあり、感染源特定と伝播経路マッピングが進行中。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC (203312) を列挙。高い感染性、重症度、国際的拡大リスクから PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ấn Độ ghi nhận ca nhiễm virus Nipah tại Kerala
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India records Nipah virus infection case in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus infection confirmed in a 43-year-old male in Kozhikode district, Kerala, India, on June 11; patient is receiving care in ICU at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital. Authorities identified 77 contacts: 58 healthcare workers, 14 relatives, 5 colleagues/friends; risk stratification: 2 very high, 13 high, 62 low. All high/very high–risk contacts have been isolated; no symptoms among them to date. Local authorities mapped patient movement, implemented containment, community surveillance, and opened a control room at the District Health Office to inform residents. PPE, gloves, masks, and prophylactic medications have been prepared. Health Minister K.
