Muraleedharan said the patient had previously visited the outpatient department and underwent MRI and echocardiography before confirmation, and stressed that Kozhikode healthcare facilities are prepared and urged the public not to panic.

triage.headline_ja: インド、ケーラ州でニパウイルス感染者を確認
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは重篤な人獣共通感染症であり、確認された症例は重度の懸念対象。IHR基準において異常性・重症度が明確で、国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRA対象と判断。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高い致死率（40-75%）を持つ注視すべき病原体。患者はICU入院中で重篤。77名の接触者が特定され、リスク層別化も実施されており、初期対応は適切。しかし医療施設内での曝露（58名の医療従事者）と地域への拡大リスクが存在。継続監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Biodata Evan Marvino Diduga KDRT dan Selingkuhi Istri, Tularkan Penyakit Seksual
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Biodata of Evan Marvino: Alleged domestic violence and infidelity toward his wife, spreading sexually transmitted diseases.
article.articleSummary: Indonesian actor Evan Marvino, real name Ivan Sigit Pratama, is accused of domestic violence (KDRT) against his wife Uffridatun Nitami and of infidelity with alleged transmission of a sexually transmitted disease to a woman named Tami. Tami disclosed the allegations in Instagram posts, describing a traumatic night and sharing a photo of a fan she says was used in the abuse. No official response from Evan has been issued, and his Instagram account reportedly became inaccessible. The couple reportedly married in 2021 after a viral romance that began when Tami, a longtime fan since 2015, sent him direct messages. Evan has been rising in Indonesian television with the soap Beri Cinta Waktu. The report appears on POSBELITUNG.CO, citing Tribun Style.

triage.headline_ja: エヴァン・マルヴィーノの経歴：家庭内暴力と不倫の疑い、性感染症の感染の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 本件はインドネシアの著名人による個人的な家庭内暴力・不倫疑惑の報道であり、感染症の公衆衛生学的な集団発生イベントではない。感染症学的なリスク評価の対象とならない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の集団発生を報道するものではなく、インドネシアの芸能人による個人的なスキャンダル（家庭内暴力、不倫）についての報道である。疾患分類が「Unknown Illness」となっているが、本文では具体的な感染症の流行や医学的な懸念事項は記述されていない。感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo spreads to three new eastern health zones
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has spread to three additional eastern health zones in North Kivu and Ituri, according to a government report dated 2026-06-12. As of Wednesday, June 10, confirmed infections reached 676, with 136 deaths. The three new zones are in provinces already at the outbreak’s center, underscoring ongoing transmission in eastern DR Congo. The government warns that the outbreak poses a serious cross-border risk to neighboring Uganda and Rwanda. In DR Congo, a health zone is a defined area served by clinics and a referral hospital, illustrating how surveillance and response are organized around local administrative boundaries as the outbreak expands.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が東部3つの新たな保健地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。確認患者676名、死亡136名の深刻な状況であり、国際的な国境越え拡大リスク（ウガンダ、ルワンダ）が政府により警告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部（North KivuおよびIturi州）での流行拡大を主題としており、ウガンダとルワンダへの国境越え拡大リスクが言及されているが、現時点での確認患者・死亡者はいずれもDRCに限定されている。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。引き続き隣国での症例発生の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 47 عاما.. وفاة ابنة ملك تايلاند بعد إصابتها بعدوى في جلسة مع كلاب
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 47-year-old daughter of Thailand's king dies after contracting an infection during a session with dogs.
article.articleSummary: Princess Bajrakitiyabha Mahidol, the eldest daughter of Thailand’s King Maha Vajiralongkorn, dies at 47 after an intestinal infection and a prolonged battle with infection. The Royal Palace said her condition deteriorated, and she passed away peacefully on Thursday. She had been hospitalized since December 2022 following a sudden illness during a training session with the royal Thai Army’s dogs. In August 2025, officials announced she was battling a severe bloodstream infection (sepsis) and depended on life support for lung and kidney function. Her body will lie in state at the Grand Palace in Bangkok, with funeral rites to be conducted with the highest royal honors, in keeping with royal traditions.

triage.headline_ja: タイ国王の娘（47歳）が犬との訓練中に感染した感染症で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 個人の死亡事例であり、新規の感染症集団発生を示唆するシグナルではない。病原体特定もなく公衆衛生上の継続リスク情報が不在。
triage.notes: 本事例は既知の個人（王族）の死亡事例であり、新規の感染症シグナルではない。犬との接触後の感染は記載されているが、病原体が特定されておらず、集団発生または継続的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆する証拠がない。社会的関心は高いが、感染症危機管理上のシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo weitet sich aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread, now affecting three additional health zones. Total confirmed cases have risen to 676, with 136 deaths, as of Thursday evening local time. The newly affected areas lie in North Kivu and Ituri provinces, with health zones serving roughly 100,000–150,000 people each. The three-province epicenter comprises Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and involves the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. The outbreak was announced on May 15 and has been hard to control due to mistrust of health workers and attacks on burial teams and treatment centers. The DRC has experienced several devastating Ebola outbreaks, including the second-deadliest globally from 2018 to 2020, with more than 2,200 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の多地域への拡大、相応の死亡数、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱(Bundibugyo strain)の現在の流行は確認症例676件、死亡136件で、South Kivu、North Kivu、Ituri州の3州に拡大。5月15日に公表された以降、保健労働者への不信感や埋葬チーム・治療センターへの攻撃により制御困難。DRCは過去の甚大なエボラ流行(2018-2020年で2,200人以上死亡)の経験あり。

article.articleHeadline: केरल में निपाह वायरस की दस्तक, जानें यह कैसे फैलता है और कितना खतरनाक?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus makes its presence felt in Kerala; learn how it spreads and how dangerous it is.
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India reports a new Nipah virus case in Kozhikode: a 45-year-old man confirmed, currently treated at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital. Authorities identified 77 contacts—14 family members, 5 friends/colleagues, and 58 healthcare workers—with 15 classified as high-risk; none have shown Nipah symptoms so far. Nipah is a bat-borne virus; fruit bats are the natural host. Transmission occurs via bat saliva, urine, or contaminated fruit; consumption of raw date palm sap touched by bats; contact with infected animals (notably pigs); and exposure to the body fluids of an infected person. Incubation is 4-14 days; early symptoms resemble a viral illness (fever, headache, myalgia, weakness, cough, sore throat, breathing difficulty); severe cases can cause brain inflammation. WHO notes case fatality can be 40-75%. First emerged in 1999 in Malaysia and Singapore; Kerala remains on heightened surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でニパーウイルスが出現、感染方法と危険性を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスの確定症例が報告され、高い致死率（40～75%）を持つ人獣共通感染症である。接触者追跡が進行中で、国際的な感染拡大リスク（マレーシア、シンガポール等での過去の発生歴）および公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を呈する。
triage.notes: ニパーウイルスは致死率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染が可能な危険な病原体である。記事で言及されているマレーシアとシンガポールは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めていない。インドのケーラ州での確定症例が主題。接触者77名が特定され、疫学的調査が進行中で監視体制が整備されている。

article.articleHeadline: Φόβος εξάπλωσης του Έμπολα στην Ευρώπη: Συστάσεις για αναβολή έξι εβδομάδων στην αιμοδοσία για όσους επισκέπτονται περιοχές με κρούσματα - Τι λέει το ECDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of Ebola spreading in Europe: Recommendations for a six-week postponement of blood donation for those visiting areas with Ebola cases — What the ECDC says.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) issued new guidance on the safety of blood, tissues, cells and human organs amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Individuals returning from areas with documented community transmission should be temporarily deferred from blood donation or donation of cells, tissues, and organs for at least six weeks after arrival in the European Union (EU). The precaution aligns with Ebola’s maximum incubation period of up to 21 days, providing an additional safety buffer. A similar precaution is advised for plasma donations. The recommendations aim to minimize transmission risk while safeguarding the blood supply in EU health systems.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパへのエボラ出血熱拡大への懸念：コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの発生地域を訪問した者への6週間の献血延期勧告 — ECDCの見解
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスクが明確であり、IHR基準3つ以上該当。ECDC（ヨーロッパの公的保健機関）が正式な血液安全ガイダンスを発行しており、国際的な公衆衛生対応が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: 記事ではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ出血熱発生を言及しているが、本トリアージ対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。ECDCの正式ガイダンス発行により、国際的対応が既に開始されている点が重要。WPRO基準が4つ該当し、公的保健機関による認識も確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 15 millions d'euros suffiraient pour finaliser ses recherches : la biotech lyonnaise Fabentech développe un traitement contre plusieurs souches du virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 15 million euros would be sufficient to finalize its research: the Lyon-based biotech Fabentech is developing a treatment against several strains of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: During the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, the Bundibugyo strain drives transmission. As of June 6, 2026, WHO reports 93 deaths among 534 laboratory-confirmed cases and 17 recoveries. Fabentech, a Lyon-based biotech and Sanofi Pasteur spin-off, claims a broad-spectrum Ebola treatment capable of neutralizing multiple strains, including Bundibugyo. The company estimates 15 million euros would complete clinical development within 24 months, a venture hampered a decade ago by funding shortages. The project, Ebola Prep-T Box (EU-funded), has shown in vitro activity against Bundibugyo and five other strains via a polyclonal antibody platform, enabling multi-target neutralization. Fabentech emphasizes cost-effectiveness and use as a frontline measure to contain initial clusters and protect health workers, with production of thousands of doses potentially costing about 30 million euros. Vaccines exist but are less effective against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 1500万ユーロで研究完了が可能：リヨン発バイオテック企業Fabentechがエボラウイルスの複数株に対する治療法を開発中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、Bundibugyo株による93死亡534確定症例が報告されており、IHR基準の公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性を満たす。また、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度（死亡例多数）と流行可能性が該当し、国際支援の必要性も示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク対応であり、Lyonはフランスの治療開発地点のみ。対象国リストに基づきDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。534確定症例、93死亡という深刻な数字とBundibugyo株という懸念される亜種の存在が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Breaking | Keralam | Shigella | சிறுவர்களை குறிவைக்கும் 'ஷிகெல்லா' | கேரளம் முழுவதும் கோரத்தாண்டவம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking | Kerala | Shigella | 'Shigella' targeting children | Uproar across Kerala
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Kerala, India, reports Shigella infection spread with seven more confirmed cases, including seven school students in the state. Over the past six months, Shigella has caused two fatalities in Kerala. The article notes a broader public-health context with rising fever and malaria cases across the state. These Shigella infections are described as laboratory-confirmed, but the report provides no details on transmission routes, infection sources, or whether cases are imported or exported. Public-health authorities are monitoring the outbreak, with emphasis on protecting children and maintaining vigilance in schools. The information highlights the need for continued surveillance to gauge the outbreak’s reach within Kerala and to guide targeted interventions.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州でシゲラ集団感染 - 子どもたちを標的に、州全体で警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ感染症の確認例が増加（7例追加）し、過去6ヶ月間に2人の死亡が報告されており、重症度基準とWPRO異常基準に該当。学校での感染拡大の可能性と子どもへの集中的な影響が社会的・政治的関心を喚起している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの疾患名フィールドは『Malaria』とされているが、記事サマリーおよび見出しは明らかにShigella（シゲラ）感染症を主題としている。これはデータ品質の不整合である。シゲラ感染症は細菌感染症で、特に学校環境での糞口感染が懸念される。伝播経路、感染源の詳細が記載されていないため、疫学調査の深掘りが必要。タイムスタンプは2026年となっているが、これは未来日付であるため記事更新日時の誤記の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: UN appeals for $15m to support Uganda's Ebola response
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, UN and partners appeal for $15.8 million to support Uganda's Ebola response through August, with $3.1 million mobilised and a $12.7 million funding gap. UNICEF, IOM and UNHCR support risk communication, border screening, surveillance, and refugee services; WFP has transported 33 metric tons of relief to Bunia, DRC. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus, visiting Uganda, reaffirmed commitment and urged maintaining cross-border ties amid the outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak epicenter is Ituri Province, eastern Congo, where Africa CDC reports 515 of 544 confirmed cases. Uganda has 19 confirmed cases, most among people who entered Uganda from Congo. The funding appeal covers the national response through August.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ出血熱対応を支援するため、国連が1,500万ドルの拠出を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）はPHEIC宣言済みで、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにおける国際的なヒト-ヒト感染の事例がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州が主要な発生地域で515例）とウガンダでのエボラ発生を述べている。しかし評価対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみが含まれているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。エボラは PHELIC 宣言済みで、人道支援の強化が進行中。WFPによるブニア（DRC）への物資輸送実績あり。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Faces Dual Health Scare: Nipah Alert and Shigella Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports a dual health threat: Nipah virus in Kozhikode with a 43-year-old man confirmed positive and in critical care on ventilator support; 77 contacts identified (58 healthcare workers, 14 family), with high-risk individuals quarantined and no symptoms among contacts so far. Concurrent Shigellosis outbreak in Wayanad has nine confirmed cases, linked to local schools; to curb spread, authorities have declared holidays in three panchayats and the Sulthan Bathery municipality. Preventive actions include boiling or chlorinating drinking water and widespread food safety inspections. NIV Pune is coordinating rapid testing with local labs; Health Minister K. Muraleedharan says monitoring is ongoing hour-by-hour and advises hand hygiene and avoidance of crowds. Officials emphasize reliance on official updates. As of 12 June 2026, authorities pursue containment through contact tracing, isolation, school closures, and water safety to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州が直面する二重の健康危機：ニパウイルス警報とシゲラ菌感染症アウトブレイク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。ニパウイルスは致死率が高い新興感染症で、同時に腸管感染症アウトブレイクが並行発生している。インドの重要な地域での確認例があり、接触者追跡と隔離対応が進行中。
triage.notes: ニパウイルス（Nipah）は高い致死率（40-75%）を持つ新興ウイルス性感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染が可能。コジコード（ケーラ州）での確認事例と77名の接触者特定は、早期検出・対応の重要な段階。同時にシゲラ菌感染症アウトブレイク（9確認例、学校関連）が並行発生。学校閉鎖、飲料水管理強化など複数の感染症対策が同時実行中。NIV Pune による検査調整が進行中で、州保健大臣による直接的な対応表明あり。アウトブレイク初期段階だが、二重感染症危機の状況にあり、継続的モニタリングが必須。

article.articleHeadline: 隔離措置経て、Ｗ杯コンゴ民主共和国代表が米に入国...エボラ出血熱の流行で米政府が隔離義務付け | ヨミドクター(読売新聞)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following quarantine measures, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's World Cup squad enters the United States... The U.S. government imposes quarantine requirements due to the Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak prompts the United States to impose a 21-day pre-entry quarantine for the Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team ahead of the World Cup North/Central American event. The squad arrived in Houston, Texas on June 11, 2026, after canceling their domestic camp and training in Belgium. A planned June 9 warm-up against Chile in Spain was canceled due to outbreak concerns, replaced by a behind-closed-doors match in France. U.S. authorities, with Secretary of State Rubio, stated that entry by infected persons would not be allowed. The DR Congo team will open their group-stage campaign on June 17 against Portugal (Japan time June 18). The outbreak has prompted travel restrictions and disrupted pre-tournament preparations for teams from affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 隔離措置経て、Ｗ杯コンゴ民主共和国代表が米に入国...エボラ出血熱の流行で米政府が隔離義務付け
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で発生し、国際的な移動制限・隔離措置が実施されている。IHR基準において異常性（予想外の流行）、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限が複数該当し、また社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行により米国が隔離措置を実施したケースを報じている。Bluedot APIが多数の国を検出しているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国での流行イベント。米国・日本・フランス・チリ・ポルトガル・スペイン・ベルギーは流行の二次的影響国として言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないか、または影響国であり発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala On Alert As Critical Nipah Case Emerges; 77 Contacts Being Monitored, 2 In Highest-Risk Category
article.articleSummary: Nipah case in Kerala's Kozhikode remains critical, with a 43-year-old patient on ventilator support in an isolation ward. The Health Department released a route map of the patient's movements between May 30 and June 10 to aid contact tracing. A total of 77 contacts have been identified: 58 healthcare workers, 14 family members, and 5 friends or colleagues. None of the contacts has reported symptoms so far. Risk categories include 2 highest-risk, 13 high-risk, and 62 low-risk; all those in the highest- and high-risk groups have been quarantined. As of 12 June 2026, monitoring continues for potential secondary transmission, underscoring Kerala's alert status and ongoing contact-tracing efforts in response to this Nipah case.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州が警戒態勢に：ニパウイルス重症患者が発生、77人の接触者を監視中、2人が最高リスク分類
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは重篤で感染力の高い病原体であり、本事例は人工呼吸器を要する重症患者である。IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスク・重症度が複数該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさが該当する。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは致死率が高く（40～75%）、ヒト・ヒト感染が可能な第1種感染症である。現在1例の重症患者が確認されており、77人の接触者（医療従事者58人含む）が監視下にある。二次感染の可能性が懸念される。ケーラ州は過去数年間に複数のニパウイルスアウトブレイクを経験しており、地域的なスクリーニング能力が確立されている点は利点である。

article.articleHeadline: केरल में निपाह और शिगेला के मामले; हाई अलर्ट पर स्वास्थ्य विभाग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah and Shigella cases in Kerala; Health Department on High Alert.
article.articleSummary: Kerala faces Nipah virus risk with a new suspected case in the state and a Shigella outbreak in Wayanad district, prompting high-level public health alert as of 12 June 2026. Shigella infections among children in Wayanad have risen to nine confirmed cases, with 47 people hospitalized and 502 pupils at Koliyadi School showing symptoms. In response, three panchayats and the Sultan Bathery municipality schools have been closed to curb spread; parents are advised to avoid crowded places until the situation improves. A Nipah suspect case has been reported in Kerala; the central government has activated SOPs, monitoring, and cross-agency support. Suspected Nipah cases and contacts have been sent to NIV Pune for emergency laboratory testing; results will inform virus source and transmission risk. Authorities reassure the public to remain vigilant without panic.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でニパーウイルスとシゲラ菌の症例；保健部門が高度な警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルス（高致死率、ヒト-ヒト感染可能）の疑い例と同時にシゲラ菌アウトブレイク（学童552人が症状）が報告され、IHR基準3項目該当（重症度、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。インドの対象国であり、中央政府が対応プロトコルを発動した。
triage.notes: ニパーウイルスは高い致死率（40-75%）を持つ人獣共通感染症であり、アウトブレイク初期段階での報告。シゲラ菌アウトブレイクは学校での群発感染（552人中症状）を示しており、複合的な公衆衛生上の脅威。NIV Pune での検査結果が感染源・感染様式の特定に重要。

article.articleHeadline: केरल में निपाह और शिगेला के मामले; हाई अलर्ट पर स्वास्थ्य विभाग - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah and Shigella cases in Kerala; Health Department on high alert.
article.articleSummary: Kerala faces dual health threats on 12 June 2026: Nipah virus risk and a Shigella outbreak in Wayanad. A new Nipah suspect has been reported; Central and state authorities are closely monitoring, with samples from contacts sent on an emergency basis to the National Institute of Virology, Pune, for confirmation. Official results pending; emphasis on strict Nipah SOPs and ongoing technical support from the center. Separately, Shigella infections in Wayanad have reached nine confirmed cases; 502 students at Koliyadi School showed symptoms, and 47 remain hospitalised. To curb spread, holidays have been declared in three panchayats and in the Sultan Bathery Municipality area schools. Authorities are conducting field surveillance and awareness campaigns; residents are urged not to panic and to follow health department guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でのニパウイルスとシゲラ症の症例; 保健部門が高度な警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは致死率の高い新興ウイルス感染症で、ケーラ州での新規患者報告と同時にシゲラ集団発生が発生。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の懸念がある。中央・州当局が積極的に対応中であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは致死率40-75%の重篤な人獣共通感染症であり、ケーラ州での患者確認は重大。同時にシゲラ集団発生（9例確認、502名が症状呈示）が報告されており、複合的な感染症危機として対応が必要。NIVプネへのサンプル送付、厳格なSOP実施、学校休校措置など対応が進んでいるが、確認結果待機中。

article.articleHeadline: ЕБОЛАТА И НАТАМУ СЕ ШИРИ, досега починаа повеќе од 120 лица
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Continues to Spread; More Than 120 People Have Died So Far.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 635 confirmed cases and 127 deaths, with Uganda reporting 19 cases and 2 deaths. Africa CDC notes the epidemic has spilled over into Uganda. A major challenge is weak contact tracing: in Ituri province, fewer than 5,000 contacts have been identified from an estimated 24,000, and only 57% of identified contacts have been located. Many confirmed cases remain not isolated in treatment centers, raising concerns of uncontrolled community transmission. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warned that without effective control of infected individuals and their contacts, the outbreak could spread unchecked. The report underscores cross-border transmission risks and the need for intensified surveillance, rapid isolation, and rigorous contact-tracing to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは引き続き蔓延、これまでに120人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（635確定例、127死亡）、異常で予想外（ウガンダへの越境拡大）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明白であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの症例報告も言及しているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCにおけるエボラの活発な蔓延、接触者追跡の失敗（24,000人中5,000人未満）、隔離されていない確定例による市中感染の高リスク等が報告されており、早急なRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: കോഴിക്കോട് നിപ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ച 43കാരന്റെ ആരോഗ്യനില ഗുരുതരമായി തുടരുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kozhikode Nipah-confirmed 43-year-old's health condition remains critical.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus infection confirmed in a 43-year-old resident of Ramanattukara, Kozhikode, with diagnosis from Kozhikode Medical College Virology Laboratory. The health department released travel history for May 30–June 10. Fifteen people in the highest-risk category have been placed in home quarantine as authorities bolster cluster tracing and surveillance. The patient’s contact list totals 77, comprising 58 health-care workers, 14 family members, and 5 friends or colleagues; none have shown symptoms to date. Among contacts, 2 are highest-risk, 13 high-risk, and 62 low-risk; all highest- and high-risk individuals are quarantined. A district medical office control room is established for precautionary measures. Public contact lines: 0495 2373 901, 9072007767.

triage.headline_ja: コジコード地方でニパー確認された43歳男性の健康状態が引き続き深刻である
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスは高い致死率を持つ既知の病原体であり、確定患者と77名の接触者が確認された。インドのケーララ州での発生はIHR基準2つ以上に該当し、国際的な関心と対応が必要。
triage.notes: ニパーウイルスは過去に南アジアで複数の流行を引き起こしており、致死率25-75%の高リスク病原体。患者の容態が深刻で、77名の接触者（内58名は医療従事者）が追跡中。当局は積極的なクラスター追跡と監視体制を整備している。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: la 17e épidémie d'Ebola loin d'être maîtrisée, avertit le Centre africain de contrôle des maladies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the 17th Ebola outbreak far from being under control, warns the African Centre for Disease Control.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports the 17th Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, eastern DRC, four weeks after declaration; as of 12 June 2026, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths. The outbreak has expanded from three health zones to 27, with zones doubling within a week. Contact tracing remains the major challenge: in dense mining areas a confirmed case can generate more than 20,000 contacts; only 4,955 have been identified. Obstacles include community mistrust, population movement, insecurity, and limited resources in remote zones, hindering follow-up. The latest affected zone is Tchomia, 50 km south of Bunia on Lake Albert. Uganda says the outbreak is under control. WHO has declared an international health emergency. Ebola spreads by close contact and bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）：第17次エボラ出血熱の流行は制御下にあるとは言い難い、とアフリカ疾病管理センターが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: BluedotAPIが誤って Lake Albert(オーストラリア) や State of New South Wales を発生地域として指定しているが、記事の主題は DRC の Ituri 州 における第17次エボラ流行である。同州内の Bunia、Tchomia など複数の地区で感染が確認されている。4週間で 676 確定患者、136 死亡。流行規模が急速に拡大（3保健区から27保健区へ、1週間で倍増）。接触者追跡が深刻な課題。採掘地域での高い感染リスク。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Virus Outbreak: कोरोना ते निपाह... धोकादायक विषाणू सर्वात आधी केरळमध्येच का आढळतात? जाणून घ्या कारण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala Virus Outbreak: From Corona to Nipah... Why are dangerous viruses detected first in Kerala? Find out the reason.
article.articleSummary: Kerala frequently records the first cases of new and dangerous infectious diseases in India, including COVID-19 (coronavirus), Nipah virus, Monkeypox, and Shigella. As of 12 June 2026, the article notes that when a novel outbreak emerges in the country, its earliest documentation often appears in Kerala. It asks why the state repeatedly serves as the initial reporting location for such outbreaks, framing the question rather than offering concrete explanations. The piece emphasizes this pattern without detailing specific outbreaks, epidemiological data, or transmission sources. It underscores curiosity about potential factors behind Kerala’s early detection of emerging pathogens, inviting further inquiry rather than presenting established conclusions.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州ウイルス感染症アウトブレイク：コロナからニパウイルスまで...なぜ危険なウイルスはケーラ州で最初に検出されるのか？その理由を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な病原体（Nipah、COVID-19、Mpox）が列挙されており、ケーラ州における早期検出パターンの考察記事だが、具体的な現在進行中のアウトブレイク情報、患者数、重症度データが明記されていない。情報不足のため継続観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のアウトブレイク事例（COVID-19、Nipah、Mpox）を参照しながらケーラ州における早期検出パターンについての分析・考察記事である。具体的な現在進行中の患者発生、死亡者数、感染経路などの疫学的詳細は記載されていない。Nipahウイルスなど高リスク病原体への言及はあるが、現在の発生状況の具体的な情報が欠落している。続報での具体的なアウトブレイク情報の有無に注視すること。

article.articleHeadline: Еболата се шири во Конго: Епидемијата зафати уште три здравствени зони
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo: the outbreak has hit three more health zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread, with three more health zones affected, bringing total confirmed cases to 676 and 136 deaths as of Wednesday, June 10, 2026. New hotspots are in North Kivu and Ituri provinces, areas already facing healthcare delivery challenges. In DRC, a health zone is an administrative/medical unit comprising clinics and a referral hospital serving 100,000–150,000 people; the country operates more than 500 health zones. Authorities maintain intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and measures to limit transmission, while international health organizations monitor the situation. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals or contaminated objects; timely detection and isolation of cases are crucial to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大：流行が3つの保健地域にさらに拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行は、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。確認済み676例、死亡136例、3つの新たな保健地域への拡大は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致命率を持つ疾患であり、DRCにおける676例・136死亡という規模、および複数の新たな保健地域への急速な拡大は、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示唆する。IturiはDRCの実在する州であり、記事サマリーで具体的に言及されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: केरल में निपाह और शिगेला के मामले; हाई अलर्ट पर स्वास्थ्य विभाग | Cases of Nipah, Shigella in Kerala; health machinery on high alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Nipah and Shigella in Kerala; Health Department on high alert.
article.articleSummary: Kerala faces two infectious disease threats: Nipah virus risk with a new suspected case in the state, prompting central authorities to monitor closely and dispatch samples from suspected Nipah patients and contacts to NIV Pune for emergency testing to confirm the infection source. Officials say the situation is under control and fear is unnecessary as SOPs are being enforced. Separately, Shigella outbreaks continue in Wayanad, Kerala, now with 9 confirmed cases; Kolliyadi School has 502 students who developed symptoms and 47 people are hospitalized. To curb transmission, three panchayats and Sultan Bathery Municipality schools have been closed; parents are advised to limit children’s presence in crowds. Health authorities have intensified surveillance, outreach, and testing, with further confirmatory results expected today and ongoing coordination with the central Health Ministry for technical support and expertise.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でニパウイルスとシゲラの患者が発生；保健部門が高度警戒態勢へ
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは致死性の高い新興感染症であり、新規患者の報告と中央当局による監視体制の強化は異常かつ重大な公衆衛生イベントに該当。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「重症度（致死的病原体）」に該当し、スクリーニング基準も複数合致するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは過去に東南アジアで複数の流行を引き起こした高リスク病原体（致死率40-75%）。新規患者発見と中央当局による緊急検査体制、NIV Puneへの検体送付は、インドの感染症早期警戒システムが機能していることを示す。併せてShigella集団発症も報告されており、複合的な感染症危機の様相。国際的拡大リスクは現段階では直接記述されていないが、ニパウイルスの国境越え伝播の可能性は周辺地域への警戒を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Hingga Mei 2026, Temuan TBC di Sumsel Naik Mencapai 6.699 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As of May 2026, TB cases detected in South Sumatra rose to 6,699.
article.articleSummary: As of end-May 2026, Tuberculosis (TB) cases in South Sumatra reached 6,699 across 17 regencies/cities, with Palembang City reporting the highest burden at 2,111 cases (2,073 drug-susceptible TB and 38 drug-resistant TB). SITB data through May 27, 2026 show 6,574 drug-susceptible TB and 125 drug-resistant TB province-wide. The province saw a notable rise since March 2026 (3,148 cases), though Palembang’s burden is estimated to exceed 9,000. Treatment coverage in Palembang is about 73% (roughly 6,000 patients). Officials warn of rising TB trends in Palembang, Lubuklinggau, and Prabumulih, and prioritize intensified screening of household contacts to cut transmission, alongside ensuring patients complete and adhere to TB treatment regimens.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年5月末時点で南スマトラ州の結核発見数が6,699件に増加
triage.triage_reason: 結核は周知の風土病であり、単一国内の地域別統計報告である。IHR基準該当なし、異常性・重症度が明確でなく、国際拡大リスクも低い。ただし薬剤耐性結核を含み管理可能性に懸念があるため経過観察を推奨。
triage.notes: インドネシア（南スマトラ州）における結核の地域統計報告。薬剤耐性結核（125例）を含むが、全体として既知の風土病の通常的監視データと判断。政府による対策（接触者スクリーニング、治療アドヒアランス確保）が進行中。国際的な異常性・緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 嬰幼兒染百日咳可致呼吸暫停 亞太及本港專家聯署籲全城打針防反彈 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infants and young children infected with pertussis can experience respiratory arrest; Asia-Pacific and Hong Kong experts sign a joint statement urging the city to get vaccinated to prevent a rebound.
article.articleSummary: Pertussis outbreaks are intensifying globally, with last year’s cases nearly five times those of the year before, and Asia-Pacific and Hong Kong facing outbreaks. In infants, Bordetella pertussis can cause apnea, brain hypoxia, and pneumonia, with a protracted, months-long course. Adolescents and adults often present atypically, serving as reservoirs that spread to vulnerable newborns and the elderly. WHO data show global pertussis incidence climbing from under 9 to about 137 per million last year, a rebound linked to waning vaccine protection after COVID-19 and vaccine hesitancy. A joint statement by the Asian Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases, Asia-Pacific Pediatric Society, the Hong Kong Medical Association, and lawmakers urges core protections: maternal vaccination during mid-to-late pregnancy to pass fetal antibodies; adherence to infant/child vaccination schedules, including boosters; and adult boosters for high-risk groups (asthma, COPD, elderly) to curb transmission. Residents are urged to seek guidance and vaccinate; education will be intensified.

triage.headline_ja: 乳幼児の百日咳感染は呼吸停止をもたらす可能性があり、アジア太平洋および香港の専門家が連盟で都市全体へのワクチン接種を呼びかけ反発を防ぐ
triage.triage_reason: 百日咳の世界的な大流行が進行中であり、過去1年で前年の5倍近い症例が報告されている。IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」が該当し、香港・中国を含むアジア太平洋地域での集団発生として公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 香港の記事であるが、地域的には China に含める。記事は百日咳の世界的流行とアジア太平洋地域（特に香港・中国）での集団発生を主題としており、専門家団体による緊急の公開声明がなされている。乳幼児への重症化リスク（呼吸停止、脳低酸素症）が強調されており、ワクチン保護の減弱とワクチン躊躇が背景にある。WHO認定の再興感染症として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Seven more Shigella cases confirmed in Kerala's Wayanad
article.articleSummary: Shigella infections in Kerala's Wayanad district rose with seven more schoolchildren testing positive, bringing the total in that cohort to 16. The bacterial diarrheal illness spreads via contaminated food or water and person-to-person contact. Health officials note 34 Shigellosis cases in Kerala for June so far, with new cases reported in Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam and Kozhikode. As of June 11, 578 people were symptomatic and 55 admitted to hospitals in the state. In Wayanad, well water at a major institution was found contaminated, prompting school closures and a holiday for all schools and educational institutions in the affected area until June 14. DMO Dr K T Rekha said surveillance and preventive measures have been strengthened; all 16 children are in satisfactory condition. Minister K Muraleedharan advised vigilance and not to self-medicate; symptomatic individuals should seek care, and public hygiene remain crucial.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州ワヤナド地区でシゲラ症の症例が7例追加確認
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ症の多数事例発生（34例以上、578名が症状あり）、学校閉鎖等の公衆衛生対応が実施され、人口への曝露リスク継続。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当、政府・公衆の関心高い。
triage.notes: ケーラ州ワヤナド地区での学校集団感染が主体。汚染された井戸水が感染源として特定され、学校閉鎖等の対応が実施中。55名が入院し、複数地区での症例報告あり。6月11日現在578名が症状を呈する状況は監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Xác định được vi khuẩn gây ngộ độc thực phẩm tập thể ở Đồng Tháp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacteria identified as the cause of a mass food poisoning outbreak in Đồng Tháp.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Đồng Tháp authorities report Salmonella spp. caused a mass food-poisoning outbreak linked to Nam Nguyên Foods meals served at Kim Đồng Primary School in Sa Đéc Ward. 81 of 525 meal recipients on 18 May were poisoned; 70 hospitalised; no deaths. 18/30 patient specimens tested positive for Salmonella; some samples had Escherichia coli and Bacillus cereus. Cross-contamination during processing, storage, or serving is suspected. Earlier, from 24 February to 7 March, 86 people contracted food poisoning from bánh mì thịt produced by Hồng Ngọc 12 bakery in Hồng Ngự Ward; bakery fined 90 million VND and halted operations for four months.

triage.headline_ja: ドン・タップ州での集団食中毒の原因となった細菌を特定
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数の食中毒アウトブレイク（サルモネラ、大腸菌、セレウス菌）が確認され、81名が罹患し70名が入院。異常性・重症度・長期曝露リスク（食品製造工程の衛生問題）が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではベトナム（ドン・タップ州）で複数の食中毒事例が報告されている。2026年6月12日現在の事例では小学校給食（5月18日）でサルモネラ属菌による81名の罹患と70名の入院が確認。また2月24日〜3月7日の別事例では86名が罹患。交差汚染の可能性が指摘されており、食品製造・供給ルートの衛生管理に構造的問題がある可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Потврдена ебола во уште три здравствени зони на ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed in three more health zones in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has spread to three additional health zones in the Democratic Republic of Congo, according to a government report. The total number of confirmed Ebola cases rose to 676, with 136 deaths, as of Wednesday, June 10, 2026. The figures were released by the health minister via X (formerly Twitter). The three newly affected health zones are in North Kivu and Ituri provinces. In the DRC, a health zone is a defined territory with a network of clinics and a referral hospital, serving roughly 100,000–150,000 residents; the country has more than 500 health zones. The report provides national totals and does not detail infection sources, specific symptoms, or whether cases are imported or exported. No vaccination data is mentioned in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でさらに3つの保健ゾーンでエボラ出血熱が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する既知の一類感染症。DRC国内での拡大報告は対応が必要。
triage.notes: 6月10日時点で確認症例676例、死亡136例。北キブ州およびイトゥリ州の新たに3つの保健ゾーンに拡大。エボラウイルス病はWHO懸念される感染症であり、IHR（2005）Annex2に完全に該当する公衆衛生上の緊急事態。DRCの保健機関により正式に報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala battles twin disease threat as Nipah alert coincides with Shigella outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kerala's Wayanad district faces a dual infectious disease threat as health authorities respond to a suspected Nipah virus case while contending with a Shigella outbreak. The Nipah case remains unconfirmed; samples from suspected patients and contacts have been sent to NIV Pune for emergency testing, with the Centre directing strict Nipah prevention guidelines and ongoing coordination with the Kerala government. Separately, Shigella has nine confirmed cases, with 502 Koliyadi School students seeking care and 47 patients hospitalized across multiple hospitals. Holidays have been declared for educational institutions in three panchayats and Sulthan Bathery municipality to curb spread. Union Health Ministry is monitoring developments and awaiting test results to determine extent and source. Public advisories urge vigilance and avoidance of unverified information.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州がニパールウイルスアラートとシゲラアウトブレイクの同時発生により二重の疾病脅威に直面
triage.triage_reason: ニパールウイルスは致死性が高く国際的に重要な病原体であり、複数州での疑い事例・複合アウトブレイク（シゲラ同時発生）、未確認ながら高い警戒態勢と中央政府の対応が認められ、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ニパールウイルスは確定事例ではなく疑い事例だが、NIV Poonaでの緊急検査送付、中央政府による厳密な予防ガイドライン指示、複数州（ケーラ州、マハラシュトラ州）での警戒態勢が確認されている。同時にシゲラアウトブレイクが進行中（9確定例、502名が受診、47名入院）。教育機関の休校措置が取られており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。情報不足ではなく、高いリスク指標が複数該当するため PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: UN and partners appeal for $15.8 million to support Uganda's Ebola response
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola driving a regional outbreak prompts a UN appeal for $15.8 million to fund Uganda's response through August. Uganda has 19 confirmed Ebola cases, most among cross-border travelers; in Congo, Ituri Province remains the epicenter with 515 of 544 confirmed cases. The WHO has declared this Bundibugyo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. International partners mobilize: UNICEF, IOM, and UNHCR assist with risk communication, border screening, surveillance, and refugee-settlement health services; WFP has transported 33 metric tons of relief to Bunia, DRC. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus urged Uganda not to close its border with the DRC. The UN notes a $12.7 million funding gap despite $3.1 million mobilized. Next steps include donor reviews, expanded border screening, and policy considerations on border management and regional trade.

triage.headline_ja: 国連及びパートナー機関、ウガンダのエボラ対応を支援するため1,580万ドルの拠出を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の地域的流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO公式にPHEIC宣言済み、複数国への国際的な拡大リスク、国際支援の動員が進行中。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri Province, Bunia）とウガンダの越境流行を記述。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCのみ該当。WHO PHEICは2024年8月17日に公式宣言済みの既知事象だが、本記事は2026年6月12日時点での資金動員と対応状況の進行中レポートのため、アクティブな対応状況追跡イベントとしてPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Rendkívüli lépés jöhet: a hadsereget is bevethetik, minden vaddisznót kilőnek a fertőzött térségben
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An extraordinary step could be taken: the army could also be deployed, and every wild boar in the infected area will be shot.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak in Hungary, centered in Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg, involving a farm that triggered the slaughter of the local wild boar population within a 10-km radius. The virus, likely spread by local wild boars, is highly aggressive and currently has no cure. Authorities may deploy the army if hunter groups fail to cull quickly. The aim is to eliminate direct outbreak effects and halt spread within two months. The outbreak risks disappearing exports to Korea, Vietnam, and Serbia, threatening thousands of tons of processed or in-transit pork and about 9,000 pigs weekly slated for export. Domestic measures include boosting local consumption and public procurement of Hungarian meat, with 60% of meat in public catering currently imported. Increasing domestic meat share and consumer support are urged to help absorb surplus meat during this crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 異例の措置が迫る：軍も投入できる、感染地域のすべての野生イノシシが銃撃される
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）の国際的な流行リスク、複数国への輸出制限の可能性、農業経済への深刻な影響がIHR基準を満たす。ハンガリーおよびベトナムの対象国を含む。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域リストにはハンガリー、セルビア、韓国も含まれているが、これらは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。ベトナムは記事サマリーに明示的に記載されており、ASF流行による輸出リスク国として特定されている。本イベントは動物疾患（豚）であるが、国際的な農畜産物流通への影響と経済的インパクトが大きく、公衆衛生上の関心を呼ぶ可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Uganda's movement restrictions cripple cross-border trade
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC has killed 127 people with 635 confirmed cases; the toll may be higher due to deaths outside facilities. The epicenter started in Ituri and has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, reaching Uganda where 19 infections and two deaths are reported as of 2026-06-12. To contain spread, Uganda and DRC imposed border restrictions since May, including 21-day isolation for travellers from DRC, health screening, disinfection, and cargo checks. Essential goods may cross without quarantine but under strict health measures. At Bwera–Mpondwe, border queues up to two kilometres delay perishable cargo (plantains, tomatoes, fish), harming livelihoods; bilateral trade exceeded $1 billion in 2024/25. Nearly 900 Congolese living with HIV receive treatment at Arua Regional Referral Hospital, risking disruption. WHO notes no pandemic threat but regional risk; IOM calls for coordinated cross-border mobility systems.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：ウガンダの移動制限が国境を越える貿易を麻痺させる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、渡航制限実施）、WPRO基準複数該当。DRC発のエボラ流行がウガンダに越境し、両国が国境制限を実施中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラが東部DRCから発生し、Ituri→North Kivu→South Kivu経由でウガンダに越境。DRC側635確定例127死亡、ウガンダ側19感染2死亡（記事日時：2026-06-12）。両国が5月以降国境制限（21日隔離、健康診断等）を実施中。HIV治療中の約900人のコンゴ人（Arua地域）への治療中断リスクも言及。貿易への経済的悪影響も記事の主要テーマ。

article.articleHeadline: Món ăn bán trú nhiễm 3 vi khuẩn khiến 81 học sinh ngộ độc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The school lunch contaminated with three bacteria caused 81 students to suffer food poisoning.
article.articleSummary: 81 students and teachers at Kim Đồng Primary School in Dong Thap Province, Vietnam, fell ill with suspected food poisoning after a school lunch on May 18. Laboratory results linked the outbreak to Escherichia coli in four dishes, with Bacillus cereus detected in white rice and canh cải ngọt nấu tép; the following day’s meals also contained pathogens, including E. coli in additional items and Bacillus cereus. Salmonella was detected in 18 of 30 patient samples and in some meal items; the soy milk beverage on May 19 was contaminated, while fresh milk showed no bacteria. The Nam Nguyên Foods Co., Ltd., supplier from Tan Nhuận Đông commune, is under investigation. A discrepancy between the school menu and actual dishes was found, complicating sampling. Health authorities will pursue action against the supplier; all 81 cases have recovered and been discharged.

triage.headline_ja: 学校の給食が3つの細菌に汚染され、81人の学生が食中毒に罹患
triage.triage_reason: 複数の病原体（E. coli、Salmonella、Bacillus cereus）による大規模食中毒アウトブレイク（81名）であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行性）に複数該当するが、既に全患者が回復・退院しており、国際的拡大リスクは限定的。情報追加を注視する必要があるため、WAT状態での継続観察が適切。
triage.notes: 食中毒事例であり、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」および「深刻な公衆衛生影響」には該当しないが、複数の病原体による大規模集団発症（81名）はWPRO基準の異常性・重症度・流行性で識別される。全患者が既に回復している点が重要。給食納入業者の調査進行中。記事言語がベトナム語であり、現地での社会的・政治的関心が高い可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 'If Ebola comes, we'll be wiped out': fear grips camps in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo centers on Ituri province, with Bunia’s Kingonze camp housing over 25,000 displaced people living in tarpaulin and tents. Transmission is via close contact, and crowded camps heighten the risk of rapid spread as millions are displaced in the DRC’s east. Ituri contains nearly a million displaced amid ongoing conflict, complicating outbreak response and control measures. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that eastern DRC faces a catastrophic collision of disease and conflict, hampering containment efforts. The article notes no laboratory-confirmed case counts or specified symptoms are provided. Published June 12, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラが来たら、我々は一掃される」：コンゴ民主共和国のキャンプで恐怖が広がる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。WHO事務局長による警告と大規模キャンプでの高いまん延リスクが存在。
triage.notes: Ituri州のBunia（キングオンゼキャンプ）を中心とした発生。2万5000人以上の避難民がいる過密キャンプでのまん延リスクが極めて高い。WHO事務局長による「疾病と紛争の大惨事的衝突」の警告。ただし研究室確認症例数や具体的な症状記述がないため、情報面では限定的。情報更新を要経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Nipah Case Reported in Kozhikode; Kerala on High Alert - The PrimeTime News
article.articleSummary: Suspected Nipah virus case in Kozhikode, Kerala; patient in critical condition. Health Department intensifies surveillance and containment, deploying special medical teams and directing hospitals to stay on high alert. Extensive contact tracing underway for family members, healthcare workers, and other close contacts. Samples collected and sent for laboratory testing; authorities awaiting confirmation of infection. Public urged to cooperate and avoid panic. Nipah, known for high fatality, has caused outbreaks in Kerala in the past; officials stress early detection, isolation, and effective contact tracing to prevent community transmission. The situation remains under close observation as investigations continue, with results expected soon.

triage.headline_ja: Kozhikodeで疑い例のニパウイルス症例が報告され、ケーララ州が厳戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス感染症は高い死亡率を持つ重症感染症であり、国内の疑い症例報告は異常かつ予想外。保健当局が強化された監視と封じ込め対策を展開していることから、IHR基準2項目以上を満たし、フルRRA進行に値する。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはZoonotic pathogenであり高い死亡率（40-100%）を特徴とする。ケーララ州は過去にもアウトブレイクの経験を持つ。現段階で疑い例であるが、検査結果待機中。保健当局の積極的な対応（特別医療チーム配置、広範な接触者追跡、病院の警戒態勢）から深刻度が高い。国内検出事例として国内公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: 主子注意！細菌塵蟎高峰期～獸醫認可#寵物家庭專用消毒神器滅10大貓狗病原‡！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Attention, pet parents! Peak season for bacteria and dust mites—veterinarians approve a home-use disinfection device that eliminates the top 10 feline and canine pathogens!
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong-based Dettol unveils a plant-based all-function home disinfectant for pets, addressing summer-driven bacterial and dust-mite exposure. The product kills 99.99% of Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus and targets 10 common feline and canine pathogens, including feline calicivirus, feline panleukopenia virus, and canine distemper virus. It provides seven days of antimicrobial protection and helps with odor and mite control. Formulated from plant extracts, it excludes four harsh chemicals—PCMX, chlorine, bleach, and pyrethrins—and is US veterinarian-approved. Cautionary notes: do not apply directly to animals or their bowls; avoid aerosolizing; let surfaces dry before pets re-enter. Marketed to Hong Kong pet owners through retailers such as PNS Online, Wellcome online, HKTVmall, Pandamart, and Long Fung online store.

triage.headline_ja: 主子注意！細菌塵蟎高峰期～獸醫認可#寵物家庭專用消毒神器滅10大貓狗病原‡！
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペット用消毒製品の販促記事であり、E. coli等の実際の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。公衆衛生上の新規感染症イベント、異常症例の報告、または流行の兆候を含まない。
triage.notes: 本記事は香港を舞台としたペット用消毒製品の商品紹介・広告記事である。記事サマリーから、既存のE. coliやS. aureusなどの病原体に対する消毒製品の効果説明であり、感染症の実際の発生、症例報告、または疾病の流行を述べたものではない。そのため、感染症イベントとしてのシグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。Bluedot APIが「E. coli」と「Hong Kong」を検出していても、公衆衛生上の危機を示唆する内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: As World Cup boosts infection risk, Toronto and Vancouver aren't sitting on the sidelines
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak risk accompanies FIFA World Cup host cities Toronto and Vancouver and Mexico, with more than 6.5 million fans expected during the 39-day event. Public health uses wastewater surveillance and social media monitoring to detect infections, focusing on norovirus, measles, and mpox alongside respiratory viruses. Wastewater can flag measles 5–7 days before emergency visits; vaccination before travel is urged. Measles cases are nearing 2,000 in the U.S. this year, with resurgence in parts of Mexico and Canada, including Alberta and Manitoba. Mpox remains a local concern in Toronto, with guidance on vaccination and safer-sex practices. Ebola Bundibugyo has caused an outbreak in eastern DRC, with 500+ confirmed cases and 100 deaths; WHO declared a PHEIC. Canada has border measures; Ebola is excluded from wastewater testing due to very low risk. Monitoring also uses electronic health records and social media; a food vendor portal aims to curb foodborne illness.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップが感染リスクを高める中、トロントとバンクーバーは対策に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク疾患（麻疹、エボラ、MPX、ノロウイルス）が同時に報告され、IHR基準の2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。DRCのエボラ・ブンディブギョでPHEIC宣言、大規模国際イベント（ワールドカップ）での感染拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: カナダ（トロント、バンクーバー）およびメキシコでのワールドカップに関連した麻疹・MPX・ノロウイルス報告は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのエボラ・ブンディブギョ（500+確認症例、100死亡、PHEIC宣言）は対象国に含まれるため検証済み地域に列挙。複数の呼吸器疾患と腸管感染症が大規模国際イベントと組み合わさることで、高いシグナル強度を示す。

article.articleHeadline: افزایش موارد ابتلا به ابولا در جمهوری دموکراتیک کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths. The surge is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The latest situation report, published yesterday, records 41 new confirmed cases and 9 deaths on Wednesday in Ituri and North Kivu provinces. In total, 29 health zones across three provinces are affected. Official assessments show week-to-week increases, signaling ongoing community transmission. A Xinhua-published update warned that, without prompt public health measures, there is a risk of rapid geographic spread. These findings underscore the need for intensified surveillance and a robust public health response to curb further expansion."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ患者数の増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。大規模かつ急速に拡大するエボラアウトブレイク（676確認例、136死亡、複数州で継続的な市中感染）であり、国際的拡大リスクが明示的に警告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、アウトブレイク発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリおよび北キブ州で確認。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による急速な感染拡大と、公開された情報源（新華社）による地理的拡大警告が記載されており、高リスク評価に値する。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: 宁波男子在农家乐吹了一晚空调后，高烧不退、剧烈干咳，重度呼吸衰竭进了ICU！最终确诊嗜肺军团菌肺炎，医生提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ningbo man develops Legionella pneumophila pneumonia after spending a night at a rural guesthouse with air conditioning, with persistent high fever and severe dry cough, progressing to severe respiratory failure requiring ICU; doctors warn.
article.articleSummary: Ningbo, China: A man developed Legionella pneumophila pneumonia after spending a night at a rural guesthouse with air conditioning. He had persistent high fever and a dry cough, progressing to severe respiratory failure, requiring ICU care. Oxygen saturation stayed around 70% despite ventilation. ECMO was initiated to provide extracorporeal oxygenation. The Li Hui Li Hospital Precision Medicine Center conducted broad pathogen testing among 5,000-plus agents and identified Legionella pneumophila as the cause. Targeted antibiotics followed; after 6 days on ECMO, it was removed, and he was extubated and transferred to a general ward. Doctors warn that Legionella pneumonia is a summer/fall high-incidence illness, often linked to poorly cleaned air conditioning. Preventive measures include regular AC cleaning, ventilation every few hours, and flushing stagnant water in showers and storage heaters. No vaccine exists.

triage.headline_ja: 宁波男子在农家乐吹了一晚空调后，高烧不退、剧烈干咳，重度呼吸衰竭进了ICU！最终确诊嗜肺军团菌肺炎，医生提醒
triage.triage_reason: 単一の重症例報告であり、IHR基準は2つ以上該当していない。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と異常性で該当するが、流行拡大の兆候や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりが不明であり、情報不足のため経過観察判定が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域はZhejiang Sheng（浙江省）とNingbo（寧波市）と特定されており、いずれも中国領域。記事は単一症例の重症化事例を報じており、集団発生や流行拡大の証拠はない。医師による予防啓発が含まれるが、これは個別事例を受けた医学的助言であり、制度的な感染症危機を示唆していない。Legionella pneumophilaは環境由来病原体であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: World Cup surveillance for infections ramps up in host cities
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks, heat events and food-borne illnesses are health hazards at the FIFA World Cup in Toronto, Vancouver, and U.S. and Mexican host cities; officials will mine wastewater and social media to mitigate spread. The 39-day tournament began in Mexico; matches will be played Friday in Toronto and Saturday in Vancouver, with more than 6.5 million visitors expected. Surveillance targets norovirus, measles and mpox in wastewater, alongside existing testing for COVID, influenza and RSV. Wastewater signals measles 5–7 days before emergency department presentation, enabling pre-travel vaccination messaging. Measles cases are nearing a U.S. record (~2,000) with outbreaks in Alberta and Manitoba; mpox remains ongoing in Toronto. Norovirus could appear in wastewater, prompting hygiene reminders. Separately, WHO declared Bundibugyo Ebola in the DRC a public-health emergency; Canada has border screening, and Ebola is excluded from wastewater testing.

triage.headline_ja: ホスト都市での感染症サーベイランスがワールドカップで拡大
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の米国記録的な流行（約2,000件）、複数国での多疾患サーベイランス、650万人以上の来場者による国際的な感染拡大リスク、およびDRCでのEbola公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはカナダ、米国、メキシコが含まれているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCはEbola公衆衛生上の緊急事態の発生地として記事サマリーで言及されており、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。多疾患統時流行（measles, mpox, norovirus, COVID-19, influenza, RSV）および大規模国際イベント時の複数国への感染拡大リスク、そして DRC での Ebola 宣言が組み合わさった複合的な感染症危機として評価。

article.articleHeadline: Health Minister: Rwanda Remains Ebola-Free as Outbreak Slows in Region - KT PRESS
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-12, Rwanda remains Ebola-free amid a regional Ebola-Bundibugyo outbreak declared May 15, with cases in eastern DRC and Uganda. Health Minister Dr. Sabin Nsanzimana said Rwanda maintains heightened surveillance and preparedness to prevent cross-border transmission. Uganda has had periods without new cases; DRC’s Goma and Bukavu near Rwanda's border report declines, but transmission continues in eastern DRC farther from borders. No Ebola cases in Rwanda; authorities emphasize prevention over response. Border controls include automated fever screening at Kigali International Airport and a 21-day follow-up for Rwandan citizens returning from high-risk zones. Strengthened lab capacity helps rapidly distinguish Ebola from malaria. Rwanda calls for regional cooperation with WHO and Africa CDC to contain outbreaks and reassure investors and travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣：ルワンダはエボラ出血熱の感染をしていない、地域での発生は減速中 - KT PRESS
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。地域レベルでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク継続中であり、隣国ルワンダの国境での脅威が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは東部DRCおよびウガンダで発生中。ルワンダは現在感染者なしだが、国境監視と準備態勢を強化している状況。対象国はDRCのみに限定（ウガンダは評価対象外）。地域的なエボラ拡大リスク、マラリアとの鑑別診断強化、国境コントロールの実施など、複数の感染症危機管理要素が含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Pascaserangan Anjing Diduga Rabies, Dinas Peternakan Aceh Vaksinasi 266 Hewan di Aceh Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog Attack Suspected Rabies: Aceh Department of Animal Husbandry Vaccinates 266 Animals in Central Aceh.
article.articleSummary: On 11 June 2026 in Kebayakan District, Aceh Tengah Regency, vaccination efforts were conducted by the Aceh Department of Animal Husbandry and the Aceh Tengah Regency Department of Agriculture after eight residents in Silih Nara Subdistrict were injured by dogs suspected of rabies. A rabies vaccination and awareness campaign was carried out in Timbangan Gading Village and Mandale Village, vaccinating 266 animals (260 dogs, 6 cats). The event was led by Safridhal, head of the Aceh Department of Animal Husbandry, with Ruhaty, Veterinary Health official, and included Rina Safrina from the Aceh Health Department’s Zoonosis Program. Participants received education on rabies transmission, bite treatment, and the importance of regular pet vaccination. Rabies is a zoonotic virus that attacks the central nervous system; transmission is mainly via bites from infected animals, and once symptoms appear, fatality is near 100%.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の疑いで犬に襲われた後、アチェ州畜産局が中部アチェで266頭の動物にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）での狂犬病関連イベントで、8人が負傷し266頭の動物にワクチン接種が実施された。ただし、確定診断がなく人間への死亡報告も記載されていないため、現時点では情報不足のWATCH判定とする。
triage.notes: 疾患は狂犬病（致死率ほぼ100%）で、人間への感染リスクがある。8人の被咬傷者がいるが、確認された患者数や死亡数の記載がない。地方当局による迅速な対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が実施されており、管理可能性は高い。続報で人間の患者確認や死亡報告があれば、PICKUPへの昇格を検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: केरल में निपाह और शिगेला के बढ़ाते मामले पर हाई कोर्ट सख्त | High Court strict on increasing cases of Nipah and Shigella in Kerala
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High Court strict on rising Nipah and Shigella cases in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports Nipah virus risk with one new suspected case; central government and the National Institute of Virology, Pune, are monitoring the situation, with samples from suspected patients and contacts sent to NIV Pune for testing; officials say results will clarify virus source and seriousness, and strict SOPs are being enforced to prevent spread. Separately, a Shigella outbreak in Wayanad district intensifies, with 9 confirmed cases and 502 children at Koliyadi School showing symptoms; 47 patients are hospitalized. To contain transmission, three panchayats and Sultan Bathery Municipality schools have been closed, and parents are advised to keep children away from crowded places until the situation improves. Health teams are conducting ground-level surveillance and awareness campaigns while authorities review containment measures and coordinate with the central ministry.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でのニパーウイルスとシゲラの増加する症例に対して高等裁判所が厳しい態度
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスは重症度が高く国際的な懸念を招く病原体であり、複数州での複数患者報告、中央政府とNIVによる監視、学校閉鎖を含む公衆衛生対応が実施されている。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、重症度、国際的拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: ニパーウイルスは高い致死率（40-75%）を持つエマージングウイルスであり、国際的に重要な公衆衛生上の脅威。記事ではケララ州とマハラシュトラ州での症例、NIVプネでの検査、学校閉鎖などの対応が記述されている。シゲラ集団発生も同時に報告されており、地域の感染症管理に対する負荷が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ấn Độ ghi nhận một ca nhiễm virus Nipah tại Kerala
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India records a Nipah virus infection case in Kerala.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus infection reported in Kozhikode district, Kerala, India. A 43-year-old male patient is confirmed with Nipah virus and hospitalized in the intensive care unit of Kozhikode Medical College Hospital. As of 11 June 2026, authorities traced 77 contacts, including 58 healthcare workers, 14 relatives, and 5 colleagues; 2 contacts are very high risk, 13 high risk, and 62 low risk. All high- and very high-risk contacts have been quarantined; none have developed symptoms yet. Local health authorities mapped patient movements, activated containment measures, and opened a district health office control room to provide information; PPE, gloves, masks, and prophylactic supplies prepared. Nipah is a zoonotic virus associated with fruit bats; human-to-human transmission can occur with close contact. There is no approved vaccine; treatment is supportive with limited monoclonal antibodies. Officials urge calm and adherence to public health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: インド、ケーラ州でニパーウイルス感染1例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスは高致死率の危険病原体であり、異常・予想外の発生。人間と動物の両者に影響を及ぼし、ヒト・ヒト感染の可能性があるため、IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。即座にフルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: ニパーウイルスは致死率40～75%の高リスク病原体。現在1例の確認患者、77名の接触者追跡中で、高リスク・超高リスク接触者は全員隔離実施済み。未承認ワクチン、限定的治療選択肢。ジューン2026年発生との記載あり。ケーラ州は過去にニパー発生経歴のある地域。ヒト・ヒト感染リスク、動物由来リスク、国際的懸念の全てが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon In Kerala And The Rise Of Infectious Diseases: Doctors Explain Shigella, Nipah And West Nile Cases
article.articleSummary: Monsoon in Kerala heightens infectious-disease concerns. Shigella infections surge in Kerala, including Wayanad school-linked outbreaks; Shigella, a highly contagious gut bacterium transmitted via contaminated food or water, causes diarrhea and blood in stools; the infectious dose is very low and bloody diarrhea requires urgent medical evaluation. In Kozhikode, Nipah outbreaks leave one patient in critical condition and 76 others affected; Nipah is a bat-borne zoonosis that can spread to humans and, with close contact, between people; early symptoms mimic other viral illnesses but can progress to breathing difficulties or brain complications. West Nile fever is reported in Ernakulam; mosquito-borne, most infections are asymptomatic, but when symptomatic include fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, and rash; fewer than 1% progress to severe neurological disease. Monsoon conditions—water contamination, flooding and mosquito breeding—heighten these risks; awareness and timely care are essential.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州のモンスーンと感染症の増加：医師がシゲラ菌、ニパウイルス、ウェストナイルウイルス症例について説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。ニパウイルスの重症度（1名が重篤、76名が感染）とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が懸念される。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはヒト-ヒト感染が可能であり、濃厚接触による伝播リスクがある。シゲラ菌とウェストナイルウイルスも同時に報告されており、モンスーン期の多因子感染症流行が形成されている。Kerala州Kozhikode地区での発生が主焦点。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค เผยยอดป่วยโควิดในไทย 5.1 พันคน เสียชีวิตคงที่ 1 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control reports 5,100 COVID-19 cases in Thailand, with deaths unchanged at 1.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Thailand: As of June 6, 2026, the Department of Disease Control reports 5,180 cumulative COVID-19 cases since January 1, 2026, with 1 death (case fatality rate 0.02%) and an incidence of 8.15 per 100,000 population. This year’s figures are lower than 2025 (614,601 cases, 275 deaths; CFR 0.04%) and 2024 (777,730 cases, 222 deaths; CFR 0.03%). The Director of the Bureau of Epidemiology notes the infection pace is slower, with no identified cluster outbreaks so far, and overall severity remains low. Public health guidance emphasizes reducing exposure in crowded places, wearing masks, and maintaining hand hygiene with soap or alcohol-based sanitizers.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省疾病管理局がタイ国内のCOVID-19患者数5,100人を報告、死亡者数は1人のまま変わらず
triage.triage_reason: 2026年1月以降の累積症例5,180件、死亡1件という低い水準であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスク・異常性いずれも示されていない。定期的な疾病サーベイランス報告であり、シグナル特性に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的な疾病統計報告である。症例数・死亡数ともに前年比で低下傾向、感染速度も鈍化、クラスター未検出、重症度も低い。公衆衛生上の脅威を示す指標がなく、ルーチン監視情報。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／高雄出現登革熱「醫院群聚」7旬女2次住院確診 相鄰病室4人也陽性
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: Dengue fever hospital cluster in Kaohsiung; a woman in her 70s diagnosed after two hospitalizations, four people in adjacent rooms also tested positive.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever hospital cluster detected in Kaohsiung, Taiwan (Sanmin District). Index case is a woman in her 70s with chronic illness, hospitalized May 29, discharged June 10, readmitted June 11 with fever and dizziness; dengue fever serotype 2 confirmed. Four additional dengue-positive cases in adjacent rooms formed the cluster. Taiwan’s CDC Mobilization Epidemic Prevention Team deployed to Kaohsiung to support tracing, expand testing, vector surveillance, and breeding-source elimination; residents urged to monitor health, clinicians to report promptly, and travelers to disclose travel histories. As of June 12, 2026, Taiwan has 74 confirmed dengue cases: 6 locally transmitted (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported from Southeast/South Asia (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9; others from Southeast/South Asia). Global totals reached about 1.02 million by April 2026, with rising cases in Vietnam, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, and Timor-Leste. Preventive guidance emphasizes DEET, Picaridin, IR3535; seek care for fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias, or rash; NS1 testing used.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：高雄でデング熱の「病院クラスター」発生 70代女性が2度の入院後に確診、隣接した病室の4人も陽性
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄での院内デング熱クラスターは異常性・予想外性が高く、IHR基準（深刻性、異常性）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）し、地域的関心と国際的背景から、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はTaiwan高雄の院内クラスターイベントだが、対象国リストにはTaiwanが含まれないため、verified_locationsはサマリーで言及されている対象国（インドネシア、ベトナム等）のみに限定。グローバル流行背景とAsian regionでの広がりが示されており、国際的な関心が高い。院内クラスターは予防・制御上の重大な懸念。
