article.articleHeadline: 7旬女住院治病卻染疫 高雄某醫院爆「登革熱群聚」感染5人中鏢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seventy-year-old woman hospitalized for treatment contracts dengue fever; a dengue fever cluster erupts at a Kaohsiung hospital, infecting five people.
article.articleSummary: Seventy-year-old woman from Kaohsiung’s Sanmin District was hospitalized in late May, discharged June 10, and readmitted June 11 with fever and dizziness, diagnosed as dengue fever type 2. Because household members were asymptomatic, Kaohsiung health authorities expanded epidemiologic investigation and found four additional dengue-positive patients in an adjacent ward, forming a cluster. Contact tracing and planned expanded testing aim to identify more cases. Investigators found Aedes breeding in rooftop drainage ducts and floor depressions in the hospital area, prompting a 15,000 TWD fine. By June 12, Taiwan reported 74 dengue cases this year: 6 locally (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported from Southeast and South Asia (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9, others). The year-to-date total mirrors 2025 (78) and remains well below 2024 (271). Globally, dengue surpassed 1 million cases by April, with the Americas most affected and rising cases in Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Laos, Cambodia, Maldives, and Timor-Leste.

triage.headline_ja: 70代女性が入院中にデング熱に感染；高雄の病院でデング熱クラスター発生、5人が感染
triage.triage_reason: 医療機関内でのデング熱クラスター発生（5例）という異常イベントであり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ）に該当。台湾は対象国ではないが、記事サマリーでベトナムを含む複数の対象国での継続的なデング熱拡大が報告されており、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 台湾（Kaohsiung）での医療機関内クラスターが主題だが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに加えない。ただし、記事サマリーでベトナム（9例輸入）とインドネシア（21例輸入）でのデング熱拡大が明示されているため、これらを対象国として列挙。グローバルデング熱の世界的流行（100万例超）と複数対象国での継続的なリスク上昇が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Foot in mouth disease at the Agriculture Ministry | Politicsweb
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in South Africa remains center of controversy around Agriculture Minister John Steenhuisen's leadership. The piece recounts a private email by Jana le Roux, Steenhuisen's chief of staff, mocking a conciliatory outreach from FMD Response SA and a department push to align vaccination strategy with the disease biology. FMD Response SA urged tighter, near-simultaneous national interventions and broader vaccine access to the private sector to accelerate containment. The article argues the department's piecemeal campaign contrasts with Brazil and Argentina's coordinated approaches, and highlights the burden on farmers and poor black communities whose small herds form family wealth. Steenhuisen's public response deflected blame and excluded certain agricultural groups, underscoring a tense culture within the Department of Agriculture. The piece frames this as a symptom of political culture affecting FMD management in South Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省における口蹄疫問題（口蹄疫と農業省指導部の論争）
triage.triage_reason: 南アフリカにおける口蹄疫の発生は確認されるが、記事の主眼は政治的・管理的対立であり、疫学的な公衆衛生上の深刻性や国際的拡大リスクについての具体的情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はブラジル・アルゼンチン両国の対応策への言及を含むが、実際の発生事例の詳細が記載されているのは南アフリカのみである。南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。口蹄疫は家畜病として公衆衛生上の懸念があるが、本記事は政治的対立・管理体制の問題に焦点が当てられており、疫学的重篤性の客観的データが提示されていない。スクリーニング基準では長期曝露と流行しやすさで該当するが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当がなく、かつ社会的関心の詳細が不明であるため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : MSF intensifie la surveillance épidémiologique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF intensifies epidemiological surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts MSF to intensify epidemiological surveillance and contact tracing in affected zones, announced June 11 in Kinshasa. MSF warns persistent insecurity hampers field deployment in Mungwalu. The national response is led by the Ministry of Health through the Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP), with support from international partners including the World Health Organization. Ituri province remains the epicenter, housing the majority of cases to date; confirmed patients receive care under strict protocols before returning to their communities. The Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak; response also covers North Kivu and South Kivu as MSF tightens surveillance. This is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak; the government declared it on May 17, with the first case identified on April 24, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: RDCでのエボラ：MSFが疫学的監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。確認済みアウトブレイク、複数州への広がり、国際支援の実施。フルRRA推奨。
triage.notes: 2026年4月24日に初例確認、5月17日に公式宣言。Bundibugyo株によるDRC第17回目のアウトブレイク。Ituri州が震源地だが、North Kivu、South Kivu、Kinshasa市にも拡大。MSFなど国際機関による積極的な監視・対応体制が敷かれている。セキュリティ上の制約がある地域での展開課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: معهد الصحة العامة في إفريقيا: السلطات غير قادرة على تحديد المدى الحقيقي لتفشي إيبولا في الكونغو - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa Institute of Public Health: Authorities Unable to Determine the True Extent of the Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Difficulty locating all contacts hampers outbreak assessment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths were reported through June 10. The outbreak has spread to 29 health zones, up from 26, indicating geographic expansion across three additional areas. Security challenges, including rebel activity, and poor transportation hinder response, with patients fleeing overwhelmed hospitals. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned earlier in June that the outbreak remains out of control. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, underscoring international concern and the need for intensified surveillance and containment measures. The article notes ongoing challenges in tracing contacts and does not detail infection sources beyond the confirmed cases and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ公衆衛生研究所：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ発生の真の規模を特定できない当局 - シュルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響（676例、136死亡）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（PHEIC宣言済み）、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。セキュリティ上の課題（反政府勢力活動）と交通インフラの不良により、接触者追跡および対応が阻害されている。発生地域は29保健地域に拡大中で、患者が医療施設の過負荷により逃げている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Truy tìm 'bệnh nhân zero' trong dịch Ebola gây tử vong hàng loạt ở Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tracking down 'patient zero' in the Ebola outbreak that caused mass fatalities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Mongbwalu after the funeral of Pastor Paluku Makundi Denis, who died February 3 in Bunia. A coffin incident during burial and a surge of symptoms (fever, vomiting, bleeding) followed, with 48 deaths in the two weeks after burial and three close relatives dying in the ensuing weeks. WHO was alerted May 5 and the outbreak was confirmed on May 15. Since then, over 600 cases and at least 115 deaths have been reported across eastern Congo, including Mongbwalu, with investigators believing the virus may have circulated undetected for 4–6 months. Efforts are hampered by fear and distrust in the community, hindering contact tracing as authorities seek the first Ebola patient (patient zero) in Mongbwalu."} }{

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で多数の死亡者を出したエボラ出血熱の流行における「患者ゼロ」の追跡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（600例以上、115名以上の死亡）が確認されている。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項として、WHOが関与しており、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。600例以上の確認患者と115名以上の死亡が報告されており、4～6ヶ月間の未検出流行期間がある可能性が指摘されている。コミュニティでの恐怖と不信感が接触者追跡を妨げている。WHOは2026年5月5日に通知を受けて、5月15日に流行を確認。対象国はDRCのみであり、記事サマリーに基づいて検証されている。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo từ trường hợp bệnh nhi suýt tử vong, mất chân vì vi khuẩn tụ cầu vàng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning from a pediatric patient's near-fatal case that led to the loss of a leg due to Staphylococcus aureus.
article.articleSummary: An 11-year-old boy from Lai Châu, Vietnam, developed septic shock and bacteremia due to Staphylococcus aureus, progressing to fulminant osteomyelitis of the femur with multiple abscesses and risk of limb loss. Two months of persistent high fever, chills, and severe bilateral thigh pain escalated to respiratory failure requiring mechanical ventilation. MRI and ultrasound showed widespread femoral osteomyelitis with pelvic, gluteal, and thigh abscesses; a 12×15 mm subperiosteal abscess drained to the skin was identified. Blood tests demonstrated marked inflammation; culture confirmed Staphylococcus aureus sensitive to multiple antibiotics. The patient underwent over an hour of surgical debridement to remove necrotic bone and pus, followed by implantation of antibiotic-loaded cement spacers to seal bone defects. Within a week, infection was controlled; plans call for 3–6 weeks of continued treatment before bone grafting (autograft or allograft) to preserve limb function. A warning note highlights bacteremia risk with chickenpox, urging prompt medical evaluation for fever and vesicular rash.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの11歳患者の重症例：水痘に伴う黄色ブドウ球菌敗血症により脚を失う危険に直面
triage.triage_reason: 水痘に関連した黄色ブドウ球菌敗血症の重症単一症例報告。重症度は高いが散発例であり、流行規模、国際的拡大リスク、対応困難性の具体的根拠が不足。続報で複数症例または集団発生の兆候がないかを監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は水痘とそれに関連した黄色ブドウ球菌敗血症の危険性についての警告を目的としており、単一の重症症例報告である。流行性疾患ではなく散発例と考えられるため、IHR基準は『serious_impact』のみ該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では『severity』に該当。社会的関心は医療・保健分野での注視が高いと推定されるが、政府対応レベルや国際的支援必要性についての言及は記事にない。継続監視の対象として『WATCH』と判定。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄驚爆登革熱「醫院群聚」 鄰床5人齊發病！疾管署成立機動隊 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung Dengue Fever Hospital Cluster: Five Patients in Adjacent Beds Develop Symptoms Simultaneously! CDC Establishes Mobile Task Force | LIFE News
article.articleSummary: Five dengue fever cases linked to Kaohsiung Minsheng Hospital in Sanmin District, Taiwan. Index case is a 70-something woman hospitalized May 29, re-admitted June 11 with fever and dizziness; dengue type 2 confirmed. Four additional patients in adjacent rooms also tested positive for dengue type 2, totaling five in the cluster. Infection source unknown; Taiwan CDC will perform genome sequencing to assess relation to imported cases. A Mobile Epidemic-Prevention Task Force was established to support control efforts. Expanded testing of about 130 people; vector control around the ward and residents; environmental surveillance for mosquito density and larval sources; guidance for nearby residents to monitor health and for hospitals to report cases. This marks Taiwan’s first dengue hospital cluster in eight years (last in 2018 Taichung). As of June 12, 2026, 74 dengue cases: 6 locally acquired (Kaohsiung) and 68 imported from Southeast/South Asia (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9); 2026 totals near 2025's 78, below 2024's 271.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄驚爆登革熱「醫院群聚」 鄰床5人齊發病！疾管署成立機動隊
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市の病院における登革熱クラスター（5症例）は、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」（8年ぶりの病院内集団発生）と「国際的拡大リスク」（輸入症例多数）に該当し、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行性」「管理の必要性」が明確。社会的・行政的関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは台湾（高雄）が主要な発生地であり、インドネシア・モルディブ・ベトナムは輸入症例の出所国として言及されているが、これらの国での新規の感染症イベント発生は確認されていないため、verified_locationsには台湾のみ含める。病院内クラスター、感染源不明、ゲノム解析予定、8年ぶりの病院内集団発生という背景から、社会的関心及び当局の対応態勢（機動隊設置）が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le CDC américain craint 20 000 cas en trois mois si rien n'est fait
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the U.S. CDC fears 20,000 cases in three months if nothing is done.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda, driven by the Bundibugyo variant with no approved treatment or vaccine. CDC warns that without rapid containment, up to 20,000 people could be infected in three months, with about 4,000 deaths, potentially the second-largest Ebola outbreak after West Africa 2014. Experts emphasize isolation; CDC projects that isolating at least 70% of cases could keep total infections under 10,000. Latest figures: 471 confirmed cases (452 in DRC, 19 in Uganda) and 84 deaths (82 in DRC, 2 in Uganda). WHO had cautioned thousands of suspected cases, many ruled out. Funding: $518 million for an emergency plan covering coordination, surveillance, labs, infection prevention, clinical care, and community engagement. EU pledges 100 tonnes of humanitarian aid; ceasefire urged. Berlin's Charité reports Ebola survivor Dr. Peter Stafford, treated with remdesivir, virus-free since May 30.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：対策が講じられなければ3ヶ月で20,000人の感染が懸念される（米CDCの警告）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo変異株による急速な感染拡大、死亡率の高さ、有効な治療法・ワクチン未承認、3ヶ月で最大20,000人の感染予測など、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはBerlin（ドイツ）、Uganda、Angolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際の主要発生地はDRC（northeastern地域）。Ugandaでも19確認例があるが、記事の主題はDRC中心のため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみ verified_locations に列挙。Berlinに関しては治療例の報告地であり、発生地ではないため除外。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆登革熱「醫院群聚」！隔壁房5人中鏢 孳生源待釐清
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever hospital cluster erupts in Kaohsiung! Five people in the adjacent room infected; source of infection under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever hospital cluster in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, with five confirmed cases linked to a single hospital ward. The index patient is a woman in her 70s from Sanmin District, hospitalized May 29 and diagnosed June 11 with dengue fever type 2; four additional cases were found in the adjacent room, totaling five. Taiwan CDC has formed a Mobile Epidemic Prevention Team, widened epidemiological investigations, and conducted vector surveillance with breeding-source elimination around residences and activity areas. Genome sequencing is planned; more than 100 hospital samples have been tested. As of June 12, 2026, Taiwan reports 74 dengue cases this year: 6 locally transmitted (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported from Southeast/South Asia (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9). Preventive measures include wearing light-colored long sleeves and trousers outdoors, using DEET/Picaridin/IR-3535 repellents, and seeking prompt medical care if fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, or rash occur (inform travel/occupation/contact/history). NS1 rapid testing is available; last in-hospital cluster occurred in Taichung in 2018.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄でデング熱「医院クラスター」が爆発！隣の部屋の5人が感染 感染源の解明待ち
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の院内クラスター（5例）がIHR基準を満たし（異常性、国際的蔓延リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。地域内での感染拡大のリスクと管理可能性の問題がある。
triage.notes: 台湾およびモルディブはAPI発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations に含めない。しかし記事サマリーに基づき、台湾内でのクラスター発生（医院内での5例患者）は確認され、東南アジアからの輸入症例も報告されている（インドネシア21例、ベトナム9例、モルディブ14例）。verified_locations は対象国リストとの交差に基づき、実際に感染流行が報告されているインドネシアとベトナムのみ記載した。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄驚爆登革熱「醫院群聚」 鄰床5人齊發病！疾管署成立機動隊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming dengue fever cluster at Kaohsiung hospital as five patients on adjacent beds fall ill! Taiwan CDC forms a mobile task force.
article.articleSummary: Five patients across adjacent beds at Kaohsiung Min-Sheng Hospital in Sanmin District, Taiwan, comprise a dengue cluster. The index case is a woman in her 70s hospitalized for fever and dizziness; she tested dengue serotype 2 on June 11, after an earlier admission on May 29 and discharge on June 10. Four additional cases in adjacent wards were dengue-positive, all type 2, forming a nosocomial cluster with unknown source. The Taiwan CDC has formed a Mobile Prevention Task Force to bolster control efforts. Expanded testing covers about 130 people; contact tracing, vector surveillance around residences and hospital areas, and breeding-site cleanup are underway. Genomic sequencing will assess links to imported cases. Last domestic hospital cluster occurred in Taichung in 2018. By June 12, 2026, 74 dengue cases: 6 locally transmitted (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported from Southeast Asia and South Asia (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9).

triage.headline_ja: 高雄驚爆登革熱「醫院群聚」 鄰床5人齊發病！疾管署成立機動隊
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の高雄市の病院での登革熱の院内集団感染（5例）が報告され、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・重症度）に該当。公開衛生的影響も深刻で、当局による対応チーム設立など政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾の登革熱院内集団感染。Bluedot APIから返された地域情報にはTaiwan、Vietnam、Indonesia、Maldivesが含まれるが、記事サマリーの実際の内容は台湾の病院内での発生が中心であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれていない（中国の特別地域として扱われないため）。Vietnam、Indonesiaは輸入症例の由来地として言及されているが、これらの国での新規発生イベントではなく、台湾への流入事例であり、verified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Kemarau Panjang Mengintai, Penyakit dari Flu, Iritasi Mata hingga Dehidrasi Ancam Warga Bantul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Long Drought Looms, Illnesses Ranging from Influenza and Eye Irritation to Dehydration Threaten Bantul Residents
article.articleSummary: On June 12, 2026, Bantul Regency, Indonesia, faces extended dry-season health risks with predicted increases in influenza, eye irritation, dehydration, and dust- and smoke-related respiratory issues. The Bantul Health Office (Dinkes Bantul), led by Agus Tri Widiyantara, warns that dry air and higher ground dust threaten public health, especially for children and the elderly. Flu and eye irritation are linked to airborne dust, while high temperatures raise dehydration risk and water-quality decline may trigger digestive and respiratory problems. Authorities have instructed health facilities to intensify public education on dry-season risks and to promote Clean and Healthy Living (PHBS), including access to clean water, environmental hygiene, frequent handwashing, and balanced nutrition. Mask use outdoors is recommended to mitigate dust-related respiratory issues, with continued vigilance urged through the dry season.

triage.headline_ja: 長期干ばつの懸念、インフルエンザ、眼刺激から脱水症まで - バントゥル住民を脅かす疾病
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バントル県）での季節性インフルエンザ増加予測に関する報道だが、既知の季節的健康リスク（干ばつ期の典型的な疾患群）であり、異常性がなく、重症度や国際的拡大の兆候も認められない。当局による公衆衛生対応（衛生啓発、マスク推奨等）が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 季節的な干ばつ期のインフルエンザ増加は予測可能な現象であり、シグナルを示唆する異常性に欠ける。バントル県保健局は既に対策（PHBS推進、衛生啓発）を実施している。社会的・政府的関心は存在するが、その性質は日常的な季節健康リスク管理である。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's World Cup team arrives in Houston after Ebola quarantine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. US tightened entry requirements for travelers linked to affected regions. The DRC Leopards arrived in Houston on June 11-12 after a 21-day monitored quarantine in Belgium, with a connection via Paris, under a controlled 'bubble' setup. The team canceled a Kinshasa camp and a Spain-based friendly against Chile to maintain safety protocols; two European friendlies occurred. Group K opponents are Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan; opening match vs Portugal in Houston on June 17, then Colombia in Guadalajara on June 23, and Uzbekistan in Atlanta on June 27. The squad will base in Houston for the group stage. This marks a 52-year World Cup absence since Zaire in 1974, led by captain Chancel Mbemba. Supporters face travel restrictions and ticket refund issues due to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱隔離後、DRCのワールドカップチームがヒューストンに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのブンディブギョエボラ流行に関連。国際的スポーツイベントへの影響と複数国への渡航制限リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済みのブンディブギョエボラ流行がDRC東部（Ituri、South Kivu）で進行中。DRCワールドカップチームの移動は国際的な感染症リスク管理の事例として重要。記事の発生地域には米国、フランス、メキシコなど複数国が含まれているが、実際の流行地はDRC（Ituri、South Kivu）のみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bengkalis Imbau Masyarakat Waspada DBD di Kondisi Cuaca Tak Menentu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bengkalis Health Office Urges Public to Be Vigilant for Dengue Fever Amid Unsettled Weather
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) cases rise in Bengkalis Regency, Indonesia, with 349 reported from January through early June 2026. Unsettled weather—frequent rain and heat—drives Aedes mosquito breeding; prolonged heavy rain may reduce larvae by flushing them away, while hot periods with intermittent rain promote larval growth. The Bengkalis Health Office (Dinkes) urges residents to close rainwater storage containers to curb breeding. District-level totals: Bengkalis 110, Mandau 67, Bantan 43, Bathin Solapan 39, Rupat 29, Siak Kecil 21, Bukit Batu 18, Talang Mandau 8, Rupat Utara 2. The warning comes from Irawadi, head of the P2P division, noting that weather conditions are a key factor in DBD transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ベンカリス保健局、不安定な気象条件下でのデング熱警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ベンカリス県）でのデング熱症例の増加（2026年1月～6月初旬で349例）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、死亡や重症化の情報がなく、国際的拡大リスクの記述も限定的なため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱は地域内では周知の疾患であり、季節性の警戒情報と位置づけられる。記事には死亡例や重症例の記述がなく、国内の予防対策（貯水容器の蓋を閉じるよう呼びかけ）中心の内容。気象条件（不規則な降雨・高温）が蚊の繁殖に影響する環境的要因の説明あり。国際的拡大リスクについては記述がない。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Shigellosis outbreak puts Karnataka on alert
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis outbreak in Kerala has claimed a four-year-old girl’s life in Kozhikode and infected over 300 children across districts, prompting Karnataka to heighten surveillance and issue vigilance instructions to district health officials and government hospitals. The bacterial infection spreads via contaminated food and water and poor sanitation, primarily affecting the intestines. Symptoms include high fever, stomach cramps, vomiting, severe diarrhoea, blood in stools, and dehydration; early diagnosis and treatment are vital. Karnataka has intensified border-area surveillance and urged healthcare facilities to monitor suspected cases closely. Preventive measures emphasized: regular handwashing with soap, drinking boiled or purified water, avoiding stale or contaminated food, and maintaining sanitation. Officials say there is no cause for panic but stress rapid response to any detected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州のシゲロア症アウトブレイクがカルナタカ州を警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡・300人以上感染、異常性、複数州での拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準4つ該当。複数州での流行とヒト-ヒト感染の高リスク性により即応フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: シゲロア症は水系感染症であり、衛生不良環境での拡大リスクが高い。死亡報告と300人以上の感染者が確認されており、複数州（ケーラ州・カルナタカ州）への広がりが既に進行している。カルナタカ州の境界警戒強化は域内拡大への懸念を示唆。ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、小児への重症化リスク、汚染水による継続的暴露リスクがすべて高い。

article.articleHeadline: मेसमध्ये रात्री बटर चिकन अन् पनीरचा बेत, दोन तासांतच १५० हून अधिक विद्यार्थ्यांना विषबाधा! पंतनगर विद्यापीठात नेमकं काय घडलं?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butter chicken and paneer on the menu in the mess at night, more than 150 students poisoned within two hours! What exactly happened at Pantnagar University?
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar, Uttarakhand, affects over 150 students after dinner at Patel Bhavan hostel. As of 12 June 2026, a special menu featuring paneer bhaji for vegetarians and butter chicken with naan, rice, and rasmalai was served to about 185 second-year engineering residents. Within 1-2 hours, students developed vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain; most received initial care and were sent back to the hostel, while five students remain hospitalized in serious condition. Allegations persist of prior insect presence in meals and substandard ingredients from the mess contractor. A three-member inquiry committee has been formed to determine whether food quality or negligence caused the incident, with strict legal action promised for those found responsible after the report. The case underscores campus food safety concerns.

triage.headline_ja: パントナガル大学の学生食堂で食中毒発生、バターチキンとパニールの夜間食事後、2時間以内に150人以上の学生が毒性被害
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒イベントであり、影響人数が多く（150人以上）、5人が入院中と重症度が認められるが、既知の食中毒パターンで異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。情報不足のため続報を要注視。
triage.notes: 疾患名が『Unknown Illness』と記載されているが、記事サマリーから食中毒（Food poisoning）と特定される。本イベントは大学食堂での限定的な食中毒事例であり、微生物学的検査結果や原因特定に関する情報は記事中に記載されていない。5人の重症入院患者が存在し、調査委員会が設置されているが、IHR基準2つ以上に該当していないため PICKUPではなく WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreads in DRC as misinformation hampers response
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, in Ituri province, is linked to Bundibugyo strain and began 15 May. By 12 June, 676 confirmed infections and 136 deaths; 635/114 previously reported. Uganda reports 19 cases (2 deaths), mostly Congolese cross-border. The epicenter spans 27 health zones, up from 3, with access hindered by insecurity and poor roads. No approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. Misinformation hampers response, from denial to witchcraft; ActionAid estimates nearly one in three in Ituri doubt Ebola reality. Africa CDC warns outbreak not under control; over 20,000 contacts may need monitoring, but only 4,955 identified. A rapid-test centre via RadiOne in Mongwalu aims to isolate cases. Government launches social-media debunking and community engagement using local leaders and ambassadors. Recent deaths include two babies at a Bunia orphanage; Buswaza died at two weeks; Cherie died June 10; amniotic fluid/placenta detected, indicating possible birth transmission. WHO/Africa CDC launched a €445 million six-month plan.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ感染拡大、不正確な情報が対応を妨害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。死亡例や周辺国での感染確認、感染拡大リスクが高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで DRC(Ituri province, Bunia) が主要な発生地であることが明確。Uganda での症例報告もあるが、Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず。DRC のみを verified_locations に列挙。Bundibugyo エボラウイルス株、妊娠中の女性・新生児での感染報告、周辺国への越境感染、対応を妨害する大規模な不信感など、複数の深刻なリスク要因が存在。WHO/Africa CDC による €445 million 規模の対応計画が立案されており、国際的な対応枠組みが整備されている。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆登革熱「醫院群聚」！隔壁房4人中鏢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung Dengue Fever "Hospital Cluster"! Four people in the neighboring room were infected.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a hospital-linked dengue fever cluster in Kaohsiung City’s Sanmin District. The index patient, a woman in her 70s, was hospitalized May 29 and diagnosed with dengue type 2; after discharge June 10, she was readmitted June 11 with fever and dizziness. Surveillance of adjacent wards identified four more dengue-confirmed cases, for a total of five in the cluster. The CDC has formed a mobile outbreak response team; expanded testing is under way to identify potential additional infections and trace exposures. Vector control includes mosquito density surveys and breeding-source elimination around the patient’s residence and activity sites; residents are advised to self-monitor and clinicians to heighten reporting. This is Taiwan’s first in-hospital dengue cluster since 2018 Taichung. Genome sequencing will assess connections to overseas strains. Year-to-date, Taiwan records 74 dengue cases: 6 locally in Kaohsiung, 68 imported (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9).

triage.headline_ja: 高雄爆登革熱「医院群聚」！隣室4人が感染
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・高雄市での院内デング熱集団発生。異常性（院内集団感染）、重症度（確定5例）、管理課題（ベクター制御対応中）、社会的関心（医療システムへの懸念）を満たし、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たすシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はTaiwanでのデング熱院内集団発生。Taiwanは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。ただしWPRO基準5項目すべて該当し、IHR基準も2項目以上該当するため PICKUP 判定。インドネシア・モルディブ・ベトナムは輸入症例の出所国として言及されているが、それら国での発生ではなく、Taiwan内での院内伝播が主題のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 相隔8年再現登革熱醫院群聚 高雄5病患確診疾管署介入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever hospital cluster reappears after eight years; five Kaohsiung patients diagnosed, Taiwan CDC intervenes.
article.articleSummary: Five dengue fever cases diagnosed at Kaohsiung's Minsheng Hospital mark Taiwan's eight-year gap in hospital-associated clusters. All patients are inpatients, infected with dengue virus serotype 2. The index case is a woman in her 70s from Sanmin District, hospitalized for chronic disease on May 29, discharged June 10, and readmitted June 11 with fever and dizziness. Expanded testing identified four additional cases, totaling five. The Taiwan CDC has deployed a Mobile Epidemic Prevention Team to assist Kaohsiung with epidemiological investigation, expanded testing (over 137 person-times), and control measures. Virus sequencing will determine if the cluster links to imported cases. As of June 12, Taiwan reports 74 dengue cases this year: 6 locally transmitted (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported from Indonesia, the Maldives, and Vietnam. Public health measures emphasize eliminating standing water during the rainy season and prompt medical care for dengue-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 相隔8年再現登革熱醫院群聚 高雄5病患確診疾管署介入
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の院内集団発生（8年ぶり）で、IHR基準において「異常性」「国際的な拡大リスク」が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当。台湾当局が介入し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 台湾はスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。ただし記事の主要な発生地域はカオシュン（台湾）であり、インドネシア、ベトナム、モルディブはデング熱の輸入元として言及されているため、これら対象国を記載。院内集団発生が確認されたことで検査対象者137人以上という大規模な接触者追跡が実施されており、管理の観点でも重要。

article.articleHeadline: Route map of Nipah patient released; condition remains critical, 15 in home quarantine
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus infection in a 43-year-old man from Ramanattukara, Kozhikode, Kerala, remains critical and he is on a ventilator in an isolation ward. A route map for May 30–June 10 records visits to Red Crescent Hospital (June 2), Aster MIMS (June 9), and Kozhikode Medical College thereafter. Fifteen people in the highest/high‑risk categories with close contact are in home quarantine; 77 others are on the contact list. Containment zone status will depend on the emergence of symptoms among more people. The patient, a sanitation worker who cleaned an old building in Feroke, initially sought private care, was discharged, then fainted, and was taken to a de‑addiction center amid alcohol use. Health officials weigh two infection sources, prioritizing bat‑fruit exposure (eating chickoos from his home garden) over a godown link. Vigilance advised, panic not warranted.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス患者の行動ルート地図が公開；状態は重篤、15人が自宅隔離中
triage.triage_reason: インドで確認されたニパウイルス感染症。患者が重篤（人工呼吸器装着）で、複数の感染源追跡が進行中。接触者の隔離と監視が実施されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ニパウイルス感染症は高致死率ウイルスであり、インドでの確認は重要なシグナル。患者が重篤かつ人工呼吸器装着中。接触者追跡が進行中（15人の濃厚接触者が自宅隔離、77人が監視対象）。感染源の特定（コウモリ由来果実の可能性）が調査中。ニパウイルスは人間から人間への感染可能性があるため、流行拡大リスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: ผงะ สุนัขติดโรคพิษสุนัขบ้า เกิดอาการคลั่ง วิ่งไล่ขย้ำชาวบ้านเจ็บ4 น่องเหวอะ-เอ็นขาด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking: Rabid dog goes berserk, chases and mauls villagers; four injured, calves ripped and tendons torn.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand, after a stray brown male dog with rabies attacked four residents on the evening of June 10, 2026, near a garbage-dump site in Moo 9, Nong Bu Sala Subdistrict, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima. The four victims—17-year-old boy (left chest and left leg wounds), ~30-year-old woman (right-arm wound with tendon rupture), ~60-year-old woman (deep wound to the right calf), and 16-year-old girl (deep wound to the right thigh)—were treated at Maharat Nakhon Ratchasima Hospital. The stray also bit a domestic dog, which was vaccinated and observed; its head tested positive for rabies. Authorities implemented a 5-km radius ring vaccination and surveillance, immediate quarantine for exposed animals, and public awareness. Additional vaccination drives targeted areas around Hua Thale and Wat Don Khwang near Hua Thale pond. Since Jan 1, 2026, 23 animals have tested rabid; a February death of a 54-year-old man in Pho Klang District with 163 high-risk contacts, all vaccinated, is noted.

triage.headline_ja: 衝撃：狂犬病に罹患した犬が狂乱状態に陥り、村民を追いかけ襲撃；4人が負傷、仔牛が被害を受け腱が切断される
triage.triage_reason: タイで複数の人間被害を伴う狂犬病アウトブレイク（2026年1月以降23頭の感染動物、2月の死亡例1件、現在4人の新規患者）が報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）と、WPRO基準複数（重症度、長期曝露、管理可能性）に該当する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は規則的に発生する疾患であるが、本件は2026年1月以降の累計23頭の感染動物と1月当たりの死亡例を含む継続的なアウトブレイク状況、および現在4人の重症患者（腱断裂等の深刻な咬傷）を伴うため、フルRRAの対象となる。タイ当局による5km圏内ワクチン接種と監視が実施されており、管理可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆登革熱「醫院群聚」！隔壁房4人中鏢 - 生活新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung Dengue Fever Outbreak 'Hospital Cluster'! Four People Infected in the Adjacent Room - Life News - PChome Online News
article.articleSummary: Five dengue fever cases linked to a Kaohsiung hospital cluster, all due to dengue serotype 2: the index patient is a woman in her 70s from Sanmin District who was admitted May 29, diagnosed June 10, and readmitted June 11 with fever; four adjacent-room contacts tested positive during extended screening, yielding a total of five cases. Public health authorities formed a Mobile Epidemic Prevention Team, expanded testing and contact tracing, and conducted vector surveillance and breeding-source cleanup around residences and facilities. Genomic sequencing will assess links to overseas strains, and hospital infection-control investigations are planned. Nationally, as of June 12, 2026, Taiwan reports 74 dengue cases: 6 locally acquired (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported from Southeast/South Asia, including Indonesia (21), the Maldives (14), and Vietnam (9). Rainy-season conditions prompt reinforced prevention and personal protection guidance, plus prompt medical evaluation for dengue-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄でデング熱「病院クラスター」爆発！隣室の4人が感染
triage.triage_reason: デング熱セロタイプ2による病院内クラスター（5例）が確認され、異常な集団発生を示唆。台湾では計74例報告され、地域的に限定されているが、公衆衛生上の懸念と対応強化が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾（対象国リストに未含）での病院内クラスター報告が主要な内容であるが、記事で言及されている輸入症例の由来地はインドネシア（21例）とベトナム（9例）。Bluedot APIが付与した地域には台湾が含まれているが、評価対象国でないため除外。ただし、インドネシアとベトナムからの輸入症例との関連が報告されているため、これら2国を verified_locations に含める。デング熱の地域的広がり、病院内感染制御の必要性、ゲノム配列解析による海外株との関連確認が進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄醫院登革熱群聚！ 5人中鏢感染源不明 疾管署急南下斬斷蚊蹤
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cluster at Kaohsiung hospital! Five infected; source of infection unknown. Taiwan's CDC rushes south to cut off the mosquito transmission chain.
article.articleSummary: A dengue fever cluster at a Kaohsiung hospital in Taiwan totals five cases—the first domestic cluster this year and the first hospital cluster in eight years. The index patient, a woman in her 70s from Sanmin District, was admitted May 29, discharged June 10, and readmitted June 11 with fever and dizziness; dengue virus type 2 was confirmed. Four additional cases were found in an adjacent ward during her hospitalization; the infection source is unknown, with genome sequencing underway. Taiwan CDC has deployed a mobile epidemic prevention team to Kaohsiung to conduct contact tracing, expand testing, and perform vector control, including breeding-source elimination around residences. Nationwide, 74 dengue cases were reported as of June 12: 6 local (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported from Southeast/South Asia, Indonesia accounting for 21. Public advised to remove standing water, wear light-colored long sleeves, use approved repellents, and seek prompt medical care for fever, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, or rash, informing travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄医院のデング熱集団発生！5人が感染、感染源不明。台湾の疾病管理局が南下し、蚊の伝播経路を遮断
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の院内集団発生（8年ぶり）で異常性が高く、感染源不明という管理可能性の課題がある。IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPRO基準4項目以上該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（高雄市）でのデング熱院内集団発生が主題。8年ぶりの病院内集団発生で異常性が高い。感染源が不明という点から継続的な疫学調査が必要。インドネシアからの輸入症例が21件と多いため、地域的な流行状況との関連を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄醫院爆登革熱群聚！70多歲女住院確診「鄰房再驗出4例」 急成立機動防疫隊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cluster at Kaohsiung Hospital: Woman in Her 70s Hospitalized and Diagnosed; Four More Cases Found in Adjacent Room; Emergency Mobile Epidemic-Prevention Team Formed
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cluster at a Kaohsiung City hospital in Sanmin District. The index case is a woman in her 70s with chronic illness who was admitted May 29, discharged June 10, and readmitted June 11 with fever; lab-confirmed dengue type 2. During the inpatient period, four additional dengue-positive cases were found in an adjacent room, forming a hospital-based cluster. Taiwan CDC has established a Mobile Epidemic-Prevention Team to support Kaohsiung, with expanded testing to identify additional infections and contact tracing within exposure windows. As of June 12, Taiwan totals 74 confirmed dengue cases: 6 locally acquired, all in Kaohsiung, and 68 imported from Southeast and South Asia, notably Indonesia (21), Maldives (14), and Vietnam (9). Vector surveillance and breeding-source elimination are underway around affected residences and activity areas. Public advised to monitor symptoms (fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, rash) and report travel history; call 1922 for guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄醫院爆登革熱群聚！70多歲女住院確診「鄰房再驗出4例」 急成立機動防疫隊
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の院内集団発生（5例）が台湾で確認され、複数のIHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たす。国内での局所的拡大リスクおよび国際的な流行背景（インドネシア21例、モルジブ14例等からの輸入例68例）があり、シグナルとしてピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾の高雄における院内デング熱集団発生であるが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、記事サマリーに記載された輸入例の感染源国であるインドネシア（21例）とベトナム（9例）を verified_locations に含める。モルジブも輸入例14例の源であるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: India sends measles vaccines, medical supplies to Maldives amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: India dispatched 20,000 measles vaccine doses and about 3 tonnes of medical supplies to the Maldives on 12 June 2026 to counter rising measles cases and bolster immunisation coverage. The consignment was handed over at a ceremony with Maldives Health Minister Geela Ali in attendance. Maldives officials praised the timely assistance as reflecting strong bilateral cooperation and its role in safeguarding public health. The move underscores India’s role as a trusted regional partner under the Neighbourhood First policy and Vision MAHASAGAR (Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions). Separately, discussions between India's High Commissioner and State Pharma Managing Director focused on expanding bilateral health cooperation. This aid accompanies ongoing efforts to strengthen measles vaccination in the Maldives amid increased disease activity.

triage.headline_ja: インドがマルジブのはしか症例増加に対応して、はしかワクチンと医療物資を送付
triage.triage_reason: マルジブでのはしか症例増加は確認されているが、記事は主にインドからの人道支援の内容に焦点を当てており、マルジブの流行状況の詳細（症例数、死亡、重症度）が不明。スクリーニング基準の複数該当の可能性はあるが、詳細情報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドからマルジブへの支援内容を主に記述。マルジブ（対象国リストに含まれない）での流行の詳細情報が不足。はしかはヒト-ヒト感染性が高く地域的な懸念事項ではあるが、より詳細なエピデミオロジー情報が必要。続報を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns of 'blind spots' in Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo faces multiple blind spots as of 2026-06-12, according to WHO. Olivier le Polain, a WHO epidemiologist based in Beni, eastern Congo, warns that in several high-risk areas surveillance is incomplete, and the full extent of Ebola transmission remains unknown. The remarks stress that surveillance needs to be strengthened to better map spread, identify clusters, and guide response. The report provides no concrete case counts or dates. The emphasis is on closing gaps in data and laboratory confirmation to detect new infections promptly and support containment in eastern Congo, where prior outbreaks have repeatedly flared. The WHO call highlights ongoing concern and the need for intensified monitoring, reporting, and resources to reduce undetected transmission in remote communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラアウトブレイクの「ブラインドスポット」について警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の発生であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（deaths/severe cases）および国際拡大リスクが懸念される。WHO公式警告により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは具体的な症例数や死亡数を提供していないが、WHO高官による公式警告（2026年6月12日）であり、東部コンゴの監視体制の不完全さと検出されていない伝播の懸念を強調している。エボラは高致命率の病原体であり、過去の反復的なアウトブレイク歴がある地域での報告であることから、シグナルとしての優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Missing Contacts Obscure Congo Ebola Outbreak's True Extent
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows a growing number of confirmed cases, signaling ongoing community transmission. Health authorities warn that without swift public health measures, the outbreak could expand rapidly across districts. The situation is clouded by missing contacts, leaving the true extent of transmission difficult to ascertain. As of 2026-06-12, observed patterns point to continued infection within communities and raise concern for broader geographic spread. The article underscores the challenge of incomplete contact tracing as a key obstacle to understanding and responding to the outbreak. Rising case numbers heighten urgency for swift public health actions, while efforts to fill tracing gaps are critical to map transmission and guide response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症アウトブレイク、接触者不明で真の規模が不明瞭に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い重症度と致死率を持ち、コミュニティ内での継続的な人間-人間感染、複数地域への拡大リスク、国際的拡散リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクがすべて明白である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はWHO最高警戒レベルの病原体であり、DRCでのアウトブレイクは国際的に高い関心を集める。接触者追跡の不完全性は対応能力に直接的な影響を与え、制御不能状況へのリスクを高める。フルRRA実施は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Characterization of HIV acquisitions during a large oral... : AIDS
article.articleSummary: During February 2018–December 2020, an implementation study among MSM and transgender women in Brazil, Mexico, and Peru evaluated HIV acquisitions during oral PrEP. Acute HIV prevalence at enrollment was 0.5% (43/9,552). Across 8,714 participants (12,185.25 person-years; median age 29; MSM 94.8%; transgender women 5.2%), 104 (1.2%) seroconverted during follow-up. Median HIV viral load at diagnosis: 12,257 copies/mL (IQR 851–114,118). Resistance mutations: K65R in 1 participant; M184V/I in 6. Median time from first PrEP dispensation to HIV diagnosis: 360 days; country difference significant (P=0.012). Tenofovir intracellular levels indicating ≥4 doses/week at HIV diagnosis in 5 participants (8.6%). The study highlights low acute infection detection at PrEP initiation and substantial adherence challenges among young MSM and transgender women; suggests long-acting PrEP and tailored adherence support to reduce HIV incidence in Latin America.

triage.headline_ja: 大規模経口PrEP試験におけるHIV感染の特性化：AIDS
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2018-2020年の実施研究の成果報告であり、進行中の感染症危機や異常な集団発生ではない。ラテンアメリカにおける一般的なHIV疫学研究として、公開学術誌掲載の研究論文である。
triage.notes: 本イベントはペルーとメキシコでの実施研究を含むが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。記事は学術研究論文であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、既往研究結果の報告である。シグナルトリアージの対象外として適切に分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Откриха ебола в три нови здравни зони в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola detected in three new health zones in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola detected in three new health zones in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, per a government report, signaling continued geographic expansion of the outbreak. The number of confirmed infections has risen to 676, with 136 deaths. Health authorities warn that cases are likely to keep increasing as many people fail to follow orders, including prohibitions on large gatherings. The report underscores ongoing transmission within the DRC and urges communities to adhere to public health measures to curb spread. Separately, Ugandan authorities say they have managed to contain the outbreak. As of 12 June 2026, the situation remains closely monitored.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国の3つの新しい保健地域で検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。確認感染者676名・死亡136名の深刻な流行が進行中であり、地理的拡大が継続している。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの発生についても言及されているが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国における流行の地理的拡大であり、ウガンダの現況は「封じ込めに成功している」と報告されているため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。この流行規模と拡大傾向は国際的な保健上の脅威として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ 81 người ngộ độc ở Trường Tiểu học Kim Đồng: Phát hiện thức ăn nhiễm khuẩn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Incident of 81 people poisoned at Kim Đồng Primary School: Bacteria-contaminated food found.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Đồng Tháp Department of Health reported 81 cases of food poisoning at Kim Đồng Primary School in Sa Đéc Ward, Sa Đéc City, linked to a lunch on 18 May supplied by Nam Nguyên Foods Co., Ltd. Of 525 meal participants, 81 fell ill (71 students, 10 adults); symptoms included abdominal pain, vomiting, and diarrhea; 70 were hospitalized; no deaths. By 21 May, 62 people were hospitalized (56 students, 6 adults), with totals rising to 81 cases; all patients have since recovered and been discharged. Laboratory tests found Salmonella spp. in 18 of 30 patient samples; some food samples contained Escherichia coli and Bacillus cereus. The investigation attributes likely cross-contamination during preparation, storage, or serving. Authorities are coordinating with relevant agencies to address the supplier and prevent recurrence.

triage.headline_ja: キム・ドン小学校での81人食中毒事件：細菌汚染食品が発見
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設の限定的な食中毒集団発生で、すでに全員回復・退院。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と異常性で該当するが、国際的拡大リスクと長期曝露のリスクは低く、情報も十分。経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 学校給食での限定的な食中毒事件。患者全員が回復・退院済み。Salmonella、E. coli、Bacillus cereusが検出されたが、原因は食事準備・保管・提供時の交叉汚染と特定済み。供給業者への対応と再発防止策が進行中。国際的拡大リスク・継続的曝露リスクは極めて低い。

article.articleHeadline: 我国展开首个骨痛热症人体挑战研究 志愿者为病毒研究以身试毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China launches its first dengue fever human challenge trial; volunteers risk their lives for virus research.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever human challenge trial DEN-CHIM-01 conducted in China, led by Singapore's National Centre for Infectious Diseases (NCID). The TRIDENT-funded study uses a weakened dengue virus strain developed by the NIH. Five healthy adults aged 21–45 were recruited and screened before vaccination. Participants were inoculated under tight supervision and must remain hospitalized for at least 10 days with continuous monitoring. PCR testing, blood analyses, and health assessments will track viral dynamics and immune responses, ensuring safety throughout. After discharge, follow-up examinations continue to monitor recovery and immune changes. Associate Professor Barnaby Yang, Clinical Trials Unit director, said the team will precisely document virus exposure, dose, and timing to better track replication and symptoms. Senior Nurse Gu Shiyun notes only mild symptoms (headache, rash) without high fever or bleeding observed. Detailed analyses are planned in coming months.

triage.headline_ja: 中国が初のデング熱ヒト感染実験を実施 ボランティアがウイルス研究のため身を呈す
triage.triage_reason: シンガポール・中国が共同実施するデング熱の医学的に管理された人体チャレンジ試験。制御された研究環境であり緊急的なアウトブレイク状況ではないため、異常性・重症度の基準では限定的。ただしボランティア参加者の安全性と国際的な倫理的関心が存在するため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントは野生のアウトブレイクではなく、倫理的監督下にある医学研究試験。シンガポールのNCIDが関与しているが、実験実施地は中国。弱毒化ウイルス株を使用し、参加者は5名の健康成人に限定。重症例なし（軽度症状のみ報告）。アウトブレイク状況としてのIHR通知対象ではないが、国際的な倫理的関心と将来の継続監視の需要があるため、WATCH段階での経過観察が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ituri - Une équipe de riposte Ebola attaquée à Rwampara, un médecin séquestré puis libéré
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ituri - An Ebola response team attacked in Rwampara, a doctor held hostage and then released.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, faces security and misinformation challenges. On June 9, in the Tséré groupement of the Rwampara health zone, a surveillance team investigating a suspected Ebola case in the village of Toutou was attacked by armed residents with machetes and stones. A doctor conducting a sample collection was tied up, held, and threatened, then rescued by security forces. Groupement head Zamundu Batagura condemned the assault and urged the public to support the response and report suspected cases to hospitals, while warning against misinformation on social networks. Prosecutor Edoxy Maswama pledged firm action against those spreading false information or hindering the response. The incident highlights ongoing community resistance and rumours that complicate containment. On June 1, four Red Cross responders were severely injured at Nyamurongo cemetery, Bunia, during burial-related clashes linked to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: イトゥリ州 - ルワンパラでエボラ対応チームが攻撃を受け、医師が人質となった後に解放される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生地域（DRC イトゥリ州）で対応チームへの暴力事件が報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）、かつ社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州（Bunia、Rwampara健康地域）でのエボラアウトブレイク対応に焦点を当てている。発生地域にChad（2434508）とRwanda（49518）も記載されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの事案であり、これら隣国での確認事例に関する明確な記載がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。対応チームへの暴力、医師の人質化、社会的デマによる対応阻害など、複数の懸念要素がある。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄民生醫院爆登革熱群聚！5病患確診 8年首見疾管署急南下
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cluster outbreak at Kaohsiung Minsheng Hospital; five patients diagnosed, first time in eight years, Taiwan CDC rushes south.
article.articleSummary: Five inpatients at Kaohsiung Minsheng Hospital in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, have been diagnosed with dengue fever type 2, marking the year’s first hospital cluster and Kaohsiung’s first hospital outbreak in eight years. The index case is a woman in her 70s from Sanmin District who was hospitalized late May to early June and later confirmed dengue type 2. To define the scope, health authorities expanded testing on the 6th floor; by June 12, 131 people had been tested, uncovering four more dengue-positive cases in three adjacent rooms, for a total of five all among inpatients. Infection source and transmission remain under investigation; vector breeding was found in the hospital environment after heavy rains, and a fine of NT$15,000 was issued for inadequate water-management. The hospital implemented ward-down measures, moved 6th-floor patients, and intensified vector-control. Nationally, 74 dengue cases this year, 68 imported (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9) and 6 domestic—all in Kaohsiung. Citizens urged to 'look, drain, clear, brush' and seek prompt care for dengue-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄民生醫院爆登革熱群聚！5病患確診 8年首見疾管署急南下
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の医療機関内での登革熱クラスター（5名確診）により、IHR基準「異常性」（8年ぶりの院内集団発生）および「重症度」（入院患者含む複数例）に該当。対象国内での発生であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はTaiwan（台湾）の医療機関クラスター発生であるが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事に記載されているインドネシアとベトナムは輸入症例のソースとして言及されているため、WPRO基準では対象国関連の感染症情報として評価対象に含める。医療施設内での二次感染拡大リスクおよび環境内の蚊媒介リスク（降雨後のベクター繁殖確認）が管理の課題。

article.articleHeadline: โคราช ประกาศเขตโรคระบาดชั่วคราว เฝ้าระวังพิษสุนัขบ้า ถึง 9 ก.ค. หลังพบกัดปชช.เจ็บ 4 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korat Declares Temporary Epidemic Zone: Rabies Surveillance Through July 9 After Four People Were Bitten
article.articleSummary: Rabies surveillance was expanded into a temporary epidemic zone in Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand, with ongoing monitoring through July 9, 2026, after four residents were bitten by a stray dog near a municipal waste disposal site in Nongbuasala and Pho Klang, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima. The victims, ages 17 (male), 30 (female), 60 (female), and 16 (female), were treated at Maharat Nakhon Ratchasima Hospital. The stray dog that bit a domestic dog tested positive for rabies. Authorities implemented a 5-km ring vaccination around the outbreak, vaccinated exposed individuals, and employed sedative darts to manage stray dogs around the site, noting roughly 100 stray dogs in the area. In Hua Talay’s Donkhwang area, officials vaccinated animals within a 5-km radius due to another confirmed case; the region hosts large gatherings and about 5,000 students. Since Jan 1, 2026, 23 animals have been infected and a 54-year-old man died in February; 163 high-risk contacts were vaccinated. The Livestock Office urges vaccination of unvaccinated pets and reporting suspect animals.

triage.headline_ja: コラート：4人が咬傷被害後、7月9日までの一時的狂犬病流行地区を宣言・監視継続
triage.triage_reason: タイにおける狂犬病の人への感染（4人の咬傷被害、1人死亡）と複数動物での確認、一時的流行地区の宣言、広範な接触者管理が行われており、IHR基準および WPRO スクリーニング基準を複数満たしている。
triage.notes: タイのナコンラッチャシマ県で狂犬病の複合感染事例。2026年1月以来23動物に感染、人での死亡例あり。一時的流行地区宣言、5km圏内のワクチン接種、野犬管理など積極的対応が実施されている。継続監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄發生醫院登革熱群聚5人確診　疾管署支援防疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five dengue fever cases confirmed in a hospital cluster in Kaohsiung; Taiwan CDC provides epidemic prevention support.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cluster in Kaohsiung, Taiwan: five locally acquired cases linked to a hospital outbreak. The index patient, a woman in her 70s with chronic illness, was admitted May 29, discharged June 10, then readmitted June 11; four adjacent rooms tested positive, forming the cluster. All five infections are DEN-2; Kaohsiung now reports six local cases this year. Transmission is mosquito-borne (Aedes); not human-to-human. Viral sequencing is underway to compare with overseas imported cases from Indonesia and Vietnam; results expected June 16. National totals as of June 12: 74 dengue cases, six locally transmitted (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported, mainly from Indonesia (21), Maldives (14), and Vietnam (9). With plum rain season, authorities urge draining standing water, environmental cleaning, and use of approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535). Symptoms include fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, rash; seek prompt medical care and note travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市の病院で登革熱の集団発生、5人が確診 台湾疾管署が防疫支援
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での登革熱クラスター（5例）は異常/予想外の発生であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数に該当するが、ウイルスが主にシーズン的な蚊媒介であり、国内対応能力は高く、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。情報充実度は高いが、国際的な影響の程度を判断するには続報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主な発生地はTaiwan（対象国リストに非含有）だが、サマリーではベトナムとインドネシアからの輸入例との関連調査も記載されており、これらの国の感染状況との関連を検証中。蚊媒介疾患で雨季との関連があり季節的な懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ｗ杯コンゴ代表が米国入り　エボラ熱対策で隔離後：山陽新聞デジタル｜さんデジ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo's World Cup squad arrives in the United States after Ebola-related quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's World Cup squad arrived in Houston, Texas, for the North American three-country tournament, following an Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC and a quarantine in Belgium. The team and head coach are based outside the DRC. The United States has barred entry of foreigners with Congo stay, leading the group to cancel a planned pre-camp in Kinshasa. They are set to face Portugal in their opening match on June 17. The move comes after Ebola-related travel restrictions and quarantine procedures linked to the eastern Congo outbreak, with the squad moving from Belgium to the United States for the event.

triage.headline_ja: W杯コンゴ代表が米国入り　エボラ熱対策で隔離後：山陽新聞デジタル｜さんデジ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の新規発生報告ではなく、既知の東部DRC での流行に関連した代表チームの移動に関する報道。公衆衛生的な新たなリスク要因の提示がなく、スクリーニング基準の該当がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）関連のニュースであり、既知のエボラ熱流行に対する行政的対応（隔離・渡航制限）の結果としての代表チーム移動を報じているもの。新規感染事例の報告や疫学的な懸念の増加を示唆する情報は含まれていない。感染症シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Wild Boar Cull Ordered as Swine Fever Hits Domestic Pigs
article.articleSummary: African swine fever has appeared in Hungary's domestic pig population, spreading from local wild boars into Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg County. The virus is described as extremely aggressive with no known cure; the initial infected herd exhibited hemorrhagic symptoms and rapid mass mortality. Officials say the introduction likely came from wild boars, not cross-border domestic pigs. To contain the outbreak, authorities will eliminate the entire wild boar population within a 10-kilometer radius of the infected farm, primarily via hunting associations; if pace lags, the Defense Forces will be deployed. The aim is to suppress immediate consequences within two months and halt spread. Economically, several thousand tons of pork in transit or processed face market loss as non-European export markets—South Korea, Vietnam, Serbia—revoke imports. About 9,000 slaughter pigs per week intended for export may need domestic absorption; Hungary imports ~400,000 pigs’ worth of meat annually, and 60% of public catering meat is foreign.

triage.headline_ja: 豚コレラがハンガリーの飼育豚に発生、野生イノシシの駆除を命令
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は世界的に高い経済的・動物衛生学的影響を持つ重要な疾患であり、複数国への国際的な拡大リスク（記事でも韓国、ベトナム、セルビアが輸入禁止）と予想外の発生地域での確認が確認され、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した発生地域にはハンガリー、セルビア、韓国も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はハンガリーでの発生であり、セルビア・韓国・ベトナムは輸入禁止措置を取る側として言及されている。対象国リストではベトナムのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはベトナムのみとした。ただしハンガリーでの確認事例自体は重要な地域外シグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Ανησυχία για "τυφλά σημεία" στο ξέσπασμα Έμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Concern over 'blind spots' in the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of blind spots in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the full extent of transmission still unclear. A WHO epidemiologist based in Beni, in the eastern DRC, states several areas are high risk and surveillance in these zones must be strengthened to limit spread and detect new cases promptly. The remarks underscore ongoing uncertainty about how far Ebola has spread, particularly in eastern provinces around Beni. The article does not provide case or death counts. The call for enhanced surveillance emphasizes early detection, rapid response, and targeted public health measures in high‑risk districts to prevent undetected transmission and aid outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行における「盲点」への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当。エボラウイルスは国際的に極めて重大な感染症であり、DRCでの流行は公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念を示している。WHOによる懸念表明は政策レベルの関心を反映している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは極めて高い致命率を有する。WHOが「盲点」への懸念を表明している点は、サーベイランスギャップと未検出伝播の可能性を示唆しており、制御困難性が高い。DRCにおける継続的な流行は国際的脅威に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola Vaka Sayısı 676'ya Yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case count in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 676.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of 12 June 2026. The Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak, now affecting 29 regions across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in eastern DRC. On 11 June, 41 new confirmed cases were reported in Ituri and North Kivu, with 9 deaths among them. The health ministry warns the disease could spread geographically if control measures are not rapidly implemented. A total of 5,768 contacts are under follow-up, but the contact-tracing rate stands at 71.8% versus a target of 95%, posing a challenge to interrupt transmission. In Bunia, Ituri’s capital, two more recoveries were recorded, bringing total recoveries to 32. The outbreak, first detected in 1976, marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, with roughly 15 million people living in the affected provinces amid ongoing displacement and cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が676人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患であり、複数地域への拡大と接触者追跡の課題が存在する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模な流行。既に676確定患者、136死亡。Bundibugyo株による。接触者追跡率が71.8%と目標95%に未達であり、伝播制御に課題。15百万人が影響地域に居住し、越境人口移動のリスクも高い。国際的な支援と監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : une structure médicale tradimoderne engagée dans la sensibilisation sur Ebola à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: a traditional-modern medical facility engaged in Ebola awareness in Beni - ACP
article.articleSummary: On June 12, 2026, in Beni, North Kivu (Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo), a tradimoderne medical facility engaged ACP to alert patients about Ebola virus disease. Dr. Germain Mathe Tsongo, head of the Benedictine Traditional Medical Center (CMTB) in Beni, reports that about 80% of patients first visit their center; they aim to raise awareness of Ebola and screen suspected cases for referral to appropriate treatment centers. The center emphasizes it does not treat Ebola cases and has no Ebola medicines; patients with signs are directed to proper facilities for proper care. They condemn social media misinformation and dangerous home remedies, noting there is no approved vaccine and no cure—only symptomatic care. Amid the 17th Ebola outbreak affecting Ituri, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu, the center positions itself as a frontline community actor in response.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニの伝統的近代医療施設がエボラに関する啓発活動に従事 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関連する啓発活動の報道。シグナルとしての新たなイベント性は低いが、既知の流行状況に対する地域レベルの対応情報であり、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中のエボラ流行（第17次）の背景下における地域医療施設の啓発活動についての報道。新規症例報告や流行拡大を示すシグナルではなく、既知の流行に対する地域レベルの対応情報。ただしエボラは常に重篤な関心事であり、流行継続中のため継続監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Nipah Virus Cases : केरल में निपाह का नया मामला, कोझिकोड में 45 वर्षीय व्यक्ति संक्रमित, संपर्क में आए 77 लोगों पर पैनी नजर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah Virus Cases in Kerala: A new Nipah case in Kozhikode, a 45-year-old man infected, 77 contacts under close watch.
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports a new Nipah virus case in Kozhikode, a 45-year-old man confirmed infected and receiving treatment at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital as authorities escalate contact tracing. A total of 77 contacts are under close surveillance, including 14 family members, 5 friends/colleagues, and 58 healthcare workers; 15 individuals are categorized as high-risk and under enhanced monitoring. Nipah is a zoonotic virus with fruit bats as the primary reservoir; transmission can occur via contact with bat saliva, urine, or contaminated fruits, and human-to-human spread is possible through direct contact with an infected person. This outbreak situation follows earlier Nipah occurrences in the region; the virus was first identified in 1999 in Malaysia and Singapore. The case-fatality rate is high, prompting rapid containment efforts. No symptoms have yet appeared among the 77 contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州ニパウイルス事例：コージコード郡で45歳男性が新たに感染、接触者77人が厳重監視下に
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つ新興感染症であり、ケーラ州での新規確認事例は地域にとって異常・予想外である。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、高リスク接触者の存在、医療従事者への暴露、および過去の発生歴から、スクリーニング基準複数該当かつ社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはシンガポールとマレーシアが含まれているが、記事サマリーはケーラ州（インド）での新規事例に焦点を当てており、これらの国は過去の歴史的参照のみである。verified_locationsはインド（ケーラ州コージコード）のみとした。ニパウイルスの高い致死率（記事で言及）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、医療従事者を含む多数の接触者、および過去のこの地域での発生歴により、フルリスク評価（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必要である。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Προειδοποιεί για "τυφλά σημεία" στο ξέσπασμα του ιού Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Warns about "blind spots" in the Ebola virus outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, the World Health Organization warned of several 'blind spots' in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, noting that the full scale of spread is not yet known. Olivier Le Polén, WHO epidemiologist based in Beni, eastern DRC, said that there are areas with high risk where surveillance needs strengthening. The piece references a Congo Ebola update indicating nearly 600 cases. No further laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported case details are reported in the article. Such gaps underscore the ongoing challenge of mapping transmission in hard-to-reach areas amid efforts to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス感染症の流行における「盲点」について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス感染症は最重要危険病原体であり、継続的な流行と監視ギャップの報告は国際的な懸念事項。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症の流行はIHRおよびWPRO基準の全項目に該当する最高優先度のシグナル。ほぼ600症例が報告されており、監視の盲点が存在するという問題は、実際の感染数がより多い可能性を示唆している。東部DRC（Beni）における地域的な社会経済的課題があり、外部支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄醫院登革熱群聚！ 5人中鏢感染源不明 疾管署急南下斬斷蚊蹤
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cluster at Kaohsiung Hospital! Five people infected; source of infection unknown; Taiwan CDC rushes south to cut off mosquito transmission.
article.articleSummary: Five dengue fever cases confirmed at a Kaohsiung City hospital in Taiwan, marking the year’s first hospital cluster and the first in eight years. The index case is a woman in her 70s from Sanmin District, admitted May 29, discharged June 10, then readmitted June 11 with fever and dizziness; dengue virus type 2 detected. Four additional infections were found in an adjacent ward; the infection source remains undetermined, with genomic sequencing underway. The Taiwan CDC has deployed a mobile epidemic prevention team, intensified contact tracing and expanded testing, and conducted vector control around the patient’s residence and hospital. As of June 12, national dengue totals reach 74, with six local cases all in Kaohsiung and 68 imported cases, mostly from Southeast and South Asia (Indonesia 21).
