triage.headline_ja: 高雄医院デング熱群発！5人が感染、感染源不明 疾病対策庁が急いで南下し蚊の伝播を断つ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の高雄市病院で8年ぶりのデング熱院内集団発生が確認され、感染源が特定されていない。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPRO基準複数該当。公式な感染症対策機関による介入と国内での社会的関心あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はTaiwan（高雄市）での院内集団発生だが、対象国リストにTaiwanは含まれない。ただし記事内でインドネシアからの輸入症例が21件と明記されており、Indonesiaは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。台湾でのクラスターはWPRO基準5項目全て該当する懸念事項だが、対象国に限定した場合はIndonesiaのみの記載となる。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄發生醫院登革熱群聚5人確診 疾管署支援防疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five dengue fever cases confirmed in a hospital cluster in Kaohsiung; Taiwan CDC assists with epidemic prevention.
article.articleSummary: Five locally acquired dengue fever cases have been confirmed in a Kaohsiung City hospital cluster, raising the city’s local dengue total for 2026 to six. The index case is an elderly woman (70s) with chronic illness who was admitted May 29, discharged June 10, and readmitted June 11 with dengue. Four additional patients in adjacent rooms also tested positive, creating a cluster of five cases all among hospitalized patients; dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2) was identified. Transmission is via mosquitoes, not person-to-person; the infection source is under investigation, with possible links to imported cases. Taiwan CDC is performing viral genome sequencing to compare against overseas strains from Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Maldives; results expected June 16. Ongoing monsoon rains raise standing-water risks. Authorities urge “巡、倒、清、刷” to eliminate breeding sites, and to seek prompt care if dengue symptoms appear. As of June 12, 2026, Taiwan tallies 74 dengue cases: 6 locally (Kaohsiung) and 68 imported (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9).

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市の病院でデング熱集団発生、5人確診 台湾CDCが防疫支援
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）での局所的な集団発生で、IHR基準は2未満。ただしDENV-2の国際株比較分析が進行中であり、ウイルスゲノム解析結果（6月16日予定）によって国際的リスク評価が変わる可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域の地理的位置：台湾高雄市（対象国外）。ただし、台湾CDCが行うウイルスゲノム解析でインドネシア、ベトナム、モルディブ由来の株との比較が予定されており、ウイルス輸入源の確認待ち。現在のところ局所的集団感染（病院内、蚊媒介）であり、重症度・死亡報告なし。台湾は対象国に含まれないため verified_locations にはインドネシアとベトナムのみ記載（輸入源国として）。モルディブは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Aktion gegen den Hunger stellt 130.000 Euro aus dem Nothilfefonds für die Ebola-Prävention bereit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: Action Against Hunger allocates €130,000 from the Emergency Relief Fund for Ebola prevention.
article.articleSummary: Uganda receives €130,000 from Action Against Hunger's Emergency Relief Fund to bolster Ebola prevention and containment, aiming to reach about 50,000 people while ongoing relief work continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The regional director for East Africa and the Horn of Africa, Rotimy Djossaya, says the funding supports infection prevention and control measures, PPE for health workers, community awareness campaigns, and epidemiological surveillance in affected and at-risk areas. Ebola outbreaks harm malnourished communities already facing food and water/sanitation shortages, raising preventable morbidity and mortality. Measures include maintaining essential health and nutrition services, implementing distancing rules in health and nutrition centers, and preparing communities for culturally sensitive challenges such as traditional burial practices that can raise transmission risk. The WHO declared the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus disease a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：国連機関がエボラ予防のため130,000ユーロを緊急救援基金から配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHO緊急宣言済みのエボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）が複数国で発生している。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの予防活動を報告しているが、実際の発生地域はDRC（継続中の流行）及び関連地域。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。Mozambiqueも記事サマリーに明記されていないため除外。WHO公式宣言（2026年5月17日）によるBundibugyo株のPHEIC認定済み。複数国での流行と国際的拡大リスクが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : MSF appelle à une mobilisation générale pour freiner l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: MSF calls for a general mobilization to curb the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spurs MSF to call for a general mobilization of all actors. At a Kinshasa press briefing on June 11, 2026, MSF reported ongoing insecurity and population movements that complicate control across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with about twenty health zones affected. MSF operates in all three provinces, running four Ebola treatment centers and focusing on patient care, transmission prevention, and protection of health workers and communities. Albert Essoun, MSF deputy head of programs in Ituri, stressed that the crisis requires broad participation—government, civil society, religious groups, and communities—to mount a rapid, multi-level response given the challenging environment. Early case detection remains crucial; MSF urges rapid testing for symptoms compatible with Ebola to enable swift treatment and improve patient survival.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: 一般的な動員を求めるMSF
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の流行で、複数州での発生、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な懸念、MSFによる緊急対応呼びかけがある。スクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理性で該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHO監視対象の重大感染症。記事では南キブ州、イトゥリ州、北キブ州の複数州での発生が記述されており、約20の保健地区が影響を受けている。治安悪化と人口移動がリスク要因として指摘されている。MSFが4つのエボラ治療センターを運営し、一般的な動員を呼びかけていることから、対応が急務とみなされている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns of 'blind spots' in Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, WHO epidemiologist Olivier le Polain in Beni, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, warned that there are many 'blind spots' in the Ebola outbreak, indicating the full scale of spread is not yet known. He said surveillance in high-risk areas needs strengthening to better map transmission and detect cases promptly. The remarks highlight gaps in field reporting and the potential for undetected spread. The article does not provide current case or death counts, dates of onset, or confirmed infection sources. There is no detail on laboratory confirmation within the report. Strengthening surveillance and rapid reporting from affected communities are implied as steps to improve understanding of the outbreak's reach in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行における「盲点」について警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で重大な国際的懸念疾患であり、DRCでの発生は異常かつ予想外の特性を示す。surveillance gapの存在は管理可能性の課題を示し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて致命的な感染症であり、記事はWHO公式エピデミオロジストによるBeniでの警告を報告している。Surveillance gapの指摘は outbreak containmentの能力に関わる重大な懸念を示唆している。現在の具体的な症例数や死亡数は記載されていないが、未検出拡大の可能性が明示されており、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Ο ΠΟΥ προειδοποιεί για "τυφλά" σημεία και υψηλό κίνδυνο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO warns about "blind" spots and high risk.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, a World Health Organization epidemiologist warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo contains numerous blind spots. The WHO notes that the full scale of Ebola transmission remains unknown. In several areas—particularly around Beni in the eastern DRC—these blind spots pose a high risk of undetected spread. The agency stressed that surveillance in these regions must be strengthened to improve detection of cases and understanding of transmission dynamics. The statement underscores ongoing uncertainty about how widely Ebola has already spread and calls for intensified monitoring in identified high-risk zones. The report does not provide case counts or fatalities, instead focusing on the need to bolster surveillance in hard-to-reach areas to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOが「盲点」と高リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行について、WHO公式の警告があり、IHR基準の「異常性・予想外性」「国際拡大リスク」が該当。スクリーニング基準では「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCのベニ周辺を中心とした東部地域でのエボラ感染の「盲点」についてWHOが公式警告。監視強化の必要性が強調されており、国際的関心が高い。ただしサマリーには具体的な患者数や死亡数の記載がないため、現流行の規模は不明確。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Προειδοποιεί για "τυφλά σημεία" στο ξέσπασμα του ιού Έμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of 'blind spots' in the Ebola virus outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the World Health Organization warns of numerous blind spots in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with the full scale of transmission still unknown. In Beni, in the eastern DRC, WHO epidemiologist Olivier le Polen says many high‑risk areas lack adequate information, underscoring the need to strengthen surveillance there. The emphasis is on expanding monitoring to better map the outbreak’s reach and inform response efforts. The report centers on surveillance gaps and does not provide case counts, deaths, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラウイルスアウトブレイクにおける「ブラインドスポット」を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確認されたアウトブレイク（DRC）であり、IHR基準2項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。WHO公式警告により社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは極度に危険な病原体であり、DRCでの確認されたアウトブレイク報告。WHO公式警告により信頼性が高い。記事では具体的な患者数、死亡者数、確定例数が記載されていないため詳細は不明だが、surveillance gapに関する警告自体が深刻さを示唆している。フルRRA実施時には詳細な疫学情報収集が必須。

article.articleHeadline: ЕБОЛАТА ГИ СТАВИ ВО 21-ДНЕВЕН КАРАНТИН Репрезентацијата на Конго доби зелено светло за влез во САД - plusinfo.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EBOLA PUTS THE CONGO NATIONAL TEAM IN A 21-DAY QUARANTINE - CONGO'S NATIONAL TEAM GOT THE GREEN LIGHT TO ENTER THE UNITED STATES - plusinfo.mk
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, American authorities allowed the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) football team to enter the United States after a 21-day quarantine mandated due to an Ebola outbreak in the country. The squad, which had halted preparations in Kinshasa and continued in Europe, arrived in Houston ahead of the FIFA World Cup, with their first match slated for 17 June against Portugal. Group-stage opponents also include Uzbekistan and Colombia. The 21-day quarantine was a prerequisite for entry, requiring the players and coaching staff to remain outside DR Congo territory during the period. The move underscores public health controls linked to Ebola while enabling the team's participation in the World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ代表チームを21日間隔離に - コンゴ代表チームは米国への入国許可を得た
triage.triage_reason: DRC でのエボラ発生（記事サマリーに明記）で IHR 基準 2 つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO スクリーニング基準でも複数該当。対象国 DRC での実際の発生確認のため、フルRRA に進む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC での Ebola 発生を明確に述べており、米国への渡航制限（21 日隔離）も実施されている。Bluedot の発生地域リストに Houston・Texas・USA が含まれているが、これらは隔離後の目的地であり、実際の Ebola 発生地は DRC のキンシャサ。したがって verified_locations は DRC のみ。国際的な交通制限および公衆衛生上の懸念が明確。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا يتسع في الكونغو وسط تحديات صحية وأمنية متزايدة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak widens in the Congo amid increasing health and security challenges - Ardu Point
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak widens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 12 June 2026, the World Health Organization records 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths across 34 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Ongoing transmission is linked to increased population movement and displacement, a weakened health system, persistent food insecurity, and security challenges hampering response efforts. The scale of the outbreak remains unclear. WHO continues to assist the government with surveillance and contact tracing, enhances laboratory capacity and clinical management, and sustains risk communication to communities and health workers. The report highlights the challenging operating environment, underscoring the need for coordinated health and security measures to control transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴで拡大、保健・安全保障上の課題が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。確認症例676件、死亡136件という重症度、国際的な懸念、およびWHOの対応が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRCでのエボラ出血熱流行を主題としており、South Kivu Province、Ituri、North Kivu地域での多数の確認症例と死亡を報告。WHOによる公式記録と対応が確認されている。記事配信日2026年6月12日。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists race to develop Ebola vaccines
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern DR Congo (Ituri province) with over 500 cases; no proven vaccine for Bundibugyo. Four vaccines are in development; two could enter clinical trials by August 2026 (Oxford University and Moderna using COVID-19 tech). Even with favorable results, at least two additional months would be needed for further trials and regulatory approval. Experts warn it could take months to years to end the outbreak; the 2018 Zaire strain outbreak lasted about two years despite a vaccine. Bundibugyo may have circulated undetected for weeks in Ituri, an area reliant on artisanal mining. A vaccine with comparable efficacy to the Zaire jab could significantly cut transmission and mortality. Resource constraints, including the shuttering of USAID and Western aid cuts, have weakened on-ground response. Africa CDC urges AU states to strengthen exit screening at airports, seaports, and ground crossings to curb cross-border spread while preserving safe movement.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者たちがエボラワクチン開発に競う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。500例超の患者数、ワクチン非適用株、国境越え拡大リスクがあり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱のバンディブギオ株による東コンゴ（イトゥリ州）での爆発的流行。既承認ザイール株ワクチンが無効であり、新規ワクチン開発急務。資源制約（USAID閉鎖、西側援助削減）が対応を弱化させている。Africa CDCが国境検疫強化を要請し、国際的対応の重要性が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Tanggapi HIV/AIDS di Tegal Capai 1.062 Kasus, Wabup Ahmad Kholid Siapkan Langkah Penanganan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV/AIDS in Tegal Reaches 1,062 Cases; Deputy Regent Ahmad Kholid Prepares Response Measures.
article.articleSummary: HIV/AIDS in Tegal Regency, Central Java, reaches 1,062 cumulative cases as of May 2026. Deputy Regent Ahmad Kholid, speaking after an event at RSUD dr. Soeselo on 12 June 2026, outlined response measures including intensified socialization on safe daily-life practices and planned inspections (sidak) of kos-kos (boarding houses) to enforce discipline, with coordination to involve police and Satpol PP. The local health office (Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Tegal) confirms 1,062 cumulative cases up to May 2026, of which 929 people living with HIV/AIDS (ODHIV) are currently alive and distributed across districts. Of these, 693 have known status and are registered at 29 puskesmas across the regency. The highest transmission risk factor is men who have sex with men (MSM), contributing about 70% of behaviorally related cases.

triage.headline_ja: テガル地域のHIV/AIDS感染者が1,062件に達する、アハマド・コーリッド副摂政が対応措置を準備
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）内の特定地域でのHIV/AIDSの累積症例報告だが、新規アウトブレイクではなく既知の継続的な健康課題の報告である。国家レベルの異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクは指摘されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: HIV/AIDSは既知の慢性疾患であり、テガル地域の累積症例報告は新興感染症の突発的なアウトブレイクではない。地域当局による対応体制が確認されている。ただし、MSM人口における高い感染率（行動関連症例の70%）と継続的な感染リスク曝露の観点から、WPRO基準で3項目該当。社会的・政治的関心も確認されているが、国際的拡大やWHO通知レベルの懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Ebola : la biotech lyonnaise Fabentech sur la piste d'un traitement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: the Lyon-based biotech Fabentech on the trail of a treatment
article.articleSummary: Lyon-based biotech Fabentech, recently cleared for its ricin antidote, is pursuing an Ebola treatment. The company’s polyclonal antibodies, developed initially against the Zaire (Zaïre) strain in 2015, retain neutralizing activity against Bundibugyo and also against Reston, Sudan, and the Makona, Kikwit and Mayinga variants of Zaïre. Since May 15, 2026, a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, driven by Bundibugyo, has prompted renewed interest in this therapy. Ebola’s regional impact is longstanding; past outbreaks from 2014–2016 caused over 11,000 deaths. In the current episode, the World Health Organization reports 534 laboratory-confirmed cases and 93 deaths. Fabentech’s approach underscores polyclonal antibody therapy as a potential treatment across multiple Ebola strains amid ongoing outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：リヨンのバイオテック企業Fabentechが治療法を開発中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当（重症度：533例・93死亡、流行しやすさ：複数国での発生、長期曝露：地域的に継続中）。2026年5月15日以降のコンゴとウガンダでの新規アウトブレイク進行中。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラウイルスのアウトブレイクと治療開発について報じており、2026年5月15日からのコンゴ・ウガンダでの新規発生が言及されている。Bundibugyo株による確認症例534例、死亡93例。リヨンは医療研究企業の所在地であり、アウトブレイク発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola surveillance in Cross River tightened as state backs mandatory health insurance
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) surveillance in Cross River State, Nigeria, has intensified after Federal Ministry of Health alerts about cases in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Public Health Emergency Operations Centre is on alert; surveillance is expanded across all 18 LGAs, with priority on border communities. Travel from affected countries is monitored and unexplained illnesses with Ebola-like symptoms are investigated. Healthcare workers, port health staff and surveillance officers have been trained on case definitions, referral, isolation and reporting, with strengthened cross-border cooperation with Cameroon and interstate authorities. Screening at airports, seaports and land borders continues; infection prevention and control measures are reinforced in facilities. No Ebola case has been recorded in Cross River, but vigilance is urged. Separately, at Akure, SSHIAs call for mandatory health insurance to advance Universal Health Coverage, with Cross River State aiming to expand coverage, including informal workers and rural residents.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の監視強化 - クロスリバー州が強制健康保険を支持
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、ウガンダとDRCでの確認ケースを受けてナイジェリアが国境監視を強化している。異常かつ予想外のイベントであり、国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはナイジェリア（特にクロスリバー州およびアクレ）を主な舞台としており、ウガンダおよびDRCでの既知ケースへの対応体制が記述されている。ウガンダとカメルーンは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーではこれらの国での新規ケースについては具体的に記載されておらず、ナイジェリアの監視・対応が主題である。対象国リストに照らしGhana（2300660）は記載されないため、検証済み位置にはナイジェリアとDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Tödliche Krankheit: Ebola breitet sich im Kongo aus - neue Regionen betroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly disease: Ebola is spreading in the Congo — new regions affected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands to new regions, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of June 11, 2026, according to WHO official Olivier le Polain in Beni, North Kivu. Most infections remain in Ituri province, but cases in North and South Kivu involve people from Ituri, and there is now local transmission in North Kivu. Ongoing fighting, population displacement, and a weak health system hinder the response, and the full scale of the outbreak remains unclear. UNICEF warns fear of infection is leading families to skip routine clinic visits and delay care for sick children, potentially increasing mortality. In Ituri, more than half of children under five are malnourished, worsening vulnerability amid the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な病気：エボラがコンゴで拡大 - 新しい地域が影響を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は最高レベルの公衆衛生脅威であり、DRCでの継続的な拡大は国際的な懸念となる重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内の複数地域（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）でのエボラ拡大を報告。2026年6月11日時点で676確認症例、136死亡。紛争、人口移動、脆弱な保健システムが対応を阻害。子どもの栄養不良（Iturityで5歳未満の50%以上）が脆弱性を悪化。UNICEFは感染恐怖による医療アクセス低下を警告。国際的支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Sebulan Terjadi 500 Gigitan HPR di Jembrana, Petugas Sisir Lagi Wilayah Kasus Suspek Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 500 Bites from Rabies-Transmitting Animals in Jembrana in a Month; Officials Sweep the Area Again for Suspected Rabies Cases
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a concern in Jembrana, Bali, Indonesia, where officials conducted second-phase rabies vaccination on June 11, 2026, in Banjar Kembangsari, Tukadaya, Melaya, vaccinating 35 rabies-transmitting animals (dogs and cats). The drive follows a suspected rabies death of a homemaker linked to an attack or scratch by a rabies-transmitting cat; authorities continue active surveillance. Across Bali’s Gumi Makepung area, 33 animals have tested positive for rabies. With about 500 bites from rabies-transmitting animals reported in Jembrana in the past month, residents are urged to vaccinate their pets and remain vigilant. In bite cases, people should rinse wounds with running water and soap, report to local medical services, and seek rabies post-exposure vaccination (VAR) at a primary health facility. The campaign will continue to sweep regions to prevent further cases.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンブラナでの1ヶ月間の狂犬病動物咬傷500件；疑い患者症例地域の再掃討
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の死亡例（疑い例）、著しい咬傷数増加（月500件）、継続的な人動物曝露、インドネシア当局による積極的対応が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシア（バリ州ジェンブラナ地域）における狂犬病の著しい増加を報告している。月間500件の咬傷、1件の疑い死亡例、33頭の感染確認が記載されており、当局の積極的な対応（予防接種キャンペーン、監視継続）が認められる。狂犬病は致命率がほぼ100％であり、集団曝露が継続中である点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: سحر ومؤامرة خارجية.. الكونغو تطلق حملة لمكافحة التضليل بشأن فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sorcery and foreign conspiracy... The Democratic Republic of the Congo launches a campaign to counter misinformation about the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, concentrated in Ituri province’s eastern districts. As of 12 June, 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths; the outbreak spans 27 health zones, up from three initially. Neighboring Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, largely among Congolese who crossed the border. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; risk is high domestically and regionally, with global risk lower. Misinformation online and in villages—blaming sorcery or alleging the outbreak is a hoax—hinders surveillance and care, with over 20,000 contacts potentially needing monitoring but only 4,955 identified so far. In response, the government launched a social-media misinformation counter-campaign and opened a rapid-testing center via the RadiOne platform in Mongwalo to quickly isolate cases. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak; authorities urge avoidance of handling the dead due to traditional burial practices.

triage.headline_ja: 魔術と外国の陰謀...コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスに関する偽情報対策キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）宣言済み、複数国での確認、多数の死亡、国境を越えた人的移動による国際的拡大のリスクが現実化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの19例について言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC のイトゥリ州での発生が主要な焦点。WHO PHEIC宣言、676確定例、136死亡、27健康地域への拡大、偽情報による対応の困難さ（接触者追跡率が低い）を記載。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスに対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: L'UNADI plaide pour l'implication des communautés dans la riposte contre Ebola en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: UNADI calls for community involvement in the Ebola response in Ituri
article.articleSummary: UNADI urges community involvement in Ebola response in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, after a June 11 statement in Bunia. The Union des associations culturelles pour le développement de l'Ituri, representing 21 local communities, says engaging residents and local leaders is essential to counter misinformation, distrust, and vandalism targeting health teams and to curb the spread of Ebola virus disease. The appeal calls for sensitization campaigns in local languages and outreach to remote areas, noting the critical role of community actors alongside formal health authorities. President Michel Meta complains that communities are not currently integrated or coordinated with UNADI. As part of ongoing efforts, UNADI continues awareness work; after Rwampara, it plans to move to Mungwalu, near Bunia, currently the epicenter of the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：UNADIがイトゥリ州のエボラ対策への地域コミュニティの関与を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。エボラの確認事例に基づくシグナルとして、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年6月時点のDRC第17次エボラ流行。イトゥリ州ブニアが現在の震源地。地域コミュニティの関与が重要課題として指摘されており、保健対応の管理可能性に課題あり。ルワンダは発生地域情報に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主要なイベント発生地。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: خطر خفي يهدد السيطرة على تفشي الإيبولا في شرق الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: A hidden threat to the control of the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, a World Health Organization epidemiologist based in Beni, in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, warned that there are several 'ambiguous points' surrounding the Ebola outbreak there, with the full scale of transmission not yet clear. He called for a substantial strengthening of surveillance in high-risk zones to better delineate how widely Ebola has spread and to guide response measures. The report provides no specific case or death tallies, laboratory confirmation details, or information about import/export of cases. The remarks underscore ongoing challenges in controlling Ebola in eastern Congo and the need for enhanced monitoring to close data gaps and improve outbreak management.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ東部のエボラ出血熱流行の制御に対する隠れた脅威
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い公衆衛生影響を有し、コンゴ民主共和国での流行継続は国際的拡大リスクを持つ。WHOの懸念表明により異常性・重症性が確認され、IHR基準2項目以上、WPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO疫学者による東部コンゴのエボラ流行に関する警告を報道。具体的な症例数・死亡数は記載されていないが、「データギャップ」と「監視強化の必要性」の言及から流行継続が示唆されている。環境影響も記載されている点から継続監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو: نقاط غامضة تحتاج مراقبة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: Mysterious aspects that require monitoring.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (primarily in Beni, eastern Congo) features unresolved aspects, with the World Health Organization noting that the extent of transmission remains unclear. Olivier Le Bolin, an epidemiologist with WHO based in Beni, said there are still a number of 'mysterious' points in high-risk areas and stressed an urgent need to strengthen surveillance in those zones. The article highlights the ongoing outbreak but does not provide concrete figures, clinical details, laboratory confirmation, or information on infection sources. The emphasis is on improving monitoring to better delineate the outbreak’s size and trajectory and to detect changes as data accumulate.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行：監視が必要な不明な側面
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは高い致死率を持つ第一類感染症であり、DRCでの流行報告は公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大のリスクを満たす。IHR基準2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月12日時点のDRC東部（Beni地域）でのエボラ流行について報告。具体的な症例数や死亡数は記載されていないが、WHO疫学者が「謎の多い」状況や監視強化の必要性を指摘している。流行が継続中であり、伝播範囲が未だ不明確であることが懸念される。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Ema e l'Agenzia per i medicinali africana rafforzano l'alleanza regolatoria - AboutPharma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: EMA and the African Medicines Agency strengthen the regulatory alliance - AboutPharma
article.articleSummary: EMA and the African Medicines Agency (AMA) have launched a joint regulatory alliance with African national authorities to speed the Ebola response caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The collaboration includes WHO’s African Vaccines Regulatory Forum and aims to define clinical-development and regulatory pathways for vaccines and therapies in development. This is the first emergency where EMA and AMA collaborate since AMA's launch, strengthening international coordination as Bundibugyo has no approved vaccines or treatments, unlike Ebola-Zaire. The EU is providing 16.5 million euros: 6.5m to the African Pathogen Genomics Initiative for field equipment, training, and surveillance; 5m to WHO for epidemiological surveillance and essential supplies; 5m for diagnostic tools. Candidate vaccines include rVSV-based, ChAdOx1 adenoviral, and mRNA platforms; treatments include MBP-134, remdesivir, maftivimab, with obeldesivir under evaluation for post-exposure prophylaxis. The aim is rapid evidence and harmonized decisions to bolster outbreak preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱: EMAとアフリカ医薬品庁が規制同盟を強化 - AboutPharma
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによる現行の流行であり、複数国での発生、国際的な規制協力体制の構築という点で重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: Ugandaはサマリーに明記されているが、提供された対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれていないため除外。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ブンディブギョエボラは重症度が高く、有効なワクチン・治療薬がまだ確立されていない点が懸念される。EMA、AMA、WHOを含む国際的な規制協力体制の構築は、世界的な公衆衛生上の重大事象を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Ema e l'Agenzia per i medicinali africana rafforzano l'alleanza regolatoria - AboutPharma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, EMA and the African Medicines Agency strengthen the regulatory alliance - AboutPharma.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, the European Medicines Agency (EMA) and the African Medicines Agency (AMA), with African national regulators, launched a joint effort to accelerate regulatory and clinical development for vaccines and therapies targeting the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. It marks the first public health emergency in which EMA and AMA collaborate since AMA began operations. The goal is swift, harmonized regulatory decisions leveraging Ebola experience and Africa’s regulatory networks, given Bundibugyo’s lack of approved vaccines or treatments. The European Commission announced €16.5 million in support: €6.5m to the Africa Pathogen Genomics Initiative for field equipment, training, and surveillance; €5m to WHO for epidemiological surveillance and PPE; and €5m for diagnostic tools and rapid tests. Candidate vaccines include rVSV-based, ChAdOx1 adenoviral, and an mRNA platform; treatments include MBP-134, remdesivir, maftivimab, with obeldesivir for post-exposure prophylaxis. Trials plans aim to rapidly generate robust evidence.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、EMAとアフリカ医薬品庁が規制上の同盟を強化 - AboutPharma
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによるコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ発生。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当：公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な病原体の出現、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク。また、WPRO基準においても全5項目に該当し、EMA・AMAの協力など国際的な対応体制の構築が進められている。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。記事サマリーはEMA・AMAの協力、EU資金支援（€16.5百万）の発表、複数の候補ワクチン・治療薬の開発進捗について述べており、高い国際的関心と対応の複雑性を示唆している。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスは既知の承認ワクチンおよび治療法がないとされており、新興脅威として評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Cepheid Delivers Xpert Hemorrhagic Fever Panel Tests to Africa to Address Diagnostic Gaps in Ebola Bundibugyo Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompts Cepheid, a Danaher company, to donate an initial shipment of Xpert Hemorrhagic Fever panel tests. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026. The first shipment has arrived in the DRC, with Cepheid coordinating with the U.S. government, WHO, Africa CDC, in-country ministries, and partners to accelerate deployment within regulatory pathways. The panel detects Ebola (including BDBV), Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever, Marburg, and Lassa viruses, with about a one-hour time to result on GeneXpert systems. There is an extensive installed base in DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda to support decentralized testing for rapid isolation and outbreak control, underscoring public-private collaboration and cross-border transmission risk management.

triage.headline_ja: Cepheid社がアフリカへの検査キット寄付でエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の診断ギャップに対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言した複数国にまたがるエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の集団発生であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ・ブンディブギョ株の発生が明確に述べられているDRCとウガンダのみを verified_locations に含めた。スーダンとルワンダは記事サマリーで主要な発生地として言及されていないため除外した。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。複数国での活動および公私協力体制の構築が記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: La Jornada: La OMS en tiempos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Jornada: WHO in the Ebola era.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva addressed Ebola era preparedness and financing. Debates centered on a revised International Health Regulations (IHR), a new funding framework, and stronger collaboration for epidemiological emergencies. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, alongside hantavirus activity, underscores that the COVID-19 era was not an anomaly and that rapid action is essential. Lessons include unfulfilled early promises and unequal access to treatment and vaccines, fueling moves toward a WHO Pandemic Accord and an Annex on Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS). Financing remains a challenge: voluntary, donor-driven funding has amplified the Gates Foundation’s influence; nations argue for sovereign funding to ensure global health priorities benefit all member states. President Trump urged withdrawing the United States from WHO.

triage.headline_ja: ラホルナダ：エボラの時代のWHO
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC and Uganda, hantavirus activity, and COVID-19 pandemic preparedness discussions. Multiple IHR criteria met (unusual/unexpected outbreak, international spread risk, potential trade/travel implications). Verified outbreaks in target countries (DRC, Uganda) with high sociopolitical attention at WHA.
triage.notes: Multiple pathogens reported: Ebola (Bundibugyo ebolavirus), Hantavirus, and COVID-19 context. Article discusses WHA response to outbreak preparedness and financing frameworks. Geographic mentions include Geneva (WHO headquarters, not an outbreak location) and USA (policy discussion only, no outbreak reported). Only DRC and Uganda verified as actual outbreak locations among target countries.

article.articleHeadline: Mycoplasma, l'infezione che ha colpito la principessa Bajrakitiyabha: perché può essere molto grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mycoplasma, the infection that struck Princess Bajrakitiyabha: why it can be very serious.
article.articleSummary: Mycoplasma infection, typically affecting the respiratory tract, can be asymptomatic in healthy individuals but may trigger severe, sometimes fatal disease in immunocompromised people. In this case, in Thailand, Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendira Debyavati developed health problems in December 2022 after a sudden loss of consciousness attributed to a Mycoplasma infection that impacted the heart. She died at age 47 after a prolonged coma. Mycoplasma is the leading cause of primary atypical pneumonia, though it can cause non-respiratory complications such as erythema multiforme, polyarthritis, autoimmune hemolytic anemia, hepatopathies, and cardiovascular or neurological diseases. The bacterium lacks a cell wall, enabling potential resistance to antibiotics like macrolides. Transmission occurs person-to-person via aerosols from coughing or sneezing. Treatment relies on antibiotics such as macrolides or tetracyclines; penicillin is ineffective. Anti-inflammatory management may include corticosteroids, sometimes with IV immunoglobulins.

triage.headline_ja: マイコプラズマ、タイ王女バジュラキティヤバ妃を襲った感染症：なぜそれほど深刻になる可能性があるのか
triage.triage_reason: 個別の歴史的な著名人の事例報告であり、現在進行中の感染症流行・集団発生を示唆する証拠がない。マイコプラズマの医学情報提供記事として捉えられ、新規シグナルとしての公衆衛生的懸念は認識されない。
triage.notes: 記事は2022年12月に発生したタイ王女の死亡事例（2026年6月の報道）に関する医学教育的記事であり、現在の流行を示唆しない。個人事例の遡及的報道であり、新規感染症シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Reports Surge In Shigella, Chikungunya Cases As Monsoon Fuels Disease Spread
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports a surge in Shigella and Chikungunya as monsoon intensifies, with one Nipah case in Kozhikode. Reported by the Directorate of Health Services, 24 deaths from communicable diseases since June 1 and 12 suspected deaths. Shigella shows 38 confirmed cases and one death this month, plus 20 suspected cases; since Jan 1, 2026 Kerala has 114 confirmed, 80 suspected, and two deaths. Shigella causes diarrhoea, fever and cramps, spreading via contaminated food/water or contact. Eight amoebic brain infections and two deaths reported this month; year-to-date 133 brain fever cases and 33 deaths. Chikungunya has 2,161 suspected cases and two suspected deaths this month; 617 confirmed cases and three deaths. Influenza leads with seven deaths and 529 infections; leptospirosis and Hepatitis A each cause two deaths (88 and 265 confirmed cases, respectively). Nipah in Kozhikode; officials say containment, chlorination of drinking-water sources, and awareness campaigns are underway; seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州、モンスーンが病気の流行を助長する中、シゲラとチクングニア症例の急増を報告
triage.triage_reason: 複数の公衆衛生上の懸念がある。IHR基準では異常性（複数疾患の同時急増）と国際拡大リスク（チクングニア、ニパウイルス）で2基準該当。WPROスクリーニングでは異常性、重症度（24死亡を含む）、流行しやすさ（水系感染、ベクター媒介）、管理可能性（既に対応中であるが多疾患同時発生で監視継続必要）で複数該当。モンスーンシーズンでの継続拡大リスク高。
triage.notes: ニパウイルス（Nipah）の1症例はコジコード地区で確認され、特に注視が必要。複数の水系・ベクター媒介感染症が同時に急増している点が特徴。モンスーン時期であり、さらなる拡大の可能性あり。6月1日以降24死亡、疑い死亡12例と既に相当な死亡報告がある。

article.articleHeadline: RS investiga caso suspeito de ebola na Grande Porto Alegre | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul investigates a suspected Ebola case in Greater Porto Alegre | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul is investigating a suspected Ebola case in Nova Hamburgo (Greater Porto Alegre). A 64-year-old man who recently spent time in Uganda is under evaluation after malaria testing; confirmation would come from Fiocruz. He will be moved to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre for specialized care and lab analysis, and if confirmed, referred to a national reference unit. Contacts are monitored for 30 days. In São Paulo, a second suspected Ebola case involves a 31-year-old Brazilian who worked in North Kivu, DR Congo; he returned June 6 with fever and diarrhea and was admitted June 9, then transferred to Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas. Earlier, a 37-year-old man from DR Congo with similar symptoms had Ebola ruled out and remains hospitalized at Emílio Ribas. Ebola, transmitted via bodily fluids, can cause fever and body pains, fatigue, progressing to diarrhea, vomiting, and bleeding, per CDC guidance.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスル州がグレーターポルトアレグレにおける疑いエボラ症例を調査 | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: 複数国でエボラの疑い症例が同時報告（ブラジル2件、DRC関連）され、国際的な懸念が高い。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさで懸念が存在するため。
triage.notes: ブラジルでは2件の疑いエボラ症例が報告：（1）ウガンダ滞在歴のある64歳男性（リオグランデドスル州）、（2）DRC北キブ州勤務の31歳ブラジル人（サンパウロ州）。両者とも症状が一致し、Fiocruzでの確認検査待機中。接触者監視が実施されている。エボラは高い致死率を有し、国際的な懸念が正当化される。

article.articleHeadline: CNJ aprova nota técnica sobre análise de benefícios a vítimas da síndrome do Zika - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CNJ approves technical note on the analysis of benefits for victims of Congenital Zika Syndrome - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: CNJ unanimously approved a technical note to guide the judiciary's analysis of potential impacts stemming from the administrative denial of special pensions for people with permanent disabilities associated with congenital Zika syndrome in Brazil. The decision, taken during a June 9 session, aims to provide legal parameters for interpreting relevant legislation and regulatory acts, and to outline possible effects of INSS denial, including increased judicialization of cases. The note also highlights reports from families about difficulties in documentation and medical-legal assessment procedures for benefits. It states that the absence of certain exams or laboratory confirmation should not, by itself, prevent recognition of a causal nexus when other clinical elements and patient history are compatible.

triage.headline_ja: CNJ（全国司法評議会）がジカウイルス症候群の被害者への給付分析に関する技術的メモを承認 - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は司法行政上の給付制度に関する技術メモの承認についての報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやその拡大を報告するものではない。ジカウイルス感染症の疫学的な悪化や国際的拡大のリスクを示す公衆衛生情報を含まない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のジカウイルス感染症の慢性的影響（先天性ジカ症候群）に関する司法行政上の給付制度について述べたもので、現在の感染症アウトブレイクや疫学的ホットスポット情報ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من نقاط غامضة لتفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of mysterious hotspots for an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the World Health Organization warns of mysterious hotspots amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Olivier Le Poulain, a WHO epidemiologist in eastern DRC, said several points remain unclear in high-risk areas and the overall scale of transmission is not yet fully understood. He stressed an urgent need to strengthen surveillance in those regions to better gauge spread and identify gaps in monitoring. The report provides no Ebola case or death totals. The warning underscores uncertainty around outbreak dynamics and potential undetected transmission in remote areas, highlighting the importance of vigilant surveillance, rapid data sharing, and targeted public health measures to guide responses.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ出血熱の流行に関する謎の集中地域について警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率を持つ感染症であり、DRCで流行が報告されている。WHOが監視体制の強化を求める不確実性と未検出の伝播の可能性が示唆されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に複数該当する可能性が高く、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内の不明確な監視ギャップと未検出伝播の可能性を強調しており、WHOが介入を求めている。死亡数・患者数の具体的な数値は記事に記載されていないが、エボラウイルスの病原性と懸念されている監視体制の不十分性を踏まえ、詳細な流行規模評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Avoid these foods during monsoon to prevent stomach infections, says gastroenterologist
article.articleSummary: Monsoon conditions in India, especially in Jaipur, heighten gastrointestinal illness risk as rainwater and humidity promote growth of bacteria, viruses, and fungi. A gastroenterologist, Dr Anil Kumar Jangid of CK BIRLA HOSPITALS, Jaipur, warns that cases of food poisoning, stomach infections, diarrhoea, typhoid, and gastroenteritis rise during the season. Key avoidances include street food due to poor hygienic practices and water contamination; leafy green vegetables and raw salads contaminated by soil or improper washing; cut fruits and uncovered juices exposed to air and questionable water; seafood whose quality and cold-chain integrity decline with monsoon; and deep-fried snacks such as pakoras and samosas which can worsen acidity and indigestion. Safer practices focus on freshly prepared foods, strict hygiene, ample water, and avoiding foods left uncovered for long periods. If greens are used, thorough washing, soaking, and full cooking are advised. The guidance underscores practical, season-specific food choices to reduce GI illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン中の胃腸感染症を予防するために避けるべき食物（消化器内科医による）
triage.triage_reason: 記事は予防的食生活ガイダンスであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。症例数、重症度、異常性の情報が記載されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はジャイプールの医学専門家による季節的な食生活予防ガイダンスであり、実際の発生症例報告ではない。モンスーン期に胃腸疾患リスクが増加することは既知の季節現象であり、異常性がない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bantul antisipasi munculnya penyakit saat musim kemarau panjang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bantul Health Office anticipates the emergence of diseases during the long dry season
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Bantul Regency Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Bantul) warns of diseases likely to emerge during an extended dry season in Yogyakarta. The head, Agus Tri Widiyantara, has ordered all healthcare facilities (Fasyankes) to push massive awareness campaigns (KIE) via social media about extreme weather risks. Public health messaging aims to protect residents from dehydration, vector-borne diseases, gastrointestinal disorders, malnutrition, and respiratory problems caused by dust and smoke. Influenza and eye irritation from airborne dust are highlighted as common dry-season illnesses, with children particularly at risk. Citizens are urged to practice clean living and healthy behavior (PHBS): drink clean water, frequent handwashing, maintain household cleanliness, and ensure balanced nutrition. Masks are advised outdoors, and especially for the ill to reduce respiratory illness and transmission. Emphasis on caregiver vigilance and community compliance.

triage.headline_ja: バントゥル保健局が長期乾期における疾病発生に備える
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザを含む複数の疾病が長期乾期に出現する可能性が予測的に警告されているが、既存の本格的な流行・患者数増加の報告ではなく、当局の予防・注意喚起段階。情報の充実待ちが必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア・ヨグヤカルタのバントゥル地区保健局による予防警告であり、現在の本格的な流行報告ではない。長期乾期に向けた予測的対策段階。ベクター媒介疾病やインフルエンザを含む複数疾病の同時流行リスクが指摘されているため、今後の患者数増加報告に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: How Philadelphia is preparing for measles and other disease outbreaks during FIFA World Cup events
article.articleSummary: Philadelphia is strengthening measles preparedness for FIFA World Cup events. The Lemon Hill fan festival in Fairmount Park will operate for 39 days, drawing over 1.5 million visitors. Measles vaccination rates in the region have fallen, creating pockets of under-vaccinated populations, with an outbreak currently sickening 52 people in Lancaster, Berks, Dauphin, and Lebanon Counties. Hospitals have added measles vaccination questions to ED screening; city labs have on-call staff to test suspected cases, and new posters educate on early signs. Officials have devised plans to quarantine large numbers if needed and to mobilize surge staffing and medical tents citywide. The two-year planning effort involves the Philadelphia Health Department and major systems, including Temple Health, Penn Medicine, and Jefferson Health. The article also notes an Ebola outbreak in parts of Africa, including the DRC, with a World Cup team in Houston.

triage.headline_ja: フィラデルフィアがFIFAワールドカップイベント開催中の麻疹およびその他の疾病流行に備える
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹とエボラの複合シグナル。フィラデルフィアでの麻疹流行（52人、複数郡に拡大）は異常かつ深刻であり、150万人超の大規模イベント開催に伴うヒト-ヒト感染リスクが存在。DRCでのエボラ発生も併記されており、国際的な流行拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクが認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはフィラデルフィア・ペンシルバニア州での麻疹準備体制を主題としているが、該当する対象国には該当しない（米国は対象リストに含まれない）。ただしDRCでのエボラ発生が併記されており、対象国としてDRCのみを検証位置に列挙した。IHR基準とWPRO基準の両方で高いスコアを示唆する内容であるが、詳細な患者数・死亡数・国際的拡大の具体的な範囲については不明な点が多い。フルRRAで詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": تفشي إيبولا يتسع في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak expands in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the World Health Organization reports the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths. Cases have been detected across 34 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, signaling broad geographic spread. Contributing factors include increased population movement, a weak health system, and ongoing food insecurity, all complicating response efforts in insecure areas. WHO and the government are scaling up surveillance, contact tracing, laboratory capacity, clinical management, and risk communication to contain the outbreak. The overall size of the outbreak remains unclear, underscoring the need for intensified containment and monitoring to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱がコンゴで拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の確認事例676件、死亡136件という重大な公衆衛生上の影響、地理的拡大、国際的拡散リスク、対応能力の限界が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内のIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州での発生が明記されている。2026年6月12日現在の統計に基づく。WHO、DRC政府による対応が進行中だが、不安定地域での対応困難、弱い保健システム、人口移動の増加などにより包含リスクが高い。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 'Blind spots' could hide full spread of Congo's Ebola outbreak, WHO
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's eastern Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain (no approved treatment or vaccine), has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with three new health zones affected and spread reported to neighboring Uganda. WHO epidemiologist Olivier le Polain warned of blind spots in high-risk areas, calling for stronger surveillance. Isolation capacity is limited, with about 250 beds across the three affected provinces. The outbreak reportedly went undetected for weeks as responders race to catch up. WHO has not issued projections; the US CDC warned it could reach scales similar to the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, which killed over 11,000. The report underscores potential underestimation due to surveillance gaps and cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 「盲点」がコンゴのエボラ流行の全容を隠す可能性、WHO警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株による大規模エボラ流行で676確定例・136死亡、ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告され、監視ギャップによる更なる拡大の危険性が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDR Congoを主要な発生地として記述。Ugandaへの越境伝播が報告されているが、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため検証対象外。Bundibugyo株は2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（11,000以上死亡）との比較言及があり、大規模化懸念が強い。監視ギャップによる実際の規模の過小評価が明示的に警告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в Конго превзе нови райони -- OFFNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo has spread to new areas -- OFFNews
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to three additional health zones, bringing confirmed cases to 676 and deaths to 136, according to a government report posted by the health minister on X. The newly affected zones are in North Kivu and Ituri provinces, signaling ongoing geographic spread within the country. Each health zone comprises a defined network of clinics and a referral hospital serving roughly 100,000–150,000 people. Congo reportedly has more than 500 health zones. The report provides the case and death counts but offers no further details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation beyond confirmed cases, infection sources, or any imported/exported cases. The outbreak remains active within the country's health-system framework.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、活発な流行が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は非常に高い致命率を持つ指定感染症。確認患者676名、死亡136名という数字は深刻。新たに3つの健康区域への地理的拡大が報告されており、継続的な国内拡散リスクが存在。政府レベルでの報告もあり、国際的な懸念が高まっている状況。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 'Blind spots' could hide full spread of Congo's Ebola outbreak, WHO suggests
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in eastern provinces including Ituri’s Bunia and Beni, has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with spread to three new health zones and to neighbouring Uganda. WHO epidemiologist Olivier le Polain warns of numerous blind spots in surveillance, especially in high‑risk areas, and notes a shortage of isolation beds—only about 250 across three affected provinces. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. The outbreak was undetected for weeks as responders race to catch up; WHO has not issued projections, while the U.S. CDC suggested the outbreak could reach the scale of West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis, which killed more than 11,000. Ongoing efforts include setting up Ebola treatment facilities like Bunia; response faces surveillance gaps and resource constraints.

triage.headline_ja: 「ブラインドスポット」がコンゴのエボラ禍の全貌を隠す可能性、WHO警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・予想外の発生・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模発生で676確定例・136死亡、ウガンダへの越境感染あり、監視体制の不備と資源不足が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州Bunia）が主な発生地域であり、ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されている。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations に含める。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは主題とされていないため除外。Bundibugyo型エボラ、治療法・ワクチンなし、監視の盲点、隔離床不足（250床/3州）という複合的な懸念により、フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF Warns: Ebola May Impact More Kids in DRC
article.articleSummary: As of 11 June, the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC (Ituri, Bunia epicenter) has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. At Rwampara Hospital in Bunia, routine care has declined as fear rises. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment beyond supportive care, elevating emphasis on surveillance, infection prevention, and community trust. Ituri children face severe malnutrition (over half under five) and more than one in five are zero-dose, signaling vulnerability. Early pediatric symptoms—fever, diarrhoea, vomiting, fatigue, loss of appetite—are difficult to distinguish from malaria, delaying detection. UNICEF's six-month plan targets 3.7 million people; 150 metric tons of supplies delivered to Bunia; 1,600+ community health workers; 24 decontamination teams reaching over 160,000 households; nurseries near Ebola Treatment Centres, first crèche in Bunia. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda (19 cases, 2 deaths) along an 800-km border. UNICEF seeks US$70.7 million, with US$17.4 million unfunded.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF警告：エボラがDRCでさらに多くの子どもに影響を及ぼす可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国に拡大する出血熱の流行であり、ワクチン・治療法なし、子ども層への脆弱性が報告されており、緊急フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥリ、ブニア）を主要発生地としており、ウガンダへの越境事例も記載。ただし対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルス株は承認済みワクチン・特異的治療がなく、栄養不良と予防接種未実施の子どもが特に脆弱である点が重要。UNICEF資金要請額の大部分が未充当。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العامة بأفريقيا: ارتفاع عدد المناطق المتضررة بإيبولا إلى 29
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health in Africa: the number of Ebola-affected areas has risen to 29.
article.articleSummary: Ebola incidents in Africa have risen to 29 affected areas, per Africa Public Health Institute, with authorities unable to define the outbreak's true extent. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 101 confirmed Ebola deaths have been reported, amid 35 new confirmed infections in the last 24 hours, bringing totals to 550 cases and 101 deaths. Cases span 17 health zones in Ituri, 7 in North Kivu, and 1 in South Kivu. Ongoing security challenges, with armed groups operating in Djugu, Irumu, and Mambasa in Ituri, continue to block humanitarian access to affected or at-risk zones. The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola was declared mid last month; officials say it had remained undetected for weeks, complicating containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの公衆衛生：エボラ出血熱の被害地域が29地域に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国での広がり、高い死亡率、セキュリティ課題による人道支援アクセス制限により、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生的には深刻な国際的な懸念事項である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにアフリカ全体での29地域への拡大に言及されていますが、具体的な感染確認と詳細なデータはDRC内に限定されています。セキュリティ課題（武装勢力）による人道支援アクセス制限は、制御不可能性を高めています。Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスが数週間検出されなかったという事実は、流行の真の規模を把握する困難さを示唆しています。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆醫院登革熱群聚5例確診　民生醫院緊急病房降載清消 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cluster at a Kaohsiung hospital with 5 confirmed cases; Minsheng Hospital Emergency Department reduces capacity and carries out cleaning and disinfection - OwlNews.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cluster detected at Kaohsiung's Minsheng Hospital, Taiwan, with 5 locally acquired cases confirmed as of 2026-06-12. The index patient, a 78-year-old woman hospitalized May 29–June 10, developed fever, dizziness and nausea on June 11; laboratory confirmation showed dengue virus type 2. Expanded testing on the adjacent 6th-floor ward found 4 more inpatients aged 79–91, prompting ward downscaling, an exit-only policy, mosquito-proof isolation, and environmental disinfection and spraying. By noon, 131 people had been tested. The hospital, a designated infectious-disease response facility, cited recent rain and potential stagnant water as mosquito breeding risk. The Taiwan CDC notes this is the first hospital dengue cluster since 2018, with a mobile outbreak team deployed; the infection source remains under investigation, with sequencing results due next week. Nationally, as of 2026-06-12, 74 dengue cases have been reported: 6 locally acquired (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported from Indonesia, the Maldives and Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄爆醫院登革熱群聚5例確診　民生醫院緊急病房降載清消
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄の病院におけるデング熱の院内集団感染（5例確認）は異常かつ予想外の事象であり、WPRO基準の「異常性」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当。IHR基準では「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、公開ニュース報道により社会的関心も高い。フルRRA実施の対象とする。
triage.notes: 台湾（香港・マカオ同様の扱いで中国に含める基準の対象外で、WPRO域内における独立した公衆衛生地域）におけるデング熱院内集団感染が主題だが、対象国リストに台湾は含まれていない。ただし記事では国家レベルの統計データで、インドネシア、モルディブ、ベトナムからの輸入症例が報告されており、これら対象国の関与が明記されているため verified_locations に含める。院内感染リスク、入院患者への曝露（高齢患者、重症化リスク）、ベクター対策の必要性から WPRO 5基準すべてに該当。2018年以来初の病院内集団感染と報告されており、異常性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: "Travel Warning" Tidak Asal Keluar Saat Ada Wabah Penyakit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travel Warning: Do Not Go Out Unnecessarily During a Disease Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia relies on travel advisories rather than travel warnings in response to disease outbreaks. Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda have prompted international concern and, in some cases, travel restrictions, with Ebola designated as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). In Indonesia, public commentary criticized the absence of a formal travel warning, while the Health Ministry issued an Ebola Awareness Circular on 19 May 2026. Globally, the term travel warning is treated as sensitive; many countries use graded systems such as the United States Travel Advisory (Levels 1–4), Australia Travel Advice (four levels), and EU Travel Advice, with classifications reflecting risk levels. The article emphasizes that travel advisories are guidance, whereas travel restrictions can include entry bans or mandatory quarantine, illustrating different national risk assessments during outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 渡航警告：病気の流行中に不要な外出をしない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がDRCとウガンダで発生しており、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。さらにPHEIC指定により公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダのエボラ流行が主題であり、インドネシアは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。PHEIC指定により国際的対応が必須となっている。米国とオーストラリアも発生地域として列挙されているが、記事サマリー上では彼らは渡航警告体制の例示のみで、実際の流行地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذّر من "نقاط غامضة" لتفشي إيبولا - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of 'unknown foci' of an Ebola outbreak - Al Ahly Stadium
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, the World Health Organization warns of unknown foci in an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Olivier Le Poulain, WHO epidemiologist based in Beni, eastern DRC, says there are multiple “unknown focal points” in high-risk areas and that the overall spread is not yet fully understood. He stresses an urgent need to strengthen surveillance in these zones to improve detection and monitoring of transmission. The remarks highlight gaps in knowledge about outbreak dynamics and call for enhanced surveillance to guide response efforts in eastern DRC’s affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ感染症の流行における「不明な焦点」について警告 - アルアハリスタジアム
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高く、未把握の感染源が存在することは異常・予想外である。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月12日付。DRCの東部地域（ベニ周辺）でのエボラ流行において、複数の「未把握の感染源」が存在することがWHOから指摘されている。これは感染動態が完全には理解されていないことを示唆し、監視強化の緊急必要性が強調されている。エボラウイルス病の本質的な高リスク特性に加え、疫学的不確実性が存在することにより、シグナルとして確実にピックアップする必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Ο Παγκόσμιος Οργανισμός Υγείας προειδοποιεί για "τυφλά σημεία"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The World Health Organization warns of "blind spots".
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the World Health Organization warns of numerous blind spots in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, noting that the full scale of transmission remains unknown. Olivier Le Polén, a WHO epidemiologist, spoke from Beni in the eastern DRC, stating that many areas deemed high risk still exhibit significant surveillance gaps. He emphasized that surveillance in these regions must be strengthened to improve detection of cases and tracking of transmission, enabling a more effective public health response. The remarks underscore ongoing uncertainty about the outbreak’s geographic reach and transmission dynamics, and call for intensified monitoring and field assessments to close these gaps and guide control measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：世界保健機関が「盲点」について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的懸念を持つシグナルイベント。DRCでの流行継続と監視体制の弱さが指摘されており、直ちにフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラは急性出血熱で致死率が高く、公衆衛生上の重大事象。DRCでの流行継続と監視ギャップの存在が確認され、国際的な懸念が高い。WHO幹部が直接現地から警告を発しており、重要度が高い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Clinical and genomic characterization of Influenza A co-infection with SARS-CoV-2 and Influenza B: a respiratory surveillance study in Assam, India
article.articleSummary: In a respiratory surveillance study in Dibrugarh, Assam, India (January 2025–August 2025), 4,948 respiratory samples were screened by multiplex RT-PCR with subtyping of Influenza A/B and targeted next-generation sequencing (NGS) on selected SARS-CoV-2 and Influenza A positives. Two co-infection cases were identified: (1) Influenza A(H3N2) co-infected with SARS-CoV-2 (Omicron XFG lineage) and (2) Influenza A(H3N2) co-infected with Influenza B (Victoria lineage). Both patients experienced mild illness without hospitalization. NGS assigned Influenza A(H3N2) to clade 3C.2a1b.2a.2a.3a.1, while SARS-CoV-2 fell under the Omicron XFG lineage. HA gene mutational differences were observed relative to the reference vaccine strain A/Darwin/6/2021. N-glycosylation analyses predicted conserved sites at positions 79, 181, 262, and 301, with an additional site at 110 in the co-infections. The study underscores limited genomic data from Northeast India and the need for sustained surveillance to monitor mutations and inform future vaccine strategies.

triage.headline_ja: インドのアッサム州における呼吸器サーベイランス研究：SARS-CoV-2とインフルエンザBの同時感染を伴うインフルエンザA臨床・ゲノム特性化
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA(H3N2)とSARS-CoV-2の同時感染およびインフルエンザAとインフルエンザBの同時感染が検出された学術的に重要な事例だが、両患者とも軽症で入院なく、発生件数は限定的（4,948サンプル中2件）であり、緊急対応を要する公衆衛生上の危機ではない。ただし遺伝子情報の限定性と今後のワクチン戦略への影響を考慮し、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はNature誌の学術論文であり、ディブルガル（アッサム州）での2025年1月～8月のサーベイランス研究結果。同時感染事例は現在のところ極めて限定的（2件）で、重症化なし。発見は遺伝子変異追跡の観点では重要だが、急速な拡大のシグナルはない。Northeast Indiaのゲノムデータ不足が強調されており、サーベイランス強化を推奨している。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria da Saúde acompanha investigação de caso suspeito de Ebola no Rio Grande do Sul - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department monitors investigation into a suspected Ebola case in Rio Grande do Sul - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: A 64-year-old man in Novo Hamburgo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, is under investigation for Ebola virus infection after recent travel to Uganda. Ebola-like symptoms include high fever, severe headache, muscle pains, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. A rapid malaria test detected Plasmodium falciparum, and malaria treatment has begun, but Ebola testing continues per Ministry of Health protocols. Final confirmation will depend on results from Fiocruz, the national reference laboratory. The patient will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre for specialized monitoring, with samples sent for laboratory analysis; if Ebola is confirmed, transfer to a national reference hospital will follow. The State Health Secretariat has notified the Ministry of Health, and contact tracing will monitor contacts for 30 days, with infection prevention and biosafety guidance issued to health services. Published 2026-06-12.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスル州でエボラウイルス疑い患者の調査を保健局が監視中 - ジョルナル・オ・スル
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い患者報告であり、ウガンダからの帰国者で異常かつ予想外のイベント。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの複数該当。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダからの帰国者でエボラウイルスの疑いが強い。マラリア陽性が判明しているが、エボラ検査が継続中。Fiocruzでの最終確認待ち。接触者追跡が30日間実施予定。ブラジルでのエボラ疑い患者報告は重要な公衆衛生シグナルであり、フルRRA実施の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Amazonian Monkeys Are Contracting Human Hepatitis B And Deforestation Is Making The Situation Worse
article.articleSummary: HBV detected in Amazonian monkeys; 88 primates across 28 species were sampled in Rondônia, Mato Grosso, and upper Japurá River. HBV was found in 17 of 49 primates from human-impacted areas; none of the 39 from remote areas carried the virus, suggesting human population density as a driver of infection in wild primates. This indicates human-to-primate (anthroponotic) transmission driven by deforestation and expanded human intrusion into habitats. Lab confirmation came from blood and liver samples; it is not yet known if the infection causes illness in monkeys or whether transmission monkey-to-monkey occurs. In humans, HBV spreads via blood, saliva, or intimate contact and can cause jaundice, weakness, fever, and liver disease; chronic infection can occur after six months. Indigenous peoples and locals hunt and eat around 3 million primates annually; hunting and pet trades increase contact. Study published in EcoHealth; researchers from University of Salford and Federal University of Amazonas.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾンのサルが人間のB型肝炎に感染中、森林破壊が状況を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（霊長類）でのHBV検出は異常で学術的関心が高いが、ヒト-ヒト感染の拡大リスクが不明確であり、現段階では情報不足。今後のヒト感染例増加の報告に注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物での検出に焦点があり、ヒト感染者の報告はない。記事は人間へのHBV伝播リスク（狩猟・ペット取引による接触機会増加）を指摘しているが、現時点では実際のヒト感染クラスタは報告されていない。アマゾン先住民や地域住民における感染拡大のリスク評価には追加情報が必要。学術誌EcoHealthへの掲載で国際的な関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: നിപ: പേടിവേണ്ട, ജാഗ്രത കൈവിടരുത്; അറിയേണ്ടതെല്ലാം | Nipah: Don't panic, don't let your guard down; everything you need to know
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah: Don't panic, don't let your guard down; everything you need to know.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus has been confirmed again in Kozhikode district, Kerala, triggering renewed Nipah vigilance in India. Nipah is an RNA virus of the Henipavirus genus, named after Kampung Sungai Nipah in Malaysia, where it was first identified. Natural hosts are four Pteropus fruit bat species; the virus is shed in saliva, urine, feces, and other secretions, enabling spillover to pigs and other animals and, subsequently, to humans. Human-to-human transmission is also possible. In Malaysia, pigs served as an intermediate host; Bangladesh has documented spillover from local bats. In Kerala, Nipah activity is reported to peak February–September. Symptoms begin with fever, headache, dizziness, fatigue, cough, and throat pain; progression can include vomiting, collapse, delirium, coma, and respiratory distress. Incubation is 5–14 days. Lab confirmation is via blood, urine, throat swab, or cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Prevention emphasizes avoiding bat contact and contaminated fruits/palm sap, protecting water sources, isolating suspected cases, PPE, and ward separation.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス：パニックするな、警戒を解くな；知っておくべきことすべて
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスはケーララ州で確認された高い致死性を持つヒト-ヒト感染可能な人獣共通感染症であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生影響の3基準に該当する。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的関心がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはバングラデシュとマレーシアも含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国での新規発生は述べられていない。サマリーは主にケーララ州インドでの最近の確認と、ニパウイルスの一般的な背景情報を扱っており、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。ニパウイルスは高い致死率（40-75%）を持つ人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染が可能な点が重要。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: WHO warnt vor "blinden Flecken"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: WHO warns of "blind spots".
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands, with WHO warning of blind spots in surveillance. As of June 11, 2026, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths are reported. The majority of cases are in Ituri, with growing local transmission in North Kivu and South Kivu; many cases in these provinces involve people who originated in Ituri. The outbreak is driven by ongoing conflict, displacement, and a weak health system; surveillance gaps persist in vulnerable districts and in Beni, where a WHO expert assists authorities. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and severe weakness. Africa CDC puts the case fatality rate at about 17%. UNICEF warns routine care is being foregone, risking higher child mortality; in Ituri, over half of children under five are malnourished. Cross-border concerns include Uganda reporting rising Ebola infections and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：WHOが「ブラインドスポット」について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認患者676名、死亡136名による深刻な公衆衛生影響、地域的に異常な拡大、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、国際的な渡航・貿易制限のリスクあり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）での大規模エボラ流行が主題。ウガンダの言及は国境を越えた波及を示唆しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。監視ギャップ、紛争による悪化、栄養不良などの複合リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'épidémie continue de s'étendre en RDC, dit l'OMS - Le Soleil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The outbreak continues to spread in the DRC, says the WHO - Le Soleil.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to widen, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of Thursday, according to the Congolese Health Ministry and WHO. The rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain is involved; no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Most infections are in Ituri Province, but cases have been reported in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO notes new cases almost daily in new health zones, reflecting the outbreak's true scale and high population mobility. Fragile health systems under security pressures complicate response, though DR Congo has Ebola management experience. Surveillance, case finding, and contact tracing are being strengthened; contact tracing now exceeds 70% of identified contacts. Key measures include safe and dignified burials, infection prevention in health facilities, rapid detection, isolation, care, and reinforced community engagement. Africa CDC reports Uganda's Ebola presence under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOによると流行は引き続きコンゴ民主共和国で拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された流行で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及）、およびトラベル・トレードへの制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダはサマリーで「エボラ存在は制御下にある」と記載されており、主要な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ワクチンや承認された治療法が存在しない稀なブンディブギョ株による流行であり、深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Namibia: Ebola Misinformation Stalls DRC Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola misinformation hampers Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak response, as Ituri province reports 115 deaths. A widely shared video claiming 'There is no Ebola here' illustrates distrust fueling the crisis, with one in three people in Ituri doubting Ebola's reality. Misinformation delays care and hampers contact tracing, as families withhold information and patients seek help late. Aid workers face security risks, including two Alima tents burned at a hospital after a body retrieval, stoned vehicles, and targeted burial teams; in Bunia, a relative nearly beat to death a safe-burial worker in late May. Ebola transmits via close contact and bodily fluids. WHO warns misinformation spreads as fast as the virus. Solutions emphasize rebuilding trust through community ambassadors, local-language outreach, and engagement of leaders, survivors, and traditional healers to support the public health response.

triage.headline_ja: ナミビア：エボラに関する誤情報がDRCの対応を停滞させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な対応困難、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC Ituri州での115人の死亡報告、ヒト-ヒト感染、医療体制の機能障害、国際的支援（WHO警告）が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事見出しにナミビアが含まれるが、本文サマリーはDRC Ituri州でのエボラ爆発を主題としており、ナミビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Ituri州での115人死亡、接触追跡の失敗、医療従事者への暴力、誤情報による対応阻害が記載されており、深刻な公衆衛生危機と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: RS investiga caso suspeito de ebola em homem que retornou de Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RS investigates suspected Ebola case in a man who returned from Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil: a 64-year-old man who recently returned from Uganda is under investigation after presenting symptoms consistent with infectious diseases. A rapid test detected Plasmodium falciparum malaria; treatment started. Ebola diagnosis remains unconfirmed under Ministry of Health protocols due to recent travel to a region with reported cases. The patient will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição (GHC) in Porto Alegre, the state's reference facility for such cases, and biological samples have been sent to Fiocruz for confirmation. If Ebola is confirmed, the patient will be moved to a national reference unit. Health authorities began contact tracing with 30-day monitoring for those exposed. Outbreaks are ongoing in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Officials stress Brazil's risk is very low, as Ebola transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids, not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: RS（リオグランデ・ド・スル州）がウガンダから帰国した男性のエボラ疑い症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス疾患の疑い症例で、確認待ちだが公式な調査・接触者追跡が実施されている。対象国DRCでの流行継続が記事で言及されており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルの疑い症例を主題としており、その患者の感染源はウガンダでの曝露と思われる。しかし対象国リストではウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでは流行が継続中と記事で言及されている。エボラ診断は未確認だが、Ministry of Health protocolに基づき調査・検査が進行中。Plasmodium falciparum マラリアが検査で確定。接触者追跡が30日間実施されている。ブラジル政府は「リスクは非常に低い」と強調しているが、シグナルとしてピックアップすべき国際的に重要なイベント。

article.articleHeadline: Duale defends Laikipia Ebola facility amid court dispute
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale defended a US-funded Ebola facility under construction at Laikipia Air Base as a precautionary preparedness measure, noting no Kenya cases of the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain. As of 12 June 2026, he stressed preparedness is not panic amid an ongoing DRC Ebola outbreak reported on 15 May and cross-border movement concerns. Construction at Laikipia Air Base—believed to be an Ebola quarantine centre—has sparked protests in Nanyuki and Laikipia, with at least three deaths; a Katiba Institute lawsuit seeks contempt against Duale and AG Dorcas Oduor for allegedly flouting court orders to halt work. Kenya has strengthened surveillance at entry points, lab readiness, healthcare worker training, risk communication, and isolation capacity; media should share verified information. The ministry will publish regular updates, and counties are urged to bolster rapid-response, surveillance, and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ前首相、法廷紛争の中でライキピア州エボラ対応施設を擁護
triage.triage_reason: ケニアにおけるエボラ対応施設の建設・整備に関する記事。DRC での進行中のエボラ流行への対応として位置付けられているが、ケニア国内での患者報告はなく、むしろ準備体制強化の議論が中心。情報不足のため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアのエボラ対応施設建設に関する法廷紛争及び準備体制であり、実際のエボラ患者発生報告はケニアにはない。参照されているDRC のエボラ流行は背景情報に過ぎず、主要な感染症イベント発生地はケニアとなるが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、IHR 基準・WPRO基準への該当はなく、シグナルとしてはピックアップ対象ではない。続報を注視する段階。

article.articleHeadline: بعد تسجيل 676 إصابة مؤكدة.. "الصحة العالمية" تدق ناقوس الخطر: إيبولا يتفشى في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After recording 676 confirmed cases, the World Health Organization sounds the alarm: Ebola spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-06-12, with infections detected across 34 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The World Health Organization says the outbreak continues to expand, driven by high population movement, a weak health system, and ongoing food insecurity, which complicate response efforts. WHO is supporting the government in surveillance, contact tracing, laboratory capacity, clinical management, and risk communication to stakeholders. The overall size and trajectory remain unclear. The report does not provide information on exported or imported cases. This summary reflects the situation reported on 2026-06-12.

triage.headline_ja: 676例の確定患者を記録した後、「世界保健機関」が警鐘を鳴らす：エボラがコンゴで蔓延
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラの広範な発生（676確定患者、136死亡）、34の保健ゾーンでの拡大、国際支援の実施、高い公衆衛生インパクト、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模発生。676確定患者と136死亡が記録され、Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu地域の34の保健ゾーンに感染が拡大している。WHOが積極的に対応支援を実施しており、人口移動の多さと弱い保健システムが拡大の主要因とされている。フルRRAの実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Murió a los 47 años la princesa de Tailandia; estuvo más de tres años internada y padeció una infección que se volvió "incontrolable"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Thai princess died at 47; she spent more than three years hospitalized and suffered an infection that became 'uncontrollable'.
article.articleSummary: Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha Mahidol, the king’s eldest daughter, dies at 47 after more than three years in hospital from a sudden illness. She suffered an abdominal infection and, by 2025, a severe bloodstream infection requiring life-support; in May 2026 the royal household said her infection had become uncontrollable and her condition deteriorated. Comatose since December 2022 after a serious heart problem during a military dog-handling training session, she had been hospitalized since. An accomplished lawyer and diplomat, she studied in the United Kingdom, Thailand, and the United States, earned a law degree from Cornell, and served as Thailand’s ambassador to Austria, with UN roles and advocacy for women’s rights. The palace will lay her remains in the Grand Palace with a noble funeral. The 73-year-old king has seven children; no heir has been publicly named, and lese-majeste laws shield the royal family.

triage.headline_ja: タイの王女が47歳で死亡。3年以上入院していた王女は「制御不能になった」感染症に苦しんでいた
triage.triage_reason: 本件は個人の医療死亡事例であり、感染症の流行・アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上の新規の脅威を示す感染症イベントではない。疾患名が特定不能で、公衆衛生的な影響の深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクのいずれも確認できない。
triage.notes: 本件は王族の個別死亡事例であり、感染症の流行や集団発生を示すイベントではない。記事は個人の医療経過と王室の相続問題に焦点を当てている。Bluedot APIが地政学的・国際的な文脈（オーストリア大使、英米での学位取得など）から複数国を検出したが、これは当該患者の個人的背景であり、感染症の発生地や拡大を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Lesão em jogo de futebol evolui para infecção geral e mobiliza helicóptero para salvar adolescente em Porto Alegre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Injury in a football match evolves into sepsis, and a helicopter is deployed to save a teenager in Porto Alegre.
article.articleSummary: Sepsis in a 12-year-old boy from Lajeado, Vale do Taquari, originated from a football-related injury, with the infectious focus spreading to the joints and requiring multiple prior surgeries. On 11 June, SAMU Porto Alegre coordinated an urgent aeromedical evacuation, with the PRF providing a helicopter to transfer the patient from Hospital Bruno Born, Lajeado, to Hospital Nossa Senhora da Conceição in Porto Alegre. Medical teams remained aboard throughout the intercity flight to provide continuous care and stabilization. Ground transport risks prompted the emergency airlift. Upon arrival in Porto Alegre, the patient was encaminhado to a high-complexity multidisciplinary facility for pediatric-focused care, including rheumatology among other specialties. The case highlights rapid air-assisted transfer for severe sepsis in a pediatric patient and the collaboration between SAMU and the Federal Highway Police.

triage.headline_ja: フットボール（サッカー）での怪我が敗血症に進行し、ポルトアレグレの少年救助のためヘリコプターが動員される
triage.triage_reason: 本件は個別症例（12歳少年の外傷由来敗血症）であり、公衆衛生的な流行または集団発生の兆候がなく、IHR基準および WPRO スクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。医療システムの機能を示すニュースに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一の外傷由来敗血症症例であり、感染症危機管理（EBS）の対象となるシグナルではない。医療輸送システムの有効性を示す個別事例。感染症の集団発生・流行の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Сборной ДР Конго разрешили въезд на ЧМ в США после карантина из-за вируса Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DR Congo national team was allowed to enter the World Cup in the United States after a quarantine due to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's national football team was cleared to participate in the FIFA World Cup 2026 in the United States after completing a 21-day quarantine imposed due to an Ebola outbreak in the country. The squad arrived in Houston, Texas, following the quarantine period. To satisfy U.S. authorities, the team quarantined in Belgium, where its training camp had been held, before boarding a flight to the United States via Paris. DR Congo will compete in Group K against Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan. The report highlights Ebola-related travel and quarantine requirements that affected preparation and entry for the tournament, with no further clinical details or case counts provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国代表がエボラウイルスによる隔離後、米国のワールドカップ出場が認められた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ関連の隔離措置に関する報道ですが、実際の感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、スポーツイベント（FIFA W杯2026）への参加制限に関する管理措置の報道です。サマリーに臨床詳細やケース数の記載がなく、IHRおよびWPRO基準を満たしていません。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のエボラアウトブレイクに関連する隔離措置の報道であり、現在のアクティブなエボラ流行の情報ではありません。スポーツイベント参加に関する行政対応の記事として分類されるべきです。Bluedot APIが複数の国を抽出していますが、実際のイベント発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみです。

article.articleHeadline: Jak nie złapać salmonellozy -- porady lekarza - Kurier Wileński
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How not to catch salmonellosis — doctor's advice — Vilnius Courier
article.articleSummary: Salmonella poses a stealth risk: bacteria have no odor or flavor, and contaminated foods often look normal. In Lithuania, as elsewhere, salmonellosis mainly spreads via eggs, chicken, and their products, but risk extends to vegetables, nuts, and spices.
