The State Food and Veterinary Service (VMVT) monitors Salmonella in poultry farms, yet protection must be strict across the food chain. Water polluted with agricultural sewage used for irrigation can introduce bacteria to crops; rodents, wild birds, and insects can transfer it to berries, fruits, or lettuce; in processing plants or kitchens it can spread via hands and unwashed tools. Preventive measures include washing hands, separate cutting boards, storing raw meat on the bottom shelf, cooking meat and eggs thoroughly, washing all produce, and disinfecting kitchen surfaces regularly. Through June 3, 2026, VMVT logged 35 reports of dangerous poultry/poultry products: 17 Polish, 16 Lithuanian, 2 Brazilian; vs 14/4 in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: サルモネラ菌に感染しないために――医師のアドバイス
triage.triage_reason: サルモネラ症は既知の食品衛生リスクであり、記事は予防啓発が主体。IHR基準に該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」が該当する可能性があるが、情報が限定的で、国際的拡大リスクや管理可能性の評価が不十分。続報を注視。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはリトアニアでのサルモネラ症予防啓発が主題。発生地域にはポーランド・リトアニア・ブラジルが含まれ、2026年6月3日までにVMVT報告として17件のポーランド産、16件のリトアニア産、2件のブラジル産危険家禽製品が記録されている。ただし記事本文が提供されていないため詳細な評価は困難。リトアニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはブラジルのみを含める。前年同期比での増加傾向が報告されているが、社会的関心の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'épidémie continue de s'étendre en RDC, dit l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The outbreak continues to spread in the DRC, says the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported for the Bundibugyo strain, which currently has no vaccine or approved treatment. Most infections are in Ituri province (northeast), but cases have now been identified in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO warns that the true scale is likely higher due to population mobility and ongoing insecurity, which hinder responses. Olivier le Polain, head of Epidemiology and Analysis for interventions, notes that surveillance, case finding, and contact tracing are being reinforced, with contact tracing now over 70% complete. Response priorities include safe and dignified burials, reducing infections in health facilities, rapid detection, isolation and care, and strengthened community engagement. Africa CDC says neighboring Uganda’s Ebola situation is under control following a May 15 confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: WHO、DRCでの流行の拡大が続いていると報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、エボラウイルス病という国際的に懸念される感染症の流行拡大。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain）の流行が東部DRCで拡大中。676確定症例、136死亡報告。34の保健地域に及び、ウガンダでも症例確認されている。ワクチンと承認治療法がない点、人口流動性と治安悪化による対応困難が懸念される。WHOが警告し、アフリカCDCも対応中。ウガンダの状況はコントロール下にあると報告されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Τα "τυφλά σημεία" ενδέχεται να κρύβουν την πλήρη έκταση της επιδημίας του Έμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: "Blind spots" may conceal the full extent of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have possible 'blind spots' according to WHO, with the rare Bundibugyo strain spreading beyond official estimates. The DRC announced the outbreak has reached three new health zones, reporting 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with spillover into neighbouring Uganda. Surveillance is uneven in high-risk areas, and there are only about 250 hospital beds available for isolation across the three affected provinces, hampering response. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved treatment or vaccine, and early responders say significant ground remains to cover. The US CDC has warned the outbreak could reach scale similar to West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic, which killed more than 11,000. Two Ebola-related deaths were confirmed at the Kpangba refugee camp in eastern Congo, housing about 30,000 internally displaced people, prompting reinforced prevention and response measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：「盲点」がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の全容を隠蔽しているおそれがある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準5つすべても該当する。エボラウイルス病の確認患者676名・死亡136名、ウガンダへの流出、治療法のない株、難民キャンプでの発症、西アフリカ2014-2016年の大流行との比較言及など、極めて高いリスク評価。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCが主題。ウガンダへの流出言及があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはシエラレオネ・アンゴラも含まれているが、記事サマリーに具体的な言及なく、DRCでの流行に関連する地理的参照と推定される。検証結果としてDRCのみ列挙。Bundibugyo株の治療法・ワクチン未承認、難民キャンプ（約30,000人）での確認患者、国内での監視体制不備（隔離病床約250床のみ）が管理可能性を著しく低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ekiti sets up emergency health committee to tackle cholera, Lassa fever
article.articleSummary: Ekiti State inaugurated a Public Health Emergency Operations Centre Steering Committee in Ado Ekiti on 12 June 2026 to strengthen health security and outbreak preparedness. Chaired by Commissioner for Health and Human Services Dr Oyebanji Filani, the committee will provide strategic direction, policy guidance and coordination for the centre. It responds to challenges including COVID-19, cholera, Lassa fever and measles, and notes Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as concerns. The government will invest in surveillance, workforce development, laboratory strengthening, risk communication and emergency coordination. Permanent Secretary Olusola Gbenga-Igotun says the move strengthens inter-sectoral collaboration, resource mobilisation, accountability and sustainability of preparedness. The centre will be the hub for preparedness, response and resource mobilisation, described by State Epidemiologist Dr Bosede Alowooye as a platform for coordination among experts, government and partners. Members include Information, Environment, Finance, Budget and Agriculture commissioners and Director-General, Transformation and Service Delivery.

triage.headline_ja: エキティ州、コレラとラッサ熱に対処するための緊急衛生委員会を設置
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤感染症（コレラ、ラッサ熱、エボラ、麻疹）が言及されているが、記事は主にナイジェリア（エキティ州）の備災体制構築に関するもので、進行中の大規模アウトブレイクの報告ではない。地域の公式な対応準備状況を示すシグナルとして継続監視を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア（エキティ州）の公式な衛生体制構築に関するもので、DRCおよびウガンダのエボラアウトブレイクは言及されているが主体的な発生報告ではない。対象国リストに該当する国での実質的な感染症イベント発生は確認できないため、verified_locationsは空配列。ただし複数の高リスク疾患と地域の対応強化が記述されているため、継続的な情報収集を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'épidémie continue de s'étendre en RDC, dit l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The outbreak continues to spread in the DRC, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with the vast majority of infections concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast. Cases have now been recorded in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, according to the World Health Organization. Olivier le Polain, head of the WHO Epidemiology and Analysis for Interventions, speaking from Beni in North Kivu, said new zones are identified nearly every day, suggesting the true scale is larger than detected, compounded by high population mobility. Health systems in the DRC remain fragile, and insecurity complicates response efforts, though the country has strong Ebola-management experience, particularly in the affected areas. The WHO emphasized that the response must fortify existing capacities and workforce, as coverage gaps persist in high-risk areas. Improved visibility will come as surveillance, contact tracing, and testing capacity are strengthened, especially in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO発表によると、同感染症の流行はコンゴ民主共和国で継続拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国境を超える流行の可能性が高く、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が見られる。シグナルとして認識し、フルのリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はカテゴリーIVの最高リスク疾患。DRCでの34の保健地域への拡大、人口移動による国境越境リスク、地域不安定性による対応困難性が確認されている。WHOが直接発表しており、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ για Έμπολα: "Υπάρχουν πολλά τυφλά σημεία - Άγνωστη η πλήρης κλίμακα της εξάπλωσης στη στη Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO on Ebola: "There are many blind spots - the full extent of the spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is unknown".
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is clouded by numerous blind spots that prevent an accurate assessment of its size and spread. WHO epidemiologist Olivier Le Polén, based in Beni in eastern DRC, warns that several areas remain under-surveilled and pose high risk, necessitating strengthened surveillance and rapid case investigation. The report emphasizes that the true extent of transmission cannot be determined with current data. In Uganda, 19 confirmed Ebola cases and two deaths have been reported, according to the WHO chief, illustrating cross-border threat. The WHO urges intensified surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and contact tracing to define the outbreak’s scope and guide an effective public health response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO声明：エボラ出血熱について「多くの盲点がある - コンゴ民主共和国での拡大の全体規模は不明」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模多国間発生で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の拡大、国際的な波及（ウガンダへの越境）、渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での確認例も報告されているが、主要な発生地はDRCで対象国リストに含まれるため検証地域に追加。サマリーが監視体制の不十分さと拡大の不確実性を強調している点が懸念材料。WHOからの警告レベルが高く、即座のRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola spreading to new regions in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding: 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported by Thursday, according to WHO official Olivier le Polain in Beni, North Kivu. Cases are identified in new health zones almost daily, though most remain in Ituri province. While most North and South Kivu cases involved people from Ituri, local transmission has now been recorded in those provinces as well. Ongoing conflict, large numbers of displaced people, and a weak health system create blind spots and hinder containment. UNICEF warns that families are avoiding routine hospital check-ups due to fear of infection, risking more child deaths. In Ituri, more than half of children under five are malnourished, worsening vulnerability. The full scale of the outbreak remains unclear and intensified surveillance and health services are needed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラがコンゴの新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数地域での異常な拡大、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラウイルス病は高致命率で国際的に懸念される疾患であり、複数州での二次感染と国境地域での拡大傾向がフルRRAを必要とする。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致命率が高く（この記事では20%）、複数健康地区での新規症例の毎日確認、地方伝播の発生、紛争地域での弱い保健システムなど、管理困難性が高い。栄養不良児童が多く（イトゥリでは5歳未満の50%以上）、脆弱性が増幅される。発生地域はDRC内のIturi州とNorth/South Kivu州だが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: DBD Masih Jadi Tantangan, Kemenkes Catat 39.672 Kasus hingga Mei
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Remains a Challenge as the Ministry of Health Records 39,672 Cases Through May
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s dengue fever remains a public health challenge. Ministry of Health data show 161,752 dengue cases in 2025 with 673 deaths; as of May 2026, 39,672 cases and 105 deaths have been recorded. Ongoing efforts emphasize vector control, surveillance, clinical management, and community empowerment via the 3M Plus movement: drain water storage, cover water containers, and recycle items that can breed Aedes aegypti. Plus measures include planting mosquito-repellent plants, inspecting water-holding sites, maintaining larvivorous fish, using mosquito repellents, installing screens on windows and vents, community cleanups, storing used clothing in closed containers, applying larvicides to hard-to-drain containers, and fixing leaky gutters and drainage. Innovations such as Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes and dengue vaccines are noted. The key challenge is implementing all strategies within a single, nationally integrated, evidence-based framework with strong cross-sector coordination, as highlighted during ASEAN Dengue Day in June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱は依然として課題、保健省が5月までに39,672件の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのデング熱は継続的な公衆衛生上の課題であり、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）の複数項目に該当するが、国内対策が進行中であり、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク基準の明確な言及がないため、情報が不足している状態での判定となる。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアでは風土病的疾患であり「予想外」ではないが、2025年の673死亡、2026年5月までに105死亡と持続的な死亡者が報告されている。国家レベルでの対策（3M Plus運動、ワクチン、Wolbachia蚊など）が進行中。ASEAN Dengue Day（2026年6月）での言及から地域的関心が存在する。国際的拡大リスクについては記事に明記されていないため「不明」と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Uganda is 'under control': Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Ebola is transmitted through close contact and bodily fluids. As of 12 June 2026, the Uganda outbreak is under control, with 19 cases and 2 deaths in nearly a month, almost all among Congolese nationals who crossed the border. Uganda has identified 792 contacts under active follow-up; WHO praised Kampala's strategy and noted a case fatality rate under 1%. The Africa CDC urges at least 40 contacts per confirmed case. In the DRC, the outbreak epicenter is Ituri province, with 635 confirmed infections and 127 deaths since the May 15 announcement. WHO has declared an international health emergency over the DRC outbreak. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. DRC has traced fewer than 5,000 contacts; authorities aim for about 24,000. A ceasefire in eastern DRC is urged to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラは「コントロール下にある」：アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済みで、DRCで635例・127死亡の大規模流行。シグナルとしてフルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行（635例、127死亡、Bundibugyo株）を主題としている。ウガンダでの輸入症例（19例、2死亡）は副次的な記述。DRC Ituri州が流行の中心地。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Un pasteur décédé, un cercueil vandalisé... À Mongbwalu en RD Congo, le patient zéro d'Ebola a peut-être été découvert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deceased pastor, a vandalized coffin... In Mongbwalu, DR Congo, Ebola's patient zero may have been discovered.
article.articleSummary: Researchers in the Democratic Republic of Congo pursue Ebola patient zero for the outbreak officially declared May 15 in Ituri's Mongbwalu. The probe centers on Paluku Makundi Denis, a 44-year-old Nande pastor who died in February in Bunia from peritonitis. His body was transported to Mongbwalu for burial, during which the coffin cracked and was replaced; the funeral drew dozens of mourners. Days later, relatives and attendees fell ill with fever, vomiting, and bleeding; by mid-February the pastor's brother died, and within about two weeks nearly 50 people had died in the community. Rumors linked misfortune to a curse tied to the damaged coffin, fueling a TikTok trend about coffins in Mongbwalu. Health authorities sent epidemiologists in early May; by June 9, roughly 40 Ebola deaths had been reported in Mongbwalu, with transmission believed to have circulated 4–6 months before official confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 故牧師、棺が損壊... コンゴ民主共和国モングバワルでエボラ出血熱の患者ゼロが発見された可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の宣言された流行で死亡例が多数、4〜6ヶ月間の未検出の伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: 5月15日に公式宣言されたItturi州Mongbwalu地区のエボラ流行。患者ゼロは2月に死亡した44歳の牧師と特定される可能性が高い。4〜6ヶ月間の未検出の伝播期間、葬儀を通じたスーパースプレッダーイベント、SNS（TikTok）による風評の拡大など複数の懸念要因あり。WHO通知基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Santé : deux nouveaux cas de Mpox détectés, la leptospirose recule, et les cas de dengue restent stables
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: two new Mpox cases detected, leptospirosis declines, and dengue cases remain stable.
article.articleSummary: Mpox: Two new imported cases from Madagascar bring Réunion Island’s 2026 total to 17 clade Ib cases (12 imported, 5 autochthonous; 3 secondary transmissions). Dengue and chikungunya remain active: 250 autochthonous dengue and 48 autochthonous chikungunya since January; weekly dengue around 20, with clusters in Saint-Leu, Saint-Pierre and Saint-Gilles-les-Bains; 6 imported dengue cases from Thailand, India, Tahiti, Madagascar and Kenya. Dengue virus serotypes: DENV1 dominant (156 analyses); DENV2 detected in 25% of analyses and reported in several communes. Leptospirosis: 195 autochthonous cases Jan 1–Jun 11; one death; 108 hospitalisations. Spatial distribution: South 45% (Tampon, Saint-Joseph, Saint-Louis, Saint-Pierre); East 28% (Saint-Benoît, Saint-André, Sainte-Rose); West 17% (Saint-Paul, Saint-Leu); North 10% (Sainte-Suzanne, Saint-Denis). After March peak, incidence declines but remains a risk. Public health note: rapid confirmation for dengue-like syndromes and a triplex PCR for chikungunya/dengue/leptospirosis is advised.

triage.headline_ja: 健康：2つの新しいMpox症例が検出され、レプトスピラ症は減少、デング熱の症例は安定している
triage.triage_reason: 複数の新興感染症（Mpox、Dengue、Chikungunya、Leptospirosis）が同時に発生しており、Mpoxは国際的に重要な人獣共通感染症であり、デング熱とチクングニアは局所的に流行しており、レプトスピラ症は既に195例を記録。IHR基準は3つ以上該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: レユニオン島（フランス海外県）での複数感染症の同時流行。Mpoxは2例がマダガスカルからの輸入症例であり、国際的に移動している。デング熱、チクングニア、レプトスピラ症は地元で持続的に流行。記事サマリーから、実際の流行地がレユニオン島（フランス領）であり、タイとインドは輸入症例のソース国として言及されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはThailandとIndiaのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Elsevier Limited: Elsevier launches Ebola Information Center with free clinical and research resources to support response to outbreak
article.articleSummary: Following the WHO's Public Health Emergency of International Concern declaration for an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, Elsevier launches the Ebola Information Center to provide free clinical and research resources for frontline responders, researchers, policymakers, and the public. The center aggregates Ebola Healthcare Hub with evidence-based clinical overviews, patient education, and drug monographs; free ScienceDirect Ebola content; LeapSpace AI workspace to map Bundibugyo virus pathology, treatment approaches, collaborators, and data analysis; The Lancet Ebola Collection and Cell Press Ebola Collection; SSRN Ebola Hub for early-stage, non-peer-reviewed research; and curated Mendeley Data across figshare, Zenodo, and Dryad. Content is freely accessible via publicly funded repositories with unrestricted reuse rights while the Center remains active. Additional resources will be added as new evidence emerges, emphasizing support for the ongoing outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: Elsevier Limited: エルゼビアがエボラ情報センターを立ち上げ、臨床および研究リソースを無料提供してアウトブレイク対応を支援
triage.triage_reason: WHO公開衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）として宣言されたエボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）のアウトブレイクである。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性）も複数該当する。WHO公式宣言があるため国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に記載されているが、記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国におけるアウトブレイク言及があり、WHO PHEICの対象国として両国が関連している。ただし対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしている。本イベントはWHO公式宣言があるため、優先度の高いシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Elsevier launches Ebola Information Center with free clinical and research resources to support response to outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). On 2026-06-12, Elsevier launched the Ebola Information Center to provide free access to clinical guidance, peer-reviewed research, early-stage findings, datasets, and AI-assisted tools to support global response. Resources include Ebola Healthcare Hub with evidence-based clinical overviews, patient education materials, and drug monographs; ScienceDirect free Ebola-related articles and book chapters; LeapSpace AI workspace to map Bundibugyo virus pathology, treatments, and collaborations; The Lancet Ebola Collection and Cell Press Ebola Collection, freely available; SSRN Ebola Hub for early, non-peer-reviewed studies; and curated Mendeley Data across figshare, Zenodo, and Dryad. Content will expand as new evidence emerges and is freely reusable via publicly funded repositories. This complements Elsevier’s prior support for SARS, MERS, Zika, Coronavirus, and Mpox.

triage.headline_ja: エルゼビア、エボラ情報センターを立ち上げ、臨床・研究リソースを無料提供してアウトブレイク対応を支援
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo virus によるエボラが DRC およびウガンダで PHEIC 指定されており、IHR 基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。また WPRO スクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）に該当し、国際的支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明確に「DRC およびウガンダ」での Bundibugyo virus によるエボラアウトブレイクを述べている。ウガンダ（ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。PHEIC 指定という重大な国際保健上の決定がなされており、複数の国際機関・主要学術出版社が対応リソースを動員している状況を反映。

article.articleHeadline: SpaceX's big day, Iran, Ebola's patient zero and Russian chess
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-12, Congo faces a deadly Ebola outbreak with investigators hunting for patient zero after linking transmission to a pastor's funeral. The report highlights epidemiologic tracing around funeral-related exposure as authorities seek to identify initial cases and interrupt transmission chains. No specific case counts, fatalities, or laboratory confirmation details are provided in the excerpt. Presented within a broader morning briefing, the item underscores persistent Ebola risk in Central Africa and the critical role of rapid public health investigation to contain spread. The article does not describe treatment options or vaccination status, focusing instead on locating the outbreak’s source and containment efforts tied to the funeral event.

triage.headline_ja: SpaceX's big day, Iran, Ebola's patient zero and Russian chess
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はハイインパクト疾患であり、DRCでの集団発生と患者ゼロ特定の公衆衛生調査が進行中。IHR基準で複数該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性の懸念が認められるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラ集団発生が明確に述べられている。葬礼関連の曝露と患者ゼロ追跡が報告されており、感染連鎖の遮断に向けた公衆衛生調査が進行中。具体的な患者数や死亡数は記載されていないが、「致命的な集団発生」と表現されており、ハイリスク疾患の確認事例として取り扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in RDC, MSF: "La risposta non sta tenendo il passo con la diffusione dell'epidemia" | HealthDesk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC, MSF: "The response is not keeping pace with the spread of the epidemic" | HealthDesk
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is spreading faster than containment efforts can keep pace, according to Médecins Sans Frontières two weeks after the official declaration. For the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, there are no approved vaccines or targeted therapeutics. Local data analysis capacity is limited, leaving hundreds of biological samples awaiting screening and hindering precise assessment of severity and reach. International movement restrictions are disrupting logistics, with border and airport closures delaying delivery of essential medical devices, humanitarian aid, and specialized personnel. The outbreak hits an already vulnerable health system, reducing access to non-Ebola care and dampening facility attendance due to fear of contagion. MSF calls for immediate scaling of diagnostic testing and a community-engaged response to counter disinformation, build trust, and ensure communities seek care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ、MSF：「対応が流行の拡大に追いついていない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の流行拡大、国際的規制影響、重症度、管理能力の課題が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strain（ブンディブギョ株）でワクチン・特異的治療薬がないことが特に懸念される。診断検査の遅延（数百のサンプルが検査待ち）、国際的な移動制限による物流混乱、脆弱な保健システムが複合的に対応を困難にしている。MSFによる公式声明があり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TB di Sulbar capai 30,9 persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB cases in West Sulawesi reach 30.9 percent.
article.articleSummary: West Sulawesi Province (Sulbar) reports tuberculosis (TB) case detection at 30.9% of its 2026 estimated burden, above the national average of about 30%, placing Sulbar among provinces with the best TB case-finding nationally. As of June 7, 2026, Sulbar leads in key TB indicators: TB Treatment Enrollment for drug-susceptible TB at 92.9% (highest national level for immediate treatment after diagnosis) and TB treatment success for drug-resistant TB at 100%. Health official dr Nursyamsi Rahim in Mamuju highlighted coordinated efforts across districts, primary health centers, hospitals, health workers, community cadres, and partners. The Garatta TB program—Active Community and Integrated Health Workforce Movement for TB control—aims to accelerate elimination through early case finding, treatment support until cure, and stigma reduction, with a target TB elimination by 2030. Focus remains on expanding case finding and TB preventive therapy (TPT) for at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 西スラウェシ州の結核患者数が30.9%に達する
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西スラウェシ州の結核ケース検出率が全国平均と同程度で高い成功率を示している報告。公衆衛生上の危機ではなく、むしろ良好な制御状況を示すものであり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア西スラウェシ州の結核対策の成功事例を報告するもの。ケース検出率30.9%は全国平均と同程度で、治療成功率が高く（薬剤耐性TB 100%）、むしろ良好な疫学状況を示している。シグナルとしてのピックアップ要件に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya, proteste a Nanyuki contro il centro di quarantena Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya, protests in Nanyuki against the Ebola quarantine center.
article.articleSummary: Protests flare in Nanyuki, Kenya, near Laikipia Air Base over a planned quarantine center for U.S. citizens who had contact with Ebola. The Kenyan court had suspended the agreement with the United States, but the government proceeded, triggering renewed demonstrations and earlier violence that left two deaths, per ANSA. There have been no confirmed Ebola cases in Kenya, though the country is deemed at risk. On May 16, 2026, the WHO declared the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Kenyan travel advisories note enhanced health screening for travelers from Uganda and the DRC due to the outbreak. The quarantine center, located at a military base, raises concerns about potential spillover even as authorities push ahead with the project.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ隔離センターに対するナニュキでの抗議
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生上の関心が高く、IHR基準に複数該当。WHOが5月16日にコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ outbreak を国際的懸念事項(PHEIC)と宣言しており、ケニアも地域的リスク国として認識されている。社会的・政治的関心も高い（抗議活動、死亡事例あり）。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし、DRC由来のエボラ outbreak の地域的波及リスク（ケニアでの隔離センター設置、ウガンダとの関連性）があり、対象国DRCの確定的な outbreak に基づくシグナルとして PICKUP 判定。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが対象国リストにないため同様に除外。記事サマリーの主題は DRC でのエボラ outbreak とその地域的影響（ケニアでの対応）。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola sigue extendiéndose en RD Congo, advierte la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic continues to spread in DR Congo, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, according to the WHO as of June 11, 2026. The rare Bundibugyo strain has caused 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths. Most infections are in Ituri province (northeast), with cases in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. New zones are identified nearly daily, suggesting the true scale may be higher due to population movement. Health systems are weakened and insecurity hampers response, though Congo has Ebola-management experience. Surveillance and testing capacity, including contact tracing now over 70% complete, are being strengthened. Uganda reported Ebola confirmed on May 15, with Africa CDC noting the outbreak there is under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大を続けている、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、予想外の稀なBundibugyo株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に最高レベルの危機管理対象疾患。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu各州）での発生を主題としており、Ugandaの事例は「Africa CDCが管理下にある」との記述に留まる。DRCのみを対象国として検証位置に含める。Bundibugyo株は稀なエボラ株で、676件の確認症例と136人の死亡が報告されている。健康システムの弱体化と不安定な治安が対応を阻害している点が懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola continuă să se extindă în RDC, anunță OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues to spread in the DRC, WHO announces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to spread, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, which currently has no vaccine or approved treatment. Most transmissions occur in Ituri province, but cases have been reported in 34 health zones across Ituri, North and South Kivu. WHO warns daily new cases are emerging in additional zones, indicating the outbreak's scale. The response faces fragile health systems and insecurity, but the DRC has Ebola-management experience; emphasis is on leveraging existing capacities and workforce. Gaps persist in high-risk zones; visibility will improve as surveillance, contact tracing, and testing capacity are strengthened, especially in North Kivu. Currently, just over 70% of contacts are being identified. Essential measures: safe and dignified burials, reducing infection risk in health facilities, rapid detection, isolation, surveillance, and community engagement. Africa CDC notes Uganda's imported outbreak (May 15) is under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大を続けている、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、複数地域での急速拡大と隣国への波及が報告されているため、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダの輸入症例は制御下にあると述べられているため、verified_locationsには含めない。DRCが主たる発生地域。676確認症例、136死亡、致死率約20%の深刻な状況。ワクチン・承認治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による。34の保健ゾーンに拡がり、複数地域での同時多発的拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra aumento de hospitalizações por VSR e gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records an increase in hospitalizations due to RSV and influenza.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports rising hospitalizations from respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and influenza across the country, per Fiocruz (June 11). In Epidemiological Week 22 (May 31–June 6), RSV admissions increased nationwide, while influenza A and B also climbed as cooler weather drives transmission in confined spaces. The InfoGripe bulletin shows 11 federative units at alert, risk, or high risk for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) in the past two weeks, with a long-term upward trend; 16 others show interruptions or declines, though 12 remain at alert or risk, including Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais and Bahia. Since 2026 began, Brazil has recorded 3,591 SRAG deaths. RSV mainly drives hospitalizations in children up to 4 years; rhinovirus predominates in 5–14; influenza A affects adults and the elderly, with influenza B rising in 5–14 and 15–49. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene, masking in health facilities and crowded places, isolation when symptomatic, and vaccination as the key protection.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、RSVおよびインフルエンザによる入院数増加を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。複数の呼吸器ウイルス同時流行による入院急増は地域的脅威であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル全国で RSV、インフルエンザ A/B による同時流行が進行中。Fiocruz による公式発表で、11州が SRAG に関し警報または高リスク状態にある。2026年初から 3,591 人の SRAG 死亡が報告されており、小児から高齢者まで幅広い年代に影響。季節的（冬季）な呼吸器ウイルス流行パターンだが、複数病原体の同時増加は社会的・医療的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Epidemia continua a alastrar-se na RDCongo - OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Epidemic Continues to Spread in the DRC - WHO.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread, with 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths linked to the Bundibugyo strain as of 12 June 2026. Most infections are in Ituri province, but transmission has been reported in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The true scale is likely higher due to population mobility and security challenges. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment, so containment relies on barrier measures and rapid case detection. Significantly, surveillance and contact tracing are being reinforced; about 70% of contacts are currently traced. Essential controls include safe and dignified burials, reducing infection risk in health facilities, isolating and treating patients, and robust community engagement. Uganda’s outbreak, linked via Africa CDC, has been described as controlled.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：流行はコンゴ民主共和国で拡大し続けている - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。致死的な新規株（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模流行で、ワクチン・治療法なし。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行は2023-2024年に西アフリカで検出された珍しい株。676確認症例、136死亡、致死率20%。34ヘルスゾーンに拡大。ウガンダ関連症例も報告されているが、サマリーではDRCが主題。対象国リストにウガンダはないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・治療法がないため、検査強化・接触者追跡・隔離・安全な埋葬などが主要対策。人口移動と治安課題により実被害はより大きい可能性。

article.articleHeadline: Un pasteur décédé, un cercueil vandalisé... À Mongbwalu en RD Congo, le patient zéro a peut-être été découvert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deceased pastor, a vandalized coffin... In Mongbwalu, DR Congo, patient zero may have been discovered.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, declared May 15. Investigators focus on Pastor Paluku Makundi Denis, who died in Bunia in February from peritonitis; his body traveled to Mongbwalu for funeral on February 4, during which the coffin cracked and was burned by attendees. In the days after, illnesses appeared; the pastor’s brother died February 16, and within two weeks nearly 50 people had died in the community with fever, vomiting, and bleeding—signs of the Ebola variant behind the ongoing outbreak. Rumors of a curse linked to burning the coffin circulated on TikTok, while a local tune referenced the coffin incident. By June 9, Congolese authorities reported about 40 Ebola deaths in Mongbwalu; epidemiologists believe the virus may have circulated 4–6 months before official confirmation on May 15. Investigators arrived in early May, facing distrust as they pursue patient zero.

triage.headline_ja: 故牧師、棺破損... コンゴ民主共和国モンバワルで患者ゼロが発見された可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の新規集団発生がDRCで宣言され（5月15日）、複数のIHR基準を満たす。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（既に40人以上の死亡）、国際的拡大リスク、および管理可能性の課題が認識される。
triage.notes: エボラ病の新規集団発生が5月15日に宣言され、Ituri州モンバワルで発生。患者ゼロの特定に向けた調査が進行中。地域社会内での情報信頼性の課題と伝播ルートの複雑性が認識されている（葬儀での棺破損、4-6ヶ月の事前循環の可能性）。WPRO基準における全項目該当により、フルリスク評価の実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Geneva, June 12, 2026 (AFP) - Ebola spreading into new areas in northeast DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading into new areas in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to a World Health Organization update released on 12 June 2026 from Geneva. The report notes ongoing transmission and expansion into additional districts in the northeast, indicating a widening outbreak. The article provides no specific case counts, deaths, onset dates, or laboratory confirmation details. It does not detail infection sources or whether cases are imported or exported. A separate photograph caption in Swakopmund, Namibia describes a TVET programme launch and is unrelated to the Ebola coverage. The piece underscores ongoing public health risk in DR Congo’s northeast and the need for continued surveillance and coordinated WHO response.

triage.headline_ja: ジュネーブ、2026年6月12日（AFP）- エボラがDRコンゴ北東部の新しい地域に拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予期しない地域拡大、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限の可能性）。エボラは高い致死率と国際的脅威を持つ第一種感染症であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、エボラウイルスの実際の発生地域はDRコンゴ北東部のみ。ジュネーブはWHOの声明発表地であり、ナミビア（スワコプムンド）の記載は関連のない別の写真キャプションのため、verified_locationsから除外。記事では具体的な症例数や死亡者数が記載されていないため、より詳細な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: "Τυφλά σημεία" και ανησυχία για την εξάπλωση του Έμπολα στο Κονγκό | AlphaTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: "Blind spots" and concern about the spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | AlphaTV
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-12, WHO epidemiologist Olivier Le Polen, reporting from Beni in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, expressed concern about the Ebola outbreak. He said the true extent of the epidemic remains unaccounted for, with several areas where data are limited and the surveillance picture is incomplete. These blind spots imply elevated risk of undetected transmission beyond currently known cases. The World Health Organization calls for strengthened surveillance and monitoring mechanisms in these zones to better map spread, confirm cases, and guide control efforts. The report emphasizes gaps in observation rather than providing case counts, underscoring the urgent need to improve epidemiological surveillance to prevent further expansion of Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の拡大に関する「盲点」と懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱という高病原性・致死率の高い感染症で、DRCでの流行拡大懸念が WHO によって正式に報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は WHO が監視する最優先感染症の一つ。記事では DRC 東部ベニ地域での流行が進行中であり、監視体制の不備（「盲点」）により実際の流行規模が過小評価されている可能性が指摘されている。これは国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念となる。

article.articleHeadline: Butantan mantém estudo clínico da vacina contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butantan continues clinical trial of the dengue vaccine.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Butantan continues clinical trials of its dengue vaccine in four research centers in Southern Brazil after the Health Ministry suspended nationwide vaccination on June 8 following investigations of serious adverse events, including two deaths. Begun in January, the trial enrolls dengue-naïve adults aged 60–79 to compare antibody responses with those in earlier trials, using the region's low dengue incidence for tighter safety assessment. Field work is in Porto Alegre and Pelotas (Rio Grande do Sul) and Curitiba (Paraná), planned to last about a year with safety as the primary endpoint. Director Ésper Kallas said the public-vaccination pause is precautionary and restart will depend on rigorous data analysis. Despite the pause, Butantan remains confident in the vaccine's potential to aid dengue control, with ongoing discussions with health authorities to define next steps and, after detailed safety analysis, provide new data supporting safety and future use in Brazil's public health network."}

triage.headline_ja: ブタンタンがデング熱ワクチンの臨床試験を継続
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチンの臨床試験中断と関連する医療安全イベントであり、国内で重大な懸念が生じているが、現時点は感染症の新規発生・流行ではなく、臨床試験の安全性問題が主題。情報不足により継続経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントはデング熱ワクチンの臨床試験中断に関連する公衆衛生上の懸念（2名の死亡を含む重大有害事象）であり、IHR基準を2つ満たす。ただし、これは既知の流行対応ではなく、ワクチン安全性調査が主題であるため、感染症シグナルとしての優先度は相対的に低い。保健当局が関与し政府の関心が高く、ブラジル国内で重要な医療政策問題となっている。継続的な監視と続報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penyakit Menular, Rutan Tanah Grogot Gelar Sosialisasi Hanta Virus Bersama Dinkes Paser
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent Infectious Diseases, the Tanah Grogot Detention Center Holds a Hantavirus Socialization Session with the Paser Health Office.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, Rutan Kelas IIB Tanah Grogot and Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Paser conducted a Hantavirus socialization session at the Tanah Grogot detention center. Attended by staff and representatives of inmates (WBP), the program aimed to raise awareness and vigilance against infectious diseases. Officials explained that hantavirus can be transmitted via rodents’ droppings, saliva, or urine, and covered symptoms, risk factors, and actions for suspected cases. The session emphasized hygiene, environmental cleanliness, and measures to prevent rodent presence in work and living areas. It also served to strengthen coordination between Rutan Tanah Grogot and the Paser Health Office, reaffirming commitment to promotive and preventive health efforts and inter-agency cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症予防のため、タナグロゴット刑務所がパセル保健局とともにハンタウイルス啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既に発生している感染症イベントではなく、ハンタウイルスの予防啓発・社会化活動の報告である。確認された患者数、発症例、または異常な感染症クラスタの報告がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハンタウイルスの予防啓発活動に関する報告であり、実際の感染症イベント（患者発生、集団発症）ではない。刑務所での感染症対策強化は行政当局による正常な対応活動であり、シグナルの基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Grande do Sul investiga caso suspeito de ebola em idoso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul investigates suspected Ebola case in elderly man.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is under investigation in an elderly man in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, after a malaria rapid test came back positive; malaria treatment has started while Ebola is ruled out. Samples will be sent to Fiocruz for laboratory confirmation, and the patient will be transferred to Porto Alegre's Grupo Hospitalar Conceição for specialized care. If Ebola is confirmed, the patient would be moved to a national reference hospital. Contacts will be monitored for 30 days to detect any symptoms, with infection prevention measures coordinated by health services. In São Paulo, a 31-year-old Brazilian woman is a suspected case. She was transferred to Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas, is stable and in isolation, and follows biosafety protocols. She traveled to North Kivu in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, landed in Brazil on June 6 and developed diarrhea and fever starting June 9. The notification cites travel to a transmission area and symptoms, triggering surveillance and care.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州が高齢者のエボラ疑い症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例2件（ブラジル）が報告され、うち1件はDRC北キヴ州への渡航歴があり国際的拡大リスクを示唆。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・深刻度で該当、WPRO基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はWHO通知対象感染症。疑い症例1（リオグランデ・ド・スル州）はマラリア陽性であるが並行してエボラ検査中。疑い症例2（サンパウロ州）はDRC北キヴ州への渡航歴があり、6月9日より症状（下痢、発熱）を呈しており、国際的なトランスミッションリスク因子を複数保有。両症例ともFiocruzでの確認検査待機中。30日間の接触者監視体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola sigue extendiéndose en RD Congo, advierte la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues to spread in DR Congo, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with cases rising and reaching new geographic areas, according to the WHO. As of Thursday, 676 cases have been confirmed, with 136 deaths, linked to the uncommon Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The majority of infections are in Ituri Province (northeast), but cases have been recorded in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Figures come from the Congolese Ministry of Health and were disseminated by the WHO on 2026-06-12. Ongoing transmission is being monitored as the outbreak expands geographically.

triage.headline_ja: RD Congoでのエボラ流行が拡大し続けている、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認された流行事例で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確認されたアウトブレイクで、676例の確認患者、136名の死亡が報告されている。複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）および34の保健ゾーンに拡大しており、治療法やワクチンが不在。2026年6月12日時点でのWHO報告に基づく。対象国DRCで実際に発生しているため検証済み。

article.articleHeadline: Plotki i dezinformacja utrudniają walkę z epidemią Eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rumors and misinformation hinder the fight against the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Intense misinformation and mistrust obstruct Ebola response in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where a Bundibugyo virus outbreak has been unfolding for weeks. As of 12 June 2026, authorities report 363 confirmed infections and 62 deaths, with likely undercount. Many residents distrust official communications, cling to traditional remedies, and some deny the disease’s existence; families often arrange privately organized funerals, despite the fact that Ebola remains contagious after death and funerals should be supervised. Initial health responses prioritized more common Ebola strains, delaying recognition of the Bundibugyo outbreak, which was officially confirmed on 15 May. Deep-seated regional conflicts, displacement, and limited access to healthcare and education amplify skepticism toward authorities and aid groups, feeding conspiracy theories that NGOs created the outbreak for funding or that vaccines cause infection. These dynamics hinder outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: デマと誤った情報がエボラウイルス感染症との闘いを阻む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。確認症例363名、死亡62名の稀少なBundibugyo株のアウトブレイク。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は稀少で致死率が相対的に低いが、本例では公式発表で確認症例363名、死亡62名（致死率17%）と報告されている。2026年5月15日の公式確認後、複数週間のアウトブレイク継続中。地域の紛争、変位、低い医療アクセス、医療不信、誤情報がレスポンス阻害要因。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ（ID 203312）。

article.articleHeadline: Потврђена два смртна случаја од еболе у Конгу, СЗО упозорава на слепе тачке"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two Ebola deaths confirmed in Congo; WHO warns of blind spots.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related deaths were confirmed among internally displaced persons in the Kpangba refugee camp in eastern Congo, where about 30,000 refugees are housed. UNHCR reported the deaths in a Reuters story. WHO epidemiologists warn of surveillance blind spots that could understate the outbreak’s true reach, particularly in high-risk areas. Congo reported the virus has spread to three additional health zones, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; the outbreak has also crossed into neighboring Uganda. Hospitals report shortages of beds for isolating patients. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is neither approved therapy nor vaccine; WHO has yet to complete a full assessment of the outbreak’s scope. The US CDC warns the outbreak could reach the scale of West Africa’s 2014-2016 epidemic, which killed more than 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者2人が確認、WHOが監視の死角を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。確認された死亡、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境）、治療法やワクチンの欠如、監視の隙間がある。国際的な懸念と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（治療法・ワクチン未承認）による致死的アウトブレイク。難民キャンプ（Kpangba）での発生、隣国ウガンダへの越境確認、監視の隙間による実際の規模把握困難など、複数の公衆衛生上の重大リスク要因あり。記事はウガンダの越境を述べているがサマリーで主要な発生地はコンゴであるため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола е сериозна: Защо няма да се превърне в пандемия?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is serious: Why it will not become a pandemic?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) triggers serious concern, with hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths, and spread to Uganda. CDC modeling warns that without timely, effective measures the epidemic could exceed the West Africa 2014–2016 crisis, which killed over 11,000. The WHO declared a health emergency in May; earliest cases may date back to February. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo strain; initial tests sought the more common Zaire strain, delaying recognition and response. Transmission remains through contact with bodily fluids of severely ill patients, placing health workers and caregivers at greatest risk. It is unfolding in a remote, resource-limited area, with armed conflicts and mistrust hindering contact tracing. There is no vaccine specifically for this strain; existing vaccines target other variants, and experimental therapies are in trials, with results months away. Authorities have strengthened surveillance, contact tracing, and border screening to mitigate cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行は深刻：なぜパンデミックにはならないのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、予想外の展開（Bundibugyo株）、国際的拡大リスク、高い重症度と死亡率を示す。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC内での多数症例（数百例）・死亡例（数十例）、ウガンダへの拡大、CDC警告（西アフリカ2014-2016年危機〔11,000死〉を上回る可能性）、WHOの5月の保健上の緊急事態宣言が述べられている。Bundibugyo株による流行は稀であり異常。武装紛争、社会的不信、資源不足という複雑な文脈での対応困難性を指摘。ただし対象国リストではDRCのみ該当し、ウガンダは非対象。

article.articleHeadline: How health workers in Dubai are helping to tackle deadly Ebola outbreak in Africa | The National
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, Mongbwalu) and Uganda is being tackled with international support. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency last month. In the DRC, 91 deaths have been reported from 550 cases; Uganda has at least 19 cases and two deaths. MSF, including Dubai-based experts, is mapping containment and has set up a 60-bed Ebola treatment hospital in Mongbwalu and plans to reactivate a 32-bed centre in Kampala, focusing on rapid detection, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials and community engagement. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine; testing capacity is limited, though trials may begin soon. Displacements—Ituri about one million and South Kivu about 1.2 million—complicate surveillance in insecure areas, risking a prolonged outbreak without diagnostic and facility scale-up.

triage.headline_ja: ドバイの保健労働者がアフリカのエボラ流行に対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行で、IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRC及びウガンダでの死亡例・感染者が報告され、WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言。国際的な支援体制が構築されており、高い社会的関心と管理上の課題が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri、Mongbwalu）とウガンダ（Kampala）でのエボラ流行が主題であるが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ドバイ（UAE）は支援側の地域であり、実際の流行地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株による流行で承認済み治療法やワクチンがなく、大規模な人口移動による監視困難が報告されており、継続的なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola se extinde în RDC. OMS avertizează că amploarea reală ar putea fi mai mare decât datele oficiale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading in the DRC. The WHO warns that the real scale could be larger than official figures.
article.articleSummary: All Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains active, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of 12 June 2026. The epidemic is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Cases have been reported in 34 health zones across Ituri province (northeast) and in North and South Kivu. WHO cautions the spread is concerning amid high population mobility, and the true scale is likely larger than detected due to fragile health systems and insecurity. Surveillance, contact tracing, and testing are improving, with authorities now identifying just over 70% of contacts, an improvement over previous weeks. Key measures include safe and dignified burials, reducing nosocomial transmission, rapid case finding, isolation, care, and strengthened surveillance and community engagement. Uganda reports an Ebola outbreak confirmed May 15, with the AU indicating it is under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大。WHOは実際の規模が公式統計より大きい可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤度が高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダでも確認）、予想外の感染ルート（Bundibugyo株）が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでのエボラ確認も記事内で言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの活動流行は2026年6月12日時点で676確認症例、136死亡。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法がないため極めて危険。人口移動の多さと脆弱な保健システムが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: تفاقم تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية: خلاف أميركي أوروبي حول قيود السفر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Worsening Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: American-European dispute over travel restrictions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths, spreading in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo lineage, for which no vaccines or approved therapies exist. WHO assessments place the national risk as very high, and regional risk as high, while global risk remains low. Ongoing challenges include armed conflict, weak health infrastructure, misinformation, and suboptimal contact tracing (about 62% of contacts reached vs a 90–95% target). The European Union continues funding and coordination for containment, and the United States has imposed travel restrictions on foreigners who have visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan, plus plans a quarantine facility in Kenya for exposed Americans. Some recoveries have been reported in Ituri, highlighting the benefits of early diagnosis and adequate care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行の悪化：渡航制限をめぐる米欧紛争
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の大規模流行イベントであり、国際的拡大リスク、国際的関心の高まり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確である。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに米国、スーダン、ケニア、ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーを精査するとこれらは米国の渡航制限政策の対象国またはキャンプ設置予定地であり、実際のエボラ流行の発生地ではない。DRCが唯一の実際の発生地である。Bundibugyo lineageのワクチン・治療法不在、武装紛争による対応困難、接触追跡率の低さ(62%)などが管理可能性の懸念要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans l'Est : l'implication des journalistes sollicitée dans la riposte contre l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the East: journalists' involvement sought in the response to the epidemic - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is confirmed in three eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Ituri as the epicenter and spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. As of 12 June 2026, health authorities and MSF lead the response, with Ebola Treatment Centers in Mongbwalu (Ituri), Beni, Goma, and Bukavu, and about a dozen additional health facilities supported. MSF notes there is no approved treatment or vaccine, emphasizing basic infection-control measures: avoid contact with patient bodily fluids, thorough hand hygiene, seek medical care for symptoms, and avoid handling the corpse. MSF has delivered nearly 100 tonnes of materials and will increase funding to sustain the response, working under the Ministry of Health via INSP and with WHO. Journalists were urged to rely on reliable sources for accurate Ebola information.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の東部での流行：流行対策への記者の関与が求められている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定例が DRC 東部 3 州（イトゥリが震源地）で報告されており、IHR 基準 4 つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航/貿易制限リスク）。確定例報告と多地域への拡大は高優先度シグナル。
triage.notes: Ebola virus disease の確定例が DRC 東部の Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu の 3 州で報告されている。WHO, MSF, 保健省が対応にあたっており、複数の Ebola Treatment Centers が設置されている。2026 年 6 月時点での現行流行状況の報道。対象国リストでは DRC は ID 203312 で含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz alerta para crescimento de hospitalizações por gripe e bronquiolite infantil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz warns of an increase in hospitalizations due to influenza and pediatric bronchiolitis.
article.articleSummary: RSV and influenza drive rising pediatric hospitalizations in Brazil, according to Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin released 12 June 2026. The report notes a growing trend across 11 states, with respiratory infections in children intensifying. No precise case or death counts are provided. Vaccination through the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS) is essential for prevention, and specialists advocate routine immunization alongside non-pharmaceutical measures. When symptoms appear, use of masks and isolation is recommended to curb transmission. The bulletin underscores the need for vigilant monitoring of pediatric respiratory disease activity and emphasizes vaccination as a key public health tool to reduce severe outcomes associated with RSV and influenza.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruzがインフルエンザと小児気管支炎の入院増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: RSVとインフルエンザの流行指標があり、複数州での小児入院増加が報告されているが、具体的な患者数・死亡数が提供されていない。IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」の判定が困難なため、情報充実を待つ段階と判断。
triage.notes: Fiocruzの公式警告（InfoGripe bulletin）に基づく報告であり、政府・公開の関心が高い。ただし定量的な重症度指標（入院数、死亡数）が記載されていないため、IHR基準の『深刻な影響』判定が困難。3州以上での増加傾向が示唆されており、WPRO基準の『流行しやすさ』『長期曝露』は該当。続報で具体的統計データが提供される場合はPICKUP昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: InfoGripe: cresce número de hospitalizações por VSR e gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: InfoGripe: rising number of hospitalizations due to RSV and influenza.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces rising hospitalizations for severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) linked to Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) and influenza in 2026, with 3,591 SRAG deaths recorded to date. Tatiana Portella of Fiocruz’s InfoGripe Bulletin urges preventive measures: frequent handwashing; masking in health facilities and crowded, poorly ventilated settings; isolation if flu or cold symptoms appear, or, if isolation isn’t possible, wear an N95/PFF2 respirator. Vaccination remains essential for priority groups: influenza and RSV vaccines to reduce risk of severe disease or death. Age-stratified lab data show SRAG surges in children ≤4 years are mainly driven by RSV, while rhinovirus predominates in 5–14-year-olds. Recently, SRAG linked to influenza A has risen among youths, adults and older adults, with influenza B increasing especially in ages 5–14 and 15–49. Ongoing burden underscores vaccination and infection-control measures in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: InfoGripe: RSVとインフルエンザによる入院数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な増加傾向、国際的拡大リスク）。ブラジルにおけるRSVおよびインフルエンザの入院増加は既知の病原体による季節的流行であるが、死亡数3,591件と重症度が高く、システム監視（InfoGripe）が機能している状況。フルRRAで詳細評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル公衆衛生機関Fiocruzの公式監視システム（InfoGripe Bulletin）に基づいている。RSVとインフルエンザAの同時流行により、特に小児と高齢者での重症化が報告されている。予防接種と感染対策の強化が推奨されている。WPRO地域外であるが、感染症イベント自体の重要性とスクリーニング基準該当により PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: 老人入住精神病院7年后查出梅毒 家属质疑医院责任
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly man diagnosed with syphilis seven years after being admitted to a psychiatric hospital; family questions the hospital's liability.
article.articleSummary: In Harbin, Heilongjiang Province, China, an elderly man admitted for 15 years to Harbin Psychiatric Specialty Baiyuapo Hospital was diagnosed with syphilis in 2018, seven years after admission. The family, led by Mr. Chen, says the hospital has since instructed discharge but provided no information about syphilis treatment. Attempts to place the patient in long-term care facilities were blocked due to infectious-disease concerns. From 2018 to 2023, medical records list diagnoses of organic mental disorder, vascular dementia, and syphilis, yet show no syphilis-specific medication or therapy. A video shows red-brown skin lesions on the patient, not reflected in skin-exam notes. The patient had previously been transferred to an infectious-disease hospital for syphilis assessment but remained in the psychiatric hospital and was moved to the hospital’s newly established 14th Therapy Ward housing multiple syphilis patients. The family questions hospital liability and infection-control practices.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢男性が精神病院入院7年後に梅毒診断、家族が病院の責任を疑問視
triage.triage_reason: 梅毒は既知の慢性感染症で、本件は医療施設内での個別の患者管理・責任追及に関する医療事故訴訟的性質が強い。国際的拡大リスクや異常な流行兆候はなく、公衆衛生学的には新規シグナルとして該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は単一患者の医療施設内での梅毒診断遅延と医療過誤に関する民事紛争であり、感染症の流行・異常集積・公衆衛生学的脅威を示唆する証拠がない。梅毒患者の存在は医学的事象ではなく、施設の感染管理体制の不備を示唆する可能性があるが、集団発生の兆候は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola sigue extendiéndose en RD Congo, advierte la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to spread in DR Congo, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of June 11, 2026, attributed to the Bundibugyo strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Most infections are in Ituri province (northeast), but cases have been reported in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, reflecting significant population movement. The WHO cautions that the real scale is likely higher due to surveillance gaps and insecurity that hamper response, though the country has deep Ebola experience. Contact tracing is improving, now covering just over 70% of contacts. Health systems remain strained; emphasis remains on enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and testing capacity in high-risk areas like North Kivu. In neighboring Uganda, Africa CDC says the outbreak there is under control as of May 15.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、コンゴ民主共和国で拡大が続く（WHO警告）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体であり、確認患者676名、死亡者136名という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、複数州での多地域拡大、ワクチン・治療法がない株での国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性を備えている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は統制下にあるとされているが、記事の主題はDRコンゴの拡大である。DRコンゴは対象国リストに含まれるため含める。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法がない点で特に懸念が高い。人口移動による広域拡大（34の健康地帯で確認）と監視体制の脆弱性が特記される。

article.articleHeadline: Elle était plongée dans le coma depuis près de quatre ans : la princesse de Thaïlande meurt d'une infection "incontrôlable"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: She had been in a coma for almost four years: the Thai princess dies of an 'uncontrollable' infection.
article.articleSummary: Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendira Debyavati, elder daughter of King Maha Vajiralongkorn, died June 11, 2026, at age 47 from a bloodstream infection. She had been hospitalized in the province of Nakhon Ratchasima since December 2022 after a cardiac event and had remained in a coma for nearly four years. In August 2025 the palace said she suffered a serious bloodstream infection and depended on medical devices to support pulmonary and renal function. A later bulletin three weeks earlier noted a serious deterioration and an infection that had become uncontrollable, preparing Thais for the inevitable. The royal palace announced her death on June 12, 2026. She was a potential heir to the throne; the king has seven children and succession rules favor male heirs.

triage.headline_ja: 4年近くの昏睡状態から：タイの王女が「制御不能な」感染症で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは個人の医学的死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生・流行ではない。感染症の拡大リスク、異常性、または国際的脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は王族個人の死亡報道であり、感染症の公衆衛生的な集団発生ではない。「Unknown Illness」との疾患分類は不適切。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、感染症監視の対象とするシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading into new areas in northeast DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo spreading to new areas as of 2026-06-12. 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, plus 119 suspected cases and 32 recoveries. Bundibugyo species with no approved vaccines or treatments; outbreak centered in Ituri province, also in North Kivu and South Kivu. Case numbers and geographic spread expanding; new health zones identified almost daily amid high population mobility. Contact tracing now just over 70% of contacts, still below ideal. Isolation capacity of 250 beds across affected provinces is insufficient and needs rapid scaling up. Cross-border spread to Uganda reported, with 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; African Union says Uganda situation is under control. Many high-risk areas remain with surveillance improving but incomplete, indicating the full outbreak scale is not yet clear.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が北東コンゴ民主共和国の新たな地域に拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国にまたがる現在進行中の多地域エボラ流行であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu各州）でのエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダへの越境感染も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo種でワクチン・承認済み治療薬がない点、接触追跡率が70%にとどまる点、隔離容量が不足している点が重要な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC commends cooperation with China in fight against Ebola outbreak amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: 654 lab-confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 129 deaths, as of June 12, 2026. The outbreak is expanding geographically, with Ituri Province cited as a major hotspot where many contacts remain unidentified or are not being actively followed. Africa CDC Director General Jean Kaseya flagged gaps in contact tracing and outlined factors driving spread: delayed detection, high mobility, insecurity, community resistance, and uneven tracing across health zones. Operational constraints include unsafe burials, community mistrust, limited case management capacity, funding shortages, and security challenges. The Ebola virus causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, systemic pain, and possible internal/external bleeding; fatality rates vary by viral subtype. Africa CDC commended cooperation with China, noting substantial support—financial, human resources, and public health commodities—across Africa to aid outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがエボラ出血熱の流行対策における中国との協力を称賛、症例増加の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。654件の確認症例と129死亡を伴う進行中のエボラ出血熱の多国間流行であり、緊急対応が必要なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus subtype（BDBV）による多国間流行。DRCとウガンダでの症例報告だが、対象国リスト内はDRCのみ。記事中では中国との協力が強調されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。接触者追跡の不備、高い移動性、地域社会の抵抗、資金不足など複数の運用上の制約が存在。

article.articleHeadline: கேரளாவில் பள்ளி மாணவர்களை தாக்கும் ஷிகெல்லா நோய் தொற்று அபாயம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shigellosis threatens schoolchildren in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis outbreak identified in a government-aided school in Kerala’s Wayanad district, with 16 children hospitalized for illness symptoms. Following a 2020 Shigellosis outbreak in Kerala that affected all age groups, health authorities successfully contained it then. Causes include unsafe food, water contamination, and sanitation problems. Health officials detected bacteria in the school's borewell; 16 students admitted. District administration ordered temporary school closures; statewide cases exceed 126. Affected districts: Wayanad, Kozhikode, Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Alappuzha, and Malappuram, under strict surveillance. Symptoms include bloody and mucus-containing diarrhea, severe abdominal pain, fever, and vomiting; residents with these symptoms are urged to seek hospital care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州の学童を脅かすシゲラ菌感染症
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数地区で126件以上の症例、入院患者16名、学校閉鎖措置の実施が確認される。
triage.notes: インド・ケララ州でのシゲラ菌感染症アウトブレイク。ワヤナド地区の学校で16名が入院、州全体で126件以上の症例。6地区（ワヤナド、コジコード、ティルヴァナンタプラム、コラム、アラップザ、マラプラム）が影響下にある。2020年の同州でのアウトブレイク歴あり。WPRO基準全項目該当により強いシグナルとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola continua se espalhando na RDC, alerta OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic continues to spread in the DRC, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to spread, WHO warns. Data from the Congolese Ministry of Health, disseminated by the WHO, show 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of Thursday, linked to the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The vast majority of infections are concentrated in Ituri province (northeast), but cases have been reported in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, indicating expansion to new geographic areas. The Bundibugyo strain’s lack of a licensed vaccine or treatment highlights the ongoing challenges in controlling this outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で引き続き拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が認められる。WHOが公式に警告している確認済みの流行である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の流行。確認症例676例、死亡136例。ワクチンや承認された治療法がない稀な株である点が特に懸念される。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州の34保健地域に拡大している。WHOによる公式警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreads to crowded displacement camp in Congo
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related deaths confirmed in Kpangba displacement camp in eastern Congo, where about 30,000 refugees live. The victims were a mother and daughter who died May 31 and June 1 and were tested for Ebola by the World Health Organization after death. The outbreak has now spread to three provinces—Ituri, South Kivu and North Kivu—since the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Congo has reported 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; neighboring Uganda has 19 cases. The Bundibugyo strain involved has no approved treatment or vaccine. Aid workers warn that crowded tents and poor sanitation in displacement camps heighten transmission risk and could fuel rapid spread and panic. The outbreak went undetected for weeks and first responders say they are playing catch-up.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生、コンゴの過密な難民キャンプに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響を伴う異常事象で、国境を越えた拡大リスクが実証されており、国際的な渡航・貿易制限の対象となる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での発生を主として述べており、ウガンダへの拡大も記載されているがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。シエラレオネは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリー内で具体的な発生情報がないため除外。過密な難民キャンプでの発生という要素が急速な拡大と制御困難性を高める。Bundibugyo株による治療法・ワクチンの欠如が深刻性を増す。

article.articleHeadline: Após surto de ebola, RD Congo é liberada para a Copa do Mundo | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After an Ebola outbreak, DR Congo is cleared for the World Cup | A TARDE
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo triggered a World Health Organization alert, with more than 500 confirmed cases and dozens of deaths. Despite the outbreak, the DR Congo Leopards were cleared to enter the United States for the 2026 World Cup, arriving in Houston from Paris around 14:30; all squad members reportedly gained entry. Earlier, a 21‑day Belgian ‘sanitary bubble’ had been proposed. Preparation included a closed‑doors friendly in Orléans, France, a 2‑1 defeat to Chile, and a planned match in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, canceled due to Ebola concerns. None of the players reside in DR Congo, and a Kinshasa training leg was canceled as a precaution. DR Congo qualified by beating Jamaica in the intercontinental playoff and will debut June 17, 2026, vs Portugal in Houston, with Colombia and Uzbekistan in the group. DR Congo last appeared in 1974 as Zaire.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行後、コンゴ民主共和国がワールドカップ参加を許可される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行は500例以上の確定患者と複数の死亡を伴う深刻なイベントだが、記事の主題はサッカー選手団の渡米であり、流行自体の医学的展開ではない。対象国内での現在進行中の流行情報が限定的。
triage.notes: IHR基準は4つすべて該当しPICKUP水準を満たすが、記事は2026年のワールドカップ関連のニュースであり、現在進行中の流行状況の詳細情報が限定的。Bluedot APIが付与した多数の地名（スペイン、フランス、米国等）は選手団の移動経路または試合予定地であり、実際の流行発生地ではない。コンゴ民主共和国内での流行の現在の規模、進行状況、制御状況に関する具体的なアップデート情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。続報でコンゴ民主共和国内の流行が継続・拡大していることが確認されればPICKUPに昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Конго: два летальных исхода в лагере беженцев - MigNews - Новости Израиля и Мира на русском языке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: two deaths in a refugee camp
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, two Ebola-related deaths occurred among internally displaced people in the Kpangba refugee camp in the Democratic Republic of Congo, housing about 30,000 refugees. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain), has 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with transmission extending into neighboring Uganda. High camp density raises transmission risk; isolation capacity is severely limited with only 250 beds across three affected provinces. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo strain. U.S. CDC warns the epidemic could reach the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (>11,000 deaths). WHO does not offer long-term projections but calls for immediate strengthening of epidemiological surveillance and expanded isolation infrastructure in all affected zones, noting several blind spots in high-risk regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ熱の流行：難民キャンプでの2人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行（676例、136死亡）で、隣国ウガンダへの拡大あり。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、イベントはコンゴ民主共和国のKpangba難民キャンプで発生し、隣国ウガンダへも拡大しているが、対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国のみが該当する。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチンおよび治療法が承認されていない。米国CDCは2014-2016年西アフリカの流行規模（11,000人以上の死亡）に達する可能性を警告しており、WHOは疫学サーベイランスの強化と隔離インフラ拡張の必要性を指摘。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: केरल में Nipah Virus का नया खतरा, संपर्क में आए 77 लोग, जानें यह कैसे फैलता है
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Nipah Virus Threat in Kerala: 77 People Came Into Contact; Learn How It Spreads
article.articleSummary: Kerala's Kozhikode district reports a new Nipah virus case in a 45-year-old man, with 77 contacts identified and 15 high-risk under monitoring as of 12 June 2026. Nipah is a zoonotic virus, primarily carried by fruit bats, first identified in 1999 in Malaysia and Singapore, with cases reported in India, Bangladesh, and Southeast Asia. Transmission occurs via bat saliva, urine, or feces on contaminated fruit, and potentially through raw date palm juice; infected animals, notably pigs, can spread it, and human-to-human transmission via saliva, blood, or other fluids risks caregivers. Early symptoms appear 4–14 days after exposure and include fever, headache, myalgia, weakness, sore throat, cough, and breathing difficulties; severe cases may progress to encephalitis, seizures, and coma. Prevention focuses on hygiene, avoiding raw date palm juice, limiting animal contact, and PPE for caregivers; vigilance and monitoring are essential to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でのニパウイルスの新たな脅威：77人が接触、どのように感染するかを知る
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（高い死亡率を持つ人獣共通感染症）の新規発生をケーラ州コーチンで報告。77人の接触者と15人の高リスク者が監視下にあり、人−人感染の可能性があり、IHR基準（異常性、重症度リスク、国際的拡大の可能性）を満たす。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高い致死率（40-75%）を持つ新興ウイルス。記事はインドのケーラ州での発生を主としており、歴史的にはバングラデシュ、マレーシア、シンガポールでも報告されているが、本イベント情報は現在のインドでの発生に焦点。77人の接触者追跡と15人の高リスク者監視は活動的な疫学対応を示唆。人−人感染のリスク、高い重症化率、および動物−人界面での感染源により、国際的関心と対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Spreads to Crowded Displacement Camp in Congo
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related deaths were confirmed in the Kpangba displacement camp in eastern Congo, where about 30,000 refugees reside, signaling rapid transmission risk in crowded camps. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, has spread to three provinces—Ituri, South Kivu and North Kivu—since the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The victims were a mother and daughter who died May 31 and June 1 and were tested for Ebola by the WHO after death. As of June 12, Congo reported 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; neighboring Uganda has 19 cases. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. Poor hygiene and cramped conditions in camps, with shared facilities, heighten transmission risk, and responders note the outbreak went undetected for weeks while efforts are being scaled at Bunia’s new Ebola treatment facility.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの混雑した国内避難民キャンプへのエボラ感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、国際的な支援と監視が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。Bundibugyo株には治療法やワクチンが承認されていない。3州にわたる急速な拡大、避難民キャンプでの人口密集、衛生状況の悪さが懸念される。ウガンダへの二次的な拡大もある（19例）。

article.articleHeadline: India sends measles vaccines, medical supplies to Maldives amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: India dispatched 20,000 doses of measles vaccines and about 3 tonnes of medical supplies to the Maldives to address rising measles cases and boost immunisation coverage. The Maldives Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed appreciation for the timely assistance in a social post, noting the effort reflects close bilateral cooperation. The consignment, announced in a New Delhi press release dated 11 June 2026, was handed over at an official ceremony attended by Maldives Minister of Health Geela Ali. India positions itself as a trusted first responder in the region, aligned with New Delhi's Neighbourhood First policy and Vision MAHASAGAR (Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions). Earlier the Indian High Commissioner, G. Balasubramanian, met State Pharma Managing Director Shah Mahir to discuss further strengthening bilateral health cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: インドがモルディブに麻しん（はしか）ワクチン・医療物資を送付、感染者増加に対応
triage.triage_reason: モルディブでの麻しん患者数増加が報告されており、地域的な関心が高い。しかし記事の主体はインドからの支援提供であり、詳細な流行状況・重症度・患者数が不明であるため、情報が不十分。
triage.notes: 記事はインドによるモルディブへの医療支援を主題としており、実際の麻しん流行事例の詳細（患者数、重症度、発症地域の確定）が記載されていない。モルディブでの『rising cases』言及があるが、具体的な流行状況は記事に記述されていないため、モルディブは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。インドは支援国として該当。続報で流行の詳細情報が得られれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذر من "نقاط غامضة" لتفشي إيبول
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of "mysterious points" in the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak context: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has several unresolved aspects; the total scope remains unclear. Olivier Le Bolin, a WHO epidemiologist based in Beni in eastern DRC, described numerous 'mysterious points' in high-risk areas and stressed an urgent need to bolster surveillance there. The statement underscores gaps in monitoring, aims to refine case detection, reporting, and understanding of transmission patterns in affected districts, informing outbreak response efforts. The remarks reflect ongoing uncertainties about how widespread the virus is and where transmission is occurring, and they call for intensified data collection, laboratory confirmation, and field investigations. No case counts or deaths are mentioned in the briefing.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ流行における「謎の点」について警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。DRCからの直接報告でWPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は常時IHR基準を満たす高優先度案件。記事では死亡者数・患者数が明記されていないが、監視体制の不備と「謎の点」の存在が強調されており、流行規模と伝播パターンの不確実性が指摘されている。DRCの東部地域（ベニ）が焦点。WHO疫学者による現地からの直接報告であり信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah scare in Kerala: Animal Husbandry dept. opens control room for fast intervention
article.articleSummary: June 12, 2026: A Nipah virus infection case in Kozhikode district led the Animal Husbandry department to open a district-level control room at the Animal Disease Control Project Office, Bank Road, Kozhikode, to curb animal-to-human transmission and coordinate surveillance and response. Surveillance is intensified in Ramanattukara municipality, where the case was reported, and surrounding areas. Field inspections are under way in bat habitats, pig farms, and areas with high domestic animal populations. Public should report unusual animal symptoms or deaths to 04952-762050. Caution: avoid wild or ground fruits possibly contaminated by bats; protect wells with nets and chlorinate water. Livestock owners must report unusual symptoms or deaths and not self-treat animals. Gloves and masks are advised for those in contact with animals. A separate medical team will be deployed; officials urge calm.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でニパウイルス懸念：動物衛生部が迅速対応のため管理室を開設
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの確定症例がインドで報告され、IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、政府レベルでの対応体制が既に構築されている。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは致死率が高い人獣共通感染症として認識されており、既に地区レベルの管理室設置、監視強化、コミュニティ向け注意喚起など組織的な対応が実施されている。動物・環境・人間への複合的な影響が指摘されており、フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Συνεχίζεται η εξάπλωση του Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό, προειδοποιεί ο ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The spread of Ebola continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as the Bundibugyo strain continues to spread to new areas. Most cases are in Ituri province, with transmissions in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. WHO warns the true scale may be larger due to population mobility and reporting gaps. Strengthening surveillance, contact tracing, and diagnostics remains critical, especially in North Kivu. Response emphasizes safe and dignified burials, infection prevention in health facilities, rapid isolation of patients, and sustained community engagement; capacity-building for local health workers is essential amid weak health systems and insecurity. WHO reports just over 70% of contacts traced. In neighboring Uganda, where Ebola was confirmed on May 15, the situation is now described as under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの拡大がコンゴ民主共和国で続く、WHO警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、異常かつ予想外な地域における継続的な感染拡大、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、ワクチンなし治療法なしの状況により、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認事例あるが、記事では「管理下にある」と報告。DRC東部のIturi、South Kivu、North Kivuでの継続的な感染拡大が主要な懸念。Bundibugyo株によるもので、ワクチンおよび承認済み治療法がない。接触追跡率は70%超だが、人口移動と報告ギャップにより実症例数はより大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: HIV: Dentista é preso suspeito de transmitir vírus propositalmente a mulheres em Porto Velho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV: Dentist Arrested on Suspicion of Deliberately Transmitting the Virus to Women in Porto Velho
article.articleSummary: HIV transmission case in Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, involving a dentist suspected of intentionally transmitting the virus to women. Four women have filed complaints with the Civil Police’s Specialized Women's Assistance Unit (DEAM). Investigators say the dentist knew his HIV-positive status but did not inform partners, exposing them to infection risk during consensual sex. Evidence includes documents, laboratory tests, medical records, and testimonies, suggesting the conduct may have occurred more than once. A court has ordered the arrest for aggravated bodily injury (lesão corporal de natureza gravíssima), Article 129, § 2 II, of the Brazilian Penal Code. The four identified victims are under investigation; police urge any additional potential victims to report to DEAM, with assurances of confidentiality and safety for complainants.

triage.headline_ja: HIV：ポルト・ベーリョで女性に意図的にウイルスを感染させた疑いで歯科医が逮捕
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで個別の刑事事件（意図的な感染拡大）として報告されており、公衆衛生上の流行兆候ではない。個別事件の性質が強く、広範な公衆衛生への影響や国際的拡大のリスクは現時点では低い。
triage.notes: 本事件は意図的な感染拡大を伴う刑事事件であり、疾病流行ではない。4名の被害者報告に基づき経過観察対象とするが、広範な公衆衛生上の危機兆候とは判断されない。ポルト・ベーリョの地域警察により適切に対応されている。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz alerta para crescimento de hospitalizações por gripe e bronquiolite infantil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz warns of an increase in hospitalizations due to influenza and pediatric bronchiolitis.
