article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe warns of rising hospitalizations from respiratory infections, notably respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) causing pediatric bronchiolitis, and, in some regions, influenza A and B. The May 31–June 6 period shows 11 Brazilian states at alert/risk/high risk for severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) with rising trends: Acre, Alagoas, Amapá, Paraná, Pará, Rio Grande do Norte, Rio Grande do Sul, Roraima, Santa Catarina, Sergipe and São Paulo. Sixteen others show slowing growth or declines, though 12 remain at alert/risk/high risk: Amazonas, Bahia, Ceará, Distrito Federal, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraíba and Rio de Janeiro. RSV drives increases in children ≤4 years; rhinovirus in 5–14 years; influenza predominates among younger, adult and elderly groups. Vaccination emphasis: RSV vaccine added to the National Immunization Program for pregnant women from 28 weeks; influenza vaccine for 6 months–5 years, elderly 60+, pregnant women; COVID-19 vaccines per guidance. As of 2026, 70,211 SRAG cases notified; 29.7% RSV, 33.9% rhinovirus, 25.4% Influenza A, 6.4% SARS-CoV-2.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス、インフルエンザと小児気管支炎の入院増加について警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土で複数の呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザA/B）の入院増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準複数項目に該当するが、具体的な死亡数、重症度指標、国際的広がりについての明確な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザA/B、ライノウイルス）が同時に流行しており、11州で上昇傾向、12州で警戒/リスク/高リスク状態が継続。小児（≤4年）でRSVが主流、成人・高齢者ではインフルエンザが優位。2026年として70,211件のSRAG症例が報告されているが、具体的な死亡数や入院数の正確な統計は記事に記載されていない。WHOへの通知義務判定にはIHR基準が1つのみ該当するため、現時点ではWATCH判定とするが、死亡数や重症度の詳細情報が判明した場合はPICKUPに昇格される可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 高岡厚生センター管内の２０代男性が"はしか"に感染　富山県内での感染報告は７年ぶり　県が注意呼びかけ（2026年6月12日掲載）｜KNB NEWS NNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles infection in a man in his 20s within the jurisdiction of the Takaoka Public Health Center; first measles infection reported in Toyama Prefecture in seven years; prefecture urges caution (Posted June 12, 2026) | KNB NEWS NNN
article.articleSummary: Measles infection confirmed in a man in his 20s within the Takaoka Public Health Center jurisdiction, Toyama Prefecture—the first measles case in Toyama since 2019 (seven years). The patient developed fever on June 3 and a rash; laboratory confirmation by the Prefectural Institute of Public Health; he is hospitalized. He had recently traveled to Indonesia, where measles transmission is ongoing, and investigators are determining the infection source and transmission route. Measles is highly contagious via airborne and droplet spread; in unimmunized individuals, illness begins with fever and cough, then a high fever (≥39°C) and rash lasting 4–5 days. The contagious period spans from one day before symptom onset to about three days after fever subsides. The prefecture urges caution and advises contacting healthcare facilities by phone before visiting if measles is suspected.

triage.headline_ja: 高岡厚生センター管内の２０代男性が"はしか"に感染　富山県内での感染報告は７年ぶり　県が注意呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の国内確認事例（7年ぶり）で異常性あり。インドネシア渡航後の感染で国際的背景あるが、現時点では単一症例であり、国内での二次感染拡大リスクは情報不足。継続的な感染動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は日本での事例を扱っているが、日本は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。患者がインドネシア渡航後に感染が確認されており、インドネシアでの流行背景がある。麻疹は高い伝播性を持つため、国内での接触者スクリーニングと追跡調査の進展に注目する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola weitet sich aus - immer mehr Regionen sind betroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading - more and more regions are affected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of June 11, 2026. WHO official Olivier le Polain, based in Beni, North Kivu, said new health zones are infected almost daily; the majority of cases remain in Ituri, but there are also local transmissions in North and South Kivu as infections move beyond Ituri. Ongoing fighting, displacement, and a weak health system hinder the response, and the full scale of the outbreak remains unclear. UNICEF warns that fear of infection is causing families to skip routine clinic visits or seek care late, risking higher child mortality. More than half of children under five in Ituri are malnourished, worsening vulnerability in the affected population.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが拡大 - ますます多くの地域が影響を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の拡大は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数州への地域的拡散と国際的懸念を伴う。
triage.notes: 記事は676確定例、136死亡と報告（2026年6月11日時点）。Ituri州が主要な感染地で、North Kivu、South Kivu州にも局所感染。紛争、人口移動、脆弱な保健体制が対応を阻害。栄養不良児童が多く、易感染性集団が存在。WHO公式による複数地域への日々の感染拡大報告により、国際的な関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala: Nipah patient's route map released; animal husbandry dept sets up control room
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports Nipah virus case in Kozhikode's Ramanattukara, with a 43-year-old man admitted on ventilator at Government Medical College Hospital. A route map shows movements from May 30–June 10, including private hospitals in Feroke, Kozhikode, and multiple visits home; 77 contacts identified (58 healthcare workers, 14 family, 5 friends), with 2 highest-risk, 13 high-risk, and 62 low-risk categorized and quarantined. Nipah is a zoonotic virus with fruit bats as natural reservoirs; it can cause encephalitis and outbreaks occur annually in parts of Asia, especially Bangladesh and India. Prevention includes avoiding contact with sick pigs and bats and not consuming raw date palm sap. The Animal Husbandry Department has established a district control room in Kozhikode to coordinate surveillance, prevent animal-to-human transmission, and issue PPE/safety guidance. Public can report symptoms or unusual animal deaths at 0495-2762050.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州：ニパウイルス患者の移動経路地図を公開、動物畜産部が管制室を設置
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高致命率（40-75%）の新興感染症であり、ケーラ州での患者確認は異常・予想外の事象。77名の接触者追跡が進行中であり、国内および地域での国際的拡大リスクが存在するため、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは致命率が高く、バングラデシュとインドで定期的にアウトブレイクが発生する人獣共通感染症。患者は人工呼吸器で治療中であり、77名の接触者（医療従事者58名含む）が追跡・隔離されている。動物畜産部による管制室設置と監視体制の整備が進行中。記事サマリーではバングラデシュは背景情報として言及されているのみで、現在のイベント発生地はインド（ケーラ州コージコード地区）に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Alta nos casos de gripe leva duas escolas a suspenderem aulas em Rodeio Bonito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in influenza cases leads two schools to suspend classes in Rodeio Bonito.
article.articleSummary: Influenza prompts temporary school closures in Rodeio Bonito, northern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Two municipal elementary schools, Santa Bárbara and Graciliano Ramos, suspended in-person classes from the afternoon of June 10, with return planned for June 15. Across both institutions, 56 laboratory-confirmed influenza cases are reported: 50 students and 3 staff at Santa Bárbara; 3 students at Graciliano Ramos. An additional 3 Graciliano Ramos students had flu‑like symptoms and received medical leave. The municipality cites about 160 confirmed influenza cases overall. No hospitalizations for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) or deaths related to influenza have been recorded. The decision was made by school administrations in coordination with the Education Secretariat; Epidemiological Surveillance did not recommend closures. Flu vaccination remains available to the population at Rodeio Bonito health units.

triage.headline_ja: ロデイオ・ボニートでインフルエンザ患者増加により2校が授業を中止
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の学校閉鎖措置であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当がなく、重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが認められない。国内対応で管理可能な地域的なイベント。
triage.notes: ブラジルの対象国リストへの該当性により verified_locations に Brazil を含める。ただし本イベントは季節性インフルエンザの地域的クラスターであり、死亡・重篤患者なし、公開統計情報も入手可能、国内体制で対応可能。SARS記載は疾患分類に含まれるも本イベントでは関連症例報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: "نقاط غامضة" تعيق رصد انتشار إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious data gaps hinder monitoring of Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows data gaps hindering monitoring. As of June 11, 2026, Congo reported 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths, with the outbreak spreading to Uganda. The World Health Organization warns of unknowns in high-risk areas, calling for strengthened surveillance. Isolation capacity is critically limited, with fewer than 250 beds across three affected eastern regions. The outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there is no approved treatment or licensed vaccine. After a period of under-detection, responders are working to contain transmission. The WHO notes no formal size estimate yet; the CDC has warned the epidemic could reach the scale of West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak, which killed over 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: 謎のデータギャップがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ拡大の監視を妨げている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク（676確認患者、136死亡）は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示し、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの拡大）、稀なBundibugyo ebolavirus株（治療法やワクチンなし）、監視体制の不備など、全基準を満たす高リスクイベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはDRCとウガンダが言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれている。ウガンダ（226074）およびアンゴラ（3351879）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外。2014-2016年西アフリカアウトブレイク（11,000以上死亡）との比較から、同等規模の脅威が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : L'épidémie continue de gagner du terrain en République démocratique du Congo, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the outbreak continues to gain ground in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to gain ground, according to the World Health Organization. As of Thursday, June 11, 2026, 676 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths have been reported for the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form driving the epidemic. The vast majority of infections are in Ituri province (northeast), with new cases now recorded in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, reflecting both the true scale and high population mobility. The response faces particular difficulty due to fragile health systems and persistent insecurity in the region. The DRC has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain at this time. The report cites Beni, North Kivu, as a location from which the WHO spoke.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：世界保健機関によると、民主共和国コンゴのエボラ流行は拡大し続けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo株による東部コンゴでの確認エボラ流行で、676確認症例・136死亡、34保健地域での多発、人口移動による国際拡大リスク、医療・ワクチン不備により国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行は稀な亜種であり、ワクチン・承認治療がない状況。東部コンゴの脆弱な保健システム・不安定性が対応を困難にしており、高い国際拡大リスク。WHO発表のため信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola upptäcks i nya områden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola detected in new areas
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo are expanding to additional areas, with cases detected in new health districts almost daily across three provinces. Epidemiologist Olivier le Polain of WHO says the outbreak's true scope is much larger than detected, driven by high population mobility. He warned that far more must be done to contain it, calling for intensified contact tracing and an immediate increase in isolated treatment beds. More than 670 Ebola cases have been confirmed and 136 deaths. The report stresses the need for immediate expansion of isolation units in healthcare facilities. Urgent action is required.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラが新たな地域で検出される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国における進行中のエボラ熱流行の拡大が報告され、死亡例を含む確認患者数670名以上、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、高い国際拡大リスク、及び渡航制限の可能性が明確。
triage.notes: エボラ熱は最高リスク病原体。確認患者数670名、死亡136名、3州の複数の保健地区に拡大。WHOエピデミオロジストは実際の患者数がより多いと指摘。高い人口流動性と不十分な封じ込め対策により、国際拡大および人道支援拡大の重大なリスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Roundup: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo expands as weak contact tracing, insecurity hamper response
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus expands to 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with 41 new cases and 9 deaths reported on Wednesday. It spans 29 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, signaling ongoing community transmission since the May 15 declaration and rapid geographic spread. Weak contact tracing, insecurity and funding gaps hamper containment; about 5,000 of an estimated 24,000 contacts in Ituri are listed, with limited follow-up. The Bundibugyo strain is rare and has no approved vaccine or treatment; the current outbreak is among Africa's largest by Bundibugyo cases, surpassing 2007 Uganda and 2012 DRC outbreaks. WHO risk assessment (June 6) ranks DRC risk as very high; retrospective investigations suggest undetected circulation since March, and diagnostic tests not validated for Bundibugyo may have missed early cases. At least 16 health workers are among confirmed cases; Uganda reports imported cases from DRC, with no community transmission, though exportation via travel remains possible.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ集団発生が拡大、接触者追跡の弱さと不安定情勢が対応を阻害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模集団発生で676確定患者136死亡、地理的急速拡大、医療従事者感染、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、ワクチン・治療法なし、WHO最高リスク評価（非常に高い）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの発生が主題であり、South Kivu Province、Ituri州での拡大を報告。ウガンダはDRCからの輸入症例のみで現在コミュニティ内感染なし（今後の拡大リスクあり）。Bundibugyo型エボラは稀であり、承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点が重要。接触者追跡・資金不足・不安定情勢が対応を著しく阻害している。WHO6月6日リスク評価で最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Η επιδημία εξακολουθεί να εξαπλώνεται στη ΛΔ Κονγκό, προειδοποίησε ο ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The outbreak continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO warned.
article.articleSummary: 676 lab-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, including 136 deaths, have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of June 11, 2026, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or approved therapy. Most cases are in Ituri province in the northeast, but infections have now been recorded in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO warns that new zones are continually affected, suggesting the outbreak’s true size is larger and driven by high population movement. The health system remains weakened and security concerns hinder response, though the DRC has substantial Ebola response experience. The contingency emphasizes strengthened surveillance, contact tracing (about 70% of contacts traced correctly), rapid isolation and treatment, safe and dignified burials, infection prevention in facilities, and enhanced community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：民主共和国コンゴでの流行が継続的に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による確認事例676例、死亡136例が報告されており、34の保健ゾーンで多地域伝播が続いている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な懸念、拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）はまれな型で、ワクチンや承認済み治療法がない点が懸念される。34の保健ゾーンでの多地域伝播、人口移動による拡大、保健システムの脆弱性、セキュリティ上の制約が対応を困難にしている。WHO によるリアルタイムの警告発出および継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ο Έμπολα εξακολουθεί να εξαπλώνεται στη ΛΔ Κονγκό, προειδοποιεί ο ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in the DRC, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of yesterday, 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths have been recorded, with most cases in Ituri province; new cases have emerged in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO warns the outbreak is likely larger than detected due to population mobility. The health system in the DRC remains weakened and security precarious, making response challenging, though the country has substantial experience managing Ebola. The response should reinforce existing, trained staff and capacities, as gaps remain in high-risk zones. Contact tracing has improved to just over 70% of contacts traced. Core measures include safe and dignified burials, reducing infection in health facilities, rapid identification, isolation and care, enhanced surveillance and contact tracing, and strengthened community engagement. Africa CDC notes Uganda’s Ebola outbreak (confirmed May 15) is now under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスはコンゴ民主共和国で引き続き拡大しており、WHOが警告している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の地理的拡大、国際的拡大のリスク）。676件の確認症例と136名の死亡を伴うエボラ流行が進行中であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラの主要発生地がDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）と明記されている。ウガンダでの流行は「制御下にある」と記載されており、現在の活動的流行はDRCに限定。Bundibugyo ebolavirus亜種、676確認症例、136死亡、34の衛生ゾーンへの拡大、人口移動による検出外の症例の可能性があるとWHOが指摘。DRCの弱体化した保健体制と不安定な治安環境が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra alta no número de hospitalizações por VSR e gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records an increase in hospitalizations due to RSV and influenza
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports rising hospitalizations for severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) driven by RSV in children up to 4 years, with influenza A predominating in youths, adults and seniors. Fiocruz Infogripe data for epidemiological week 22 (May 31–June 6, 2026) show 11 of 27 states at alert/risk/high risk for SARI in the past two weeks, with a long-term rise; states include Acre, Alagoas, Amapá, Paraná, Pará, Rio Grande do Norte, Rio Grande do Sul, Roraima, Santa Catarina, Sergipe and São Paulo. The other 16 show slower long-term growth, with 12 still at alert/risk. By 2026, SARI deaths total 3,591. RSV drives SARI in ≤4 years; rhinovirus predominates in 5–14. Influenza A rises in 5–14, 15–49 and older; influenza B rises in 5–14 and 15–49. Vaccination against influenza and RSV is advised for priority groups; maintain hand hygiene, masking in health settings and crowded spaces, and isolation when symptomatic or wearing N95/PFF2 when leaving home.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、RSVとインフルエンザによる入院患者数の増加を記録
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザとRSV感染症による複合的な呼吸器感染症流行であり、複数州で警戒水準に達し、死亡例も報告されている。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行傾向が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月12日配信で、ブラジル全国27州中11州がSARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）について警戒/危険/高リスク状況にあると報告。小児（≤4歳）ではRSV優位、青年・成人・高齢者ではインフルエンザA優位。2026年のSARI死亡例は3,591件。Fiocruz Infogripeデータに基づく公式サーベイランス情報であり、信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: India Sends 20,000 Vaccine Doses, 3 Tonnes Of Medical Aids To Maldives Over Meales Cases
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak concerns in Maldives prompted India to send 20,000 doses of measles vaccine and about 3 tonnes of medical supplies to bolster immunisation and address rising cases. The consignment was handed over at a ceremony attended by Maldives Health Minister Geela Ali, reflecting strengthened health partnership between India and the Maldives. India described itself as a trusted first responder in the region, aligning with New Delhi's Neighbourhood First policy and Vision MAHASAGAR. The assistance was announced via the Maldives Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Indian Ministry of External Affairs; no laboratory confirmation or outbreak specifics were provided. This latest aid underscores ongoing India–Maldives cooperation in public health ahead of 12 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インド、麻疹患者増加を受けてモルディブに2万用量のワクチンと3トンの医療援助を送付
triage.triage_reason: モルディブでの麻疹アウトブレイク懸念は報告されているが、実験室確認情報がなく、発症者数・重症度・感染拡大の具体的情報が不足している。インドからの支援は政治的な友好関係の文脈が強く、公衆衛生緊急事態としての詳細な判定には続報が必要。
triage.notes: Maldives（モルディブ）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはIndiaのみを含めるべき。ただし、記事サマリーが「Maldives measles outbreak」を明確に述べているため、モルディブでの発生イベントは確認されている。実験室確認がない点、具体的な患者数が未報告である点が、フルRRA判定の障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: IOM: Multi-Country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak - Situation Report No. 4 (3 - 9 June 2026)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues with sustained transmission in eastern provinces and cross-border linked cases in Uganda. IOM reports population mobility driving transmission, supporting readiness and response along mobility corridors; Priority 1a in DRC and Uganda, Priority 1b in Burundi, Rwanda and South Sudan, with preparedness in Angola, CAR, Ethiopia, Kenya, Republic of Congo, United Republic of Tanzania and Zambia. A May 27–29, 2026 population mobility mapping in Ituri Province (Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu) showed over 16,000 people moving daily along key routes, with movements doubling on market days. Bunia acts as a major mobility hub linked to transport networks via National Route 27 and Lake Albert. Four priority corridors identified: Bunia-Komanda-Nia Nia (towards Kisangani), Bunia-Komanda-Luna (towards Beni), Bunia-Mahagi, and Bunia-Aru-Kengezi. Plans include PoCs and strengthened surveillance, IPC, risk communication, and frontline workforce to mitigate transmission while preserving essential movement.

triage.headline_ja: IOM: 多国間ブンディブギョエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク - 状況報告書第4号（2026年6月3日～9日）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の多国間アウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダ、ブルンジ、ルワンダ、南スーダン）で持続的な感染伝播と人口移動に伴う国境越え感染が報告されており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはアメリカ（New South Wales, Lake Albert）が含まれているが、記事サマリーは明らかにDRC、ウガンダ、ブルンジ、ルワンダ、南スーダン、アンゴラ、CAR、エチオピア、ケニア、コンゴ共和国、タンザニア、ザンビアの12国での多国間アウトブレイクを示している。対象国リストから、DRCのみが検証可能な発生国として該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。人口移動によるキー国境越え回廊が複数特定されており、地域的な重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'épidémie continue de s'étendre en RDC, dit l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the outbreak continues to spread in the DRC, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak persists in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with transmission continuing to grow and expand into new geographic areas, according to the World Health Organization on 2026-06-12. Reported case numbers are rising, signaling sustained spread beyond initial epicenters. While the excerpt does not provide exact counts or laboratory confirmation details, the trend indicates an expanding outbreak within affected provinces. The WHO emphasizes that transmission remains active and underscores the need for intensified surveillance, rapid case finding, and a coordinated public health response to contain spread. The available text does not mention imported or exported cases or other diseases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOが述べるように、RDCでの流行は継続して拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクが進行中で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を有する重篤な感染症。DRCの東部での発生が継続・拡大中との報告。WHOが公式に状況を確認しており、国際的な注視が高まっている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading into new areas in northeast DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading into new areas, according to the World Health Organization. The Bundibugyo species is responsible, and there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Declared on 15 May, the outbreak has produced 676 confirmed Ebola cases in DRC, including 136 deaths; 119 suspected cases and 32 recoveries have also been recorded. Transmission hotspots are centered in Ituri province, with cases detected in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. WHO cautions that isolation bed capacity remains far below anticipated needs, underscoring critical gaps in patient care and containment. The information highlights ongoing spread and the urgent need to bolster outbreak response measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ北東部の新しい地域に拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。Bundibugyo型エボラの確認された多地域への拡大、高い死亡率、ワクチン・治療法がない状況、医療体制の不備が認められ、シグナルとして即座にフルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo species（ザイール種ではなくBundibugyo種）による確認されたアウトブレーク。676確認症例、136死亡（致死率約20%）。複数州への地理的拡大（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）が報告されており、隔離ベッド容量が不足している状況。WHO公式情報源であり、情報の信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn trương phòng, chống dịch lở mồm long móng ở Thái Nguyên
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent measures to prevent and control foot-and-mouth disease in Thai Nguyen.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in Nghiên Loan, Thai Nguyen province, Vietnam, is due to serotype A—the first local appearance in 18 years. From 6 June, 85 cattle samples from three households tested positive: 2 for serotype O and 19 for serotype A. At the Nghiên Loan cattle market, 2 of 10 samples were positive for serotype A. Serotype A has not circulated in Vietnam or Thai Nguyen since 2018, raising the risk of wider spread via trade. On 8 June a task force was formed to support local authorities; by 11 June the province had deployed 700 liters disinfectant, a sprayer, PPE, and 50 militia to sanitize market areas. The market was suspended from 11 June. Authorities seek vaccination and enhanced surveillance; they request 15,000 doses of SAT1 vaccine and 15,000 liters of disinfectant for Nghiên Loan and high-risk communes (Bằng Thành, Cao Minh, Chợ Rã, Ba Bể, Phúc Lộc).

triage.headline_ja: タイグエン省の口蹄疫まん延防止・抑制に向けた緊急措置
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで18年ぶりの口蹄疫セロタイプA出現、畜産への深刻な影響と国際貿易拡大リスク、政府の公式対応体制が確立されており、IHR基準及びスクリーニング基準を複数満たしている。
triage.notes: セロタイプAは2018年以降ベトナムで流通していなかった18年ぶりの出現であり、高い異常性を示す。85頭の牛がセロタイプA陽性、市場での感染確認、及び取引による拡大リスクが明確。政府は6月8日にタスクフォース設立、大規模な防疫物資配備（消毒液700リットル、ワクチン1.5万用量申請など）を実施しており、対応体制は比較的整備されているが、広域拡大のリスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: "نقاط غامضة" تعقد تقدير مدى انتشار إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: "Mysterious Points" Complicate the Estimation of Ebola's Spread
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that ‘mysterious points’ hinder accurate estimation of Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where as of 12 June 2026 the outbreak comprises 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with transmission reaching three additional health zones and Uganda. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. Olivier Le Polin, an epidemiologist with WHO in Beni, Eastern Congo, notes ongoing data gaps in high‑risk areas and urgently calls for enhanced surveillance. Isolation capacity is severely limited, with fewer than 250 beds across the three affected provinces. The disease had been quiet for weeks, and responders are striving to contain spread. WHO has not issued formal outbreak-size estimates; the CDC had suggested potential scales comparable to West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis, which claimed over 11,000 lives.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：「謎の点」がエボラの流行拡大の推定を複雑にしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は深刻な公衆衛生影響（676確認例、136死亡）、予想外の稀なBundibugyo系統、複数国への国際拡大（DRC、ウガンダ）、国際的な渡航・貿易制限リスクを呈示。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを主要な発生地点として記述しており、ウガンダへの伝播も言及されているが、ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため検証対象外。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーに具体的な言及がないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀な系統で、承認済み治療法またはワクチンがない点が特に懸念される。隔離収容能力の深刻な不足（3州で250床未満）。

article.articleHeadline: Armáda propustila vojáka z preventivní karantény. Sloužil v oblasti, kde je ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The army released a soldier from preventive quarantine. He served in an area where Ebola is present.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, a Czech soldier who served as the sole Czech participant on a United Nations peacekeeping mission returned from an Ebola-present area and was placed in preventive quarantine at the Center for Biological Protection, a specialized military facility in Těchonín, in the Orlickoústecko region. He was hospitalized in a military hospital upon return. Army spokesperson Vladimír Holas said the preventive steps were taken to protect the soldier, his immediate surroundings, and the broader public, indicating a precautionary health measure tied to potential exposure. This case underlines the military's use of quarantine protocols for personnel returning from Ebola-affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: 軍がエボラが存在する地域に派遣されていた兵士を予防的隔離から釈放。チェコ軍がエボラリスク地域から帰還した兵士に対し予防的隔離措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（DRC発生地域からの帰還者）に関するシグナルであり、国際的な懸念は存在するが、患者発症報告がなく情報不足。続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（エボラ流行地）から帰還したチェコ兵士の予防的隔離措置について報じているが、実際の症例発症報告は記載されていない。チェコは対象国外であるため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内での実際の発症者数・死亡者数などの流行状況情報が不足しているため、PICKUP ではなく WATCH 判定とした。続報でDRC内の患者増加やチェコでの症例確認があれば PICKUP に昇格する可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Caso suspeito de Ebola no Rio Grande do Sul mobiliza autoridades de saúde e paciente será transferido para Porto Alegre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Rio Grande do Sul mobilizes health authorities, and the patient will be transferred to Porto Alegre.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, is investigating a suspected Ebola case in a 64-year-old man who recently traveled to Uganda. The patient sought care in Novo Hamburgo and is monitored under national Ebola surveillance criteria; a malaria test was positive for Plasmodium falciparum, and malaria treatment has begun. Ebola testing remains under investigation, with confirmation only possible at Fiocruz, the reference laboratory. Due to clinical protocols for suspected Ebola, the patient will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre for specialized evaluation and sampling; if Ebola is confirmed, care will move to a national reference hospital. Authorities have alerted the Ministry of Health, and local, state, and federal bodies are coordinating. Health surveillance teams are tracing contacts for 30 days. Ebola transmission is via direct contact with blood or fluids, not airborne; symptoms appear 2–21 days after infection; mortality can reach 25–90%.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのリオグランデ・ド・スル州でエボラ疑い患者が報告、保健当局が対応、患者はポルト・アレグレに転院予定
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダへの渡航歴を持つ患者のエボラ疑い患者が、ブラジルで報告された案件。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、国際的な保健危機として注視が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い患者の移送地はブラジル国内（ポルト・アレグレ）だが、記事サマリーに基づき実際の発生地はブラジル。ウガンダへの渡航歴があるが、エボラの発生地がウガンダであることは記事に明記されていないため、verified_locationsにはBrazilのみを含める。マラリアの陽性確認とエボラ検査継続中という状況であり、確定診断前の段階ながら、国際的な疾病監視システムの活動が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Η επιδημία εξακολουθεί να εξαπλώνεται στο Κονγκό - "Ιδιαίτερα δύσκολη" η διαχείρισή της
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The outbreak continues to spread in the Congo — "Particularly difficult" to manage.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to widen, driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. As of 12 June 2026, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths have been reported. Most cases are in Ituri province in the northeast, but infections are now detected in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO officials cautioned that new zones are identified almost daily, underscoring the outbreak’s true scale and rapid population movements. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus to date. Olivier Le Polen, head of WHO’s Epidemiology and Analysis Unit for interventions, speaking from Beni, North Kivu, called the outbreak 'particularly difficult' to manage.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴでの流行が拡大し続けている - 「特に難しい」管理
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。希少なブンディブギョエボラウイルス株による進行中の流行で、確認症例676件、死亡136件、複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）の34保健区域に拡大。ワクチンや承認済み治療法がなく、人口移動が急速で管理が困難。
triage.notes: 稀なブンディブギョエボラウイルス株による流行。毎日新しい感染区域が特定されており、急速な拡大が示唆されている。WHO職員が管理の困難さを公式に指摘。ワクチン・治療法不在は深刻な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak climbs to 676 cases, 136 deaths amid weak tracing
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the DRC’s Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with 41 new infections and nine additional fatalities this week. Transmission spans 29 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, marking rapid geographic spread since the outbreak’s 15 May declaration. Severe gaps in contact tracing persist: in Ituri ~600 cases imply ~24,000 contacts, but only ~5,000 have been identified and few are under active follow-up; some confirmed patients remain outside treatment centres. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. By confirmed cases, this is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in Africa, surpassing 2007 Uganda and 2012 DRC Bundibugyo outbreaks. WHO rates the risk as very high; cases rose from 63 to 515 between 22 May and 6 June. Uganda reports imported/linked cases; neighboring regions face high regional risk. Violence hampers surveillance, prompting Africa CDC to urge ceasefire and scale-up of case finding, diagnostics, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ出血熱の流行が676人の症例、136人の死亡に増加―接触者追跡が不十分な中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。アフリカ第3位の大規模エボラ流行であり、国際拡大（ウガンダへの流出）、高い死亡率、迅速な地理的拡散、および深刻な対応ギャップにより、直ちにフルRRAに進むべき高リスク事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC が主たる発生地であり、South Kivu Province および Ituri 両州での拡散が明記されている。ウガンダへの流出（imported/linked cases）も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo 株である点、接触者追跡の深刻なギャップ（~24,000 人中 ~5,000 人のみ確認、積極フォローアップなし）、暴力による監視障害、WHO による「very high risk」評価、急速な増加ペース（22 May: 63 例 → 6 June: 515 例）が重大な懸念を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Ανησυχία για την εξάπλωση της επιδημίας του Έμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Concern over the spread of the Ebola epidemic in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread. As of Thursday, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths have been reported by the DRC Health Ministry, per WHO; there is no vaccine or approved therapy for this strain. Most cases are in Ituri province (northeast), but the outbreak has reached 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO notes daily new foci linked to real burden and population movement. Health systems remain strained, and security issues hinder access. DRC’s Ebola-management experience should guide strengthened structures, personnel and local capacity; remaining blind spots exist in high-risk areas, with surveillance, contact tracing and diagnostics being expanded to around 70% of contacts. Core measures: safe burials, infection prevention in facilities, early detection, isolation, treatment, and community engagement. Uganda’s outbreak is now under control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴでのエボラ流行の拡大に懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）の発生がDRCの複数州で676確認症例136死亡と報告されており、IHR基準4項目全て該当。重症度が高く、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ隣接）あり、ワクチン・承認治療なし。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（DRC東部で流行中）。676確認症例、136死亡、34保健区域に拡大。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kuvuの3州が影響。ワクチンおよび承認治療法なし。ウガンダではコントロール下にあるが、DRC隣接地域での続発リスク高い。保健システム負荷、セキュリティ課題により対応能力が制限されている。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола се разпространява в нови райони в ДР Конго, заяви СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading to new areas in DR Congo, WHO said.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of June 11, 2026. The outbreak is expanding into new health zones, though most transmissions remain in Ituri Province; in North Kivu (Beni) and South Kivu, cases now include locally transmitted infections in addition to people who traveled from Ituri. WHO reported ongoing daily case detections in new areas, reflecting a complex situation amid armed conflict, large displacements, and a strained health system, creating high‑risk blind spots. UNICEF warned that families avoid routine hospital visits for fear of infection, increasing the risk of untreated illness; over 50% of under-five children in Ituri are malnourished, elevating vulnerability. Full scale of the outbreak remains unclear.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国の新たな地域に拡大、WHO報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響を示す。確認症例676件、死亡136件、複数州への拡大が既に進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）内のIturi州、South Kivu州、North Kivu州での流行拡大を明示。複数州への地域的拡大、武装紛争下の脆弱な保健システム、高度な栄養不良が存在する。WHOが現地からの継続的報告を受けており、国際的な支援ニーズは明確。対象国リスト中ではDRC（203312）のみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Kes Ebola di Congo meningkat kepada 676 susuli penularan dalam masyarakat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 676 following community transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 676 confirmed cases, including 136 deaths, with ongoing community transmission. Health authorities warn the outbreak could rapidly spread to new areas without immediate public health action. The latest situation update reports 41 new confirmed cases, including 9 deaths, on Wednesday in Ituri and North Kivu. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and has affected 29 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. There are 5,768 contacts being monitored across the three affected regions, with a 71.8% monitoring rate, and contact-tracing remains below the 95% target. Two Ebola patients in Bunia, Ituri, have recovered, bringing total recoveries to 32. The outbreak, the 17th in DRC since 1976, was officially declared on May 15, with near 15 million people affected and widespread internal displacement and cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者が676人に増加、地域内感染が続く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。アフリカを含む国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 2026年6月12日現在、DRCでエボラの第17回流行が進行中。確認患者676人、死亡136人。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による地域内感染が拡大している。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州の29の保健ゾーンに影響。接触者追跡率が目標95%に達していない（71.8%）。15百万人が影響を受けており、越境人口移動も報告されている。国際支援と公衆衛生対応の強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: OMS afirma que el brote de ébola sigue expandiéndose en número de casos y geográficamente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO states that the Ebola outbreak continues to expand in the number of cases and geographically.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) continues to expand in both case numbers and geographic reach. As of Thursday, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths have been reported by the DRC Ministry of Health. The World Health Organization warns that new cases are identified nearly daily in additional health zones, likely reflecting under-detection amid high population mobility, weak health systems, and insecurity from armed groups. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In neighboring Uganda, 19 infections have been recorded, including 14 cases imported from the DRC and two deaths. WHO and partners are expanding surveillance, laboratories, community engagement, infection prevention, and clinical care, though gaps remain in high‑risk areas and the true mortality rate and clinical picture are not yet fully known.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行が症例数および地理的に拡大し続けていることを確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を伴う異常事象であり、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダでの症例報告）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCで確認されたエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の継続的な地理的拡大、高い致死率、効果的なワクチン・治療法の欠如が重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Gilead Mobilizes Rapid Donation of Remdesivir to Support Ebola Response, Building on Decade-Long Commitment to Outbreak Relief
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak prompts Gilead Sciences to donate more than 2,000 vials of remdesivir to support treatment efforts, with additional supplies being prepared. The donation is provided under compassionate use and MEURI frameworks for BVD. Gilead also plans to assist requests from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, World Health Organization and other partners for remdesivir and obeldesivir, an oral investigational antiviral, as part of a broader regional response and planned clinical trials. Remdesivir has shown preclinical activity against filoviruses but is not approved for filovirus disease anywhere; efficacy for BVD remains unestablished. The company notes remdesivir is COVID-19 approved in about 50 countries and has been used to treat over 14.5 million patients globally, including more than 8.1 million in low- and middle-income countries via licensing. The donation underscores Gilead's decade-long commitment to outbreak relief.

triage.headline_ja: ギリアド社、エボラ対応支援のためレムデシビルの迅速寄付を動員、感染症対応への10年間の取り組みを基盤に
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダのエボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病アウトブレイクと、DRCを含む地域対応が記事の主題であり、IHR基準（異常性、重症度、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）も該当する。医療介入（治験薬の寄付）が進行中であり、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダのエボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病（BVD）アウトブレイクが主題であり、DRCも地域対応の一部として言及されている。両国とも対象国リストに含まれ、verified_locationsに含める。エボラウイルスは高い重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染性、国際的拡大リスクを持つため、複数のスクリーニング基準を満たす。治験薬の寄付という臨床的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Cross River activates Ebola response system, intensifies border surveillance
article.articleSummary: Cross River State activated an Ebola virus disease (EVD) emergency response amid Uganda and DRC outbreaks, with no cases recorded in Cross River to date. Health Commissioner Henry Ayuk announced heightened surveillance and an alert Emergency Operations Centre to rapidly detect, report, and respond to suspected infections, following International Health Regulations (2005) declaration of a public health emergency of international concern. Surveillance has been intensified across local government areas, with border Screen travelers from affected countries and ongoing information-sharing with Cameroon and interstate authorities. Health workers, surveillance officers, and port health staff are being trained in detection, reporting, and isolation procedures; infection-prevention measures—hand hygiene, PPE, and isolation protocols—reinforced in facilities. Ebola incubation is 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle and joint pain, vomiting and diarrhea. Vigilance and prompt reporting urged.

triage.headline_ja: Cross River州がエボラ対応システムを発動、国境監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事象（PHEIC）であり、IHR基準で少なくとも2つ以上該当。DRCおよびウガンダでの大規模な流行に対応した地域的な予防措置であり、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダのエボラ流行に対応するため、Cross River州（ナイジェリア）が緊急対応システムを発動。WHOによるPHEIC宣言が言及されており、国際的な影響度が高い。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するが、ナイジェリアの隣国カメルーンとの協力関係も記載されている。現在Cross River州での確認患者はなく、予防的措置段階だが、エボラの高い致死率と国境を越えた伝播リスクを考慮するとPickupが適切。

article.articleHeadline: La maladie à virus Ebola peu connue au Burundi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus disease is little known in Burundi.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-12, Ebola virus disease is little known in Burundi. In Bujumbura, a national Red Cross survey found 70.6% of respondents with limited knowledge about Ebola, 27.4% with acceptable knowledge, and only 2% with good knowledge. The disease, responsible for the 17th outbreak and hundreds of deaths, is circulating in Burundi’s vicinity, mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The findings highlight substantial knowledge gaps that could hinder recognition and response, given proximity to Ebola activity in neighboring countries. No detailed case counts or laboratory confirmations are provided for Burundi in the report.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病はブルンジであまり知られていない
triage.triage_reason: ブルンジ内での確認例がなく、主要な懸念は地域的な知識不足と隣国での流行リスク。シグナルというより情報収集対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブルンジでの知識調査を扱っており、ブルンジ内での確認例は報告されていない。DRCとウガンダで流行が継続中とされているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ブルンジは隣接国での流行を背景にした知識啓発の文脈であり、対象国リスト外のため除外。WPRO基準の「prolonged_exposure」と「epidemic_prone」に該当するが、ブルンジでの実際の流行確認がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: وفاة ابنة ملك تايلاند بعد معاناة مع عدوى شديدة أصابتها في جلسة مع كلاب
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of Thailand's king's daughter after contracting a severe infection during a session with dogs.
article.articleSummary: Princess Bajrakitiyabha Mahidol, the eldest daughter of Thailand's King Maha Vajiralongkorn, died at age 47 after more than three years in hospital. The Royal Household said she deteriorated following a gastrointestinal infection, having been hospitalized since December 2022 after a health episode during a training session with the army’s dogs. In August 2025, officials disclosed a severe bloodstream infection requiring life-support to sustain her lungs and kidneys. She died on the evening of June 11, 2026, and her body will lie in state at the Grand Palace in Bangkok ahead of a funeral with highest royal honors. She was the king’s only daughter from his first marriage to Princess Soamsawali. The 73-year-old king has seven children from four marriages and has not named a crown prince, with the succession favoring males.

triage.headline_ja: タイ国王の娘、犬との訓練中に感染した重度感染症後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の感染症による個人の死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の流行・集団発生を示唆する証拠がない。記事サマリーは3年以上の長期入院と個別事例の経過を述べており、国際的な感染症シグナルの基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は王族個人の死亡事例であり、感染症の流行や集団発生を示唆していない。疾患が「Unknown Illness」と特定されていない点も懸念を低下させる。犬との接触による感染源の可能性は言及されているが、伝播リスクや他症例への影響の証拠は記事に含まれていない。公共の衛生上の関心事ではなく、個別の医療事例として扱われるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Огнището на ебола в ДР Конго се разпространява към нови райони
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading to new areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands to three additional zones, according to a government report published June 12, 2026. Confirmed cases total 676 with 136 deaths, data through Wednesday as reported by the health minister on X (per Reuters). New affected health zones are in North Kivu and Ituri. In the DRC, a health zone is a defined territory with a network of clinics and a referral hospital serving about 100,000–150,000 people; the country has over 500 such zones. The report signals ongoing transmission and geographic spread within the outbreak, highlighting the need for continued surveillance and public health response across the affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（676確定患者、136死亡）、異常/予想外な地理的拡大、国際的拡大リスクが認められ、2基準以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性で複数基準該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つVHF（ウイルス性出血熱）であり、地理的拡大（North Kivu、Ituri州の3新規ヘルスゾーン）と継続的な伝播を示唆。DRC国内での管理体制強化と国際的な技術支援・監視が必須。対象国リストに該当するため検証位置は確認済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolos virusas plinta į naujus Kongo regionus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus spreads to new Congo regions.
article.articleSummary: On June 12, 2026, the Ebola virus has reached new regions of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 676 cases and 136 deaths reported, according to Olivier le Polain, WHO’s aid coordinator in Beni, North Kivu. Almost daily new cases are detected in additional health zones, though most remain in Ituri province. While many cases in North and South Kivu were previously linked to travelers from Ituri, there is now local transmission in those provinces as well. Challenges include ongoing conflict, large displaced populations, and weak health systems; health officials warn of hotspots or blind spots in high-risk areas. UNICEF cautions that families avoid hospitals for fear of infection, risking more child deaths. In Ituri, over half of children under five suffer from malnutrition, compounding the outbreak's risk to children.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴの新しい地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱の多地域への拡大、死亡例の報告、ヒト-ヒト感染の進行が確認され、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高致死率かつ国際的に懸念される重要な感染症。記事では676例、136死亡という具体的な患者数が報告されており、複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での感染確認。紛争下での弱い保健体制、避難民の大規模移動、医療施設への信頼喪失など、制御困難な状況が明記されている。WHOおよびUNICEFが関与していることから国際的な対応が既に展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: PSO: Ebolos virusas plinta į naujus Kongo regionus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola virus is spreading to new Congo regions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread to new regions, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of June 11, 2026. Olivier le Polain, WHO spokesperson in Beni, North Kivu, said new cases are being detected in an increasing number of health zones, though most remain in Ituri province. Initially, many infections in North and South Kivu were linked to people arriving from Ituri; now there is also local transmission within Ituri. Ongoing conflict, large displacement, and weak health systems hinder response, with 'blind spots' in high-risk areas. UNICEF warns that families avoid hospitals to prevent infection, risking higher child mortality; Ituri province also reports that more than half of children under five are malnourished, heightening vulnerability to Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラウイルスがコンゴの新しい地域に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。進行中のエボラ流行で確認患者676名、死亡136名、複数地域への拡大、医療施設回避による二次リスク、栄養不良人口の脆弱性が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 南キブ州およびイトゥリ州での複数地域への拡大が確認されている。紛争、大規模避難、脆弱な保健システムが対応を妨げており、医療施設回避による隠れた患者増加リスクが懸念される。5歳未満児の半数以上が栄養不良状態にあり、エボラへの脆弱性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Η επιδημία εξακολουθεί να εξαπλώνεται στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The outbreak continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths from Ebola, of the Bundibugyo strain, have been reported in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Most cases are in Ituri province, with new detections now in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO warns the index is rising as zones expand, reflecting true scale and population movement, while weak health systems and insecurity hinder response. A WHO epidemiology lead notes persistent blind spots in high-risk areas and says the exact extent remains uncertain; better estimates should come as surveillance, contact tracing, and diagnostics improve, especially in North Kivu. Contact tracing coverage is a little over 70%. Core measures include safe and dignified burials, infection prevention in health facilities, rapid case identification, isolation and care, strengthened surveillance and community engagement. Africa CDC says Uganda’s linked outbreak is now under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国での流行が引き続き拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症は最高級の病原体であり、複数州への拡大と死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確認症例676件、死亡136件。Ituri州を中心に34の健康地区に拡大。ウガンダでの関連アウトブレイクも言及されているが、サマリー上でウガンダはコントロール下と述べられており、DRCが主題。弱い保健システムと不安全な環境が対応を阻害。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: 'We May See More Children Affected in the Days Ahead' - Unicef Warns As Ebola Spreads in Eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC's Ituri region, centered on Bunia. As of 11 June, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment beyond supportive care. Early pediatric symptoms—fever, diarrhoea, vomiting, weakness, loss of appetite—are non-specific and overlap with malaria, delaying suspicion. Chronic malnutrition affects over half of under-fives in Ituri, and more than 20% are zero-dose for DTP, signaling limited healthcare access that heightens risk amid the outbreak. The region's conflict and displacement hinder surveillance and response. UNICEF emphasizes community engagement; response includes a six-month plan for 3.7 million people, 150 metric tons of supplies to Bunia, over 1,600 community health workers, 24 decontamination teams, and nurseries near Ebola Treatment Centres (first crèche in Bunia). Exported risk: Uganda’s 800-km border remains a concern. UNICEF seeks $70.7 million; $17.4 million unfunded.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：「今後さらに多くの子どもが影響を受ける可能性がある」—ユニセフが東部DRCでエボラが拡大する中で警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な健康影響、異常な出来事、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Ebola outbreak with confirmed cross-border transmission to Uganda, high mortality, vaccine unavailable strain, and humanitarian crisis conditions.
triage.notes: Uganda is mentioned in the data as a location with confirmed cases (19 cases, 2 deaths) and border risk, but Uganda is not on the target country list for verification. Only DRC is included in verified_locations. Critical factors: Bundibugyo strain lacks approved vaccine, high pediatric vulnerability due to malnutrition and low vaccination coverage (>20% zero-dose DTP), conflict/displacement affecting response, ongoing transmission with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of June 11. UNICEF funding gap of $53.3 million indicates significant resource constraint. Cross-border transmission already documented.

article.articleHeadline: Números de casos da doença de Chagas voltam a crescer no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Chagas disease cases is rising again in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease (American trypanosomiasis) cases in Brazil rose from 64 in 2013 to 292 in 2023, according to SINAN. Caused by Trypanosoma cruzi and transmitted mainly by triatomine insects (barbeiro), the disease is also spread via blood transfusion, congenital transmission, ingestion of contaminated food, and laboratory accidents. The rise is attributed largely to oral transmission through contaminated foods, though vectorial and congenital routes persist. An estimated 2–3 million people are infected in Brazil. Prevention centers on improved housing, food hygiene, screens and nets in homes, and avoiding undercooked meat. The acute phase, if detected within the first seven days, is curable and presents with weakness, malaise, swelling, headache, skin pain, and a bite-site lesion; if untreated, the disease often becomes chronic, causing cardiopathy and possibly sudden death. The trend was highlighted by a Goiânia cardiologist, signaling renewed public health concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでシャーガス病の症例数が再び増加
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病の症例増加（2013年64件から2023年292件）は重要な公衆衛生トレンドであり、複数の感染経路と約200～300万人の感染者が存在することは注視を要する。しかし現時点では国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクの具体的証拠に乏しく、情報不足のため段階的な経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: シャーガス病はブラジルの地方病であり、経年的な症例増加傾向が確認されている。重症度（慢性期の心臓病、突然死のリスク）、長期曝露（推定200～300万人の感染者）、流行しやすさ（複数の感染経路：昆虫媒介、輸血、先天性感染、食物摂取）の点でWPRO基準に複数該当する。ただし記事は学術的・統計的トレンド報告であり、急性発症の集団発生やアウトブレイク宣言ではない。国際的拡大やブラジル国外への具体的なリスクについては記事に記載なし。ゴイアスの心臓専門医による警告は公衆衛生への関心を示唆するが、政府機関や国際機関の対応状況は不明。継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths confirmed in DRC displacement camp
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related deaths were confirmed in the Kpangba displacement camp in eastern DRC, where about 30,000 refugees live. The victims, a mother and daughter, died on May 31 and June 1 and were tested for Ebola by the World Health Organization after death. The outbreak has spread to three provinces—Ituri, South Kivu and North Kivu—and the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. As of 12 June 2026, the DRC reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with Uganda reporting 19 cases. The circulating Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. Crowded camp conditions and poor sanitation heighten transmission risk, prompting warnings of rapid spread and panic as responders race to catch up after weeks of undetected transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRC国内避難民キャンプでエボラ出血熱による死亡が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。大規模な感染流行、高い死亡率、国際的拡大、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言の状況。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行。DRC内で676例の確認症例と136例の死亡が報告されており、ウガンダでも19例が確認されている。Bundibugyo strain（承認済みの治療法またはワクチンなし）が循環している。WHO は2026年5月17日に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。避難民キャンプの過密条件と不十分な衛生状態が感染リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo expands as weak contact tracing, insecurity hamper response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus has reached 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; 41 new cases and 9 deaths were reported on Wednesday. The outbreak spans 29 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with ongoing community transmission and rapid geographic expansion. Declared May 15, the outbreak has grown from three reporting zones to 27 in about 10 days. Contact tracing remains well below targets; in Ituri, ~600 confirmed cases would imply ~24,000 contacts, but about 5,000 are listed with only a limited share under active follow-up. The WHO rapid risk assessment rates the DRC risk as very high, noting eightfold case growth between May 22 and June 6. Diagnostic tests not validated for Bundibugyo may have missed early cases; under-reporting, limited laboratory capacity, and insufficient isolation infrastructure are concerns. Cross-border risks remain high; Uganda reports imported cases linked to the DRC, with no sustained community transmission there, while health workers are among the confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱のDR Congoでの流行が接触者追跡の不備と不安定性により拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。676確認症例、136死亡、急速な地理的拡大、国境を越えたウガンダへの波及、接触者追跡の著しい不備（目標の約20%以下）、診断検査の妥当性問題など、深刻な公衆衛生緊急事態であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの波及（輸入症例）が報告されているが、ウガンダでの持続的コミュニティ伝播はまだ確認されていない。ただしDRCが主要な発生地域であり、国境リスクは極めて高い。Bundibugyo亜種によるエボラ出血熱であり、診断検査の妥当性問題により実際の症例数はさらに多い可能性がある。WHO迅速リスク評価でDRCリスクが「非常に高い」と評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: Com caso suspeito em investigação no RS, o que se sabe sobre o surto de ebola no mundo e os riscos para o Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With a suspected case under investigation in Rio Grande do Sul, what is known about the Ebola outbreak worldwide and the risks to Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, investigates a suspected Ebola case: a 64-year-old man who recently returned from Uganda tested positive for malaria; Fiocruz will analyze the sample to rule out Ebola, and close contacts are monitored. A second possible case, a 31-year-old woman who traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, remains in isolation awaiting lab confirmation and is clinically stable. The Epidemiological Surveillance Center considers the risk of an Ebola outbreak in Brazil or South America very low. Globally, the Congo outbreak has 101 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, with 220 suspected deaths and 900 suspected cases overall; Uganda reports 5 confirmed cases and 1 death. WHO declared a public health emergency on May 17. No vaccine for Bundibugyo; treatment is supportive; monoclonals exist for Zaire strain. Diagnosis requires PCR; transmission is by contact with blood or fluids, not airborne; reservoirs are fruit bats.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスル州で調査中の疑わしい症例により、世界的なエボラの流行と何がわかっているか、ブラジルへのリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当：エボラは重篤で高い致死率を持つ（公衆衛生への深刻な影響）、複数国での同時流行は予想外（異常），複数国間での国際的拡大リスク明確，WHO PHEIC宣言済み（渡航制限可能性）。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度、国際的流行性、管理可能性）。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotが付与したが、記事サマリーでは全球流行動向の参考情報として言及されているのみで、調査対象の対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCとブラジルが主たる発生・調査地点。WHO PHEICは2026年5月17日に宣言済み。複数国での確認症例あり、重症度も高い（死亡例報告）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Nyakunde: manque d'ambulances, un défi pour la prise en charge des malades - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nyakunde: shortage of ambulances, a challenge for patient care - ACP
article.articleSummary: Nyankunde health zone, over 50 km from Bunia in Ituri Province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports a critical shortage of ambulances for Ebola case management amid the ongoing outbreak response. On 12 June 2026, Dr. Désiré Duabo said only one vehicle—a non-medicalized jeep transformed into an ambulance—serves suspected Ebola cases and ordinary patients, hindering triage and safe evacuations. He emphasized the need for a dedicated ambulance for suspected Ebola cases and another for non-suspected patients to improve categorization and biosafety during transports to other facilities. Acquisition of a second ambulance would strengthen outbreak-response logistics and safety. Dr. Duabo appealed to technical partners to support Nyankunde with transport resources tailored to Ebola-era patient care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがニャクンデで：救急車不足が患者ケアの課題に - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラの進行中の流行において、患者管理の重大な課題（救急車不足）が報告されている。IHR基準では重大な公衆衛生影響と異常な状況、WPRO基準では重症度・流行性・管理可能性の複数項目で該当し、シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中のエボラ流行におけるニャクンデ保健圏での具体的な運用課題（救急車不足による患者分類・バイオセーフティ上の課題）を報告している。医療施設の資源不足は流行対応能力に直結する重大な問題。国際的技術支援の必要性が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO opozarja na širjenje ebole v DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the spread of Ebola in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading to new areas. More regions are affected, and the number of cases is rising, according to a WHO epidemiologist. The Geneva-based agency notes expanding transmission within DR Congo, with no details on fatalities or laboratory confirmation provided in the excerpt. The warning underscores ongoing outbreak dynamics and the challenge of containment across multiple districts. No information is given about infection sources or imported/exported cases in the current text. The situation calls for intensified surveillance and response efforts in affected provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRコンゴのエボラ感染の拡大に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外性が認められ、4基準中3つ該当。エボラウイルス感染症は高い重症度と死亡率を特徴とし、複数地域への拡大と伝播継続が報告されているため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では2026年6月12日現在、DRコンゴにおけるエボラウイルスの集団発生が新たな地域に拡大していることがWHOから警告されている。複数地域への拡大、症例数の増加が報告されているが、致命数および検査確認情報の詳細は記事サマリーには含まれていない。Genevaはサマリーの発行元（WHO本部の所在地）の記載と考えられるため、実際の発生地は検証対象国ではないSwitzerlandを除外し、DRC（ID: 203312）のみを検証済み地点として記録した。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率（50～90%）を有する新興感染症であり、多地域への拡大報告は国際的懸念の対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Behandeling tegen Ebola in de maak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola treatment in the works
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Ebola continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with rising casualties. For the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus, no approved treatment exists yet, but two candidates may be tested on patients within the next two weeks, according to Laurens Liesenborghs, an infectious-disease physician at the Institute for Tropical Medicine in Antwerp. The outbreak is not yet at its peak, making a medicine crucial. The two promising options are an antiviral to halt viral replication and an antibody-based therapy. Although patient numbers are limited, animal studies have shown very favorable results. The aim is to substantially reduce mortality. The article recalls the 2018 Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, where medicines developed for the Zaïre variant reduced mortality from about 50% to 35%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス治療薬の開発が進行中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の東部DRC発生で、死亡者数増加中。ベルギーでの治療候補薬の臨床試験が計画されており、国際的な対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部でのエボラ流行を主題としている。ベルギー・アントウェルペンは治療薬開発の拠点として言及されているが、実際の病例発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。高リスク：Bundibugyo株は難治性で、死亡率低下に向けた治療薬の国際臨床試験計画がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : au-delà de la prise en charge des malades, MSF assure la désinfection des structures sanitaires
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Beyond patient care, MSF ensures the disinfection of health facilities.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, remains uncontrolled in Mungwalu (Djugu territory) as MSF expands treatment and sanitation efforts. In Mungwalu, MSF runs a 44-bed Ebola Treatment Center; a second center is under construction to bolster capacity. In Bunia, the provincial capital near MSF’s base by the airport, a 60-bed center operates at Elykia Hospital, with another center planned within the same facility to anticipate more cases. Beyond patient care, MSF is assisting the Health Ministry with disinfection of health facilities as part of its rapid-response pillar. A Bunia team disinfects 55 facilities; 3–4 centers have already been disinfected; another team will operate in Fataki in rural areas. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, two patients have recovered; authorities urge heightened vigilance and intensified response to interrupt transmission chains in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ出血熱：患者ケアを超えて、MSFが保健医療施設の消毒を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生でIHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国での治療施設拡張と感染制御対応の進行中であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に発生が宣言されたエボラ出血熱。イトゥリ州ムングワル地域で制御不十分な状態が続いており、MSFが複数の治療センター（ムングワル44床、ブニア60床など）を運営中。保健省と連携し55の保健施設の消毒を実施。感染チェーン遮断に向けた対応が進行中で、国際支援（MSF）が現地で活動している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Spreads in DR Congo, Agencies Brace for Child Cases
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with 676 cases and 136 deaths reported in about three weeks. Cases span from Aru in Ituri to Miti Murhesa in South Kivu, a 1,000 km stretch across 34 health zones, with North Kivu reporting new cases. UNICEF and WHO warn of rising pediatric infections as many children are malnourished and unvaccinated; in Ituri, over half of under-fives are chronically malnourished and more than 20% are zero-dose for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis vaccines. No Bundibugyo-specific therapeutics or vaccines exist. About 70% of contacts are traced; Beni’s lab processed 500 tests in one day to gauge outbreak scale. Response includes eight transport flights delivering 100+ tonnes of supplies; UNICEF has deployed 1,600+ community health workers and 24 decontamination teams, reaching over 160,000 households. Schools may stay open with infection prevention and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で拡大、機関は小児症例に備える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの急速な拡大（3週間で676症例136死亡）、地理的拡散（1,000km、34保健区域）、小児・未接種者への感染リスク、既存の治療法・ワクチン欠如により国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの大規模アウトブレイク。短期間での急速な症例増加、広範な地理的拡散（イトゥーリ州からサウスキブ州）、栄養不良および予防接種未実施の小児人口への高い脆弱性が特徴。UNICEFおよびWHOによる対応実施中だが、既存治療法・ワクチンの欠如が大きなリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για την έξαρση του Έμπολα στο Κονγκό και την εξάπλωση σε νέες περιοχές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and its spread to new areas.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand, with 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths. The World Health Organization warns that the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain is driving the surge, and there is no vaccine or approved therapy for this variant. Most cases are in Ituri province in the northeast, but infections have now been detected in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Daily new detections in new zones reflect true spread driven by population mobility. The health system remains weakened and security unstable, complicating response efforts; emphasis is on strengthening experienced staff, surveillance, contact tracing, and diagnostics, especially in North Kivu. Contact tracing is improving, with just over 70% of contacts traced correctly, according to Olivier Le Polen, reporting from Beni.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の急増と新興地域への拡散に関する警報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱は極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数の州に拡大している。ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo株の出現により、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株はワクチンおよび承認済み治療法が存在しない稀な株である。複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での確認と、34の健康地域への拡大が報告されている。健康システムの脆弱性と治安不安定化により、対応能力が限定的。WHOによる公式警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: NL Health Services Declares Outbreak of Invasive Meningococcal Disease in Central Zone
article.articleSummary: Three lab-confirmed cases of invasive meningococcal disease (IMD) in the Central Zone of Newfoundland and Labrador trigger an outbreak. Public Health has completed case and contact management; all close or high-risk contacts have been notified and offered meningococcal B vaccination. Overall risk to the public remains low. IMD can cause meningitis or meningococcemia; transmission requires close, prolonged face-to-face contact and is not spread by casual contact or shared air. Incubation is 2–10 days (usually 3–4). Symptoms include high fever, purplish rash, severe headache, stiff neck, vomiting, and drowsiness. Precautions: avoid saliva-sharing items, cover coughs/sneezes, practice hand hygiene, and stay up to date with routine immunizations. Meningitis B vaccination is recommended for identified close/high-risk contacts; others are not considered close contacts for post-exposure vaccination. NL Health Services will monitor and update the public as needed.

triage.headline_ja: NL Health Services Declares Outbreak of Invasive Meningococcal Disease in Central Zone（NL保健局がセントラルゾーンにおける侵襲性髄膜炎菌疾患の発生を宣言）
triage.triage_reason: 侵襲性髄膜炎菌疾患（IMD）の3件の確定症例による発生宣言。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、死亡リスク、および国際流行リスクの観点からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはカナダ（Newfoundland and Labrador）およびフィリピン（Ilocos地域）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はNnewfoundland and Labrador（カナダ）での発生である。カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし、Ilocos（フィリピン）が記事に明記されており、フィリピンは対象国に含まれるため、フィリピンを verified_locations に含める。注：記事サマリーの内容からはカナダでの発生が主題と判断されるが、Bluedot APIの地域検出の不正確性により、フィリピンも発生地域として付与されている可能性がある。実際には、記事サマリーに基づく限り、カナダでの発生が主題であり、フィリピンが実際の発生地であるかは明確ではない。再検討の結果、記事サマリーに「Ilocos」や「Philippines」に関する記述がないため、verified_locationsは[]とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: DR CONGO-ITURI-EBOLA OUTBREAK-CONFIRMED CASES
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ituri Province Ebola outbreak has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with health authorities warning of continued community transmission and the risk of sudden geographic expansion. In Bunia, a June 9, 2026 image shows a staff member outside a quarantine zone at an Ebola treatment center, illustrating ongoing containment efforts. The report dated June 12, 2026 notes sustained transmission within communities and the possibility of rapid spread to new areas if unchecked. No infection source or imported/exported case details are provided in the article, and authorities warned of the potential for geographic spread despite containment measures, to neighboring districts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州エボラ出血熱流行-確認患者数
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（高致死性・国際的懸念病原体）の確認された流行で、確認患者676名・死亡136名、コミュニティ内での持続的伝播と地理的拡大リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準4項目すべて該当する。フルRRAを要する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高優先度のシグナル。患者数・死亡数・持続的コミュニティ伝播・隣接地区への拡大リスク警告がすべて記事に明記されており、IHR/WPROスクリーニング基準をすべて満たす。即座のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading into new areas in northeast DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding into new areas, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Ituri province remains the epicenter, with spillovers in North Kivu and South Kivu. Since declaring the outbreak on May 15, there have been 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths, plus 119 suspected cases and 32 recoveries, according to WHO. Isolation bed capacity is far below anticipated need, and no approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo. Cases are being identified in new health zones almost daily, indicating rapid geographic spread and high population mobility. While early transmission was linked to hotspots, there is now local community spread in new areas, with several blind spots in high-risk regions. From Beni in North Kivu, WHO epidemiologist Olivier le Polain underscored the ongoing expansion and challenges.}

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国北東部の新たな地域に拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の地理的拡大、高い死亡率、国境越えのリスク、ワクチン/治療法の欠如が確認される。WHO公式通知相当の重大イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行が確認されており、Ituri州を中心にNorth Kivu、South Kivu州への拡大が明記されている。確認症例676名、死亡136名、疑い例119名。Bundibugyo型に対する承認済みワクチンおよび治療法が存在しないことは深刻。日次での新規症例確認と地理的拡大が加速している。WHOの現地疫学者による情報も含まれており、官公庁の関心が高い。国際的支援の必要性が明白。

article.articleHeadline: Frio chega, vírus circulam e vacinação contra gripe segue baixa em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cold arrives, viruses circulate, and influenza vaccination remains low in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination coverage in Mato Grosso do Sul stands at 43.85% as winter and higher circulation of respiratory viruses begin, with the state reporting 67 influenza deaths in 2026. The latest epidemiological bulletin records 3,523 severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) hospitalizations and 525 laboratory-confirmed influenza cases this year, including 378 Influenza A and 147 Influenza B. Vaccination remains the primary preventive measure to reduce hospitalizations and deaths; vaccines are freely available at municipal health units. In addition to immunization, authorities urge hand hygiene, well-ventilated environments, respiratory etiquette, and mask use when symptomatic. Some municipalities show higher uptake (Japorã 75.09%, Vicentina 71.70%, Jateí 64.88%), but most cities fall short of targets. Active vaccination campaigns and outreach to schools, elderly care facilities, and high-traffic sites are ongoing to expand coverage.

triage.headline_ja: 寒冷気候の到来、ウイルスが循環し、マトグロッソドスル州ではインフルエンザ予防接種率が低いままである
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのインフルエンザA/B流行は季節性であり、予防接種率43.85%の低さが懸念されるが、重症度・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクはいずれも明白ではない。情報不足のため継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、既知のパターン内。予防接種キャンペーンが実施中であり、当局が対応中。死亡数67件と重症化事例の詳細情報は不足。社会的・政府的関心は高まっているが、国際的な懸念は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Neue Regionen im Kongo von Ebola betroffen - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Regions in the Congo Affected by Ebola - German Medical Journal
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding to new health zones, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of Thursday. Most cases remain in Ituri province, but transmission has expanded to Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu, including locally acquired infections in those provinces and many cases among people originally from Ituri who now reside there. In Beni, North Kivu, the outbreak response faces ongoing fighting, displacement, and a fragile health system. Daily case counts are rising, and limited laboratory capacity delays confirmatory testing despite some mobile laboratories and recent improvements. UNICEF warns that fear of infection is reducing routine clinic visits, risking higher child mortality, while in Ituri more than half of children under five are malnourished, worsening vulnerability during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの新たな地域がエボラに影響を受ける - ドイツ医学誌
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。エボラウイルス疾患の多地域拡大、高死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、複数の深刻な社会的影響が認識される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患の確認症例676例、死亡136例（配信日時2026-06-12時点）。イトゥリ州、ノルド・キブ州、スッド・キブ州に拡大。紛争の継続、保健システムの脆弱性、検査容量の不足、栄養不良児の高率（イトゥリで5歳未満の50%以上）により管理が極めて困難。ユニセフの警告による感染恐怖に伴う医療利用低下も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz fará análise de caso suspeito de Ebola no RS; paciente testou positivo para malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz to analyze suspected Ebola case in Rio Grande do Sul; patient tested positive for malaria.
article.articleSummary: In Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, a 64-year-old man with recent travel to Uganda is under investigation for Ebola virus disease after presenting to a Novo Hamburgo health unit. Rapid malaria testing returned positive for Plasmodium falciparum, and malaria is currently the leading diagnosis. Nonetheless, Ebola testing continues under ongoing protocols established by the Ministry of Health. The investigation and infection control measures were implemented immediately, and laboratory confirmation is pending to distinguish malaria from Ebola. Once confirmed, appropriate malaria treatment has already been initiated. Fiocruz will analyze the suspected Ebola case as part of the assessment. The investigation remains active, with public health surveillance maintained and the patient remaining under medical care while travel-linked exposure from Uganda is considered.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruz がリオ・グランデ・ド・スルのエボラ疑い患者を分析へ；患者はマラリア陽性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的な拡大リスク）。ウガンダへの渡航歴を持つエボラ疑い患者がブラジルで報告された典型的な輸入感染症シグナルであり、初期検査はマラリア陽性だが、エボラの除外検査が進行中。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 患者の確定診断はまだペンディング中。現在の診断はマラリア（Plasmodium falciparum）だが、ウガンダからの渡航歴とエボラの初期症状の重複により、エボラを含む鑑別診断が進行中。発生地域フィールドにはUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーでは患者がウガンダを訪問した旅行歴があるのであり、ウガンダでの実際の発生ではないため、verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | "نقاط غامضة" تعيق رصد انتشار إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Your News Net | "Mysterious points" hinder monitoring of the spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported. The outbreak has expanded to three health zones in eastern DRC and reached neighboring Uganda. A WHO epidemiologist in Beni highlighted data gaps in high-risk areas, calling for enhanced surveillance. Isolation capacity is critically limited, with fewer than 250 beds across the three affected provinces. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. The outbreak had gone unmonitored for weeks as responders attempt containment. WHO has not yet issued size estimates; the CDC has warned it could reach West Africa–era levels seen in 2014–2016, which killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: 「謎の地点」がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ拡大の監視を阻害している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。確定症例676件、死亡136件、複数国に拡大、治療法なしのBundibugyo株。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示される発生地はDRC（東部3つのヘルスゾーン）およびウガンダへの拡大。Bluedot APIが示すAngolaは記事サマリーに言及されていないため除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、ウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。治療法・ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株であることが重篤性を高める。

article.articleHeadline: Le CDC Afrique salue sa coopération avec la Chine dans la lutte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC welcomes its cooperation with China in the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, Africa CDC reports 654 confirmed Ebola cases (Bundibugyo strain) in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 129 fatalities. Contact-tracing gaps in eastern Congo's Ituri province hinder containment, as many contacts remain unidentified or lack active follow-up. Authorities cite rapid geographic spread, late detection, high mobility, insecurity, community resistance, and unequal tracing capacity across health zones as drivers of insufficient contact investigation. Operational barriers include unsafe burials, community mistrust, limited case management, funding shortfalls, and security concerns. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya welcomed ongoing China cooperation, noting financial support, human resources, and public-health products across African nations, including the continent’s health agency. Ebola symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, generalized pain or malaise, with internal/external bleeding in severe cases; case-fatality rates vary by viral subtype per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCが、エボラ感染症との闘いにおける中国との協力を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。エボラウイルス感染症の既知の極めて重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、DRCとウガンダでの確認事例と急速な地理的拡大、高い致死率(約20%)、複数国への国際的拡大の可能性。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州でのエボラウイルス感染症(Bundibugyo株)の流行。654例の確認症例と129人の死亡が報告されている。接触者追跡の大きな課題があり、地域的な拡大と複数国への拡散リスクが高い。記事ではウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、サマリーの主な焦点はDRCでの流行状況にあり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。中国による国際支援が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Českému vojakovi sa skončila karanténa, príznaky eboly sa u neho neprejavili
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Czech soldier's quarantine has ended; he did not develop any Ebola symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related quarantines highlight the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). A Czech soldier returning on May 22, 2026 from a United Nations peacekeeping mission in the DRC was placed in preventive isolation at the Těchonín facility; he had no confirmed contact with Ebola cases and showed no symptoms, and was released after three weeks. Similarly, an American physician who worked in the DRC and was treated at Bulovka hospital spent three weeks in isolation without developing symptoms and was discharged. The latest Ebola outbreak began in mid-May in Ituri Province, with the virus spreading to other provinces and into neighboring Uganda; authorities say more than 100 people have died in the DRC this week. Isolation on return from foreign missions remains a standard precaution.

triage.headline_ja: チェコ兵士の隔離が終了、エボラ症状は発症しなかった
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで確認され、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・重症度を満たす。また、WPRO基準では異常性・重症度・流行易性が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダへの拡大が言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。本イベントはコンゴ民主共和国での流行の継続を示す報告であり、5月中旬に開始された流行で100名以上の死亡が報告されている。チェコとアメリカの事例は返国時の予防隔離の記録であり、進行中の流行の確実な証拠を提供している。

article.articleHeadline: OMS afirma que el brote de ébola sigue expandiéndose en número de casos y geográficamente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says the Ebola outbreak continues to expand in the number of cases and geographically.
