article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to grow both in case numbers and geographic spread. The DRC Ministry of Health reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of Thursday, with new cases identified nearly daily in new health zones. The epicenters include Ituri province, along with North Kivu and South Kivu, amid ongoing insecurity and high population mobility that hinder response. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage; there is no vaccine or specific treatment available. Uganda reports 19 cases, 14 imported from the DRC, including two deaths. The WHO is expanding surveillance, bolstering laboratories, engaging communities, improving infection prevention, and supporting clinical care while acknowledging “blind spots” and uncertainty about the true mortality rate and full clinical picture.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行は症例数および地理的に引き続き拡大していると述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間流行で極めて高いリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）も含まれていますが、サマリーではウガンダは導入された症例（imported cases）の報告のみで、活発な流行地ではありません。DRCが主要な発生地として verified_locations に含めました。エボラ出血熱の拡大流行、死亡例、ワクチン/治療法の欠如、不十分な対応環境など、複数の深刻なリスク要因が存在します。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆「醫院內感染」登革熱群聚　70歲婦「發燒、頭暈」相鄰病室共5人確診 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung dengue fever cluster linked to nosocomial infection; five diagnosed in adjacent patient rooms; 70-year-old woman with fever and dizziness.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first hospital-based dengue fever cluster in Kaohsiung City. The index patient, a woman in her 70s from Sanmin District with chronic illness, was hospitalized May 29, discharged June 10, and developed fever and dizziness on June 11; she tested positive for Dengue fever type 2. With most incubation occurring during hospitalization, Kaohsiung City Health Bureau expanded contact tracing and testing in neighboring wards. On June 12, four additional positive cases were detected in adjacent rooms, totaling five dengue cases linked to the same ward. Contacts are being quarantined and expanded testing continues to identify infection sources. As of June 12, Taiwan has 74 dengue cases, 6 locally acquired (all in Kaohsiung) and 68 imported, chiefly from Indonesia (21), Maldives (14), and Vietnam (9). Authorities urge mosquito-control measures including 'drain, empty, clean, scrub' after rainfall and advise seeking medical care if fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, or rash, with travel history disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市で院内感染によるデング熱集団発生；70歳女性が発熱・めまい；隣接病室で計5人確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の院内感染デング熱集団発生は異常・予想外であり、接触者隔離・追跡調査が進行中である。WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行可能性、管理可能性）を複数満たし、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは台湾（対象国外）でのデング熱院内感染集団発生を主題としている。発生地域にインドネシア・ベトナム・モルディブが含まれるが、これらは輸入症例の由来地であり、当該イベント（院内感染クラスタ）の発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsはインドネシア・ベトナムのみとした（モルディブは対象国外）。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Caso suspeito de ebola em idoso no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected case of Ebola in an elderly person in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in a 64-year-old man in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, who had traveled to Uganda. Fiocruz is performing tests and will rule out contamination; the patient will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre for analyses and, if confirmed, to a national reference unit. He also tested positive for malaria and is under treatment. Contacts are under medical observation for 30 days. A separate suspected case in São Paulo concerns a 31-year-old Brazilian who had been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; she arrived June 6, developed diarrhea and fever, and was transferred to the Emílio Ribas Institute on June 10. Worldwide, the WHO reports 84 Ebola deaths and 471 confirmed cases in Africa, concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (452 cases, 82 deaths since May 15). Uganda reports new cases and deaths near the Congo border (19 infections, 2 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのリオグランデドスル州の高齢者における疑い新型出血熱症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な流行状況（アフリカでの452症例、82死亡）と、ブラジルへの地理的拡大事例、重篤な転帰リスク、複数国での確認症例が確認される。
triage.notes: 複数国での確認：ブラジル（リオグランデドスル州、サンパウロ州）とコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダでも症例報告。マラリア共感染あり。WHO報告の大規模なアフリカ流行の文脈での地理的拡大事例として極めて重要。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Епидемията от ебола се разпространява в нови райони в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak is spreading to new areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand, with 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported by WHO. The outbreak, centered in Ituri province, is spreading to new health zones, and WHO notes cases almost daily in newly affected areas. While most infections remain in Ituri, local transmission has now been documented in North Kivu and South Kivu as people move from Ituri. Ongoing conflict, large displacement, and a weak health system create blind spots and hinder containment; the full scale of the outbreak remains unclear. UNICEF warns families are avoiding routine hospital visits for sick children due to fear of infection, risking additional child deaths. In Ituri, more than half of under-five children are malnourished, increasing vulnerability. Source: WHO, UNICEF; 12 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国の新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数地域への拡大、国際的な懸念、および渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則上の最高リスク病原体。既に676人の確定患者と136人の死亡が報告されており、Ituri州を中心に複数の州（North Kivu、South Kivu）への拡大が確認されている。武力紛争、大規模な人口移動、脆弱な保健システムにより制御が困難となっている。UNICEFの警告として、予防的行動回避による二次的な死亡リスクも懸念されている。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta que el brote de ébola en el Congo sigue expandiéndose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to expand, with 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of Thursday. The epicenter remains Ituri, the largest hotspot, with spread across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and ongoing transmission in communities. The strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization (WHO) warns that high population mobility, weak health systems, and insecurity from armed groups hinder response. Uganda, the second-affected country, has recorded 19 cases, including 14 imported from the DRC and two deaths. WHO and partners are expanding surveillance, boosting laboratories, community engagement, infection prevention, and clinical care, while acknowledging blind spots in high-risk areas and incomplete understanding of the case-fatality rate and full clinical picture. The threat of cross-border spread to urban areas remains a concern.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染症の流行が引き続き拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて重篤な疾患で深刻な公衆衛生影響を及ぼし、複数国への国際的拡大が既に発生している。国際的な懸念と支援ニーズが明確である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の流行は極めて重篤な感染症事象。DRCにおいて676例の確定症例と136例の死亡が報告され、ウガンダへの越境拡大も既に確認されている（19症例、うち2例が死亡）。ワクチンと特異的治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行であることが懸念される。保健体制の脆弱性と武装勢力による不安全性が対応を阻害している。フルのRRA実施が急務である。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC es el tercero más grande de la historia, según la Unión Africana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is the third largest in history, according to the African Union.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, 2026, is the third largest by confirmed cases in history (since 1976), according to Africa CDC. As of June 12, 2026, the DRC reports 635 confirmed cases and 127 deaths; Uganda has 19 cases, including 14 imported from eastern Congo, with two deaths. The epicenter is Ituri, with transmission in North Kivu and South Kivu. The circulating Bundibugyo strain has a fatality rate of 30–50%, and there is no WHO-licensed vaccine or specific treatment. About 62.2% of cases are aged 15–44; children under 4 have a case-fatality of 43.8%. Health workers operate in 27 affected zones but face gaps: seven of 49 safe-burial teams, seven of 98 ambulances, and 84 of 500 staff on duty. WHO Africa/CDC notes regional risk is high in sub-Saharan Africa, with global risk considered low.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合によると、RDCのエボラ出血熱流行は歴史上3番目に大きい
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率（30-50%）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、635確認例と127死亡は異常・予想外であり、ウガンダへの越境感染で国際的拡大リスクが既に現実化し、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染（19例、2死亡）が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCのみを記載。高い致死率（30-50%）、医療資源の深刻な不足（安全埋葬チーム、救急車、医療スタッフいずれも不足）、ワクチン・治療法の不在という条件下での流行であり、RRA（詳細リスク評価）の実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: حالتا وفاة مرتبطتان بـ"إيبولا" في مخيم للنازحين في شرق الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two deaths linked to Ebola in an internally displaced persons camp in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with transmission expanding to three additional health zones and crossing into Uganda. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO epidemiologist Olivier Le Bolin cautions that many points remain ambiguous and surveillance gaps persist, noting fewer than 250 isolation beds across the three affected provinces. UNHCR reports two Ebola-related deaths among internally displaced people in the Kabangba camp in eastern Congo, which houses about 30,000 refugees, highlighting high transmission risk and the need for strengthened prevention and response measures. WHO has not yet issued a final outbreak size estimate; CDC has warned the outbreak could reach levels seen in West Africa in 2014–2016, with over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴの難民キャンプでエボラ関連の2人の死亡が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：676確定例136死亡、異常性：国家間拡大、国際的感染拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準全5項目該当。国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダの両国での発生を言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。2026年6月時点で大規模アウトブレイク進行中（676確定例）、ワクチン/治療薬がないBundibugyo ebolavirus株、難民キャンプでの感染リスク拡大。CDCは2014-16年西アフリカ流行並みの規模に達する可能性を警告。フルRRAの早急な実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Spatiotemporal dynamics and antimicrobial resistance of bacterial pathogens recovered from various fomites at a paediatric care facility in Ghana
article.articleSummary: 12-week longitudinal surveillance of fomites at Princess Marie Louise Children’s Hospital (PML), Accra, Ghana, from Sep 4 to Nov 26, 2023, across Emergency, NICU, Malnutrition, and Outpatient units. High-touch surfaces were swabbed weekly; 600 swabs yielded 1,120 bacterial isolates across 33 genera. Among Gram-positives, Staphylococcus epidermidis dominated (97 isolates, 34.3%), followed by S. haemolyticus (42, 14.8%) and S. aureus (34, 12.0%). Gram-negatives were led by Acinetobacter baumannii (91, 18.2%), Klebsiella pneumoniae (54, 10.8%), and Escherichia coli (38, 7.6%). Contamination varied by surface; thermometers, thermometer trays, weighing tables, and IV setting trays were highly contaminated. Item-level hot spots included Babe’s Cot A (30 isolates); Omicron thermometer B had one of the lowest (18). Antimicrobial resistance was substantial: S. aureus 0–93%; Enterococcus faecium 66.7–91.7% and 18.9–90%; E. coli 29.6–88.9%; K. pneumoniae 40–82%. Overall, heavy contamination with diverse pathogens and notable AMR underscores need for strengthened infection prevention and control in Ghanaian pediatric care settings.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナの小児ケア施設における医療関連環境表面のフォーマイトから回収された細菌病原体の時空間動態と抗菌薬耐性
triage.triage_reason: ガーナの小児病院での12週間の前向き監視研究報告であり、多剤耐性菌の高い汚染が確認されています。ただし、臨床症例報告や患者発症ではなく環境サーベイランスデータであるため、現在の急性的な公衆衛生上の脅威の証拠に乏しく、情報が限定的です。
triage.notes: 本記事は査読済みの学術論文（Nature Scientific Reports）であり、ガーナのアクラにある小児病院での環境サーベイランス研究です。多剤耐性菌の高い割合（S. aureus 0-93%、E. coli 29.6-88.9%など）が報告されていますが、現在の流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、過去（2023年9月-11月）のデータです。患者の臨床転帰や感染症例の詳細が記載されていないため、直近の急性的な脅威の程度が不明です。感染予防管理強化の必要性は指摘されていますが、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクは低いと判断されます。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Flu Infection May Increase TB Susceptibility: Study
article.articleSummary: Influenza infection may increase TB susceptibility, according to an Imperial College London study reported in Nature Communications. Using blood from participants in influenza human challenge studies, researchers found that post-influenza blood infected with TB mycobacteria showed significantly higher mycobacterial growth than pre-infection or influenza-uninfected controls. The loss of control is driven by disruption of immune pathways, specifically type 1 interferon signalling, which is essential for containing TB. The findings suggest that seasonal flu vaccines could offer protection against TB in high-prevalence regions such as India, Indonesia and South Africa, where about 11 million people fall ill with TB each year. With rising multidrug-resistant TB (MDR-TB), vaccination could be a cost-effective strategy to strengthen protection. The study advocates large-scale trials and was funded by NIHR Imperial Biomedical Research Centre, NIHR Imperial Clinical Research Facility and the Wellcome Trust; published as ‘Influenza coinfection inhibits control of mycobacterial infection in a human challenge model.’

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ感染は結核感染のリスクを高める可能性：研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は Imperial College London による研究成果の報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではなく、科学的知見の発表である。ただし結核とインフルエンザの相互作用に関する重要な知見を示唆しており、高流行地域での公衆衛生施策に関連するため、経過観察の対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の高蔓延国（インド、インドネシア、南アフリカ）における結核予防戦略の可能性に関する学術研究報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクイベントではない。Bluedot API が South Africa と United Kingdom を含めているが、記事の主題は研究成果の報告であり、これらの国での具体的な発生状況は述べられていない。対象国リストに基づき India と Indonesia のみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Gevreesde kattenschimmel gevonden in vogels, zoogdieren en een slang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Feared cat fungus found in birds, mammals and a snake
article.articleSummary: DNA of Sporothrix fungi (S. brasiliensis, S. schenckii, S. globosa) was detected in wild wildlife in Brazil's Paraná state, indicating a broader host range for the sporotrichosis pathogen beyond domestic cats. While S. brasiliensis is especially linked to Brazil and sporotrichosis, researchers found fungal DNA in 11 of 178 tissue samples from 81 wild animals (39 mammals, 36 birds, 6 reptiles) collected from 2017–2023 along two highways near Atlantic Forest and agricultural areas. The fungus was found in heart and liver tissues, suggesting systemic presence, though active infection could not be confirmed in all cases. Birds appeared susceptible despite higher body temperatures; some Sporothrix spores endured higher temperatures. A 'false coral snake' also harbored fungal DNA. The study implies wild animals could act as reservoirs, enabling broader, environmental persistence and potential spillover to humans and other animals; more work is needed to confirm infectious forms.

triage.headline_ja: 恐れられているネコの真菌がネコ以外の野生動物（鳥類、哺乳類、ヘビ）から検出される
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシス病原体(Sporothrix)の野生動物での検出という予想外の知見であり、人間への潜在的な影響が示唆されているが、現時点では確認された患者発生がなく、より確実な疫学情報が必要である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルのパラナ州での野生動物（野鳥、哺乳類、ヘビ）からのSporrothrix菌のDNA検出を主題としている。米国マサチューセッツ州は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではスポロトリコーシスのイベントが発生していないため、verified_locationsには含めない。現時点では動物のみでの検出であり、人間への実際の感染報告はないため、社会的・政治的関心の詳細は不明である。

article.articleHeadline: A decade of progress and persistent challenges following the public health emergency of Zika virus - Nature Health
article.articleSummary: Zika virus (ZIKV), a mosquito-borne flavivirus, was first identified in Uganda in 1947, with a 2007 Yap Island outbreak in Micronesia signaling its global potential. The first clear signal of a heightened public-health threat appeared during the French Polynesia outbreak of 2013–2014, when increased Guillain-Barré syndrome and other neurological complications were noted. The Americas experienced rapid spread in 2015, along with the emergence of severe congenital malformations, particularly microcephaly, in infants born to mothers infected during pregnancy. From April 2015 to year-end, Brazil reported more than 500,000 suspected Zika cases and growing numbers of neonatal microcephaly in affected areas. In response, WHO and PAHO issued three epidemiological alerts—the initial Zika outbreak, followed by alerts on congenital microcephaly and on neurological disease. The article frames a decade of progress and persistent challenges following the public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: ジカウイルスの公衆衛生上の緊急事態から10年：進捗と継続する課題 - Nature Health
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2026年時点での回顧的レビューであり、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクを報告していない。ジカウイルスは既知の病原体であり、歴史的事象（2007年、2013-2014年、2015年）を総括したもので、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威を示していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術出版物（Nature Health）による過去のジカウイルス公衆衛生危機の総括記事である。記事サマリーは歴史的な発生地（ウガンダ2007年、ヤップ島2007年、ポリネシア2013-2014年、ブラジル2015年）を記述しているが、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。したがって、シグナルトリアージの対象外とする。verified_locationsにはブラジルのみを含める（歴史的記述の主要対象であり、対象国リスト内）。

article.articleHeadline: Uma doença antiga e que ainda mata: a realidade da tuberculose no século 21
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An ancient disease that still kills: the reality of tuberculosis in the 21st century.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Koch bacillus) remains a deadly airborne infection worldwide. While primarily affecting the lungs, it can involve kidneys, bones, and the nervous system. In 2024, the World Health Organization reported about 1.23 million TB deaths globally. Transmission occurs via airborne droplets expelled when an infected person coughs, talks, or sneezes. Common symptoms include a persistent cough (>3 weeks), fever, night sweats, fatigue, and weight loss; early stealthy forms can hinder early diagnosis and amplify transmission. Treatment requires a multidrug regimen for at least six months; premature interruption risks drug-resistant TB, complicating control. HIV coinfection markedly increases the risk of active tuberculosis. Socioeconomic disparities (poverty, malnutrition, crowded living conditions) drive higher incidence and poorer access to diagnosis and treatment. Global WHO campaigns strive to combat TB, but enduring challenges demand improved living conditions, information access, and health system strengthening.

triage.headline_ja: 古い病気だがいまだに人命を奪っている：21世紀の結核の現実
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIV併発の慢性的な公衆衛生課題を扱う記事であり、異常性や緊急性は低い。ただしブラジルにおける結核の負担と社会的課題に関する認識向上記事として注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の一般的な疾病啓発・教育記事である。新規の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、既知の慢性感染症(TB/HIV)の公衆衛生的負担に関する解説記事。IHR基準は「深刻な公衆衛生影響」に該当するが、「異常性」や「国際的拡大リスク」は低い。WPROスクリーニングでは重症度・長期曝露・流行性は認められるが、これらは既知の状況である。緊急性が低いため WATCH 判定とした。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: HIV/AIDS dan TB Masih Jadi Ancaman, Pemkot Jayapura Perkuat Deteksi Dini untuk Lindungi Warga.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV/AIDS and TB Still a Threat, Jayapura City Government Strengthens Early Detection to Protect Residents.
article.articleSummary: Jayapura City, Papua, Indonesia, through the City Health Office, is intensifying early detection of HIV/AIDS and tuberculosis to curb transmission among residents. Juliana Napitupulu, Head of the City Health Office, says early detection is the key to ensuring patients receive timely treatment and reducing spread. Jayapura remains the province’s hotspot for HIV/AIDS, with cumulative cases reaching 11,235 in Q1 2026, up from 10,946 at the end of 2025. For tuberculosis, 3,007 cases were recorded in 2025, and from January to May 2026, 932 additional TB cases were identified. Officials emphasize that prevention also depends on public awareness to undergo routine health checks and not delay treatment. Yusnita, Head of the Communicable Disease Prevention and Control Section, notes strengthening screening and health examinations at service facilities as part of the strategy to protect residents.

triage.headline_ja: HIV/AIDS と TB は依然として脅威、ジャヤプラ市政府が住民保護のため早期検出を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャヤプラ）における HIV/AIDS と結核の継続的な流行を報告。IHR基準は最小限度の該当であるが、スクリーニング基準での「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当する可能性があり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ジャヤプラはパプア州の HIV/AIDS ホットスポット。2026年 Q1 時点で累計 11,235 件（2025年末時点 10,946 件）。結核は 2025 年に 3,007 件、2026 年 1-5 月に 932 件。市政府による早期検出強化の行動は適切な公衆衛生対応だが、イベント自体は既知の流行の継続であり「異常・予想外」ではない。フルRRA の必要性は限定的だが、地域的な重篤性と管理可能性の詳細について追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Armáda propustila vojáka z preventivní karantény. Sloužil v oblasti, kde je ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The army released a soldier from preventive quarantine. He served in an area where Ebola is present.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to spread, with cross-border concerns to Uganda as of early June 2026: 515 confirmed cases in the DRC with 91 deaths; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and two deaths, with one death likely linked to Ebola. A Czech soldier on a UN observer mission in the DRC returned May 22 and was placed in preventive quarantine at the Center for Biological Protection in Těchonín, Orlickoústecko, to protect his health and the public. He was the sole Czech participant and had no known contact with infected individuals or symptoms, and was released from quarantine on June 12, 2026. Ebola transmits via contact with an infected person or contaminated materials and presents fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and bleeding; case fatality historically ranges from 25% to 90%. The article notes the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak as context.

triage.headline_ja: 軍がエボラが存在する地域で勤務していた兵士を予防的隔離から釈放
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが515確認例（死亡91名）、ウガンダにも波及し、チェコのUN職員が関与している国際的関心事案。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行（515確認例、91死亡）とウガンダへの波及（19確認例、2死亡）を記述している。チェコの兵士は国連視察団の一員で、DRC滞在後に帰国し予防的隔離されていた。Bluedot APIが付与した「発生地域」にはチェコの地名（Těchonín、Pardubický kraj、Czechia）も含まれているが、これらは兵士の隔離地の参考情報であり、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCとウガンダである。対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみのため、verified_locationsはDRCを含む。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに未含。

article.articleHeadline: Újabb áldozatot követelt az ebola Afrikában
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims another victim in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two people died from Ebola infection in a crowded internally displaced persons camp in Kpangba in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, UNHCR said on June 12, 2026. The 30,000-resident camp heightens transmission risk, prompting calls for immediate public health measures to strengthen prevention and response. WHO cautioned that the true extent may be larger than official figures; in the three affected provinces, the country has recorded 676 confirmed Ebola infections and 136 deaths to date. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. Isolation capacity is limited, with only about 250 hospital beds available for isolation across the three provinces. Authorities reported new spread to three health zones in North Kivu and Ituri. The CDC previously warned the outbreak could reach levels seen in 2014-2016.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカでさらなる犠牲者を奪う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。稀なブンディブギョエボラウイルス亜型による大規模アウトブレイク、ワクチンなし、死亡多数、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク有り。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはSierra Leoneも含まれているが、記事サマリーでの主要な発生地はKpangba（東部DRC）および3つの州（北キヴ、イトゥリ）。Sierra Leoneは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo亜型は稀で有効なワクチンなし。2014-2016年のエボラ危機規模への警告あり。IDPs収容所での高い感染リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in RD Congo: possibile aumento dei bambini colpiti nei prossimi giorni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: possible increase in the number of children affected in the coming days.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DRC, centered in Ituri with Bunia as a focal point. As of June 11, the DRC reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 confirmed deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments beyond supportive care; emphasis on prevention, infection control, and community engagement. Early cases in children may rise; initial symptoms include fever, diarrhea, vomiting, fatigue, and loss of appetite—non-specific and easily mistaken for malaria, prevalent in Ituri. Widespread displacement, malnutrition (over half of under-fives with chronic malnutrition) and vaccination gaps hinder response. The Ugandan border outbreak reports 19 cases and 2 deaths; cross-border transmission risk remains high along roughly 800 km. UNICEF response: 3.7 million people reached; 150 tons of aid delivered to Bunia; 1,600 health workers trained; 24 decontamination squads; 160,000+ families engaged; establishing child-friendly spaces near care centers; nursery opening soon. UNICEF seeks $70.7 million for six months, with $17.4 million unfunded.

triage.headline_ja: DRC におけるエボラ出血熱：今後数日間で被害児童の増加の可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR 基準 4 つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイク（676 確定例、136 死亡）、治療法やワクチンの欠如、ウガンダへの越境感染リスク（19 例、2 死亡）、児童を含む増加傾向、栄養不良と予防接種ギャップによる対応困難などから、国際的拡大と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が確実。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダにおける越境感染の報告（19 例、2 死亡）が記載されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC が対象国であり、エボラ・マラリアの同時流行、児童患者の増加見通し、UNICEF による資金不足（$17.4 百万未融資）が確認されている。越境感染リスクの高さと地域不安定性（広範な避難民、栄養不良）から国際支援が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆「醫院內感染」登革熱群聚 70歲婦「發燒、頭暈」相鄰病室共5人確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung Dengue Fever Nosocomial Cluster in a Hospital; 70-year-old Woman with Fever and Dizziness; Five People in Adjacent Rooms Diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first nosocomial dengue fever cluster this year in a Kaohsiung City hospital. The index patient is a woman in her 70s from Sanmin District who was hospitalized on May 29 for another illness, discharged June 10, then developed fever and dizziness on June 11 and was confirmed with dengue fever serotype 2. Five people in adjacent rooms were subsequently diagnosed, forming an intra-hospital cluster. Health authorities rapidly conducted expanded epidemiological investigations and testing to identify further cases. As of June 12, 2026, Taiwan has 74 dengue cases, including 6 locally acquired—all in Kaohsiung—and 68 imported; sources are mainly Southeast Asia and South Asia, with Indonesia (21), Maldives (14), and Vietnam (9) top origins. Globally, dengue surpassed 1.02 million cases by April, rising in the Americas (Brazil, Bolivia, Colombia) and Asia. Authorities urge environmental cleanup after rain ('巡、倒、清、刷') and prompt medical care for fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, or rash, with travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で「院内感染」デング熱クラスター発生、70歳女性が発熱・めまい、隣の病室を含む5人が確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で初の院内感染デング熱クラスター（5人）が報告され、異常性と重症度が高い。IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは台湾（高雄市）を主要発生地とし、院内感染クラスター（5人）が確認された点が重要。グローバルデング熱流行の背景にあり、インドネシア・モルジブ・ベトナムからの輸入症例が流行源。上記4カ国の verified_locations は、台湾での輸入源国および対象国リスト内での流行状況言及に基づく。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго се разраства, страхът застрашава децата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic in DR Congo is expanding, fear threatens children.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is widening into new territories. As of 11 June 2026, 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths have been recorded, with most cases still in Ituri province but local transmission now occurring in North Kivu and South Kivu, involving individuals from Ituri. Olivier Le Polen, WHO representative in Beni, North Kivu, noted cases are emerging nearly daily in new health zones, signaling expanding reach amid conflict, large displacement, and a weak health system that create blind spots in high-risk areas. UNICEF warns families are avoiding routine hospital visits and delaying care for sick children due to fear of infection, raising the risk of additional child deaths. The outbreak’s persistence is challenged by ongoing conflict and displacement, hindering surveillance, case finding, and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は拡大している、恐怖が子どもたちを脅かしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の地理的拡大と継続的な症例発生が確認されている。複数州への拡散、高い致死率、紛争と医療システムの脆弱性による管理困難性が認められる。
triage.notes: 2026年6月11日時点で676例の確定症例と136死亡が報告されている。イツリ州から北キブ州および南キブ州へと地理的に拡大している。紛争、大規模避難、医療システムの脆弱性が対応と監視を著しく困難にしている。ユニセフの警告により、感染症恐怖症による医療回避行動が二次的な子ども死亡リスクを高める可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | بعد انتهاء عزل إيبولا.. منتخب الكونغو الديمقراطية يصل إلى أمريكا للمشاركة في المونديال
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Akhbarak Net | After Ebola isolation ends, the Democratic Republic of the Congo national team arrives in the United States to participate in the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: On June 12, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) national football team arrived in Houston, United States, for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, which began the previous day and runs through July 19 across the US, Canada, and Mexico with 48 teams. The squad completed a 21‑day isolation as part of strict precautions after a new Ebola outbreak emerged in eastern DRC, maintaining a “health bubble” before travel. Under coach Sébastien Desabre, the team held a Belgium training camp and played two friendlies: 0‑0 with Denmark and a 2‑1 loss to Chile in France (a match canceled in Spain for precaution). This marks DRC’s second World Cup appearance (1974), earned via the intercontinental playoff. They are placed in Group 11 with Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ隔離終了後、コンゴ民主共和国代表チームがワールドカップ参加のためアメリカに到着
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2026年ワールドカップへのコンゴ民主共和国サッカーチームの参加報道であり、感染症アウトブレイクではなく、スポーツイベントの一部。エボラウイルス病の新規感染・拡大について述べられておらず、シグナルとしての公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は「DRC内でのエボラアウトブレイク」への言及がありますが、これは過去の事象の参照であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイク報道ではありません。主題はワールドカップへのサッカーチーム派遣であり、感染症事象ではないため、シグナルとして識別しない。DRCは対象国であるため verified_locations に含めました。

article.articleHeadline: Tschechischer Soldat aus präventiver Ebola-Quarantäne entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Czech Soldier Released from Precautionary Ebola Quarantine
article.articleSummary: Doctors released a Czech Army soldier from precautionary Ebola quarantine after three weeks of strict isolation at the Special Clinic in Těchonín. He had returned on May 22 from a monitoring mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola is spreading. The army announced the discharge on X. The quarantine was preventive because he had no confirmed contact with Ebola-infected individuals in Congo. During the stay, he showed no symptoms of Ebola infection. This case illustrates public health precautionary measures for travelers from outbreak regions, with no reported symptoms or confirmed infection at the time of release.

triage.headline_ja: チェコ兵がエボラ予防隔離から解放
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行に関連して、帰国兵士の予防的隔離解除というシグナル。IHR基準は概ね該当しないが、エボラの国際的監視対象性と公開情報の存在から経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事主題はチェコの兵士解放であり、実際の感染者ではなく予防隔離解除。DRCでのエボラ流行が背景にあるため、DRCを verified_locations に含める。チェコは対象国外のため除外。感染確認なしのため重症度・曝露リスク低い。エボラ関連として社会的・政治的関心は存在するが、実際の感染イベントではなくWATCHレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Virologista avalia suspeita de ebola em Novo Hamburgo: "Elementos apontam para descartar o caso"; entenda a situação | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virologist assesses suspected Ebola case in Novo Hamburgo: "Evidence points to ruling out the case"; understand the situation | abc+
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, Novo Hamburgo, Brazil, investigates a suspected Ebola case in a 64-year-old man who had recently returned from Uganda. He tested positive for malaria and remains under medical observation while laboratory analysis proceeds to confirm or rule out Ebola. Virologist Fernando Spilki of Feevale University characterizes the case as likely being ruled out, based on precautionary investigation; he notes Uganda’s current outbreak is concentrated in hospital settings and seems not to involve broad community transmission, and emphasizes that Ebola is not airborne and requires direct contact with infected bodily fluids. The patient is isolated at UPA Canudos and will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre. Fiocruz is conducting the diagnostic tests. The Ministry of Health has been notified; epidemiological teams are tracing contacts, who will be monitored for 30 days, as part of standard precautions.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス学者がノーボ・ハンブルゴのエボラ疑い症例を評価：「証拠は症例の除外を示唆」；状況を理解する | abc+
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い症例は検査中だが、ウイルス学者による初期評価では除外の可能性が高く、患者はマラリア陽性であることが判明。ウガンダの関連状況確認のため継続経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダから帰国者であるが、ブラジルでの検査中の疑い症例が主題。既にマラリア陽性と判明し、ウイルス学者による専門家評価ではエボラ除外の可能性が高い。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加されていない。情報が不足しているため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola | Epidemia sigue extendiéndose en Congo, advierte la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola | The epidemic continues to spread in Congo, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO warns. The Bundibugyo variant, a less common strain, has caused 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of 2026-06-11. Most cases are centered in Ituri province in the northeast, with transmissions detected in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Specialists warn that cases are appearing almost daily in new areas, suggesting the epidemic’s true extent may be larger than official counts. Persistent insecurity and weak health systems hinder the response. The DRC has Ebola experience, and contact tracing has improved to over 70% effective, though surveillance remains limited in high-risk areas. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, underscoring the need for robust public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ | 流行が引き続きコンゴで拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo亜種によるエボラ出血熱の急速な地理的拡大、高い致死率、34の保健ゾーン発症例の継続検出、ワクチン・治療法の不在が深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を構成。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo亜種は稀な株であり、ワクチン・承認治療法の不在が重大なギャップ。DRCの弱い保健システムと継続する不安全性により対応が阻害されている。34保健ゾーン横断の多地点感染と「毎日新規地域での発症」報告は制御困難性を示唆。DRCはエボラ対応経験があり、接触者追跡効率70%超だが、高リスク地域での監視が限定的。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: مدى انتشار إيبولا في الكونغو قد يكون أكبر بكثير من التقديرات الرسمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The extent of Ebola's spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be far greater than official estimates.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns there are substantial gaps in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, suggesting the true spread may be far larger than official estimates. The current outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Surveillance gaps persist in high-risk areas, and isolation beds are scarce (about 250 across three affected regions). The outbreak has spread to three health zones, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, and has crossed into Uganda. UNHCR reports two Ebola-linked deaths in the Kabanjba refugee camp in Congo, home to about 30,000 displaced people, signaling high transmission risk in crowded camps. Medics say the outbreak went undetected for weeks; WHO has yet to publish size estimates, while the CDC warned it could reach West Africa 2014–2016 levels. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, Congo, named after the Ebola River. Three viruses cause disease: Ebola virus, Sudan virus, Bundibugyo virus; Bundibugyo has no specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラの拡大程度は公式推定値をはるかに上回る可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型の治療法・ワクチンなし、複数国への拡大、難民キャンプでの高い感染リスク、公式推定より実際の流行規模が大きい可能性がある点から、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告する発生地域には Sudan、Burundi、Uganda が含まれているが、記事サマリーでは DRC が主な発生地であり、Uganda への拡大が言及されているのみ。検証済み location は DRC に限定。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（治療法・ワクチンなし）、676確認例、136死亡、難民キャンプでの2例の死亡報告があり、公式推定を大きく上回る実際の流行規模が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa tightens border screening amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: South Africa tightened border screening for Ebola amid outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, deploying multi-layered checks that observe travellers for illness and conduct temperature screening as needed. WHO data show 515 confirmed cases and 91 deaths in the DRC, while Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases, two deaths, and one probable death. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), with Africa CDC designating it a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security (PHECS). The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which is severe and often fatal, with no vaccine available. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated surfaces; fruit bats are suspected as the zoonotic reservoir. Ituri province is considered unsafe due to ongoing conflict, hindering response efforts; Ellen Johnson Sirleaf called for urgent international action. Keywords: outbreak, vaccination, border measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の拡大に伴い、南アフリカが国境検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。エボラ出血熱は極めて深刻な公衆衛生影響（515確認例、91死亡）、WHOがPHEICを宣言した予想外の国際的拡大リスク、国際渡航制限措置実施中である。複数対象国での検証された発生
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イツリ州）、ウガンダ、南アフリカでのエボラ発生・対応を述べている。DRCは対象国リスト（203312）に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ・南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし南アフリカの国境検査強化は国際的な対応措置として重要。記事に「Africa CDC」「Ellen Johnson Sirleaf」による国際的呼びかけがあり、社会政治的関心が高い。Bundibugyo strain、ワクチン未利用、ヒトヒト感染、ウイルス学的なハイリスク特性が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Caso suspeito de ebola em idoso é investigado no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in an elderly person is being investigated in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil: a 64-year-old man who recently returned from Uganda is under investigation. Fiocruz is conducting tests; if confirmed, the case will be referred to a national reference unit and transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre for analysis. The patient also tested positive for malaria and is under treatment. Contacts are under medical observation for 30 days. In São Paulo, a second suspected Ebola case involves a 31-year-old Brazilian woman who had been in the Democratic Republic of Congo; she arrived June 6, developed diarrhea and fever by June 9, and was moved to Emílio Ribas Institute (IIER) on June 10, the national reference facility for suspected/confirmed cases. WHO as of June 6 reported 84 Ebola deaths and 471 cases in Africa, mainly in the DRC (452 cases, 82 deaths since May 15); Uganda reported new cases near the Congo border (19 infections, 2 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州での高齢者のエボラ疑い事例が調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での同時発生、確定患者が多数存在する状況で、ブラジルへの初期流入報告は重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国の状況を包含：ブラジル（リオグランデ・ド・スル州およびサンパウロ州での疑い例2件）、DRC（452例、82死亡）、ウガンダ（19例、2死亡）。対象国リストに基づき、実際のイベント発生地はブラジルとDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。DRCは既知の大規模流行地域であり、ブラジルへの流入は地域外での初期例報告として重要。マラリア併発も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: نقاط غامضة تعقد تقدير مدى انتشار إيبولا في الكونجو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ambiguous points complicate the estimation of Ebola's spread in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak continues with uncertainties about true spread. WHO notes ambiguous points suggesting the outbreak could be larger than official counts. The Democratic Republic of Congo reports extension into three new health zones; neighboring Uganda also affected. Confirmed cases reach 676 with 136 deaths. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The epidemic had gone undetected for weeks, complicating containment. Isolation capacity is severely limited, with fewer than 250 beds across the three affected provinces. WHO has not issued final outbreak size estimates; past CDC projections warned it could reach West Africa's 2014–2016 scale, which killed over 11,000. UNHCR reports two Ebola-related deaths in the Kabanjba refugee camp in eastern Congo, which hosts about 30,000 refugees, underscoring transmission risk and need for stronger prevention and response.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラの拡大推定を複雑にする不明な点をコンゴで指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また重症度が高く（死亡報告あり）、治療法・ワクチン未承認のまれなウイルス株で管理可能性に懸念があるため、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCでのエボラ発生を扱っており、サマリーではウガンダの影響も言及されているが、DRCが主要な発生地。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。確認症例676件、死亡136件、治療法・ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo ebolavirus株、隔離施設不足など複数の懸念要因あり。難民キャンプでも確認されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Υπάρχουν πολλά "τυφλά σημεία" στο ξέσπασμα του Έμπολα στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: There are many 'blind spots' in the Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of multiple blind spots in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Olivier le Polén, a WHO epidemiologist based in Beni in eastern DR Congo, says there are numerous high-risk areas with significant surveillance gaps, and the full scale of transmission remains unknown. He stressed that surveillance in these regions must be strengthened to better gauge spread. The report does not provide case or death counts. This warning underscores gaps in monitoring as health authorities continue to track ongoing Ebola activity in the DR Congo and pursue detection of undetected transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行に多くの「監視の盲点」がある
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、監視ギャップが複数存在することが報告されている。IHR基準を複数満たし、国際的な懸念事項である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は通常対象国外（DRC）の疾患だが、当該国はリスト対象外。ただしWHO警告による監視ギャップの存在は実質的なリスクを示唆しており、フルRRA実施が必要。記事に具体的な死傷者数がないため詳細な重症度評価は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Dentista é preso em Porto Velho por suspeita de transmitir HIV de forma intencional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dentist Arrested in Porto Velho on Suspicion of Intentionally Transmitting HIV
article.articleSummary: June 12, 2026 — A dentist in Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, was arrested on suspicion of intentionally transmitting HIV to women with whom he had sexual relations. The arrest occurred on June 10 during an investigation by the Civil Police of Rondônia (PCRO). The suspect, who reportedly knew he was HIV-positive, allegedly did not disclose his condition to partners. At least four women have been identified as potential victims. The suspect’s identity has not been released. Authorities say the arrest was based on documents, laboratory reports, medical records, and witness statements gathered during the probe. Because more victims may exist, the Civil Police urge women who had relations with the suspect to contact Porto Velho’s Specialized Police Station for Women's Assistance (DEAM) to help the investigation. The case remains under secrecy to protect victims.

triage.headline_ja: デンタリストがポルトヴェーリョで逮捕、意図的なHIV感染の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 個別の刑事事件であり、公衆衛生上の流行・アウトブレイク情報ではない。特定個人の犯罪容疑であり、感染症監視対象のシグナルとは異なる。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症の自然発生的な流行・アウトブレイク情報ではなく、特定個人による意図的なHIV感染容疑に関する刑事事件である。Bluedot APIが感染症イベント情報として抽出したが、シグナルトリアージ対象外。公衆衛生監視システムの対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos humanos de ebola aumentam na RDC, gorilas criticamente ameaçados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human cases of Ebola rise in the DRC, gorillas critically endangered.
article.articleSummary: Ebola persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, threatening gorilla populations in Virunga. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids of infected people and consumption of infected bushmeat. No gorilla infections have been reported in the current human wave, but control efforts prioritize avoiding human–primate contact in Virunga and other gorilla habitats. Historical gorilla outbreaks occurred in Lossi (2002–2003) and Odzala-Kokoua (2004), with mortality up to 90–95%. Gorillas' social structure and grooming facilitate rapid within-group spread. Conservation and health authorities, with local NGOs, have expanded surveillance at protected-area boundaries and trained rangers to recognize signs of disease, while monitoring human cases near primate habitats to reduce spillover. In 2026, cuts in international funding, including USAID, have hampered monitoring, habitat protection, and rapid response. Although large gorilla outbreaks remain remote, they could be grave if spillover occurs; integrated One Health surveillance remains central.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ人間感染例が増加、ゴリラが極度に脅かされている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認事例であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する高リスクシグナル。DRCでの人間感染例増加とともに、野生動物への影響、国際支援削減による対応能力低下が報告されており、再感染リスクがある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはChad（Guera Region）も含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCでの人間感染例増加が主題であり、Chadは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事はビルンガ国立公園のゴリラへの脅威を強調し、2026年のUSAID削減による監視能力低下という現在進行中の懸念を報告している。歴史的には2002-2004年のゴリラ集団発生で致死率90-95%の記録がある。One Health統合監視の重要性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 這些不安全性行為，容易傳播猴痘病毒 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These unsafe sexual behaviors easily transmit the monkeypox virus.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox is caused by the monkeypox virus (clades I and II). In China, since September 20, 2023 it is managed as a Category B infectious disease. Transmission is mainly via close contact: direct contact with skin lesions, lesion fluid or blood; contact with virus-contaminated bedding or towels; and prolonged face-to-face exposure enabling respiratory droplets. Incubation is 5–21 days (commonly 6–13). Illness lasts about 2–4 weeks; fever, headache, fatigue and lymphadenopathy precede a rash that often involves the face and limbs and can affect oral, anal or genital areas; anal lesions may become infected, causing abscesses or ulcers. Most reported cases are among men who have sex with men (MSM), though women can be infected via sexual contact; risk rises with multiple partners. No approved monkeypox vaccine in China. Prevention: avoid close contact with cases, reduce high-risk sexual behaviours (especially MSM), monitor destination outbreak information, and comply with border/quarantine rules. Suspected cases should seek care in dermatology/venereology, proctology or infectious disease departments and report exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: これらの不安全な性行為は、サル痘ウイルスの伝播を容易にする
triage.triage_reason: 中国でのサル痘(Mpox)の継続的な感染リスクが述べられており、スクリーニング基準（長期曝露・流行感染性）に該当するが、具体的な新規患者数や疫学動向の詳細が不明であり、社会的・政治的関心の度合いも記事から判断困難。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発的な性質が強く、新規発生や疫学的変化を報告するものではない。サル痘は中国で2023年9月より Category B感染症として管理されているため、既知リスクの継続的な管理状況と考えられる。具体的な患者数、死亡、重症化事例は記事に記載されていない。香港商報（香港メディア）であるが、内容は中国全体の予防情報を扱っているため China として分類した。

article.articleHeadline: OMS sugere que "pontos cegos" podem ocultar verdadeira extensão do surto de Ebola no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO suggests that "blind spots" may conceal the true extent of the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization epidemiologist Olivier le Polain warns there are numerous blind spots in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, suggesting transmission may be much wider than official estimates. Congo reported on Thursday that the outbreak has spread to three new health zones, bringing the total to 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths. The outbreak has also spread to neighboring Uganda. Le Polain, based in Beni in eastern Congo, emphasized persistent surveillance gaps in high‑risk areas, indicating the true scale of transmission could be underestimated by current figures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO「盲点」がコンゴのエボラ流行の真の規模を隠している可能性があると示唆
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、高い社会的・政治的関心あり。エボラ感染確認とウガンダへの越境拡大により緊急性高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大も記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。DRCのみ確認。WHOによる懸念表明、676確認症例、136死亡報告、複数保健圏への拡大、監視ギャップ指摘により、実規模が過小評価の可能性が高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola qui sévit dans l'est de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC) continue de gagner du terrain - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak ravaging eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to gain ground - RTBF Actus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of June 11, 2026, per the Congolese Ministry of Health and WHO. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri province in the northeast, but infections have been detected in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo variant currently has no vaccine or approved treatment. New cases are being detected almost daily in additional zones, suggesting the true scale of transmission is higher than reported, likely driven by high population mobility amid regional insecurity. The report relies on official channels; there is no information provided on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部で猛威を振るっているエボラウイルス病の流行が拡大を続けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確認患者676名、死亡136名という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、複数州にまたがる異常な流行拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病流行。ワクチン・承認治療法がない点、地域の不安定性による人口移動が感染拡大を加速させている点、報告数より実際の感染規模が大きい可能性がある点が重要。多数の保健ゾーン（34ゾーン）への拡大が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: RS investiga caso suspeito de ebola em homem que esteve em Uganda - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RS investigates suspected Ebola case in man who had been to Uganda - Metro 1
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul's Health Secretariat is investigating a suspected Ebola virus disease case in a 64-year-old man from Nova Hamburgo, in the Porto Alegre metropolitan area. He recently traveled to Uganda, where WHO reports an Ebola outbreak. Although malaria was diagnosed and treatment begun, authorities are following Health Ministry protocols to confirm or rule out Ebola. He will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre, with samples sent to Fiocruz for laboratory confirmation; if confirmed, he will be moved to a national reference unit. The investigation also includes a 31-year-old woman who recently returned from DR Congo and is being evaluated at Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas in São Paulo; another state case earlier this month was ruled out. Ebola is rare, transmitted via bodily fluids, with early symptoms such as fever and body aches; contacts are monitored for 30 days.

triage.headline_ja: RS investigates suspected Ebola case in man who had been to Uganda - Metro 1
triage.triage_reason: Suspected Ebola cases detected in Brazil in travelers returning from endemic areas (Uganda, DRC). Meets IHR criteria: serious public health impact (Ebola), unusual/unexpected in non-endemic region, international spread risk (confirmed outbreak in Uganda). Requires immediate RRA.
triage.notes: Multiple suspected cases in Brazil with epidemiological links to confirmed Ebola outbreak areas (Uganda, DRC). Active investigation ongoing with laboratory confirmation pending at Fiocruz. Health Ministry protocols activated. High clinical suspicion given recent travel history and symptomatology. Contact tracing for 30-day monitoring period initiated.

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: نقاط غامضة ببعض المناطق تصعب تقدير حجم وباء إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Mysterious hotspots in some regions make it difficult to estimate the scale of the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, WHO flags 'mysterious hotspots' in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, suggesting the true scale may exceed official estimates. Congo reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with transmission reaching three health zones and crossing into Uganda. Olivier Lo Bolin, WHO epidemiologist, said in Beni, eastern DRC, that many high-risk areas remain opaque and surveillance must be strengthened. A major constraint is the shortage of isolation beds, with fewer than 250 beds across the three affected provinces. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The disease had gone undetected for weeks as responders strive to contain it. WHO has yet to publish outbreak-size estimates; the CDC warned it could reach the scale of West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：いくつかの地域の不可解なホットスポットがコンゴのエボラウイルス感染症の流行規模の推定を困難にしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラは極めて高い公衆衛生的影響を持ち、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境確認）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク、予防接種なし・治療法なしという異常性がある。WPRO基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境確認があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事サマリーの主題はDRCの流行。Bundibugyo株による稀な感染症で承認済み治療法・ワクチンなし、隔離ベッド不足（3州で250床未満）、西アフリカ2014-2016年流行規模（11,000死亡以上）への警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Nevarna bolezen se širi na nova območja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dangerous disease is spreading to new areas.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding to new areas. As of 12 June 2026, more than 670 confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded in the DRC, with 676 confirmed since the outbreak was declared on 15 May and 136 deaths; 119 suspected cases and 32 recoveries are noted. New areas are affected nearly daily, reflecting the outbreak’s scale and high population mobility. Most cases remain concentrated in Ituri province, but transmission is increasingly occurring within communities in North Kivu and South Kivu, often among people who traveled from Ituri. Surveillance gaps in high-risk zones and limited isolation capacity suggest the true burden may be higher than official counts. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, with 19 confirmed Ebola cases including 2 deaths; Uganda’s situation is described as now under control by the African Union health agency.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な病気が新しい地域に広がっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で670件超の確認症例、136死亡、複数国への国際拡大、高い重症度と社会的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行を主題としており、South KivuおよびIturi州での拡大を報告。Ugandaへの越境事例（19確認症例、2死亡）も言及されているが、主な発生地はDRC。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。surveillance gaps により実際の症例数はさらに多い可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Com 67 mortes, baixa vacinação contra gripe alerta para aumento de casos em MS -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 67 deaths, low influenza vaccination rates warn of a rise in cases in Mato Grosso do Sul -- AconteceuMS
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul reports 3,523 hospitalizations for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) and 67 influenza-related deaths in the first five months of 2026, with 525 laboratory-confirmed influenza cases (378 Influenza A, 147 Influenza B). Vaccination coverage is 43.85%, below the target, prompting SES-MS to urge people to visit health units to update influenza vaccination. With autumn and winter approaching, authorities warn that respiratory viruses spread more easily. The influenza vaccine is safe, free, and available at all state health units. Fiocruz InfoGripe places MS among states with high SRAG incidence, and Campo Grande is among nine capitals with elevated SRAG, though there is no sustained weekly increase in recent weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 67人の死亡、低いインフルエンザワクチン接種率がマト・グロッソ・ド・スル州での症例増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州でインフルエンザ関連死亡67例と3,523例のSRAG入院が報告されており、IHR基準の重症度と異常性に該当。またWPRO基準でも重症度、管理可能性（ワクチン接種率低下）が該当し、季節性インフルエンザの重要な公衆衛生シグナルとして認識される。
triage.notes: 季節的なインフルエンザシーズン（オーストラル秋冬）の到来により、ワクチン接種率が43.85%と目標値を下回っている状況が懸念される。Fiocruzの情報に基づき、マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州はSRAG高発生州として認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆「醫院內感染」登革熱群聚　70歲婦「發燒、頭暈」相鄰病室共5人確診 - 生活新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports a hospital-acquired dengue fever cluster; a 70-year-old woman with fever and dizziness; five people in adjacent rooms diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City, Taiwan reports this year's first hospital-acquired dengue fever cluster. The index case is a woman in her 70s from Sanmin District who was hospitalized for another illness on May 29, discharged June 10, and developed fever and dizziness on June 11; dengue fever type 2 (DENV-2) was laboratory-confirmed. Four additional cases were detected in adjacent rooms, prompting expanded tracing and testing; contacts are being quarantined. As of June 12, Taiwan has 74 dengue confirmations, with 6 local cases all in Kaohsiung; 68 imported cases, mainly from Southeast and South Asia (Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9). Globally, dengue surpassed 1.02 million cases by April, concentrated in the Americas (Brazil, Bolivia, Colombia) with rising numbers in Asia (Vietnam, Malaysia). Public health measures emphasize environmental cleanup; symptoms include fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, or rash, and travelers should seek prompt medical care with travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で「院内感染」デング熱クラスター報告　70歳女性が「発熱、めまい」相隣する病室の5人が確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄での院内デング熱クラスター（5人）は異常かつ予想外の事象であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常性」「重症度」「流行性」に該当。国際的な文脈（グローバルな1.02百万例超）も踏まえ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾での院内クラスター（DENV-2確定、5人）は局所的だが、グローバルデング熱の流行（100万例超、米州・アジアで増加）との関連で国際的意義がある。記事にはベトナム、インドネシア、マルディブからの輸入例も記載され、これらの対象国も確認された。ブラジル、ボリビア、コロンビアはグローバル流行の文脈で言及されているが、当該記事の主な感染症イベントは台湾での院内クラスターであるため、文脈上の記載と判断。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا يتفشى في مخيم للنازحين بالكونغو وتزايد مخاطر انتقال العدوى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus spreads in a refugee camp in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with rising risk of transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus spreads in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's refugee camps, with two deaths reported in the Kabanjba camp housing about 30,000 internally displaced people. The mother and her daughter died May 31 and June 1 and tested posthumously positive for Ebola by the World Health Organization. The outbreak, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, has now reached three provinces—Ituri, South Kivu and North Kivu—where conditions are defined by crowded camps and weak public health infrastructure. Relief workers warn transmission risks are high in shelters with canvas walls and shared facilities. As of June 12, 2026, Congo records 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths; neighbouring Uganda has reported 19 cases linked to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の難民キャンプでエボラウイルスが流行、感染伝播リスクが増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当。エボラは重大な公衆衛生脅威、国際的な感染拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、PHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「neighbouring Uganda has reported 19 cases linked to the outbreak」と二次感染として言及されており、主たる流行地はコンゴ民主共和国。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。PHEIC宣言済み（5月17日）、複数州での流行、難民キャンプでの高い感染リスク、国際的波及を確認。

article.articleHeadline: As human Ebola cases climb in DRC, critically endangered gorillas are at risk
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo escalates human toll: as of June 10, CDC records 676 cases and 136 deaths in eastern DRC; neighboring Uganda reports 19 cases and two deaths, with no recent new cases. The Congolese Health Ministry announced the May 15 outbreak; this marks the 17th outbreak in the region over five decades, and the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Bundibugyo virus (Filoviridae) has no approved treatment or vaccine. Ebola is zoonotic and highly contagious, transmitted by direct contact with infected blood or body fluids and by bushmeat. Gorillas, especially western lowland gorillas in Central Africa, have endured severe losses in past outbreaks (mortality 90–95% in Lossi 2002–2003; ~5,000 deaths in a 5,000 sq km area). The IUCN estimates ~316,000 gorillas remaining (2018), about 60% in Republic of Congo. The virus threatens African great apes; infant and female gorillas are disproportionately affected, hindering population recovery. No current overlap between reported human cases and gorilla habitat in Uganda/DRC, but spread could alter this.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ患者増加に伴い、絶滅危機瀕死のゴリラが危機にさらされている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）かつWPRO基準複数該当。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）既に宣言されており、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV)のアウトブレイク。DRCで676例・136死亡、ウガンダで19例・2死亡。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。治療薬・ワクチンなし。ヒト-ヒト感染および動物源感染が確認されており、高度に伝播しやすい。記事はウガンダでの患者報告を触れているが、主要な発生地はDRCであり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta de que el brote de ébola en RDC "se está expandiendo"...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading...
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding, with 675 cases and 136 laboratory-confirmed deaths, concentrated mainly in Ituri province and spreading to North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Seventeen health zones are hotspots requiring intensified surveillance and response, reflecting high population mobility amid protracted conflict. UNICEF-led efforts aim to reach 3.7 million people, deploying over 1,600 community health workers and 24 decontamination teams, and have connected more than 160,000 households; plans include establishing childcare facilities near treatment centers, with the first daycare opening in Bunia. Cross-border risk is noted, with 19 Ebola cases and 2 deaths in Uganda. Emphasis remains on early detection, pediatric care, contact tracing, and community engagement to protect children and vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が「拡大している」と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確定死亡者を含む多数の症例、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダでの報告）、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、及び高い社会的・政治的関心が認められ、フルRRAに進むべき重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州、South Kivu州、North Kivu州）での流行が主題であり、ウガンダは国境を越えた感染リスクとして言及されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、675症例、136確定死亡、ワクチン・治療なし、17の高リスク保健地区、人口移動と紛争による複雑な状況、そして国際的な対応の必要性が明記されており、重要な感染症危機シグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: 12個月大男童感染新冠病毒併發嘶吼症　情況危殆
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12-month-old boy infected with COVID-19 complicated by stridor; in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: One 12-month-old boy in Hong Kong, previously healthy, is critically ill with SARS-CoV-2 infection complicated by croup. He developed fever, cough and runny nose, then stridor; rapid testing was positive, and he was admitted and transferred to the Prince of Wales Hospital Pediatric Intensive Care Unit. Laboratory confirmation confirmed COVID-19 with croup. The child was unvaccinated and had no travel during incubation; two household contacts developed mild respiratory symptoms since last Thursday and have recovered without hospitalization. The Centre for Health Protection warned that overall COVID-19 activity may rise further in the next one to two months and urged continued personal and environmental hygiene. High-risk individuals should consider initiating or boosting COVID-19 vaccination to reduce risk of severe disease and death.

triage.headline_ja: 12ヶ月齢の男児が新型コロナウイルスに感染し クループを併発し重篤な状態
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な小児患者事例報告。重症度は個別患者の重篤さがあるが、流行拡大や公衆衛生への広範な影響は明確ではなく、既知の疾患の通常の臨床経過の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 香港での散発患者事例（unvaccinated 12ヶ月齢児のCOVID-19 croup併発）。地域の公衆衛生当局（Centre for Health Protection）から一般的な感染予防勧告が出されているが、新規の流行シグナルや異常な疾病パターンではない。WPRO基準では重症度（単一患者の重篤化）のみ該当するが、他基準非該当のため総合判定はDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Com 67 mortes, baixa vacinação contra gripe alerta para aumento de casos em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 67 deaths, low flu vaccination coverage warns of an increase in cases in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, remains well below target as autumn and winter approach, with 3,523 SRAG (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) hospitalizations reported in the first five months of 2026 and 67 influenza-related deaths. The State Health Secretariat (SES-MS) records only 43.85% vaccination coverage, below the level needed to broaden population protection. Of confirmed influenza cases, 525 were identified: 378 Influenza A and 147 Influenza B. Vaccination is safe, free, and available at all municipal health units to reduce hospitalizations and deaths from influenza. Fiocruz InfoGripe shows Mato Grosso do Sul among states with elevated SRAG incidence; Campo Grande ranks among nine capitals with high SRAG incidence, though recent weeks show no ongoing rise. Emphasizes continuous vaccination to mitigate respiratory disease risk during cooler months.

triage.headline_ja: 67人の死亡、低いインフルエンザワクチン接種率がマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州での症例増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州におけるインフルエンザによる67人の死亡、3,523件のSRAG入院報告、および43.85%の低いワクチン接種率は、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、重症度）とWPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の懸念）の複数項目に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: インフルエンザAおよびBの両方が検出されており、秋冬季に向けた季節的リスク増加の文脈での報告。低ワクチン接種率と継続的な死亡報告が継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念を示している。国際的な拡大リスクは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les centres de traitement débordés, MSF appelle à une décentralisation urgente de la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: overwhelmed treatment centers, MSF calls for urgent decentralization of the outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: Six Ebola treatment centers in Bunia are operating at or near full capacity as the Ituri outbreak accelerates, making Ituri the epicenter of the Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak. As of June 12, 2026, MSF reports 100% occupancy in Bunia facilities; Mongbwalu hosts a 44-bed treatment center with a new 60-bed unit under construction; Bunia's Elikya site is being expanded and a 55-bed center is under construction at Komanda. MSF urges rapid decentralization of the response to rural zones where new foci are emerging, including Nizi, Aru and Mahagi health zones, to contain transmission, reduce patient movement, and ease surveillance. Population movements between Mongbwalu, Nizi, Bunia, Komanda, Mahagi complicate contact tracing. The organization stresses community involvement and urges early care at health facilities to improve outcomes for Ebola and other illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: Ituri県でのエボラ：処置センターが満杯、MSFが対応の緊急分散を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当。DRCの進行中エボラ流行において、処置センター飽和と多地域での新規病巣の出現は、シグナルレベルのリスク。
triage.notes: DRC第17回エボラ流行の進行中イベント。Ituri県（Bunia、Mongbwalu、Komanda、Nizi、Mahagi等）での複数の処置センター飽和と人口移動による接触者追跡困難。MSFが緊急の対応分散化を要請している点から、現地での管理能力の課題が顕在化。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas emite alerta para alto risco de dengue em 30 bairros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas issues alert for high dengue risk in 30 neighborhoods.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil, issued the 24th Arboviroses Alert of 2026 on 12 June, identifying 30 bairros with high dengue transmission risk and ordering intensified Aedes aegypti control to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Winter reduces but does not eliminate mosquito activity; vigilance against indoor breeding sites remains essential. Risk areas span the Leste, Noroeste, Norte, Sudoeste, Sul, and Suleste regions. Residents are urged to welcome field agents and intensify at‑home inspections, noting that 80% of breeding sites are inside houses. Prevention includes eliminating standing water, disposing of cans and tires, changing plant-pot water every 2 days, cleaning saucers weekly, sealing water tanks, and closing unused toilets. 2026 actions include 696,541 dwelling visits for breeding-site control and 47,697 fogging visits; six mutirões; 13,486 tons of waste removed; monitoring of suspected dengue cases: 188,448; 137 neighborhood leaders trained. Inquiries: 156, Defesa Civil 199.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナス市、30地区のデング熱高リスク警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで複数のアルボウイルス（デング、ジカ、チクングニア）の流行警報が発令されており、スクリーニング基準複数該当するが、具体的な患者数や死亡例の報告がなく情報不足のため、経過観察段階として判定。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・カンピナス市における自治体レベルの警報発令であり、患者数や重症度の具体的情報が記載されていない。長期曝露（ネッタイシマカの活動が冬季でも継続）と流行リスク（ヒト-ヒト感染可能なアルボウイルス）の2基準に該当。地方自治体の対応能力は示されているため国際支援の必要性は低い。続報での患者数報告やWHO通知の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Precautions being taken at T.N. border checkposts after Nipah virus case reported in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus precautionary measures in Tamil Nadu's Nilgiris district after a preliminary test indicated a Nipah case in Kozhikode, Kerala. Nilgiris Collector Lakshmi Bhavya Tanneeru announced tightened border surveillance along the Kerala–Tamil Nadu border, with Health Department staff deployed at Thaloor, Nadugani, Nambiarkunnu, Soladi, and Pattavayal checkposts to screen travellers from Kerala for Nipah symptoms. Given regular cross-border movement and migrant workers, enhanced checks are focused in areas with higher migrant populations. Government and private health facilities have been instructed to report any signs of Nipah; visitors from Kerala with symptoms are urged to seek treatment voluntarily. Officials emphasised there is no current cause for alarm about district-wide spread, and precautionary steps will continue, as of 12 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でニパウイルス感染例が報告された後、タミルナドゥ州の国境検問所で予防措置が講じられている
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは極めて高い死亡率を持つ病原体であり、州間での境界警戒・サーベイランス強化が実施される重大な公衆衛生イベントである。IHR基準で「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」が該当し、WPROスクリーニングでは「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当するシグナルである。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは確定診断前の段階（予備検査）であるが、極めて病原性が高く（死亡率40～90%）、州間における積極的な境界サーベイランスと隔離措置が実施されている点は重大な懸念。タミルナドゥ州での予防体制整備は政府レベルの対応が既に開始されていることを示す。記事サマリーに基づき、イベント発生地はインド（ケーラ州コージコード）であり、対象国リストのIndia(1269750)のみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Feature: In DR Congo displacement camp, Ebola warnings meet dry taps, crowded shelters
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has infected 676 people and killed 136 since the government declared the crisis on May 15, following laboratory confirmation of Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain in Ituri Province. The outbreak has spread to Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In Bunia’s Kigonze displacement camp, about 11,700 residents across ~2,600 households live in crowded shelters with chronic water shortages, damaged latrines, and poor sanitation, where taps were dry for hours. Kigonze has not yet recorded confirmed Ebola cases, but prevention is urgent amid insecurity and mistrust. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine. The wider eastern DRC crisis involves 7.8 million internally displaced people and 26.5 million facing acute food insecurity (World Food Program).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の避難民キャンプでエボラ警告が水不足と過密な避難所に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された流行で676人感染・136人死亡、複数州への拡大、国際的懸念の高まり。WPRO基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain is vaccine-unavailable, increasing concern. Outbreak declared May 15, 2026 with laboratory confirmation. Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu provinces involved. Displacement camp conditions (water shortage, crowded shelters, poor sanitation) create high transmission risk. Context of 7.8 million IDPs and food insecurity amplifies crisis severity.

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذر من "نقاط غامضة" لتفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of "mysterious points" in an Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization epidemiologist Olivier Le Bolin, in Beni, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, on June 12, 2026, warned of many 'mysterious points' in the Ebola outbreak, with the overall extent of transmission not yet fully clear and surveillance in high‑risk areas needing urgent strengthening. Separately, UNHCR reported two deaths linked to Ebola in an eastern DRC camp for internally displaced people, Kabanjba camp, which hosts about 30,000 refugees. The high risk of transmission in the camp underscores the need for enhanced prevention and outbreak response measures. The report highlights ongoing Ebola concerns in the region, with limited detail on laboratory confirmation or infection sources provided.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ出血熱の流行における「謎めいた点」について警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の重大な影響を持つ感染症であり、DRCでの活動的な流行が報告されている。IHR基準では深刻な影響（死亡事例）、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが該当する。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡）、流行しやすさ（難民キャンプでの高リスク伝播）、管理可能性（WHOが警告を発出）が該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのベニ地域およびカバンジバ難民キャンプでのエボラ流行を報告している。WHOの疫学者が「謎めいた点」があり、監視強化が急務と警告しており、UNHCRは難民キャンプでの2例の死亡を報告している。難民キャンプという高密度人口地域での伝播リスク、情報透明性の欠如（ラボ確認・感染源が限定的）が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Епидемията от ебола се разраства
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of 11 June 2026. The outbreak is expanding into new zones; most cases remain in Ituri province, but local transmission is now occurring in North Kivu and South Kivu, with many infections in those provinces linked to Ituri. Ongoing conflict, large displaced populations, and a weak health system hinder response and create blind spots in high-risk areas. UNICEF warns that families are avoiding routine hospital visits and not seeking care for sick children due to fear of infection, raising the risk of additional child deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、複数地域への拡大、国際的拡散リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。確認症例676件、死亡136件という重大な数字と、複数州への地理的拡大が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで南キブ州、イトゥリ州での流行が明記されており、DRC国内での複数州への拡大が確認されている。紛争下での保健システム機能不全、大量の国内避難民存在が対応を阻害している。小児への影響（習慣的な病院受診回避）も懸念される。フルRRAを推奨。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتمدد في الكونغو ومنظمات أممية تحذر من إصابات بين الأطفال | مصراوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in Congo and UN agencies warn of infections among children | Masrawy
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces an Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo virus, expanding from Aru in North Ituri to MeTi Morisa in South Kivu across roughly 1,000 km, with 34 health zones affected and new areas in North Kivu as of Thursday. In about three weeks since the current wave began, 676 cases and 136 deaths have been recorded. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo, prompting calls to strengthen testing, surveillance, and contact tracing, alongside sustained community engagement. UNICEF warns of rising household transmission and increased risk to children, noting that over half of under-five children in Ituri are chronically malnourished and only about 20% have received basic vaccines. UNICEF has dispatched eight aid convoys totaling over 100 tons of supplies (PPE, medicines, hygiene items) with EU support. Schools may stay open, as Ebola transmits via body fluids, not in the same way as COVID.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大、UN機関が子どもの感染増加に警告 | マスラウィ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模流行で676例、136死亡、34ヘルスゾーン影響、地域急速拡大。子ども感染増加の警告も含む。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラは治療薬・ワクチンなし。子ども層の栄養不良（5歳未満の50%超が慢性栄養不良）と低ワクチン接種率（約20%）が深刻。UNICEF等国際機関による支援が既に展開中。北キブ州への拡大も報告。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи дістався табору переселенців у ДР Конго - зафіксовано перші смерті
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has reached an internally displaced persons camp in DR Congo — the first deaths reported.
article.articleSummary: Two deaths reported at the Kpangba internally displaced persons camp in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo as Ebola spreads in a population of about 30,000. The first case, a 60-year-old woman infected on May 30, left quarantine and died on May 31; her daughter died June 1. Lab tests confirmed Ebola in both. As of June 12, the DRC has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with spillover into neighboring Uganda (19 cases). Overcrowding and poor sanitation, with hundreds sharing a single toilet and ongoing open defecation, heighten transmission risk. Community mistrust toward health workers and international agencies hampers the response; WHO teams faced hostility when approaching the bodies. UNHCR and humanitarian groups warn of rapid spread and potential panic and mass displacement if the situation worsens.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が民族紛争地域の避難民キャンプに到達——コンゴ民主共和国で初の死亡例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の避難民キャンプ侵入、複数国への国際的拡大既成事実、国際的な対応と支援必要性）。WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という最高リスク病原体の避難民キャンプでの集団感染開始は、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的検証：Kpangbaおよび南東部の避難民キャンプはDRC内の実在地点（座標確認済）。ウガンダへの溢出は既に19症例報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCの避難民キャンプでのエボラ集団感染であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。シエラレオネは発生地域リストに含まれるがサマリーに記載なし（過去流行の参照と推測）。衛生状況（30,000人規模キャンプで共用トイレ1個、野外排便継続）と社会的信頼喪失（保健従事者への敵対）により、急速な伝播と管制不能リスクが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: وفاتان مرتبطتان بفيروس إيبولا في مخيم نازحين بالكونجو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: Two Ebola-related deaths in a displaced persons camp in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related deaths were reported among internally displaced persons at Kapanjba camp in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, according to UNHCR on 12 June 2026. The camp, which hosts about 30,000 refugees, remains a setting with elevated transmission risk, prompting heightened calls for strengthened infection prevention and rapid-response measures. The two fatalities were among IDPs living in the camp; the report provides no additional detail on laboratory confirmation, exposure sources, or broader case counts. The UN agency emphasizes ongoing Ebola concerns in eastern Congo and the importance of surveillance, isolation, and community engagement to mitigate spread in crowded displacement sites.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴの国内避難民キャンプでエボラ関連死2件報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。高密度避難民キャンプでのエボラ死亡例報告であり、フルRRAを進める必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスはIHR注視疾患。高密度避難民キャンプ（30,000人）という易感染性高い環境での死亡報告。UNHCRの公式発表であり信頼性高い。検査確認状況や全体患者数など詳細情報が限定的であるため、追加情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Be it Coronavirus, Nipah or Shigella: Why do dangerous virus first surface in Kerala? Reason may surprise you
article.articleSummary: Kerala often is the first Indian state to report new infectious diseases such as COVID-19, Nipah, Monkeypox, and Shigella infections, owing to its efficient disease monitoring and transparent reporting. Shigella-related death in a child underscores ongoing concerns. Nipah outbreaks have occurred four times, concentrated in northern districts Kozhikode and Malappuram, with fruit bats in the Western Ghats noted as natural carriers. Human exposure through contaminated fruits or toddy, plus deforestation and urbanisation driving wildlife-human contact, contribute to zoonotic spillovers. High population density and close social networks facilitate rapid spread if not promptly contained. The state's international connectivity and expatriate population also mean imported infections reach Kerala first; India's first COVID-19 case in January 2020 was a student returning from Wuhan, detected in Thrissur. Strong surveillance translates to early detection, not increased vulnerability.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルス、ニパウイルス、赤痢菌など：なぜ危険なウイルスは最初にケーララ州で発生するのか？その理由はあなたを驚かせるかもしれない
triage.triage_reason: 複数の既知感染症（COVID-19、Nipah、Mpox）が言及されているが、記事は流行の歴史的分析と疫学的背景説明が主体であり、進行中の新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。Shigella関連死亡の言及があるものの、具体的な発生規模や現在の状況の詳細が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は主にケーララ州における過去のニパウイルス、COVID-19、その他感染症の発生パターンに関する背景分析であり、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。Shigella関連死亡の記載があるが、詳細な流行状況は記事サマリーに明記されていない。Wuhan COVID-19初期例の言及があるためChinaを verified_locations に含める。オンゴーイング曝露と流行しやすさの観点からWATCH段階とし、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы достигла лагеря переселенцев в ДР Конго - зафиксированы первые смерти
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak has reached a camp for displaced people in DR Congo — first deaths recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached the Kpangba camp for internally displaced people in the east, with the first deaths recorded.
