Two fatalities are confirmed in Kpangba, which houses about 30,000 displaced individuals. The index case—a 60-year-old woman—was confirmed infected on May 30, left quarantine, and died the next day; her daughter died on June 1; laboratory tests later confirmed Ebola in both. Humanitarian groups warn that extreme crowding and poor sanitation (shared toilets and open defecation) raise the risk of rapid spread. Distrust toward medical teams complicates response; WHO staff were reportedly pelted with stones when collecting bodies. As of June 12, the DRC has 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths, and the outbreak has crossed into Uganda, which has 19 cases.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアの難民キャンプでエボラ熱の流行が発生—最初の死亡例が記録される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱の新規発生域への拡大、深刻な公衆衛生影響（密集キャンプでの流行リスク、死亡例、隣国への越境）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）、渡航制限の可能性があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内のKpangbaキャンプでのエボラ熱流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの波及も確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Bluedot APIが Sierra Leone を発生地域として挙げているが、サマリーに Sierra Leone への言及がないため除外。DRC での 676 確認例、136 死亡例、極度の密集、衛生管理不備、医療チームへの不信感など、急速な拡大のリスク要因が複数存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情攻陷擁擠難民營　罕見病毒株致母女雙亡 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo overruns crowded refugee camps; rare virus strain kills mother and daughter
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to crowded eastern refugee camps, with the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form with no approved treatments or vaccines. UNHCR confirms the Kpangba refugee camp (~30,000 people) has recorded its first Ebola deaths: a 60-year-old mother diagnosed late May who fled isolation and died the following day, and her daughter died a day later. The outbreak has now reached three provinces, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, and Uganda has reported cases. Aid workers face hostility; bodies have been attacked. Camps suffer dire sanitation—shared toilets and tarpaulin tents—hindering isolation. Danish Refugee Council warns of rapid spread and potential panic. No approved antiviral or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱が混雑した難民キャンプで蔓延；稀なウイルス株が母娘を殺害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。稀有なBundibugyo株による大規模感染、難民キャンプという高リスク環境での急速な感染拡大、承認治療法・ワクチン不在により緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は稀有で承認された治療法やワクチンが存在しない。難民キャンプという脆弱な環境での感染拡大（人口密集、貧弱な衛生施設、援助機関への敵意）により、急速な感染加速と社会不安リスクが高い。ウガンダへの波及確認済み。ただしWPRO対象国リストにはDRCは含まれていないが、エボラ出血熱の重篤性と国際的リスクから緊急対応の対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Gilead dona más de 2.000 viales de Remdesivir para uso experimental frente al Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gilead donates more than 2,000 vials of Remdesivir for experimental use against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Gilead Sciences donates more than 2,000 vials of remdesivir to Uganda to bolster the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak response, with additional supply in the works. The donation supports compassionate use and Emergency Use MEURI for Ebola Bundibugyo and anticipates requests from the Democratic Republic of Congo, the WHO, and other partners for remdesivir and obeldesivir (an oral antiviral in development) within a broader regional response and planned clinical trials. Gilead highlights a decade of contributions to filovirus outbreak responses in sub-Saharan Africa. Remdesivir shows promising preclinical activity against filoviruses but is not approved for filovirus diseases anywhere; safety and efficacy for Bundibugyo remain unestablished, with studies ongoing. Remdesivir is a nucleotide prodrug with broad antiviral activity, approved for COVID-19 in about 50 countries and used in over 14.5 million patients, including licensing programs for LMICs.

triage.headline_ja: ギリアド、エボラ対策の治験用レムデシビル2,000本以上を寄付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の国際的なアウトブレイク対応であり、ウガンダおよびコンゴ民主共和国での確認事例、国際的な医薬品供給体制構築、WHO関係機関の関与があり、IHR基準3項目該当。治験薬承認プロセスも進行中であり、公衆衛生上重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでのエボラBundibugyo型アウトブレイク対応、およびコンゴ民主共和国への追加供給計画を明記。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。むしろ同じ地域での発生リスクとしてザンビアに隣接する地理的関係から、地域的監視対象国として記載。治験段階であり、安全性・有効性はまだ確立されていないが、国際的な公衆衛生対応がすでに開始されている点で重要。

article.articleHeadline: How AI is helping fight the latest Ebola breakout
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo—the 17th since 1976 and the first during the AI era—drives four vaccines in development, with two candidates expected to enter clinical trials within two months. The outbreak crosses a conflict zone and mining hub near porous borders, challenging containment; no vaccine was available at the outset. AI aids epidemiologists by identifying where cases occur and mapping them to conflict-affected areas, enabling data-driven comparisons with past outbreaks. In March, WHO Africa launched an AI-driven early warning system for health threats, including a chatbot for officials to query data in plain language. While AI offers a cost-effective tool to augment healthcare amid Western aid cuts, risks include privacy concerns and potential AI hallucinations; officials caution against overreliance as the technology remains in its infancy. The US State Department privately compared its response favorably to China’s.

triage.headline_ja: AIがエボラ出血熱の最新の流行対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行でIHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国での17番目の流行で、紛争地帯と国境を跨ぐ拡大リスク、ワクチン未整備という深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な関心の高さから、フルRRA進出が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。紛争地帯と多孔性国境での拡大リスク、初期ワクチン未利用という重大な懸念がある。AI活用による対応強化も記事の重要テーマだが、管理可能性への不確実性が残存。西側援助削減の背景も注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola se extiende en el Congo con nuevos contagios y 136 decesos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the Congo with new infections and 136 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the World Health Organization warns of alarming expansion of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo variant for which no licensed vaccine or approved treatment exists. Although the outbreak center is Ituri province, transmission has reached 34 health districts, including North Kivu and South Kivu. Daily detection of cases in new areas suggests the true scale exceeds official tallies. Contributing challenges include deteriorating local hospital infrastructure and regional insecurity, though Congolese response brigades have extensive outbreak-control experience. Human mobility is accelerating geographic spread, and the Congolese Ministry of Health, supported by WHO, has confirmed the case counts and continues to respond.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴに拡大、新たな感染者と136人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRGスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。致死的なエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo variant）の多州への地理的拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な拡大リスク、WHOによる警告など、複数の深刻な指標が存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ州およびキブ地域でのエボラ拡大を述べており、Bundibugyo variantによる676確定症例と136死亡、34保健地区への伝播、利用可能なワクチンおよび認可治療法の不在、医療インフラの悪化、地域不安定性など、複数のリスク要因が指摘されている。WHO警告の発出と進行中の対応確認がある。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola y el oro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and the gold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in Mongbwalu, Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no vaccine or approved treatment. The CDC warns outbreaks emerge in insecure regions with artisanal gold mining and ongoing cross-border movement. The article argues Peru faces a related threat: illegal Amazon mining far larger than Congo’s (Congo <22 tons/year vs. Peru >100 tons illicitly). In La Pampa, Madre de Dios, conditions resemble Congo’s: state absence, violence, no healthcare, contaminated water, and crowded camps; the area hosts about 190 bat species. Bats and other wildlife elevate zoonotic spillover risk; rodents carry hantavirus, arenavirus, and leptospirosis. RNA viruses mutate with replication, enabling variants that may be more transmissible or immune-evasive; prolonged infections in immunocompromised hosts drive mutations. The illegal gold trade moves up to $12 billion/year; intervening five visible firms could neutralize about 80% of the risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとゴールド
triage.triage_reason: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」が該当。また、ペルーのアマゾン地域での違法採掘に関連した複数の人獣共通感染症（ハンタウイルス、レプトスピラ症など）の潜在的リスク指摘があり、WPROスクリーニング基準「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」が該当する。国際的な公衆衛生懸念として対象国複数での評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（Mangbwalu地域、Bundibugyo ebolavirus）を主要事象として報告。ペルーについては「関連脅威」の比較論述であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生ではなく潜在リスク議論のため、verified_locationsからは除外。アルゼンチンも言及なし。複数の人獣共通感染症（ハンタウイルス、レプトスピラ症、アレナウイルス）と違法採掘による人口移動がリスク要因として指摘されている。RNA病原体の変異リスクも議論されている。

article.articleHeadline: India to fast-track Production of Ebola Vaccines
article.articleSummary: India, with WHO and Africa CDC, fast-tracks production of an Ebola vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus (strain BDBV). Serum Institute of India, in partnership with University of Oxford and CEPI, leverages the ChAdOx1 BDBV viral-vector platform used for the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine; clinical-grade doses expected for trials. The Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak began mid-May 2026, with over 1500 suspected cases and 650 deaths in DRC and Uganda; Bundibugyo virus is a newer strain with no approved vaccines. India reports zero active cases; airports implement screening and isolation for travelers from DRC and Uganda. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May; Tedros visited Ituri; Africa CDC confirms vaccine manufacturing by SII. Ongoing global efforts aim to design, test, and deploy vaccines to contain the outbreak and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: インド、エボラワクチン生産を加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。DRCで1500以上の疑似症例と650人の死亡が報告されており、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言を発出しているため、シグナルとして扱うべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクであり、インドはワクチン製造国として言及されているのみ。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。2026年5月中旬からDRCで発生した新型株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による患者1500例以上、死亡650名。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言を既に発出。

article.articleHeadline: OraSure Technologies Submits Improved Rapid Ebola Test to FDA for Emergency Use Authorization
article.articleSummary: OraSure Technologies submitted the OraQuick Ebola v2.0 Rapid Antigen Test to the FDA for Emergency Use Authorization, touting new chemistry, higher analytical sensitivity, longer shelf life, and enhanced automation versus v1.0. The EUA pathway opened in 2014 during the Ebola Zaire outbreak and remains available; v1.0 received de novo FDA authorization in 2019. The v2.0 lateral-flow assay detects antigens in whole blood from inactivated Sudan, Zaire, and Bundibugyo Ebola species, but not Reston or Ivory Coast. OraSure anticipates a production ramp-up to meet urgent outbreak demand. In 2020, v1.0 was evaluated on 443 cadavers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with no false negatives and a 2% false-positive rate. Viruses (2023) reported v1.0 sensitivity 84% in archived patient blood, 90.9% in monkey blood, 97.1% in cadaver buccal swabs, and specificity 98–100% in blood, 99.1–100% in saliva. BARDA awarded $8.6 million in 2022 to develop next-gen Ebola test.

triage.headline_ja: OraSure Technologies がFDAに改善版迅速エボラウイルス検査の緊急使用許可申請を提出
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断技術の規制承認プロセスに関する医療産業ニュースであり、新規感染症イベント（患者発生、アウトブレイク拡大）の報告ではない。過去の検査パフォーマンス試験データの参照に留まる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが DRC を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーは OraQuick Ebola v2.0 の FDA 承認申請プロセスおよび過去の検査試験結果（2020年 DRC での v1.0 評価を参考データとして言及）に関するもの。現在のエボラウイルス患者発生やアウトブレイク拡大を報告していないため、感染症イベントとして識別できず、verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO cảnh báo nhiều "điểm mù" trong đợt bùng phát tại CHDC Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO warns of many 'blind spots' during the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths, with 119 suspected and 32 recovered. The flare-up is centered in Ituri Province, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu and spillover into neighboring Uganda. WHO expert Olivier le Polain warns of surveillance blind spots, suggesting the true scale may be much larger. A major impediment is shortage of isolation and treatment capacity—about 250 beds across the affected provinces—necessitating expansion of care facilities. Contact tracing has improved, with over 70% of contacts followed, but that level remains insufficient to halt transmission. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo virus strain, a rare variant with no vaccine or approved treatment. Authorities warn the outbreak could be among the most serious since the 2014-2016 Ebola epidemic unless surveillance, tracing, and treatment are strengthened; Uganda is urged to continue supporting Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO、コンゴ民主共和国での発生における多くの「情報の空白地帯」に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株という希少な変異株で、ワクチン・承認治療法がなく、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境）と医療体制逼迫が確認される。2014-2016年のエボラ流行以来の深刻な状況として国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国内（Ituri州、North Kivu州、South Kivu州）での発生が主題。ウガンダへの越境も記載されているが、発生地域はDRC。Bundibugyo株は希少で治療法がなく、イトゥリ州中心の発生で情報の空白地帯が指摘されており、真の患者数はより多い可能性がある。隔離・治療ベッド数が不足（約250床）し、拡大の危険性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تحذر من ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا في شرق الكونغو وزيادة حالات الأطفال
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations warns of rising Ebola infections in eastern Congo and an increase in cases among children.
article.articleSummary: UN agencies report ongoing Ebola transmission in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with a projected rise in infections among children in the coming days. A World Health Organization official said daily new cases are being logged in new health zones, reflecting the outbreak’s scale and the mobility of populations. In about three weeks since the current outbreak began, health authorities have recorded 676 cases and 136 deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, described as rare and severe. Authorities warn that pediatric cases may increase as the situation unfolds, while teams continue to monitor transmission. The United Nations notes ongoing international coordination in response to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ東部のエボラ感染者の増加と小児症例の増加に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。重症度（676症例、136死亡）と小児症例増加の警告により即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 稀で重症なBundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の流行。3週間で676症例、136死亡という高い致命率と、小児症例増加の警告が極めて懸念される。国連による国際的調整が既に開始されており、シグナルとして即時ピックアップが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Muere la princesa Bha de Tailandia a los 47 años tras más de tres años hospitalizada por una grave infección
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Princess Bha of Thailand dies at 47 after more than three years hospitalized due to a serious infection.
article.articleSummary: Princess Bajrakitiyabha Mahidol (Bha/Patty) died in Bangkok at 47 after more than three years hospitalized due to a serious abdominal infection. She had been at Chulalongkorn Hospital since December 2022, after collapsing during dog-training in Nakhon Ratchasima; authorities attributed an initial bacterial infection causing myocarditis and severe arrhythmias. A May update described a grave infection from inflammatory disease of the large intestine, with hypotension, arrhythmias, and coagulation problems; despite ongoing specialist care, her condition deteriorated and she died at 19:48 local time. Thai king Maha Vajiralongkorn ordered state funerals with full honors and transfer of her remains to the Grand Palace. Born December 7, 1978, she was the king’s daughter from his first marriage, a lawyer by training (University of Chicago), diplomat, and international public servant, including ambassador to Austria (2012–2014) and roles with UN Women and UNODC. She died unmarried and without children.

triage.headline_ja: タイの王女バーが47歳で死亡、3年以上の重大感染症による入院を経て
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは個人の死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生ではない。Unknown Illnessの分類であり、感染症危機管理の対象となる流行・集団感染ではなく、公衆衛生への広範な影響はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は著名人（タイ王女）の個人的な死亡事例の報道であり、感染症のシグナルトリアージの対象ではない。感染症危機管理は集団発生・流行の検知と対応を目的としており、個別患者の死亡事例（特に既知の医学的背景がある場合）は評価対象外。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、疫学的シグナルとしての価値はない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta: Epidemia del ébola se expande en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: The Ebola outbreak is spreading in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreading in Congo with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths linked to the Bundibugyo strain, per the World Health Organization. In Ituri Province, cases are detected across 34 provinces, with infections reported almost daily in new health zones—reflecting the epidemic’s true scale and population mobility. Olivier le Polain, head of Epidemiology and Analysis for Interventions, from Beni in North Kivu, warned of remaining surveillance gaps in high-risk areas and said clearer visibility will come as testing, contact tracing, and laboratory capacity are strengthened, especially in North Kivu. Health systems in the Republic of Congo are weakened, hampering control efforts. Contact tracing has improved to just over 70% of contacts traced. By comparison, Ebola in Uganda remained under control as of May 15.

triage.headline_ja: 警報：エボラ流行がコンゴで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダでの検出も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRC内の複数州（Ituri、North Kivu）での検出確認。Bundibugyo strain による676確認症例、136死亡。接触者追跡率70%、保健システム弱体化など管理面での課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Cibiyar yaƙi da cutuka ta Afrika ta soki salon yaƙi da Ebola a Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC criticized the way Ebola is being fought in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC criticized the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, saying the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak faces major obstacles and risks spreading beyond current areas. The warning coincides with doctors’ strike over severe shortages of supplies, including diagnostic tools, protective gowns, masks, and medicines. Healthcare workers report ongoing deaths from Ebola as the outbreak—the largest in history—continues. As of 2026-06-12, about 600 people have been infected and 115 have died since the outbreak began mid-last month. The CDC’s caution challenges Congolese authorities’ claims of stringent containment measures. The Bundibugyo outbreak has spread to Ituri and the North and South Kivu provinces, underscoring the urgent need for adequate resources and effective control efforts to stop further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがコンゴのエボラ対策を批判
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当、複数県での拡大と医療体制の危機的状況から直ちにRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の流行。患者数約600名、死亡115名（6月12日時点）。複数州（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu）への拡大を確認。医療従事者のストライキと医療資材の深刻な不足が対応能力を大きく低下させている。アフリカCDCの公式警告により国際的な関心が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitaria en el sur de Brasil: investigan un caso sospechoso de Ébola en Río Grande do Sul tras el viaje de un hombre a Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health alert in southern Brazil: investigators probe a suspected Ebola case in Rio Grande do Sul after a man's trip to Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-12, Brazilian health authorities investigate a suspected Ebola case in Rio Grande do Sul after a 64-year-old Novo Hamburgo resident returning from Uganda developed compatible symptoms. A rapid test detected Plasmodium falciparum malaria, but Ebola remains possible given travel history. Samples have been sent to the Oswaldo Cruz Foundation (Fiocruz) for confirmatory testing. The patient is hospitalized at Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre for specialized care and preventive isolation, with transfer to a national Ebola reference center if confirmed. Contact tracing and monitoring of all contacts have begun. Separately, São Paulo authorities are examining a second suspected case—a 31-year-old woman in isolation at the Emílio Ribas Infectology Institute. The WHO notes ongoing Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, but no autochthonous transmission in South America to date.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル南部の衛生警報：ウガンダ出張から帰国した男性の後、リオグランデドスル州でエボラ疑い症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例が報告されており、死亡率の高いエボラウイルス病が含まれ、国際移動（ウガンダからの帰国）による国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準で2つ以上該当。さらにWPRO基準での重症度・流行可能性が示唆されるため、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブラジル（リオグランデドスル州とサンパウロ州）での疑い症例が主題である。ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行は背景情報として言及されているが、実際のイベント発生地はブラジルのため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみとした。迅速検査でマラリア（Plasmodium falciparum）が検出された一方、エボラ可能性は除外されておらず、Fiocruzでの確定検査が進行中。複数地域での疑い症例（2件以上）、国際的な接触歴、主要リファレンスセンター対応により、国家および国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Three persons under observation; NCDC team to visit Kozhikode amid Nipah surveillance
article.articleSummary: Three persons under quarantine admitted to hospital in Kozhikode district, Kerala, for Nipah surveillance; samples sent for testing. NCDC experts to visit on Saturday to assess containment. No new Nipah cases reported in the district so far. A patient undergoing treatment has received the first dose of monoclonal antibody therapy per ICMR guidelines and medical board recommendations. The contact list has grown to 87 people: 4 in highest-risk, 16 in high-risk, 67 in low-risk categories, all monitored by twice-daily control-room calls. A survey in 286 houses in Ward 5, Ramanattukara municipality, identified 12 fever cases but none with Nipah symptoms. Rapid Response Team meeting reviewed containment activities. A 43-year-old man was recently confirmed to have Nipah virus infection and is being treated at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital. Nipah is a zoonotic virus with fruit bats as natural reservoir; can cause severe respiratory illness and encephalitis; high fatality rate.

triage.headline_ja: 3人が観察下に置かれ、ニパール監視の中でNCDCチームがコージコードを訪問予定
triage.triage_reason: ニパールウイルス確認症例（43歳男性）、重症度が高く（高致命率）、コンタクトトレーシング展開中（87人）、公衆衛生当局の積極的対応（NCDC専門家派遣）が認められ、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ニパールウイルスは高い致命率を持つ人獣共通感染症であり、すでに確認症例がある。現在、コンタクト追跡（87人）、モノクローナル抗体療法の実施、NCDC専門家派遣など、当局の積極的な対応が進行中。症状を示さない疑似患者が複数いるが、これまでのところ新規確認症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: ارتفاع حالات إيبولا شرق الكونغو مع تحذير من زيادة إصابات الأطفال - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: Ebola cases on the rise in eastern Congo, with a warning of an increase in infections among children
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continue, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. In about three weeks since the current outbreak began, authorities report 676 cases and 136 deaths. New daily cases are recorded in additional health zones, spanning roughly 1,000 km from Aru, North Ituri, to Miti Morisa, South Kivu, with 34 health zones affected, including areas in North Kivu. UNICEF warns of rising household transmission and a likely uptick in child infections; more than half of children under five in Ituri are chronically malnourished, and over 20% have not received any basic vaccines. UNICEF has dispatched eight relief flights totaling over 100 tons of supplies with EU support. WHO notes no approved treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo Ebola; stresses enhanced testing, surveillance, and community engagement. Schools may remain open with preventive measures and health education; resources and access are essential to protecting children.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴ東部でエボラウイルス感染者が増加、子どもの感染増加に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ集団発生で676例・136死亡、34保健圏域に拡大中。小児感染増加警告、治療法・ワクチン未承認で対応困難。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株による新規集団発生。3週間で676例136死亡、1000km以上にわたる広範な地理的拡大。UNICEFが8便の支援物資輸送を実施、EUの支援を受ける。栄養不良・低ワクチン接種率の小児が特に脆弱。治療法・ワクチン未承認が対応の大きな課題。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يستمر في التوسع.. تحذيرات أممية من انتشار أوسع للوباء في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread... UN warns of a wider outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains active in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of 10 June. The outbreak spans 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, covering about 1,000 kilometers. Seventeen zones are prioritized for enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, testing, and patient care. Children are highly vulnerable due to conflict and malnutrition; over half of under-five children are malnourished, and more than 20% have never received basic vaccines; they account for 14–17% of cases, with household transmission likely to rise. UNICEF warns of knowledge gaps—two-thirds of youths unaware of Ebola transmission and about half opposed to reintegration of recovered patients—and notes Uganda has reported 19 cases and 2 deaths. It calls for rapid international funding (US$17.4 million of $70.7 million) and safe, unobstructed humanitarian access to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の拡大が続く...コンゴでの流行の更なる拡大に関するUN警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（676確認症例、136死亡）を伴う異常事象であり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの拡大既確認）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクを有する。フルリスク評価（RRA）への進行が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（19症例、2死亡）への国際的な拡大が既に確認されており、国際支援の必要性（$17.4M急速拠出要請）が明記されている。子どもの高い脆弱性（栄養不良、低いワクチン接種率）と世帯内感染のリスク増加も懸念要因。記事はARARBIC言語のため、多言語対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RS investiga caso suspeito de Ebola em paciente atendido em Novo Hamburgo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul investigates suspected Ebola case in a patient treated in Novo Hamburgo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-12, Brazil's Health Ministry suspended temporarily the dengue vaccine Butantan-DV after 42 serious adverse events and two deaths are under investigation. From January 1 to May 30, 501,044 doses were administered to people aged 15–59 and to healthcare workers. There were 3,703 reports of dengue-like events (about 0.7% of vaccinated); 42 alerted cases and three deemed serious. A 39-year-old woman developed severe dengue requiring ICU six days after vaccination and recovered. Two deaths were reported: a 48-year-old woman with severe dengue and neurological involvement 19 days post-vaccination, and a 58-year-old man who died of shock five days post-vaccination; the deaths occurred in March and April. No causality is established yet. The suspension remains pending investigations by the Health Ministry, Anvisa, and states/municipalities. About 500,000 people had been vaccinated with Butantan-DV, the first Brazilian single-dose dengue vaccine, approved November 2025.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州、ノーボ・ハンブルゴで治療を受けた患者の疑い例エボラを調査
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチン（Butantan-DV）の安全性問題として、42件の重篤有害事象と2件の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への影響は深刻。ブラジルの保健当局による調査が進行中で、国家的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事見出しではエボラの疑い例が言及されているが、サマリーはデング熱ワクチンの安全性懸念（有害事象と死亡）が主題である。約50万人が接種済みで、Health Ministry・Anvisa・州/自治体による調査が進行中。因果関係は未確定だが、世界初のブラジル製単回接種デング熱ワクチン（2025年11月承認）に関する重要な公衆衛生イベントであり、RRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: EUA precisam reavaliar comunicação de riscos entre Covid e sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States needs to reevaluate risk communication between COVID-19 and measles.
article.articleSummary: Risk communication in the United States must better explain uncertainty and local geographic variation, while aligning messages on vaccination, symptom monitoring, and avoiding panic amid measles outbreaks. Globally, hantavirus linked to a cruise signals a downturn, and Ebola cases rising in Africa underscore communication gaps in epidemic response. The article praises dashboards, maps, and risk estimates for understanding, but warns that rapid, decontextualized data erode credibility and reader guidance. It argues for turning data into proportionate actions and highlights structural weaknesses in public channels and media that foster simplified or conflicting narratives. Historical context—from Ebola in 2014 to COVID-19 in 2020—shows how cuts to CDC, NIH, and WHO, and shrinking local media, hinder precise reporting. Trust depends on transparency about knowns, probabilities, and unknowns; Congo’s local radio example illustrates effective risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカはCOVID-19と麻しんのリスク・コミュニケーションを再評価する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: 複数の深刻な感染症（エボラ、ハンタウイルス、麻しん、COVID-19）が関連する多国的な公衆衛生上の問題であり、IHR基準で複数該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な影響）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国の感染症状況に言及しているが、具体的な発生地として特定されているのはアフリカ（エボラ、ハンバウイルス）及びコンゴの例示。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、本文でコンゴが具体的に言及されているため verified_locations に含める。米国は対象国外のため除外。ハンタウイルスはクルーズ船関連と記載されているが、具体的な発生国は明記されていないため不明。
