article.articleHeadline: Paraná conclui ciclo 2025/2026 de vigilância ativa para Influenza Aviária e Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná concludes the 2025/2026 cycle of active surveillance for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease.
article.articleSummary: Paraná concludes the 2025/2026 Active Surveillance Cycle for Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) and Newcastle Disease. The last shipment of samples was sent on June 8, 2026 to the Federal Laboratories of Agricultural Defense (LFDA) in Campinas, São Paulo, and Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul for laboratory analyses. Across the cycle, inspectors and veterinarians from Adapar collected samples and epidemiological data from 488 poultry facilities across Paraná to monitor bird health and verify the absence of circulation of economically and medically impactful pathogens. Laboratory analyses focus on HPAI and Newcastle Disease. Results will be consolidated by Adapar's technical team and used to support defense actions and sanitary certification. The effort reflects integrated work among regional and local offices, the Marcos Enrietti Diagnostic Center (CDME), producers, agro-industries, and the Official Veterinary Service, reinforcing biosafety and market confidence for Paraná’s poultry sector.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州が2025/2026年の高病原性鳥インフルエンザおよびニューカッスル病の能動的監視サイクルを完了
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は定期的な監視プログラムの完了報告であり、新規感染例の発生ではなく、家畜衛生上の予防的取り組みである。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはブラジル（GeoNames ID 3469034）が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations は空配列。記事の主題はパラナ州による定期的な監視プログラムの完了報告であり、新規疾病発生イベントではない。動物衛生に関する行政報告であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: UPSC Key: NITI Aayog, Nipah Virus and Wages for Housework
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports its first Nipah case this year as a 43-year-old man is admitted to the isolation ward at Government Medical College Hospital in Kozhikode after initial tests indicated Nipah infection. On the front page, UPSC-related notes cover NITI Aayog’s 11th Governing Council meeting, attended by all 28 Chief Ministers, with a focus on energy affordability, a broader solar deployment push, and district-level GDP estimates to address grassroots growth. Officials highlighted making energy prices competitive and expanding rooftop solar in homes, schools, hospitals, and government buildings to reduce grid dependence amid the West Asia crisis. Prime Minister Modi urged doubling the Lakhpati Didi program from 3 crore to 6 crore and stressed women-led development, as discussions encompassed cooperative federalism, governance, and the Governing Council’s composition.

triage.headline_ja: UPSC主要トピック：NITI Aayog、ニパウイルス、家事労働賃金
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは重症度が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染可能で管理が困難な病原体。インド・ケーラ州での新規事例報告は異常かつ国際的懸念があるため。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは致死率40～75%の高病原性病原体。記事ではインド・ケーラ州コジコデでの確定症例（43歳男性）が報告されている。Bluedotの発生地域にChinaが含まれているが、記事本文ではインドのみが主題であり、中国での発生に言及されていないため除外した。続報での追加情報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 635 cas et 127 morts, l'Afrique face à une nouvelle menace sans vaccin - Cameroun24.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: 635 cases and 127 deaths, Africa faces a new threat without a vaccine - Cameroun24.net
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is confronting its 17th Ebola outbreak, with 635 confirmed cases and 127 deaths, caused by the Bundibugyo strain (no vaccine). Declared May 15, it centers in Ituri near Bunia; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Uganda and DRC set up joint temporary medical centers to curb cross-border spread (Uganda reports 19 cases, 2 deaths). Russia provides Bundibugyo PCR tests; a serology/antibody diagnostic kit is under development in Kampala. In Ituri, eight Ebola Treatment Centers are operational, with a ninth opening in Nyankunde on June 11. A doctors’ strike began June 11 over pay and conditions, and some centers have been attacked by panicked residents. Nigeria has allocated 10 billion naira for health preparedness; Europe remains at low risk with no cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：635例の症例と127人の死亡、ワクチンのない新たな脅威がアフリカに直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な病原体、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。エボラ出血熱の大規模多国間流行であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC内でのエボラ流行を扱っているが、Ugandaでの症例（19例、2死亡）も言及されている。ただしUgandaは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Kampala（Uganda領土）での診断キット開発言及も、主要な感染伝播地ではなく技術支援のため除外。RussiaとNigeriaの言及は支援・準備段階であり、実際の感染発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam steps up dengue prevention as disease patterns evolve
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Vietnam is rising and shifting patterns due to climate change and urbanisation. A Hanoi-hosted ASEAN Dengue Day panel notes Aedes aegypti thrives in warmer, wetter, densely populated urban environments. After the 2022 northern outbreak, cases spread nationwide; the 2022 peak reached 371,000, and 2025 saw high levels with no year-end decline. In the first five months of 2026, Vietnam logged over 50,000 dengue cases, about 2.5 times the same period in 2025. The DENV-2 serotype is currently dominant, increasing the risk of severe disease. Dengue is no longer mainly a child disease; adults over 15 now show incidence similar to children in the south. The fever’s third to fifth day can be the most dangerous, with dengue shock syndrome, severe hemorrhage and multi-organ failure. Severe cases incur high costs and strain families. Prevention emphasizes vector control, surveillance, AI-based early warning, and a vaccine registered in Vietnam with a planned pilot rollout.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムが疾病パターンの変化に対応するデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響：2026年上半期で50,000例超、2025年同期比2.5倍；国際的拡大リスク：ASEAN地域での流行）。WPROスクリーニング基準で3項目該当（異常性：従来の小児中心から成人への拡大；重症度：デング出血熱・ショック症候群・多臓器不全の報告；流行性：都市部の高密度化でAedes aegyptiが活動しやすい環境）。社会的・政治的関心も高く（ASEAN Dengue Dayパネル、ワクチン展開計画）、フルRRA進行対象。
triage.notes: 2026年上半期の50,000例超は前年同期比2.5倍の大幅増加。DENV-2優位化による重症化リスクの上昇、小児から成人への患者層の転換、デング出血熱やショック症候群の発生報告など、複数の懸念要因がある。ASEAN域内での流行状況の把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: തൃശ്ശൂരിൽ ആളുകളെ ആക്രമിച്ച തെരുവ് നായക്ക് പേവിഷബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു. പേവിഷബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചതോടെ പ്രദേശത്ത് ജാഗ്രത ദേശം പുറപ്പെടുവിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies confirmed in a street dog that attacked people in Thrissur; an alert zone was declared in the area.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a stray dog that attacked people in Thrissur's Ashtamichira area, triggering an alert zone. Three individuals were bitten yesterday, including a differently-abled person; all bite victims reached hospital and received vaccines. The dog, captured by the panchayat earlier, died by evening. Laboratory swab tests released today confirmed rabies infection in the animal. In response, authorities have declared an alert zone and urged residents to remain vigilant, avoid contact with stray dogs, and report any signs of illness in pets to authorities. The advisory underscores vaccination and timely medical care for bite victims. This is the latest update as of 2026-06-12.

triage.headline_ja: Thrissurで人を襲った野犬から狂犬病が確認され、警戒地域が宣言された
triage.triage_reason: 単一の確認事例で、既に接触者が医療機関で対応され、感染の拡大可能性は限定的。IHR基準の複数該当はないが、公衆衛生対応の有無と続報の必要性から経過観察を推奨。
triage.notes: インドのケーララ州Thrissurで野犬からの狂犬病確認事例。咬傷患者3名は既に医療機関で予防接種を受けており、収容された犬は死亡。当局が警戒地域を宣言し市民啓発を実施。単一事象であり、接触者管理が実施されているため即座のフルRRA対象外だが、狂犬病は高い致命率を持つため、追加事例の有無を継続監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: തൃശ്ശൂർ അഷ്ടമിച്ചിറയിൽ ആളുകളെ ആക്രമിച്ച തെരുവുനായക്ക് പേവിഷബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; പ്രദേശത്ത് ജാഗ്രതാ നിർദേശം ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies infection confirmed in the stray dog that attacked people in Thrissur's Ashtamichira; area on alert ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleSummary: Rabies infection confirmed in a stray dog that attacked people in Ashtamichira, Thrissur district, Kerala, prompting a local alert. Three individuals were injured, including a differently-abled person; all had previously received rabies vaccination. The dog was captured by panchayat authorities but died in the evening on the same day. Laboratory testing confirmed rabies infection in the animal. Locals reported that several other stray dogs in the area were involved in attacks. Following confirmation, authorities issued an alert and urged vigilance. The health department advised reporting any unusual behavior or symptoms in pets and to contact authorities promptly if such signs appear. As of 12 June 2026, vigilance remains high in the area.

triage.headline_ja: トリッシュール地区アシュタミチラで人々を襲った野犬に狂犬病感染が確認；地域が警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はWPRO基準（重症度・流行リスク）で懸念があり、インド（対象国）で確認されているが、現時点で死亡例やヒト-ヒト感染の明確な証拠がなく、被害者は既にワクチン接種済み。情報が限定的であり、続報の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は高致死性疾患だが、本事例は動物由来（野犬）であり、被害者3名は全員既にワクチン接種済みで予防効果がある可能性が高い。ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低い。ただし地域内に他の野犬群がいるとの報告があり、地域レベルの管理可能性が課題。フルRRA段階で詳細評価の必要性は低いが、ワクチン接種済み患者の経過観察結果や追加症例の発生に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ჯანმო: კონგოს დემოკრატიულ რესპუბლიკაში ებოლა ახალ რეგიონებში ვრცელდება
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola is spreading to new regions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of May 15, 2026, with 136 deaths and 32 recoveries; 119 suspected cases. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. The epicenter is Ituri Province, but cases have reached North Kivu and South Kivu, including Beni in North Kivu. Olivier Le Polene, head of WHO's Department of Epidemiology and Analytics, notes near-daily case detection in new zones, indicating a larger outbreak than recorded, aided by high population mobility and current local transmission alongside imported cases. Many high-risk areas remain blind spots; strengthened surveillance is needed to reveal the full outbreak picture.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラがあたらしい地域に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRAに進める必要あり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak with 676 confirmed cases (136 deaths) as of May 15, 2026. Multiple provinces affected (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) with ongoing geographic expansion. WHO has explicitly noted this is likely underestimated due to surveillance gaps and high population mobility. No licensed vaccine or specific treatment available. Significant international health security concern.

article.articleHeadline: GBA appeals for public cooperation in dengue control
article.articleSummary: Dengue control efforts in Bengaluru step up as monsoon season begins, with the Greater Bengaluru Authority's Public Health Department (GBA) directed by Chief Health Officer S.S. Madani to intensify preventive measures. Residents should watch for dengue symptoms—high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, and intense muscle and joint pain—and act promptly. Officials urge eliminating mosquito breeding sites by preventing water stagnation in containers and properly disposing of waste materials such as used tyres, coconut shells, bottles, and other objects capable of collecting rainwater. The public is asked to contact doctors, health staff, or ASHA workers at government hospitals if fever or dengue-like symptoms develop. The campaign follows the \"Check, Clean and Cover\" approach, aiming to reduce mosquito breeding and curb transmission during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策で公衆協力を呼びかけ（GBAがベンガルール地域で）
triage.triage_reason: インドのベンガルール地域でのデング熱制御キャンペーンについての記事。季節的な予防措置の強化であり、異常な流行や重大な健康被害の報告がない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は雨季に向けてのデング熱対策キャンペーンに関するもので、緊急的な流行勃発ではなく定期的な予防啓発活動である。具体的な患者数や重症度情報が記載されていない。ベンガルール（カルナータカ州）で季節的な蚊媒介感染症対策が実施されているが、IHR基準に該当する異常性・深刻度は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Montes Claros mobiliza estudantes e moradores contra dengue zika e chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Montes Claros mobilizes students and residents against dengue, Zika and Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: On June 12, 2026, in Montes Claros, the Grande Independência neighborhood hosted an awareness campaign against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, organized by the city’s Center for Zoonoses Control (CCZ). Students and residents joined discussions, with posters and banners disseminating guidance. The campaign stressed keeping yards clean and free of standing water, noting that daily home care is essential and that ongoing property inspections are needed to prevent mosquito breeding. Messages highlighted that containers, open areas, and any water accumulation must be checked regularly. Practically, residents are advised to inspect their own yards and remove water-holding sites. The CCZ provides public guidance, while prevention relies on ongoing cooperation from residents, students, and families in Grande Independência.

triage.headline_ja: モンテス・クラロス市がデング熱、ジカウイルス、チクングニア熱に対策するため学生と住民を動員
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防啓発キャンペーンの実施を報じるもので、感染症の新規発生やアウトブレイク、深刻な公衆衛生上の事象を示す情報がない。既知のベクター媒介感染症に対する通常の予防活動であり、シグナルの基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのモンテス・クラロス市における蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、ジカ、チクングニア）に対する予防啓発キャンペーンを報じている。新規感染症の発生、症例報告、または病床逼迫などの危機的状況を示す情報は含まれておらず、通常の公衆衛生教育活動である。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah Scare: Surveillance intensified at state borders
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus scare prompts intensified surveillance in Tamil Nadu's Nilgiris district after a Nipah-positive case was confirmed in Kerala's Kozhikode. A 43-year-old man from Kozhikode tested positive for Nipah virus infection, prompting Tamil Nadu health authorities to heighten monitoring at interstate check posts and border villages in Nilgiris, which borders Kerala and Karnataka. Nilgiris District Collector Lakshmi Bhavya Tanneeru said preventive measures are in place and special surveillance teams are active in border areas and adjoining villages. Detailed advisories for border village residents will outline precautionary measures and health guidelines. Tourists visiting Nilgiris will be sensitised about Nipah symptoms and the need for early medical intervention.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス懸念：州境での監視が強化される
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つ新興感染症であり、ケーラ州での確認患者発生に伴うインド複数州での監視強化が報告されている。IHR基準で異常性と国際拡大リスクが該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度と流行しやすさが懸念される。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは致死率40-70%の重篤な人獣共通感染症。ケーラ州コージコード地区での確認患者発生とタミルナドゥ州での境界監視強化が報告されている。インド国内での複数州への拡大リスク、および地理的な南アジア位置づけから国際拡大の可能性が懸念される。情報は初段階の監視強化段階であり、症例数や具体的な流行規模等についてはさらなる情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO opozarja na širjenje ebole v DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the spread of Ebola in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading to new areas, with the number of cases rising. According to the latest data, more than 670 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The update, issued from Geneva on June 12, 2026, underscores the expanding geographic reach of the outbreak and the growing burden of this acute viral disease. The report does not include details on deaths, laboratory confirmation methods, or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の蔓延に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目中3項目が該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。WPRO基準でも重症度、流行傾向性、管理可能性において懸念あり。既知の大規模アウトブレイクの進展報告であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Genèveはニュース配信地（WHO本部）であり、実際のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク発生地ではないため除外。記事サマリーで670例以上の確定患者が報告されており、地理的拡大が強調されている。エボラ出血熱は高致命性疾患であり、国際感染予防対策上の重大関心事項。

article.articleHeadline: "L'ampleur exacte de l'épidémie reste incertaine" : le virus Ebola continue sa progression en RDC, alerte l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The exact extent of the epidemic remains uncertain: the Ebola virus continues to spread in the DRC, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported by the national Ministry of Health and WHO. The epidemic, though centered in Ituri province in the northeast, has been detected in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, reflecting geographic spread and elevated population mobility. Response efforts are hampered by worsening security conditions and a fragile health system, though authorities note improving visibility as surveillance, contact tracing, and testing capacity grow, particularly in North Kivu. In neighboring Uganda, virus presence since May 15 is considered under control by Africa CDC, with contact tracing now exceeding 70%. No licensed vaccine or approved treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak, complicating control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 「流行の正確な規模は依然として不確実である」：エボラウイルスはコンゴ民主共和国での蔓延を続けており、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。死亡者を伴う確認症例が多数あり、地域的拡大が進行中で、国際的リスクが存在するため。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行。2026年6月12日時点で676確認症例、136死亡。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州の34保健地区に拡大。隣接するウガンダでも5月15日以降にウイルスが検出されているが、現在は制御下にあるとされている。セキュリティ悪化と保健システムの脆弱性が対応を困難にしている。ワクチンや承認された治療法がないことが管理をさらに複雑にしている。WHOが警告を発出している。

article.articleHeadline: Venâncio Aires confirma duas mortes por Influenza em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venâncio Aires confirms two influenza deaths in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Two influenza-related deaths occurred in Venâncio Aires, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, confirmed by Lacen as Influenza A. Two men, aged over 90 and over 60, were hospitalized at Hospital São Sebastião Mártir and died in the last week from Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) caused by Influenza A. Neither patient had a vaccination record in the immunization system; the elder had comorbidities, the younger did not. Health authorities emphasize vaccination to prevent severe disease, especially among older adults, pregnant people, children, and those with comorbidities. To expand access, the UBS Central Immunization Unit offered extended hours starting June 11, with 73 doses that day. On June 12, operations ran 17:00–19:00, and on June 13, 07:30–11:30. Total doses administered to date: 12,171, including 6,093 to seniors, 1,012 to children, 240 pregnant individuals, 821 health workers, 1,604 with comorbidities, and 1,733 to non-priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: ベナンシオ・アイレス、2026年にインフルエンザによる2死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでインフルエンザA型による死亡2件が確認されたが、地域限定的な事例報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は現時点で限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年という将来日付のため、信憑性確認が必要。ブラジル国内における限定的な死亡事例報告で、その後の流行を示唆する情報はない。重症度基準は満たすが、IHR基準に達しておらず、また国際的な懸念材料が確認されていないため、フルRRA進行の優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den Ebola alarmı! 676 vaka, 136 ölüm bildirildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert from WHO! 676 cases, 136 deaths reported.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak expands: as of 12 June 2026, 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths are reported, with the majority in Ituri and additional transmission across 34 health zones in North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO notes new infections almost daily and cautions that true case numbers are likely higher. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine, with case counts exceeding 1,000. The flare-up was declared on 15 May after Ituri reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, and the WHO declared an international public health emergency on 17 May. Contributing factors hindering response include high population mobility, a weakened health system, and ongoing insecurity in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO からエボラ警告！676 件の症例、136 人の死亡が報告されました
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生、高い致死率、国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生。Bundibugyo variant（治療法・ワクチンなし）、致死率約20%（136/676）。2026年5月15日に宣言、5月17日にWHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。34の保健地域に拡大、報告症例は1,000を超える可能性。人口移動の多さ、保健システムの脆弱性、地域の不安定性が対応を阻害。フルRRAへの迅速な進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ, Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde 676 doğrulanmış Ebola vakası görüldüğünü bildirdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reported that 676 confirmed Ebola cases have been observed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On June 12, 2026, the World Health Organization reported 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The majority of cases are in Ituri Province, with detections across 34 health zones in North Kivu and South Kivu. Olivier le Polain, head of the WHO Epidemic and Response Analysis Unit, noted new cases are being detected nearly daily and the true burden is likely higher than reported. The outbreak began in Ituri, declared on May 15 after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths; it has since expanded amid high population mobility, a weakened health system, and ongoing insecurity, complicating response efforts. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare variant, with no approved treatment or vaccine. Total case counts reportedly exceed 1,000, and a Public Health Emergency of International Concern was declared on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確認患者676例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の大規模流行、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当。PHEIC宣言済みの継続的流行で、国際的対応が必要。
triage.notes: PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が2026年5月17日に宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な亜種）による大規模流行。676確認患者、136死亡、推定1,000例超。感染症危機管理上の最高リスク段階。

article.articleHeadline: Caso suspeito de ebola no RS: entenda como funciona o protocolo de atendimento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola Case in Rio Grande do Sul: Understand How the Care Protocol Works
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease case in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, involves a 64-year-old man with recent Uganda travel, who was treated for malaria (Plasmodium falciparum) in Novo Hamburgo. Ebola suspicion remains; diagnosis will be confirmed by Fiocruz. He is transferred to Hospital Nossa Senhora da Conceição in Porto Alegre, the reference center for suspected cases. A technical note (No. 01/2026) guides detection, notification, investigation, and infection control. Upon presentation, isolation with PPE and restricted access are required; invasive procedures and sample collection occur only at reference facilities. Municipal surveillance must notify state authorities and register the case in Sinan within 24 hours. If confirmed, transfer to a national reference unit may follow, with safe transport by SAMU or FAB. Contacts are monitored—currently 30 days. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC prompted the WHO to declare a PHEIC in May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スルにおけるエボラ疑い患者：対応プロトコルの仕組みを理解する
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ型エボラの疑い患者が報告され、DRCにおけるアウトブレイクにより2026年5月にWHOがPHEICを宣言している。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、エボラ・マラリア・ファルシパルムの複合懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（リオグランデ・ド・スル州）でのエボラ疑い患者（ウガンダ渡航歴あり）に関するもの。DRCで進行中のブンディブギョ型エボラアウトブレイクが背景にあり、WHOが2026年5月にPHEICを宣言している。マラリア（ファルシパルム）との複合診断検討が進行中。目標対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはBrazilとDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta de que el brote de ébola "se está expandiendo"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak is spreading.
article.articleSummary: 675 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with most infections in Ituri and additional cases in North and South Kivu, as the outbreak expands geographically. WHO notes 17 health zones branded as hotspots, requiring intensified surveillance amid high population mobility in the east. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. UNICEF warns more children may be affected; displacement and limited health services hinder response. UNICEF-led efforts target 3.7 million people, deploying over 1,600 community health workers and 24 decontamination teams, reaching more than 160,000 households and establishing daycare near treatment centers. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths; UNICEF seeks about €61 million for six months to sustain early detection, pediatric care, contact tracing, and community engagement to prevent worse outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行が「拡大している」と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地理的拡大、国際的拡大の実績、国際支援要請）。WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体であり、死亡例・重症例あり、複数国での確認、ワクチン・治療法なしという極めて危機的状況。
triage.notes: ウガンダも19例2死亡の報告があるが、DRCが発生地域の主体。ウガンダは対象国リストにないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebola virusはワクチン・承認治療法がなく極めて深刻。3,700万人への支援計画、国連児童基金による6ヶ月で€61百万の資金要請が進行中。人口移動が多い東部での拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: vírusfertőzésben meghalt két ember a Kongói DK egyik menekülttáborában
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Two people died of a viral infection in one of the Democratic Republic of the Congo's refugee camps.
article.articleSummary: Two people died from Ebola in the Kpangba camp for internally displaced persons in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where about 30,000 residents live; UNHCR reports urgent infection-control measures amid crowding. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. Across the country, there have been 676 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and 136 deaths to date. The disease has spread to three new health zones across North Kivu and Ituri provinces. A WHO epidemiologist notes the true spread may be higher than official figures due to information gaps in high-risk areas, and hospital isolation capacity is limited to about 250 beds in the three affected provinces. The CDC warned the outbreak could reach the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国の難民キャンプでウイルス感染により2人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による進行中のアウトブレイク（676確認症例、136死亡）、ワクチン・治療法なし、複数州への拡大、WHO・CDCによる警告。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus はエボラウイルス種の中でも稀な亜種。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較により、国際的な懸念が高い。UNHCR・WHO・CDCが関与し、医療体制の限界が指摘されている。Sierra Leone は発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは DRC のみが主題であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO cảnh báo nhiều 'điểm mù' trong đợt bùng phát tại CHDC Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO warns of many 'blind spots' during the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that surveillance blind spots in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may mask a larger Ebola outbreak than official counts. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the DRC has reported 676 Ebola cases, 136 deaths, 119 suspected cases, and 32 recoveries. The epidemic is centered in Ituri but has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, with cases at the Uganda border. WHO notes new cases are reported in health zones, and geographic spread exceeds reported numbers, with transmission in multiple locations. Severe gaps in isolation and treatment capacity persist—about 250 beds across three provinces. Contact tracing has improved to over 70% but remains insufficient to halt transmission. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or standard treatment. If surveillance and response are not intensified, this could become one of the worst outbreaks since West Africa’s 2014-2016 epidemic, with 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHO、コンゴ民主共和国での流行における多くの『情報空白』に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（676件の症例、136人の死亡、希少なBundibugyo株）、異常性（情報空白による過小報告の可能性）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ国境での症例）、国際的な移動制限リスクが認識される。フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での流行を主題としている。ウガンダ国境での症例言及があるがウガンダでの流行確認ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株は希少でワクチン・標準治療がない点、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（11,000死亡）との比較言及により、国際的な危機対応の必要性が明確。情報空白による過小報告の可能性は、実際のリスク規模が不明であることを意味し、迅速なRRA実施が重要。

article.articleHeadline: No new Nipah cases in Kozhikode; three hospitalised for observation
article.articleSummary: No new Nipah virus cases detected in Kozhikode district as of June 12, 2026. The total number of contacts under surveillance is 87 (4 highest-risk, 16 high-risk, 67 low-risk). Three individuals under quarantine have been admitted to hospital for observation, with samples sent for testing. The Nipah-positive patient has received the first dose of monoclonal antibody therapy per ICMR guidelines. Intensified surveillance included a house-to-house survey of 286 households in Ward 5, Ramanattukara municipality; 12 fever cases were identified, none with Nipah symptoms. A rapid response team reviewed containment-zone management and surveillance plans, and National Centre for Disease Control experts are expected to prepare a field report to aid district health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コジコード地区で新規ニパウイルス症例なし、3人が経過観察のため入院
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（高致命率、ヒト-ヒト感染可能）の確定症例が発生している。既知の感染者が存在し、87名の接触者が監視下にあり、継続的な曝露リスクと管理の複雑性がある。IHR基準と WPRO スクリーニング基準に該当。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは IHR Annex2 で報告義務病原体。既知の確定症例が存在し、87名の接触者が監視されている。NCDC（国立疾病管理センター）の関与と ICMR ガイドラインに基づく治療実施が報告されており、インド国内での公式対応が進行中。継続的な監視と接触者管理が進められているため、シグナル性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 28 जून को 824 बूथों पर पिलाई जाएगी पोलियो की खुराक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On June 28, polio vaccines will be administered at 824 booths.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive in India is slated for June 28 at 824 vaccination booths, with 442 house-to-house teams to vaccinate missed children over the following five days. The campaign targets 2,53,500 children and 2,63,816 households. To reach children in public spaces, 41 transit and 11 mobile teams will operate at brick kilns, bus stands, railway stations, major crossroads, and other locations. Vaccine stock for the campaign has been received at the state level, and cold chain logistics are reported as fully functional across centers. WHO's State Medical Officer Dr. Kunal noted that India has been polio-free since 2011, but neighboring Pakistan and Afghanistan continue to report cases, underscoring the need for vigilance. District authorities were told to supervise the initiative and ensure no child is left out, using block-level reviews and mobilizing village leaders and ration shop owners to support mobile crews in remote areas.

triage.headline_ja: 6月28日に824つの拠点でポリオワクチンが投与される
triage.triage_reason: ルーチンのポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、異常な疾患発生イベントではない。インドは2011年以来ポリオフリーであり、これは予防的公衆衛生活動である。IHR基準の該当がなく、流行の兆候も報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの定期的なポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施計画を報告しており、ポリオ患者の発生や流行を示す情報は含まれていない。インドは2011年以来ポリオフリーであり、これはシグナルではなく通常の公衆衛生プログラムである。発生地域に含まれるパキスタンとアフガニスタンは記事の主題ではなく、参考情報として言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsから除外する。

article.articleHeadline: FDA clears emergency use of drug to fight screwworm infections in pets
article.articleSummary: FDA granted emergency use authorization for nitenpyram tablets to treat New World screwworm infestations in dogs and cats. The first generic animal drug approved for this flesh-eating parasite. Dogs or cats ≥2 pounds and ≥4 weeks old may receive the treatment; a second dose should be given six hours after the first. Nitenpyram acts rapidly, killing most screwworm larvae within hours, though continued protection is not provided and additional removal of larvae by a veterinarian may be needed post-treatment. The New World screwworm larvae infest warm-blooded animals by feeding on live flesh and fluids; females lay eggs in open wounds or mucous membranes after mating once. In the U.S., once-eradicated cattle-warm-season scourge, but several new cases have appeared in Texas cattle and a dog in New Mexico in recent weeks. Brazil studies show expulsion of maggots after treatment. The drug’s effects are short-acting.

triage.headline_ja: FDAがペットのハエウジ症感染症と闘うための薬の緊急使用を承認
triage.triage_reason: ハエウジ症は動物疾患であり公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威ではなく、FDA承認の医療介入報道であるため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当はない。社会的関心は医療ニュースレベルの限定的なもの。
triage.notes: 本記事はFDAの動物用医薬品承認に関する報道であり、感染症流行イベントではない。テキサス州の牛およびニューメキシコ州の犬における症例言及があるが、米国は対象国リストに含まれていない。ブラジルは記事サマリーに研究言及があるため verified_locations に含める。ハエウジ症は動物寄生虫疾患であり、人間への直接的な健康脅威ではないため、IHRおよびWPRO評価の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : la Caraïbe renforce ses frontières malgré l'absence de cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the Caribbean tightens its borders despite the absence of cases.
article.articleSummary: Amid an Ebola outbreak in Central and East Africa, the Caribbean tightens border controls. Curaçao suspends issuing 'Caribbean visas' for nationals from risk zones including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and Rwanda, a decision echoed by Aruba and Sint Maarten. Antigua and Barbuda goes further, cancelling all visa exemptions for travelers from Africa; inbound visitors must reveal their travel history for the past 45 days and undergo infrared thermal screening at the airport. As of 12 June 2026, no Ebola cases have been reported in the Caribbean. The measures are described by authorities as precautionary, but the World Health Organization criticizes them as lacking scientific basis, warning they could hamper aid delivery and harm economies. The confrontation frames scientific risk assessment against political fear as authorities monitor potential imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：カリブ海諸国が感染者なしにもかかわらず国境を強化
triage.triage_reason: 中央・東アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行に対応したカリブ海地域の予防的措置であり、IHR基準の一部に該当する可能性があるが、対象地域に現在の流行が確認されていないため。続報によって状況が変わる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事はカリブ海地域での流行ではなく、中央・東アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）での流行に対応した国境強化措置を報道している。カリブ海ではいかなるエボラ症例も報告されていない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。WHO批判が存在することで国際的な関心が高まっているが、実際の対象地域での流行制御状況に関する詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola continua se espalhando na RDC, alerta OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic continues to spread in the DRC, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Most infections are in Ituri province (northeast), but cases have emerged in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO notes cases are being identified almost daily in new health zones, reflecting the outbreak’s true scale and high population mobility. The response is hampered by fragile health systems and persistent insecurity in the region, making surveillance and containment particularly challenging. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine or authorized therapy, underscoring the need for rapid public health measures to limit spread in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で引き続き拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべて該当。確認済み676症例、死亡136例、新規の健康地区で毎日症例が報告される異常な拡大パターンであり、ワクチンなし、治療法未承認の稀少なBundibugyo株の出現が国際的懸念を生じさせている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行は国際保健上の最高優先度。Bundibugyo株は稀少で、現在ワクチンおよび承認済み治療法がない点が特に懸念される。34の健康地区での報告、毎日の新規症例確認、脆弱な保健システム、地域の不安定性により、制御が困難な状況。WHOからの直接的警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola sigue extendiéndose en la República Democrática del Congo, advierte la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, warns the WHO.
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths reported in the DRC as of Thursday, linked to the Bundibugyo strain, which has no vaccine or approved treatment. Most infections are in Ituri province (northeast), with cases now in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The spread is occurring almost daily into new health zones, reflecting both the outbreak's true magnitude and population mobility. The response is challenged by weak health systems and insecurity, but DR Congo has Ebola-management experience. Gaps remain in high-risk areas; increased surveillance, contact tracing, and testing capacity are needed; contact tracing coverage is now just over 70%, an improvement over one to two weeks ago. In neighboring Uganda, Ebola presence confirmed on May 15; Africa CDC says outbreak under control. WHO remarks from Geneva via Olivier le Polain, reporting from Beni, North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行はコンゴ民主共和国で拡大し続けていると、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤で致命的な感染症、確認症例と死亡が記録されており、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認により国際拡大リスク高い。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で676確定症例、136死亡。ウガンダでも5月15日に確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。DRCのみ対象国リストに含まれる。ジュネーブのWHO報道官による情報。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Ebola spreads as agencies brace for child victims - Media Monitors Network (MMN)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths about three weeks after confirmation, with spread from Aru in Ituri to Miti Murhesa in South Kivu—roughly 1,000 km apart—across 34 health zones as of yesterday, including new cases in North Kivu. Vulnerable children, many malnourished and zero-dose for vaccination, raise concern for escalating household transmission. There are no approved Bundibugyo virus–specific therapeutics or vaccines, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance and contact tracing, currently around 70% and deemed insufficient. Testing capacity is expanding; a Beni laboratory processed 500 tests on Thursday. Response includes eight transport flights with more than 100 tonnes of supplies, 1,600 community health workers and 24 decontamination teams reaching over 160,000 households, aiming to assist 3.7 million people over six months. Schools may remain open with proper infection prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラが広がる中、機関は子どもの被害者に備える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な病原体の出現と地理的拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはワクチンと治療薬がなく、栄養不良の小児が高リスク。広範な地域的拡大（1,000km以上）と多数の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは極めて稀な病原体であり、既承認のワクチンと治療薬が存在しない。記事では676例の確認患者と136死亡が報告され、South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu各州にまたがる34の保健ゾーンに拡大している。接触者追跡は70%程度に留まり不十分とされている。3週間での急速な地理的拡大（1,000km）と小児への脆弱性が高リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação de três sorotipos da dengue reforça alerta para prevenção em Divinópolis - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Circulation of three dengue serotypes reinforces the call for prevention in Divinópolis - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: Three dengue serotypes now circulating in Divinópolis, Brazil, with a laboratory-confirmed coinfection of dengue serotypes 3 and 4 in a 27-year-old patient; first lab detection of serotype 4 in Divinópolis in 2026. Simultaneous circulation of DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4 documented. Despite improvements in care metrics, ongoing transmission risk remains. Current data: 3,827 dengue notifications; 1,535 confirmed; 1,506 discarded; 786 under investigation; three confirmed deaths and two under investigation. Primary care dengue attendances fell 37.5% week over week, from a peak of 98 to 10; Arboviroses outpatient visits went from 79 in May to 60 in early June. Aedes aegypti continues to be the main vector; authorities urge residents to eliminate standing water inside homes and yards and inspect water tanks, gutters, plant pots, tires, and discarded containers. Prior dengue infection can raise risk of severe disease with a different serotype; community participation remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: ジカウイルス3つの血清型の流行がジヴィノポリスにおける予防への警告を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱3血清型の同時流行は注視すべき異常な現象であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目（異常性、長期曝露、流行可能性）に該当するが、現段階では致死率や国際的拡大の具体的リスク情報が限定的であり、追加情報を待つべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ジヴィノポリスにおけるデング熱の3血清型（DENV-2、DENV-3、DENV-4）の同時流行を報告。単一患者でDENV-3とDENV-4の共感染が確認された点が異常。死亡者3例（確定）+2例（調査中）と死亡率は現在の統計では低いが、異なる血清型への再感染で重症化リスク増加の指摘あり。当該地域内では医療逼迫の緩和傾向を報告する一方、ウイルス流行は継続中。対象国はブラジルだがWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、南米の地域的流行監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Endiguer l'épidémie d'Ebola, une tâche difficile freinée par la désinformation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Containing the Ebola outbreak, a difficult task slowed by misinformation.
article.articleSummary: Since May 15, 2026, Ebola has reemerged in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighbouring Uganda, with Ituri in the DRC as the outbreak’s epicenter. The World Health Organization reported as of June 11: 136 deaths in DRC and 2 in Uganda. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person or animal; in the absence of a vaccine. The surge is accompanied by a rapid spread of misinformation, including theories that the virus was engineered, that other West African countries (Liberia, Ghana, Sierra Leone) are affected, false cures, and outright denial of Ebola’s existence. This infodemic undermines surveillance, case reporting, and patient care, according to ActionAid and WHO director Tedros. On the ground, hostility to responders is rising: one Ebola treatment center in Rwampara was burned, and safe burials are organized amid distrust.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の封じ込め、誤った情報により妨げられている困難な課題
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの再出現（DRC・ウガンダ）で138人の死亡を伴い、複数のIHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。情報操作による対応妨害も検出され、WPRO全スクリーニング基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC（特にIturi地域）とウガンダでの2026年5月15日以降のエボラ再出現が主な焦点。Liberia、Ghana、Sierra Leoneは誤った情報の対象地域として言及されているが、サマリー上では実際の発生地ではなく「他の西アフリカ諸国が影響を受けているという誤った理論」として記述されているため、対象国リストに含まれるGhanaのみ検討対象であるが、実際の発生地ではないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため検証対象から除外（DRCのみ verified_locations に含める）。重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、情報操作による対応の障害が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading into new areas in northeast DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding into new health zones in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported by the WHO as of 2026-06-12. There are 119 suspected cases and 32 recoveries. The strain is Bundibugyo, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. The outbreak centers on Ituri, with additional spread to North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border transmission into Uganda (19 confirmed cases, 2 deaths). UNICEF warns of a likely rise in infections among children via household transmission; over half of under-5 children in Ituri are chronically malnourished. Contact tracing remains around 70% of contacts; isolation capacity (250 beds) is far below needs and must be scaled rapidly. WHO classifies risk as very high in DRC, high in Uganda and border countries, and high but lower elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国北東部の新たな地域に拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また、確認患者676名・死亡136名、ワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株、接触者追跡率70%以下の不十分な管理体制など、WPROスクリーニング基準全項目該当。国際的支援の緊急性が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染は確認されているが、記事の主題はDRC内の流行拡大である。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で、ワクチン・治療薬の欠如、栄養不良児童の高い割合、接触者追跡の不十分さが管理困難性を示している。WHO は DRC での危険度を「非常に高い」と分類。フルRRA実施対象の緊急シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: ЮНИСЕФ призывает защитить детей от последствий вспышки Эболы в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF urges protection of children from the consequences of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of 11 June 2026. UNICEF warns that transmission within households could rise, putting more children at risk. In Ituri, more than half of children under five are chronically malnourished, and over 20% have never received the first dose of the diphtheria, tetanus and pertussis vaccine. Fear and distrust have reduced health-seeking behavior, threatening vaccination and treatment; early Ebola symptoms—fever, diarrhea, vomiting, weakness, and loss of appetite—are hard to distinguish from malaria, delaying diagnosis. UNICEF’s six-month plan aims to assist 3.7 million people, with 150 tons of aid delivered to Bunia, 1,600+ health workers trained, and mobile teams reaching over 160,000 households. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths; response supports 37 districts near borders. A $70.7 million six-month funding gap remains, with $17.4 million yet to be received.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行からの子どもの保護を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響：676確定例、136死亡；異常：エボラ流行；国際的拡大：ウガンダでも症例確認；渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例報告は二次的情報であり、流行の中心はDRCのイツリ州である。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。エボラウイルス病は IHR Annex2 の定義する緊急事態であり、確定例676、死亡136という数字は深刻な公衆衛生の影響を示す。国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大、予防接種率の低さ、栄養不良人口の高さ、ヒト-ヒト感染の高い可能性、資金ギャップ（$70.7M）は管理可能性の懸念を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Again
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola Disease (EBOD) caused by Bundibugyo virus (BVD) began 15 May 2026 in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo. By 8 June, 515 diagnosed cases and 91 deaths had been recorded, with Uganda reporting 19 cases as the epidemic spread across Africa. EBOD is a severe, often fatal illness; the Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine. The virus is thought to reside in bats and can transmit to humans through blood and body fluids, with transmission possible before symptom onset. Incubation can reach up to three weeks; symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and sometimes bleeding. Diagnosis requires specialized laboratories; sample handling poses infection risk. Nigeria’s Lagos State previously contained Ebola in 2014 via quarantine, contact tracing, and a treatment centre. Officials emphasize Ebola preparedness to forestall imported cases, noting concerns about emergence in Port Harcourt or Gwadalada in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - 再び
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる多国・多地域での発生、515例の患者と91例の死亡、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国Ituri州（2026年5月15日発症開始）であることが明確。ウガンダへの19例の拡大も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ナイジェリアについて言及があるが、これは過去事例（2014年）および将来の懸念言及であり、現在の発生地ではない。バンディブギオ型エボラウイルスによる新規発生で、ワクチンが存在しない点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den korkutan açıklama: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde doğrulanmış Ebola vaka sayısı 676'ya yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming statement from the WHO: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 676.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the World Health Organization reports Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths. The majority of cases are concentrated in Ituri province, though the virus has been detected in 34 health facilities across North Kivu and South Kivu. Officials warn that the true case count is likely higher, with new infections reported almost daily. The outbreak was officially declared in eastern DRC on 15 May after Ituri recorded 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, and the WHO declared a global public health emergency on 17 May. Response is hampered by security concerns and a weak health system, complicating humanitarian and medical efforts. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, which has no approved treatment or licensed vaccine; total cases, including suspected ones, have reportedly surpassed 1,000.

triage.headline_ja: WHO からの警告声明：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認症例数が676件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO による全世界公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant は稀な亜種で、利用可能な承認済み治療法またはライセンス取得済みワクチンがない。セキュリティ上の懸念と脆弱な医療システムが対応を複雑にしている。疑い症例を含む総症例数は1,000件を超えており、実際の症例数はさらに高い可能性あり。WHO は17年5月17日に全世界公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Dünyanın izlediği salgında korkulan oldu: Ebola sığınmacı kampına sıçradı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the outbreak the world is watching, what was feared has happened: Ebola has jumped into the refugee camp.
article.articleSummary: WHO had declared an international public health emergency on May 17 as the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached a 30,000-person refugee camp (Kpangba). In the camp, a 60-year-old mother and her daughter died after escaping quarantine; laboratory analyses confirmed Ebola in both after their deaths, with the mother testing positive on May 30 and deaths on May 31 and June 1, prompting urgent follow-up for at least eight contacts. The outbreak has extended across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in eastern DRC, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported to date, and it has crossed the border to Uganda, reporting 19 cases. The virus is the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. Overcrowded camps, inadequate sanitation, distrust of authorities, and unsafe burial practices threaten outbreak control and risk further displacement.

triage.headline_ja: 世界が注視する感染症の流行で懸念されていたことが起きた：エボラがシナイ難民キャンプに飛び火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として、フルリスク評価（RRA）が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは「国境を越えて広がった」という言及にとどまっており、DRCが主要な発生地であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラウイルス病は致死率が高く（20～90%）、難民キャンプという高リスク環境での拡大、治療法やワクチンの不在（Bundibugyo株）、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS et l'UNICEF avertissent contre une épidémie qui s'étend à une ampleur sous-estimée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO and UNICEF warn of an outbreak whose scale has been underestimated
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of June 10, across 34 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, spanning 1,000 km. WHO and UNICEF warn the true scale is likely underestimated. The outbreak is driven by population mobility, ongoing insecurity, and weak health systems; 17 health zones are prioritized for enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, testing, and care. Children are particularly vulnerable: they represent 14–17% of cases, with high malnutrition (>50% under five) and low vaccination (>20% unvaccinated). Early symptoms in children resemble malaria, hindering diagnosis. Community information gaps persist: about two-thirds of youths are unaware of transmission and roughly half would resist a survivor’s return. Cross-border transmission to Uganda is 19 cases and 2 deaths. UNICEF seeks $17.4 million of $70.7 million needed for the next six months, and urges safe, unimpeded humanitarian access.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ: WHOとUNICEFが過小評価されている流行の拡大に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は国際保健上の懸念事項（PHEIC）であり、確認症例676件、死亡136件、複数州での流行、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、そして脆弱な保健体制により、国際的な対応が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国際的拡大（19件、死亡2件）が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれる。マラリア併存が診断の複雑化を招いている。資金不足（$70.7百万必要の内$17.4百万のみ確保）により、対応が制限される恐れがある。

article.articleHeadline: Unicef diz que existe avanço iminente do ebola entre crianças na RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF says there is an imminent Ebola outbreak among children in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu) threatens children, with UNICEF warning that kids already account for about 14–17% of the 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths as of June 11, 2026. The epicenter is Bunia’s Rwampara Hospital, where transmission is increasingly occurring at home, risking a pediatric surge amid chronic malnutrition, low vaccination coverage, conflict, and strained health systems. The outbreak spans 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, within roughly 1,000 km; authorities warn the true scale may be larger due to surveillance gaps. UNICEF, WHO and WFP are coordinating logistics, nutrition, health teams, and psychosocial support, emphasizing early detection and community trust. The situation has crossed borders to Uganda, where rapid response is underway, signaling a potential rise in imported/exported cases and pediatric impact.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEFはコンゴ民主共和国の子どもたちの間でエボラの差し迫った流行があると述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て満たす。確定患者676例・死亡136例、複数県に拡大、ウガンダへの越境、子どもへの高い影響率。国際的な重大懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での進行中のエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境確認も記載。UNICEF・WHO・WFPが対応中。子どもの患者比率（14-17%）が高く、栄養不良・低ワクチン接種率・紛争による脆弱性が懸念される。Rapid Risk Assessment進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ekkora az ebolajárvány veszélye a foci vb-n: megszólalt a WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak risk at the World Cup is this big: WHO weighs in.
article.articleSummary: World Cup Ebola risk remains low, per WHO. No Ebola cases in host countries (USA, Canada, Mexico) or Europe. Travel plans need not change. WHO cites favorable factors: most infections in remote areas of the DRC; travelers from affected regions are screened before departure. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected body fluids; it is not airborne and is only contagious when symptoms appear. In East Congo, the outbreak is worsening, with about 635 confirmed infections and at least 127 deaths in the last month, per the health ministry. Reuters notes some experts link transmission to a local priest’s funeral, possibly involving a coffin transfer. WHO emphasizes on-site outbreak control and border and event health checks to protect travelers; those who recently visited DRC or Uganda and feel unwell should seek medical care and inform their physician. Across Africa, transmission outpaces response.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップでのエボラ出血熱流行リスク：WHOが言及
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がDRC/ウガンダで確認されており、国際的な関心も存在するが、WHO公式声明では「リスク低い」と評価され、深刻な国際的拡大の兆候は現在のところ認められない。情報が今後更新される可能性があるため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、アメリカ、カナダ、メキシコでのエボラ症例は報告されておらず、これらの国は「ホスト国」として言及されているのみ。ウガンダが地理的に記事に登場しているが、サマリーの主題は「DRC東部での流行悪化」であり、ウガンダでの実際の発生は明示されていないため verified_locations には含めない。発生地域にはメキシコも列挙されているが、WHO声明は「メキシコを含むホスト国にはエボラ症例がない」と述べているため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Africa CDC exige une surveillance sanitaire renforcée à toutes les frontières africaines
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Africa CDC demands strengthened public health surveillance across all African borders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, poses ongoing threats across East Africa and the Great Lakes. Africa CDC urges AU member states to immediately strengthen health surveillance at airports, seaports and land border posts to prevent cross-border spread. Past outbreaks have hit Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo with high fatality rates. The director-general Dr. Jean Kaseya calls for rapid, coordinated, scientifically grounded action: non-invasive traveler screening, deployment of trained personnel at entry points, improved detection and triage of suspected cases, and intensified risk communication, while avoiding unnecessary disruption to travel, goods, or humanitarian work. A high-level summit is planned for June 16 to mobilize funding and political commitment. Success hinges on investments in border staffing, cross-border alert systems, timely data sharing, and bilateral coordination between neighbors, as well as sustainable health financing. Belgium’s foreign minister Hadja Lahbib’s East Africa visit underscores solidarity, alongside WHO collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：アフリカCDCがアフリカ全境の国境での強化された公衆衛生監視を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）がアフリカ東部で脅威を呈しており、DRCとウガンダでの過去の発症歴、高致命率、国際的拡大リスク、アフリカCDCによる国境強化要求など、IHR基準4項目およびWPRO基準複数項目に該当する重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているEbola脅威地域はアフリカ東部および大湖地域（DRC、ウガンダが歴史的発生地）。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。オーストラリアとベルギーは地政学的背景（solidarity表現、外交訪問）として記事に含まれるが、実際のEbola発生地域ではないため除外。モザンビークも発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは具体的な言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah surveillance continues in Kozhikode; 3 persons in hospital for observation, NCDC team to visit
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus surveillance in Kozhikode district, Kerala, India, as of 2026-06-12: no new Nipah cases reported; three individuals under quarantine hospitalized for observation, samples sent for laboratory testing. The patient already under treatment has received the first dose of monoclonal antibody therapy per ICMR guidelines and medical board. Contact tracing expanded to 87 people: 4 highest risk, 16 high risk, 67 low risk; all monitored with district control room twice daily. Door-to-door survey in Ward 5 of Ramanattukara Municipality identified 286 households and 12 fever cases on Saturday, but none developed Nipah symptoms. Rapid Response Team met again to review containment; National Centre for Disease Control experts to visit on Saturday to assess situation and support public health efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ニパールウイルス監視がコジコデで継続；3人が観察のため入院中、NCDC チームが土曜日に訪問予定
triage.triage_reason: ニパールウイルスの確認された発生事例（既に1例治療中）、複数の接触者隔離、急速な接触者追跡の拡大（87人）、国家レベルの対応（NCDC専門家派遣）により、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、管理性）に該当し、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: ニパールウイルスは高い致死率（40～75%）を持つ人獣共通感染症。既に患者が確認され、単クローン抗体療法が開始されている。接触者追跡が積極的に実施されており、全国衛生機関（NCDC）の緊急対応が進行中。ただし現時点では国際的拡大のリスクは低い模様。

article.articleHeadline: Logistics Remain A Key Factor As Continent Seeks $518 Million To Combat Ebola
article.articleSummary: Logistics remain a key factor as Africa seeks $518 million to combat Ebola, with governments, donors and private-sector groups stepping up efforts to prevent wider regional transmission. Africa CDC and the World Health Organization launched a continental response plan to contain the growing Ebola outbreak across Central and East Africa. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, confirmed Ebola cases rose to 676, with 136 deaths, according to government data released on Thursday. The joint plan aims to mobilize international support and coordinate partners to accelerate outbreak response and resource deployment across affected areas. The report notes mounting financial and operational demands as the continent fights the outbreak as of 2026-06-12.

triage.headline_ja: 物流が重要な要因に　アフリカ大陸がエボラ対策に5億1800万ドルを求める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な多国発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的な支援体制整備の段階にある重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ全体および中央・東アフリカでのエボラ対策を記述しているが、具体的な患者数データはDRCのみ報告されている（676確認例、136死亡）。モザンビークは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは具体的な言及がないため verified_locations には含めない。Africa CDCおよびWHOによる大陸規模の対応計画が立案され、国際資金（5億1800万ドル）動員の段階であり、極めて高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly AI drones, Ebola containment struggles, and faltering US food aid: The Cheat Sheet
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are advancing faster than containment. The northeastern Ituri province, with Tchomia as the latest outbreak zone, accounts for about 94% of 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths nationwide. Cases have emerged in North Kivu and South Kivu, and across the border in Uganda. Contact tracing in Ituri is severely limited, reaching only about 12% of contacts, with delayed detection, high population mobility, and distrust in authorities hindering control of this rare Ebola strain for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda reports better performance, following up on 91% of contacts of its 19 Ebola patients and imposing cross-border movement restrictions. The outbreak highlights persistent containment challenges and cross-border transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なAIドローン、エボラ封じ込めの苦闘、そして減速する米国の食糧援助：チートシート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な公衆衛生影響（死亡率高い）、国境越え拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、異常な感染パターン（12%の接触者追跡率）、国際的な渡航・貿易制限リスク。フルRRA推奨。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは確認患者19名にとどまり、主要な流行はDRCであり、DRCが封じ込めの中心課題。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ワクチンなし、治療薬なしという深刻な管理課題、接触者追跡の著しい不備が重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: One more shigellosis death in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis in Kerala, India, as of 12 June 2026: 132 confirmed cases this year with 75 probable. 18 new confirmed cases across districts, and three total deaths this year, including a 59-year-old woman from Keezhattoor, Malappuram, who died on June 9, and two child deaths in Kozhikode. District-wise: Kozhikode 4, Malappuram 3, Thrissur (Wadakkanchery) 2, Thiruvananthapuram 1, Kollam 1, with 7 new cases in Wayanad; ~20 patients remain hospitalized there. Seven additional shigella-positive cases reported in Chulliyode, Wayanad; over 500 symptomatic individuals. In Thiruvananthapuram, shigella was isolated from locally made pineapple juice at a bakery in Kattakada, which has been shut after lab confirmation by the Food Safety department. Officials link rising cases to deteriorating water quality and groundwater contamination; emphasize handwashing, boiled water, and infection-control practices for patients and households.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でシゲラ症による死亡がさらに報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。複数州にわたる確認例132件、死亡3件、水質汚濁との関連が指摘され、対象国インドの健康上の脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: 記事はケーラ州を主要な発生地とし、複数の州（コーzhikode、Malappuram、Thrissur、Thiruvananthapuram、Kollam、Wayanad）に拡がる集団発生を報告。水質汚濁、地下水汚染が原因として当局が指摘。食品媒介感染（パイナップルジュース）も確認されている。WPRO全基準に該当し、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação de três sorotipos da dengue eleva atenção em Divinópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Circulation of Three Dengue Serotypes Heightens Awareness in Divinópolis.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Divinópolis, Brazil, reports simultaneous circulation of dengue serotypes DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4. Laboratory testing detected a dual infection with DENV-3 and DENV-4 in a 27-year-old woman with no comorbidities, marking the municipality’s first laboratory identification of DENV-4 in 2026. Overall dengue: 3,827 notifications; 1,535 confirmed; 1,506 discarded; 786 under investigation. Three deaths confirmed; two more under investigation. Despite a drop in health-seeking behavior, surveillance remains vigilant. Primary care visits declined 37.5% from the prior week (98 to 10). The Arboviruses Outpatient Clinic fell from May peak of 79 patients in a day to 60 in early June. Control measures remain essential, with most breeding sites inside homes (water tanks, gutters, plant pots, tires, discarded containers). Previous dengue infection increases risk of severe disease if reinfected with a different serotype; thus ongoing inspections and community participation are critical.

triage.headline_ja: デングウイルス3種の流行がディビノポリスで警戒を高める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations は空となり、PICKUP判定の前提条件を満たさない。ただし複数デングセロタイプの同時流行、致死例、DENV-4初検出など公衆衛生的な重要な特性があり、情報更新時の検証が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の発生地はブラジル（Divinópolis, Minas Gerais州）であり、CEPR対象国リストに含まれていない。IHR基準2個以上かつWPRO基準複数該当する重要なシグナルだが、地域検証規則により対象外。ただし、複数セロタイプの同時流行（DENV-2/3/4）、二重感染例、DENV-4初検出、3名の確認死亡例など、公衆衛生的に注視する価値がある。対象国での同様の流行報告が出現した場合の比較参照に有用。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO cảnh báo nhiều 'điểm mù' trong đợt bùng phát tại CHDC Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO warns of many 'blind spots' in the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of surveillance blind spots in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak as of 12 June 2026. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, the DRC has recorded 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths, with 119 suspected and 32 recovered. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province but has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, and crossed into Uganda. WHO epidemiologist Olivier Le Polain notes near-daily detections in new health zones across the three affected provinces, indicating wider transmission than official counts. Ongoing community transmission is reported in many new sites, alongside movement-related cases from hotspots. Surveillance gaps remain high-risk, with many high-risk areas not adequately monitored. Treatment capacity is severely constrained: only about 250 beds for Ebola across the three provinces, far below demand; urgent expansion is urged.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：WHO、コンゴ民主共和国の流行における多くの『盲点』に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響：676確定例・136死亡、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数のWPRO基準も満たす。対象国DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地で、ウガンダは流行が『越えた』地域として言及されている。当該情報のみではウガンダでの実際の患者発生の詳細が不明なため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。監視ギャップ、治療能力の不足が深刻なリスク要因として記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتمدد في الكونغو.. نقاط غامضة تحيط بتفشي المرض ومخاوف من انتشار أكبر | التلفزيون العربي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... Mysterious factors surround the outbreak of the disease and fears of a wider spread | Al Arabiya TV
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths. The outbreak has extended to three health zones and reached Uganda, which has 19 cases. It involves a rare Bundibugyo strain for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists, and WHO warns of mysterious factors surrounding transmission, suggesting the true scale may exceed official counts. Surveillance is urgently needed in high-risk areas; isolation capacity remains limited, about 250 beds across affected provinces. Two Ebola-related deaths were reported at the Kibangba refugee camp, housing roughly 30,000 people, where overcrowding and weak health infrastructure complicate containment. The crisis arises amid decades of conflict displacing more than five million people, heightening fears of wider spread and prompting comparisons to West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic (over 11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが拡大…疾病の流行を取り巻く不可解な点と、より大規模な拡大への懸念 | アルアラビーヤテレビ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の複数国拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の懸念）。希少なBundibugyo株による新規エボラ流行で、ウガンダへの国際的拡大と治療法なしの危機的状況。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUgandaとAngolaも含まれるが、記事サマリーでは実際の患者発生はDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）とウガンダ19例のみ確認。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。希少なBundibugyo株、承認された治療法やワクチンなし、難民キャンプでの感染確認など、極めて高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: The world feared it during the pandemic: Ebola has spread to a refugee camp.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola has spread to the Kpangba refugee camp in the Democratic Republic of Congo, housing about 30,000 people, after the WHO declared an international public health emergency on May 17. The DR Congo Ministry of Health reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths nationwide, with the outbreak crossing borders to Uganda (19 cases). The two first casualties inside the camp are a 60-year-old mother and her daughter; the mother tested positive on May 30 and died May 31, followed by the daughter on June 1; post-mortem tests detected Ebola. At least eight contacts linked to the mother/daughter are under monitoring. Containment is jeopardized by extreme overcrowding, poor hygiene, and distrust of health teams, with reports of secret burials. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola, raising fears of mass migrations.

triage.headline_ja: 世界がパンデミック中に懸念していたエボラ：難民キャンプに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。難民キャンプ内での感染拡大と境界線を超えた地域的広がりが確認された。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれず）への越境確認もあるが、主発生地はDRCの難民キャンプ。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスであり治療法・ワクチンがない点が特に懸念される。難民キャンプという高密度人口集団での発生により管理可能性が著しく低下している。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Αύξηση κρουσμάτων, επέκταση της επιδημίας σε νέες περιοχές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Increase in cases, expansion of the outbreak into new areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo expands, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, linked to the Bundibugyo strain (no approved vaccine or specific treatment). Most cases remain in Ituri, but transmission has spread to 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO epidemiologist Olivier Le Pollen, reporting from Beni, North Kivu, notes daily new cases across areas, suggesting the true burden may be higher due to population movement. Response is hindered by weak health systems and security issues, though local authorities have experience from prior outbreaks. High‑risk areas lack clear data; strengthening surveillance, contact tracing, and diagnostics—especially in North Kivu—is needed. Over 70% of contacts of confirmed cases are now identified. Priorities include safe burials, protecting health facilities, early detection and isolation, and active community engagement. Africa CDC reports Uganda’s Ebola outbreak is now under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：感染者数の増加、新たな地域への流行の拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率と国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限リスクを有し、東部コンゴでの確認例増加と複数地域への拡大は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部コンゴ（イトゥリ州、キブ州）でのエボラ流行拡大を主として報じており、676確認症例、136死亡が報告されている。Bundibugyo株であり、ワクチン・特異的治療がない。ウガンダの流行は制御下にあるとの記述もあるが、DRCが主要な発生地である。弱い保健システムと治安上の問題が対応の障害となっており、国際的支援が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: La crisi congolese dimenticata tra sfollamento, fame ed Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The forgotten Congolese crisis amid displacement, hunger and Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Displacement, hunger and an Ebola outbreak converge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a crisis long among the world's most neglected. In Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, internal displacement persists as camps host populations uprooted by armed groups and military operations, undermining agriculture, markets, livestock and seeds. In 2025 only 27.4% of required funds were disbursed, leaving over 21 million people with reduced or no assistance; aid per person has fallen from about $55 to under $33. In May 2026 an Ebola outbreak emerged in Ituri, with eight confirmed cases, 246 suspected, and 80 suspected deaths; the outbreak spread to Goma and Kinshasa, and to Uganda. WHO declared a PHEIC; the Bundibugyo strain lacks approved vaccines or therapies, and four health workers have died. The Global Preparedness Monitoring Board warns the world remains unprepared for pandemics; conflict, malnutrition and weak health systems amplify spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の忘れられた危機：避難民、飢餓とエボラ出血熱の同時発生
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多地域への拡大（イツリ→ゴマ→キンシャサ→ウガンダ）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、高い死亡率、ワクチン・治療法未承認の株による脅威、および国際的な保健危機管理能力の不足により、IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。
triage.notes: 2026年5月にイツリで発症したエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）は8確定例・246疑い例・80疑い死亡を報告。感染はゴマ（南キヴ州）、キンシャサ（首都）に拡大し、ウガンダへの国際的拡散も確認。WHOはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。医療従事者4名が死亡し、利用可能なワクチン・治療法がない状況。DRC国内の紛争、栄養不良、脆弱な保健システムが拡大を助長。ウガンダへの拡散はWPRO基準の「international_spread」を強く支持。フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: "الإيبولا" يضرب مخيمات النازحين في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hits IDP camps in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) due to the Bundibugyo strain is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, South Kivu, North Kivu) with two deaths reported at the Kabanjba internally displaced persons camp (about 30,000 residents) on May 31 and June 1; both cases were tested for Ebola posthumously by the WHO. The outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO on May 17. As of June 12, Congo has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, while Uganda has 19 cases. The transmission risk is heightened in crowded camps with inadequate sanitation and shared facilities; detection has been delayed for weeks, complicating containment. triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がコンゴの難民キャンプを襲う
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多くの症例と死亡者が報告され、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO が国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した確認済みの重大事象であり、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain のエボラウイルス病。676確認患者、136死亡（コンゴ）、ウガンダで19症例。2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言。難民キャンプ（約30,000人）での伝播リスク高、治療法やワクチンなし。記事サマリーではコンゴでの発生が主題であり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta de dengue: 30 bairros de Campinas estão em alto risco de transmissão; veja a lista - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue alert: 30 neighborhoods in Campinas are at high risk of transmission; see the list - ACidade ON Campinas.
article.articleSummary: Dengue alert issued for Campinas, Brazil, with 30 neighborhoods at high transmission risk as of June 11, according to the Painel de Arboviroses. The risk spans the Leste, Noroeste, Norte, Sudoeste, Sul and Sudeste regions, extending to nearby areas. Notable at-risk areas include Vila Costa e Silva, Jardim Santa Genebra, Alto Taquaral (East); Vila Castelo Branco, Jardim Mirassol (North); Eldorado dos Carajás, Jardim Santo Antônio (Southwest); Jardim Noêmia, Jardim Irajá (South); Vila Orozimbo Maia, Jardim Itatiaia (Southeast). Campinas had 2,861 confirmed dengue cases through June 8, with no deaths reported in this period. Risk designation considers case counts, indicators of new transmission, need for health-agent reinforcement, and inaccessible properties. Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector, also transmits Zika and chikungunya. Preventive actions urged: clean gutters and drains, keep water tanks closed, remove standing water from pots, dispose of tires/containers, clean appliance trays, and keep yards free of water-collecting objects. Winter reduces but does not eliminate risk; vigilance year-round.

triage.headline_ja: デング警報：カンピナスの30地域が高い伝染リスク、リストを参照 - ACidade ON Campinas
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのカンピナス地域で複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング、ジカ、チクングニア）の同時警報が発令されており、30地域が高リスク地域に指定されている。ただし、死亡報告がなく、地域的な警告段階であり、国際的拡大やIHR基準の明確な該当が限定的であるため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はカンピナス市（ブラジル）での蚊媒介感染症の警報に焦点。2026年6月現在で2,861件の確定デング症例が報告されているが、死亡例は報告されていない。3つの蚊媒介感染症（デング、ジカ、チクングニア）の同時リスク警告は異常だが、重症度や死亡率の高さは記事に見当たらない。地域的な公衆衛生対応として機能しており、国際的な懸念や外部支援の必要性は現時点で示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: "نقاط غامضة" تعيق رصد انتشار إيبولا - Lebanese Forces Official Website
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Mysterious Points" Hinder Monitoring of Ebola Spread
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 136 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the outbreak expanding to three additional health zones and reaching neighboring Uganda. The strain involved is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Olivier Le Poulain, a WHO epidemiologist in Beni, eastern DRC, warned of unresolved 'dark spots' in high-risk areas and called for enhanced surveillance, noting a severe shortage of isolation beds—about 250 in the three affected provinces. The outbreak had gone undetected for weeks as responders strive to contain it. WHO has yet to issue formal size estimates; the CDC has suggested it could reach levels witnessed in West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic, which killed over 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: 「謎の盲点」がエボラ拡大の監視を阻害
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者676名・死亡136名、ウガンダへの越境拡大、Bundibugyo型（治療法・ワクチンなし）、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（11,000死亡超）との比較によるハイリスク警告が示唆される。IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される発生国：DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のみ。ウガンダへの越境拡大が記載されているが、アンゴラについては記事サマリーに言及がなく、Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールド誤判定の可能性。対象国リストの制約から、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。本事例は歴史的大流行（2014-2016西アフリカ）への比較言及、治療法・ワクチン欠如、隔離病床不足（250床）、数週間の検知遅延など、複合的な深刻リスク要因を含む。WHO formal estimate未発表、CDC West Africa scale予測との記載により、情報透明性の課題も指摘される。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Конго: ЮНІСЕФ попередив про різке зростання випадків серед дітей | Головне в Україні
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: UNICEF warned of a sharp rise in cases among children | Top stories in Ukraine
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) poses rising pediatric risk. As of 11 June, 676 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths have been reported in DRC, with most infections among working-age adults. UNICEF warns that as transmission expands within households, children are increasingly affected. In Ituri, chronic malnutrition is common among under-fives, and over 20% have never received routine diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis vaccines, heightening vulnerability. Ebola symptoms in children—fever, diarrhea, vomiting, weakness, loss of appetite—mirror malaria, delaying diagnosis. Public trust in health workers is low: two-thirds of young Congolese do not know transmission or protection methods, and about 20% doubt the disease exists. UNICEF’s six-month plan aims to reach 3.7 million people, with 150 tons of supplies and 1,600+ trained responders. The outbreak has spilled into Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths; rapid detection, care, contact tracing, and risk communication are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行：ユニセフが子どもの症例の急増について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。小児層への急速な拡大、ワクチン接種率低下、信頼性低下による対応困難化が確認されており、フルRRA実施の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州）での進行中のエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境拡大（19症例、2死亡）も報告されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。小児への急速な拡大、低いワクチン接種率（DPT接種率20%未満）、公衆衛生への信頼性低下、診断遅延の潜在的リスクが特に懸念される。ユニセフの大規模対応（350万人への到達目標）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ấn Độ cảnh giác trước nguy cơ bùng phát virus Nipah sau ca nhiễm mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India on alert for Nipah virus outbreak risk after a new case.
article.articleSummary: On 11 June, India confirmed a Nipah virus case in Kozhikode district, Kerala. A 43-year-old man from Ramanattukara presents with acute encephalitis and is in critical condition on a ventilator; samples have been sent to the National Institute of Virology (NIV) Pune for confirmatory testing. Kerala health authorities have activated emergency measures, including a dedicated isolation ward, contact tracing, and enhanced surveillance. The patient reportedly rented a warehouse and cleaned the area, near sites that may host fruit bats, the natural Nipah reservoir. The case follows Kerala’s history of Nipah outbreaks, including a major 2018 outbreak, a 2021 animal-to-human case, and a 2023 outbreak. Nipah virus has a high case fatality (40–75%), with no widely licensed vaccine or antiviral; treatment is supportive. Early detection and strict isolation are crucial.

triage.headline_ja: インドがニパウイルス新規感染後の流行リスクに警戒
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス感染が確認され、高い致死率（40-75%）、人間-人間感染のリスク、そして過去の流行歴を考慮するとIHR基準3項目以上に該当。地域の公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはWHO重要感染症リストに掲載される病原体。43歳患者が人工呼吸器装着中で重篤。ケーラ州は2018年、2021年、2023年と複数回の流行歴あり。フルーツコウモリ（自然宿主）の曝露リスク存在。確定検査はNIV Puneで進行中。緊急防疫措置が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo expands to 676 cases, 136 deaths
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-12, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with true scale likely larger due to high population mobility and detection challenges. Most cases are in Ituri province, with infections now reported in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO identifies 17 hotspot areas requiring intensified support, while surveillance expands to high-risk locations not yet reporting cases. Response measures include safe burials, infection prevention in health facilities, early detection, contact tracing and community engagement. Ongoing challenges include insecurity, a weakened health system and significant population movement that complicate containment. WHO support spans surveillance, laboratory capacity, logistics, infection prevention, clinical care and risk communication to the Congolese government.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが東部コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が676例、136人の死亡に拡大したと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準5項目すべてに該当するため。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ国際感染症危機として分類される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部コンゴ（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu各州）でのエボラ出血熱の拡大を明確に述べている。676例の確定患者と136人の死亡、34の保健ゾーンへの感染拡大、17の重要ホットスポット地域の特定が報告されている。人口移動の多さと検査の課題により実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。不安定な治安と脆弱な保健システムが対応を複雑化させている。WHOは積極的な支援を展開している。

article.articleHeadline: UNHCR: Prve žrtve ebole među raseljenim licima u kampu na istoku Konga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNHCR: First Ebola victims among displaced people in a camp in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: UNHCR confirms the first Ebola-related deaths among internally displaced people in the Kpangba camp in eastern Congo, where about 30,000 IDPs reside. The two victims from the camp mark the initial fatalities within displacement sites as the outbreak continues. Ebola has spread across Ituri, South Kivu, and North Kivu provinces. Congo has reported 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths overall; the outbreak has also reached Uganda with 19 cases. Distrust toward humanitarian workers has risen during the month-long epidemic, and some locals secretly bury bodies, elevating transmission risk. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026, highlighting cross-border concerns and the need for intensified response in conflict-affected regions where displacement complicates containment.

triage.headline_ja: UNHCR: コンゴ東部の難民キャンプでエボラ熱の初の犠牲者を確認
