triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言済み。確定症例676件・死亡136件、複数国への越境拡大、人道危機地域での対応困難性が確認された。
triage.notes: Uganda（id: 226074）は発生地域に含まれているがサマリーでは「19症例を記録」と報告例のみで、実際の新規発生地として主題となっていないため除外。DRC国内の複数州（South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu）での流行、難民キャンプでの初の死亡確認、信頼関係喪失による不適切な遺体埋葬など複雑な要因がある。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）は既に発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-doden in vluchtelingenkamp Congo, angst voor verdere verspreiding
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in refugee camp in Congo, fear of further spread.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola deaths were reported in the Kpangba refugee camp in Ituri province, eastern Congo: a 60-year-old mother and her daughter. The mother became ill about two weeks earlier; an initial test suggested Ebola, she was quarantined but left, and died on May 31, with her daughter dying the following day. The World Health Organization has confirmed the infections. The camp houses about 30,000 displaced people near the Uganda border, raising fears of wider spread. Aid workers warn that overcrowded, poorly sanitized conditions and limited capacity to isolate patients increase transmission risk, while distrust toward medics has led to hostility when bodies were discovered. The International Organization for Migration notes density in camps heightens outbreak risk. Congo reports 676 Ebola cases and 136 deaths across three eastern provinces; Uganda has 19 cases. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo; there is no vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの難民キャンプでのエボラ死亡、さらなる拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。難民キャンプの過密状態と複数国への感染拡大状況がシグナル判定を支持。
triage.notes: 難民キャンプでの確認症例、ウガンダへの越境感染リスク、ワクチン未供給、医療従事者への不信感による隔離困難など複合的リスク要因が存在。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading into new areas in northeast DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern DR Congo, centered in Ituri with spillovers to North Kivu and South Kivu, is expanding in both case numbers and geographic spread (as of 2026-06-12). Since May 15, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; 119 suspected; 32 recovered. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak. Isolation capacity is 250 beds across affected provinces, insufficient for escalating needs as cases reach new health zones; contact tracing is just over 70% of contacts traced, below optimal levels. UNICEF warns of a likely rise in child infections via household transmission, noting high vulnerability due to chronic malnutrition in under-5s in Ituri. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, which has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; AU reports Uganda’s situation under control. WHO risk is very high in DRC, high in Uganda and neighboring countries, and low elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国北東部の新しい地域に拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な地理的拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による進行中の大規模エボラ流行で、DRCおよびウガンダで確認され、新規感染地域への拡大継続中。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）が含まれているが、ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには除外。DRCのみを列挙。記事サマリーでは「ウガンダでも19確認例、2死亡」と述べられているが、対象国外のため副次的扱い。Bundibugyo株は治療法・ワクチンがなく、接触者追跡率が70%と不十分で、隔離ベッド不足、子ども層の脆弱性（栄養不良）が指摘されており、管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: WCC reaffirms role of churches amid Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts the World Council of Churches (WCC) to reaffirm its role and urge urgent humanitarian access to Goma airport. The statement notes the outbreak is unfolding in conflict-affected, displaced communities with weak health systems and deep social mistrust, and calls Ebola containment to be treated as an immediate political priority in line with WHO guidance. It also urges full implementation of ceasefire commitments under the Washington Accords, warning that renewed violence and insecurity will undermine outbreak control, humanitarian access, and protection of vulnerable communities. The WCC executive committee is meeting online from June 8 to 12, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行中、WCCが教会の役割を改めて確認（コンゴ民主共和国）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR通知対象疾患であり、紛争地域での流行、脆弱な保健システム、国際的人道支援の必要性が記載されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当かつWPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月12日配信で将来日付を含むが、シグナルとしての重要性に変わりなし。紛争地域での流行であることが管理可能性を大きく低下させる重要なコンテキスト。WHO指針への言及あり。Goma空港への人道的アクセス確保が優先事項として強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: How a Utah company is aiding the fight against Ebola
article.articleSummary: BioFire Defense in Murray, Utah, has developed an FDA-approved 16-test diagnostic panel to rapidly detect Ebola and related tropical diseases, a project begun with the U.S. military after the 2014–2015 outbreaks. The panel can identify four Ebola strains that infect humans, plus one with potential human infectivity, including Bundibugyo—the strain driving current outbreaks in Africa. The test, run on a single blood sample, yields results in under an hour and helps clinicians differentiate Ebola from malaria and other causes of fever, enabling patient isolation, contact tracing, and targeted treatment. Sites evaluating the panel span Africa, Southeast Asia, and Central America, with manufacturing ramping up to meet demand amid Congo and Uganda outbreaks. As of June 10, Congo reports 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths; Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, plus 1 probable case and 1 probable death as of June 11. No U.S. cases; risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: ユタ州企業がエボラ対策を支援 - エボラとマラリア検出の診断パネルを開発
triage.triage_reason: DRCとウガンダでのエボラ集団発生（DRC: 676確認例、136死亡；ウガンダ: 19確認例、2死亡）により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められ、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はユタ州の企業による診断パネル開発であるが、サマリーは現在進行中のDRCとウガンダでのエボラ集団発生を背景として記述している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。DRCでの確認例676例、死亡136例という数字は、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的懸念を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola-Ausbruch weitet sich auf neue Gebiete im Nordosten des Kongo aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak spreads to new areas in northeastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading to new areas in the northeast, with the true scale larger than recorded. As of publication, 676 confirmed infections and 136 deaths are in DRC, while neighboring Uganda reports 19 infections (mostly returned Congolese nationals) and two deaths; Uganda’s situation is described as under control. The Ituri province serves as the outbreak’s epicenter. UNICEF warns of an anticipated rise in pediatric cases in coming weeks due to household transmission, noting that more than half of children under five in Ituri are chronically malnourished. Transmission occurs via direct contact with body fluids; the incubation period can be up to 21 days. The current epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo variant (first identified 2007), for which there is no vaccine or targeted therapy. Isolation capacity is 250 beds across affected provinces and is deemed insufficient; WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern in mid-May.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ北東部の新しい地域にエボラアウトブレイクが拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援必要性）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済みのエボラウイルス病の確認事例。
triage.notes: Ituri州が流行の中心地とされているが、Ituri州はDRCの一部であるため対象国リストでは203312（DRC）として列挙。ウガンダ（隣接国）での20例以上の確認例があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。WHOが2026年5月中旬にPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo変異体であり、ワクチンなし。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm as Ebola spreads into new areas of DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has spread to new areas in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, including the crowded Kpanga displacement camp in Ituri. Since the May 15 declaration, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths have been reported, with 32 recoveries; 119 cases are suspected. WHO warns local transmission in previously unaffected communities as response measures lag. Cases are identified in new health zones nearly daily, driven by high population mobility; isolation bed capacity is far below needs, and contact tracing remains insufficient despite improvement. “Blind spots” and unsafe camp conditions risk rapid spread. First Ebola-related deaths in Kpanga occurred May 31 and June 1. Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths, while AU health authorities say the situation there is under control.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congoのエボラ出血熱が新しい地域に拡大し警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国境越え事案であり、死亡者を伴う多数事例、急速な地理的拡大、及び国際的な対応能力不足が確認される重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内での拡大を主とし、ウガンダでの症例（19症例、2死亡）も言及されているが、ウガンダ（対象国リストに非含）への拡大の詳細は限定的であり、主要な発生地はDRC。隔離床不足、接触追跡の不十分さ、難民キャンプでの不衛生な条件等により、さらなる急速拡大リスクが高い。Bundibugyo株による発生は稀で、注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgınında son durum: 676 vaka, 136 ölü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest update on the Ebola outbreak in Congo: 676 cases, 136 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 676 Ebola cases and 136 deaths. In Ituri and North Kivu, 41 new confirmed cases were recorded, including 9 deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, affecting 29 districts across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in the eastern provinces. A weekly rise in confirmed cases indicates ongoing community transmission. Without rapid public health measures, the outbreak could spread geographically. In the three affected provinces, 5,768 contacts are being monitored, but contact tracing coverage is only 71.8%, below the 95% target, risking further transmission chains. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in the DRC; the outbreak declared on 15 May represents the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country since then.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行の最新情報：676症例、136人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目で該当。エボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体による確定事例の多発、高い致死率、複数地域への拡大、不十分な接触追跡による制御不能性が確認される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による深刻な流行。676症例、致死率20.1%。東部3州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）の29地域に影響。週単位での確定症例の増加傾向が継続的なコミュニティ感染を示唆。接触者追跡率71.8%は目標95%を大きく下回り、感染拡大のリスクが高い。2026年5月15日に宣言され、DRCでは1976年以来17番目のエボラ流行。迅速な公衆衛生対策がなければ地理的拡大のリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Davao City dengue cases drop by 61% in early 2026
article.articleSummary: First five months of 2026 saw dengue in Davao City drop 61.53% (644 cases) from 1,674 in 2025; dengue-related deaths fell 58.82% to 7, with two of the seven deaths attributed to leptospirosis rather than dengue. CHO Tropical Disease Prevention and Control Unit head Melodina Babante said the city has not reached an epidemic threshold. Of 182 barangays, 121 reported dengue; 20 areas are considered of concern due to clustering. Most cases are clustered in the third congressional district, with Marilog, Baguio, Calinan and Tugbok districts singled out; rainfall is noted as a driver. The decline is linked to City Ordinance No. 0401-20 (Mosquito-Borne Diseases Prevention and Control Program). CHO emphasizes waste segregation and ongoing disinfection of waste-accumulation areas along national highways Lasang to Boulevard, in response to landfill closure and waste-disposal disruptions. Dengue Awareness Month in June will sustain prevention efforts; community collaboration urged.

triage.headline_ja: ダバオ市のデング熱症例が2026年初期に61%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例が大幅に減少し、疫学閾値に達していない好ましい傾向を示している。異常性・緊急性が低く、国際的拡大リスクも明確でない。
triage.notes: 記事は改善傾向を報告しており、当局は対策の有効性を強調している。ダバオ市では疫学閾値に未到達で、管理下にある状況である。シグナルトリアージの観点からは公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaepidemia leviää uusille alueille Kongossa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak is spreading to new areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreading to new areas in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO warns that much more must be done to curb transmission, with isolation and treatment centers markedly fewer than needed; just over 70% of those exposed are currently under proper follow-up. The DRC has 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths, according to the latest WHO figures. UNICEF cautions that child infections may rise in coming weeks as transmission expands within households. In Ituri province, more than half of children under five suffer chronic malnutrition, increasing vulnerability to infection. The report notes ongoing outbreak dynamics with confirmed cases, and highlights gaps in surveillance and response capacity, including the need for stronger monitoring and public health measures to contain the spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国の新しい地域に拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認患者676名、死亡136名、地域的な拡大傾向、対応能力の不足が明記されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、コンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州を中心とした継続的なエボラ流行が確認されている。WHOおよびUNICEFから公式警告が発出されており、隔離・治療センターの不足、5歳未満児の栄養不良による脆弱性増加、世帯内感染の拡大リスクが指摘されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、verified_locationsに適切に記載。

article.articleHeadline: OMS revela que epidemia de ébola se extiende en el Congo; crecen contagios y decesos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Reveals That the Ebola Epidemic Is Spreading in the Congo; Infections and Deaths Are Rising.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) involves 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, linked to the Bundibugyo virus strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Most cases are in Ituri province (northeast), with transmission now reported in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, reflecting widespread movement and limited surveillance. WHO notes ongoing under-detection and highlights weak health systems and insecurity that complicate response, though the country has Ebola-management experience. Contact tracing is improving, with just over 70% of contacts traced. Surveillance, contact tracing, and testing capacity are being reinforced, especially in North Kivu. In neighboring Uganda, Africa CDC reported the Ebola outbreak there was under control as of May 15.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が発表：エボラ流行がコンゴで拡大、感染者と死亡者が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例676例、死亡136例で重症度が高く、国境を越えた拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも発生報告があるが、記事サマリーではウガンダの発生は「5月15日現在、制御下にある」と記載されており、主要な関心はDRCの東部での急速な拡大。Bundibugyo ウイルス株による流行で、ワクチン・承認治療法がない点が特に懸念材料。34の保健地域にわたる感染報告と不十分な監視体制から、さらなる拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading into new areas in northeast DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) caused by Bundibugyo strain is spreading to new areas. As of 12 June 2026, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with 119 suspected and 32 recovered. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyro. New health zones are reporting cases daily; strong population mobility and local transmission in additional areas. Contact tracing stands at about 70% of contacts traced, below ideal for control. Isolation capacity of 250 beds across affected provinces is insufficient and must be scaled up rapidly. UNICEF warns of rising pediatric cases via household transmission; in Ituri, over half of under-5 children are chronically malnourished. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda (19 cases, 2 deaths). WHO risk: very high in Congo, high for Uganda and neighboring countries, low elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ北東部の新地域に拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてにも該当。Bundibugyo株による活動的なエボラ感染症の国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、高い死亡率、不十分な対応能力を示しており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUganda（226074）が含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではウガンダは境界を越えた波及例（19例、2死亡）として報告されており、主たる発生地はDRCの北東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo株は承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、接触追跡率が70%と不十分、隔離能力が急速に不足している。小児患者の増加と栄養不良が重複している高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: कोझिकोड में निपाह निगरानी के तहत तीन लोग अस्पताल में भर्ती, अब तक कोई नया मामला नहीं
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people admitted to hospital under Nipah surveillance in Kozhikode; no new cases so far.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, three people in Kozhikode, Kerala, are hospitalized under Nipah virus surveillance with samples sent for testing; no new Nipah cases have been reported in the district. A National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) team will visit to review prevention measures. The patient currently receiving treatment has received the first dose of monoclonal antibody therapy per ICMR guidelines and medical board recommendations. A total of 87 contacts are under surveillance: 4 extremely high risk, 16 high risk, 67 low risk, with two daily phone checks. Preventive actions included a rapid survey of 286 households in Ramnattukara Nagar Palika Ward-5, identifying 12 fever cases but none with Nipah symptoms. An RRT meeting was held to review responses. A 43-year-old recently confirmed Nipah patient is hospitalized at Kozhikode Government Medical College and Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: コジコード市でニパールウイルス監視下に3人が入院、現在のところ新規症例なし
triage.triage_reason: ニパールウイルス感染症の確認症例と多数の接触者監視が発生しており、IHR基準で異常性・重症度が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当。インドの対象地域であり、シグナルとして適切。
triage.notes: ニパールウイルスは高い致死率を持つ人獣共通感染症。確認症例1名、接触者87名が監視下にあり、モノクローナル抗体療法が実施されている。NCDCチームによる予防策レビューが予定されており、公衆衛生当局の対応が活発。記事は2026年6月12日時点で新規症例未報告としているが、既存症例の重症度と接触者数から監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: சிவகங்கை மலேரியா இல்லாத மாவட்டமாகுமா? மத்திய குழு தீவிர ஆய்வு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Will Sivaganga become a malaria-free district? Central team conducts intensive study!
article.articleSummary: Sivaganga district in Tamil Nadu is being assessed for malaria-free status by a central health team. A first consultative meeting was held on 11 June 2026 at the District Collector’s Office with District Collector Ka. Poorkodi, as the team reviews malaria elimination efforts under the National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (2017–2026). A three‑day assessment runs 11–13 June 2026, with intensified surveys across government medical college hospital, government hospitals, primary health centers, sub-centers, private hospitals, and welfare centers. The expert panel includes Nishita Ranjan Das, Regional Coordinator, World Health Organization, Odisha; Dr Anju Viswan, Researcher, Indian Council of Medical Research, Odisha; Dr Sridharan Subramaniyan, Former Chief Entomologist, Tamil Nadu; and Dr Rekha Kumari, District Malaria Officer, Jharkhand. Findings will be reported to the central government, with Sivaganga administration and health department coordinating to expedite declaration of a malaria-free district.

triage.headline_ja: シバガンガ地区はマラリア撲滅地区になるのか？中央チームが集中的な調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: タミルナドゥ州シバガンガ地区のマラリア撲滅認定に向けた評価会議であり、新規の流行や急増ではなく、プログラム進捗確認の通常活動である。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常な事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア撲滅認定に向けた定期的な評価・監視活動（National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme の一環）を報じており、新規患者発生や流行の兆候ではない。WHOおよびインド医学研究評議会の専門家による実施であり、制度的な進捗確認である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : une Ong belge déploie la surveillance communautaire " One Health " pour stopper Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: a Belgian NGO deploys community surveillance "One Health" to stop Ebola - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, Ebola virus disease is being tackled in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo through an immediate deployment of VSF-B's community-based epidemiosurveillance grounded in a One Health approach. The system, active since 2022 around Kahuzi-Biega National Park, now forms the main defense as Ebola activity extends from Ituri and North Kivu into South Kivu. Human health is led by Médecins du Monde, while VSF-B coordinates animal health to intercept zoonoses before spillover. Early alerts come from a network of six private veterinarians and more than 176 Animal Health Community Agents, operating daily in schools, churches, markets, and cattle markets. Interventions include handwashing stations, hydroalcoholic solutions, PPE for workers, and radio-based awareness. The participatory model is cost-effective, community-accepted, and aimed at breaking recurrent health crises in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ベルギーのNGOがエボラ対策のため「ワンヘルス」コミュニティ監視を展開
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（高リスク病原体）がコンゴ民主共和国東部で流行中であり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）を複数満たす。また、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）も該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高いリスク病原体であり、複数省（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）への拡大が記録されている。ワンヘルスアプローチによる地域監視の展開は、状況が継続的に管理の必要性があることを示唆する。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、検証された発生地域はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Phòng, chống dịch bệnh trên vật nuôi và thủy sản mùa nắng nóng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevention and control of diseases in livestock and aquaculture during the hot season.
article.articleSummary: Phú Thọ province, Vietnam, intensifies prevention and control of animal diseases during hot season. With nearly 2 million pigs and poultry and over 36 million poultry, plus about 400,000 cattle and buffalo (including 18,600 dairy cows), farms implement hygiene, waste disposal, routine disinfection, vitamin and electrolyte supplementation, and access to clean water. To reduce heat stress, grazing is discouraged 10:00–16:00; shaded resting areas and cooling are provided. An ostrich farm with ~300 birds emphasizes cooling, shade, water, vitamins, and nutrition timing. In aquaculture, five fish cages require water-quality management, density control, and vitamin C and probiotics. Authorities stock vaccines and disinfectants: 1,000,000 poultry influenza vaccines; 60,000 FMD; 10,000 nodular dermatitis; 50,000 rabies vaccines; ~15,000 L disinfectants. Phú Thọ oversees 19,900 ha of aquaculture, 6,372 river cages, 68 centralized zones, and 24 VietGAP facilities. Three rounds of surveillance annually; first in 2026 sampled water (15) and fish (29). Growth targets: livestock >5%, aquaculture ~4.5%.

triage.headline_ja: 夏期の家畜および水産物における疾病予防・抑制
triage.triage_reason: 複数の動物疾病（インフルエンザ、口蹄疫、狂犬病）が言及されているが、記事は予防・管理措置の説明であり、実際の発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではない。情報が予防対策に限定されており、発生状況の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はフー・トー省での動物疾病の予防・管理措置に関する情報発信であり、実際のアウトブレイク報告ではない。狂犬病、口蹄疫、インフルエンザといった疫学的に重要な疾患が関連していることと、政府による積極的な動物衛生対策が実施されている点から経過観察が適当。ただし、発生状況の詳細情報が記事に含まれていないため、シグナルレベルの引き上げは現時点では困難。

article.articleHeadline: AHF: Ebola-Ausbruch macht deutlich, dass stärkere Investitionen in die Vorsorge erforderlich sind
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AHF: Ebola outbreak highlights the need for greater investments in preparedness.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-12, the AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF) urges greater investments in Ebola preparedness and response in Africa, citing the ongoing Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The appeal highlights the persistent threat of Ebola and the urgent need to strengthen public health systems across Africa. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no licensed vaccine, underscoring gaps in available prevention and control tools. AHF calls for sustained funding, enhanced surveillance, laboratory capacity, and rapid response to contain spread and protect populations. The report emphasizes continued transmission risk and the necessity of robust preparedness measures to prevent future outbreaks and mitigate impact.

triage.headline_ja: AHF：エボラ出血熱の流行は準備態勢への投資強化の必要性を浮き彫りにしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の流行は、深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の病原体亜種、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性を示しており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの流行を言及しているが、対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC, ID 203312）のみが含まれる。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブンディブギョ株は現在ライセンス取得済みワクチンがなく、対応能力への重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: AIDS Healthcare Foundation: AHF: Ebola-Ausbruch macht deutlich, dass stärkere Investitionen in die Vorsorge erforderlich sind
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AIDS Healthcare Foundation: AHF: The Ebola outbreak makes clear that greater investments in prevention are needed.
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda underscore the need for greater prevention investments, says AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF). The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or targeted treatment, highlighting ongoing vulnerabilities in detection, surveillance, community outreach, and access to essential medical supplies. AHF urges governments, donors, and global health bodies to prioritize preparedness now and for future outbreaks, including expanding regional access to personal protective equipment and laboratory supplies, improving reporting transparency by WHO and Africa CDC, and strengthening Africa CDC’s capacity to coordinate responses. The Foundation also calls for boosting local African production of health commodities—PSA, vaccines, medicines, and diagnostics—to reduce dependence on external suppliers and strengthen regional resilience. AHF serves over 3 million people in about 50 countries.

triage.headline_ja: AIDS Healthcare Foundation: エボラ出血熱の流行は、より強力な予防投資が必要であることを明確にしている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで確認されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「重症度」に該当。ワクチン・治療法がない高危険病原体であり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていません。記事サマリーでコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの両国でエボラ流行が述べられていますが、対象国はコンゴ民主共和国のみです。Bundibugyo株は2024年以降の新規流行であり、ワクチン・治療法の欠如が強調されています。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaepidemia leviää uusille alueille Kongossa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak spreads to new areas in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreads to new areas in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The World Health Organization warns that much more must be done to curb transmission, noting that isolation and treatment facilities are markedly insufficient for the current spread. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 676 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, with 136 deaths, according to WHO’s latest figures. UNICEF cautions that infections among children may rise in the coming weeks, highlighting the vulnerability of younger populations amid the expanding outbreak. Health authorities are urged to rapidly expand isolation facilities to match the outbreak's geographic spread. These steps are critical to prevent further transmission and protect vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴの新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準4項目以上に該当し、確認された死亡者と地理的拡大が認められることから、フルRRAへ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 2026年6月12日時点で676確認症例、136死亡が報告されており、コンゴ北東部への地理的拡大が進行中。WHO及びUNICEFが懸念を表明。隔離治療施設の不足が指摘されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Public health officers urge vigilance against disease outbreaks during rainy season
article.articleSummary: Public health officials in Ghana warn of heightened risk of cholera, malaria and other communicable diseases as heavy rains and flooding affect several communities. Floodwaters can contaminate water sources with human waste and pollutants, raising the threat of water-borne, water-based and water-related diseases; officials urged improved sanitation and hygiene to prevent outbreaks. GAPHTO president Joseph Owusu Asante cautioned that floods increase disease transmission and emphasized the need for rapid detection and response, including stronger disease surveillance by officers at communities, health facilities and points of entry; he noted the system currently screens for imported infections such as Ebola and mpox, but more personnel are needed. Kwahu East District Director of Health Services Angela Acheampomaa urged thorough washing of fruits/vegetables, regular handwashing and proper waste disposal, and seeking medical care for vomiting or diarrhoea. Public health communication and surveillance are critical during the rainy season, amid misinformation on social media.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生局が雨期中の疾病流行に対する警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ガーナにおける複数の水系感染症（コレラ、マラリア、エボラ、エムポックス）に関する警告記事。異常・予想外性と長期曝露リスクが認められるが、現段階では具体的な症例報告や死亡例の記載がなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察に分類。
triage.notes: 記事は警告的性質であり、確定症例の報告ではなく雨期の予防啓発が主題。ガーナの保健当局が複数の疾患（コレラ、マラリア、エボラ、エムポックス）に対する警戒を呼びかけている。洪水による水系感染症リスクの増加、人材不足、ソーシャルメディアでのミスインフォメーション対策が課題として言及されている。現在の症例数や重症度については具体的情報が記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola u Kongu: WHO upozorava na širenje, 676 slučajeva i 136 mrtvih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: WHO warns of spread, 676 cases and 136 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Ebola in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths. The outbreak remains concentrated in Ituri Province but has been detected in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with new zones identified daily. Uncertainty, population movement, and limited surveillance suggest the true burden is higher. WHO and Congolese authorities have identified 17 hotspot areas for intensified support and monitoring, while several high-risk locations have not yet reported cases. Core control measures include safe burials, infection prevention in health facilities, early detection, contact tracing, and community engagement. Despite challenges—weak health systems and displacement—WHO is strengthening surveillance, laboratory capacity, logistics, clinical care, and risk communication to bolster the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ：WHOが感染拡大を警告、676例、136名が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。エボラウイルスによる複数州での蔓延と死亡者数から、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極度の危険性を有する。記事は2026年6月時点で676確定例、136死亡を報告。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州の34ヘルスゾーンに拡大。WHOが17のホットスポット地域を特定し、強化支援を実施中。弱い保健システムと人口移動が対応を阻害している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Η επιδημία εξακολουθεί να εξαπλώνεται στη ΛΔ Κονγκό, προειδοποίησε ο ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The outbreak continues to spread in the DRC, the WHO warned.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to expand, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of June 11, 2026. Most cases are in Ituri Province, and the disease has spread to 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. There is no vaccine or approved therapy. WHO warns of numerous blind spots, indicating the outbreak may be larger than current counts due to population mobility. Response challenges include weakened health systems and security gaps; emphasis remains on strengthening experienced staff and capacities, surveillance, and contact tracing. Reported improvements show just over 70% of contacts traced. Essential measures include safe and dignified burials, reducing infection risk in health facilities, rapid identification, isolation and treatment of patients, and enhanced community engagement. Africa CDC notes Uganda’s nearby outbreak (May 15) is under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国で拡大し続けており、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な死亡・患者数、既知の流行地域での異常な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性）。WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイク。676例の確定患者と136名の死亡が報告されており、複数県（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）34保健地区に拡大。WHO警告における「ブラインドスポット」により実数はさらに大きい可能性。ウガンダでの小規模アウトブレイク（5月15日）も報告されているが、記事サマリー上では主たる発生地はDRCである。対象国リストに含まれるウガンダ（1269750）については、サマリー上では「nearby outbreak...under control」と述べられており、DRCの継続的拡大が主題であるため、verified_locationsではDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola s'étend sur fond d'insécurité et de suivi insuffisant des contacts (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak is spreading amid insecurity and insufficient contact tracing (General Feature).
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak, Bundibugyo strain, continues to spread. On 12 June 2026, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; 41 new cases and 9 deaths were reported the prior day. The epidemic now covers 29 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Authorities warn that weak contact tracing, insecurity, and funding gaps hinder containment and may drive geographic expansion. CDC Africa's Jean Kaseya notes health zones grew from 3 at declaration to 27 in ten days. Ituri accounts for about 600 confirmed cases; an estimated 24,000 contacts exist, but roughly 5,000 are listed and only a fraction actively followed. Some confirmed cases remain outside treatment centers. This is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in Africa by confirmed cases and the second in DRC caused by Bundibugyo. WHO maintains the DRC risk as very high; Uganda reports imported/linked cases, with no documented community transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：不安全と不十分な接触者追跡に伴い、エボラ出血熱流行が拡大（総合特集）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の広域流行で676確認患者・136死亡、接触者追跡の崩壊、国家間の感染例、及び地理的拡大のリスク要因が複数存在。IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常/予想外・国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行易感性・管理可能性の問題が明白。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは輸入症例/関連症例のみで主題ではなく、コミュニティ伝播は確認されていないため、verified_locationsではDRCのみに限定。これはアフリカで3番目に大きいエボラ出血熱流行（確認患者数）で、接触者追跡の崩壊（推定24,000人中5,000人のみ登録、さらに一部のみ追跡）と資金不足は非常に深刻な管理課題。WHOはDRCのリスク評価を「非常に高い」と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Acre está em alerta para aumento de casos graves de síndrome respiratória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre is on alert for an increase in severe respiratory syndrome cases
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) alert in Acre, Brazil, based on Fiocruz InfoGripe covering May 31–June 6, 2026. Acre ranks among 11 states with SRAG incidence at alert/risk/high risk and a growing trend; Rio Branco, the capital, is among 10 capitals with sustained case increases. Growth is greatest among children under 2 and adolescents up to 14, with rising hospitalizations among the elderly in Rio Branco. Despite signals of plateauing or slower growth for SRAG linked to Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), hospitalizations remain elevated; RSV remains the main driver of severe cases in young children nationwide. Increases in hospitalizations due to influenza A and B are noted across regions. Preventive measures recommended: hand hygiene, masking in health facilities and crowded indoor spaces, and isolating symptomatic individuals. Nationally, 2026 SRAG reports exceed 82,500 cases, with nearly half lab-confirmed; last 4 weeks show RSV 49.6%, rhinovirus 24.5%, influenza A 20.7%.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのアクレ州、呼吸器症候群の重症例の増加に警戒
triage.triage_reason: RSVとインフルエンザA型による重症急性呼吸器感染症(SRAG)の増加が報告されており、IHR基準では「異常/予想外」が該当するが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクは現時点では明確でない。情報が限定的であり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象外地域だが、RSVとインフルエンザA型による重症呼吸器感染症の増加傾向が記事の主要な医学的内容。2026年全国で82,500件以上のSRAG報告があり、実質的な感染症発生状況と判断される。対象国リストに含まれていないため、フルRRA対象外だが、継続監視の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola se espalha pelo Congo e tem 'escala muito maior', diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads across the Congo and is on a much larger scale, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo variant (no licensed vaccines or treatments), has reached 676 confirmed cases and 136 fatalities, with 119 suspected and 32 recoveries. The outbreak center remains Ituri province in the northeast, but new cases have been reported in North Kivu and South Kivu, with transmission spreading to new health zones almost daily. Community transmission is increasingly driving spread, challenging contact tracing (just over 70% of contacts monitored). Isolation capacity is limited, with about 250 beds available across affected provinces, below projected needs. UNICEF warns potential rises in pediatric cases amid widespread malnutrition in under-5s in Ituri. Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. WHO classifies very high risk in DRC, high in Uganda and neighbors. Rapidly scale surveillance, diagnostics, isolation, PPE, and community engagement to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ全域に拡大し、「非常に大規模」と WHO が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数国での確認と高い致死率、地域感染拡大の進行、国際的支援ニーズが明確。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（226074）も記載されており、ウガンダで19確認例と2死亡例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国（203312）に含まれるため記載。Bundibugyo variant でワクチン・治療法なし、致死率約20%、急速な地域感染拡大、隔離施設不足等から国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rikkoutunut arkku ja pastorin hautajaiset - näin ebola saattoi alkaa levitä Kongossa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Broken Coffin and the Pastor's Funeral — This Is How Ebola May Have Begun to Spread in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province is under investigation to identify the earliest known infection (patient zero), centering on February death of Pastor Paluku Makundi Denis, 44, in Bunia. He was treated for infection but not tested for Ebola due to lack of outbreak awareness. His body was transported by pickup along a rough road to Mongbwalu mining town; the coffin broke, the body was moved to a new coffin, and several relatives touched it. The funeral drew dozens of attendees and is considered a high-risk contact event that could be among the earliest superspreading events. In the days and weeks that followed, Mongbwalu reported rapidly increasing illnesses. A May 21, 2026 photo caption shows Ebola-related body preparation at Rwamparan hospital, underscoring ongoing transmission in the region, with nearly 50 deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: 破損した棺と牧師の葬儀—エボラがコンゴで拡大し始めた経緯
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。エボラウイルス病の公式な流行であり、患者ゼロの追跡、高リスク接触イベント、複数死亡報告があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年6月12日付であるが、イベント自体は2026年2月に開始。Ituri州Bunia市およびMongbwalu鉱山町でのエボラ流行に関する調査報道。患者ゼロの特定、葬儀を介した超拡散イベント、複数死亡（約50名）が報告されている。DRC以外の国からの具体的な拡大報告はサマリーに記載されていないが、国際的拡大リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. مخاوف من انتشار إيبولا بمخيم نازحين بعد وفاة حالتين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo: Fears of an Ebola outbreak in a refugee camp after two deaths.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related deaths were confirmed among internally displaced people at the Kabanjba refugee camp in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, which hosts about 30,000 refugees. The outbreak has spread to three provinces—Ituri, South Kivu, and North Kivu—since WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. As of Friday, June 12, 2026, the DRC has 676 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases. The two fatalities occurred May 31 and June 1 and were tested for Ebola post-mortem by WHO. Relief workers warn of rapid transmission risk in crowded camps with weak public health infrastructure—tents with fabric walls, shared toilets, and open defecation. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Isolation capacity is under 250 beds across the three affected provinces; data gaps exist, and no final epidemic size estimates have been issued. The outbreak had previously remained unmonitored for weeks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：国内避難民キャンプでの2人の死亡後、エボラ感染拡大の懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の公式PHEC（2026年5月17日WHO宣言）。DRC 676確認例136死亡、ウガンダ19例。避難民キャンプでの集団発生リスク高い。Bundibugyo株で承認治療法・ワクチンなし。隔離収容能力250床以下と極めて限定的。ウガンダも発症例報告あるが、記事の主題・状況描写はDRC中心のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: BSL-3 lab in Kozhikode set to strengthen Nipah virus detection
article.articleSummary: BSL-3 laboratory at Government Medical College Hospital (MCH), Kozhikode, Kerala, India, is nearing completion and could become operational within a couple of months as of 12 June 2026. Supported by the ICMR, the ₹8 crore facility aims to bolster Kerala’s diagnostic self-reliance and enable early detection of high-consequence pathogens such as Nipah virus, which was linked to the Kozhikode Nipah outbreak in 2018. Until now, handling of highly infectious pathogens occurs at the hospital’s BSL-2 lab; the new unit includes advanced biosafety infrastructure, specialised air-handling and filtration systems, and a double-door autoclave for sterilisation. Confirmatory testing for highly infectious pathogens will remain in Pune at NIV, under existing ICMR protocols. The project, mooted after the 2018 Nipah outbreak, faced COVID-19 lockdown delays and began in November 2021, with commissioning anticipated soon.

triage.headline_ja: コジコード(Kozhikode)のBSL-3ラボがニパウイルス検出能力の強化に向け完成間近
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスという高い危険性を持つ病原体に関連する施設開設の記事だが、実際の新規発生事例ではなく、既存の2018年アウトブレイク後の診断施設の強化プロジェクトであり、現時点での即応的な公衆衛生上の脅威は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は新規のニパウイルス感染事例ではなく、2018年のコジコード・ニパアウトブレイク後の診断施設強化事業の進捗報告。実際の現在進行形の疾病流行を示唆するシグナルではないが、高リスク病原体(Nipah)に関連する施設整備という点でICMR等政府機関の対応として関心を持つ価値あり。ニパウイルスの現在の流行状況については記事内で明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 2 infants in Hong Kong confirmed severely infected with Covid just days apart
article.articleSummary: Two unvaccinated infants in Hong Kong have been confirmed severely infected with Covid-19 within days of each other. A one-year-old boy remains in critical condition after developing fever, cough and runny nose on June 2, with stridor the next day; he was admitted to Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital on June 4 and later transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit at Prince of Wales Hospital for severe croup. The second infant was also severely infected within a week. Both children were previously healthy and unvaccinated. The Centre for Health Protection urged unvaccinated high-risk groups to vaccinate and warned that overall Covid-19 activity could rise in the next one to two months. The first child’s diagnosis is Covid-19 complicated by croup.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の2人の乳幼児がわずか数日の間にCOVID-19に重症感染と確認
triage.triage_reason: 香港での限局的な小児COVID-19重症事例の報告。IHR基準は1つ以下だが、WPROスクリーニング基準で「重症度」「異常性」に該当する可能性があり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 香港での報告であり、Chinaに含める。2件の重症小児事例は異常（乳幼児の重症化）だが、地域限定的で国際的拡大の証拠がない。ワクチン未接種者への警告が発せられているが、流行拡大の確実な兆候ではなく、情報が限定的であるためWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS y UNICEF alertan de que el Ebola en la RDC es peor de lo que dicen las cifras oficiales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and UNICEF warn that the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is worse than official figures indicate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to expand, with 676 lab-confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of June 10, 2026, though WHO and UNICEF warn the true scale is likely higher. The epidemic now affects 34 health zones, indicating substantial geographic spread in a country with fragile health infrastructure. Access barriers and distrust of health teams hinder early detection of new infections. There is a real risk of a humanitarian crisis, echoing the 2018–2020 outbreak that claimed over 2,200 lives. Vaccination and epidemiological surveillance have intensified, but resources remain insufficient. International calls for increased financial and logistical support persist. The spread also threatens neighboring countries, with Rwanda and Uganda tightening border controls. WHO maintains a high alert and has deployed emergency teams to the most affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとUNICEFがDRCのエボラ出血熱は公式統計よりも深刻と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。対象国DRCで実際の発生を確認。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極度に高リスクな病原体。記事では676確認例、136死亡（致死率20.1%）、34の保健ゾーン拡大を報告。公式統計より実数が高い可能性を WHO/UNICEF が明示。ワクチン接種と疫学監視が強化されているも資源不足。隣国（ルワンダ、ウガンダ）も警戒体制に入っている。WHOが高い警戒レベル維持。RwandaとUgandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: O que se sabe até agora sobre o caso suspeito de ebola investigado no RS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known so far about the suspected Ebola case being investigated in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: 64-year-old man in Novo Hamburgo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, is under investigation for Ebola-compatible symptoms after recent travel to Uganda, where Ebola outbreaks have drawn WHO attention. Malaria is diagnosed, positive for Plasmodium falciparum; definitive confirmation awaits Fiocruz, the national reference lab. The patient will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre for specialized care, with samples sent for laboratory analysis. GHC is a regional reference site for Ebola but does not house full treatment capacity; Adolfo Lutz (São Paulo) and Evandro Chagas (Rio de Janeiro) are the main labs for high-containment testing. Surveillance, isolation, and biosafety measures are in place, and contacts will be monitored. No immediate public danger is indicated. Ebola Zaire has a vaccine; Bundibugyo currently does not.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスル州で調査中の疑似エボラ症例について現在までに分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。ウガンダからの輸入リスクのあるエボラ疑似症例であり、公式な確認待ちの段階だが、複数の対象国に関連し、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ疑似症例であり、ウガンダへの渡航歴があり、ウガンダではWHO注視下のエボラ流行が報告されている。マラリア（Plasmodium falciparum）は既に確認されているが、エボラの確定診断はFiocruz（国家基準研究所）による検査待ち。患者は隔離措置下にあり、接触者の監視が実施されている。記事ではウガンダでのエボラ流行が言及されているが、サマリーの主題はブラジルでの疑似症例であり、verified_locationsはBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'UNICEF redoute une hausse des cas chez les enfants alors que l'épidémie s'étend
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: UNICEF fears a rise in cases among children as the outbreak spreads.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu). Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; DRC records 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths. UNICEF warns that household transmission could rise, risking more infections among children as the outbreak advances, with Bunia in Ituri as an epicenter. The World Health Organization notes most cases are in Ituri but new cases have appeared across 34 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, from Aru to Miti Murrhesa, spanning over 1,000 km. Contact tracing is just over 70% complete; a laboratory in Beni now processes more than 500 tests per day to better define outbreak size. Early pediatric diagnosis is hard due to malaria-like symptoms. UNICEF surveys reveal knowledge gaps: ~two-thirds of youths don’t know transmission routes, and one in five doubt Ebola’s existence. Some 1,600+ community health workers have been deployed; the response aims to reach 3.7 million people.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：流行が拡大する中、ユニセフが子どもの症例増加を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を持ち、DRCで676確定患者136死亡、ウガンダで19確定患者2死亡の多国家間の越境発生であり、国際的拡大と渡航制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの19確定患者が言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCの流行（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）であり、ウガンダは越境への懸念として参照されているのみ。対象国リストにUgandaが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株エボラの大規模流行で、コンタクトトレーシング70%完了、1,600以上のコミュニティヘルスワーカー展開、3.7百万人への到達を目指す対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm as Ebola spreads into new areas of DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola has spread to new areas in north-eastern DR Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu), including a crowded displacement camp, signaling a potentially larger outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain. Since the outbreak was declared May 15, WHO data show 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with 32 recoveries. A further 119 suspected cases are under investigation as the virus expands to new health zones nearly daily. Olivier le Polain, WHO head of epidemiology, said cases in new areas reflect the outbreak's scale and high population mobility; isolation bed capacity is far below anticipated needs. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibuggyo; authorities warn of local transmission and blind spots as response lags.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴの新たな地域へエボラが拡大する懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（676確認例・136死亡）、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク等複数該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度高、流行しやすさ高、管理可能性低。社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の拡大事案。複数地域（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）への拡大、難民キャンプを含む混雑地域への波及、確認例676・死亡136と重大な被害。ワクチン・治療法がなく、対応能力が不足している状況。WHOの懸念も明記されている。フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan hospital units on standby as part of Ebola emergency preparedness plan
article.articleSummary: Kenya tightens Ebola preparedness as outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, though no cases have been detected in Kenya. At Kenyatta National Hospital in Nairobi, staff have been trained to recognize and safely manage potential Ebola patients. The hospital maintains eight isolation rooms and operates a stand-alone infectious-disease isolation unit; other facilities can activate internal spaces to isolate cases as needed. Border entry measures include quarantine plans for travellers from affected regions. Kenya is preparing to quarantine Americans arriving from the DRC at a military air base, a move that sparked protests and one death. DR Congo reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; Uganda has 19 cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの病院がエボラ緊急対応計画の一環として待機態勢を敷く
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疾患であり国際的関心は高いが、記事の主題はケニアにおける準備体制であり、実際の患者発生ではない。DRCとウガンダでの発生は確認されているが、ケニアではまだ患者がいない状況。情報が限定的であり、フルRRA判定には続報が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはナイロビ（ケニア）、ウガンダ、米国が含まれているが、記事サマリーを精読すると、実際のエボラ発生は DRC と Uganda に限定されており、ケニアは準備体制段階である。対象国リストに照合すると、DRC のみが該当。ケニアは対象国外であるため verified_locations に含めない。IHR基準は2つ該当（国際的拡大リスク＋渡航制限リスク）するが、直接的な患者発生報告がケニアにはないため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من استمرار تفشي إيبولا في شرق الكونغو الديموقراطية - تيل كيل عربي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo - Tel Kil Arabic
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths have been reported in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as of Thursday, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Most infections are concentrated in Ituri Province, with additional cases in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The World Health Organization notes near-daily reports of new health zones, signaling a larger outbreak than previously seen. Health systems and security remain weak, complicating response efforts, though the DRC has substantial Ebola experience in affected areas. The response should prioritize building capacity and experienced staff, acknowledging remaining gaps in high-risk regions. Improvements are expected through strengthened surveillance, contact tracing, and testing, particularly in North Kivu’s Beni region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国東部におけるエボラ出血熱の流行継続に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当、WHOによる公式警告と確認例の継続報告。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるエボラ出血熱流行。676確認例、136死亡。ワクチンおよび承認治療法が存在しない株。主にIturi州に集中するも、34の保健地区で報告。WHOは過去の流行規模を上回る可能性を指摘。セキュリティと保健システムの脆弱性が対応を複雑化。South Kivu Provinceは発生地域に記載されているが、サマリーではIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu全体で言及されており、DRC全体での確認。

article.articleHeadline: EUA, Canadá e México, as sedes da Copa, lideram casos de sarampo nas Américas, despertando alerta global
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USA, Canada and Mexico, the World Cup hosts, top measles cases in the Americas, triggering a global alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks surge in the Americas as USA, Canada and Mexico—hosts of the FIFA World Cup—account for about 95% of 2024–2025 cases, totaling roughly 14,106 infections out of nearly 15,000 reported. The Pan American Health Organization notes a 32-fold rise in cases compared with 2024. Brazil reported 38 outbreaks, all linked to international travel, raising concerns about exportation as global event brings visitors. WHO warns measles is highly contagious via airborne droplets, with flu-like symptoms and eventual rash; fatal complications occur, with 95,000 deaths globally in 2024. Vaccination with the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine is crucial; Brazil’s SUS provides two doses free from early childhood. In Brazil, first-dose coverage is ~92%, second-dose ~78%, far from the 95% target; globally, only about 84% of those due were vaccinated with the first dose in 2024. The campaign urges travelers to verify vaccination status before travel.

triage.headline_ja: USA、カナダ、メキシコ（ワールドカップ開催国）が南米での麻疹患者数を主導し、世界的警報を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。2024-2025年に約14,106件の麻疹患者が報告され、USA・カナダ・メキシコが全体の95%を占める。ワールドカップ開催に伴う国際的渡航増加に伴う感染拡大リスクが極めて高く、WHO/PAHO双方が警告を発出している。
triage.notes: 記事はUSA・カナダ・メキシコでの麻疹流行を主題としているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていない。ただしブラジルは記事内で38件の麻疹アウトブレイクが国際旅行由来で報告されており、記事の主要な関心地域として明示されている。ワールドカップ開催に伴う国際的渡航増加とそれに伴う感染輸入リスクが強調されており、WPRO地域における実質的な脅威と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola se espalha para campo de refugiados que abriga 30 mil pessoas no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads to refugee camp housing 30,000 people in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak reaches the Kpangba refugee camp in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, housing about 30,000 displaced people. First Ebola-related deaths confirmed at the camp: a 60-year-old woman and her daughter; the mother tested positive on 30 May, left quarantine before surveillance could reach her, and died the next day; the daughter died on 1 June. At least eight close contacts identified. Residents attacked World Health Organization vehicles, complicating response amid mistrust and unsafe funeral practices. Since WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May, the Congo outbreak has spread to three provinces. By 12 June 2026, the country reports 676 cases and 136 deaths, with the outbreak crossing the border into Uganda, where 19 infections have been recorded. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no vaccine or treatment is approved, and circulation is thought to have gone undetected for weeks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイクがコンゴの3万人を収容する難民キャンプに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境）、高い致死率、ワクチン/治療法未承認のBundibugyo型、難民キャンプという広範な集団曝露環境により、公衆衛生上の重大な危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダへの越境も言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus はまれな型であり、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないことが懸念される。難民キャンプでの衛生慣行の問題（安全でない埋葬慣行、WHO車両への攻撃による対応阻害）が管理性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Cepheid Delivers Xpert® Hemorrhagic Fever Panel Tests to Africa to Address Diagnostic Gaps in Ebola Bundibugyo Outbreak
article.articleSummary: June 12, 2026 — Cepheid donated an initial shipment of Xpert Hemorrhagic Fever panel tests to support diagnostic response to the Ebola Bundibugyo (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, following the WHO's May 17, 2026 Public Health Emergency of International Concern declaration. The first shipment arrived in the DRC; Cepheid aims to accelerate production in coordination with the U.S. government, WHO, Africa CDC, in-country health ministries, and partners to deploy quickly under regulatory and public health coordination. The panel, FDA 510(k) cleared for DoD, detects Ebola virus including Bundibugyo, plus Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus, Marburg virus, and Lassa virus, with about one hour to result, on Cepheid's GeneXpert systems. A broad installed base in DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda supports decentralized testing and rapid isolation, treatment, and outbreak control through public-private collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: セフェイド、アフリカにおけるエボラ・ブンディブギョ流行の診断ギャップに対応するため、Xpert®出血熱パネル検査をアフリカに提供
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ型）の流行がDRC・ウガンダで確認され、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。複数の対象国での感染症イベント、高い重症度、国際的な対応が示唆され、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ流行を言及しているが、サマリー上の主要な発生地域はDRC。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが対象国リストに非該当のため除外。南スーダン・ルワンダは検査配備地として言及されるのみで、実際の流行地ではないため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により国際的な関心が極度に高く、複数の出血熱ウイルス（ラッサ熱、マールブルグ病、CCHF）の同時検出能力を持つ診断ツール配備という内容から、明らかにシグナルとして識別すべきイベント。

article.articleHeadline: Масштаб вспышки Эболы в ДР Конго значительно превышает официальные данные, считают в ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The scale of the Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo significantly exceeds official figures, according to WHO.
article.articleSummary: WHO epidemiology and emergency response chief Olivier le Pollen said on June 12, 2026, that the true scale of the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is far larger than official figures. Since the outbreak began on May 15, official counts report 136 deaths among 676 infections, while daily case detection continues and geographic spread expands, with incomplete data in several affected districts. Hospital bed capacity is severely limited, with only about 250 beds available for Ebola patients across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with patients kept in dedicated Ebola treatment centers or medical isolation wards. CDC projections cited by WHO suggest the outbreak could reach the scale of the 2013–2016 epidemic or exceed it, potentially involving tens of thousands of cases: around 30,000 infections and 11,300 deaths in that earlier period. Current risk assessments indicate the 2014 outbreak level could be surpassed.

triage.headline_ja: ＤＲコンゴのエボラ感染者数が公表数字を大幅に上回る可能性、WHO指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の大規模発生で、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。官報値を大幅に上回る実感染者数、病床容量の深刻な不足、国際拡大リスク、WHOによる警告が存在する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日開始の東部DRコンゴエボラアウトブレーク。公式死者数136名/感染676名だが実数はこれを大幅に上回る可能性。2013-2016年の大流行（約30,000感染、11,300死）規模またはそれ以上に達する可能性があるとWHOが警告。Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivuで発生。医療施設の病床不足（約250床）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Ένα σπασμένο φέρετρο και μια κηδεία στο μικροσκόπιο των ερευνητών
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: A broken coffin and a funeral under the researchers' microscope.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, dominates an epidemiological inquiry in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo after a broken coffin during the February funeral of Pastor Paluku Makundi Denis. Transport from Bunia morgue to Mongbwalu, in a worn Nissan SUV, involved relatives touching the coffin, contributing to its break; a hastily prepared second coffin drew over 80 mourners to the cemetery. Within days, dozens exhibited symptoms and, in two weeks, almost 50 deaths were recorded, fueling transmission rumors and community fear tied to curses. Public health teams urge cooperation to curb spread. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% fatality rate. The pastor, diagnosed with peritonitis, was a suspected Ebola case but not laboratory-confirmed. As of now, roughly 635 cases and at least 127 deaths have been reported in the eastern Congo region, underscoring a critical outbreak and the need for rapid public health intervention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: 破損した棺と研究者の顕微鏡下の葬儀
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の集団発生が東部DRCで報告され、635例以上・127例以上の死亡が記録されている。IHR基準4項目全て該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラウイルス病による大規模集団発生。葬儀を通じた家族接触による急速な伝播が確認され、死亡率30～50%の高い病原体による集団発生である。DRC東部（Bunia, Mongbwalu地域）での発生が報告されている。国際支援と緊急公衆衛生介入が必要。

article.articleHeadline: TN tightens Nipah surveillance; fever clusters on radar | Chennai News
article.articleSummary: Nipah surveillance in Tamil Nadu tightens after a Nipah case was reported in Kerala. The Directorate of Public Health directs officials to closely monitor fever cases at primary health centers and government hospitals statewide for clustering, with heightened attention to districts bordering Kerala. 13 border check posts are intensified, including Udumalaipet and Walayar, to detect suspected cases and initiate containment. Tamil Nadu reports no Nipah cases so far. Nipah is a zoonotic virus with a 6–21 day incubation; common symptoms include fever, respiratory distress, cough, vomiting, muscle pain, seizures and encephalitis. Authorities will monitor Acute Encephalitis Syndrome cases, particularly those with fever and altered mental status or recent travel/contact with infected individuals. Hospitals must report suspected cases immediately; Nipah is not as easily transmitted as respiratory infections, so panic is unwarranted.

triage.headline_ja: タミルナドゥ州がニパウイルス監視を強化、発熱クラスターが注視対象に
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスはケララ州で確認され、タミルナドゥ州でも監視体制が強化されている。ニパウイルスは高い致命率を持つ重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数州での監視と国境検査所の強化が実施されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはケララ州で症例が報告され、タミルナドゥ州でも多州にまたがる監視体制が整備されている。記事では発熱クラスター監視、13の国境検査所強化、急性脳炎症候群(AES)ケースの監視が記載されており、複数州での統合的な対応が進行中。タミルナドゥ州では現在のところ確認症例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола се разраства, пламнаха нови огнища
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is spreading, new outbreaks have flared up.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread, with new outbreaks in additional zones. As of 2026-06-11, 676 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, including 136 fatalities. While most cases remain in Ituri Province, local transmission has now been recorded in North Kivu, and new health zones are reporting cases almost daily. The WHO notes the full scale remains unclear amid conflict, displacement, and a weak health system, leaving blind spots in high-risk areas. UNICEF warns that families avoid routine hospital visits for sick children due to fear of infection, raising the risk of preventable deaths; more than half of children under five in Ituri are malnourished, increasing vulnerability. The situation points to expanding outbreaks requiring strengthened surveillance, contact tracing, and health-system support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が拡大、新たな集団感染が発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地理的拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体の活動的な流行であり、即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最優先度の感染症。確認症例676名、死亡136名（致死率約20%）。Ituri州での流行が主であるが、North Kivu州への拡大が確認されている。紛争、人口移動、脆弱な医療体制が状況を複雑化させている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue sigue en aumento en Colombia: más de 46 mil casos reportados en 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever continues to rise in Colombia: more than 46,000 cases reported in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Colombia reaches 46,146 cases by June 2, 2026, with 38.8% displaying warning signs and 1.2% classified as severe. There are 17,925 hospitalizations and 54 dengue-related deaths (31 confirmed, 23 under investigation). The highest case counts are in Meta (7,276); Bolívar and Cartagena (5,680); Magdalena and Santa Marta (4,545); Cesar (3,987); and Santander (3,082). The Caribbean region shows the largest increases vs. 2025, led by Magdalena (+413%), Cesar (+214%), Amazonas (+128%), Bolívar (+75%), and La Guajira (+43%). Children aged 0–19 years account for about 64% of cases (29,574). El Niño–related warming may favor Aedes aegypti transmission, underscoring the need for vector control, repellents, home barriers, and prompt health care for warning symptoms, with reinforced prevention into the second half of the year.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビアのデング熱、2026年に46,000件以上の症例が報告され、引き続き増加中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において重症度（38.8%に警告兆候、1.2%重症、54死亡）と国際的拡大リスク（ブラジルへの地理的近接性）が該当。WPRO基準では異常性、重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさが複数該当し、同時に社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した発生地域にはコロンビア（対象国リストに未含）の複数の州が含まれており、記事サマリーでも詳細に言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジル（3469034）のみであるため verified_locations に含める。コロンビアでの大規模デング熱流行は国際的な関心事項であり、隣接するブラジルへの拡大リスクが存在する。64%が子ども・青少年で、El Niño関連の温暖化により蚊の伝播が促進される可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in aumento nella RDC minaccia gorilla in pericolo critico di estinzione.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola on the rise in the DRC threatens a critically endangered gorilla.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak announced in May 2026 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with no detected Ebola infections in gorillas to date. Prior epidemics devastated western lowland gorilla populations; ongoing armed conflict in the DRC hampers conservation and monitoring of Grauer's and mountain gorillas, complicating public health responses. The World Health Organization has characterized the DRC outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC); Ebola has flared in DRC at least 17 times in the last half-century. U.S. CDC reports 676 Ebola cases and 136 deaths in eastern DRC as of 10 June, with Uganda reporting 19 cases and 2 deaths, though the outbreak there appears largely contained. The situation highlights risks to endangered gorilla populations amid concerns of spillover and reflects broader challenges posed by conflict and funding shifts in the U.S. administration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが増加、絶滅危機のゴリラを脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、異常な事態）。WHO PHEIC指定済み。DRC東部で676例、死亡136例、ウガンダで19例2死亡の確認。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUSAとウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRC東部の新規アウトブレイク。ウガンダの19例2死亡は記載されているがDRCが主要発生地。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。WHO PHEIC指定、DRC内での武装紛争による対応困難性あり。ゴリラなどの野生動物への影響も並記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Intensified efforts needed to halt leprosy transmission in endemic districts: Health ministry official
article.articleSummary: India eliminated leprosy as a national public health problem over two decades ago, but intensified efforts are needed in endemic districts to halt transmission, a health ministry official said at a regional workshop in Nava Raipur, Chhattisgarh. Additional Secretary Aradhana Patnaik urged periodic case detection, strengthened contact tracing, and expansion of post-exposure prophylaxis with single-dose rifampicin among eligible contacts. Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha and Madhya Pradesh together account for nearly half of India's leprosy cases, with several districts above 1 per 10,000. Deputy Director General (Leprosy) Dr Sunil V Gitte reported 91,783 new cases in 2025-26, prevalence 0.56 per 10,000; 4.18% were children and 2.12% had Grade-2 disability at diagnosis. Disability prevention and rehabilitation included 1,591 reconstructive surgeries, over 1.03 lakh micro cellular rubber footwear, and over 1.25 lakh self-care kits. The workshop focused on high-prevalence districts, more child cases, and Grade-2 disability.

triage.headline_ja: 風土病地域でのハンセン病感染を止めるために強化された取り組みが必要：保健省幹部
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は予防可能・治療可能な疾患であり、インドは20年以上前に公衆衛生上の問題として排除している。現在の91,783件は感染伝播の継続を示すが、重症度や国際的リスクは限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: インドはハンセン病を20年以上前に公衆衛生上の問題として排除宣言しているが、風土病地域（マハーラーシュトラ、チャッティースガル、オディシャ、マディヤ・プラデーシュ州）での継続的な症例報告と感染伝播が見られる。2025-26年に91,783件の新規症例が報告され、小児症例や障害度2の診断が継続している。保健省は強化対策と接触者追跡、予防投与の拡大を計画中。国際的な感染リスクや重症疾患の増加は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Kenya prépare des services d'isolement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kenya prepares isolation facilities
article.articleSummary: Kenya is intensifying Ebola preparedness despite no domestic cases, as outbreaks continue in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. At Nairobi’s Kenyatta National Hospital, staff have been trained to recognize and safely manage potential Ebola cases, with isolation units ready, dedicated personnel, and procedures to prevent transmission within health facilities. Kenyatta is described as the only hospital with a fully independent infectious-disease isolation unit; other public facilities can repurpose spaces as needed. Kenya is also preparing to quarantine Americans arriving from the DRC at a military air base, a measure that sparked violent protests in which one person was killed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアが隔離施設の準備を進める
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、隣国DRCとウガンダでの流行が継続中。ケニアは準備段階だが、国際的拡大リスク（IHR基準3つ該当）と社会的関心（軍事基地での米国市民隔離に伴う暴力的抗議）が存在し、フルRRAが必要である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの準備状況だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。隣国DRCとウガンダでの実際の流行は対象国DRCのみ検証。軍事基地での隔離措置に関連した暴力的抗議（死者1名）が報告されており、社会政治的緊張が高い。エボラ出血熱の高い病原性と国際拡大リスクから、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en niños, Haití, trabajo infantil, avances contra el VIH... Las noticias del viernes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in children, Haiti, child labor, advances against HIV... Friday's news
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri region) continues to spread, with 676 cases and 136 deaths over three weeks due to Bundibugyo; 34 health zones affected; no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance, testing, and contact tracing. UNICEF warns household transmission could rise, leaving vulnerable children at higher risk amid malnutrition and low vaccination. Haiti opens its first safe houses for women and girls survivors of violence in Port-au-Prince, as gang-related violence escalates; 2025 ONU Mujeres data show 1,863 sexual-violence cases, +163% from 2024, with nearly 1.47 million displaced, including about 790,000 women and girls. World Day against Child Labour reports about 138 million children in work, 54 million in hazardous work; Sub-Saharan Africa hosts ~87 million; 61% in agriculture; ending by 2025 would require roughly 11x faster progress. UNAIDS warns funding cuts threaten HIV gains: aid down 23% in 2025; HIV testing down 22% in high-burden contexts; PrEP access down 38% in 62 countries; AIDS deaths down 56% since 2010, new infections down 43%, but ~9 million remain untreated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（コンゴ民主共和国の子どもたち）、ハイチ、児童労働、HIV対策の進展...金曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウ型）が3週間で676症例136死亡という深刻な状況であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当（重症度・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て満たし、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ地域におけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウ型）を主題としており、34の保健地域を巻き込む深刻な流行を報告。ワクチンや特異的治療法が利用不可であり、サーベイランス・検査・接触者追跡の強化が緊急に必要とされている。ハイチの暴力やHIV資金削減の問題も記事では言及されているが、メインのシグナルはDRCのエボラ出血熱。

article.articleHeadline: OMS sugere que 'pontos cegos' podem ocultar extensão do surto de ebola no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO suggests that 'blind spots' may hide the extent of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved treatment or vaccine, may be larger than official estimates due to surveillance blind spots. As of June 12, 2026, Congo reported 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with spread to three new health zones and into neighboring Uganda. WHO epidemiologist Olivier le Polain, based in Beni, warned that many high-risk areas remain poorly monitored and surveillance must be strengthened. A major constraint is the shortage of isolation beds—only about 250 beds across the three affected provinces. The outbreak had gone unnoticed for weeks as responders race to catch up. WHO has not projected its magnitude; US CDC warned it could reach levels seen in the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which killed more than 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴでの『監視の盲点』によって隠されている可能性を示唆
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模流行で、DRコンゴからウガンダへの国境を越えた拡大が確認され、公式統計以上の規模が懸念される。WHO・US CDCによる警告と強力な国際的関心がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaとAngolaも含まれているが、記事サマリーで具体的に確認されているのはDRコンゴからウガンダへの拡大のみ。DRコンゴは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。治療法・ワクチンなし、監視体制の不備、隔離床の深刻な不足（3州で約250床）が報告されており、管理可能性が低い。2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行（11,000人以上死亡）との規模比較言及あり。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta que la epidemia de ébola sigue expandiéndose en el este del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, linked to the Bundibugyo strain for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. As of Thursday, June 11, 2026, the Ministry of Health and WHO report 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths. Most infections are in Ituri Province in the northeast, but cases have been detected in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO epidemiology chief Olivier le Polain warned that new health zones are identified almost daily, reflecting the outbreak's true magnitude and high population mobility. Response efforts are hampered by weak health systems and insecurity in several regions, though the DRC has prior Ebola experience to draw on.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ流行が拡大を続けていることに警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大のリスク、複数地域での急速な拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 進行中のエボラウイルス病の流行であり、676確認患者、136死亡が報告されている。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株であること、34の保健区域に拡大していること、新規発症地域が毎日識別されていることが重要。弱い保健システムと地域の不安定さが対応を阻害している点も懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: в Демократической Республике Конго зарегистрировано 676 подтвержденных случаев заболевания лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 676 confirmed cases of Ebola virus disease have been registered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is currently spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported as of yesterday. The vast majority of cases are in Ituri province, but infections have been detected in 34 health districts across North Kivu and South Kivu. New cases are identified almost daily, suggesting the true burden greatly exceeds the confirmed tally. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri (246 suspected cases, 65 deaths), and on May 17 the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The epidemic is driven by a rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. Total cases in this outbreak have surpassed 1,000, while transmission remains persistent amid high population mobility, a weakened health system, and ongoing instability. The WHO is coordinating with DRC authorities on the response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス病の確定患者676例が報告された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として既に宣言されており、多数の死亡を伴う重篤な状況。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。WHOにより5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。治療薬やワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo株による稀な流行。確定患者数676例以上、死亡136例。34の保健地区に拡大。人口移動が多く、医療体制が脆弱な環境での継続的な伝播リスク高。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا يتفشى في الكونغو.. تقرير أممي يُحذر من ارتفاع الإصابات بين الأطفال
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus spreads in Congo... UN report warns of rising infections among children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain, spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 676 cases and 136 deaths reported in roughly three weeks since confirmation (as of June 12, 2026). The outbreak spans from Aru in North Ituri to Meti Morisa in South Kivu, about 1,000 kilometers, with 34 health zones affected as of yesterday and new cases in North Kivu. UNICEF warns household transmission could drive infections among children as the outbreak evolves. More than half of children under five in Ituri are chronically malnourished, and over one-fifth have not received basic vaccines. The UN-led response includes shipments of medical and protective supplies to frontline health workers and affected communities as authorities monitor the evolving outbreak and containment efforts continue.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスが流行..国連報告書が子ども感染者の増加に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。短期間で676例・136死亡の急速な流行拡大が報告されており、子どもへの伝播リスク、栄養不良・予防接種不足層での易感染性、国際的支援体制が展開されている。シグナルとしてのフルRRA評価が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）はDRC東部で既知の流行菌株だが、短期3週間で676例・136死亡の急速拡大は深刻。South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu州にまたがり1000km以上の広域分布。5歳以下の慢性栄養不良（Ituri 50%超）と予防接種カバー不足（1/5以上が未接種）は重症化・死亡リスク増加。UNICEF含む国際支援体制の起動確認済み。世界保健機関への通知が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Suman 136 muertos por brote de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 136 dead from Ebola outbreak in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 676 confirmed cases since it was declared on May 15, with 136 deaths. Ituri province accounts for 629 cases; North Kivu 44; South Kivu 3, with new transmission foci detected in other health zones. Recovery stands at 32, while 260 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation. The outbreak has reached Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The World Health Organization warns that the Bundibugyo strain can have a case fatality rate up to 50%, and there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment available. This represents a significant global public health concern.}

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行で136人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の複数国での確認事例、高い致死率、国際的拡大リスク、および世界的な公衆衛生上の懸念が明確である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（ウガンダ）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの主要な流行が記事の中心であり、ウガンダは二次的な拡大事例として言及されている。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の高い致死率（最大50%）とワクチン・治療法の不在が、著しい公衆衛生上の脅威となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Cientista é acusado de tentar contrabandear mpox nos EUA - 12/06/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientist accused of trying to smuggle mpox into the United States - June 12, 2026
article.articleSummary: Dutch virologist Vincent Munster, 53, and assistant Claude Kwe, 38, were accused by federal prosecutors of conspiring to smuggle vials of inactivated mpox (monkeypox) virus and other biological materials into the United States in January. Munster heads the Virus Ecology Section at the NIH Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana; Kwe traveled with him from the Democratic Republic of Congo during a mpox outbreak. Investigators say the box contained more than 100 vials, including inactivated mpox and varicella viruses, with about 20 tested and 17 identified as mpox. The materials allegedly were not properly identified or certified as non-infectious. If indicted and convicted, they could face up to five years in prison. The case in the Eastern District of Michigan proceeds toward a grand jury after hearings in Missoula, Montana.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者がアメリカへのmpoxの密輸を試みたとして起訴される - 2026年6月12日
triage.triage_reason: 本件は感染症の自然発生的な流行ではなく、違法な病原体密輸事件に関する刑事訴追である。感染症シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本事件は病原体の密輸・刑事訴追に関するニュースであり、感染症の流行・集団発生ではない。DRCから米国への違法な病原体持ち出しの試みに関連して、DRCがmpoxの発生地として言及されているが、疾患監視シグナルとしてはピックアップ対象外。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、感染症危機管理の観点からはDismiss適切。

article.articleHeadline: Três bairros de Limeira recebem mutirão contra a dengue neste sábado | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Limeira neighborhoods host a dengue control drive this Saturday | Rápido no Ar
article.articleSummary: On June 13, 2026, Limeira, São Paulo, Brazil, will host a dengue control mutirão focusing on Aedes aegypti. Ninety agents from zoonosis and endemics control will inspect properties in Jardim Nova Suíça, Jardim Barão de Limeira, and Vila Santa Lúcia from 7:30 to 12:00. Teams will identify and eliminate potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites, assess health-risk situations, and residents will receive guidance on preventive measures to curb mosquito proliferation—the vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The operation aligns with United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (good health and well-being) under the 2030 Agenda. No case counts are reported in the article; the initiative emphasizes local surveillance, community engagement, and preventive action to reduce transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラの3地区が今週土曜日にデング熱対策キャンペーンを開催 | Rápido no Ar
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規感染症発生イベントではなく、既知疾患（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）に対するルーチンの蚊媒介対策キャンペーンの報道。患者数・死亡数の報告なく、異常性・重症度の証拠がないため、シグナル基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・リメイラ市による予防的なベクター制御キャンペーン（蚊幼虫の繁殖地排除）の告知であり、実際の感染症クラスタ・アウトブレイク検出ではない。患者発生報告がなく、異常性や重症度の指標が示されていないため、トリアージ対象外。公式な蚊媒介疾患対策の日常的実施として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Mother finds body of missing son two days after Kenya's Ebola quarantine centre protests
article.articleSummary: 17-year-old Sylvester Muigai Ndung'u was killed in Nanyuki, central Kenya, during protests over a US plan to build a 50-bed Ebola quarantine centre at the nearby Laikipia Air Base. His body was found in a mortuary two days after he went missing; witnesses said he was shot in the head, though police await post-mortem results and family says a tear-gas canister may have been the cause. He is the third person to die amid demonstrations against the facility. The isolation unit at Laikipia would serve Ebola-affected US citizens tied to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak; locals cite cross-border infection risks and concerns about government transparency. A High Court halting the opening last month contrasts with satellite imagery showing continued construction; a US official said the administration is hopeful to resolve objections. President William Ruto defended the plan, urging Kenyans not to politicise Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ隔離センター抗議の2日後、母親が行方不明の息子の遺体を発見
