triage.triage_reason: エボラ関連の社会不安と死亡者が報告されているが、実際の感染症流行ではなく、隔離施設建設に対する抗議デモに関わる事案。エボラ患者の発生ではなく、施設建設反対運動の中での死亡事案であるため、感染症クライシスとしての即座のピックアップは不適切だが、エボラ対応施設の政治的問題と社会不安は監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はエボラ患者の発生ではなく、ケニアのラリキピア空軍基地に建設予定のエボラ隔離施設に対する住民抗議デモに関わる死亡事案である。DRCエボラ流行との関連は記載されているが、ケニアでのエボラ確定患者の発生報告はない。施設建設に対する政治的・社会的関心は高いが、感染症流行シグナルとしてのピックアップはWATCH段階が適切。続報によりケニアでの確定患者発生が報告された場合は即座にPICKUPに昇格すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola u Kongu: WHO upozorava na širenje, 676 slučajeva i 136 mrtvih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: WHO warns of the spread, 676 cases and 136 deaths.
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths are recorded in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as the outbreak continues to spread geographically and in intensity. WHO warns that uncertainty, population movement, and limited health capacity hinder containment. Most cases are in Ituri Province, with infections now identified in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. New zones are being added nearly daily, and the true scope likely underestimates the epidemic due to mobility and detection gaps. Authorities have identified 17 hotspots requiring intensified support, including at-risk locations before cases are reported. Key measures include safe burials, infection prevention in health facilities, early detection, contact tracing, and community engagement. WHO support strengthens surveillance, laboratory capacity, logistics, infection control, clinical care, and risk communication as the response expands.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：WHOが拡大を警告、676件の症例と136人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を持ち、国際的な拡大リスクと地域不安定性により、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EVD）のアウトブレイク。確認された676例、死亡136例、複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）に広がり、34の保健ゾーンに拡大。人口移動と限定的な保健体制がコンテインメントを妨げている。WHOが積極的に支援を展開中。国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا: نقاط غامضة وتحذير من استمرار التفشّي في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Mysterious Spots and Warning of the Ongoing Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease persists in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with confirmed infections concentrated in Ituri and spread across 34 health zones in Ituri plus areas in North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, with deaths accompanying rising confirmed cases and no vaccines or approved treatments available. Officials warn the true scale may be larger than official estimates as cases are detected nearly daily in new districts and surveillance expands; the response is hampered by insecurity, including control of large areas by the M23 rebel group. Isolation capacity is limited, with fewer than 250 beds across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO and partners stress enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and testing, while the World Food Programme assists movement of responders and supplies. The outbreak began in mid-May and was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later, with spillover risk to neighboring Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国での継続的な流行の謎と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際拡大リスク、隣国ウガンダへの波及リスク）。PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行であり、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として既に宣言されているエボラウイルス病の流行。Bundibugyo ebolavirus という稀な系統であり、ワクチン・承認治療なし、隣国ウガンダへの波及リスク指摘あり。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu での感染確認、感染者数増加継続、医療体制の制約（隔離ベッド250床未満）、セキュリティ上の制約（M23反政府勢力支配地域）があり、マネージメント上の課題が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: OMS aponta que pontos cegos podem ocultar extensão do surto de ebola no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO points out that blind spots could conceal the extent of the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that blind spots in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could mask the full extent of a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. As of 12 June 2026, Congo has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with transmission reaching three new health zones and crossing into Uganda. The Bundibugo (Bundibugyo) strain has no approved treatment or vaccine, complicating control efforts. The WHO notes areas of high risk with insufficient surveillance, hindering accurate propagation estimates. Healthcare capacity is strained, with only about 250 isolation beds across the three affected provinces. The outbreak was previously overlooked for weeks, delaying rapid response actions. The CDC has suggested the outbreak could reach the scale seen in 2014–2016, though no official projections exist. Enhanced surveillance and increased isolation capacity are urgently needed to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが指摘：コンゴのエボラ熱感染拡大の全容が隠れている可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で、確認患者676人・死亡136人、ウガンダへの越境拡大、治療法ワクチン不在。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)でのBundibugyo Ebolaの大規模流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境拡大も言及されているが、サマリー上の重点はコンゴでの発生。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。CDCが2014-2016年規模への拡大可能性を示唆しており、監視不十分地域での隠れた伝播の懸念が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Pio IX entra em alerta após aumento de casos e reforça ações de combate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Pio IX goes on alert after an increase in cases and reinforces measures to combat dengue.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-12, the municipality of Pio IX in the southeast of Piauí, Brazil, intensified dengue control after rising case numbers. The Sesapi arboviroses panel reports 91 confirmed dengue cases in 2026, including two severe dengue. In the past two weeks, 66 suspected cases were notified, predominantly in rural communities. Authorities declared an alert and reinforced surveillance, prevention, and control measures, with endemic agents conducting inspections, community guidance, and elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Support was requested from the Regional Health of Picos to assist municipal teams. Preventive actions emphasize removing standing-water containers, keeping water tanks sealed, and using repellents. Residents with symptoms—fever, body aches, or rashes—should seek medical care, especially if symptoms worsen. The outbreak centers on dengue transmission via Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：ピオ9世が患者数増加後に警戒態勢に入り、対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）でのデング熱の局所的な増加が報告されているが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当が明確でなく、現時点では情報が限定的。スクリーニング基準では異常性と地域の流行性が認められるが、国際的拡大リスクや重大な公衆衛生影響の証拠が不十分。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ピアウイ州ピオ9世市で91確定患者、重症例2件が報告。過去2週間で66例の疑似症例が通知されており、農村地域での集中が特徴。Aedes aegypti媒介によるデング熱の局所的な流行と判断される。ブラジルはWPRO地域外（PAHO管轄）であるが、対象国リストに含まれているため検証済みロケーションに列挙した。国家的支援の要請があり、地域保健局がサポートを開始している。国際的拡大の現在の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS : des "angles morts" pourraient masquer l'ampleur de l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 'blind spots' could mask the extent of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo may be larger than reported due to surveillance blind spots, says WHO. As of 12 June 2026, authorities report over 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with 41 new infections and 9 additional deaths in the last 24 hours. The Bundibugyo strain remains mainly in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 34 health zones now affected. Almost 5,700 people are being followed as contacts, though identifying contacts remains challenging. WHO epidemiology lead Olivier Le Polain emphasizes that better visibility will come as surveillance, contact tracing, and testing capacity are strengthened. Africa CDC regards Uganda as controlled; WHO deems the regional risk very high in DRC and high in neighboring countries, while overall continental/world risk remains low. Strengthened field surveillance and contact follow-up are essential to gauge the true scale.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：「盲点」がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の規模を隠す可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラは公衆衛生上深刻な影響を持ち、確認患者676名・死亡136名の大規模流行。既に地域内での拡大（ウガンダ）を示唆し、国際的な懸念も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則(IHR)で報告義務のある疾患。WHO、Africa CDCとも関与。ウガンダは「管理下」と判定されているため主な流行地はDRCで確認。サーベイランス体制の課題が記事の中核で、実際の患者数がさらに多い可能性を指摘。地域リスク評価：DRCで「非常に高い」、隣国で「高い」。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: infectologista alerta sobre vacinação em viagens para a Copa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: infectious-disease specialist warns about travel vaccines for the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in the Americas prompt travel vaccination for the 2026 World Cup host countries—the United States, Mexico, and Canada. Canada reported 124 cases in 2026, continuing a rise from 5,062 in 2024; Mexico reached 6,152 cases in 2025 with 1,190 in January 2026; the United States had 2,144 cases in 2025 and 721 in January 2026. Natalie Del Vecchio, an infectious-disease specialist, warns that low vaccination coverage in these host nations and Brazil increases the risk of measles reintroduction. Brazil was recertified measles-free by PAHO in November 2024 after a 2018 reintroduction due to gaps in coverage; 2025 saw 38 imported cases, and January 2026 recorded two unvaccinated cases (a 22-year-old woman in Rio de Janeiro and a 6-month-old in São Paulo). Health authorities urge travelers to complete vaccination: for 6–11 months, one dose (dose zero) 15 days before travel; ages 1–30 two doses; ages 30–59 one dose; ensure the MMR at least 15 days before travel; vaccines are free via SUS.

triage.headline_ja: 麻しん：感染症専門医がワールドカップ開催国への渡航ワクチン接種について警告
triage.triage_reason: 米国、メキシコ、カナダでの麻しん多数患者発生、ブラジルの再発症例確認により、IHR基準3つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、2026年ワールドカップという国際的スポーツイベント開催に伴う渡航・ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事は米国、メキシコ、カナダでの麻しん流行について述べているが、これらは対象国に含まれていない。対象国リストではブラジルのみが該当し、記事ではブラジルでの2025年の輸入症例38件と2026年1月の自国感染2症例（リオデジャネイロとサンパウロ）が明記されている。ワールドカップ2026開催に伴う国際的なヒト移動と麻しん再発症例の関連性が指摘されており、シグナルとして拾う価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Macedônia promove arrastão nas ruas para combater focos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Macedônia City Hall conducts street sweeps to combat dengue hotspots.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-12, Macedônia city hall launched a large-scale dengue prevention operation, Arrastão Contra a Dengue, deploying agents and cleaning crews to multiple neighborhoods to remove water-collecting debris and conduct door-to-door outreach. The effort targets Aedes aegypti breeding sites and reinforces awareness of dengue transmission, which also includes risks for Zika and chikungunya. The campaigns combined environmental cleanup with direct resident engagement to emphasize that the best defense against outbreaks is everyday vigilance. The municipality underscored that individual actions—keeping yards tidy, covering water storage containers, removing plant saucers, and proper waste disposal—are essential for reducing mosquito reproduction. Officials framed the mobilization as a collective responsibility aimed at keeping Macedônia safe and free from dengue.

triage.headline_ja: マケドニア市庁舎がデング熱対策の街頭一掃作戦を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマケドニア市による予防的なデング熱対策キャンペーンの報道。既知の流行地域での対応であり、新規の集団発生を示唆する情報が記事に明示されていないため、情報不足のまま要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は予防キャンペーンの実施を報道しており、具体的な患者数、死亡、入院などの重症度指標が記載されていない。Aedes aegyptiの生息地対策と住民啓発という管理的対応が進行中であり、地域レベルで対応可能と判断される。北マケドニアは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists working to develop four Ebola vaccines to tackle outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Four Ebola vaccines are in development to tackle the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in eastern DR Congo, where more than 500 cases have been reported and no proven vaccine exists for Bundibugyo. Two vaccines could enter clinical trials within two months, including an Oxford University candidate and a Moderna-developed one, using COVID-19 vaccine technology, with trials potentially starting by the end of August. Even if results are favorable, at least two more months would be needed to advance to further trials and regulatory approval. A proven vaccine would be a game changer, but experts warn the outbreak could take months or years to end, drawing a parallel to the 2018 eastern DR Congo epidemic that lasted about two years despite a vaccine. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri province, where artisanal mining is a key activity, and undetected circulation is suspected.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ流行に対応するため、4つのエボラワクチンの開発が進行中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の新規流行であり、ワクチン未開発の株による500以上の患者報告は重大事象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の新規流行。500例以上の確認患者、証実された有効ワクチンの欠如、鉱山労働者など高リスク人口、2018年の同地域流行が2年継続した前例から、長期化が予想される。国際的なワクチン開発が進行中であることも高い注視度を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Deputado Florentino Neto é diagnosticado com dengue e suspende agenda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Florentino Neto is diagnosed with dengue fever and suspends his schedule.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian federal deputy Florentino Neto (PT) was diagnosed with dengue fever on June 12, 2026, and will temporarily suspend his public schedule, planning to resume next week after recovery. Dengue is transmitted by the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Symptoms include high fever above 38.5°C, severe headache, eye movement pain, muscle and joint pains, fatigue, loss of appetite, and a red itchy rash. The Ministry of Health advises constant hydration and cautions against self-medication, especially aspirin and NSAIDs due to bleeding risk. Authorities urge urgent medical care if warning signs appear: intense, persistent abdominal pain; vomiting; low blood pressure; bleeding; excessive drowsiness or agitation; and difficulty breathing. The notice does not detail symptom onset or hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: 副議長フロレンティーノ・ネト氏がデング熱と診断され、公務日程を中止
triage.triage_reason: 個別の症例報告であり、異常な集団発生や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示唆する情報がない。ブラジルにおけるデング熱は風土病であり、単一の政治家の感染は通常の個別事例と考えられる。
triage.notes: ブラジルでのデング熱は流行地域における常在感染症であり、個別の症例報告のみでは信号に該当しない。集団発生や異常な増加傾向の情報がないため、シグナルトリアージ対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا شرق الكونغو مع خطر للأطفال
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: Ebola infections rise in eastern Congo, putting children at risk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections rise in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with ongoing transmission and heightened risk to children. As of June 12, 2026, UN agencies report 676 new cases and 136 deaths in the past three weeks. The outbreak extends from Aru in Ituri north to Miti-Morisa in South Kivu, affecting 34 health zones and including new areas in North Kivu. UNICEF warns of increasing household transmission, raising pediatric infections, while malnutrition among under-fives in Ituri worsens vulnerability. More than 100 tons of humanitarian supplies, including PPE and medicines, have been dispatched. WHO notes there are no approved therapies or vaccines for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and stresses enhanced testing and surveillance to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴ東部でエボラ感染者増加、子どもにリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。エボラウイルス疾患は確定シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行。過去3週間で676新規症例、136死亡。複数州にまたがり34ヘルスゾーン影響。小児感染率上昇、栄養不良との複合危機。WHO承認治療法・ワクチンなし。国連機関による人道支援展開。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており verified_locations に含める。
