article.articleHeadline: Flu could increase risk of TB, says study | Mumbai News
article.articleSummary: Influenza infection may increase TB risk by suppressing immune pathways that control Mycobacterium tuberculosis, according to a Nature Communications study led by Imperial College London using controlled influenza infections in healthy volunteers. The findings, the first human data on TB–influenza interaction, suggest that preventing flu with vaccination and other public health measures could reduce TB incidence and justify clinical trials to determine whether seasonal flu vaccination lowers TB risk in vulnerable populations. In India, TB remains a major burden—accounting for about 25% of global TB, with Mumbai reporting roughly 60,000 TB cases annually; India also hosts millions of influenza cases (A(H3N2), A(H1N1), and B). Critics argue the proposed vaccination strategy is not cost-effective in India, citing a Rs 2,000 flu vaccine cost and prioritization for high-risk groups. Globally, flu affects about 1 billion people annually with 2.9 lakh to 6.5 lakh respiratory deaths.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザは結核のリスクを増加させる可能性がある、研究が示唆
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザと結核の相互作用に関する科学的知見を報告する記事であり、公衆衛生に関連するが、実際の新規アウトブレイクや患者数の異常増加を報告するイベント記事ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は科学研究の発表と結核・インフルエンザの公衆衛生負担についての報告であり、新規アウトブレイクイベントではない。インドにおける結核とインフルエンザの既知の疾病負担（年間60,000件のTB症例、複数のインフルエンザウイルス型の流行）について述べているが、異常な状況変化を示すものではない。ワクチン戦略の費用対効果に関する議論があるが、急速な感染症危機を示していない。

article.articleHeadline: Expert Explains How Tepid US Response Aided Ebola Spread In Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-12, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with 119 suspected cases and 32 recoveries. Declared May 15, the outbreak likely began about three months ago and went undetected for much of that period. WHO warns the outbreak is expanding into new areas in the northeastern DRC and is larger in scale than previously detected. American health expert Dr. Ashish Jha says US funding cuts contributed to a muted global response, noting diminished USAID presence, weakened CDC-WHO coordination after the US withdrawal from WHO, and the absence of a White House senior coordinator. He argues vaccines are not a viable rapid solution; several candidates are in testing, but unlikely to curb spread in time. He calls for a stronger, globally coordinated detection and response.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が語る：米国の生ぬるい対応がコンゴでのエボラ拡大を助長した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（676確認例、136死亡）、異常・予想外な状況（新規地域への拡大、大規模化）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国への懸念）の3項目が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡事例多数）、流行しやすさ（拡大中）、管理可能性（国際調整の課題指摘）が該当し、強い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCのエボラ発生を報道しており、米国は対応・資金面での言及に留まる。したがってDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。2026年6月時点で676例・136死亡という大規模活動中。WHO警告により northeastern DRCへの拡大が確認されている。国際的調整の不備が指摘されている点も国際拡大リスク評価に寄与。

article.articleHeadline: डीआर काँगो: इबोला वायरस का प्रकोप जारी, बच्चों में भी संक्रमण मामलों की आशंका
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola virus outbreak continues, with suspected cases among children as well.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, continues across Ituri and the eastern provinces of North and South Kivu. Since its confirmation about three weeks ago, authorities report 676 infections and 136 deaths, with 34 health zones affected. WHO epidemiologists note daily new cases, driven by movement in eastern DRC. In Ituri, malnutrition is high among children, and many under-5s have not received vaccines for diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis, increasing vulnerability. UNICEF warns that more children may become infected as the outbreak evolves. UNICEF aims to reach 3.7 million people in six months; EU shipments of 100 tons arrived, including PPE, medicines, and sanitation supplies. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo; contact tracing up to 70% is possible. In Beni, a lab processed 500 tests on Thursday. About 1,600 community health workers and 24 teams are assisting 160,000 households. Schools should stay open with prevention in place.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスの流行が継続、子どもたちの中にも感染の疑い事例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus流行は国際保健上の重大懸念。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス種）による確認された流行で、3週間前の確認以来676感染者、136死亡、34ヘルスゾーン影響。子どもの栄養不良と予防接種率の低さが脆弱性を増加させている。WHO・UNICEFが積極的に対応中。EU支援物資到着。特異的治療法やワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo種による流行であることが懸念を増大させる。

article.articleHeadline: Summer Health Guide: Montgomery County's top doc warns of rising tick bites, heat risks
article.articleSummary: Montgomery County, MD, Chief Health Officer Dr. Kisha Davis warns of rising tick activity this summer across Maryland and the Northeast, with ticks emerging earlier than usual and related ER visits increasing. Local offices are reviewing county tick-related ER upticks; Lyme disease data have not yet been reviewed. CDC data show Northeast tick-bite ED visits at 229 per 100,000 in June 2025, marking the region’s highest summer spike in at least five years. Precautions include covering ankles and wrists, using bug repellent, and checking for ticks on people and pets after outdoor time; remove ticks with fine-tipped tweezers and avoid smothering or burning. Also emphasize heat and sun protection: sunscreen, hydration, and recognizing heatstroke signs. Regarding Ebola in parts of Africa, Montgomery County risk remains low; travelers from Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and South Sudan are routed through designated airports, and transmission requires close contact with a very ill person, not mild symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の健康ガイド：モンゴメリー郡の医療責任者がダニ刺咬増加と熱中症リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: Lyme病に関する異常な季節的上昇（ER受診が過去5年で最高）が認識されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行可能性）に該当する可能性があるが、記事はモンゴメリー郡（米国）の警告情報であり、対象国における実際の感染症イベントの詳細が不足している。Ebola言及は地域リスク評価であり、主焦点ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主焦点はモンゴメリー郡（米国）でのLyme病ダニ活動の異常な増加にあり、これは対象国外である。Ebola言及は、DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンからの旅行者についての地域リスク評価であり、これらの国でのアクティブなEbolaイベント報告ではない。DRCは対象国に含まれるため記載したが、本記事では具体的なEbola事例報告がないため、実質的な検証に乏しい。続報や詳細情報の入手を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand Odisha, Madhya Pradesh account for 50% of India's leprosy patients
article.articleSummary: India recorded 91,783 new leprosy cases in 2025-26, with a national prevalence of 0.56 per 10,000. Children comprised 4.18% of new detections, and 2.12% had Grade-2 disability at diagnosis. Five states — Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha, and Madhya Pradesh — together account for about half of the national leprosy burden, with high-prevalence districts: 23 in Chhattisgarh, 21 in Jharkhand, 18 in Maharashtra, 18 in Odisha, and 10 in Madhya Pradesh. Although India achieved national elimination in 2005, several states plus Chandigarh have not met sub-national elimination targets, indicating ongoing transmission in endemic pockets. Aradhana Patnaik, Additional Secretary, NHM, called for intensified, targeted interventions to interrupt transmission in hotspot districts. The regional workshop held in Nava Raipur, Chhattisgarh, reviewed performance and outlined actions toward zero transmission.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ、チャッティスガル、ジャルカンド、オディシャ、マディヤプラデシュがインドのハンセン病患者の50%を占める
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は慢性感染症であり、インドでは国家的排除を達成済み（2005年）。新規患者数91,783件は高く、小児感染や障害事例が報告されているが、急速な国際拡大リスクや重度の急性公衆衛生危機の指標は明確でない。継続的な地域的伝播と州レベルの排除目標未達成は注視が必要。
triage.notes: ハンセン病は除去可能な感染症であり、インドは国家レベルでの排除を達成しているが、特定の州・地区での地域的伝播が継続している。WPROスクリーニング基準では4つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）しているが、IHR基準は1つのみの該当であること、国際的拡大リスクが低いこと、政府と保健省の対応が進行中であることから、WATCH判定が適切。継続的な流行状況の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: जिले में डेंगू का खतरा बढ़ा! स्वास्थ्य विभाग की जांच में 21 जगह मिला मच्छरों का लारवा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue risk has increased in the district! Mosquito larvae found at 21 locations during the health department's investigation.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk has risen in Ludhiana district, Punjab, as the health department conducted a targeted anti-dengue drive at Punjab Roadways workshops, PRTC bus depot and associated junk yards. The effort, aimed at curbing breeding sites such as discarded tires, scrap materials, and water-collecting containers, identified dengue larvae in 21 containers, which were destroyed on the spot. Across the campaign, teams visited 177 units, covered 238 areas, inspected 9,422 homes, and checked 21,843 containers for larvae. Civil Surgeon Dr. Ramandeep Kaur urged vigilance and emphasized community participation, urging agencies and citizens to avoid standing water. IEC activities informed workers and the public about dengue symptoms, prevention measures, and maintaining clean, dry surroundings. District authorities report over 2,000 suspected dengue patients so far, with two laboratory-confirmed cases upon cross-checking. As of June 12, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 地区のデング熱の危険性が増加！保健局の調査で21ヶ所でモスキート幼虫が発見
triage.triage_reason: パンジャブ州ルディアナ地区でデング熱の活動兆候が認められ、複数のスクリーニング基準に該当するが、確認症例が2件と限定的であり、さらなる情報を要する。
triage.notes: デング熱幼虫が21ヶ所で検出されたことはスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）で複数該当するが、確認症例は2件に限定されており、死亡例の報告はない。保健局による積極的な対策活動が進行中であるため、今後の発生状況推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: L'effondrement accéléré de la biodiversité, un des facteurs de l'émergence du virus Ebola en Afrique centrale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The accelerated collapse of biodiversity, one of the factors in the emergence of the Ebola virus in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurgence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda is directly linked to accelerated biodiversity loss in Central Africa, which drives closer contact between communities and wildlife. CIFOR-ICRAF researchers urge urgent action to curb unsustainable bushmeat hunting—the main protein source in much of Central and West Africa—while promoting protection, conservation, and restoration, plus sustainable ecosystem use and management, to control endemic zoonoses like Ebola. Despite illegality in some regions, millions worldwide still consume bushmeat. In the current outbreak, WHO data show 102 deaths among 608 lab-confirmed Ebola cases in DRC and 15 lab-confirmed cases in Uganda, including one death. The Congo Basin remains a hotspot where human-wildlife interaction, driven by dietary practices, escalates spillover risk. Experts call diversifying diets with plant and animal proteins to reduce health risks from bushmeat.

triage.headline_ja: 生物多様性の急速な喪失、アフリカ中央部のエボラウイルス出現の要因の一つ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、DRCとウガンダでの確定症例と死亡者が報告されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事では DRC で 608 件の確定症例と 102 人の死亡、ウガンダで 15 件の確定症例と 1 人の死亡を報告。生物多様性喪失と野生動物との接触増加がスピルオーバーリスクを高めている点が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola amenaza cada vez más a los niños en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola poses an increasing threat to children in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo expands to 34 health zones across a ~1,000 km corridor from Aru (Ituri) to Miti Murhesa (South Kivu). In about three weeks since confirmation, 676 cases and 136 deaths have been reported. There are no vaccines or specific treatments for this Ebola strain; emphasis is on strengthening surveillance, testing, and contact tracing. Case detection is increasing in new zones amid high population mobility; contact tracing is above 70% but below the level required for control. A local lab in Beni can process up to 500 tests per day. The crisis poses heightened risk to children, with many malnourished and under-vaccinated; over half of under-fives in Ituri are chronically malnourished, and more than 20% have never received first doses of DTP, tetanus, and pertussis. UNICEF, with EU support, has dispatched over 100 tons of emergency supplies in eight flights as part of a six-month plan to aid 3.7 million people, prioritizing rapid detection, pediatric care, contact tracing, and community engagement; no need to close schools if infection prevention measures are followed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国の子どもたちへの脅威を増大させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例676例・死亡136例、急速な地域拡大（3週間で約1,000km）、子どもへの高リスク等から緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株の確認。34の保健区域に拡大、東部DRC全域で高い人口移動性。子ども層の栄養不良率が高く（Ituri 5歳未満50%以上）、DPT/破傷風/百日咳の予防接種率も低い（20%以上が初回接種未実施）。現地検査能力は日500検査と限定的。UNICEFとEUが緊急支援を展開中。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breitet sich im Kongo aus - WHO alarmiert | Heute.at
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in the Congo - WHO on alert
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the World Health Organization is increasingly concerned about an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as the virus spreads. WHO chief Tedros Ghebreyesus visited Bunia, an epicenter. Authorities report over 1,000 suspected cases and more than 200 deaths. The outbreak is challenging to monitor due to blind spots in detection and limited laboratory capacity. The Bundibugyo variant currently has no approved treatment or vaccine. The recommended strategy remains rapid, focused support to the epicenter. Aid groups warn measures are too slow. The EU and the United States have dispatched medical supplies, with the US pledging an additional $80 million. Uganda and Rwanda have closed borders, while the United States bans entry for people from Congo; Tedros calls border closures completely ineffective and says they hinder transparency. Militia clashes in Ituri and crowded camps with millions displaced complicate control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大 - WHO警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限既実施）。WPRO基準も全5基準該当。多国間支援が既に展開されている重大シグナル。
triage.notes: DRC東部Ituri州Bunia地域でのエボラ（Bundibugyo型）流行。1,000件以上の疑い例、200人以上の死亡。WHO事務局長が現地訪問。米国が追加8,000万ドルを誓約、EU・米国が医療物資を派遣。ウガンダ・ルワンダが国境閉鎖、米国がコンゴからの入国禁止。治療法・ワクチン未承認。民兵衝突と大規模な避難民キャンプが制御を複雑化。記事にはウガンダ・ルワンダ・米国も言及されているが、イベントはDRCでの発生が主題のため、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: RS registra caso suspeito de Ebola em homem que esteve em Uganda | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RS reports a suspected Ebola case in a man who had been to Uganda | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, reports a suspected Ebola case in a 64-year-old man from Nova Hamburgo who had travelled to Uganda, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing. He tested positive for malaria but remains under investigation for Ebola per Ministry of Health protocol. He will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre for treatment; if Ebola is confirmed, he will be moved to a national reference facility. Contacts are under medical monitoring for 30 days to detect early Ebola symptoms. In São Paulo, a separate suspected case involves a 31-year-old Brazilian woman who had been in North Kivu, DRC, a region with an Ebola outbreak. She arrived on June 6; developed diarrhea and fever on June 9, and was transferred to Instituto de Infectologia Emílio Ribas on June 10. A rapid malaria test was negative; Ebola infection has not been confirmed, and she remains isolated and stable.

triage.headline_ja: RS（リオグランデ・ド・スル州）、ウガンダに滞在していた男性のエボラ疑い患者を報告 | ラジオ・イタティアイア
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の疑い患者2件（ウガンダ帰国者1、DRC渡航者1）が報告され、ウガンダとDRCで進行中のアウトブレイク関連。国際的な健康上の脅威となる可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、ブラジル（リオグランデ・ド・スル州とサンパウロ州）における2件のエボラ疑い患者が報告されている。1件目はウガンダからの帰国者、2件目はDRC北キブ地域からの渡航者。発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、実際のイベント発生地（確認患者地域）はブラジルとDRCであるため、verified_locationsはBrazilとDRCのみとした。ウガンダとDRCで進行中のアウトブレイク関連の輸入症例として高リスク。マラリア同時検出（1件目）も注目。

article.articleHeadline: جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية - استمرار تفشي الإيبولا، وتوقعات بزيادة الإصابة بين الأطفال
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Ongoing Ebola outbreak, and forecasts of increased infections among children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains active in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bundibugyo ebolavirus driving an outbreak in Ituri province. In the past three weeks since confirmation, authorities have reported 676 cases and 136 deaths. A WHO and UNICEF briefing warns daily new infections in multiple areas, signaling rising child infections. UNICEF’s Dr. Douglas Noble warns of household transmission as the outbreak evolves; malnutrition in Ituri is widespread, and over 20% of under-fives have received no DTP vaccine. Past DRC outbreaks showed children bore the heaviest burden. Eight flights carrying over 100 tons of emergency supplies—PPE, medicines, and sanitation items—have been sent with EU support to aid 3.7 million people. UNICEF reports 1,600 health workers and 24 cleaning teams have reached over 160,000 households. Schools should remain open; no vaccine or targeted treatment exists for Bundibugyo, underscoring the need for enhanced surveillance and testing capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行、子どもの感染増加の予測
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の流行継続、死亡例の報告、子どもへの感染拡大警告、国際的支援（EU、WHO、UNICEF）が実施されており、国際的な関心と対応の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるイトゥリ州での流行が明記されている。過去3週間で676例、136死亡が報告。子どもへの感染拡大が懸念されている。EU支援による国際的な対応が進行中。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola continue de s'étendre en RDC, dit l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to spread in the DRC, says the WHO.
article.articleSummary: 676 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, including 136 deaths, are reported in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Most infections are concentrated in Ituri Province, with cases now detected in 34 health zones across Ituri, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu. Rwampara General Reference Hospital is located in Ituri. The outbreak continues to spread amid insecurity and fragile health systems, hindering response. Key measures focus on strengthening surveillance, contact tracing (about 70% of contacts traced), rapid isolation and care, safe and dignified burials, infection prevention in health facilities, and reinforced community engagement. Africa CDC notes Uganda’s Ebola outbreak (confirmed May 15) is now under control; risk levels are very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and neighboring countries, and low for the rest of Africa and the world.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で継続的に拡大、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は確認事例676件（死亡136件）、3州にまたがる34保健地区に拡大。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療法なし。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的懸念も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での流行が主題。ウガンダでも確認されているが、サマリーは「ウガンダの流行は5月15日に確認され、現在制御下にある」と述べており、DRCが主要な懸念地域。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療法がないことが重大リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: l'oms lancia l'allarme: l'epidemia di ebola in congo continua a diffondersi: 'ogni giorno...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sounds the alarm: the Ebola epidemic in Congo continues to spread: 'every day...'
article.articleSummary: June 2026 update from the WHO: Ebola epidemic in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain as of yesterday. Most infections are in Ituri Province, but cases have been identified in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, reflecting the outbreak’s reach and high population mobility. There is currently no vaccine for Bundibugyo. The outbreak is occurring in a context of fragile health systems and ongoing insecurity, complicating response. Despite challenges, the country has Ebola management experience, particularly in affected areas. Contact tracing has reached a little over 70% of contacts, a notable improvement over the past weeks, but surveillance and containment remain difficult due to insecurity and movement.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が警告を発令：コンゴのエボラ流行は拡大し続けている：「毎日...
triage.triage_reason: IHR 基準 4/4 該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱の多地域・多州流行で、死亡例も報告されている。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラは稀な株系統。2026年6月現在で676確定患者、136死亡。ワクチンが存在しないため、コンタクトトレーシング（70%達成）と感染予防管理が重要。ただし、脆弱な保健システムと治安悪化により対応が困難。34健康地区に拡大、高い人口移動性が懸念。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta por el avance del ébola en RD del Congo y Uganda | TN8.ni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the spread of Ebola in the DR Congo and Uganda | TN8.ni
article.articleSummary: 676 Ebola cases and 136 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, with Ituri province as the epicenter near the Uganda and South Sudan borders, raising cross-border transmission risk to Uganda, which has reported 19 cases linked to the DRC outbreak, including two deaths. The detected virus corresponds to the Bundibugyo strain, which carries a case fatality rate estimated at 30–50%. There is no authorized vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. The World Health Organization is supporting surveillance, medical care, and health-system strengthening as authorities work to contain spread. Factors such as high population mobility, fragile health systems, and insecurity from armed groups complicate response and may mask more cases as access remains difficult across central and eastern Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ感染の進展について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認例812例（死亡138例）、国際的な二次感染確認、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株による高い致死率（30-50%）、複数国での流行拡大が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ流行と、ウガンダへの越境伝播を述べている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ウガンダはGeoNames IDがリストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株、高い致死率、ワクチン未承容性、武装勢力による不安定性、保健システム脆弱性は全てが追加のリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: ನಿಪಾ ವೈರಸ್ ಭೀತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ; ಕೇರಳ-ತಮಿಳುನಾಡು ಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೀವ್ರ ಕಟ್ಟೆಚ್ಚರ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus fear rising; Kerala-Tamil Nadu border on high alert.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus confirmed in Kozhikode, Kerala, with a 43-year-old patient currently on ventilatory support at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital. Seventy-seven close contacts have been isolated; samples have been sent to a Virology Institute in Pune, Maharashtra, for confirmation. Containment zones have been declared in the affected village/ward, and travel restrictions plus entry checks are enforced for Kerala-origin passengers entering Tamil Nadu, with Tamil Nadu and neighboring Karnataka on high alert. Health workers wear protective gear at border checkpoints, and vehicles from Kerala are stopped for fever and Nipah screening. First Nipah appearance in 2018 was in Kozhikode and Malappuram; authorities are tightening cross-border surveillance between Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka. In parallel, Shigella infection affects about 9 people in the Wayanad district, including a schoolgirl. Nipah transmission involves bats and other animals via contaminated fruit; symptoms include high fever, severe headache, muscle and throat pain, dizziness, vomiting, and respiratory distress.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスへの恐怖が高まる；ケーララ州とタミルナド州の国境で厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの確認症例（人工呼吸器装着患者）、複数州への地理的拡大の兆候、国境を越えた移動制限実施、過去の流行地での再発生という重大なシグナル。IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケーララ州、タミルナド州、カルナタカ州での発生・警戒を報告しており、いずれもインド国内。複数州間での国境制限実施、3州での積極的な監視体制、過去2018年の流行との関連性が指摘されている。患者は人工呼吸器装着の重症例で、77名の濃厚接触者が隔離中。ニパウイルスは人獣共通感染症でコウモリが自然宿主とされ、流行のポテンシャルが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Des réservoirs de plus de 5 000 litres d'eau installés aux barrières sanitaires contre Ebola à Beni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Water tanks of more than 5,000 litres installed at Ebola sanitary barriers in Beni.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease prevention in Beni, North Kivu, DRC: authorities have installed handwashing stations with more than 5,000 litres of water at key entry points to the city. Thermal screening and mandatory hygiene are enforced at barriers Mukulya, Paida, Mavivi, and Pasisi. All road users—pedestrians, moto-taxis, taxi drivers, and trucks—must stop and wash hands before undergoing temperature checks. Security services accompany response teams to ensure strict adherence to sanitary directives. On the Butembo–Beni route, transporters are adopting the measure, with local drivers urging community-wide compliance. The barrier system serves as a strategic control point influencing movements toward Ituri and Tshopo provinces, highlighting cross-provincial monitoring. The article does not report Ebola case counts or laboratory confirmations. These measures aim to curb propagation of Ebola within the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国: ベニのエボラ対策用衛生検査所に5,000リットル以上の水タンクを設置
triage.triage_reason: 記事サマリーは予防措置（手洗いステーション、熱スクリーニング）の実施報告であり、新規患者の確認や発生を報告していない。症例数や検査確認事例の記載もなく、既存感染症対応の公衆衛生措置に関する情報提供であるため、シグナルとしての閾値に達しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の予防・対応措置（衛生検査所の設置）を報告するものであり、新規の感染症イベント（発症者増加、確定患者報告、感染拡大など）を示すシグナルではない。DRCにおけるエボラ対応体制の継続状況を示す背景情報として参考になるが、トリアージレベルでのピックアップは不要。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Η επιδημία Έμπολα στο ανατολικό Κονγκό επεκτείνεται - 676 κρούσματα και 136 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo is expanding - 676 cases and 136 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to expand, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, according to the WHO. Olivier Le Polén, head of WHO’s epidemiology/analysis for emergencies, said the outbreak is growing in both case numbers and geographic reach, now affecting 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Most cases remain in Ituri, but new zones report infections nearly daily, suggesting the true scale is higher than the official count. Insecurity, a weak health system, and large population movements hinder surveillance and response. WHO and Congolese authorities have identified 17 high-risk areas needing intensified support. Measures include safe burials, infection prevention in health facilities, rapid case detection, contact tracing, and community engagement, with WHO aiding in surveillance, laboratory capacity, logistics, infection control, clinical care, and risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 東コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が拡大 - 676件の患者と136人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのバイオセキュリティ脅威であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際的に最も注視される感染症の一つ。記事は676件の患者と136人の死亡を報告。複数の州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）にまたがり34の保健地区に影響。insecurity、弱い保健システム、大規模な人口移動により対応が困難。WHOと現地当局が17の高リスク地域を特定して対応中。情報セキュリティとして、継続的なモニタリングと国際的な連携が必要。

article.articleHeadline: GENEVA / DRC UGANDA EBOLA
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to expand across Ituri and North Kivu, with 676 cases and 136 deaths reported as of the briefing. The outbreak spans more than 1,000 km from Aru in the north to Miti Murhesa in the south, with at least 34 health zones affected, including new areas in North Kivu. WHO and UNICEF officials warn the epidemic’s true scale is growing with population mobility. Most cases have involved socially and economically active adults, but household transmission could drive more pediatric cases. About 70% of contacts are being traced, still below levels needed for control. Coordination emphasizes linking laboratory capacity, surveillance, and healthcare facilities; Beni’s lab is achieving over 500 tests per day, aiding clarity on outbreak size. UNICEF reports emergency relief delivery to Bunia, Ituri Province.

triage.headline_ja: ジュネーブ／コンゴ民主共和国ウガンダ エボラ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイクは676例136死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ言及）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 見出しにウガンダが言及されているが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州・北キブ州でのエボラアウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダは検証可能な発生地として具体的に記載されていないため verified_locations に含めない。流行は1,000km以上拡大し、少なくとも34の保健地域を巻き込み、人口移動により真の規模が拡大中。接触者追跡率70%はコントロール達成に不十分。

article.articleHeadline: Deputado Florentino Neto é diagnosticado com dengue e tem agenda suspensa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Florentino Neto is diagnosed with dengue and has his schedule suspended.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian federal deputy Florentino Neto has been diagnosed with dengue and will temporarily suspend his public duties to follow medical treatment. The official note from his staff states he will rest and his schedule will be suspended for the coming days, with a plan to resume institutional activities next week if clinical condition improves. No hospitalization is reported; the note does not disclose when symptoms began or how the illness has progressed. The medical team’s guidance is to ensure adequate recovery, and the deputy remains under treatment with monitoring by doctors. The statement also thanks supporters for their messages; no details on infection source, travel, or imported/exported cases are provided beyond Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 下院議員フロレンティーノ・ネト氏がデング熱と診断され、日程が中止に
triage.triage_reason: 個別の感染者報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、または管理上の課題を示す証拠がない。通常の散発例と位置付けられる。
triage.notes: ブラジルの公人がデング熱に罹患した個別事例。入院なし、医学的に深刻な状況ではなく、公務休止のみ。ブラジルでのデング熱の流行状況やアウトブレイク判断に関する情報は記事に含まれていない。散発的な感染報告として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists Race to Test Treatments as Ebola Outbreak Widens
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus outbreak in East Africa, including the Democratic Republic of Congo, has infected about 695 people and caused 138 deaths as of mid-June 2026. In a newly set-up treatment center in Rwampara, clinicians provide rehydration, blood transfusions, oxygen, and pain management, but no therapy yet targets Bundibugyo specifically. The World Health Organization notes most past Ebola outbreaks were caused by Ebola virus, and drugs proven for Ebola virus may not work for Bundibugyo. Monoclonal antibody MBP-134 has shown promise in monkeys and was given to an infected American physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, along with remdesivir; his discharge in Berlin June 6 is reported. WHO on May 28 recommended moving MBP-134, remdesivir, and maftivimab/obeldesivir into clinical trials. Trials may use a cross-outbreak design; logistical and security challenges in an active conflict zone complicate rapid testing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の流行が拡大する中、科学者たちが治療法のテストに奔走
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo virus（エボラ属ウイルス）のアウトブレイク。約695人の感染者と138人の死亡者を記録しており、複数国での拡大が報告されている。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、WHOが臨床試験推奨など対応を開始している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはドイツ（ベルリン）、ルワンダ、モザンビークが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は東アフリカ（DRC中心）のBundibugyo virusアウトブレイクである。ドイツのベルリンに報告された患者（Dr. Peter Stafford）は治療受診地であり、発生地ではない。ルワンダはサマリーに言及されていないため除外した。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地として確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: فيروس إيبولا ينتشر في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: Ebola virus is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo; UN agencies warn of a likely spike in pediatric infections in coming days. A WHO epidemiology official says new cases are reported daily across health zones, signaling an outbreak larger than observed amid substantial population movement. In about three weeks since confirmation, authorities have logged 676 cases and 136 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain. Infections stretch from Aro in northern Ituri to Meti Morhesa in southern Kivu, roughly 1,000 kilometers apart. Some 34 health zones are affected, with new zones in northern Kivu reporting cases yesterday. UNICEF has deployed more than 1,600 health workers and community mobilizers, plus 24 cleansing teams, reaching over 160,000 households.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：エボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国で拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がコンゴ民主共和国で確認され、3週間で676例、136死亡が報告されている。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事態である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo strain）による大規模な流行。東部DRC（イトゥリ州・キヴ州）を中心に約1,000km離れた地域に拡大。34の保健ゾーンが影響を受け、小児感染の急増が懸念されている。国連機関による支援が展開中。WHOは検査診断と疫学調査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Fresh concerns as Ebola spreads to new areas in DR Congo - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola Virus Disease cases and 136 deaths have been reported across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 12 June 2026, with 119 suspected cases under investigation and 32 recoveries. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain—there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for it. The virus has spread to new communities with daily detections and evidence of local transmission beyond initial hotspots. The Kpanga displacement camp in Ituri has recorded Ebola-related fatalities amid overcrowding, poor sanitation and strained health services. Ongoing conflict and damaged infrastructure hinder surveillance, contact tracing and treatment, leaving gaps in containment. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths linked to the outbreak; cross-border movement raises risk. WHO warns the outbreak is entering a more dangerous phase, underscoring the need for strengthened surveillance, treatment capacity and public health measures. Symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが新しい地域に拡大、懸念が増す（コンゴ民主共和国）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模な確認症例（676例、136死亡）、ワクチン未承認株（Bundibugyo strain）、国際的な越境拡大（ウガンダへの波及19例）、および公衆衛生インフラの崩壊により、IHR4基準全て該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、シグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（19例、2死亡）での越境波及も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが対象国であり、記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行の新たな拡大である。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未承認であり、治療薬も特異的なものが無い点が重要。紛争と基盤インフラの破壊による管理の困難性を考慮すると、フルRRA実施が必須である。

article.articleHeadline: US to provide $50 million in funding to counter Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: The United States will provide $50 million to the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) to develop 'medical countermeasures' targeting a rare Ebola strain that has caused an outbreak in eastern Congo. The funding, announced by the State Department on June 12, 2026, aims to bolster preparedness and response to Ebola in the region by supporting CEPI’s efforts to advance countermeasures. The article does not provide case or death counts, laboratory-confirmation data, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases. This funding underscores U.S. government support for international outbreak countermeasures through CEPI amid the ongoing eastern Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱の流行に対抗するため5,000万ドルの資金提供を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR通知対象疾患であり、DRCでの流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクを示唆している。米国が国際支援（CEPI経由）を実施することは、管理可能性の課題と国際的関心の存在を示している。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の資金提供発表に焦点を当てているが、サマリーはDRCにおける「ongoing eastern Congo outbreak」の存在を確認している。具体的な症例数や死亡数は記事に記載されていないが、エボラ出血熱の流行という事実と国際的な対応が確認されている。米国は対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Így születik a következő világjárvány
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This is how the next global pandemic is born.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-12, Ebola is re-emerging in Eastern Congo, drawing attention beyond Africa. While Ebola has long persisted in tropical regions, the current outbreak is notable because local factors threaten to turn it into a global health risk: corruption hindering response funds, rapid disinformation campaigns targeting health workers, and extremely poor housing and working conditions for frontline staff. Globalization and better transport, along with population growth, increase the chance that a local outbreak could spread internationally — a pattern echoed in the Wuhan COVID-19 case. Compounding risk are the withdrawal of U.S. funding from international health programs and illegal gold mining, which create brutal conditions that help the virus spread. Experts warn we are not near the peak; climate change and the collapse of support systems could propel this regional outbreak into a worldwide health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 次の世界的パンデミックはこうして生まれる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、Ebola再浮上の重要なシグナルとしてRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはEbola再浮上をEastern Congo（DRC）での事象として述べており、COVID-19 Wuhan事例は比較・類似性の説明として言及されているのみ。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Chinaは比較事例としての参照であり、現在のEbola発生地ではないため除外。U.S.資金撤退やグローバル化による国際的リスクが強調されており、国際的懸念が明確。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵剛果罕見伊波拉　美國資助5000萬美元研發藥物 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Curbing Congo's Rare Ebola Outbreak: U.S. Funds $50 Million for Drug Development
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing a rare Ebola outbreak. The U.S. State Department will provide $50 million to the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) to develop new medical countermeasures, including vaccines and therapeutics, to curb the outbreak. Ebola virus, known for high mortality, spreads mainly via bodily fluids and causes fever, hemorrhage, and organ failure. The outbreak involves a rare Ebola strain; the efficacy of existing drugs and vaccines against it remains to be evaluated, prompting international concern. The funding aims to accelerate research and development of vaccines and treatments to prevent further spread. CEPI is a global partnership accelerating development of countermeasures against emerging infectious diseases. The U.S. funding signals global health security commitments and international cooperation to reduce infection risk at the outset and avert a potential global health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の稀なエボラ出血熱の封じ込め：米国が医薬品開発に5000万ドルを資金提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は死亡率が高く、国際的懸念を引き起こす稀な株による発生。米国の大規模資金支援により国際的協調が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRCの稀なエボラ株による発生を報じており、米国が$50M資金提供でワクチン・治療薬開発を加速する国際協調体制が構築されている。既存医療対策の有効性が不確実な新規株の登場に伴い、高い死亡率と国際的な感染症危機リスクが明記されている。WPRO対象国リストに DRC (203312) が含まれるため verified_locations に追加。米国（対象国外）は資金提供者として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Agentes de saúde e pessoas próximas de paciente com suspeita de ebola serão monitorados por 30 dias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health workers and close contacts of a patient with suspected Ebola will be monitored for 30 days.
article.articleSummary: 64-year-old man hospitalized in stable condition with a suspected Ebola infection at UPA Canudos in Novo Hamburgo, Brazil, and placed in isolation. A blood sample has been sent to Fiocruz, Brazil’s reference laboratory, to confirm or rule out Ebola. The patient recently returned from Uganda, East Africa, as an imported case under investigation, where Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo are ongoing and considered of international concern by the WHO. Although malaria has been diagnosed, the case remains suspected for Ebola based on compatible symptoms. The Secretaria Estadual da Saúde (SES), through Vigilância em Saúde, will monitor close contacts, family members, and health workers for 30 days to detect any early symptoms. The transfer to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição (GHC) in Porto Alegre is being organized by SES, with an isolation area prepared. All healthcare services involved have been briefed on infection prevention and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者の濃厚接触者および医療従事者が30日間監視される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで確認された輸入エボラ疑い症例であり、IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当。ウガンダおよびDRCでの継続的なエボラ流行からの輸入事例であり、WHO国際関心事項に位置付けられている。
triage.notes: ブラジルでのエボラ疑い症例は対象国。記事サマリーは主にブラジルでの検査・隔離・監視体制について述べており、ウガンダ・DRCは背景情報として言及されているが、実際の患者発生地はブラジルである。Fiocruzでの検査結果待ち中であり、確定前の段階。高度な準備体制と感染管理措置が整備されている点は管理可能性を示唆するが、国際輸入事例としての重要性は変わらない。

article.articleHeadline: The World Cup Is Bringing Millions to the U.S. Here's What Experts Say About Infectious-Disease Risk
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus and Ebola risk remains low for the U.S. public, though outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda raise concern. Hantavirus is transmitted by contact with infected rodents; U.S. cases are mainly in the Pacific Northwest, with exposures from an Argentina-origin cruise and evacuees monitored in Nebraska. Ebola transmission involves certain animals and humans; U.S. entry restrictions target travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The DRC World Cup team trains in Houston under these restrictions, and fans from the DRC face visa pauses or suspensions. The biggest risk at matches is respiratory illnesses—cold, flu, RSV, COVID—spread via aerosols, though outdoor venues reduce risk. Protective measures emphasize handwashing with soap and water, and avoiding contaminated surfaces, especially after restroom use. Wastewater surveillance by Verily/CDC, and Georgetown/MedStar, monitors influenza, COVID, RSV, and other pathogens during the World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップがアメリカに数百万人をもたらす。感染症リスクについて専門家は何と言っているか
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク疾患（エボラ、ハンタウイルス）が言及されているが、記事の主要な論点は「リスク評価」であり、実際の流行・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、国際大規模イベント関連の理論的リスク分析である。アメリカは対象国外のため、DRCおよびウガンダのアウトブレイク背景は記述されているが、詳細な現地情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はワールドカップに関連する理論的感染症リスク評価であり、実際の流行報告ではない。DRCでのエボラ・ハンタウイルスアウトブレイク、ウガンダでの懸念が背景として言及されているが、具体的な発病数、死亡数、拡大状況の詳細は記事に記載されていない。アメリカ（対象国外）での入国制限と監視体制が主な内容となっており、対象国はDRCのみ。WATCHレベルの判定は、IHR基準2つ該当（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）、WPRO基準2つ該当（長期曝露、流行可能性）、社会的関心の高さに基づいている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من استمرار تفشي إيبولا في شرق الكونغو الديموقراطية - أحداث.أنفو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of the ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo - AHDATH.INFO
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, as of June 11, 2026, due to the rare Bundibugyo strain with no licensed vaccine or treatment. Most cases are in Ituri province (northeast), with additional detections across 34 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO notes near-daily appearances of new health zones, reflecting ongoing spread. Health systems in the DRC remain weak and security concerns hamper responses, though the country has substantial Ebola experience, especially in areas currently affected. The response should prioritize capacity-building and trained personnel. Remaining gaps persist in high-risk areas, and the outbreak’s exact size remains unclear. Improvement is expected as surveillance, contact tracing, and testing are strengthened, particularly in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国東部におけるエボラ出血熱の継続的な流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱は国際公衆衛生上の最重要懸念疾患であり、ワクチン・治療法のない稀なBundibugyo株による進行中の流行。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の対象国での確認。676症例、136死亡、致死率約20%。ワクチン・治療法のないBundibugyo株で特に懸念。DRC東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）の34保健地区で検出。保健システムの脆弱性と治安上の課題が対応を阻害。WHO報告による継続的な新規患者・地域の出現が進行中の流行を示唆。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تؤكد استمرار انتشار فيروس "إيبولا" شرقي الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations confirms ongoing transmission of the Ebola virus in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 12, 2026, the United Nations confirms ongoing Ebola transmission in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with daily new cases emerging in new areas. Health authorities report 676 cases and 136 deaths over the past three weeks, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The outbreak’s scale reflects extensive regional population movement. UNICEF notes many youths are malnourished and unvaccinated against preventable diseases, increasing vulnerability. Response efforts include deploying over 1,600 health workers and 24 decontamination teams to reach more than 160,000 households, focusing on rapid case finding, pediatric care, contact tracing, and community awareness and engagement to curb transmission. The report underscores protecting children from the worst outcomes and maintaining close contact monitoring amid ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、民主共和国コンゴ東部でのエボラウイルスの継続的な蔓延を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生上極めて深刻な影響（死亡率20%以上）、予想外の急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクの全てを満たすシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirusによるアウトブレイク。過去3週間で676例、136死亡例が報告されており、東部地域で新規地域への拡大継続中。1,600以上の保健労働者とCEBS対応が展開されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、記事サマリーで明確にDRC東部での発生が述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: No new Nipah cases, 3 in hosp for observation: Kerala minister
article.articleSummary: One Nipah-positive case confirmed in Ramanattukara, Kozhikode district, Kerala: a 43-year-old man is undergoing treatment. No new Nipah cases detected in Kozhikode as of 12 June 2026. Three individuals under quarantine were admitted for observation and samples sent for testing. The patient received the first dose of monoclonal antibody treatment per ICMR guidelines, and a route map of the patient's movements has been published. A total of 87 people remain under surveillance, with 4 in the highest-risk, 16 in high-risk, and 67 in low-risk categories; contacts are being contacted twice daily. Health workers surveyed 286 houses in Ramanattukara ward 5; 12 fever cases found but none warranted Nipah suspicion. An NCDC team will visit Saturday; a district-level animal-health control room has been established to curb animal-to-human transmission, coordinating bat, pig farm and domestic-animal surveillance. Control room contact: 0495-2762050.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス新規患者なし、3人が入院観察中：ケララ州大臣
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高致死率の懸念がある重要疾患であり、IHR基準で異常性と国際拡大リスクが認められるが、現在は散発的な確認症例（1例）で流行が制御されている段階。情報不足を補うため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高致死率（40-75%）で知られ、バット・ブタ・ヒト経由の伝播リスクが存在する。現在はケララ州コジコデ地区で散発的確認であるが、動物由来感染対策が構築されており管理可能と判断される。国際拡大リスクは記事では言及されていないため「不明」とした。フルRRA前に追加情報（症例の臨床重症度、バット・ブタでの確認状況、他地域への拡大兆候）を収集することが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемия выходит из-под контроля: ВОЗ заявила, что реальное число зараженных Эболой скрыто
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic is out of control: WHO says the real number of people infected with Ebola is being concealed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding beyond official counts, according to WHO epidemiology chief Olivier Le Polen. The outbreak continues to grow in both case numbers and geographic spread, with daily new infections reported and briefings held in Bunia, Ituri Province. Full data from several affected districts are still unavailable, hindering surveillance. Hospital capacity is severely strained, with only about 250 beds for infected patients across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, leading to care in dedicated wards and medical isolation units. The government notes the current outbreak began on May 15; as of that date, 676 cases and 136 deaths had been reported in the country. Ebola virus disease causes acute hemorrhagic fever with fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding; transmission is from fruit bats to humans and then via contact with bodily fluids. There is no specific cure; core measures are strict isolation, supportive care, and safe burial practices.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に：WHOが実感染者数が隠蔽されていると発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が認められ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EVD）の大規模流行。DRC東部（イトゥリ州、南キヴ州、北キヴ州）で発生。WHO疫学責任者が実感染者数が公式発表より多いと指摘。感染者676名、死亡136名（5月15日時点）。病院の病床数（約250床）が極度に不足。動物→ヒト→ヒト感染のリスク継続。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreads to crowded displacement camp in Congo
article.articleSummary: First Ebola-related deaths have been confirmed in the Kpangba displacement camp in eastern Congo, housing about 30,000 internally displaced people. The outbreak has reached Ituri, South Kivu and North Kivu since the WHO declared a public health emergency on May 17. A 60-year-old woman in Kpangba tested positive on May 30 after leaving quarantine and could not be traced; she died May 31 and her daughter died June 1; both bodies tested positive posthumously. Eight contacts were identified for the mother, highlighting transmission risk in overcrowded camps where hundreds share a toilet and open defecation is common. In Ituri’s Kigonze camp, illness and deaths were reported but no confirmed Ebola cases at that time. As of 2026-06-12, Congo had 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; Uganda reported 19 cases. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴの混雑した避難民キャンプに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）、渡航制限リスクがあり、フルRRA対象
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した他地域（Uganda、Sierra Leone）について：ウガンダは19症例が確認されており国際的波及を示唆しているが、記事の主題はコンゴの避難民キャンプにおけるエボラ流行であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Sierra Leoneについてはサマリーに記載なし（APIの誤検出の可能性）。Bundibugyo株の出現は治療・予防手段がない点で懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ludhiana health department launches anti-dengue drive at bus depots & junkyards
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Ludhiana district health department launched an anti-dengue drive targeting high-risk breeding grounds across the city, including Punjab Roadways workshops, PRTC bus depots, and adjoining junkyards. Field teams inspected 9,422 houses and checked 21,843 water containers across 238 areas, uncovering and destroying mosquito larvae. The operation focused on stagnant water in discarded tyres, scrap material, and storage containers, with immediate destruction of larvae followed by anti-larval measures and spray activities to prevent dengue spread. Punjab Roadways workshops and 177 junkyards were covered. The frontline workforce comprised MPHWs, swasth sahayaks, breeding checkers, with nursing students providing field support; the effort was monitored by the district epidemiologist, Ayurvedic medical officer, and MP supervisors. In addition to spraying, teams conducted awareness activities to teach transport workers and residents to recognize dengue symptoms and maintain dry environments. Civil surgeon Dr Ramandeep Kaur emphasized collective responsibility and urged timely action.

triage.headline_ja: ルディアナ市保健局がバスターミナルと廃品置き場でデング熱対策キャンペーンを展開
triage.triage_reason: インドでのデング熱対策活動の報告だが、記事は予防的な施策内容であり、新規感染例の報告や感染拡大の急速な進展は述べられていない。情報が限定的なため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はルディアナ地区（パンジャブ州、インド）におけるデング熱の予防的対策活動を報告している。積極的な健康部門の取り組みが記載されており、政府の関心が高いことが示されているが、新規感染例数、死亡例、または感染の急速な拡大については明記されていない。デング熱は流行しやすい感染症であり、長期的な曝露リスクが存在するため、WATCH段階での継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola sigue extendiéndose en RD Congo, advierte la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to spread in the DRC, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread, with 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Most infections are concentrated in Ituri Province (northeast), but cases have emerged in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO officials warn the true scale is likely higher than detected due to population mobility and ongoing security and health-system challenges in the DRC, complicating response efforts. Surveillance is improving, with contact tracing now reaching just over 70% of contacts. The outbreak center includes Beni in North Kivu. In neighboring Uganda, Africa CDC reports the Ebola presence confirmed on May 15 is under control. Published 2026-06-12.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大を続けているとWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。ブンディブギョ株による676例の確定症例と136名の死亡、複数州への拡大、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダ確認）が認められ、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRC内の東部地域（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での発生が報告されており、ウガンダでの確認も言及されているが、主要な流行地はDRCである。Bundibugyo株であり、利用可能なワクチンや承認済み治療法がないため、対応が困難。人口移動と安全保障上の課題が検出困難性を増幅させている可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading into new areas in northeast DR Congo, WHO says
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding geographically and in case numbers. The Bundibugyo species outbreak, centered in Ituri with spillover into North Kivu and South Kivu, has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths since it was declared on May 15, with 119 suspected and 32 recoveries. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. WHO epidemiologist Olivier le Polain warned that isolation capacity is far below needs; current facilities total about 250 beds across the three provinces, insufficient for the scale and rising cases. New health zones report cases almost daily; early clusters traced to travel, now evident local community transmission amid high mobility and surveillance blind spots. About 70 percent of contacts are being traced. Cross-border spread to Uganda accounts for 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; AU says Uganda under control. Camps with cramped conditions and poor hygiene raise concern for rapid spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ東北部の新たな地域に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。進行中の大規模エボラ流行で国際的拡大・高い重症度・国境越え確認あり、フルRRA実施必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが列挙されているが、記事本体では19確定例と2死亡がウガンダへの越境伝播として言及されており、主たる流行地はDRC（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu）。DRCのみverified_locationsに含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、確定例676例・死亡136例、ワクチン・治療法なし、隔離キャパシティ不足、地域社会内伝播が進行中との記載あり。深刻な重大感染症事象。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: പകർച്ചവ്യാധി പടരുന്നു; ആരോഗ്യവകുപ്പിന്റെ ഏകോപനം പാളുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious disease spreading; the health department's coordination is breaking down.
article.articleSummary: Kerala faces simultaneous Nipah, Shigella, H1N1, and dengue outbreaks, prompting urgent calls for stronger disease control and heightened vigilance. Nipah was confirmed in Kozhikode via RT-PCR at Kozhikode Medical College; the health minister was on site but then returned to Thiruvananthapuram for a review, drawing criticism of coordination. Affected districts include Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Kozhikode, Wayanad, and Malappuram, with schoolchildren affected and a need to expand preventive measures. Reports of treatment delays and inadequate facilities persist in hospitals, including Perumpavur taluk hospital, and lapses at Trivandrum, Kozhikode, and Manjeri Medical College over the past weeks. Emphasizes monsoon sanitation lapses and school hygiene. Urges all-government levels to ensure drug availability, contact tracing, and cohesive action, reaffirming the science-based, Kerala-model approach that guided Nipah containment in 2018–2021 but faces current governance criticism from the opposition.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症が拡大している。保健部門の調整が崩れている。
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク病原体（ニパウイルス確定、H1N1、デング熱、シゲラ菌）が同時発生しており、複数県に広がり、医療施設での対応遅延が報告されている。IHR基準（重症度、異常性）とWPRO基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはコジコード医科大学にてRT-PCR確定済み。ケーラ州の複数地区（ティルヴァナンタプラム、コッラム、コジコード、ワイヤナド、マラプラム）に拡大。2018-2021年のニパウイルス対応実績がある地域での再発生であり、現在の保健部門調整不足が批判されている。記事は保健部門の危機対応能力への懸念を強調。

article.articleHeadline: ‫ الأمم المتحدة تؤكد استمرار انتشار فيروس إيبولا شرقي الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations confirms the continued spread of the Ebola virus in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 676 cases and 136 deaths reported over the past three weeks since the outbreak’s confirmation. Dr Olivier Le Bolan, head of WHO’s outbreak analytics unit, notes daily new cases in new areas, signaling widespread transmission amid large population movement. The Bundibugyo strain is involved. Many youths are malnourished and unimmunized, heightening pediatric vulnerability. UNICEF reports deployment of over 1,600 health workers and 24 cleaning teams to reach more than 160,000 households, prioritizing rapid case finding, high-quality pediatric care, contact tracing, and community engagement to curb transmission. Authorities warn infections among children may rise in the coming days as transmission persists in the region. Published 2026-06-12.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、民主共和国コンゴ東部でのエボラウイルス感染拡大の継続を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、また WPRO スクリーニング基準も5項目全てに該当。エボラウイルスの継続的な感染拡大、高い死亡率、ヒト-ヒト感染、国際的支援の展開が確認され、フルリスク評価（RRA）が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで DRC 東部でのエボラ発生が主題として明確に述べられている。過去3週間で 676 症例、136 死亡が報告されており、大規模人口移動、小児層の栄養不良・未予防接種状態、Bundibugyo 株の関与が確認されている。WHO、UNICEF による国際支援体制が展開中であり、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeita de Ebola é investigado por equipes médicas no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola is being investigated by medical teams in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: 64-year-old man, recently returned from Uganda, is under investigation for suspected Ebola in Rio Grande do Sul. He sought care in Novo Hamburgo on June 10 with symptoms compatible with the infection. Initial malaria testing (Plasmodium falciparum) was positive, but Ebola cannot be ruled out; samples have been sent to Fiocruz for definitive confirmation. He will be transferred to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre; advanced testing requires facilities at Adolfo Lutz and Evandro Chagas. Contacts monitored and biosafety protocols in place. Experts say there is no immediate risk of community spread; the concern centers on Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine yet, though Zaire vaccines exist and a Bundibugyo vaccine could be available by year-end. In São Paulo, a 31-year-old woman who visited North Kivu, DRC, is under investigation after a malaria rapid test; confirmation pending. A 37-year-old man from DRC suspected in RS has been ruled out.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのリオグランデドスル州で医療チームがエボラの疑いを調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種の可能性）の疑い事例がウガンダからの帰国者で報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大のリスク）を満たす。複数の対象国にまたがる事例の可能性があり、シグナルとして認識される。
triage.notes: 記事では、ウガンダからの帰国者がリオグランデドスル州でエボラの疑いで調査中。確定診断待機中。サンパウロではDRC北キブ訪問者が調査中。DRCは対象国リストに含まれているため含める。ウガンダはリスト外のため除外。Bundibugyo種エボラの可能性があり、ワクチン供給の問題を含む公衆衛生上の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: केरल : शिगेला के संक्रमण से महिला की मौत, 18 नए मामले सामने आए
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala: Woman dies from Shigellosis, 18 new cases reported.
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports 18 new Shigellosis cases on 12 June 2026, with a 59-year-old woman, Sarojini, dying from Shigella infection on 9 June at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital; laboratory confirmation followed. This brings Shigella-associated deaths in Kerala to two in the past month (one death previously last month). The state’s Shigella infections this year total 132, with 75 suspected cases pending confirmation. District-wise new cases include Wayanad: 7 (from Chulliyod), Kozhikode: 4 (Kattipara, Uliyari, Payyoli, Perambra), Malappuram: 3 (Adakkara, Morayur, Keezhattur), and Thrissur: 2 (Vaddakkancheri). Wayanad reports that all seven newly confirmed cases are linked to a school, taking the district’s infected students to 16. Health officials say surveillance, preventive measures, and awareness efforts have been intensified. Shigella is described as a virus-origin infection causing diarrhea, fever, and abdominal cramps, usually spread via contaminated food or water or through contact.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州：シゲラ感染による女性の死亡、18の新規患者が報告
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ症の集団発生で死亡例2件、累計132例、学校関連クラスター（16名の学生感染）を含む複数地域での拡大が確認されている。IHR基準では公衆衛生への影響（死亡・広範な拡大）と国際的拡大リスクで2基準該当。WPRO基準では異常性（同月内2死亡）、重症度（死亡例）、流行可能性（学校内クラスター、食水媒介）、管理可能性で複数基準該当。政府機関による対応強化も報告されている。
triage.notes: シゲラ症は細菌性疾患であるが、記事では「ウイルス由来感染」と記載されており、医学的記述に誤りがある可能性がある。複数地域（Wayanad、Kozhikode、Malappuram、Thrissur）での同時多発、学校クラスター、食水媒介の可能性が示唆されており、続報監視が重要。累計132例のうち75例が検査待ちであり、実患者数の増加可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: மாலத்தீவில் தட்டம்மை பரவல்: தடுப்பூசி மருந்து அனுப்பியது இந்தியா
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Tattammai in the Maldives: India sent a vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Spread of Tattammai in the Maldives accelerates as of 2026-06-12, with many people affected and receiving treatment. In response, India has sent aid to Maldives: 20,000 doses of tattammai vaccine and 3 tons of medical equipment. The relief reflects cross-border support to bolster the Maldives’ public health response to the outbreak. No specific case counts, fatalities, or laboratory confirmation details are provided in the article. The assistance aims to accelerate vaccination campaigns and strengthen clinical care to curb transmission and support health facilities overwhelmed by the surge. This demonstrates regional cooperation to address imported or emerging infectious threats and protect public health in the Indian Ocean region.

triage.headline_ja: モルディブでの麻疹流行：インドがワクチンを送付
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準4項目該当（異常性、長期曝露・多数者影響、流行しやすさ、管理能力の限界）。国境を超えた支援動員と地域協力の事例として社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはモルディブでの麻疹（Tattammai）流行を主題としているが、Maldives（ID: 1282028）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。ただしインドがモルディブへワクチン支援を行っている重要な地域協力事例であり、インドは対象国であるため PICKUP 判定。具体的な患者数・死亡数・検査確認は記載されていないため、severity は症状の重篤性と患者多数により Yes と評価。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Pours $50 Million Into Medical Defenses Against Rare Ebola Strain - Tampa Free Press
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia, Nyankunde) receives a new US push: $50 million to the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations for lab studies, clinical trials, and manufacturing of medical countermeasures. Total direct Ebola response funding by the State Department exceeds $270 million, with an additional $350 million in humanitarian aid to the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda for contact tracing, border screening, and community education. International Medical Corps and Medair support 100 health clinics and six Ebola treatment facilities; Ituri Province screening shows over 6,300 people across 24 facilities identified 41 suspected cases by early June, with new treatment centers being built in Bunia and Nyankunde. Safe and dignified burials are conducted by FHI 360 and the IFRC, with the Red Cross handling 200 burials by June 11. US guidance encourages Americans exposed or seeking to depart the region to use the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program.

triage.headline_ja: 米国が稀なエボラ株への医学防御に5000万ドルを投入 - タンパフリープレス
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認例を伴う多国間アウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。重症度高く、多数国への米国による大規模資金投入と国際的な対応体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に「Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo」と主要発生地が指定されている。DRC内Ituri Province（Bunia、Nyankunde）が中心。米国、ウガンダ、南スーダンは支援国・隣接国として言及されるが、実際の主要な患者発生地はDRCのみ確認。WPROスクリーニング基準全5項目該当。

article.articleHeadline: Carreta da Hanseníase realiza atendimentos e identifica novos casos da doença em Porto Velho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hansen's disease mobile clinic provides care and identifies new cases of Hansen's disease in Porto Velho.
article.articleSummary: Hansen's disease (leprosy) mobile clinic in Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil identified five new cases after outreach on June 9–10 at Praça CEU in the East Zone, with 55 clinical evaluations across 1.5 days. The mutirão is a joint effort of the Ministry of Health and the state government, with logistical support from Agevisa-RO and Semusa. Mayor Léo Moraes underscored bringing specialists to peripheral neighborhoods to strengthen primary care; Secretary Sandra Cardoso and the program coordinator Sheila Arruda stressed early detection to prevent permanent disabilities and to counter stigma through education. Hansen's disease is a chronic infection affecting skin and peripheral nerves; signs include pale or red patches, tingling, numbness, and reduced sensitivity. Treatments are free via SUS. After urban activities, the Carreta da Hanseníase will move to Vista Alegre do Abunã district on Friday, expanding to rural communities.

triage.headline_ja: ハンセン病移動医療クリニックがポルト・ベーリョで医療を実施し、新規症例を特定
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の新規症例が5件確認されていますが、この記事は公衆衛生キャンペーンとしての移動医療クリニックの活動報告です。異常な集団発生、重篤な症例、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の懸念がなく、IHR基準もWPRO基準も満たしていません。
triage.notes: 本件はハンセン病の既知疾患における定期的な早期発見・啓発活動です。新規症例5件は、移動医療クリニックによる主動的なスクリーニングの結果であり、突発的な集団発生ではありません。ハンセン病は慢性感染症で、早期治療で予防可能です。シグナル特性は認められません。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda controls Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) has 635 confirmed infections and 127 deaths since 15 May. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths over nearly a month, mostly Congolese cross-border arrivals, with the outbreak described as under control and 792 contacts under active follow-up. Africa CDC guidance calls for identifying at least 40 contacts per confirmed case; the DRC has traced under 5,000 contacts, far below the estimated 24,000. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. WHO declared an international health emergency over the DRC outbreak; Ugandan officials urge a ceasefire in eastern DRC to curb transmission. Ebola transmits via close contact and bodily fluids and has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の流行を抑制
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、DRCとウガンダにまたがる多国家アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUganda (GeoNames ID不在だが文脈から記事で言及)も含まれているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。DRCはIturi州での635確認症例・127死亡、ウガンダでの越境感染19例・2死亡と報告されている。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み、Africa CDCガイダンス、接触者追跡の不足（推定24,000に対し5,000未満）、特異的治療法・ワクチン欠落など多くの懸念要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos de Ebola confirmados sobe para 689 no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of confirmed Ebola cases rises to 689 in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo: As of June 12, 2026, the DRC reports 689 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 139 deaths. The figure reflects confirmed cases up to Thursday, per a government situation report that recorded 17 new infections in the past 24 hours, all in Ituri province, the region where the outbreak began. The update underscores ongoing transmission within Ituri, with no additional details on exposure settings or case origins provided. There is no information on laboratory confirmation methods beyond confirmation status, and no specific mention of imported or exported cases. The report is attributed to the DRC government and summarized by Reuters, with reporting by Amindeh Blaise Atabong.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの確認されたエボラウイルス病の症例数が689例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上極めて深刻、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。WPROスクリーニングでも全5項目該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は指定感染症かつIHRで報告義務のある疾患。DRC政府の公式報告に基づく症例数更新（689確認例、139死亡）。Ituri州で進行中の伝播が確認されており、過去24時間で17新規症例。死亡率約20%は極めて高い。国際的影響度が非常に高く、フルリスク評価（RRA）が必須。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Η επιδημία Έμπολα στο ανατολικό Κονγκό επεκτείνεται - 676 κρούσματα και 136 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo is expanding - 676 cases and 136 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported by the World Health Organization. The epidemic is spreading to new districts as population movement remains high. Ongoing insecurity and a weakened health system hinder response efforts and complicate surveillance, making it difficult to fully document the outbreak’s extent. The report emphasizes ongoing transmission in a setting marked by mobility and instability, which challenges public health authorities’ ability to track and respond effectively. The update is dated 12 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：東コンゴのエボラ流行が拡大 - 676例および136例の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラの拡大流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、トレード/渡航制限リスク、高い重症度を示す。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認感染676例、死亡136例（致命率20.1%）。東部DRCで拡大継続中。人口移動が高く、治安不安定により対応が困難。DRCは確認された発生地であり、対象国に含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Water sources in 87 villages in district contaminated, residents raise concerns
article.articleSummary: 132 drinking water sources across 87 villages in Pune district, Maharashtra, are contaminated, with the worst-hit Purandar, Baramati and Junnar. Microbial testing from a May district-wide surveillance drive found several sources unfit for consumption; authorities are disinfecting sources, enforcing repeat tests, and declaring water safe only after satisfactory results. As monsoon approaches, contamination raises risk of diarrhoea, gastroenteritis, typhoid and hepatitis, particularly when runoff waters enter wells and open sources. Public health measures include chlorination by gram panchayats, advisories to boil water, and hygiene campaigns around wells and storage tanks. Residents report muddy, yellow, foul-smelling water in Baramati; others rely on public wells and pumps. People demand reliable piped water rather than temporary fixes. Officials warn the weeks ahead will test preventive actions against a potential outbreak for thousands dependent on these sources.

triage.headline_ja: 地区の87村の水源が汚染、住民が懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: 複数の水因性疾患（腸チフス、肝炎）に関連した大規模水汚染イベント。87村132箇所の飲料水源の汚染は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示し、季節的リスク（モンスーン）増加に伴う拡大のリスクがある。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはマハラシュトラ州プネ地区における87村の飲料水汚染を主題としており、水因性感染症（腸チフス、肝炎、下痢、胃腸炎）の発生リスクが明記されている。モンスーン時期の臨界的な環境衛生危機として、当局の対応能力試験という観点から社会・政治的関心が高い。複数の町村（Purandar, Baramati, Junnar）が明示的に記載されており、Uttar Pradesh の Purandar Chhapra も言及されているが、記事の主体は Maharashtra の Pune district である。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا إلى 689
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo: Confirmed Ebola cases rise to 689.
article.articleSummary: According to government data published on June 12, 2026, confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 689, with 139 deaths. These totals reflect confirmed cases up to Thursday. In the last 24 hours, 17 new cases were recorded, all in Ituri Province, where the outbreak originally began. The update indicates ongoing transmission concentrated in Ituri, highlighting the persistence of this outbreak in that hotspot.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラウイルスの確定患者数が689例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。致死率20%超、継続的なヒト-ヒト感染、DRCは対象国。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 2026年6月時点で689確定例、139死亡（致死率約20.2%）、過去24時間で17新規例、Ituri州に集中。継続的なヒト-ヒト感染ありでWPRO全基準該当。アラビア語ソースからの報道で国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Women, Girls Majority of Ebola Cases in DRC, Uganda
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda total 457, with women and girls making up 244 cases (53.4%). Among adolescents, girls account for 27 of 37 lab-confirmed cases (over 61%). The pattern mirrors prior outbreaks, with transmission concentrated in caregiving, domestic labor, frontline health work, and burial practices that keep women and girls in close contact during infectious stages. Historically, the DRC’s 2018–2019 outbreak saw women and girls represent about two-thirds of cases, and the 1976 outbreak-era deaths were 56% female. Calls for stronger primary health care, PPE access, prevention supplies, and women’s leadership in community Ebola awareness and prevention. UN Women supports women-led organizations and crisis communication to counter misinformation; sustained funding enables early detection and safe care. WHO data as of 7 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRCとウガンダのエボラ病例の過半数が女性・少女
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認患者数457名、複数国への拡大、高い致死率を持つ疾患という特性から IHR基準2つ以上該当。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行リスク・管理可能性が明確。国際的関心が高く、WHO・UN Women の支援活動が記載されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は DRC および Uganda でのエボラ発生を述べている。発生地域フィールドに Uganda が含まれているが、対象国リストに Uganda（226074）は含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。DRC（203312）のみ該当。2026年6月時点での感染者数457名、死亡率の言及はないが、歴史的背景から致死率が高い疾患であることは明白。女性・少女への不均等な感染パターンは公衆衛生対応上の重要な課題を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل إصابات جديدة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports new Ebola infections.
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 689 confirmed Ebola infections, including 139 deaths, all from the rare Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or therapy. The tally reflects confirmed cases up to yesterday, with 17 new cases in the last 24 hours, all in Ituri Province where the outbreak began. The World Health Organization warned the outbreak persists in eastern DRC as cases rise and the virus spreads to new areas. Most infections are in Ituri (northeast), but detections have occurred across 34 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. UNHCR reported two Ebola-related deaths in a refugee camp in eastern DRC, as aid workers caution about accelerated transmission risk in refugee sites.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラウイルスの新規感染者を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の確認患者689名（死亡139名）、ワクチン・治療法なし、難民キャンプでの感染拡大懸念があり、国際的公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はまれであり、利用可能なワクチンや治療法がない。難民キャンプでの感染は地域的な管理可能性を低下させる。34の保健ゾーンにまたがる複数県での検出は、制御困難なシナリオを示唆している。WHOの警告およびUNHCRの報告により国際的な関心が高い。
