article.articleHeadline: Cruise Outbreak Reveals Hantavirus Agricultural Threat
article.articleSummary: May 2, 2026: WHO confirms Andes virus infections aboard the MV Hondius in the Atlantic, with the CDC issuing a Health Alert Network advisory; cruise-linked cases subsequently reported in South Africa, the Netherlands, Paris, and Tristan da Cunha. Hantaviruses are zoonotic RNA viruses causing hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) in Asia/Europe and hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) in the Americas, with HPS fatality up to 40%. The event underscores rodent-contaminated farming environments as a major exposure risk for millions of agricultural workers. A 2025 Vietnam serosurvey of 210 wildlife farmers found hantavirus seroprevalence of 10.1%, active IgM infections in Dong Nai, and wildlife farming as a significant risk factor (OR 2.7). In China, 70–90% of global HFRS cases occurred; 2004–2019 saw 209,209 cases and 1,855 deaths, with farmers comprising 64.6% of 2023 cases. Dominant Chinese hantaviruses are Hantaan (Apodemus agrarius) and Seoul (Rattus norvegicus), linked to rice paddies, grain stores, and livestock housing with spring/autumn peaks. A One Health approach and broader vaccination (HTNV/SEOV) are urged to mitigate this persistent occupational hazard.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船での集団発生がハンタウイルスの農業的脅威を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の多国間拡大、国際的な渡航関連リスク）。さらにWPRO基準も複数該当し、中国・ベトナムを含む農業労働者への重篤なリスク（HPS致死率40%、中国で年間数千例）と国際的な社会的関心が高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はクルーズ船でのAndes virus感染事例から始まるが、主題はアジア（特に中国・ベトナム）における農業労働者への慢性的なハンタウイルス脅威。中国では2004-2019年に20万例超、ベトナム2025年調査で10.1%の血清陽性率を報告。対象国リスト外の南アフリカ・オランダ・パリ・スペインでのクルーズ関連症例も報告されているが、verified_locationsは対象国のみ列挙。One Health接近と予防接種拡大が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: ΗΠΑ: Δίνει επιπλέον 50 εκατ. για την καταπολέμηση του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US: Provides an additional $50 million to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the United States will provide $50 million to CEPI to accelerate countermeasures against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, in response to the current Africa-wide outbreak. The funding will support laboratory studies, clinical trials, and the production of candidate therapeutics and diagnostics for Bundibugyo Ebola virus. This raises the State Department's immediate Ebola-related funding to $270 million, with CEPI already pledging more than $60 million to a portfolio of four candidate vaccines and evaluating additional options. No approved vaccines exist for Bundibugyo at present. In the ongoing outbreak, the Democratic Republic of Congo has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, while Uganda reports 19 cases as the cross-border spread continues and frontline responders race to regain ground.

triage.headline_ja: 米国：エボラ対策に5000万ドルの追加資金を提供
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）のアフリカ規模の流行で、DRC676例・136死亡、ウガンダ19例の確定患者が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）の複数該当、およびWPRO基準（高重症度・流行リスク・管理課題）の複数該当。国際的な研究開発・資金投入の話題として政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。米国による資金提供の記事だが、実際の流行発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスは稀な株系統であり、認可ワクチン・治療法が未確立で管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: US to provide $50mn more in funding to counter Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: US provides $50 million to CEPI to accelerate medical countermeasures for Bundibugyo Ebola strain, including laboratory studies, clinical trials, and manufacturing for candidate therapies. Total U.S. Ebola response funding rises to $270 million. CEPI has committed over $60 million to four vaccine candidates and is evaluating additional options. With no licensed vaccines against Bundibugyo virus, the investment aims to speed development to control the current outbreak and bolster defenses against future Bundibugyo epidemics. As of 2026-06-12, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with the outbreak spreading to Uganda, which has 19 cases. The outbreak went undetected for weeks, and responders are racing to catch up. These funds support rapid countermeasure development and manufacturing capacity for potential vaccines and treatments.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱対策に5000万ドル追加資金を提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。進行中の多国間アウトブレイクで国際支援が活動化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国とCEPIの資金投入を主題としているが、実際のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの発生地はDRC（676確認例、136死亡）およびウガンダ（19例）。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株による多国間アウトブレイクで、未承認ワクチン開発の加速化により国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya to comply with court order on Ebola facility as outbreak spreads in region
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Kenya will comply with a court order temporarily stopping the Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki. Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale warned he will not hesitate to invoke sections of the Public Health Act to enforce stricter measures if a positive Ebola case is confirmed within Kenya. The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to 676 cases with 136 deaths and has spread to neighboring Uganda. The Kenyan response emphasizes containment within legal limits, with vigilance for domestic cases and potential escalation if Ebola enters Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラ施設に関する裁判所命令に従うと発表、地域での感染拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は極めて高い致死率と国際的脅威を持つ疾患であり、DRCで676例・136死亡という重大な流行が確認され、ウガンダへの波及が報告されている。ケニアが対応措置を準備していることから、IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行（676例、136死亡）とウガンダへの波及を主題としており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ケニアはサマリー内で対応国として言及されているが、サマリーには「ケニア国内で確認されたエボラ患者」の報告はなく、準備段階の対応が記載されているため、ケニアは発生地域ではなく対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。ウガンダへの波及についても、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 676 إصابة و136 وفاة.. إيبولا يواصل الانتشار في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 676 cases and 136 deaths... Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns Ebola is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths from the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Most cases are in Ituri province, with additional cases in 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. New infections are reported almost daily in more health zones, signaling the outbreak’s expanding reach. Weak health systems and ongoing security challenges hinder containment, though DRC has substantial experience with past Ebola waves. Priorities include strengthening the local workforce and technical capacity and deploying experienced personnel. Gaps persist in high-risk areas, and the total scope remains not fully clear. Improved surveillance, contact tracing, and testing are needed to map spread, especially in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: 676例と136死亡例...エボラがコンゴ民主共和国での拡大を継続
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる確認症例676例・死亡136例で極めて重篤。ワクチン・認可治療法なし。複数州での急速拡大と国際的拡大リスク。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはまれな株であり、利用可能なライセンス済みワクチンや承認済み治療法がない。Ituri州が主な発生地で、34の保健ゾーンに拡大。セキュリティ上の課題と脆弱な保健体制が対応を阻害。WHO警告により国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Médecins Sans Frontières rappelle qu'il est possible de guérir d'Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Doctors Without Borders reminds us that it is possible to recover from Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province. Four weeks after the 17th Ebola epidemic was officially declared in the DRC, the situation remains serious but not hopeless. As of 12 June 2026, the country reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with eight new recoveries in the last week bringing total recoveries to 30. The number of affected health zones has surged from three to 34 in a week, underscoring rapid spread across Ituri. MSF and partners warn against fatalism, stressing that Ebola is not inevitably lethal; with symptomatic treatment and specialized care, patients can survive even without a virus-specific cure. Early detection and rapid care improve prognosis and reduce transmission. Ongoing awareness campaigns aim to reduce stigma and encourage reporting of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | 国境なき医師団がエボラから回復することが可能であることを改めて強調 | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当し、エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行が東部コンゴ民主共和国で報告されている。確認症例676例、死亡136例、急速な地理的拡大（3から34の保健地域への拡大）が示されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の急速拡大パターンが認識される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最も深刻な感染症の一つであり、IHR通知義務の典型的な対象疾患。現在のDRCでの流行は17番目のエボラ流行として公式宣言されており、1週間で影響を受ける保健地域が3から34に急増した点は特に懸念される。MSFを含む複数の国際機関が関与しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 网传澳门出现非洲埃博拉病毒确诊病例？卫生局已紧急报案追责！官方：已全力做好各项准备工作防范输入..._手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Online rumors claim confirmed cases of the African Ebola virus in Macau? The Health Bureau has urgently filed a report and is pursuing accountability! Official: Has done its utmost to prepare all measures to prevent importation...
article.articleSummary: Macau's Health Bureau denies any confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases in Macau after circulating rumors triggered public alarm. The Bureau has filed a report with the Judiciary Police to identify and prosecute spreaders of false information, confirming all local infectious-disease updates come from official channels. Despite Africa's new Ebola outbreak and the World Health Organization designating it as a public health emergency of international concern, Macau assesses local risk as low due to limited cross-border traffic. Preparedness measures cover border controls, medical response, and community outreach: enhanced temperature screening and health assessments at major entry points; rapid isolation and testing for suspected cases; strict infection-control practices in healthcare settings; and guidance for travelers to avoid wildlife and disclose travel history. The Bureau will continue coordinating with WHO and regional health authorities and adjust measures as risk evolves.

triage.headline_ja: マカオでアフリカのエボラウイルス確定症例が出現したとの噂？衛生局は緊急に報告と責任追及を実施！当局：輸入防止のための各種準備作業を全力で実施中...
triage.triage_reason: エボラは極めて深刻な疾患だが、記事サマリーは「マカオでは確定症例なし、うわさは虚偽」と明確に述べている。アフリカでの新規発生は言及されているが、マカオ/中国での実際の感染イベントではない。ただし感染症危機管理の観点から、エボラの国際公開衛生上の緊急事態指定と予防措置の記載があるため、続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はマカオ/中国でのエボラ確定症例の『否定』である。アフリカでのエボラ発生はWHO公開衛生上の緊急事態として言及されているが、対象国リスト内での実際の発生イベントではない。虚偽情報の拡散という社会的関心と公式の予防措置の強化が確認されるため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。実際の患者発生報告がなければDISMISSに移行する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola é transferido de UPA de Novo Hamburgo para hospital de Porto Alegre | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola transferred from Novo Hamburgo's UPA to a hospital in Porto Alegre | abc+.
article.articleSummary: A 64-year-old man in Rio Grande do Sul is under investigation for suspected Ebola after presenting at UPA Canudos in Novo Hamburgo on June 10. He was transferred in isolation to Hospital Nossa Senhora da Conceição in Porto Alegre on June 12, with an ambulanced fitted isolation barriers escorted by municipal guards and the Federal Highway Police along BR-116 to the hospital. The State Health Secretariat confirmed on June 11 that a suspected Ebola case is being investigated in Rio Grande do Sul. Although malaria testing returned positive and treatment began, Ebola protocol remained in place pending laboratory confirmation. The patient had recently returned from Uganda. Samples were sent to Fiocruz for confirmation, and authorities initiated 30-day contact monitoring as part of epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者がノーボ・ハンブルゴのUPAからポルトアレグレの病院に転院 | abc+
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ疑い患者の検査確認待ちであり、ウガンダからの帰国者であることから国際的懸念が存在。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIではウガンダが発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーから患者の発症地はブラジル（Rio Grande do Sul州）であり、ウガンダは疫学的リンク（患者の最近の渡航歴）として言及されているのみ。したがってverified_locationsはBrazilのみ。エボラ疑い患者であり、Fiocruzでの検査確認待ち段階。30日間の接触者監視が開始されている。同時にマラリア陽性も確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Caso suspeito de Ebola é investigado no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A suspected case of Ebola is being investigated in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: A 64-year-old man in Novo Hamburgo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, is under investigation for Ebola after returning from Uganda with compatible symptoms. A rapid malaria test was positive, but Brazilian health authorities are following surveillance protocols to rule out Ebola; samples will be sent to Fiocruz for confirmation. He was moved to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre and, if confirmed, will be transferred to a national reference hospital; the patient’s identity remains undisclosed. A second suspected Ebola case is being investigated in São Paulo, and contacts will be monitored for 30 days. The WHO declared a global emergency on May 17 amid Ebola outbreaks in Africa; Uganda and Congo report cases. Uganda had at least 515 confirmed cases and 91 deaths as of June 8. The circulating strain lacks a specific vaccine, with PAHO noting 55–60% mortality; transmission occurs via bodily fluids, with incubation 2–21 days, and contagion begins with symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのリオグランデ・ド・スル州で疑いのあるエボラ患者が調査されている
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの帰国者にエボラの症状が疑われており、IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度と流行しやすさに該当。また、WHO が5月17日にグローバル緊急事態を宣言しており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要なイベントはブラジル（リオグランデ・ド・スル州およびサンパウロ州）での疑い症例の調査である。ウガンダとコンゴでのアウトブレイクが背景にあるが、本トリアージの対象はブラジルでの疑い症例に限定した。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはDRC（203312）とウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、これらは背景情報であり、実際の感染症イベントはブラジルで発生している。

article.articleHeadline: 27 suspected jaundice, 10 hepatitis A cases jolt Patiala
article.articleSummary: 27 suspected jaundice cases and 10 confirmed Hepatitis A in Patiala's Dogra Mohalla near Sirhindi Gate; one Hepatitis E detected; samples tested at IDSP lab Mata Kaushalya Hospital; area of about 243 households, ~1,119 residents; ages 4–48; five hospitalized. Surveillance intensified with door-to-door checks for the third day. Water testing started with five initial H2S samples; 15 additional samples sent for detailed analysis; state lab results in Kharar awaited. ASHA and ANM teams tracing symptoms and educating residents; chlorine tablets distributed and ORS provided; medical camp for testing and treatment. Deputy Commissioner Himanshu Aggarwal orders thorough inquiry, Navreet Kaur Sekhon to lead; pipelines inspected; leaks suspected to allow sewage into water. BJP criticizes handling of sewage-water issues.

triage.headline_ja: 27例の疑い黄疸症例と10例のA型肝炎がパティアラを揺るがす
triage.triage_reason: A型肝炎とE型肝炎の確認事例、および多数の疑い黄疸症例が同一地域で集中発生。水道水の汚染が疑われ、住民1,119人が曝露リスクにさらされており、継続的な公衆衛生脅威がある。
triage.notes: パティアラはインド・パンジャブ州内の都市。水道水汚染が原因と疑われる多発事例であり、ウイルス性肝炎（A型・E型）の共同発生は管理可能性の評価上重要。地元当局の公式調査が開始されており、フルRRA対象として適切。

article.articleHeadline: SUA alocă 50 de milioane de dolari pentru dezvoltarea de vaccinuri și tratamente împotriva unei tulpini rare de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States allocates $50 million for the development of vaccines and treatments against a rare strain of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: United States to provide $50 million to the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) to develop vaccines and treatments against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus fueling the outbreak in Africa. Funds will support laboratory studies, clinical trials, and the production of vaccines and other candidate therapeutics against Bundibugyo. This investment brings total direct US government funding for Ebola response to $270 million. CEPI has already allocated over $60 million to support a portfolio of four vaccine candidates and is reviewing additional options. CEPI CEO Richard Hatchett said that, in the absence of approved vaccines for Bundibugyo, rapid action is essential to accelerate lifesaving measures and strengthen global preparedness against future Bundibugyo epidemics. As of 2026-06-12, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with Uganda reporting 19 cases; the outbreak had remained undetected for weeks, and response teams aim to recover lost time.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラウイルスの稀な株に対するワクチンと治療法の開発に5,000万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な株、複数国での国際的拡大、対応に多額の国家資金投入）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。確認された死亡者と複数国での発生により高いリスク。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyo株エボラウイルスのアフリカでの発生に関するもの。DRC（676確定症例、136死亡）とウガンダ（19症例）での発生が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含。米国は資金提供国であり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。稀な株（Bundibugyo）の出現とワクチン不在による緊急対応が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: கேரளத்தில் பரவும் பன்றிக் காய்ச்சல்: தமிழக எல்லைப் பகுதிகளில் மருத்துவ முகாம் அமைக்க பொதுமக்கள் வலியுறுத்தல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine fever spreading in Kerala: People urge setting up medical camps in Tamil Nadu border areas
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, swine fever (H1N1) is spreading in Mariyapuram near Cheruthoni, Idukki district, Kerala, along the Tamil Nadu border. An 82-year-old woman, Mariyamma, died from swine fever. Two other residents tested positive for swine fever, while three more are under intensive medical surveillance. Health authorities have conducted door-to-door surveys in about 200 households and intensified preventive measures. The outbreak emerges as the southwest monsoon begins, with rising animal-to-human transmission noted. Public pressure is urging the setup of medical camps in Tamil Nadu border areas to bolster surveillance and containment.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラー州で拡大する豚インフルエンザ：タミルナードゥ州国境地域への医療キャンプ設置を公共の声が要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響：死亡例・複数感染者、予想外：季節的な動物由来感染症の急増、国際的拡大リスク：国境地域での発生）。WPRO基準でも4つ該当。対象国インドでの確認シグナル。
triage.notes: H1N1人獣共通感染による死亡例が確認され、季節的要因（モンスーン）による動物由来感染の増加傾向が指摘されている。国境地域（タミルナードゥ州との境界）での発生のため、越境感染のリスク評価が必要。医療体制の強化が関係者から要求されている点が社会政治的関心を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: നിപാ: 3 പേർകൂടി ആശുപത്രിയിൽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah: 3 more people hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Nipah update from Kozhikode, Kerala: A Nipah-infected Farook College resident remains in critical condition. The medical board has given the first dose of monoclonal antibody therapy; a second dose is due within 48 hours. Three more contacts were hospitalised on Friday, increasing the contact list to 87: 4 in ICU, 16 in high-dependency unit, and 67 in general wards. No new Nipah cases have been reported. An ICMR expert team will visit on Saturday to study the outbreak and collect samples. The three previously exposed patients were admitted yesterday and their samples sent for testing. In Ramanattukara municipality, 286 households were surveyed; 12 fever cases were found but none show Nipah symptoms. Because Nipah triage is not yet activated, the Medical College emergency department is examining fever patients and referring suspected cases to contact isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ニパー：3名がさらに入院
triage.triage_reason: ニパールウイルス感染症は高い死亡率と国際的な懸念のある病原体であり、複数の入院患者と接触者追跡が進行中。IHR基準2つ以上（異常性、重症度）に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ニパールウイルスはフィロウイルス科の高リスク病原体（致死率40～75%）。インド・ケーララ州コジコード地区での初期段階の集団感染と推定される。ICMR専門家チームが現地調査予定。接触者87名の一部が入院・隔離中で、能動的なサーベイランスが進行中。ニパール対応プロトコルの正式発動前段階だが、医療機関の対応体制が整備されている。

article.articleHeadline: UAE Provides Support To Contain Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, the UAE provides support to the World Health Organization to contain the Ebola outbreak in Africa, via the UAE Aid Agency, under President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan's directives. The initiative backs international relief amid the Bundibugyo cross-border Ebola virus strain in Africa, with UAE pledging medical aid, approved vaccines, and essential medications, coordinating with governments and UN bodies to bolster treatment centres. UAE's Minister of State, Sheikh Shakhbout bin Nahyan Al Nahyan, underscored ongoing humanitarian efforts to combat epidemics and protect communities. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak remains out of control, citing challenges in isolating and monitoring contacts and the need for high isolation rates (about 90%) to halt spread. The statement emphasizes international collaboration with UAE's health support and partnerships to strengthen containment.

triage.headline_ja: UAEがエボラ流行の抑制を支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの流行がコンゴ民主共和国で発生し、WHO事務局長が「制御不能」と警告している。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行のしやすさ・管理可能性に該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月12日の日付で、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）が主題。WHO事務局長が制御不能状態を警告しており、接触者の隔離・監視に課題があり約90%の隔離率が必要とされている。UAEが国際支援を提供している。対象国の中ではDRCのみが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: MPF participa de reunião sobre plano estadual para resposta a casos suspeitos de gripe aviária em Alagoas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Federal Public Ministry participates in a meeting on the state plan to respond to suspected avian influenza cases in Alagoas.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Federal Public Ministry (MPF) participated in a Maceió meeting to refine an Alagoas State Action Plan for suspected or confirmed highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) cases. The session, led by Promoter Alberto Fonseca and with Roberta Bomfim, Procuradora da República, gathered environmental, agro-pecuary defense, and public health representatives to standardize identification, notification, and rapid response for wild or domestic birds showing IAAP symptoms. Health authorities including CIEVS, Sesau, and Lacen urged timely sharing of laboratory results to monitor potential human exposure. MPF will request clarifications from Adeal on current notification procedures to improve interagency communication. The evolving workflow assigns initial response to BPA, Adeal, Instituto Biota, and CCZ in Maceió, with health agencies (Sesau, municipal health secretaries, Lacen) handling human exposure. Citizens are advised not to approach or capture sick or dead birds and to report sightings to environmental or health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル連邦公検察庁がアラゴアス州の鳥インフルエンザ疑い症例対応の州行動計画に関する会議に参加
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザの複数型（H5N2、H5N1、H5N6等）がブラジルで確認・疑い報告されており、異常性と長期曝露リスクが存在するが、記事の焦点は対応計画の策定段階であり、現在の発生規模・重症度の詳細が不明。追加情報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル（対象国リストに含まれる）でHPAI複数型の疑い・確認事例が報告されている。記事は州・連邦レベルの対応計画策定に焦点を当てており、実際の症例数や重症度、人への感染リスクについての詳細情報が不足している。野生鳥および家畜への拡大リスク、継続的な人獣共通感染症曝露の可能性が指摘されている点から、スクリーニング基準3項目以上に該当。ただし現在段階での発生規模や社会的パニックレベルが不明であるため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة رم : الكونغو: ارتفاع الإصابات المؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا إلى 689
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RAM Agency: Congo: Confirmed Ebola cases rise to 689.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 689, with 139 deaths reported. The figures reflect totals up to Thursday, according to a RAM Agency situation report cited on Friday. The update records 17 new cases in the previous 24 hours, all located in Ituri province, the region where the outbreak’s first cases were identified. These figures underscore ongoing transmission centered in Ituri, highlighting the continuing challenge for outbreak response efforts in this province. No further details on laboratory confirmation, exposure sources, or imported/exported cases are provided in the report. The numbers indicate a sustained phase of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: RAM通信社：コンゴ：エボラウイルス病の確認患者数が689人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。確認患者689人、死亡139人という重篤な状況が継続中。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の急速な事例増加（689人、死亡139人）、Ituri州での持続的な感染、24時間で17新規患者との報告。世界的なPHEIC関心事として継続監視が必要。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: In eastern Congo, trust becomes a key tool in addressing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Congo’s Ituri province has produced over 500 confirmed cases since identification in late April, with the outbreak prompting CDC warnings that failure to contain could become one of the largest on record. In Rwampara, Congo, a late-May crowd mourned Eli Munongo and stormed a hospital compound when burial at home was blocked, illustrating anger toward responders. Anthropologist Julienne Anoko, working with WHO, argues that trust is as essential as medical measures. A decade of frontline outreach shows that compassion matters: she once crawled into a body bag to understand communities, and studies suggest local acceptance rises when responders acknowledge local realities and cultures. Ituri’s war-torn history, displacement, and a steady influx of outsiders fuel suspicion about resource distribution. Trust-building is presented as central to outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ対策の鍵となる信頼
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：500人以上の確認症例、異常かつ予想外、国際拡大リスク）。エボラは対象国DRCで発生しており、フルRRA評価が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)の通知義務対象疾患。DRCのIturi州で4月下旬以降500人以上の確認症例が報告されており、CDCは封じ込め失敗時には過去最大規模の流行となる可能性を警告している。記事ではルワンダ（Kigali Province）も地名として登場するが、サマリー本文ではDRC内での状況説明が主体であり、ルワンダでの実際の発生は記述されていないため verified_locations には含めない。信頼構築の重要性が強調されており、対応の複雑性と国際的な関心の高さが明白。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго количество умерших от лихорадки Эбола достигло 139
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, the number of deaths from Ebola fever has reached 139.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports an ongoing Ebola outbreak with 139 deaths and 689 confirmed cases as of June 12, 2026, according to TASS citing the Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media in its daily bulletin. The report provides no district-level breakdown or details on transmission chains, laboratory confirmation methods, or imported/exported cases. The figures reflect the latest official update, signaling sustained Ebola activity in the country. No information on symptoms beyond generic Ebola fever is provided in the bulletin. The data underscore the severity of the current outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the need for continued public health surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱死者数が139人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的拡大リスクを有する指定感染症であり、IHR基準の2つ以上（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当する。継続中の流行を示す公式統計報告。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率（本件では20.2%）を示す生物学的脅威。DRC保健省の公式日次報告により確認された継続中の流行。国際的なスクリーニングおよび支援要件の対象。WPROスクリーニング基準全てに該当。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns Congo Ebola outbreak may be far larger than official figures
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain may be far larger than official figures, with blind spots in high-risk areas and a severe bed shortage of 250 isolation beds across three affected regions. As of June 11–12, 2026, Kinshasa reported expansion to three new health districts, totaling 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths. The outbreak has crossed into neighboring Uganda; in Congo's Kabanga refugee camp, two Ebola-related deaths were recorded among 30,000 displaced people, signaling extremely high transmission risk in crowded camps. Bundibugyo virus has no approved treatment or vaccine; WHO has not released final size estimates, while CDC has warned it could reach the scale of West Africa's 2014–2016 outbreak (over 11,000 deaths). Three Ebola virus types exist—Ebola virus, Sudan virus and Bundibugyo virus—with Bundibugyo currently lacking specific therapies.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラアウトブレイク、公式数字より大幅に大きい可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準5つ全て該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性、管理可能性）。高い社会政治的関心とともに、複数国にまたがる大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、即座にフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）を主題としており、Kinshasa、Kabanga難民キャンプでの発生状況を記述。ウガンダへの越境拡大が記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。2026年6月時点で676確認例、136死亡。治療法・ワクチン未承認。西アフリカ2014-2016年アウトブレイク規模への懸念。

article.articleHeadline: UAE ramps up humanitarian health aid to combat Ebola in Africa
article.articleSummary: UAE, under President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, via the UAE Aid Agency, provides support to the World Health Organization to contain the Ebola outbreak in Africa, focusing on the Bundibugyo cross-border Ebola virus strain. The UAE aims to double international efforts to prevent transmission among different age groups in Africa, in partnership with governments and UN organizations. It continues medical aid, vaccine shipments, and medications, and collaborates with international and local groups to deliver care at designated treatment centres. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak remains out of control, citing challenges in isolating and monitoring contacts and stressing the need for 90% isolation to halt contagion.

triage.headline_ja: UAE、アフリカのエボラ対策に人道支援・保健支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が対象国（DRC）で報告され、WHOも制御不能と指摘。IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の3基準に該当し、国際支援の必要性も明確。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、DRCでのエボラ流行が主題。UAE（対象国外）は支援国として言及されているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCのみ。WHOトップが制御不能との警告を発出しており、緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: நிபா வைரஸ்: நீலகிரி எல்லையில் சிறப்புக் குழுக்கள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus: Special teams at the Nilgiris border
article.articleSummary: On 12 June 2026, Nipah virus fever has been confirmed in Kerala state. At the Nilgiris border, special teams have been formed and precautionary measures intensified, according to district collector Lakshmi Pavya Thannera on Friday. The report indicates a focused public health response at the border with Kerala, though it does not provide additional details on case counts, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources. The actions reflect heightened vigilance by local authorities to manage Nipah virus risk at the state boundary. No further information on the scope of the outbreak or confirmed transmission is provided in the brief.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス：ニルギリ山脈の国境に特別チームが展開
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスはIHR Annex2基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（高い致死率）、異常性、国際的拡大リスクを満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の懸念があり、インドの主要なシグナルとして対応が必要。
triage.notes: ケララ州でのニパウイルス確認を報告。ニルギリ山脈の州境での特別チーム配置は州間での感染拡大を懸念していることを示唆。症例数、検査確認、感染源の詳細は記事サマリーに記載なし。ニパウイルスは高い致死率（40-75%）と限定的な治療オプションで知られており、過去のアウトブレイクは南アジアで国際的関心を集めている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta sobre expansión del brote de Ébola en República Democrática del Congo - Correo del Orinoco | La Artillería del Pensamiento |Noticias de ...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the expansion of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Correo del Orinoco | La Artillería del Pensamiento | News from ....
article.articleSummary: June 12, 2026 — The World Health Organization warns of expanding Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The Congolese Ministry of Health reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths to date, with transmission widening geographically. The outbreak is due to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment. Factors hindering response include high population mobility, fragile health systems, and armed-group activity in the region. The neighboring country Uganda reports 19 cases and two deaths, with 14 infections imported from the DRC. WHO cautions that the virus could reach densely populated areas and cross international borders, maintaining strict surveillance and urging strengthened prevention and control measures to avert a larger regional public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、高い公衆衛生上の脅威。確認例676例、死亡136例、ウガンダへの越境感染、地域的拡大と国際的波及のリスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部でのエボラ出血熱拡大を報じており、ウガンダへの越境感染（19例、死亡2例）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株で利用可能なワクチンがない点、武装勢力の活動など対応阻害要因が明記されており、地域的公衆衛生上の緊急事態への進展リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ για Έμπολα: "Άγνωστη η πλήρης κλίμακα της εξάπλωσης στη Λαϊκή Δημοκρατία του Κονγκό"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO on Ebola: "The full extent of the spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is unknown."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains incompletely understood, with the World Health Organization warning that the full extent of spread is unknown as of June 12, 2026. An epidemiologist based in Beni, in eastern DRC, cautioned that numerous uncharted foci—blind spots—persist across the affected region, hindering precise assessment of case numbers and geographic reach. The lack of complete surveillance means transmission dynamics and outbreak size cannot be accurately quantified at present. The WHO emphasis is on strengthening surveillance in these high-risk areas to better map the outbreak and guide response measures. No specific case or death counts are provided in the report, and there is no detail on laboratory confirmation, transmission sources, or imported/exported cases; the focus remains on improving monitoring to illuminate the epidemic’s true scope.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がエボラについて声明：「コンゴ民主共和国での拡大の全範囲は不明」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラはCEPRの最重要監視疾患であり、監視システムの不完全さと地理的範囲の不確実性が指摘されている。
triage.notes: エボラは PHE 認定疾患。記事は DRC でのアウトブレイク継続と WHO による監視強化の必要性を報告。「blind spots」や不完全な疫学情報の存在が明示されており、対応困難性が高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Grande do Sul tem caso suspeito de ebola; Saiba onde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul Has a Suspected Ebola Case; Find Out Where.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul State Health Secretariat is investigating a suspected Ebola case in Novo Hamburgo, within the Porto Alegre metropolitan area. The patient, a 64-year-old man, recently traveled to Uganda, Africa, and sought care locally. A rapid malaria test detected Plasmodium falciparum, and malaria treatment was initiated, but Ebola remains under investigation. He will be transferred to Hospital Conceição in Porto Alegre for specialized care, with samples sent to a laboratory for analysis. If Ebola is confirmed, he will be moved to a national reference hospital. Ebola is described by the WHO as a rare, severe viral hemorrhagic fever that can affect multiple organs. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids (blood, urine, feces) and not via airborne spread; symptoms include high fever, headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding in severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスル州がエボラ疑い症例を報告；発生地を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで初のエボラ疑い症例が報告され、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」と「国際拡大リスク」に該当。ウガンダとの関連性があり、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行の可能性」「管理可能性」に該当。エボラは高い社会的・政治的関心を引く疾患である。
triage.notes: 患者がウガンダから渡航してきた事例であり、国際的な感染症拡大のリスクが懸念される。エボラウイルスは致死率が高く、診断が確定されれば、ただちにPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）相当の対応が必要となる可能性が高い。現在は疑い症例であるが、ウガンダとの接触歴がある点で国際監視ネットワークに直結する。

article.articleHeadline: Новую масштабную вспышку Эболы могла привести смерть пастора -- Reuters
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pastor's death could have sparked a new large-scale Ebola outbreak — Reuters.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could have been sparked by funeral events for 44-year-old pastor Paluku Makundi Denis, whose coffin cracked during a three-hour road journey to burial. A preliminary Reuters-backed epidemiological chain links the funeral to subsequent infections: over 80 mourners attended, and within two weeks about 50 people died with Ebola-like symptoms (fever, vomiting, bleeding). The pastor died in Bunia hospital in early February; officials attributed death to peritonitis, with no Ebola testing at the time. The Congo outbreak has since exceeded 120 deaths and more than 600 infections. WHO has raised national risk to very high, regional high, global low. Uganda’s measures—intense contact tracing and canceling mass gatherings—have helped curb spread. Ebola, first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in present-day DRC, transmits via blood, body fluids, and contaminated surfaces, causing fever and hemorrhagic symptoms with potential multi-organ failure and death.

triage.headline_ja: 牧師の死がエボラの大規模流行のきっかけとなった可能性 — ロイター
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。既に120人以上の死亡と600人以上の感染が確認され、DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行は緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの流行が主題であり、既に120人以上の死亡、600人以上の感染確認。Bunia市での初期集団感染から拡大。ウガンダは隣接国として言及されているが、DRCが主要な発生地。WHOが国家リスクを非常に高に、地域リスクを高に評価。対象国リストの確認により、DRC（203312）のみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Новий масштабний спалах Еболи могла спричинити смерть пастора -- Reuters
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new large-scale Ebola outbreak could have caused the pastor's death — Reuters
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may have begun with the funeral of a 44-year-old pastor, Paluku Makundi Denis. The pastor died in Bunia in February; no Ebola tests were performed. His wooden coffin, loaded into an overcrowded SUV for a three-hour ride to Mongbvalu cemetery, cracked under weight as mourners rode with it. Over 80 relatives and neighbors attended. In the days and weeks after, several community members fell ill; within two weeks, about 50 deaths occurred with Ebola-like symptoms (fever, vomiting, bleeding). By Reuters’ briefing, the outbreak had surpassed 120 deaths and more than 600 cases. Uganda’s measures—intense contact tracing and cancellation of mass gatherings—helped curb spread, while Congo faces a very high national outbreak risk per the WHO. Ebola, identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in present-day DRC, transmits via bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな大規模エボラ出血熱の流行、牧師の死亡が引き金となった可能性——ロイター通信
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準全て該当。DRCでの大規模エボラ流行の発生であり、600例以上の確定/疑似症例と120名以上の死亡が報告されており、ウガンダへも既に波及している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは「接触者追跡などの対策措置を実施して流行の拡大を抑制できた」との文脈であり、主たる流行地はDRCのBunia（イトゥリ州）とされている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため検証対象地として追加。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。2024年後半～2025年初頭のDRC-ウガンダにおける実際のエボラ流行をモデルにした想定シナリオと推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Macacos da Amazônia contraem hepatite B humana em áreas degradadas, diz estudo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonian Monkeys Contract Human Hepatitis B in Degraded Areas, Study Says.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) detected in wild neotropical primates in the Brazilian Amazon. In a study by researchers from the University of Salford (UK) and the Universidade Federal do Amazonas (Brazil), blood and liver tissue from 88 primates representing 28 species were analyzed in two regions of the Brazilian Amazon: Rondônia and Mato Grosso, areas heavily impacted by human activity, and a remote upper Japurá River region in Amazonas, considered less affected by humans. For the first time, evidence of human HBV was found in wild neotropical primates, indicating cross-species transmission potentially driven by environmental degradation and human encroachment in primate habitats. The research, published April 3 in EcoHealth, underscores potential zoonotic/reverse-zoonotic risks and highlights how habitat disturbance may alter spillover dynamics between humans and primates.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾンのサルが劣化した地域で人間のB型肝炎に感染、研究が示唆
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物からのB型肝炎ウイルス検出で逆人獣共通感染のリスクが示唆されるが、ヒト症例の報告がなく、現在の公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は不明。動物での検出という研究報告であるため、スクリーニング基準（異常性・管理可能性）で要注視。
triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物（サル）でのHBV検出に関する研究報告であり、ヒト症例の発症報告ではない。逆人獣共通感染（人間→動物への病原体伝播）のリスク指摘であるが、ヒト感染者への直接的な影響は明記されていない。環境破壊に関連した感染症動態の変化という観点では関心があるが、確認されたリスクは理論的であり、現時点での公衆衛生学的な深刻性は不明。継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Escolas de Gaúcha do Norte mobilizam estudantes em ações práticas de prevenção à dengue | Cliquef5 - Noticias de Primavera do Leste e Campo Verde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Schools in Gaúcha do Norte mobilize students in practical dengue prevention actions | Cliquef5 - News from Primavera do Leste and Campo Verde.
article.articleSummary: Gaúcha do Norte, Mato Grosso, Brazil, advances dengue, Zika, and chikungunya prevention through the Agente Mirim program, training students to monitor homes and act as preventive multipliers. On June 9–10, 2026, Escola Independência’s 2nd–3rd years participated in Dengue Bowling and symptom-focused quizzes to identify and eliminate standing water, with candies and future certificates as incentives. 4th–5th graders received practical Agente Mirim training, conducting home visits alongside environmental surveillance technicians to observe the work of Endemias Control Agents (ACE). A key component was demonstrating ovitrampas, mosquito egg-traps used to map vector presence, aligned with a nationwide initiative expanding in Mato Grosso in early 2026. The municipal Environmental Surveillance leads the effort to extend knowledge from schools to residences, reinforcing vector-control measures. Brazil reported roughly a 75% drop in dengue notifications by late April 2026, though Mato Grosso remains among states with notable arboviral activity. Plans include extending to Escola Bem Me Quer, Botuverá, and Xingu Nova Aliança.

triage.headline_ja: ガウーシャ・ド・ノルテの学校が学生を動員してデング熱予防の実践的行動に取り組む | Cliquef5 - プリマヴェーラ・ド・レステとカンポ・ヴェルデのニュース
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱の同時発生が確認されるブラジル・マットグロッソ州での予防活動報道。全国的な通知は75%減少しているが、同州では依然としてアルボウイルス活動が活発であり、ベクター制御の取り組みが強化されている。ただし記事は予防キャンペーンに焦点を当てており、新規感染数や重症度についての具体的データが不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はマットグロッソ州での予防教育プログラムに焦点を当てており、直接的な感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、既知の蚊媒介性アルボウイルス（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）に対する公衆衛生対応。全国レベルでは2026年4月下旬までにデング熱通知が75%減少しており、流行は管理下にあると思われるが、マットグロッソ州は依然として活動が続いている。継続的に後続情報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: FDA approves emergency use of medication to treat screwworm in dogs, cats
article.articleSummary: New World screwworm (NWS) infestations identified in Texas (eight cases) and New Mexico (one case) as of June 12, with cattle and goats affected in Zavala, La Salle, Gillespie, and Edwards counties; a dog case initially reported in Andrews County was reclassified to Lea County, New Mexico. FDA issued an emergency use authorization for nitenpyram to treat NWS infestations in dogs and cats. Nitenpyram, a flea medication (Capstar), killed most NWS larvae within hours in Brazilian studies; a second dose six hours after the first is recommended. Remaining larvae may require removal by a veterinarian, and wound-care plans are advised. NWS lays eggs in open wounds or mucous membranes; larvae feed on living flesh and can infect humans rarely. The screwworm, historically eradicated in the U.S., is expanding north from Panama, about 300 miles south of the Texas border. Public updates will be provided daily by authorities.

triage.headline_ja: FDA、犬と猫のスクリューワーム治療用医薬品の緊急使用を承認
triage.triage_reason: 米国で獣医衛生上の懸念（スクリューワーム侵出）があるが、対象国内での人間への感染は極めて稀であり、IHR基準に該当しない。対象国（Brazil）での実際の発生報告がなく、医薬品承認のニュースが主体である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Brazil を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーに基づくと、実際の発生はテキサス州とニューメキシコ州（米国）であり、ブラジルは医薬品効能試験の参考国として言及されているのみ。対象国リストに米国は含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。スクリューワームは獣医衛生上の問題であり、IHRの人間対象の基準に直接該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: O que se sabe sobre casos de Ebola investigados no RS e SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What Is Known About Ebola Cases Under Investigation in Rio Grande do Sul and São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Brazil reports no confirmed Ebola virus disease cases; two suspected cases are under investigation—one in Rio Grande do Sul and one in São Paulo. Earlier suspected cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro were discarded. In response to a WHO alert, the National Contingency Plan for Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers was activated, with intensified surveillance for travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The Rio Grande do Sul case involves a 64-year-old man who recently traveled to Uganda; a rapid malaria test was positive (Plasmodium falciparum), but Ebola testing by Fiocruz continues; he will be transferred to Porto Alegre for ongoing care with 30-day contact monitoring. In São Paulo, a 31-year-old woman who traveled to North Kivu, RDC, arrived 6 June and developed diarrhea and fever on 9 June; she is isolating at IIER; malaria negative, Ebola testing pending at IAL.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスル州とサンパウロ州で調査中のエボラ疑い症例について判明していること
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダおよびDRCから帰国した複数の疑い症例が報告され、WHOアラート発令に基づいて国家対応計画が発動されている。国際的な感染症拡大リスクと公開情報関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例2件がブラジル国内で報告されており、症例はウガンダおよびDRC（北キブ地域）からの帰国者。WHOアラートに基づいて国家対応計画（Plano de Contingência Nacional para Febre Hemorrágica Viral）が発動され、DRCおよびウガンダからの渡航者に対する強化サーベイランスが実施されている。マラリア陽性と陰性が混在しており、エボラ検査は継続中。IHR基準4つすべてに該当するため、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente com suspeita de ebola é transferido para o GHC, em Porto Alegre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient with suspected Ebola is transferred to GHC in Porto Alegre
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-12, a 64-year-old man with recent travel to Uganda was transported from Novo Hamburgo to Porto Alegre's Grupo Hospitalar Conceição (GHC) for suspected Ebola. Malaria infection was confirmed; given the Uganda travel history, Ebola remains a clinical-epidemiological suspicion. The transfer began around 15:20 from UPA Canudos and arrived at the hospital’s northern sector around 16:10. The ambulance used a back-service entrance, with a temporary blockage to minimize hospital traffic. The GHC reported a dedicated isolation area with exclusive staff, PPE, and cleaning equipment for the patient. A blood sample was collected and sent to Fiocruz, the national reference laboratory, to confirm or exclude Ebola. If Ebola is confirmed, the patient would be transferred to a national reference hospital in Rio de Janeiro or São Paulo. The case is imported, involving limited cross-traffic and strict infection-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者がポルトアレグレのGHCに転院
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ渡航歴のあるエボラ疑い患者がブラジルで確認され、マラリア確定、エボラ臨床疫学的疑い継続。国際的な移動リスク、国家参照検査機関への検体送付、重症性の高い病原体の懸念から、IHR基準複数該当かつWPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダからの輸入例。マラリア確定、エボラは臨床疫学的疑い。Fiocruzで確認検査予定。エボラ陽性の場合はリオデジャネイロまたはサンパウロの国家参照病院に転院予定。感染制御対策が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente de Novo Hamburgo com suspeita de ebola trabalhou sete meses em Uganda; veja o que se sabe sobre o caso | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient from Novo Hamburgo with suspected Ebola virus disease worked seven months in Uganda; see what is known about the case | abc+
article.articleSummary: A 64-year-old man from Novo Hamburgo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, is under investigation for Ebola virus disease after returning from Uganda (East Africa) where he worked for about seven months. He returned to Brazil on May 18 without symptoms, but by early June developed fever and blood pressure changes. He sought care on June 2, was hospitalized June 3, discharged June 5, and readmitted the same day due to worsening condition. A rapid malaria test during the investigation was positive for Plasmodium falciparum, and malaria treatment was started immediately. Ebola testing is being conducted by Fiocruz, with results pending. Authorities activated national surveillance protocols; the patient has been transferred from UPA Canudos to Grupo Hospitalar Conceição in Porto Alegre, with possible transfer to a national reference hospital if Ebola is confirmed. Contact monitoring has begun for people with recent exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ノボ・ハンブルゴの患者がエボラ疑い症例、ウガンダで7ヶ月間勤務；症例について既知の情報を参照
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において異常性（帰国後の発症）・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクの3項目が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準においても異常性・重症度・流行リスク・管理能力の懸念が複数該当。エボラウイルス病疑い症例として緊急対応を要する。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダでの7ヶ月間の勤務後、2026年5月18日にブラジルへ帰国。6月初旬に発熱・血圧変化を呈し、6月3日に入院。マラリア（Plasmodium falciparum）が確認されているが、Fiocruzでのエボラウイルス検査は継続中。接触者監視が開始されており、確定診断待機中。ウガンダはエボラ流行地であり、帰国者への高度な警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US to provide $50 million more in funding to counter Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: US to provide $50 million in funding to CEPI to develop medical countermeasures against Bundibugyo Ebola during the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda. As of June 12, 2026, Congo has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; Uganda has 19 cases. There are no licensed vaccines against Bundibugyo virus. The funding, part of the US total Ebola response of $270 million, will support laboratory research, clinical trials, and manufacturing for countermeasure candidates. CEPI has committed over $60 million to a portfolio of four vaccine candidates and is evaluating additional options. The U.S. is coordinating with the CDC, DRC and Uganda to mount a rapid, comprehensive response, and efforts emphasize keeping potentially exposed individuals overseas to limit spread. The Bundibugyo strain is a rare Ebola variant driving this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ流行対策のため5000万ドルの追加資金を提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常なBundibugyo株、複数国への国際拡大、対国際対応の動き）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダでのエボラ流行が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当対象である。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo株は稀なエボラ変種であり異常性が高い。死亡率（20.1%）および国際的対応体制の動員が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: ΗΠΑ: Νέα χρηματοδότηση $50 εκατ. για την αντιμετώπιση της έξαρσης του Έμπολα στην Αφρική
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US: New $50 million funding to tackle the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: US commits $50 million to CEPI to accelerate development of vaccines and therapeutics for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in Africa. The funding, announced by the State Department, raises total US Ebola-related assistance to $270 million. CEPI reports over $60 million already pledged for four candidate vaccines, with additional options under consideration. CEPI CEO Dr. Richard Hatchett notes there is currently no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo and that the new funds will speed laboratory studies, clinical trials, and manufacturing of countermeasures to curb the outbreak and bolster global readiness. As of June 12, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths; the outbreak has reached Uganda with 19 cases. The situation is complicated by weeks of undetectable spread, demanding intensified control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 米国：アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行対策に5,000万ドルの新規資金援助
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。確認症例676例、死亡136例、複数国での発生が報告されており、ハイリスク感染症であるエボラウイルス病の流行拡大対応の国際的支援実施。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（676例、136死亡）とウガンダ（19例）でのエボラ出血熱発生が明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。米国による $50 million の国際支援決定、Bundibugyo株のワクチン開発加速、未検出感染期間の問題など、複数のハイリスク因子が存在。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تحذّر من استمرار تفشي إيبولا شرق الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization warns of the ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 10, 2026, Ebola virus disease continues to sweep eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, per Bloomberg News. The majority of cases are centered in Ituri province, but infections have been detected in 34 health zones spanning Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO epidemiology and intervention lead Olivier Le Bolan in Beni, North Kivu, said new health zones are identified almost daily, underscoring the outbreak’s true extent and the need to boost experienced staff, surveillance, contact tracing, and diagnostic testing. Gaps persist, including a shortage of isolation beds—figures show only about 250 beds across the three affected regions. No formal outbreak size estimate has been issued by WHO, contrasting with past projections of a West Africa-scale epidemic (2014–2016). Two recent deaths occurred among internally displaced people in the Kabanjba camp housing around 30,000 refugees, where overcrowding increases transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）が中部コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の継続的な流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当（異常/予想外、重症度、長期曝露、流行易易性）。エボラウイルス病は高い致死性と国際的懸念を伴う指定感染症であり、フルリスク評価への進行が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は指定感染症（Notifiable Disease）。記事サマリーで確認された676確定症例、136死亡、患者が複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）に分布、新規患者が継続的に発生中、避難民キャンプでの感染など、拡大リスクが高い。国際的な支援体制強化の必要性がWHOにより言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Oms, 'l'epidemia di Ebola continua a diffondersi nell'est del Congo' - Sanità
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO, 'the Ebola epidemic continues to spread in eastern Congo' - Health
article.articleSummary: 676 confirmed Ebola cases, including 136 deaths, attributed to the Bundibugyo strain in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 11 June 2026. The outbreak remains concentrated in Ituri province but has spread to 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with new zones identified almost daily, underscoring widespread transmission and high population mobility. The Bundibugyo strain has no available vaccine. Health systems are fragile and insecurity persists, making response efforts particularly difficult, though Congo retains substantial Ebola-management experience in the affected areas. Contact tracing is improving, with just over 70% of contacts correctly traced, a meaningful advance over previous weeks. The figures come from Congolese Health Ministry data transmitted via the World Health Organization, reflecting ongoing challenges and the need for sustained public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、「エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ東部で引き続き拡大している」- 保健
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、確認された676症例と136死亡を伴う進行中のエボラウイルス病の流行が、複数州に拡大している。国際的な懸念とWHO関与が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは確認症例676例、死亡136例、Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の流行をDRC東部で報告。Ituri州、North Kivu州、South Kivu州の34保健地域に拡大。ワクチン未利用、脆弱な保健システム、治安悪化が課題だが、接触者追跡率は70%を超えている。WHOが関与し、コンゴ保健省データに基づく。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в ДР Конго выросло до 139
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in DR Congo has risen to 139.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 June 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 139 deaths (up 3 in the last 24 hours) and 689 confirmed cases (up 13). The outbreak began on 15 May in eastern DR Congo, with the epicenter in Ituri Province. The Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media reported these figures in the daily bulletin. The Africa CDC has expressed concern about contact tracing, noting an official rate of 61% of contacts identified, while experts say it should reach about 95% to curb transmission. The report situates ongoing transmission in the eastern region; no additional locations or imported/exported cases are detailed. Keywords: Ebola, DR Congo, Ituri, outbreak, contact tracing, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が139人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生への影響が深刻で、国際的拡大リスクが高く、感染症の新規発生として異常・予想外。接触者追跡率が目標値を下回る管理上の懸念も存在。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは極めて高い致死率（ここで20%程度と推定）と国際的懸念を有する。2026年5月15日発生開始で、28日間で689例・139死亡の急速な拡大。接触者追跡の管理課題（61% vs 95%目標）が指摘されており、マネージャビリティリスクも高い。DRCはWPRO対象外国であるため verified_locations に含まれていないが、グローバルな脅威シグナルとして最優先の処理が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus: Unveiling the Hidden Agricultural Threat Behind the MV Hondius
article.articleSummary: ANDES virus hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship in May 2026, confirmed by WHO on May 2, with evidence of human-to-human transmission and cases reported across multiple continents by CDC and UK/France. The incident highlights hantaviruses’ zoonotic risk, transmitted via rodent excreta; HFRS dominates Asia/Europe, HPS in the Americas, with HPS case fatality up to 40%. China accounts for 70–90% of agricultural hantavirus disease; 2004–2019 saw >209,000 HFRS cases and ~1,900 deaths, with 2023 and agricultural workers disproportionately affected (~65%). A 2025 Vietnam serosurvey of 210 wildlife farmers found 10.1% seroprevalence, with active infections in Dong Nai; farming environments are primary exposure points. HTNV and SEOV circulate in China within rice paddies, grain storage, maize fields, barns; spring/autumn peaks. Preventive measures include rodent-proof storage, wet cleaning, PPE, rodent monitoring; China’s bivalent HFRS vaccine targets HTNV/SEOV.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：MV Hondius号クルーズ船の発生の背後にある隠された農業的脅威を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOによる確認、複数大陸での症例報告、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠があり、国際的対応が必要である。
triage.notes: 記事は国際クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス（ANDES virus）の集団発症を報告。WHO確認済みでヒト-ヒト感染の証拠あり。発生地域にはスペイン（対象国外）も含まれるが、サマリーの主要な焦点はアジア地域（中国・ベトナム）の農業関連リスク分析。中国は世界のHFRS症例の70-90%を占め、ベトナムでも農業従事者の血清陽性率が10.1%。複数大陸での症例報告により国際的対応が急務。
